### [1] [Tuning La0.7Sr0.3MnO3 magnetic anisotropy via interfacial coupling in homometallic trilayers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37736)
*Nunzia Coppola,Giovanni Vinai,Alksandr Yu Petrov,Chiara Sacco,Hafiz Sami Ur Rehman,Sofia Scarnicci,Lucia Capogna,Cinzia Di Giorgio,Carmela Aruta,Luigi Maritato,Alice Galdi*

Main category: cond-mat.mtrl-sci

TL;DR: 该工作通过磁光克尔效应（MOKE）与磁阻测量，研究SrMnO3/La0.7Sr0.3MnO3/SrMnO3三明治结构（trilayer）的复杂磁性，证明界面重构与铁磁/反铁磁竞争可调控LSMO层磁性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旨在探索利用异质结（heterostructure）界面效应调控磁性行为的可行性，特别是结构重构、轨道重构（orbital reconstruction）与界面铁磁/反铁磁竞争如何影响复杂磁性。

Method: 结合磁光克尔效应（magneto-optic Kerr effect, MOKE）与磁阻（magnetoresistance）测量，并采用两种不同LSMO层厚度以改变界面作用的相对权重。

Result: 在125 K以下观察到LSMO易磁化轴（magnetic easy axis）的自旋重取向（spin reorientation），归因于界面交换相互作用超过衬底诱导磁各向异性；界面超交换与交换作用竞争形成高度阻挫的界面自旋玻璃态（spin glass state），使矫顽场（coercive field）增强约20倍并产生交换偏置（exchange bias）。

Conclusion: 界面效应驱动的磁晶各向异性（magnetocrystalline anisotropy）改变导致各向异性磁阻（anisotropic magneto-resistance）响应变化，并主导低温行为；表明异质结是调控与控制磁性的有效策略。

Abstract: In this work we explore the complex magnetic behaviour of SrMnO3/La0.7Sr0.3MnO3/SrMnO3 trilayers combining magneto-optic Kerr effect (MOKE) and magneto-resistance measurements. The interplay of structural and orbital reconstruction and the competition of ferromagnetism/antiferromagnetism at the interfaces is responsible of a variety of complex magnetic properties, highlighting the use of heterostructures as an effective strategy to tune and control magnetic behaviour. We demonstrate the possibility to tune the magnetic properties of a ferromagnetic La0.7Sr0.3MnO3 (LSMO) layer, embedded in two homometallic antiferromagnetic layers (SrMnO3, SMO), by properly varying the role of interfaces using two different LSMO thickness values. Spin reorientation of the LSMO magnetic easy axis away from its room temperature orientation was observed below 125 K, due to the predominance of exchange interaction at the interface over the substrate-induced magnetic anisotropy, in agreement with established models for homometallic manganite heterostructures. The competition of super-exchange and exchange interactions at the interface results in a highly frustrated interfacial spin glass state, resulting in 20-fold enhancement of the coercive field and exchange bias. The modification of the magnetocrystalline anisotropy driven by the interfacial effects leads to a change in the anisotropic magneto-resistance response of the system, which dominates the low temperature behaviour.

</details>


### [2] [MoireKP: An Automated Workflow for Symmetry-Constrained Moiré Continuum Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37760)
*Yan Zhang,Hanqi Pi,Wangqian Miao,Zhong Fang,Hongming Weng,Xi Dai,B. Andrei Bernevig,Quansheng Wu*

Main category: cond-mat.mtrl-sci

TL;DR: MoireKP 是一个自动化工作流，可从局域轨道第一性原理哈密顿量（ab initio Hamiltonian）构建紧凑连续模型（continuum model），在多种扭转莫尔体系（moiré materials）中重现截断原子平面波能带至 3.0 meV 以内。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 第一性原理哈密顿量虽包含研究莫尔材料所需的电子信息，但其规模庞大导致后续计算代价高昂，亟需在保持低能物理的同时大幅降维。

Method: 构建谷分辨（valley-resolved）的截断原子平面波（truncated atomic-plane-wave, TAPW）哈密顿量，选取低能基组，并将晶体对称性操作投影到该基组；由此确定对称性允许的哈密顿量项，其系数通过将低能有效哈密顿量投影到相应算符基组获得，模型维度、局域参考态与谐波截断可自动或由用户指定。

Result: 在 AA 堆叠扭转双层 MoTe₂、AB 堆叠扭转双层 ZrS₂ 与 A–AB 扭转三层 MoTe₂（覆盖 K、M、Γ 谷）上验证，所有模型在高对称 k 路径的目标窗口内重现 TAPW 能带能量，误差在 3.0 meV 以内。

Conclusion: 该基于哈密顿量的构建流程在选定低能子空间内保留了波函数信息，为从第一性原理出发系统生成紧凑、对称性一致的莫尔连续模型提供了自动化方案。

Abstract: First-principles Hamiltonians contain the electronic information needed to study moiré materials, but their size makes subsequent calculations costly. We present MoireKP, an automated workflow for constructing compact continuum models from localized-orbital ab initio Hamiltonians. The workflow constructs a valley-resolved truncated atomic-plane-wave (TAPW) Hamiltonian, selects a low-energy basis, and projects the crystal-symmetry operations into this basis. These representations determine the symmetry-allowed Hamiltonian terms, whose coefficients are obtained by projecting the low-energy effective Hamiltonian onto the corresponding operator basis. The model dimension, localized reference states, and harmonic cutoff can be selected automatically or specified by the user. This Hamiltonian-based construction retains wave-function information within the selected low-energy subspace. We apply the workflow to AA-stacked twisted bilayer MoTe$_2$, AB-stacked twisted bilayer ZrS$_2$, and A--AB twisted trilayer MoTe$_2$, covering K, M, and $Γ$ valleys. All models reproduce TAPW band energies within 3.0 meV in the target windows along high-symmetry $k$ paths.

</details>


### [3] [Planar energetics do not determine twin persistence in nanocrystalline aluminium](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37925)
*Yue Wu,Yuan Tian,Haoyu Wan,Deng Pan,Mingwei Chen*

Main category: cond-mat.mtrl-sci

TL;DR: 面心立方（face-centred cubic, fcc）金属中，平面能量学（planar energetics）是孪生能力（twinnability）的标准描述符，但本工作表明它并不能决定纳米晶铝中形变孪晶（deformation twins）是否保留：两个复现相同零载荷滑移曲线与相近层状能量面的机器学习势（machine-learned potentials）分别给出64%与14%的孪晶覆盖率；局部牵引力取向与部分位错（partial-slip）前沿的到达顺序才是决定性因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 平面能量学长期被用作fcc金属孪生能力的标准描述符，也是原子间势（interatomic potentials）的常规验证目标。已有认识默认平面能量学可预测孪晶是否形成并保留，但这一假设在纳米晶（nanocrystalline）体系中缺乏验证。因此需要检验在平面能量学几乎一致的前提下，孪晶保留行为是否仍然一致。

Method: 采用两个机器学习势（machine-learned potentials），二者复现相同的零载荷滑移曲线（zero-load slip curves）与间距相近的层状能量面（layered energy surfaces）。在相同加载条件下，从共同的分离层错前驱体（separated-fault precursor）出发进行原子尺度模拟，并对比二者预测的孪晶演化与保留行为。

Result: 两势对保留孪晶覆盖率（retained twin coverage）的预测分别为64%与14%，出现显著分歧。分歧源于畸变部分位错核（distorted partial cores）内部沿尾随平移（trailing translation）方向的力，该平移会移除外层层错（outer fault）。平面能量学仅设定边界条件：外层层错使中间面剪切（middle-plane shear）的增量势垒（incremental barrier）降低一半以上，但孪晶完成与外层层错移除之间的能量差仅10–21 mJ m⁻²。

Conclusion: 孪晶能否保留并非由平面能量学决定，而取决于局部牵引力（local traction）相对全滑移角平分线（full-slip bisector）的取向，以及来自晶界网络（grain-boundary network）的部分滑移前沿的到达顺序。这意味着以平面能量学作为孪生能力描述符与势函数验证目标存在局限，纳米晶体系中的孪晶保留需考虑局部力学与位错前沿时序。

Abstract: Planar energetics are the standard descriptors of twinnability in face-centred cubic metals and the usual validation targets for interatomic potentials. Here we show that they do not determine whether deformation twins persist in nanocrystalline aluminium. Two machine-learned potentials reproducing the same zero-load slip curves and closely spaced layered energy surfaces predict, from a common separated-fault precursor under identical loading, retained twin coverage of 64\% and 14\%. The divergence traces to forces within distorted partial cores acting along the trailing translation that would remove an outer fault. Planar energetics do set the margin: an outer fault more than halves the incremental barrier for middle-plane shear, yet twin completion and fault removal remain separated by only 10--21 mJ m\textsuperscript{-2}. Whether an assembled twin persists is decided instead by the orientation of local traction relative to the full-slip bisector and by the arrival order of partial-slip fronts from the grain-boundary network.

</details>


### [4] [Analytical framework for interpreting thermoreflectance measurements of nanoline gratings under finite spot illumination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37957)
*Abhishek Pathak,Seungwon Park,Shubham Deshmukh,Alan J. H. McGaughey,Jonathan A. Malen*

Main category: cond-mat.mtrl-sci

TL;DR: 本文提出基于频域热反射（frequency-domain thermoreflectance, FDTR）的技术，用于测量表面带有金属纳米线光栅结构的多层材料堆栈的有效热性质，并建立含有限激光光斑半径与光栅尺寸的解析热扩散模型，经实验验证后可作为测量热导率随加热器尺寸变化的基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有FDTR方法在表面图案化（金属纳米线光栅）情形下缺乏考虑有限激光光斑高斯分布与光栅尺寸的解析模型，难以准确提取有效热性质，也限制了将方法拓展至研究热导率随加热器尺寸变化及非扩散热输运（non-diffusive thermal transport）的能力。

Method: 推导了用于预测FDTR相位响应（phase response）的解析热扩散模型（analytical heat diffusion model），模型纳入泵浦与探测激光的高斯强度分布及有限光斑半径，以及纳米线光栅的尺寸参数；并在a-SiO₂与c-蓝宝石衬底上制备宽度100–1000 nm的Au纳米线光栅进行测量，将模型与实测结果对比验证。

Result: 模型与测量在不同激光光斑半径和纳米线宽度下均表现高度一致；反演得到的c-蓝宝石体热导率（bulk thermal conductivity）以及Au-Cr/a-SiO₂与Au-Cr/c-蓝宝石界面的热边界导（thermal boundary conductance）与作者前期测量及文献值相当。由于所用衬底声子平均自由程（phonon mean free paths, MFPs）较短，全宽度范围内热输运保持扩散（diffusive）区。

Conclusion: 该已验证模型可作为稳健基线（robust baseline），用于将本方法拓展至测量有效热导率随加热器尺寸的变化；该途径尤其适用于存在非扩散热输运区、可探测声子MFP相关热导率贡献的材料体系。

Abstract: A frequency-domain thermoreflectance (FDTR)-based technique is presented to measure the effective thermal properties of a material stack whose surface is patterned with metallic nanoline gratings that are heated and probed by lasers. An analytical heat diffusion model is derived for predicting the FDTR phase response that incorporates a finite laser spot radius with a Gaussian intensity profile for the pump and probe lasers, as well as the dimensions of the nanoline grating. The model is validated by comparing with measurements of Au nanoline gratings, with widths ranging from 100 to 1000 nm, fabricated on a-SiO$_2$ and $c$-sapphire substrates. Due to the short phonon mean free paths (MFPs) in these substrates, thermal transport remains in the diffusive regime for the whole range of nanoline widths. The model and the measurement show excellent agreement across different laser spot radii and nanoline widths, with a bulk thermal conductivity value of $c$-sapphire and the thermal boundary conductances at the Au-Cr/a-SiO$_2$ and Au-Cr/$c$-sapphire interfaces comparable to our prior measurements and the literature. The validated model will serve as a robust baseline for extending this method to measure effective thermal conductivity as a function of the heater size. This approach is particularly relevant for materials where non-diffusive thermal transport regimes enable probing phonon MFP dependent contributions to the thermal conductivity.

</details>


### [5] [Electronic-morphological decoupling in mixed-dimensional halide perovskite heterostructures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37964)
*Mahmoud Samadpour,Alireza Fathi Beiraghvandi,Kazem Meraji,Tristan Sachsenweger Ballantyne,Fuxiang Ji,Mahdi Mohammadi,Nasim Kabir,Wolfgang Tress*

Main category: cond-mat.mtrl-sci

TL;DR: 在混合维度钙钛矿异质结构中，表面形貌的显著演变并不必然导致电子学异质性增加：低维Ruddlesden-Popper覆盖层虽提高粗糙度，却改善并维持了辐射复合准费米能级劈裂的空间均匀性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表面形貌通常被视为薄膜质量的指标，且一般认为更光滑的薄膜具有更均匀的光电性质。本文旨在检验“表面演化必然导致电子学异质性增加”这一常规认知是否成立。

Method: 采用源自位阻型5-叔丁基-菲啶鎓（5-tert-butyl-phenanthridinium）阳离子的低维Ruddlesden-Popper覆盖层构建混合维度异质结构，并将统计原子力显微镜（AFM）分析与共聚焦、空间分辨光致发光（PL）光谱相结合，关联表面形貌与微区光电性质（含准费米能级劈裂，QFLS）。

Result: 覆盖层虽增加表面粗糙度与高度不对称性，但未增加电子学不均匀性；相较原始三维薄膜，异质结构表现出增强的PL、降低的非辐射复合以及更均匀的辐射QFLS空间分布。在加速老化条件下差异更明显：原始薄膜出现显著的发射与QFLS空间涨落，而覆盖异质结构基本保持光电均匀性。

Conclusion: 低维覆盖层可抑制老化诱导的光电无序，表明形貌不规则下仍可维持电子学均匀性；这种形貌与电子学性质的解耦为耐久、高性能钙钛矿光伏的设计提供了原则。

Abstract: Surface morphology is widely considered an indicator of thin-film quality, with smoother films generally expected to exhibit more uniform optoelectronic properties. Here, we demonstrate that substantial surface evolution does not necessarily lead to increased electronic heterogeneity in mixed-dimensional perovskite heterostructures. We investigate how low-dimensional Ruddlesden-Popper capping layers derived from the sterically hindered 5-tert-butyl-phenanthridinium cation affect the spatial distributions of photoluminescence (PL) characteristics and quasi-Fermi level splitting (QFLS) in 3D perovskites. By combining statistical atomic force microscopy (AFM) analysis with confocal, spatially resolved PL spectroscopy, we correlate surface topography with microscale optoelectronic properties.
  Although capping increases surface roughness and height asymmetry, it does not increase electronic inhomogeneity. Instead, the heterostructures exhibit enhanced PL, reduced non-radiative recombination, and improved spatial uniformity of radiative QFLS compared with pristine 3D films. Under accelerated aging, this contrast becomes more pronounced: pristine films develop substantial spatial fluctuations in emission and QFLS, whereas capped heterostructures largely preserve their optoelectronic homogeneity. These findings indicate that the low-dimensional capping layer suppresses aging-induced optoelectronic disorder, demonstrating that electronic uniformity can be maintained despite morphological irregularity. This decoupling provides a design principle for developing durable, high-performance perovskite photovoltaics.

</details>


### [6] [Thermal laser evaporation of superconducting Nb films](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38070)
*Yifei Yan,David S. Catherall,Finley B. Donachie,Dorsa Najafipanah,Austin J. Minnich*

Main category: cond-mat.mtrl-sci

TL;DR: 本文利用自建的1070 nm连续波光纤激光热激光蒸发（TLE）系统，在c面蓝宝石上沉积铌（Nb）薄膜，获得高质量超导薄膜，其超导转变温度仅比体材料低10 mK，验证了TLE作为难熔元素物理气相沉积方法的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 热激光蒸发（thermal laser evaporation, TLE）是一种可蒸发高熔点难熔元素的新兴物理气相沉积（physical vapor deposition, PVD）技术，但需通过沉积难熔超导元素并表征薄膜质量来评估其成膜品质。

Method: 采用自建TLE系统（1070 nm连续波光纤激光），将533 W激光聚焦至约500 μm直径作用于Nb靶材，在c面蓝宝石（c-plane sapphire）衬底上沉积Nb薄膜，并进行电学与超导性能表征。

Result: 沉积速率达0.19 Å/s；厚度22.47 ± 0.05 nm、均方根（root-mean-square, RMS）粗糙度0.23 ± 0.02 nm的薄膜室温电阻率为21.60 ± 0.05 μΩ·cm，剩余电阻率比（residual-resistivity ratio, RRR）为5.71；超导转变温度Tc为9.24 K，仅低于体材料值10 mK，转变宽度29 mK。

Conclusion: 在未加热衬底的沉积条件下，该薄膜的电学与超导性能达到或超过其他技术所沉积的薄膜，支持TLE作为难熔元素及化合物通用PVD方法的共识。

Abstract: Thermal laser evaporation (TLE) is an emerging physical vapor deposition (PVD) technique that uses continuous-wave lasers to evaporate even the most refractory elements. The deposition and characterization of superconducting refractory elements are of interest to assess the quality of films deposited by TLE. Here, we report the deposition of niobium (Nb) on c-plane sapphire using a home-built TLE system equipped with a 1070 nm continuous-wave fiber laser. A deposition rate of 0.19 Å/s was achieved with 533 W of laser power focused to a diameter of approximately 500 $μ$m on a Nb target. A film with a thickness of $22.47 \pm 0.05$ nm and a root-mean-square (RMS) roughness of $0.23 \pm 0.02$ nm exhibited a room-temperature resistivity of $21.60 \pm 0.05$ $μΩ\mathrm{cm}$ and a residual-resistivity ratio (RRR) of 5.71. The superconducting transition temperature, $T_\mathrm{c}$, of the film was measured as 9.24 K, only 10 mK below the bulk value, with a transition width of 29 mK. Among films deposited without substrate heating, the electrical and superconducting properties of the present films meet or exceed those deposited by other techniques. This work contributes to the emerging consensus regarding TLE as a versatile PVD method for refractory elements and compounds.

</details>


### [7] [Emergent higher-order optical nonlinearity in self-assembled polar supertextures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38138)
*Daniel A. Bustamante Lopez,Deepankar Sri Gyan,Xiaojiang Li,Vladimir A. Stoica,Sujit Das,Peter Meisenheimer,Akash Surampalli,Mohit Tanwani,Xianghan Xu,Aiden Ross,Long-Qing Chen,Sang-Wook Cheong,Lane W. Martin,Ramamoorthy Ramesh,Venkatraman Gopalan,Wanzheng Hu*

Main category: cond-mat.mtrl-sci

TL;DR: 该工作报道了自组装极性斯格明子（polar skyrmions）在中红外激发下产生巨大且超快的二次谐波产生（second-harmonic generation, SHG）效应，并将高阶非线性归因于平衡态下极性织构内部强烈的周期性局域介电常数调制所致。

Abstract: Odd elasticity extends continuum mechanics to active nonconservative systems containing internal energy sources, such as robotic active metamaterials with nonreciprocal feedback. ### [58] [Finite-step statistical mechanics of scale-invariant learning: spectral equations of state and curvature transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38012)

Main category: cond-mat.stat-mech

TL;DR: 该论文探讨离散随机梯度动力学（discrete stochastic gradient dynamics）中由尺度对称性（scale symmetry）而非热平衡（thermal equilibrium）导出的类热力学关系，并给出量化偏离理想气体描述（ideal-gas description）的诊断工具，其核心是精确的曲率输运恒等式（curvature-transport identity）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 平稳学习（stationary learning）的理想气体描述依赖于严格的噪声假设，而实际神经网络的梯度噪声常偏离这些假设；因此需要厘清哪些类热力学关系源于尺度对称性而非平衡态，并量化非理想涨落。

Result: 曲率输运恒等式将谐振涨落关系的修正分解为可测的曲率变化、有限步余项、梯度-记忆关联与有限窗口漂移项；位移加权曲率变化的均值与二阶矩给出前向与反向状态对之间相对熵（relative entropy）的下界；并计算了高斯输入下整流师生网络（rectified teacher-student networks）激活边界对曲率的贡献。

Abstract: Stationary learning admits an ideal-gas description under restrictive noise assumptions. In neural networks whose gradient noise departs from these assumptions, however, an entropy-scaling relation resembling a Maxwell relation remains approximately valid. We ask which thermodynamic-looking relations follow from scale symmetry rather than equilibrium, and how departures from the ideal-gas description can be quantified, for discrete stochastic gradient dynamics with memory. An exact rescaling of trajectories explains the entropy relation without assuming thermal equilibrium. Within a local harmonic approximation, self-adjusting weight norms yield a spectral equation of state whose virial coefficients are set by moments of the curvature spectrum, and coupled parameter groups can sustain stationary probability currents. Our central result beyond this approximation is an exact curvature-transport identity. The CCM blanket geometry then gives two constructive variance profiles, $Q_\ell$ on the Ising side and $Γ_\ell$ on the auxiliary side. The bipartite shell scale is $$ Q_{\ell+1}Γ_{\ell+1}-Q_\ellΓ_\ell, $$ and Gaussian core comparison removes the core contribution $ΔQ_\ellΔΓ_\ell$ under blanket refinement. The scalar cavity functional has three terms, $$ \mathcal{A}_{\mathrm{perc}}(ν)=\mathbb{E}\left[\log\langle2\cosh x\rangle_ν+α\log\langle U(s)\rangle_ν-\log\langle e^y\rangle_ν\right], $$ where $x$ is the new-spin field, $s$ is the new-constraint field, and $y$ is the cavity correction. </details>


### [70] [Thermodynamic Crossovers in Supercritical Matter: One, No One, and One Hundred Thousand](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39986)

Main category: cond-mat.stat-mech

TL;DR: 该论文论证超临界区（supercritical region）的交叉边界并非由普适临界行为唯一确定：满足既有条件的交叉线（crossover lines）存在无穷多对，其位置依赖所选取的热力学路径与操作判据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为区分超临界区内类液（liquid-like）与类气（gas-like）区域，已有多种判据，且近期提出的 $L^\pm$ 交叉线旨在解决旧定义与 Ising 模型（Ising model）普适临界行为不相容的问题；本文检验这些要求能否唯一确定交叉边界。

Conclusion: 普适临界行为本身不足以选出特权性的超临界热力学交叉边界；此类边界可标识热力学、结构或输运性质上的物理有意义变化，但其精确位置与所划分区域宽度依赖定义所用的操作判据，该限制属于方案选择而非系统属性。

Abstract: Beyond a critical point, two thermodynamic phases become continuously connected, without being separated by any thermodynamic singularity. Recently, a pair of thermodynamic crossover lines, $L^\pm$, was introduced to address a proposed incompatibility of previous definitions with the universal critical behavior of the Ising model. These lines divide the supercritical region into three regimes, meet only at the critical point, and obey the expected critical scaling laws. Here, we demonstrate that these requirements do not uniquely determine the crossover boundaries. Instead, infinitely many pairs of lines satisfy the same conditions, with different choices of thermodynamic paths selecting different crossover boundaries. Restricting to regular probing paths that respect the $Z_2$ symmetry of the critical point recovers the Widom and $L^\pm$ prescriptions asymptotically. This restriction, however, is a choice of protocol rather than a property of the system, and even then two inequivalent prescriptions survive. </details>

</details>

Abstract: We study multi-excited random walks on infinite locally finite trees. Abstract: Randomly connected networks are ubiquitous in computer science, physics or biology. A central question is whether, and how, their collective dynamics depend on the choice of the distribution of the random couplings. We then extend the conjecture to heavy-tailed couplings, and propose a limit driven by a self-consistent $α$-stable process, for which we prove existence for every $α\in(0,2)$ and uniqueness for $α\in[1,2)$, and provide extensive numerical evidence in all three cases.

Abstract: Allowing for small fraction of errors in retrieved stored binary patterns, Hopfield-Hebbian neural network (NN) associative memory dynamics [14] achieves linearly scaled capacity. We consider precisely such practical settings where each \emph{archetype} pattern is replaced with $M$ correlated \emph{examples} with parameter $r$ governing the quality of correlation. We develop a powerful Random Duality Theory (RDT) based framework to analyze correlated data and already on the first level of RDT lifting obtain capacity characterizations that remarkably well match behavior exhibited through simulated dynamics. Moreover, characterizations explicitly feature correlation parameters $M$ and $r$, which allows to precisely determine their effects on phase-transitioning behavior of the underlying dynamics.
  Our results are also a well-fitting complement to the existing literature. Namely, to circumvent challenging statistical mechanics analyses, an alternative combination of spectral and replica methods is considered in [4]. We confirm that [4]'s elegant spectral characterizations are excellent approximations in the low correlated regime. At the same time, we also close the gap in the regimes with higher correlation levels where spectral methods deviate from the practical dynamics performance.

</details>

### [90] [Exploring and optimizing the Vivado Flow on large FPGA designs: A Practical Analysis of Strategies and Their Impact on Timing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38575)
*Kachkachi Nor Eddine*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文比较 Vivado Design Suite 中多种时序指令（timing directives）与优化策略（strategies），以 NQR 谱仪 SoC-FPGA 与高能物理探测器数字读出 ASIC 原型两个测试案例，评估其在时序、面积与运行时间上的权衡，旨在识别最高效的实现流程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FPGA 设计实现时序收敛（timing closure）对高性能应用至关重要，Vivado 虽提供多种优化策略，但为具体项目选定最佳配置仍具挑战性，缺乏明确的策略选择依据。

Method: 基于两个测试案例设计——核四极共振（NQR）谱仪 SoC-FPGA 与高能物理粒子探测器数字读出 ASIC 原型——对 Vivado 的不同时序指令与策略配置进行对比实验，考察性能、时序、面积与运行时间等指标。

Result: 通过两类设计的策略与配置对比，识别出在时序、面积和运行时（runtime）综合表现上较为高效的实现流程；摘要未给出具体量化数据。

Conclusion: Vivado 时序策略的选择需结合具体设计特征进行实验性比较，本文的对比结果为高效流程的选取提供了参考依据，有助于缓解时序收敛过程中的配置选择困难。

Abstract: Achieving timing closure in FPGA designs is crucial, especially for high-performance applications. The Vivado Design Suite offers several strategies for optimization, but finding the best configuration for a given project remains challenging. This paper explores the various Vivado's timing directives and strategies to improve performance across timing, area, and runtime. Through two test-case designs, an NQR spectrometer SoC-FPGA and a digital readout ASIC prototype for high energy physics particle detector's, different strategies and configurations are compared to identify the most efficient flow.

</details>

### [91] [Odds Estimation for Supermassive Black Hole Binaries in Local Core Galaxies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38886)
*C. J. Harris,Kayhan Gültekin*

Main category: astro-ph.GA

TL;DR: 该研究结合 IllustrisTNG 模拟与大质量星系并合历史及半解析核心剥蚀（core-scouring）模型，构建了以五个可观测核心星系属性为输入的逻辑回归（logistic regression）模型，用于预测近邻核心星系在 z=0 时宿主束缚超大质量双黑洞（SMBHB）的概率，并在观测样本中筛出八个可能宿主候选体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超大质量双黑洞（supermassive black hole binaries, SMBHBs）被认为是巨质量星系并合的必然产物，但在近邻星系中对其进行识别仍十分困难；因此需要建立将可观测星系核心属性与双黑洞存在概率相联系的统计方法。

Method: 基于 IllustrisTNG 的大质量星系组装历史，结合半解析核心剥蚀模型：（i）用观测驱动的星系恒星质量函数（stellar mass function）构造核心星系族群；（ii）通过动力学摩擦（dynamical friction）、恒星硬化（stellar hardening）与引力波辐射（gravitational-wave emission）刻画双黑洞演化；（iii）以恒星质量亏损、恒星质量、中心密度、中心速度弥散和有效半径五个可观测预测量进行逻辑回归。

Result: 模型在模拟系统上表现良好，伪 R² 为 0.51±0.03，准确率 0.95±0.01，精确率 0.92±0.03，召回率 0.82±0.04；未并合双黑洞通常较为致密，分离度峰值约 0.3 pc，但仅约 0.3% 在脉冲星计时阵列（pulsar timing array）波段有辐射。

Conclusion: 将模型应用于观测到的核心星系后，识别出八个更可能宿主 SMBHB 的近邻星系；其中 Messier 86（NGC 4406）因曾被独立方法同样指出而尤为值得后续观测验证。

Abstract: Supermassive black hole binaries (SMBHBs) are expected products of massive galaxy mergers, but identifying binaries in nearby galaxies remains challenging. We combine simulated massive-galaxy assembly histories from IllustrisTNG with a semi-analytic core-scouring model to connect observable core galaxy properties to the probability of hosting a bound SMBHB at z=0. We (i) construct a core galaxy population using an observationally motivated galaxy stellar mass function, (ii) model binary evolution through dynamical friction, stellar hardening, and gravitational-wave emission, and (iii) perform logistic regressions with five observable predictors: stellar mass deficit, stellar mass, central density, central velocity dispersion, and effective radius. The resulting models perform well on simulated systems, achieving a pseudo-$R^2$ of $0.51\pm0.03$, accuracy $0.95\pm0.01$, precision $0.92\pm0.03$, and recall $0.82\pm0.04$. Uncoalesced binaries are typically compact, with separations peaking near 0.3 pc, though only $\sim0.3\%$ emit in the pulsar timing array band. Applying the model to observed core galaxies, we identify eight nearby galaxies more likely than not to host SMBHBs. Of those eight host candidates, we note Messier 86 (NGC 4406) as a particularly likely example that was similarly identified using independent means and therefore warrants future follow-up.

</details>

### [92] [A Search in LHCb Open Data for $f$-Baryon Resonances Predicted at HADRON 2025](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37674)
*Soctt Chapman*

Main category: hep-ex

TL;DR: 利用公开的LHCb数据，以无分bin、考虑本底（background-aware）的二维Dalitz似然比较三种假设，检验$\Bbar\to\Lb\Lc K^-$中是否存在含假设$f$夸克的窄$\Lc K^-$共振（3800与3950 MeV）；名义显著性达$4.02\sigma$与$6.17\sigma$，但仅属模型比较诊断量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HADRON 2025上提出的预言认为，含额外假设$f$夸克的类重子态可能以3800与3950 MeV的窄$\Lc K^-$共振形式出现在$\Bbar\to\Lb\Lc K^-$衰变中，本文旨在用公开LHCb数据对该预言进行检验。

Method: 采用无分bin（unbinned）、考虑本底的二维Dalitz似然（two-dimensional Dalitz likelihood）比较三种模型：基线含非共振三体相空间与$\Lb K^-$中的$N(1900)$贡献；模型二将$\Lc K^-$共振质量固定于3800与3950 MeV并拟合宽度；模型三固定3800 MeV质量、放开第二个质量与宽度，并加入两个奇异（exotic）$\Lc\Lb$贡献。

Result: 模型二相对基线给出名义Wilks等效改善$4.02\sigma$，模型三给出名义值$6.17\sigma$。作者明确指出这些显著性仅为模型比较诊断量：共振分数被约束为非负、部分拟合宽度触及参数边界、浮动质量引入试验效应（trials effect），且效率与系统不确定性尚未纳入。

Conclusion: 公开LHCb数据在名义上支持含窄$\Lc K^-$共振的模型，但现有显著性不足以作为发现证据；需纳入效率与系统不确定性并处理边界与试验效应后，方能对$f$夸克相关预言作出可靠判定。

Abstract: A prediction presented at HADRON 2025 proposed two baryon-like states containing an additional hypothesized $f$ quark that could appear in the decay $\Bbar\to\Lb\Lc K^-$ in the form of narrow $\Lc K^-$ resonances at 3800 and 3950~MeV. Public LHCb data are used here to compare three hypotheses with an unbinned, background-aware two-dimensional Dalitz likelihood. The baseline contains nonresonant three-body phase space and an $N(1900)$ contribution in $\Lb K^-$. A second model tests the two a-priori prediction masses directly, fixing $\Lc K^-$ resonances at 3800 and 3950~MeV while fitting their widths. A third model keeps the 3800-MeV mass fixed, allows the second $\Lc K^-$ mass and width to float, and adds two exotic $\Lc\Lb$ contributions. The second model gives a nominal Wilks-equivalent improvement of $4.02σ$ over the baseline, while the third gives a nominal value of $6.17σ$. The quoted significances are model-comparison diagnostics only: the resonance fractions are constrained to be non-negative, some fitted widths reach parameter boundaries, the floating mass introduces a trials effect, and efficiency and systematic uncertainties are not yet incorporated.

</details>


### [93] [The Position Resolution of a Charged Particle Hodoscope Consisting of Triangular Scintillator Counters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37955)
*Edmond Craig Dukes*

Main category: hep-ex

TL;DR: 本文针对由三角计数器（triangular counters）与嵌入式波长位移光纤（wavelength shifting fibers）构成的闪烁体寻迹器（hodoscope），在对相邻计数器光产额插值（interpolation）提升位置分辨率的方法作简要说明后，推导了插值所得 x、y 位置不确定度（uncertainty）随带电粒子入射位置变化的近似表达式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此类寻迹器因成本低、易制作、无需冷却系统、可采用低成本光探测器（photodetectors）、所需电压较低且位置分辨率较好而日益普及；为定量描述其插值定位性能，需要给出位置不确定度随入射位置的解析近似表达。

Method: 先简要说明通过相邻计数器光产额插值提高位置分辨率的做法，随后以带电粒子入射位置为自变量，推导插值 x、y 位置不确定度的近似表达式（approximate expressions）。

Result: 文中给出插值 x、y 位置不确定度作为带电粒子入射位置函数的近似表达式；摘要并指出，插值可获得的位置分辨率通常比计数器间距（counter separation）好一个数量级。

Conclusion: 该工作为基于三角计数器与波长位移光纤的寻迹器提供了插值定位不确定度的近似解析描述，可用于评估其位置分辨率随入射位置的依赖关系。

Abstract: Hodoscopes consisting of triangular counters with embedded wavelength shifting fibers are becoming more popular as they are relatively inexpensive, are easily fabricated, need no cooling systems, employ low-cost photodetectors, require only modest voltages, and perhaps most importantly, have good position resolution. Through interpolation of the light yields between adjacent counters, position resolutions that are typically an order of magnitude better than the counter separation can be obtained. Here, after a brief explanation of how the interpolation is done to improve the position resolution, we derive an approximate expressions for the uncertainty in the interpolated $x$ and $y$ positions as a function of the impact position of the charged particle.

</details>

Zhu,W. Z. Zhu,Y. C. Zhu,Z. A. Zhu,X. Y. Zhuang,M. Zhuge,J. H. Zou,J. Zu*

Main category: hep-ex

TL;DR: 基于 BESIII 探测器在 4.600–4.699 GeV 采集的 4.5 fb$^{-1}$ $e^+e^-$ 湮灭数据，首次对粲重子衰变 $Λ_c^+ \to p K_S^0 π^0$ 进行振幅分析（amplitude analysis），并观测到三个中间共振态过程。据此测量了 $Δ(1600)^+$ 与 $N(1710)^+$ 的质量、宽度及三个过程的衰变分支比（branching fraction）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 论文开展 $Λ_c^+ \to p K_S^0 π^0$ 的首次振幅分析，以分辨该三体末态中可能存在的中间共振态（如 $p\bar{K}^{*}(892)^0$、$Δ(1600)^+$、$N(1710)^+$），从而深入理解粲重子衰变动力学与强子谱（hadron spectroscopy）信息。

Method: 利用 BESIII 探测器在质心能量（center-of-mass energy）4.600 至 4.699 GeV 区间收集的积分亮度（integrated luminosity）4.5 fb$^{-1}$ 的 $e^+e^-$ 湮灭数据，对衰变 $Λ_c^+ \to p K_S^0 π^0$ 进行首次振幅分析，识别各中间过程并测量相应共振态参数与分支比（分支比的不确定度分为统计误差与系统误差两部分）。

Result: 识别出三个过程，统计显著性（statistical significance）分别为 $Λ_c^+ \to p\bar{K}^{*}(892)^0$ 12.8σ、$Λ_c^+ \to Δ(1600)^+ K_S^0$ 14.5σ、$Λ_c^+ \to N(1710)^+ K_S^0$ 6.2σ。测得 $Δ(1600)^+$ 质量为 $(1520.4 \pm 8.8 \pm 37.7)$ MeV、宽度为 $(199.4 \pm 26.4 \pm 39.9)$ MeV；$N(1710)^+$ 质量为 $(1719.7 \pm 9.4 \pm 9.1)$ MeV、宽度为 $(72.0 \pm 18.0 \pm 15.0)$ MeV。三个过程的分支比分别为 $(8.10 \pm 0.80 \pm 5.57)\times10^{-3}$、$(1.58 \pm 0.48 \pm 0.77)\times10^{-3}$ 与 $(2.63 \pm 0.47 \pm 0.29)\times10^{-3}$。

Conclusion: 该工作首次完成 $Λ_c^+ \to p K_S^0 π^0$ 的振幅分析，确认 $Δ(1600)^+$、$N(1710)^+$ 与 $p\bar{K}^{*}(892)^0$ 中间态在 $Λ_c^+$ 衰变中的显著贡献，提供了这些共振态的质量、宽度及相应分支比的实验测定，为粲重子衰变机制与重子共振态性质研究提供数据支撑。

Abstract: Using $e^+e^-$ annihilation data corresponding to an integrated luminosity of 4.5 fb$^{-1}$ collected with the BESIII detector at center-of-mass energies between 4.600 and 4.699 GeV, the first amplitude analysis of the charmed baryon decay $Λ_c^+ \to p K_S^0 π^0$ is performed. The processes $Λ_c^+ \to p \bar{K}^{*}(892)^0$, $Λ_c^+ \to Δ(1600)^+ K_S^0$, and $Λ_c^+ \to N(1710)^+ K_S^0$ are identified with statistical significances of $12.8σ$, $14.5σ$, and $6.2σ$, respectively. The mass and width of $Δ(1600)^+$ are measured to be $(1520.4 \pm 8.8 \pm 37.7)~\text{MeV}$ and $(199.4 \pm 26.4 \pm 39.9)~\text{MeV}$, respectively. The mass and width of $N(1710)^+$ are measured to be $(1719.7 \pm 9.4 \pm 9.1)~\text{MeV}$ and $(72.0 \pm 18.0 \pm 15.0)~\text{MeV}$, respectively. The branching fractions of these processes are determined to be $\mathcal{B}[Λ_c^+ \rightarrow Δ(1600)^+ (\rightarrow p π^0) K_S^0] = (8.10 \pm 0.80 \pm 5.57) \times 10^{-3}$, $\mathcal{B}[Λ_c^+ \rightarrow N(1710)^+ (\rightarrow p π^0) K_S^0] = (1.58 \pm 0.48 \pm 0.77) \times 10^{-3}$, and $\mathcal{B}[Λ_c^+ \rightarrow p \bar{K}^{*}(892)^0 (\rightarrow K_S^0 π^0)] = (2.63 \pm 0.47 \pm 0.29) \times 10^{-3}$, where the first uncertainties are statistical and the second systematic.

</details>


### [95] [The TAMBO Project and the TAMBITO Prototype](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38777)
*Pablo Fernández-Menéndez*

Main category: hep-ex

TL;DR: TAMBO 计划利用秘鲁 Colca 峡谷山体作为靶体，通过探测 1–1000 PeV 能段的 tau 中微子（tau neutrino）衰变产物来填补光学切伦科夫（optical-Cherenkov）与射电实验之间的探测空白，并介绍其原型阵列 TAMBITO 的研发进展与物理潜力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IceCube 与 KM3NeT 已探测到天体物理 PeV 中微子，但天体物理通量弱且大气中微子（atmospheric neutrino）本底显著，限制了对源的深入研究，因此需要在本底被大幅压低的新能段开展探测。

Method: TAMBO 拟在秘鲁 Colca 峡谷陡坡面部署至多 5,000 个粒子探测器（particle detector），探测 tau 中微子与峡谷山体作用后产生的 tau 轻子（tau lepton）衰变产物，覆盖 1–1000 PeV 能段；文中报告项目现状与研发（R&D），重点为 100 单元原型阵列 TAMBITO。

Result: 摘要未给出具体物理结果或灵敏度数值，仅报告项目当前状态与研发进展，包括 100 单元 TAMBITO 原型、预期时间线（projected timeline）及其物理潜力。

Conclusion: TAMBO 定位于光学切伦科夫观测站与射电实验之间的能段，本底抑制良好，有望以独特方式拓展天体物理中微子探测能力。

Abstract: The detection of astrophysical PeV-scale neutrinos by IceCube and KM3NeT observatories has opened the window to probe new phenomena in the universe. However, a deeper study of the sources remains limited by the small astrophysical flux and the sizable atmospheric neutrino background. The Tau Air-Shower Mountain-Based Observatory (TAMBO) aims to overcome these limitations by detecting tau neutrinos from 1\,PeV to 1\,000\,PeV, an energy range in which backgrounds are largely suppressed and which lies between the reach of optical-Cherenkov observatories and that of radio-based experiments. TAMBO will employ up to 5,000 particle detectors installed on the face of a steep hill in the Colca Valley (Perú) to detect tau neutrinos interacting with the face of the canyon in front via the decay products of the associated tau leptons. In this contribution, we will describe the current status of the project and its R\&D, focusing on the 100-unit array TAMBITO prototype, the projected timeline, and the physics potential that this unique detector brings to the field.

</details>

Result: 得益于高统计量与分析设计，所提取截面能强烈区分不同事件产生器预测；在比较的模型中无一能成功描述全部三个变量，最大偏差出现在横向缺失动量（transverse missing momentum）变量。

Conclusion: 该结果为中微子-氩相互作用建模树立了新的基准（benchmark），对当前及未来加速器中微子实验的高精度测量具有关键意义。

Abstract: This letter presents the first neutrino-argon cross-section measurement from the Short-Baseline Near Detector (SBND) at the Fermi National Accelerator Laboratory. We report the nominal flux-averaged single-differential cross sections of muon neutrino charged-current interactions on argon with a single proton and no pions in the final state as functions of the transverse kinematic imbalance variables. Using a subset of Run~1 data corresponding to $8.8\times10^{19}$ protons-on-target, we select 12,804 signal candidates with a purity of 91%. The extracted cross sections discriminate strongly among event-generator predictions, owing to the high statistics and the design of the analysis. Among the compared models, none successfully describes all three variables, with the largest discrepancies in the transverse missing momentum variable. These results set new benchmarks for neutrino-argon interaction modeling, which is crucial for high-precision measurements at current and future accelerator neutrino experiments.

</details>


### [97] [Dark sector searches at BESIII](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39618)
*Zhijun Li,Zhengyun You*

Main category: hep-ex

TL;DR: 该报告综述了BESIII实验利用粲偶素、粲介子、超子与轻介子大样本，在多个衰变道中搜寻亚GeV暗物质、无质量暗光子、暗重子及轻矢量玻色子的最新结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: BESIII采集的大量粲偶素（charmonia）、粲介子（charm mesons）、超子（hyperons）与轻介子（light mesons）样本，为检验暗部门（dark sector）与粲夸克、轻夸克相互作用提供了灵敏途径，因而有必要系统梳理相关搜寻进展。

Method: 采用在特定衰变道中搜寻不可见或奇异末态的实验方法，涵盖 η→π⁰+invisible、J/ψ→φ+invisible、D⁰→ωγ′ 与 D⁰→γγ′、不可见 K⁰_S 衰变、Ξ⁻→π⁻χ，以及 χ_cJ→J/ψV、V→e⁺e⁻ 等通道。

Result: 报告汇总了上述各通道的搜寻结果，其中对 η 衰变搜寻给予特别关注，该结果对标量媒介（scalar-mediated）暗物质给出限制，并检验热遗迹（thermal relic）基准。

Conclusion: BESIII的多样衰变道搜寻构成对亚GeV暗部门模型的互补性检验体系，尤其 η 搜寻为标量媒介暗物质与热遗迹情景提供了有约束力的实验判据。

Abstract: Large samples of charmonia, charm mesons, hyperons and light mesons collected by BESIII offer sensitive tests of dark sector interactions with charm and light quarks. This contribution reviews recent searches for sub-GeV dark matter in $η\toπ^0+\mathrm{invisible}$ and $J/ψ\toφ+\mathrm{invisible}$, massless dark photons in $D^0\toωγ'$ and $D^0\toγγ'$, invisible $K^0_S$ decays, dark baryons in $Ξ^-\toπ^-χ$, and light vector bosons in $χ_{cJ}\to J/ψV$, $V\to e^+e^-$. Particular attention is given to the $η$ search, which constrains scalar-mediated dark matter and tests thermal relic benchmarks.

</details>

Main category: hep-ex

TL;DR: 本文报道了在EuXFEL高能量密度（HED）装置上以暗场（dark-field）方法搜寻光-光散射（light-by-light scattering）的实验细节，用116 eV质心光子能量对撞XFEL光束与300 TW级近红外激光。累积2751次泵浦-探测碰撞后未观测到高于本底的信号，给出95%置信度下截面上限为QED预言的7×10⁴倍，是迄今最严格的低能光-光散射限制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 光-光散射是量子电动力学（QED）的基本预言，但低能区信号极弱、本底强，此前实验限制非常宽松，因此需要一种能显著提升信本比（signal-to-background ratio）的实验方案来检验该过程。

Method: 采用泵浦-探测（pump-probe）型暗场实验：在EuXFEL的HED仪器上将XFEL光束与300 TW级近红外ReLaX激光对撞，质心光子能量ω⋆=116 eV，并结合偏振过滤（polarization filtering）同时记录两个偏振通道。文中详述了实验装置与诊断手段，包括单发时空重叠诊断（spatiotemporal-overlap diagnostics）、偏振分束器（polarizing beam splitter）、残余本底表征，以及端到端模拟（start-to-end simulations）。

Result: 累积2751次泵浦-探测碰撞，未观测到高于本底的过量信号；由此推导出95%置信水平下光-光散射截面上限为QED预言的7×10⁴倍。

Conclusion: 该结果是迄今对低能光-光散射最严格的限制，相较此前的实验极限提升了十个数量级，验证了暗场加偏振过滤方案在强本底环境下搜寻微弱QED信号的可行性。

Abstract: We report on the experimental details of a dark-field search for light-by-light scattering signals performed at the High Energy Density (HED) instrument of the European XFEL (EuXFEL) in a pump-probe type experiment colliding the EuXFEL beam with the 300-TW-class near-infrared Relativistic Laser at XFEL (ReLaX) at a center-of-mass photon energy of $ω_\star = 116\,\mathrm{eV}$. Especially in combination with polarization filtering, the dark-field concept allows the signal-to-background ratio to be significantly enhanced and both polarization channels to be recorded. This work elaborates on the experimental setup and the diagnostics used, from the per-shot spatiotemporal-overlap diagnostics, via the polarizing beam splitter, to the characterization of the residual background. Moreover, it provides details on the start-to-end simulations of the setup used for analysis. Accumulating 2751 pump-probe collisions, no excess above background is observed, and an upper limit on the light-by-light scattering cross section of $7\times10^{4}$ times the QED prediction at a 95% confidence level is derived. This is the most stringent bound on low-energy light-by-light scattering achieved to date, representing an improvement by ten orders of magnitude upon previous experimental limits.

</details>


### [99] [First search for sidereal and annual modulation of $Z$-pole asymmetries with the recovered SLD data set](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40282)
*Wonyong Chung*

Main category: hep-ex

TL;DR: 利用回收的SLD极化数据首次开展Z极点电弱不对称的时间分辨分析，未发现恒星日、太阳日或年调制，并对洛伦兹破坏系数给出10^-2量级灵敏度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检验Z极点电弱不对称是否存在随参考系时间（恒星日、太阳日、年）的调制，以探索标准模型扩展中的洛伦兹与CPT破坏效应，并利用此前未充分挖掘的SLD极化数据。

Method: 基于SLD公开释放的6.6×10^5个极化e+e-→Z事例（385583个强子衰变、跨782个恒星日周期），用发表的选择条件和逐事例带符号Compton极化重建左右不对称A_LR；采用联合无分箱似然拟合约束恒星日一阶谐波振幅，并在以太阳为中心的参考系中约束各向异性张量和最小标准模型扩展系数。

Result: 未观测到任何调制；恒星日一阶谐波振幅限制在0.0086（95% C.L.，统计），对后释放的1998年数据（229833事例）盲测得到振幅0.0018（p=0.90）；各向异性张量界限为ρ1≤0.060、ρ2≤0.18、ρ0≤0.092（95% C.L.）；对k_W双时间指标块与k_φφ给出10^-2量级灵敏度，Born模型界限排除有限系数带而非给出上限。

Conclusion: 首次实现Z极点电弱不对称的恒星日时间分辨分析并确认零结果，同时提出Z极双折射新通道（响应增强约2M_Z/Γ_Z），且首次对强子化与轻子不对称给出10^-4–10^-3水平的仪器漂移约束。

Abstract: We report what is, to our knowledge, the first time-resolved analysis of electroweak asymmetries at the $Z$ pole, using the public release of the recovered SLD collision data: $6.6\times10^5$ polarized $e^+e^-\to Z$ events from the 1996-1998 SLC runs, with 385583 selected hadronic $Z$ decays spanning 782 sidereal cycles. The left-right asymmetry $A_{LR}$, reconstructed with the published SLD selection and per-event signed Compton polarization, shows no sidereal, solar-diurnal, or annual modulation; a simultaneous unbinned likelihood fit bounds the sidereal first-harmonic amplitude at 0.0086 (95% C.L., statistical). The analysis, frozen on the initial partial release, applied unchanged to the 229833 events of the later-released 1998 run confirms the null (amplitude 0.0018, p=0.90). Using the as-built SLC beam azimuth from the release's documentation corpus, we bound the asymmetry's anisotropy tensor in the Sun-centered frame: $ρ_1\le0.060$, $ρ_2\le0.18$, and, for vector backgrounds, $ρ_0\le0.092$ (95% C.L.). A leading-order matching maps these onto minimal Standard-Model-Extension coefficients as $10^{-2}$-level sensitivities to the two-time-index block of the electroweak gauge-sector coefficient $k_W$ (components with no existing laboratory constraint) and to the Higgs-sector coefficient $k_{φφ}$; the insertions split the $Z$ pole by polarization, so for the tensor families assessed the resonance saturates the sidereal amplitude near $10^{-2}$ and the Born-model bounds exclude finite coefficient bands rather than set an upper limit. We also derive a previously unpublished $Z$-pole birefringence channel in the helicity-odd azimuthal modulation of the thrust axis, with response enhanced by about $2M_Z/Γ_Z$; a Born-level pilot is null. First sidereal analyses of hadronization and leptonic asymmetries bound instrumental drifts at the $10^{-4}$-$10^{-3}$ fractional level.

</details>


### [100] [FCC-μe: High Energy, High Luminosity Muon-Electron Collider & Neutrino Factory at CERN](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40451)
*K. Piotrzkowski*

Main category: hep-ex

TL;DR: 该论文提出在FCC-ee（或CEPC）设施上同步实现质心能量1–2 TeV、平均亮度高于10^34 cm^-2 s^-1的μ^+e^-碰撞的方案构想。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主要科学动机包括测量希格斯玻色子自相互作用（Higgs boson self-interaction）等前沿课题，并拓展未来高能储存环与中微子科学的应用潜力。

Method: 论文描述了FCC-μe装置的布局，涵盖从超冷反μ子源（ultra-cold anti-muon source）、μ子增强器（muon booster）到主μ子环（main muon ring）的链路，并讨论机器-探测器接口（machine-detector interface）及FCC-μe与相关中微子工厂（neutrino factory）的性能。

Result: 摘要未给出具体测量或性能数值结果，仅提出可在e^+e^-碰撞同时运行的μ^+e^-碰撞方案及其亮度与能量指标目标。

Conclusion: 结论以展望形式指出反μ子束（anti-muon beams）对未来高能储存环以及中微子科学具有相关性。

Abstract: The concept is presented of making at the FCC-$ee$ (or CEPC) facility $μ^+e^-$ collisions at the centre-of-mass energy between 1 and 2 TeV and the average luminosity above $10^{34}$cm$^{-2}$s$^{-1}$, concurrently to the $e^+e^-$ collisions. First, a concise scientific motivation is given, including the exciting prospect of measurements of the Higgs boson self-interaction, and is followed by a presentation of the FCC-$μe$ layout -- from the source of ultra-cold anti-muons, through the muon booster, to the main muon ring. Basic considerations are also given regarding the machine-detector interface and the performance of the FCC-$μe$ and associated neutrino factory. The paper concludes with an outlook underlying relevance of such anti-muon beams for any future high energy storage ring as well as for neutrino science.

</details>

### [101] [Geometry-controlled active transport in smectic textures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37812)
*Yhony M. Arce,William G. C. Oropesa,Alef R. Siqueira,Hartmut Löwen,André P. Vieira,Danilo B. Liarte*

Main category: cond-mat.soft

TL;DR: 该文构建活性布朗粒子在近晶相液晶层法向场中的最小模型，揭示结构化各向异性介质中输运由内禀持久性与缺陷散射间平均自由时间的竞争所主导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 活性粒子在各向异性结构化介质（如近晶相液晶）中的输运与各向同性环境存在定性差异，需要给出描述该现象的最小模型与物理机制。

Method: 提出推进轴与近晶相层法向场耦合的活性布朗粒子（active Brownian particle）最小模型，并结合数值模拟与近似解析计算，考察二维近晶相中三种微结构：均匀平面织构、孤立环形焦锥畴及周期性环形焦锥畴阵列。

Result: 平面与孤立焦锥几何下刻画了从短时超扩散（superdiffusion）到长时正常扩散（normal diffusion）的转变；周期阵列中输运受两种持久性机制控制，其相对重要性依赖佩克莱数（Péclet number）与取向-层法向耦合强度ε：小ε时由活性布朗动力学的内禀持久时间主导，大ε时缺陷反复散射产生的涌现持久时间主导输运。

Conclusion: 活性运动的内禀持久性与遭遇近晶相缺陷的平均自由时间之间的竞争，为结构化各向异性介质中非平凡扩散行为的出现提供了简单物理机制。

Abstract: Self-propelled particles moving through structured anisotropic media such as smectic liquid crystals exhibit transport properties that differ qualitatively from those in isotropic environments. Here we introduce a minimal model of an active Brownian particle whose propulsion axis is coupled to the layer-normal field of a smectic liquid crystal. Using numerical simulations complemented by approximate analytical calculations, we investigate the dynamics of an active particle in three representative two-dimensional smectic microstructures: a uniform planar texture, an isolated toroidal focal conic domain, and a periodic array of toroidal focal conic domains. For the planar and isolated focal-conic geometries, we characterize the crossover from short-time superdiffusion to long-time normal diffusion. In periodic focal-conic arrays, however, transport is controlled by two distinct persistence mechanisms whose relative importance depends on the Péclet number ($\mathrm{Pe}$) and the coupling strength $\varepsilon$ between the particle orientation and the smectic layer-normal field. At small $\varepsilon$, long-time diffusion is governed by the intrinsic persistence time of the active Brownian dynamics. At large $\varepsilon$, repeated scattering by smectic defects generates an emergent persistence time that dominates the transport. These results demonstrate that the competition between the intrinsic persistence of active motion and the mean free time between encounters with smectic defects provides a simple physical mechanism for the emergence of nontrivial diffusive behavior in structured anisotropic media.

</details>


### [102] [Structural Determination vs Stochastic Events: Relaxation Dynamics in a Supercooled Liquid](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38375)
*Shivam Mahajan,Peter Harrowell,Massimo Pica Ciamarra*

Main category: cond-mat.soft

TL;DR: 该研究通过等构型系综（isoconfigurational ensembles）内与系综间的动力学涨落分析，揭示过冷液体（supercooled liquids）结构弛豫（structural relaxation）由构型依赖的约束与随机动力学事件共同支配，初始结构决定弛豫发生的时间与位置但不唯一决定其微观实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 过冷液体的结构弛豫受初始构型影响，但其微观演化存在显著变异性；因此需要厘清结构约束（structural constraints）与动力学随机性（dynamical stochasticity）之间的相互作用。

Method: 考察等构型系综（isoconfigurational ensembles）之间及内部的弛豫动力学涨落（fluctuations of relaxation dynamics），在集体层面采用包含一系列有效弛豫事件的随机模型（stochastic model）描述弛豫时间分布，并在微观层面分析动力学涨落的空间关联（spatial correlations）及其特征长度。

Result: 同一构型出发的轨迹间涨落占总体动力学涨落的可观比例且跨越较宽温度范围；弛豫时间分布可由随机模型良好描述，其有效弛豫事件数随降温而减少；微观涨落的空间关联随降温增强，其特征长度与随机首次通过模型（first-passage model）推断的长度尺度高度吻合。

Conclusion: 结构弛豫由构型依赖的约束与随机动力学事件共同支配：初始结构影响弛豫何时、何处发生，但并不唯一确定其微观实现，从而将动力学涨落的空间组织与集体弛豫的时间统计联系起来。

Abstract: Structural relaxation in supercooled liquids is influenced by the initial configuration, yet its microscopic evolution exhibits substantial variability. Here, we investigate the interplay between structural constraints and dynamical stochasticity by examining fluctuations of relaxation dynamics across and within isoconfigurational ensembles. We show that fluctuations among trajectories originating from the same configuration constitute a substantial fraction of the total dynamical fluctuations over a broad range of temperatures. At the collective level, the distribution of relaxation times is well described by a stochastic model involving a sequence of effective relaxation events, whose number decreases upon cooling. At the microscopic level, dynamical fluctuations exhibit spatial correlations that grow upon cooling, revealing a spatial organization of relaxation even when the initial configuration is fixed. Remarkably, the characteristic length associated with these fluctuations closely follows the length scale inferred from the stochastic first-passage model, establishing a connection between the spatial organization of dynamical fluctuations and the temporal statistics of collective relaxation. Together, these results suggest that structural relaxation is governed by an interplay between configuration-dependent constraints and stochastic dynamical events: the initial structure influences when and where relaxation occurs, without uniquely determining its microscopic realization.

</details>


### [103] [Extraordinary stiffening and reciprocal control in a DNA condensate/actin composite](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38504)
*Sam Wilken,Austin Hopkins,Kyu Hwan Choi,John Berezney,Matthew E. Helgeson,M. Cristina Marchetti,Sho Takatori,Zvonimir Dogic,Omar A. Saleh*

Main category: cond-mat.soft

TL;DR: 在纠缠态肌动蛋白（actin）网络中引入体积分数低于10%的相分离DNA液滴（DNA droplets），可使复合体系刚度提升约25倍且可逆，远超经典理论预测的上限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软复合材料（soft composites）的刚度通常由填料体积分数决定，经典理论预测填料占10%体积时增刚不超过约25%，因此寻找在低填料分数下实现显著增刚的机制是核心动机。

Method: 构建由相分离DNA液滴与纠缠肌动蛋白网络组成的复合体系，并用显微术（microscopy）观察液滴与网络的相互作用及液滴尺寸的决定因素。

Result: 占据不足10%体积的DNA液滴使网络刚度可逆地提升25倍；显微观察显示肌动蛋白可穿透液滴，网络弹性因而决定液滴尺寸，体系呈现基质与液滴性质的双向（reciprocal）调控。

Conclusion: 异常增刚归因于液滴对肌动蛋白的夹带（entrainment），使有效夹杂物（effective inclusions）增大直至其接触网络主导力学行为；表明液-液相分离（liquid-liquid phase separation）不仅能控制局部组成，也能调控力学性质。

Abstract: Soft composites, materials consisting of inclusions within a polymeric matrix, offer a broad design space with diverse mechanical properties. Composite stiffness is normally set by the volume fraction of filler, and classical theory predicts at most ~25% stiffening when inclusions occupy 10% of the volume. Here we introduce a composite of phase-separated DNA droplets that occupy <10% of an entangled actin network, yet stiffen it 25-fold, reversibly. Microscopy reveals that actin penetrates the DNA droplets, leading network elasticity to determine their size; thus the system exhibits reciprocal control between matrix and droplet properties. We attribute the extraordinary stiffening to entrainment of actin by the droplets, which enlarges the effective inclusions until their contact network dominates the mechanics. This shows that liquid-liquid phase separation can control not only local compositions, but also mechanics, achieving exceptional stiffening at modest filler fractions through local geometries that constrain the matrix beyond the inclusions themselves.

</details>


### [104] [The effects of hydrodynamic interactions on the swimming velocity and stability of a swarm of microswimmers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38689)
*Andrés Córdoba,Jay D. Schieber*

Main category: cond-mat.soft

TL;DR: 该文采用热力学自洽的微游动体模型（thermodynamically compliant microswimmer model），以平均场（mean-field）框架研究微游动体集群（swarm）的动力学与稳定性。研究发现集群中游动体速度可提升至孤立的约十二倍，且推式型（pusher）与拉式型（puller）集群在流体力学力矩（hydrodynamic torques）作用下呈现相反的稳定性特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有数值模拟显示流体力学力矩对拉式型集群有稳定作用、对推式型集群则通常使其失稳，但缺乏可解析、且物理上自洽的理论框架来同时刻画集群动力学与稳定性。作者希望突破人为设定的稳态约束，纳入燃料消耗与高阶流体力学相互作用，以系统考察燃料浓度和体积分数（volume fraction）对稳定性的影响。

Method: 构建平均场模型，将集群视为沿平均同一方向运动的游动体均匀解，并假定晶格排列（crystalline arrangement）以准确建模游动体间的流体力学相互作用。模型采用热力学容许的运动—燃料消耗耦合关系，并计入燃料消耗与高阶流体力学相互作用，通过计算集群产生的流体力学力矩随体积分数的变化来评估稳定性。

Result: 当体积分数约为 0.14 时，集群内游动体的游动速度可达孤立状态下的十二倍。流体力学力矩对拉式型集群起稳定作用，而推式型集群一般因流体力学相互作用而失稳，该预测与近期多粒子模拟（multiparticle simulations）结果一致。在高燃料浓度下，即使体积分数低至 0.02，拉式型集群仍可被流体力学力矩稳定；但体积分数更低时，布朗力（Brownian forces）会使集群失稳。

Conclusion: 热力学自洽的耦合使模型能够研究完整动力学而非仅人为约束的稳态，从而揭示稳定性同时依赖于燃料浓度与体积分数。结论表明拉式型与推式型集群的稳定性机制存在本质差异，且低体积分数下布朗涨落构成失稳的主导因素。

Abstract: The dynamics and stability of a swarm of microswimmers is examined here using a thermodynamically compliant microswimmer model. The theory presented here is a mean-field model in which the swarm is considered to be a uniform solution of swimmers that are moving, on average, in the same direction. The hydrodynamic interaction between swimmers is modeled accurately assuming a crystalline arrangement to the swarm. A swimmer in the swarm can swim up to twelve times faster than when alone in an infinite sea, when the volume fraction of swimmers in the swarm is about 0.14. Moreover we have also studied the stability of the swarm around a uniform crystalline arrangement by calculating the hydrodynamic torques generated by the swarm as a function of the volume fraction of swimmers. The predictions presented here agree with recent multiparticle simulations that have shown that hydrodynamic torques have a stabilizing effect in swarms of pullers while swarms of pushers are generally destabilized by hydrodynamic interactions. The thermodynamically admissible coupling between the swimmer's motion and fuel consumption allows us to study the full dynamics instead of artificially constrained steady-states only. By accounting for fuel consumption and high order hydrodynamic interactions we are able to examine the swarm's stability as function of fuel concentration and the volume fraction of swimmers. We find that at high concentrations of fuel, swarms of pullers are stabilized by hydrodynamic torques for volume fractions of swimmers as low as 0.02 but at lower volume fractions Brownian forces make the swarm unstable.

</details>


### [105] [Nonreciprocity Propels Nematic Defects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39037)
*Yunpeng Cao,Yu Du,Yao Li*

Main category: cond-mat.soft

TL;DR: 本文提出一个含非互易力矩（nonreciprocal torque）的二维向列相模型与连续场论，揭示非互易性可使+1/2拓扑缺陷沿其极轴自主运动，并改变+1缺陷的分裂路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非互易相互作用（nonreciprocal interactions）是普遍的非平衡动力学来源，但其对向列相拓扑缺陷（nematic topological defects）的影响此前尚未被研究。

Method: 在二维六角晶格上构建非互易向列相模型，并建立包含向列相非互易力矩的连续介质理论（continuum theory）；在确定性极限下结合数值模拟与对称性分析（symmetry analysis）进行研究。

Result: 对称性分析与模拟显示该力矩驱动+1/2缺陷沿其极轴（polar axes）自推进；非互易性同时改变了整数+1缺陷的分裂（splitting）路径。

Conclusion: 研究给出了一条由对称性刻画的路径，将非互易性与向列相缺陷输运及拓扑重组（topological reorganization）联系起来，该机制区别于主动应力（active stress）驱动的运动。

Abstract: Nonreciprocal interactions are a generic source of nonequilibrium dynamics, yet their consequences for nematic topological defects remain unexplored. We introduce a nonreciprocal nematic model on a two-dimensional hexagonal lattice and formulate a continuum theory containing a nematic nonreciprocal torque. In the deterministic limit, simulations and symmetry analysis show that this torque drives +1/2 defects to self-propel along their polar axes. Nonreciprocity modifies the splitting pathway of integer +1 defects. These results identify a symmetry-resolved route from nonreciprocity to nematic defect transport and topological reorganization, distinct from active-stress-driven motion.

</details>


### [106] [Response of Hydrogels and Microgels to Nanoparticle Crowding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39039)
*Mahesh Aryal,Alan R. Denton*

Main category: cond-mat.soft

TL;DR: 该工作将Flory-Rehner溶胀理论扩展至含纳米颗粒拥挤剂（crowders）的体系，结合自由能景观数值求解与Monte Carlo模拟，揭示纳米颗粒拥挤促使凝胶去溶胀（deswelling）、削弱颗粒间关联，并在高浓度下存在依赖拥挤剂尺寸与交联密度的最大负载容量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交联聚合物网络的内部自由度使可压缩水凝胶（hydrogels）与微凝胶（microgels）能随环境变化吸收或排出溶剂而溶胀/去溶胀；溶液中的大分子作为拥挤剂（crowding agents）会影响该响应，这对药物递送与生物传感具有实际意义，但现有理论缺乏对纳米颗粒拥挤效应的定量描述。

Method: 将Flory-Rehner聚合物网络溶胀理论扩展，把纳米颗粒拥挤剂作为另一隐式组分（implicit species）纳入体积排阻（volume exclusion）效应，并借助聚合物场论（polymer field theory）计入拥挤剂穿透的熵代价；在非对称三元混合物（asymmetric ternary mixtures）的自由能景观中数值求解凝胶内外溶剂与拥挤剂化学势（chemical potentials）平衡关系；同时独立开展Monte Carlo模拟，引入允许凝胶溶胀与摄取拥挤剂的试探移动（trial moves）。

Result: 研究考察了拥挤剂尺寸、溶液浓度、交联密度（cross-link density）与溶剂质量（solvent quality）对凝胶溶胀、拥挤剂在凝胶内外的分配（partitioning）以及由Hertzian弹性对相互作用（Hertzian elastic pair interactions）主导的微凝胶悬浮液结构性质的影响。结果表明纳米颗粒拥挤促进去溶胀，从而削弱颗粒间关联（interparticle correlations）；随拥挤剂浓度增加，聚合物凝胶达到最大负载容量（maximum loading capacity），该容量取决于拥挤剂尺寸与聚合物交联密度。

Conclusion: 纳米颗粒拥挤是调控可压缩凝胶溶胀行为与微凝胶悬浮液结构的重要隐式因素；扩展后的Flory-Rehner框架与Monte Carlo模拟相互印证，可预测拥挤条件下的去溶胀趋势与负载容量上限。

Abstract: Internal degrees of freedom of cross-linked polymer networks enable compressible hydrogels and microgels to swell or deswell by absorbing or expelling solvent in response to environmental changes. Macromolecules in solution can influence the swelling response by acting as crowding agents, with practical relevance for drug delivery and biosensing. We extend the Flory-Rehner theory of polymer network swelling to incorporate nanoparticle crowders as another implicit species that can perturb a gel through volume exclusion, including the entropic cost of crowder penetration from polymer field theory. Within the free energy landscape of asymmetric ternary mixtures, we numerically solve equilibrium relations equating solvent and crowder chemical potentials inside and outside the gel. Independently, we perform Monte Carlo simulations, including trial moves that allow gels to swell and take up crowders. We investigate how crowder size, solution concentration, cross-link density, and solvent quality influence swelling of polymeric gels, partitioning of crowders between inside and outside, and structural properties of microgel suspensions governed by Hertzian elastic pair interactions. Our results show that nanoparticle crowding promotes deswelling, thereby weakening interparticle correlations, and that, with increasing the concentration of crowders, polymeric gels reach a maximum loading capacity, dependent on crowder size and polymer cross-link density.

</details>


### [107] [The End of Chaos at the Ideal Glass Transition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39098)
*Zi-Long Wang,Jack F. Douglas,Matteo Baggioli,Zhao-Yan Sun,Wen-Sheng Xu*

Main category: cond-mat.soft

TL;DR: 该研究指出，最大李雅普诺夫指数（maximum Lyapunov exponent，λ_max）趋于零可作为理想玻璃转变（ideal glass transition）的动力学标志，将构型熵（configurational entropy，S_c）判据与微观混沌动力学、能垒曲面几何统一起来。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理想玻璃转变常与构型熵 S_c 外推至零相联系，但这一热力学判据如何在微观动力学中体现尚不明确，论文旨在寻找对应的动力学特征。

Method: 采用分子动力学模拟（molecular dynamics simulations），在二维与三维多种模型玻璃形成液体中测量最大李雅普诺夫指数 λ_max，并考察其随温度的变化及与构型熵、局域势能面曲率涨落方差 σ_K^2 的关系。

Result: λ_max 近似满足标度关系 λ_max ∝ (T−T_λ)^(1/2)，外推至零的温度 T_λ 与考兹曼温度（Kauzmann temperature，T_K）一致；并得到定量关系 λ_max^2 ∝ T·S_c 以及 λ_max^2 ∝ σ_K^2。

Conclusion: 结果为玻璃形成提供了热力学、动力学与几何相统一的框架，并将理想玻璃转变界定为体系在能垒曲面上混沌探索的终点。

Abstract: The ideal glass transition has often been associated with the extrapolated vanishing of configurational entropy $S_c$, yet how this thermodynamic criterion is reflected in microscopic dynamics remains unclear. Here, we show that the vanishing of deterministic chaos quantified by the maximum Lyapunov exponent $λ_{\mathrm{max}}$ provides such a dynamical signature. Using molecular dynamics simulations across diverse model glass-forming liquids in two and three dimensions, we show that $λ_{\mathrm{max}}$ follows an approximate scaling $λ_{\mathrm{max}} \propto (T-T_λ)^{1/2}$ and extrapolates to zero at a temperature $T_λ$ consistent with the Kauzmann temperature $T_{\mathrm{K}}$. Furthermore, we establish the quantitative relation $λ_{\mathrm{max}}^2 \propto T S_c$, directly linking chaotic dynamics to configurational entropy. By demonstrating that $λ_{\mathrm{max}}^2 \propto σ_K^2$, where $σ_K^2$ is the variance of local potential energy landscape curvature fluctuations, we connect the suppression of chaos directly to landscape geometry. These results provide a unified thermodynamic, dynamical, and geometric framework for glass formation, identifying the ideal glass transition as the endpoint of chaotic exploration of the energy landscape.

</details>


### [108] [Aging and protocol dependence of thermal activation events in structural glasses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39405)
*Yuki Takaha,Atsushi Ikeda*

Main category: cond-mat.soft

TL;DR: 该研究通过分子模拟与势能景观分析，揭示结构玻璃中热激活事件随等待时间由雪崩型向局域型转变，且该激活性质并非仅由能量水平决定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旨在探究结构玻璃（structural glasses）中热激活事件（thermally activated events）对等待时间（waiting time）与制备协议（protocol）的依赖性，厘清稳定性与激活性质之间的关系。

Method: 采用分子模拟（molecular simulations）与势能景观分析（potential energy landscape analysis），并结合等构型系综分析（isoconfigurational ensemble analysis）；同时比较分别由等待时间和母温度（parent temperature）调控稳定性的两类玻璃。

Result: 发现激活事件性质存在从雪崩型事件（avalanche-like events）到局域事件（local events）的定性转变（crossover），事件多样性降低且更具可逆性；在相同固有结构能量（inherent structure energy）水平下，母温度控制的玻璃更不稳定并保持雪崩型特征。

Conclusion: 结构玻璃的激活性质不能仅由其能量水平决定，状态连通性（state connectivity）与复杂能量景观中的动力学采样（dynamical sampling）起关键作用。

Abstract: In this study, we investigate the waiting time dependence and the protocol dependence of thermally activated events in structural glasses using molecular simulations and potential energy landscape analysis. We find a qualitative crossover in the nature of activation events; from avalanche-like events to local events. We also use the isoconfigurational ensemble analysis and reveal that the events become less diverse and more reversible. We discuss these crossovers from the perspective of the stability and the potential energy landscape of glasses. To investigate the protocol dependence, we compare the two types of glasses whose stability is controlled by waiting time and parent temperature, respectively. Surprisingly, at the same inherent structure energy level, the parent-temperature-controlled glasses are more unstable and maintain their avalanche-like nature. These results demonstrate that the activation properties of structural glasses are not determined solely by their energy levels, highlighting the essential role of state connectivity and the dynamical sampling in the complex energy landscape.

</details>


### [109] [Resisting Drying Stress in Laponite Bentonite Clay Composites, Two Step Yielding and Crack Peel Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39465)
*Tapati Dutta,Agnishikha Chakrabarti,Soham Mitra,Deepshikha Das,Indranil Chakraborty*

Main category: cond-mat.soft

TL;DR: 将纳米尺度 Laponite 与微米尺度 Bentonite 黏土混合，可显著降低干燥膜在疏水与亲水基底上的开裂与剥落损伤，且中间配比在玻璃上的损伤低于两者简单平均；流变学两步屈服导出的内聚能随所选步骤变化数个量级，由能量平衡定义的量纲一"内聚-黏附指数（cohesion-adhesion index）"符号与剥落/开裂行为一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 黏土膜在刚性基底上干燥时会出现开裂、剥落或保持完整，这一结果对涂层（coating）、阻隔层（barrier layer）与陶瓷加工（ceramic processing）均有影响。已有研究多集中于黏土-聚合物复合材料，而组分在尺寸与电荷上均不同的纯黏土复合体系（clay composites）研究明显不足，故需考察配比能否作为调控干燥损伤的简单手段。

Method: 将纳米尺度 Laponite 与微米尺度 Bentonite 按不同配比混合成膜，在疏水性（hydrophobic）与亲水性（hydrophilic）基底（含聚丙烯与玻璃）上干燥观察开裂/剥落行为；对凝胶态悬浮液进行流变学（rheology）测试，分析两步屈服（two-step yielding）并据其估算内聚能（cohesive energy）；基于能量平衡（energy balance）推导量纲一内聚-黏附指数（cohesion-adhesion index）的符号；并开展重复实验以检验结果稳健性。

Result: Laponite 膜基本保持完整，Bentonite 膜则广泛断裂；在玻璃基底上，多数中间配比的损伤程度低于两种纯组分损伤的简单平均。所有配比的凝胶悬浮液均呈现两步屈服，由不同屈服步骤导出的内聚能相差可达数个量级。内聚-黏附指数的符号与"在聚丙烯上剥落、在玻璃上开裂"的配比行为一致。

Conclusion: 黏土配比可被视为调控黏土膜抗开裂性（crack resistance）的简单控制变量，并为后续寻找"无裂纹临界厚度（critical crack-free thickness）随黏土组成变化关系"提供了起点；同时提示任何流变-开裂关联（rheology-cracking correlation）必须明确所采用的内聚能导出步骤。

Abstract: Clay films that dry on a rigid substrate crack, peel or stay intact, and which of these happens matters for coatings, barrier layers and ceramic processing. Composites of clay with polymers have been studied widely. Clay composites, whose components differ in size and charge, are much less explored. We show that mixing the nano scale clay Laponite with the micron scale clay Bentonite reduces desiccation damage on both a hydrophobic and a hydrophilic substrate, Laponite films stay essentially intact, Bentonite films fracture extensively, and on glass most intermediate compositions are less damaged than a simple average of the two would suggest. Rheology of the gelled suspensions reveals a two step yielding in every composition, and the cohesive energy derived from it depends by orders of magnitude on which step is used, a point that any rheology cracking correlation must specify. A dimensionless cohesion adhesion index, whose sign we derive from an energy balance, is consistent with compositions that peel on polypropylene and crack on glass. Replicate experiments were performed for robustness of results. The results identify composition as a simple handle on the crack resistance of clay films and open the search for the critical crack-free thickness as a function of clay composition.

</details>


### [110] [Hidden Phase Transition in Single-Polymer Stretching under Elongational Flow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39575)
*Aiqing Zhu,Fushuai Wang,Eleonore Vissol-Gaudin,Qianxiao Li,Beatrice W. Soh*

Main category: cond-mat.soft

TL;DR: 该研究利用机器学习从微观轨迹中学习约化随机动力学，在平面拉伸流驱动的聚合物链中，于已知的线圈-拉伸转变（coil-stretch transition）之外识别出第二个动力学转变，并由大偏差分析与单分子DNA实验提供支持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 聚合物链在流动中的拉伸传统上以线圈-拉伸转变（coil-stretch transition）为核心描述，但流动强度继续增大时是否存在其他转变尚不明确，需要一种能从微观轨迹中提取非平衡自由能景观（nonequilibrium free energy landscape）的方法加以揭示。

Method: 发展 Universal and Identifiable Dissipative Dynamics（UIDD）的条件化扩展，使其能跨不同流动强度联合学习约化随机动力学，并给出相应的稳态非平衡自由能景观；同时用简化的解析链模型做大幅差分析（large-deviation analysis），并以单分子DNA实验进行定性检验。

Result: 随流动强度增大，演化景观先呈现预期的线圈-拉伸转变，随后出现此前未被识别的动力学转变：拉伸态持续存在，但在小端距（end-to-end separation）条件下沿折叠坐标（folding coordinate）的分布变为双峰。解析模型复现了两个转变，并表明其在长链极限下为相变（phase transition）。

Conclusion: 平面拉伸流中的聚合物链存在第二个动力学转变，可视为长链极限下的相变；单分子DNA实验通过预测的折叠响应反转提供了定性支持，说明了机器学习方法结合解析模型的揭示能力。

Abstract: Using machine learning, we identify a second transition in polymer chain stretching driven by planar elongational flow, beyond the well-known coil-stretch transition. We achieve this by developing a conditional extension of Universal and Identifiable Dissipative Dynamics (UIDD) that jointly learns reduced stochastic dynamics from microscopic trajectories across flow strengths and yields the corresponding stationary nonequilibrium free energy landscapes. As the flow strength increases, the evolving landscape exhibits the expected coil-stretch transition, and then a previously unrecognized dynamical transition. In the latter, the stretched states persist, but the distribution along a folding coordinate becomes bimodal when conditioned on small end-to-end separation. Large-deviation analysis of a simplified analytical chain model reproduces both transitions and shows that they are phase transitions in the long-chain limit. Single-molecule DNA experiments provide qualitative support for the dynamical transition through the predicted reversal of the folding response.

</details>


### [111] [Temporal Correlations and Optimal Feedback Control of an Active Information Engine](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39632)
*Laura Hoek,Yael Roichman*

Main category: cond-mat.soft

TL;DR: 以自驱动鬃毛机器人（bristle-robots）构成宏观信息引擎（information engine），实验表明反馈控制只需一阶马尔可夫（first-order Markov）统计描述即可接近最优功率，而无需预测完整时间动力学。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探讨反馈控制器（feedback controller）究竟需要多大程度地了解其所利用的涨落（fluctuations），即控制所需的知识粒度问题。

Method: 通过实验测量占据时间序列（occupancy time series），比较独立测量假设、一阶马尔可夫近似与完整时序记忆对空位检测（vacancy detection）及首次通过时间（first-passage time）分布的刻画能力，并评估不同协议下的功率表现与传感成本（sensing cost）影响。

Result: 短测量间隔下平均首次通过时间超出独立测量预测一个数量级以上；一阶马尔可夫近似能捕捉大部分效应但无法重现完整首次通过分布，说明存在高阶时间记忆（higher-order temporal memory）；马尔可夫选择协议功率距实验最大值仅差0.15%，忽略相关性则损失数个百分点功率并倾向更大压缩距离（compression distances）。

Conclusion: 在相关非平衡系统（correlated nonequilibrium systems）中，近最优反馈控制所需的统计描述可显著简化；引入传感成本使最优策略转向稀疏传感（sparse sensing），该转变仅由马尔可夫模型而非独立模型预测，并经受独立时间段的交叉验证（cross-validation）确认。

Abstract: How much does a feedback controller need to know about the fluctuations it exploits? We address this question using a macroscopic information engine driven by self-propelled bristle-robots. Experimentally measured occupancy time series show that temporal correlations strongly affect vacancy detection. At short measurement intervals, mean first-passage times exceed independent-measurement predictions by more than an order of magnitude. A first-order Markov approximation captures much of this effect. It does not reproduce the full first-passage distribution, revealing higher-order temporal memory. Nevertheless, Markov-selected protocols come within 0.15\% of the maximum experimental power. Neglecting correlations causes power losses of several percent and favors larger compression distances. Introducing a sensing cost shifts the optimal strategy toward sparse sensing. The independent model cannot predict this shift, whereas the Markov model captures it. Cross-validation on separate time segments confirms the near-optimal performance of Markov-selected protocols. These findings demonstrate that near-optimal feedback control in correlated nonequilibrium systems can require a simpler statistical description than predicting their full temporal dynamics.

</details>


### [112] [Influence of hydrophobic polyelectrolyte composition on pH-dependent solubilization of lipid bilayer membranes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39736)
*Martijn Koorengevel,Michelle N. M. de Dood,Wouter T. E. Bosker,James L. Martin Robinson,Cornelis A. van Walree,Bas G. P. van Ravensteijn,Willem K. Kegel*

Main category: cond-mat.soft

TL;DR: 疏水性聚电解质（hydrophobic polyelectrolytes, HPE）可将脂双层膜（lipid bilayer membranes）溶解为直径约10 nm的圆盘结构，其溶解行为受链长、离子基团与疏水基团的空间排布及pH调控，并在组成依赖性上可用线性叠加定量描述。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究旨在厘清不同链长与分子组成的阴离子型疏水聚电解质如何溶解脂双层膜，并检验其行为能否由配体介导的协同转变（ligand-mediated cooperative transitions）模型解释，为抗癌医学与药物递送提供依据。

Method: 比较链长为20–100个单体、分子组成各异的阴离子HPE的溶解行为，考察离子基团与疏水基团的空间排布、组成分布（固定组成与二项分布）、pH变化路径，并将某一HPE的溶解行为与宏观油水相分配（partitioning）关联。

Result: 发现：(1) 仅20个单体的短链HPE即可溶解脂双层膜；(2) 离子与疏水基团的空间分子排布决定溶解是否发生；(3) 阴离子HPE可呈现两个pH依赖的溶解转变，分别出现在升pH的低pH区间与降pH的高pH区间；(4) 疏水与可电离基团的二项组成分布相较固定组成，并未明显拓宽低pH转变的溶解pH范围；(5) 疏水基团组成的线性叠加可定量解释溶解pH的组成依赖性，但在低于临界疏水残基分数时失效。

Conclusion: HPE的膜溶解行为受链长、基团空间排布与组成共同调控，其组成依赖性可由线性叠加在限定范围内定量刻画，并与配体介导的协同转变模型相符；结果对抗癌医学与药物递送具潜在应用价值。

Abstract: Lipid bilayer membranes can be solubilized in the form of disks of approximately 10 nm in diameter by several types of hydrophobic polyelectrolytes (HPE). The disks are stabilized by wrapped HPE along the rims of the disks. We compare the solubilization behavior of anionic HPE with chain lengths in between 20 - 100 monomers, and with varying molecular composition. We find that (1) HPE as short as 20 monomers can readily solubilize lipid bilayer membranes; (2) spatial intermolecular arrangement of ionic and hydrophobic groups in HPE determine if solubilization occurs; (3) anionic HPEs may exhibit two distinct pH-dependent solubilization transitions: the first is encountered in the lower-pH regime upon increasing the pH, whereas the second emerges at higher pH when the pH is decreased; (4) a binomial composition distribution of hydrophobic and ionizable groups over the chains, compared to a fixed composition, does not lead to a measurably wider pH range where solubilization occurs for the transition at low pH. We link the solubilization behavior of one of the HPE's to pH-dependent partitioning between macroscopic oil and water phases. Finally, (5) we find that linear composition superposition of the hydrophobic groups in HPE quantitatively accounts for the composition dependence of the pH's where solubilization occurs. This result holds within a range of compositions and breaks down below a critical fraction of hydrophobic residues in a HPE chain. Throughout, we compare the observations to a recently developed model for ligand-mediated cooperative transitions. Our findings have potential impact on anti-cancer medicine and drug delivery applications.

</details>


### [113] [High-throughput quantification of interfacial protein load in monodisperse oil-in-water emulsions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40506)
*Varun Potdar,Alexander Favela,Michael Boehm,Stefan Baier,Siva Vanapalli*

Main category: cond-mat.soft

TL;DR: 结合微流控单分散乳液与比色蛋白定量，本研究定量测定了食品蛋白在油水界面的初始与饱和吸附载量（Γ₀、Γ∞），并揭示其随体相浓度呈亚线性标度、超出单层预测及受蛋白种类、pH 和离子强度调控。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 食品蛋白作为乳化剂（emulsifier）在油水界面的吸附行为决定乳液形成与稳定性，但传统乳化方法的粒径多分散性（polydispersity）使界面蛋白载量（interfacial protein load）难以定量表征。

Method: 将微流控生成单分散乳液（microfluidic monodisperse emulsion）与比色法蛋白定量（colorimetric protein quantification）相结合，测量收集后的初始界面载量 Γ₀，并追踪 48 h 以获得饱和载量 Γ∞；同时对三种蛋白、七个浓度、三种 pH 与两种离子强度进行高通量映射，仅需毫克级蛋白样品。

Result: 界面载量随体相浓度呈显著依赖并可由准一级模型（pseudo-first-order model）良好描述；Γ₀ 与 Γ∞ 均呈亚线性标度（sublinear scaling，Γ₀ ~ C^0.21，Γ∞ ~ C^0.12）。载量基本与液滴直径无关，仅在低浓度下最小液滴的初始载量略有降低。实测载量高于理想单层（monolayer）预测，介于双层与三层界限之间。α-酪蛋白（α-Casein）界面载量高于 β-酪蛋白与乳清蛋白分离物（Whey Protein Isolate），最大吸附出现在等电点（isoelectric point）附近及较高离子强度条件下。

Conclusion: 本研究建立了连接蛋白性质、配方条件与界面行为的定量实验框架，可基于单分散微流控乳液在毫克级样品用量下开展蛋白界面表征。

Abstract: Food proteins play a critical role as emulsifiers, where adsorption at the oil and water interface governs emulsion formation and stability. However, quantitative characterization of interfacial protein load remains challenging due to polydispersity in conventional emulsification methods. We combine microfluidic generation of monodisperse emulsions with colorimetric protein quantification to measure the post-collection initial interfacial load ($Γ_0$) and subsequently monitored over 48 h to obtain the saturation load ($Γ_\infty$). Interfacial load exhibited a strong bulk concentration-dependent trend and was well described by a pseudo-first-order model. Both $Γ_0$ and $Γ_\infty$ followed sublinear scaling with concentration ($Γ_0$ ~ C^{0.21}$, $Γ_\infty$ ~ C^{0.12}$). Interfacial loads were largely independent of droplet diameter, with modest reductions in initial loading for the smallest droplets at low protein concentration. Measured loads exceeded idealized monolayer predictions and fell between bilayer and trilayer bounds, consistent with accumulation beyond a simplified monolayer model. Additionally, high-throughput mapping was performed across three proteins, seven concentrations, three pH values, and two ionic strengths, revealing that $α$-Casein exhibited higher interfacial loads than $β$-Casein and Whey protein Isolate, with maximum adsorption near the isoelectric point and at elevated ionic strength. In summary, this study establishes a quantitative experimental framework for linking protein properties, formulation conditions, and interfacial behavior using monodisperse microfluidic emulsions, while requiring only milligram-scale protein quantities.

</details>

### [114] [Exploring Fractional Quantum Hall States with Deep Learning: From Abelian to Non-Abelian Phases](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38533)
*Xiangyu Ma,Kehuang Chen,Yuntian Gu,Weiluo Ren,Ji Chen,Di Luo,Fengcheng Wu,Xiang Li*

Main category: physics.comp-ph

TL;DR: 该工作提出一种对称适应神经网络波函数（symmetry-adapted neural-network wavefunction），可在纳入全部朗道能级（Landau levels）的情况下同时描述阿贝尔与非阿贝尔分数量子霍尔态，并在 ν=4/3、7/5 与 3/2 处给出与分数量子霍尔拓扑序相符的数值证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分数量子霍尔系统（fractional quantum Hall systems）具有拓扑量子计算潜力，但其微观基态难以确定：竞争相往往近简并（nearly degenerate），且朗道能级混合（Landau-level mixing）难以处理。

Method: 构建对称适应的神经网络波函数，同时描述阿贝尔（Abelian）与非阿贝尔（non-Abelian）态，并纳入所有朗道能级；通过有限尺寸交叠（finite-size overlaps）与纠缠谱（entanglement spectra）对候选态进行判定。

Result: 方法准确刻画了复合费米子液体（composite-fermion liquids）以及低填充下维格纳晶化（Wigner crystallization）的出现；第一朗道能级部分填充时，ν=4/3 与 7/5 的证据与 \(\bar{2}^{k}1^{k+1}\) 型部分子相（parton phases）一致，ν=3/2 则呈现类反-Pfaffian（anti-Pfaffian-like）纠缠结构。

Conclusion: 神经网络波函数为研究分数量子霍尔系统中相互竞争的拓扑序（competing topological orders）提供了灵活框架。

Abstract: Fractional quantum Hall systems host strongly correlated topological phases with potential applications in topological quantum computation, yet identifying their microscopic ground states remains challenging because competing phases are often nearly degenerate and Landau-level mixing is difficult to treat. Here, we introduce a symmetry-adapted neural-network wavefunction that describes Abelian and non-Abelian states while incorporating all Landau levels. The method accurately captures composite-fermion liquids and the emergence of Wigner crystallization at low filling. When the first Landau level is partially filled, finite-size overlaps and entanglement spectra provide evidence consistent with $\bar{2}^{k}1^{k+1}$-type parton phases at $ν=4/3$ and $7/5$, while the $ν=3/2$ state exhibits anti-Pfaffian-like entanglement structure. These results demonstrate that neural-network wavefunctions offer a flexible framework for studying competing topological orders in fractional quantum Hall systems.

</details>


### [115] [ML-COHP: predicting bond descriptors using latent space of a universal interatomic potentials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40445)
*Daniil S. Alekseev,Ilya V. Chepkasov,Alexander G. Kvashnin*

Main category: physics.comp-ph

TL;DR: 该工作以 MACE 基础模型的冻结描述符（frozen descriptors）为输入，训练一个对称对头（symmetric pair head）来逐键预测积分晶体轨道哈密顿布居（ICOHP），从而绕开逐结构 DFT 单点计算与 LOBSTER 投影的高昂成本，误差显著低于已有高斯过程（Gaussian process）模型，单结构推理仅需约一秒。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ICOHP 是 DFT 框架下衡量键强度的标准量，但每个结构都需单独的 DFT 单点计算与 LOBSTER 投影，对含百个原子的晶界或催化纳米颗粒需耗时数天，难以支撑大规模或高通量键合分析。

Method: 从 MACE 基础模型的冻结描述符出发，用对称对头读取两原子的标量通道（scalar channels）与键投影矢量通道（bond-projected vector channels），并以同模型元素嵌入（element embeddings）构成的对基线（pair baseline）为基础进行修正；在高熵二硼化物（Hf,Zr,Ti,Nb,Ta)B2、缺陷石墨烯上的 Pt 团簇及吸附 O2 的 Pt/Pd 纳米颗粒上验证。

Result: 强于 0.5 eV 的键上误差为 1.6–4.1%，约为 Ferreira 等在同一数据上训练的高斯过程模型的一半；仅用高温 HEB2 快照训练，即可在约一秒内复现弛豫晶界胞的 LOBSTER ICOHP（误差 0.06 eV），而 LOBSTER 本身需 5–51 小时。矢量通道使误差相对标量通道减半，且对基线设计使模型仅用两个训练结构仍可使用。

Conclusion: 该方法可在保持 DFT 级键合描述的同时将 ICOHP 评估成本降至秒级，具备跨体系迁移能力；结合微调 MACE 势给出的几何结构，可连续扫描 O2 覆盖度下的键合变化，并揭示 O2 对 Pt 富集壳层金属—金属键合的消耗远大于 Pd 壳层。

Abstract: The integrated crystal orbital Hamilton population (ICOHP) is the standard measure of bond strength in a DFT calculation, but every structure needs its own DFT single point and LOBSTER projection, which takes days for a cell of a hundred atoms, such as a grain boundary or a catalytic nanoparticle. We predict ICOHP from the frozen descriptors of a MACE foundation model. A symmetric pair head reads the scalar and bond-projected vector channels of the two atoms and corrects a pair baseline built from the element embeddings of the same model. We tested the model on the high-entropy diboride (Hf,Zr,Ti,Nb,Ta)B$_2$, Pt clusters on defective graphene and Pt/Pd nanoparticles with adsorbed O$_2$. The error on bonds stronger than 0.5 eV is 1.6-4.1%, about half that of the Gaussian-process model of Ferreira et al. trained on the same data. Trained only on high-temperature HEB$_2$ snapshots, the model reproduces the LOBSTER ICOHP of relaxed grain boundary cells to 0.06 eV in about a second, against 5-51 hours of LOBSTER. The vector channels halve the error compared to the scalar ones, and the baseline keeps the model usable with two training structures. With geometries from a fine-tuned MACE potential, the model gives the bonding of Pt/Pd particles over a continuous O$_2$ coverage, and DFT on these particles shows that O$_2$ costs a Pt-rich shell several times more metal--metal bonding than a Pd shell.

</details>

### [116] [Hybrid CutFEM-IFEM model for embedded and immersed interfaces with triply-cut cells for the 2D Poisson problem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38271)
*Darsh Nathawani,Christopher Kees*

Main category: math.NA

TL;DR: 提出一种混合 CutFEM–IFEM 方法，在单一非贴体网格上求解含浸没流体–流体界面与嵌入流–固界面的二维 Poisson 问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旨在结合非贴体有限元方法（unfitted finite element methods）与浸没界面技术（immersed interface techniques）的优势，高效处理复杂界面几何与强间断。

Method: 采用 Heaviside 与 Dirac delta 函数的复合等价多项式表示（composite equivalent polynomial representation）在三重切割单元上积分；并用提升函数（lift functions）富集 IFEM 基函数，以精确表征解与通量的跳跃。

Result: 数值算例表明线性与二次单元均达到最优收敛（optimal convergence），精度与对两个界面均贴体的网格相当。

Conclusion: 该混合方法在不使用贴体网格的前提下，可有效处理多重界面问题并获得与贴体网格相当的精度。

Abstract: We present a hybrid CutFEM--IFEM method for 2D Poisson problems with an immersed fluid--fluid interface and an embedded fluid--solid interface on a single unfitted mesh. The proposed method leverages the strengths of both unfitted finite element methods and immersed interface techniques to handle complex interface geometries and strong discontinuities efficiently. A composite equivalent polynomial representation of the Heaviside and Dirac delta functions is used to integrate on triply-cut cells. Moreover, the IFEM basis functions are enriched with the lift functions exactly representing solution and flux jumps. Numerical examples show optimal convergence for linear and quadratic elements, with accuracy comparable to that of a mesh fitted to both interfaces.

</details>
