### [117] [Going deep, reaching further: What can Boltzmann machines efficiently represent?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39731)
*Tobias Reinhart,Gemma De les Coves*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出“有效可达范围（efficient reach）”概念，证明更深或具有高阶相互作用的机器学习模型能高效表示更大的函数集合，从而从理论上解释了深度与相互作用阶数的重要性，并为深度玻尔兹曼机（DBM）与受限玻尔兹曼机（RBM）等模型建立了表示能力层级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用逼近定理（universal approximation theorem）虽为模型表示能力提供理论支撑，但存在两个缺陷：不关注高效表示，且对深度等启发式重要性质不敏感。本文旨在说明这两个缺陷是相互关联的。

Method: 证明手段借鉴三类方法：通用自旋模型（universal spin models）的近期刻画、自旋模型的计算复杂度（computational complexity）界，以及应用于浅层模型的通信复杂度（communication complexity）界。

Result: 证明更深或高阶相互作用的模型具有更大的有效可达范围；由此得到深度玻尔兹曼机（DBM）具有最大有效可达范围、受限玻尔兹曼机（RBM）为次最大、k-体（k-body）推广构成二者之间的层级，尽管它们均为通用逼近器。此外还给出最大有效可达范围模型的完整刻画、三类表示任务上深层与浅层模型的分离，以及由相互作用阶数索引的浅层模型有效可达范围的无限层级。

Conclusion: 通用机器学习模型在高效表示能力上可存在显著差异，该工作为关于深度的启发式观察提供了理论基础。

Abstract: While universal approximation theorems theoretically underpin the representation capabilities of machine learning models, they have two shortcomings: They do not focus on efficient representations and they tend to be insensitive to depth and other heuristically important properties. In this work we show that these two shortcomings are intertwined. We prove that machine learning models which are deeper or have higher-order interactions can efficiently represent a larger set of functions, i.e. have larger efficient reach. It follows that deep Boltzmann machines (DBMs) have maximal efficient reach, restricted Boltzmann machines (RBMs) sub-maximal, and k-body generalizations of RBMs form a hierarchy between the two, even though all are universal. More generally, (i) we provide a full characterization of machine learning models with maximal efficient reach; (ii) we derive separations between deep and shallow models for three representation tasks; and (iii) we prove that the efficient reach of shallow models constitutes an infinite hierarchy indexed by the interaction order. The proofs draw on different methodologies, namely on (i) a recent characterization of universal spin models; (ii) computational complexity bounds for spin models; and (iii) communication complexity bounds applied to shallow models. This work shows that universal machine learning models can strongly differ in their efficient representation capabilities, and provides a theoretical foundation for heuristic observations.

</details>


### [118] [Interpretable neural equation learning for high-dimensional materials data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37880)
*Philip Jacobson,Prasad Iyer,Remi Dingreville,Saaketh Desai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 nn-EQL 框架，通过迭代训练、剪枝与重训练可定制神经元级激活函数的神经网络生成候选方程，并用受最小描述长度（MDL）启发的评分排序与诊断，面向稀疏高维材料数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方程学习（equation learning）方法较少能在稀疏高维材料数据集上发现并解释所学方程，缺乏可解释性与诊断手段。

Method: nn-EQL 使用具有用户可定制神经元级激活函数的神经网络，经迭代训练、剪枝和重训练生成候选方程；以受最小描述长度（minimum description length, MDL）启发的评分平衡误差与稀疏性进行排序，并诊断逐项贡献、输入缩放敏感性（input-scaled sensitivities）与不确定性；可通过标准编码器（encoder）模型接入表格与高维数据。

Result: 在标准 AI-Feynman 基准以及多尺度高维材料数据集（非均质材料的有限元模拟、高通量实验薄膜沉积数据）上验证，nn-EQL 能学习方程并对所学项提供洞见。

Conclusion: nn-EQL 可将方程学习与表格及高维数据衔接；未来整合物理可解释表示、多模态与多保真数据及自适应数据采集，有望支持机制假设的构建与检验。

Abstract: Equation learning seeks to discover compact, interpretable equations from data using various machine-learning techniques. However, few workflows discover and interpret learned equations in sparse, high-dimensional materials datasets. We present nn-EQL, an equation-learning framework that generates candidate equations through iterative training, pruning, and retraining of a neural network with customizable, user-specified neuron-level activation functions. Candidate equations are ranked using a minimum description length (MDL)-inspired score, balancing error and sparsity, and diagnosed to assess term-wise contributions, input-scaled sensitivities, and uncertainties. We demonstrate nn-EQL on standard AI-Feynman benchmarks as well as multiscale high-dimensional materials datasets such as finite-element simulations of heterogeneous materials, and high-throughput experimental thin-film deposition data. nn-EQL integrates with tabular data and high-dimensional data via standard encoder models, learning equations and providing insight into learned terms. Looking forward, integrating physically interpretable representations, multimodal and multi-fidelity data, and adaptive data acquisition could enable equation learning to formulate and test mechanistic hypotheses.

</details>


### [119] [A physics-informed uncertainty-aware surrogate for $p$-$n$ junction diodes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39993)
*Suchita Kulkarni*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文构建了一个面向一维 p-n 结二极管、以器件长度、掺杂与偏置为条件的不确定性感知物理信息代理模型（uncertainty-aware physics-informed surrogate），并基于其内部状态定义多项关注量指标，用于评估代理预测在用户指定容差内的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对一维 p-n 结二极管的快速且可靠的器件级预测需求，需要在保持物理一致性（physics-informed）的同时量化代理模型预测的可信度，以判断其解答是否满足用户给定容差。

Method: 以器件长度、掺杂和偏置为输入条件构建不确定性感知物理信息代理模型；利用代理预测的器件内部状态构造关注量测试集，包括端电流（terminal current）、耗尽宽度（depletion width）、峰值场（peak field）与存储电荷（stored charge）；并通过基准分析说明该方法与关注量可推广至非对称结与二维二极管。

Result: 在一维对称结代理模型上，静电势（electrostatic potential）的中位 L1 误差为 0.11%，电子与空穴密度误差分别为 1.5% 与 0.61%；所建立的不确定性分析可判定代理答案是否落在用户指定容差内。

Conclusion: 该工作将物理信息代理建模与不确定性分析结合，实现了一维 p-n 结二极管的多关注量、带可信度判定的代理预测，并显示其形式体系具备向非对称结与二维器件扩展的潜力。

Abstract: We develop an uncertainty-aware physics-informed surrogate for a one-dimensional $p$-$n$ junction diode, conditioned on device length, doping and bias. Using the internal state of the device as predicted by the surrogate we develop a test-suite of quantities of interest including the terminal current, depletion width, peak field and stored charge. The formalism and the quantities are can be extended to asymmetric junction and two-dimensional diodes as shown by means of benchmark analysis. For the one-dimensional symmetric junction surrogate, we obtain 0.11% median $L_1$ error on the electrostatic potential, and 1.5% and 0.61% on the electron and hole densities. Finally, we develop an uncertainty analysis which determines the validity of surrogate answer within the user-specified tolerance.

</details>


### [120] [Does System Size Matter in Uncertainty Quantification for Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40126)
*Chayaphol Lortaraprasert,Nontawat Charoenphakdee,Wenwen Li,Yong-Bin Zhuang,Yuta Tsuboi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究检验了机器学习原子间势（machine-learning interatomic potentials, MLIPs）中“逐原子不确定性经均值或最大值聚合后其结构级分数是否跨体系尺寸可比”这一隐含假设。结果表明两种聚合方式具有不同的尺寸依赖性，尺寸无感知的不确定性判据存在实际局限，需引入尺寸感知的校准（size-aware calibration）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLIPs 常以不确定性估计标记分布外（out-of-distribution, OOD）构型并筛选结构用于主动学习（active learning），而实践中普遍将逐原子不确定性以均值或最大值聚合后与固定阈值比较，隐含假设该结构级分数在不同体系尺寸间可比；该假设此前缺乏系统检验。

Method: 在多组分布内（in-distribution, ID）与 OOD 配对体系上，将两种聚合方式（均值聚合与最大值聚合）刻画为原子数的函数，考察其尺寸依赖性，并通过再训练实验比较不同类型 OOD 结构的改进效果。

Result: 两种聚合呈现不同的尺寸依赖：均值聚合对均质体系保持尺寸无关，但在大晶胞中丧失对缺陷的敏感性；最大值聚合在 ID 体系中随体系尺寸增大而升高，而在含缺陷体系中近似平坦，从而缩小 ID-OOD 差距，其行为与极值统计（extreme-value statistics）一致。大结构中高不确定性原子虽可能指示新颖局域环境，但据此再训练收效甚微，与在刻意置于训练分布之外的 OOD 结构上再训练形成对比。

Conclusion: 结果揭示了尺寸无感知（size-unaware）不确定性判据的实际局限，并为大规模原子模拟中更可靠的 OOD 检测提出尺寸感知校准（size-aware calibration）的需求。

Abstract: Machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) commonly use uncertainty estimates to flag out-of-distribution (OOD) configurations and select structures for active learning. A key question is whether the resulting structure-level uncertainty scores remain comparable across different system sizes. A common practice is to aggregate per-atom uncertainties by their mean or maximum and compare the resulting score against a fixed threshold, implicitly assuming such comparability. We test this assumption across several in-distribution (ID)/OOD pairs by characterizing both aggregations as a function of atom count. The two aggregations exhibit distinct size dependencies. Mean aggregation remains size-independent for homogeneous systems but loses sensitivity to defects in large cells. In contrast, maximum aggregation grows with system size for ID systems while remaining approximately flat for defect-containing systems, narrowing the ID-OOD gap in a manner consistent with extreme-value statistics. Although highly uncertain atoms in large structures may indicate novel local environments, retraining on these structures yields little improvement, in contrast to retraining on OOD structures constructed to lie outside the training distribution. Our results reveal a practical limitation of size-unaware uncertainty criteria and motivate size-aware calibration for more reliable OOD detection in large-scale atomistic simulations.

</details>


### [121] [Framework-Conditional Open Materials Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40443)
*Maya M. Martirossyan,Hillary Pan,Philipp Höllmer,Stefano Martiniani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出 OMatG-FC，一种以结构框架（晶胞形状与粒子位置）为条件、对原子种类与晶胞体积分别建模的无机晶体材料从头生成范式，在避免学习原子堆积的同时取得低于凸包的最优S.U.N.生成率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 材料生成的首要目标是获得稳定、独特、新颖（stable, unique, novel, S.U.N.）的结构，而现有预测方法多将新化学组分映射到已知结构原型上，且各方法在超越已知材料分布时均受特定约束与挑战限制。

Method: OMatG-FC 以结构框架为条件：固定原位分数坐标与单位体积晶格矢量，采用对原子种类的离散流匹配（discrete flow matching）与对晶胞晶格体积缩放随机插值（stochastic interpolants）的组合学习，从而大幅降低问题维度；较原型约束方法更灵活。

Result: 模型可发现源自已知结构框架的未见且稳定的原型；作者还统计了 MP-20 数据集中唯一框架的数量，揭示数据集中框架重复的倾向并提供框架划分版本；在 LeMat-GenBench 基准上使用三种机器学习原子间势评估，其凸包以下的 S.U.N. 率（S.U.N. rate）达到当前最优。

Conclusion: 以结构框架为约束的生成范式可在无需学习原子堆积（atomic packing）的前提下实现高效材料发现，说明框架条件化是连接已知原型与新型稳定结构预测的有效途径。

Abstract: Theoretical predictions of novel materials rely on a variety of techniques, from data-mining-based ion substitution methods to fully de novo generative models. Each approach imposes specific constraints and encounters unique challenges when extrapolating beyond the distribution of known materials to discover new ones. The foremost goal of materials generation is to produce stable, unique, and novel (S.U.N.) structures. Predicted structures that meet these criteria, however, typically result from novel chemical compositions mapped onto known structural prototypes or frameworks. We leverage this heuristic insight to present a new generative paradigm for the de novo prediction of inorganic crystalline materials constrained by their structural framework---i.e., the unit cell shapes and respective particle positions. Our method, termed OMatG-FC (Open Materials Framework-Conditional Generation), learns via a combination of discrete flow matching on the atomic species and stochastic interpolants for the volume scaling of the unit cell lattice, while fixing in-place the fractional coordinates and the unit-volume lattice vectors, dramatically reducing the dimensionality of the problem compared to unconstrained (framework-free) generation. Our method is more flexible than existing prototype-constrained methods, demonstrating capability for discovery of unseen, stable prototypes derived from known structural frameworks. We also investigate the number of unique frameworks in the MP-20 dataset, demonstrating the propensity of duplicate frameworks within the dataset and providing a framework-split version. We benchmark the performance of our model using the LeMat-GenBench suite using three ML interatomic potentials and achieve state-of-the-art S.U.N. rate below the convex hull, eschewing the need to learn atomic packings for materials discovery.

</details>


### [122] [Nonlinear Dynamical Systems as Scalable and Efficient Physical Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40471)
*Tyler King,Magnus Saebo,Jeremie Laydevant,Haoting Zhen,Maxwell G. Anderson,Tatsuhiro Onodera,Peter L. McMahon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究通过仿真表明，将模型压缩（model compression）等现代机器学习训练实践应用于基于非线性动力系统（nonlinear dynamical systems）的物理神经网络（physical neural networks），可在 MNIST 上达到 99.2% 准确率，并借助类 MLP-Mixer 架构在 CIFAR-10 上达到 86.4%（结合预训练与知识蒸馏达 92.2%），同时给出能效与速度数量级提升的粗略估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先进机器学习模型规模快速膨胀带来算力需求上升，推动高能效硬件加速器（hardware accelerators）发展；物理神经网络因潜在的高能效被视为候选方案，但既有研究报告的推理准确率（inference accuracy）明显低于传统数字神经网络（digital neural networks）的先进水平。

Method: 在仿真研究（simulation studies）中，对基于非线性动力系统的多种候选物理神经网络应用现代 ML 训练实践，包括模型压缩（model compression）；并以某一动力系统为核心构建受 MLP-Mixer 启发的参数高效（parameter-efficient）架构。

Result: MNIST 手写数字识别准确率最高达 99.2%；CIFAR-10 图像分类最高达 86.4%（经预训练与知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）达 92.2%），而同一系统在不使用 mixer 架构时为 64%，且 mixer 方法所用可训练参数（trainable parameters）比基线少 5 倍以上。

Conclusion: 以示例物理动力系统进行的推理能效与速度粗略估算（back-of-the-envelope estimates）显示，相较数字电子神经网络可能存在数量级的改进，表明结合现代训练实践的物理神经网络具备缩小准确率差距并保持能效优势的潜力。

Abstract: The rapid growth in the size of state-of-the-art machine-learning (ML) models has led to increasing compute demands, spurring the development of energy-efficient hardware accelerators. Physical systems trained to perform ML inference, known as physical neural networks, have been proposed as accelerators in part because of their potential to be highly energy efficient. However, the ML inference accuracies reported in most investigations of physical neural networks have been substantially below the state of the art for conventional digital neural networks. In this work, we show in simulation studies that by applying modern ML training practices, including model compression, various candidate physical neural networks based on nonlinear dynamical systems can achieve accuracies as high as 99.2% on MNIST handwritten-digit recognition. We also show for one dynamical system that using it as the core building block of a parameter-efficient ML architecture inspired by MLP-Mixers enables accuracies of up to 86.4% on CIFAR-10 image classification (92.2% with pretraining and knowledge distillation), compared with 64% for the same system without the mixer architecture. The mixer approach achieved its accuracy while using $>5\times$ fewer trainable parameters than the baseline. Finally, we present back-of-the-envelope estimates for inference energy efficiency and speed when using an example physical dynamical system, suggesting that orders of magnitude improvements may be possible over digital-electronic neural networks.

</details>


<div id='math.FA'></div>

# math.FA [[Back]](#toc)

### [123] [Sharp Tilting Inequalities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39598)
*Hao-Chung Cheng,Po-Chieh Liu*

Main category: math.FA

TL;DR: 本文对半正定矩阵建立了含方向对数导数（directional derivative of the logarithm）的最优迹不等式，系数 $s^s(1-s)^{1-s}$ 为最佳，并推广至可分希尔伯特空间上的迹类算子。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对 $1/2\le\alpha\le1$ 情形下涉及对数方向导数与分数幂（fractional power）的迹不等式，给出具有最优常数（optimal coefficient）的精细估计，并拓展其算子适用范围。

Method: 证明采用对数的方向导数的超算子表示（superoperator representation），并结合分数幂导数的 Araki 型估计（Araki-type estimate）。

Result: 得到 $\operatorname{Tr}[A\,D\log(A^\alpha+B^\alpha)(B^\alpha)] \le s^s(1-s)^{1-s}\operatorname{Tr}[A^\alpha B^{1-\alpha}]$，其中 $s=(1-\alpha)/\alpha$，且常数最优；该不等式及其对称商（symmetric-quotient）对应形式均可延伸。

Conclusion: 所得不等式与对称商版本对正迹类（trace-class）$A$ 及可分希尔伯特空间（separable Hilbert space）上正的可能无界自伴（self-adjoint）$B$ 同样成立。

Abstract: For positive semidefinite matrices $A,B$ and $1/2\leα\le1$, we establish $\operatorname{Tr}\!\left[A\,D\log(A^α+B^α)(B^α)\right] \le s^s(1-s)^{1-s}\operatorname{Tr}[A^αB^{1-α}]$, where $s=(1-α)/α$, with the optimal coefficient. The proof uses a superoperator representation of the directional derivative of the logarithm and an Araki-type estimate for the derivative of a fractional power. Both this inequality and its symmetric-quotient counterpart extend to positive trace-class $A$ and positive, possibly unbounded, self-adjoint $B$ on a separable Hilbert space.

</details>

### [124] [Hot and dense QCD equation of state from the complex Langevin equation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38466)
*Michael Mandl,Dénes Sexty,Daniel Unterhuber*

Main category: hep-lat

TL;DR: 该工作首次在物理π介子质量（physical pion mass）下采用复朗之万模拟（complex Langevin simulations），给出跨越交叉区温度以上、高重子化学势（baryon chemical potential）区间的QCD状态方程（equation of state），并在连续极限外推后报告能量、熵、焓密度与比热容。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高重子化学势区域的QCD状态方程因符号问题（sign problem）难以用传统格点方法获得，而物理π介子质量下的直接模拟此前缺失，这限制了对该区域热力学性质的定量认识。

Method: 采用复朗之万模拟方法，在物理π介子质量下进行格点计算，并将结果外推到连续极限（continuum extrapolation），提取热力学量随重子化学势与温度的变化。

Result: 给出连续极限外推后的能量密度（energy density）、熵密度（entropy density）、焓密度（enthalpy density），以及比热容（specific heat capacity）作为重子化学势与温度函数的结果。

Conclusion: 复朗之万模拟可在物理π介子质量下直接用于研究高重子化学势区的QCD热力学，为交叉温度以上区域的状态方程提供定量结果。

Abstract: We discuss the QCD equation of state at temperatures above the crossover and for high baryon chemical potentials, obtained via the first ever complex Langevin simulations at the physical pion mass. In particular, we present continuum-extrapolated results for the energy, entropy, and enthalpy densities, as well as for the specific heat capacity as a function of baryon chemical potential and temperature.

</details>


### [125] [Enhanced Signal and Excited-State Control in Nonlocal Lattice Correlators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39944)
*Shi-Yi Zhong,Jian-Hui Zhang,Dian-Jun Zhao*

Main category: hep-lat

TL;DR: 该文提出一种比值拟合策略，通过用非局域关联函数除以局域关联函数来投影出主导的基态动力学，从而同时抑制信号噪声与激发态污染。该方法在夸克与胶子 PDF、夸克 GPD 和 TMDPDF 上得到验证，精度与稳定性显著提升，并可推广至更大强子动量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 格点计算部分子物理（parton physics）依赖非局域关联函数（nonlocal correlation functions），但其提取受限于两大困难：随欧几里得间隔（Euclidean separation）与强子动量增大而迅速恶化的信噪比（signal-to-noise ratio），以及激发态污染（excited-state contamination）。

Method: 提出新的拟合策略（fitting strategy）：取非局域关联函数与局域关联函数之比，以此投影出主导的基态（ground-state）动力学。该方法适用于一般狄拉克与动量结构（Dirac and momentum structures），涵盖连通与非连通贡献（connected and disconnected contributions）。

Result: 在夸克与胶子 PDF、夸克 GPD 和 TMDPDF 上进行了演示；结果与传统三点/两点比值拟合（three-point/two-point ratio fit）一致，但精度与稳定性明显改善，且可及范围延伸至更大的强子动量；对 GPD 等非前向矩阵元（nonforward matrix elements），分析流程大幅简化。

Conclusion: 该策略可自然推广至其他非局域关联函数，能够直接部署于现有格点研究计划，服务于精确的强子结构（hadron structure）计算。

Abstract: Nonlocal correlation functions underpin lattice calculations of parton physics. However, their extraction is limited by a rapidly deteriorating signal-to-noise ratio with increasing Euclidean separation and hadron momentum, and by excited-state contamination. We propose a new fitting strategy that enhances control over both: by taking the ratio of nonlocal to local correlators, we can project out the dominant ground-state dynamics with a signal that is much cleaner and far less sensitive to excited states than the conventional approach. We demonstrate the method on the quark and gluon PDF, the quark GPD and TMDPDF. The results are consistent with those from the conventional three-point/two-point ratio fit but exhibit markedly improved precision and stability, and extend the accessible range to larger hadron momenta. For nonforward matrix elements such as GPDs, our strategy greatly simplifies the analysis procedure. Our method applies to general Dirac and momentum structures, for connected and disconnected contributions, and extends naturally to other nonlocal correlators, making it immediately deployable in existing lattice programs toward precision hadron structure.

</details>

### [126] [Computing with Coupled Oscillator Networks: Optimization, Memory, and Modern AI Primitives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39703)
*Ahmed Allibhoy,Fabio Pasqualetti*

Main category: eess.SY

TL;DR: 该文探讨耦合振子网络（coupled oscillator networks）中的同步（synchronization）现象如何被用于执行多种计算任务，并借助伊辛模型（Ising model）搭建网络动力学与计算原语之间的桥梁，重点讨论其在组合优化、联想记忆与注意力机制三方面的应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统数字计算机（digital computers）在机器学习与人工智能等大规模问题上的能耗需求不断上升，促使研究者寻找替代方案；耦合振子网络因物理实现广泛（如模拟电路、神经体系、自旋电子系统）而具备作为通用计算范式（universal computing paradigm）的吸引力。

Method: 以源自统计物理（statistical physics）的伊辛模型为理论桥梁，将耦合振子网络的局部相互作用与全局复杂、无序的同步模式联系起来，并据此分析该网络实现的三种基本计算操作。

Result: 耦合振子网络可实现三类基本计算操作：作为NP难组合优化问题（NP-hard combinatorial optimization）的专用硬件求解器，解编码于同步模式中；作为联想记忆（associative memory）系统，以振荡相位表示数据的存储与检索；以及作为注意力（attention）的动力学实现，以同步机制完成键（keys）与查询（queries）的对齐。

Conclusion: 耦合振子网络能够实现上述计算原语，为在多种物理基底（physical substrates）上构造新型智能系统提供了可能路径。

Abstract: We explore how synchronization in coupled oscillator networks may be employed to perform a variety of computing tasks. These systems are becoming more attractive as an alternative to conventional digital computers due to the increasing energy demands of the latter, particularly for large-scale problems in machine learning and artificial intelligence. The ubiquity of coupled oscillator networks means that oscillator-based computing can be thought of as a universal computing paradigm encompassing systems with a diversity of physical realizations, e.g. as analog circuits, neurological systems, spintronic systems. The bridge between the dynamics of coupled oscillator networks and computational primitives they implement is the Ising model, which originates in statistical physics, and when applied to oscillator networks, explains the emergence of globally complex and disordered synchronization patterns from local interactions in the network. We discuss the application of coupled oscillator networks to three fundamental computing operations. First, oscillator networks as specialized hardware solvers of NP-hard combinatorial optimization problems, with the solution encoded in the synchrony patterns. Second, oscillator networks as associative memory systems, enabling storage and retrieval of data represented through phases of oscillations. Finally, oscillator networks as a dynamical implementation of attention, with synchronization providing the mechanism for the alignment of keys to queries. The ability of oscillator networks to implement these computational primitives paves the way for novel realizations of intelligent systems through a variety of physical substrates.

</details>

### [127] [Large connectivity expansion of Ising Spin Glasses on random graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38724)
*Luca Maria Del Bono,Flavio Nicoletti,Federico Ricci-Tersenghi*

Main category: cond-mat.dis-nn

TL;DR: 本文针对稀疏随机图上的 Ising 自旋玻璃（Ising spin glass），提出一种围绕全连接平均场极限的高连通性解析展开（high-connectivity analytical expansion），从而用闭式解析方程直接求得有限连通平均场系统的 de Almeida-Thouless 线，避免了数值迭代腔方法的高计算成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏随机图上该系统的精确腔解仅能通过数值迭代方程获得，缺乏解析刻画；本文旨在以解析展开近似临界行为（尤其是 T–H 平面中的 de Almeida-Thouless 线），获得显著的计算优势，并厘清平均场解的修正来源。

Method: 将腔方程（cavity equations）在全连接平均场极限附近展开，识别并处理三类修正：腔场的非高斯性（non-Gaussianity of the cavity fields）、腔场与其涨落之间的统计关联（statistical correlation）、以及腔滤波函数（cavity filter functions）的修正。采用两种展开：非均匀展开（non-uniform expansion，三项均展开）与均匀展开（uniform expansion，仅展开统计量而保留腔滤波函数不变）。

Result: 非均匀展开可直接与 Sherrington-Kirkpatrick 模型比较，但因 de Almeida-Thouless 线在零温极限发散而在低温失效；均匀展开能高精度描述系统的临界行为。结果进一步推广至 T = 0 极限。

Conclusion: 该高连通性解析展开在稀疏随机图 Ising 自旋玻璃研究中兼具计算效率与理论解析性，其中均匀展开是刻画临界行为的更稳健方案，并可延伸至零温情形。

Abstract: We compute a high-connectivity analytical expansion for Ising spin glasses on sparse random graphs. We expand the cavity equations around the fully-connected mean-field limit, focusing on the critical behavior of the system: our approach allows us to compute the de Almeida-Thouless line of mean-field finitely-connected systems in the temperature $T$--magnetic field $H$ plane, by means of closed analytical equations. The exact cavity solution of such systems can only be obtained by solving numerically iterative equations, so our approach brings a notable computational advantage. On the theoretical side, we are able to identify three sources of corrections to the fully-connected mean-field solution: i) the non-Gaussianity of the cavity fields, ii) the statistical correlation between the cavity fields and their fluctuations, and iii) the corrections to the cavity filter functions. These corrections are treated using two different expansions: a non-uniform expansion, where we expand all three contributions around the mean-field solution, and a uniform expansion, where we only expand the statistics but leave the cavity filters untouched. The former allows for a direct comparison with the Sherrington-Kirkpatrick model but fails at low temperatures, as a consequence of the de Almeida-Thouless line diverging in the zero-temperature limit. On the other hand, the uniform expansion describes with good accuracy the critical behavior of the system. We also extend these results to the $T = 0$ limit.

</details>


### [128] [Spectral theory of large data with power-law latent features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39013)
*Philipp Fleig*

Main category: cond-mat.dis-nn

TL;DR: 该文提出一种用于解释经验协方差矩阵幂律特征值谱的生成式潜特征模型（generative latent feature model），并建立其谱理论，给出Stieltjes变换的自洽方程、体特征值密度与孤立顶部特征值的位置与涨落。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 由数据估计的协方差矩阵呈现幂律特征值谱（power-law eigenvalue spectra），这一现象广泛出现于神经群体、蛋白质等领域，但缺乏能解释该谱形态并可纳入测量噪声的生成模型及其谱理论。

Method: 构建生成式潜特征模型，可选地引入测量噪声（measurement noise）；推导协方差矩阵Stieltjes变换的闭式领头阶自洽方程（self-consistent equations），由此获得体特征值密度（bulk eigenvalue density），并为自洽方程给出变分原理（variational principle）；同时计算孤立顶部特征值的位置与涨落。

Result: 理论在已知的代数极限下得到验证，并与数值模拟结果进行对照检验。

Conclusion: 所提出的潜特征模型谱理论能够刻画含噪数据协方差矩阵的幂律谱结构，在解析极限与模拟中均获支持，为跨领域幂律谱现象提供了统一的理论框架。

Abstract: Power-law eigenvalue spectra of covariance matrices estimated from data appear in diverse domains ranging from neural populations to proteins. We introduce a generative latent feature model for such data, optionally corrupted by measurement noise, and develop its spectral theory. We derive closed leading-order self-consistent equations for the Stieltjes transform of the covariance matrix from which the bulk eigenvalue density is obtained and provide a variational principle for the self-consistent equations. We also compute the positions and fluctuations of isolated top eigenvalues. The theory is validated in known algebraic limits and tested against simulations.

</details>


### [129] [Tunable periodic cascade of delocalization transitions in non-Hermitian IAAF model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39514)
*Yi Xue,Yunhua Wang*

Main category: cond-mat.dis-nn

TL;DR: 本文在非厄米（non-Hermitian）插值 Aubry-André-Fibonacci（IAAF）模型中引入虚相位位移，实现了可调的周期性离域转变级联（periodic cascade of delocalization transitions），并给出仅依赖虚相位位移的级联周期解析式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离域转变级联（cascade of delocalization transitions）为多步调控离域提供途径，但实现可编程的周期级联仍是挑战。

Method: 在准周期势（quasiperiodic potential）中加入虚相位位移，构建非厄米 IAAF 模型；结合数值静态局域化表征、级联周期解析推导以及静态与动力学诊断进行验证。

Result: 相图中出现局域态与扩展态交替的规则条纹图案；级联周期解析上仅由虚相位位移决定，可通过单一控制参数连续调节；静态与动力学诊断结果一致。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了一类具有可调级联周期的新型离域转变，为实验上可编程地控制离域提供了路径。

Abstract: Cascade of delocalization transitions provides a route to multi-step control of delocalization, yet achieving a programmable periodic cascade remains a challenge. Here, we demonstrate a tunable periodic cascade of delocalization transitions in a non-Hermitian interpolating Aubry-André-Fibonacci (IAAF) model by introducing an imaginary phase shift into the quasiperiodic potential. Such a periodic cascade of delocalization transitions arises from the competition between kinetic-energy-facilitated delocalization and gain-loss-regulated localization. In numerical static localization characterizations, successive regular stripe patterns for localized and extended states emerge in phase diagrams. We also derive an analytical expression for the cascade period and find that it relies solely on the imaginary phase shift. This provides a direct way of continuously tuning the cascade period via a single control parameter. Complementary static and dynamical diagnostics consistently confirm this periodic cascade of delocalization transitions in the non-Hermitian IAAF system. Our findings identify a novel class of delocalization transitions with tunable cascading periods, opening a route toward experimentally programmable control of delocalization.

</details>


### [130] [Microscopic Mechanism and Control of Reentrant Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39961)
*Pei-Jie Chang,Quanfeng Lu,Wentao Yang,Dong Ruan,Gui-Lu Long*

Main category: cond-mat.dis-nn

TL;DR: 该工作通过解析傅里叶通道（Fourier channels）间散射，揭示准周期二聚体链（quasiperiodic dimer chains）中同一调制既致局域化又促恢复的微观机制：相邻通道散射与回散射使谱边相对由中性辅助共振（neutral auxiliary resonance）确定的局域化边界移动，其相继穿越驱动同一谱包在局域化与扩展态间往返。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 准周期调制增强可在局域化之后恢复扩展态（extended states），但同一调制何以同时驱动局域化与恢复尚缺乏微观解释，本文旨在填补这一机制空白。

Method: 在准周期二聚体链中解析傅里叶通道之间的散射过程，追踪固定积分态密度（integrated density of states, IDS）标签的谱包相对局域化边界的演化；并构造精确的子晶格映射（sublattice mapping）用于阈值预测。

Result: 散射进入相邻通道并回散射会使谱边相对中性辅助共振所定边界发生移动，其相继穿越使同一谱包先局域化又恢复扩展；该恢复在两个带隙开启族（gap-opening families）及相对相位失谐（relative-phase detuning）的有限参数范围内存续。

Conclusion: 精确子晶格映射可实现恢复窗口的补偿调控，并能预测各IDS标签对应的恢复阈值，为调制诱导的局域化—恢复转变提供可解析、可调控的统一图像。

Abstract: Increasing quasiperiodic modulation can restore extended states after localization, raising the question of how the same modulation drives both localization and recovery. We identify a microscopic mechanism in quasiperiodic dimer chains by resolving scattering between Fourier channels. Specifically, scattering into neighboring channels and back shifts the spectral edge relative to a localization boundary determined by a neutral auxiliary resonance. Their successive crossings drive the same spectral packet with fixed integrated-density-of-states (IDS) labels into localization and back into an extended regime. This recovery persists across finite parameter ranges in both gap-opening families, including relative-phase detuning. Furthermore, an exact sublattice mapping enables compensated control of the recovery window and predicts recovery thresholds for individual IDS labels.

</details>


### [131] [Dynamical mean-field theory for associative memory with block-correlated patterns](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40060)
*Andrea Callegaris,Yoshiyuki Kabashima*

Main category: cond-mat.dis-nn

TL;DR: 该文将生成泛函动力学平均场理论（DMFT）推广至固定有限大小相关二值模式块，用于描述联想记忆（associative memory）中初始状态如何在个体记忆提取与对称混合态（symmetric mixed states）之间进行选择，并刻画重入（re-entrant）提取区域及其吸引域（basin）边界几何。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 存储相关模式时，个体记忆的提取会与对称混合态相互竞争，仅凭平衡态分析无法说明初始状态如何决定最终结果，因此需要动力学层面的描述。

Method: 把针对独立模式的生成泛函动力学平均场理论（generating-functional dynamical mean-field theory, DMFT）扩展到固定有限大小的相关二值模式块，得到等效单神经元过程，其中串扰噪声协方差（cross-talk noise covariance）与自反馈系数依赖块协方差特征值（block-covariance eigenvalues）。

Result: 对具有非单调传递函数（nonmonotonic transfer）的层级相关模式（hierarchically correlated patterns），加载量（loading）增加可使不完美初始状态先实现提取、继续增加则抑制提取，形成重入区域；DMFT 重现直接模拟的提取轨迹与吸引域几何，并在该区域下边界附近揭示分隔共存混合态与目标提取态的平稳鞍点（stationary saddles），其轨迹参数敏感性可预测边界移动，而上边界处需更大目标重叠方能提取。

Conclusion: 动力学平均场理论可定量刻画相关模式联想记忆的提取动力学与吸引域结构；在不动点收敛假设下，该理论退化为广义自洽信噪比分析（generalized self-consistent signal-to-noise analysis）的方程。

Abstract: In associative memories storing correlated patterns, retrieval of individual memories can compete with symmetric mixed states. A dynamical description is needed to determine how the initial state selects between these outcomes. We extend the generating-functional dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT) for independent patterns to independent blocks of correlated binary patterns of fixed finite size. The resulting effective single-neuron process has a self-consistent cross-talk noise covariance and self-feedback coefficients that depend on the block-covariance eigenvalues. For hierarchically correlated patterns with nonmonotonic transfer, increasing the loading can permit retrieval from an imperfect initial state before further loading prevents it. DMFT reproduces the retrieval trajectories and basin geometry found in direct simulations. Near the lower boundary of this re-entrant region, direct networks reveal stationary saddles separating coexisting mixed and target-retrieval states. Parameter sensitivities of DMFT trajectories predict nearby shifts of this boundary. At the tested upper boundary, retrieval remains accessible from initial states with larger target overlap, indicating a change in basin access. Under fixed-point convergence assumptions, the theory recovers the equations of generalized self-consistent signal-to-noise analysis.

</details>


### [132] [Structural signatures of primary and secondary relaxation during physical aging of a metallic glass](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40298)
*Beatrice Baraldi,Stefano Marchesin,Davide Marchesi,Lara Piemontese,Francesco Dallari,Søren S. Sørensen,Eloi Pineda,Marco Di Michiel,Giulio Monaco,Peihao Sun*

Main category: cond-mat.dis-nn

TL;DR: 该研究利用快速扫描量热与原位X射线全散射联用装置，追踪金属玻璃在跨越六个数量级时间和宽温区范围内的物理老化，发现主级与次级老化过程分别对应中程与短程结构长度尺度的变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理老化（physical aging）驱动玻璃趋向平衡并改变其热力学与力学性质，但伴随的微观结构演化认识不足；现有手段难以在极宽时间与温度范围内同步测量结构与焓变。

Method: 采用低背景（low-background）装置，将快速扫描量热（fast scanning calorimetry）与原位X射线全散射（in-situ X-ray total scattering）结合，对Pd42.5Cu30Ni7.5P20金属玻璃（metallic glass）在跨越六个数量级时间、从玻璃转变温度以上至其下150 K以上的温区内进行测量。

Result: 结构变化主要出现在结构因子（structure factor）第一与第二峰附近；在玻璃转变温度附近及以上，第一锐衍射峰（first sharp diffraction peak）的变化紧密跟随焓弛豫，主要对应中程有序度（medium-range ordering）提高；在更低温度下，仅此贡献无法描述焓演化，揭示出与第二衍射峰变化相关的额外更快弛豫过程，涉及短程结构重排（short-range structural rearrangements），包括Pd–Pd关联增强。

Conclusion: 研究建立了热力学弛豫与结构演化之间的直接联系，为“主级老化与次级老化过程分别关联不同结构长度尺度”提供了有力证据。

Abstract: Physical aging drives glasses toward equilibrium and changes their thermodynamic and mechanical properties, but the accompanying microscopic structural evolution remains poorly understood. Here, using our recently developed low-background setup combining fast scanning calorimetry with \emph{in-situ} X-ray total scattering, we investigate microscopic structural changes during physical aging in Pd$_{42.5}$Cu$_{30}$Ni$_{7.5}$P$_{20}$ metallic glass. The measurements span an unprecedented six orders of magnitude in time and a temperature range extending from above the glass transition temperature to more than 150\,K below it. We observe dominant structural changes near the first and second peaks of the structure factor. Near and above the glass transition temperature, changes in the first sharp diffraction peak closely follow enthalpy relaxation and are associated predominantly with increasing degrees of medium-range ordering. At lower temperatures, the enthalpy evolution can no longer be described by this contribution alone, revealing an additional, faster relaxation process that correlates with changes near the second diffraction peak and thus short-range structural rearrangements, including increased Pd--Pd correlations. These results establish a direct connection between thermodynamic relaxation and structural evolution, providing strong evidence that primary and secondary aging processes are associated with distinct structural length scales.

</details>

### [133] [Hierarchical Laminates Cannot Reproduce All Effective Properties of Planar Two-Phase Composites: A Counterexample with a 16-Component Potential](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37899)
*Lianghao Cao*

Main category: math.AP

TL;DR: 该摘要否定性地回答了分层层合板（hierarchical laminates）能否复现同一组分材料全部有效性质的问题：对势函数分量≥16的平面两相线性系统，存在有效性质无法被任意分层层合板逼近的微结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 设计复合材料需理解通过改变微结构（microstructure）可获得哪些有效性质；分层层合板可达到许多已知性质极限，故自然追问其是否能复现同组分材料的所有有效响应。论文针对这一普适性问题给出否定答案。

Method: 对受线性系统支配、势函数具16个及以上分量的平面两相复合材料，构造组分材料性质与任意指定非平凡相分数（phase fraction）下的周期微结构；使所有分层层合板在两个给定平均梯度处有效能量相等，再构造局部为相分数光滑变化的水平层合板、但有效能量破坏该等式的介质，用足够细的周期条纹逼近得到两相反例。

Result: 构造出有效性质不能被分层层合板逼近的周期微结构，即使层方向、比例与分层步数均不受限制；并据此对双势阱松弛问题（two-well relaxation problem）给出否定回答——$\mathbb{R}^{2\times32}$ 上两个正定齐次二次型的最小值可具有不同的拟凸包（quasiconvex envelope）与一阶凸包（rank-one convex envelope）。

Conclusion: 分层层合板不能穷尽两相复合材料的有效性质空间；该反例及包络间的严格不等式已在 Lean 4 中形式化验证。

Abstract: Designing a composite requires understanding which effective properties can be achieved through varying its microstructure, i.e., the spatial arrangement of given constituent materials. Hierarchical laminates, created by successive layering, reach many known limits on these properties, making it natural to ask whether they can reproduce every effective response obtainable from the same constituents. We answer this question negatively for planar two-phase composites governed by linear systems whose potentials have 16 or more components. We construct constituent material properties and, at any prescribed nontrivial phase fraction, periodic microstructures whose effective properties cannot be approximated by hierarchical laminates, even when layer directions, proportions, and the number of layering steps are unrestricted. We design the constituents so that all hierarchical laminates have equal effective energies at two prescribed mean gradients. The key step is to construct a medium whose local properties are those of horizontal laminates with smoothly varying phase fractions, but whose effective energies violate this equality. Approximating these energies with sufficiently fine periodic stripes of the original constituents yields the two-phase counterexample. This construction also gives a negative answer to the two-well relaxation problem: the minimum of two positive-definite homogeneous quadratic forms on $\mathbb{R}^{2\times32}$ can have distinct quasiconvex and rank-one convex envelopes. The counterexample and the strict inequality between the envelopes are formally verified in Lean 4.

</details>


### [134] [Genericity of singularities of solutions to quasilinear systems on compact sets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38370)
*Azamat Shavlukov*

Main category: math.AP

TL;DR: 该论文证明：在气体动力学（gas dynamics）与非线性几何光学（nonlinear geometrical optics）方程的解中，$A_2,A_3,D_4^\pm$ 型奇点（singularities）在相应横截性条件（transversality conditions）下具有一般性（genericity），其解集在光滑与实解析解空间中于紧集上的 Whitney 拓扑（Whitney topology）下是开且稠密的。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究动机在于确定这些特定类型奇点在解空间中的典型性，即是否构成开稠密集，从而说明其在一般解中普遍出现而非例外情形。

Method: 以气体动力学方程与非线性几何光学方程的解为对象，对满足相应横截性条件的解集，在赋予紧集上 Whitney 拓扑的光滑解空间与实解析（real-analytic）解空间中讨论其开性与稠密性。

Result: 满足横截性条件的 $A_2,A_3,D_4^\pm$ 型奇点解集被证明在光滑解空间与实解析解空间中均为开且稠密（open and dense）。

Conclusion: $A_2,A_3,D_4^\pm$ 型奇点在上述两类方程的解中具有一般性（genericity），即其在相应拓扑下是典型的而非退化的例外现象。

Abstract: We study the genericity of singularities of types $A_2,A_3,D_4^\pm$ in solutions of the equations of gas dynamics and nonlinear geometrical optics. The sets of solutions satisfying the corresponding transversality conditions are proved to be open and dense in spaces of smooth and real-analytic solutions equipped with the Whitney topology on compact sets.

</details>


### [135] [Electromagnetic Potentials via the Extended Maxwell System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38500)
*Rainer Picard,Sascha Trostorff,Marcus Waurick*

Main category: math.AP

TL;DR: 该论文在任意开的三维区域上为各向异性、非均匀材料构造电磁势，去除了单连通性等拓扑假设，核心手段是借助扩展麦克斯韦系统（extended Maxwell system）的简易解理论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统电磁势构造通常需要单连通性（simple connectedness）或无孔洞等拓扑前提，这限制了结果的适用范围；本文旨在使各向异性（anisotropic）、非均匀（non-homogeneous）介质中的势构造不再依赖此类拓扑假设。

Method: 在任意开的三维集合上运用扩展麦克斯韦系统（extended Maxwell system），利用其易于处理的解理论（solution theory）来导出标量势（scalar potential）与矢量势（vector potential）的存在性。

Result: 在无需单连通性或无孔洞等拓扑条件下，成功证明了任意开三维集合上标量势与矢量势的同时存在性。

Conclusion: 扩展麦克斯韦系统为各向异性、非均匀介质中的电磁势构造提供了不依赖拓扑假设的统一框架，使拓扑前提在该语境下成为多余。

Abstract: We construct electromagnetic potentials on arbitrary open 3-dimensional sets for anisotropic, non-homogeneous materials, thus rendering any topological assumption like simple connectedness or the absence of holes superfluous in this context. The main idea is to invoke the extended Maxwell system the easy solution theory of which then yields existence of both scalar- and vector potentials.

</details>


### [136] [A Note on the Smoluchowski Coagulation-Fragmentation Equation with Fractional Laplacian](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38908)
*Mattia Cantoni,Silvia Lorenzani*

Main category: math.AP

TL;DR: 本文评估含分数阶拉普拉斯算子（fractional Laplacian）的 Smoluchowski 凝聚-破碎方程（coagulation-fragmentation equation）的适定性（well-posedness），研究对象为带齐次 Neumann 边界条件的离散截断系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究动机在于刻画粒子运动呈现非标准行为，即“反常”扩散（anomalous diffusion）情形下凝聚-破碎模型的数学适定性问题。

Method: 采用离散 Smoluchowski 型方程（Smoluchowski-type equations）的截断方程组建模团簇（clusters）的形成，以分数阶拉普拉斯算子描述扩散项，并施加齐次 Neumann 边界条件。

Result: 摘要仅说明对上述截断系统的适定性进行了评估，未给出具体的存在性、唯一性或稳定性结论。

Conclusion: 该工作针对反常扩散背景下的凝聚-破碎方程建立了适定性分析框架，具体结论需参见全文。

Abstract: In this work, we assess the well-posedness of the Smoluchowski coagulation-fragmentation equation with fractional Laplacian. In particular, we consider a truncated set of discrete Smoluchowski-type equations modeling the formation of clusters, with homogeneous Neumann boundary conditions, where the diffusive term describes a non-standard behavior in the movement of particles ('anomalous' diffusion).

</details>


### [137] [Unified transform method for nonautonomous linear evolution equations: rigorous analysis and qualitative theory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39698)
*Andreas Chatziafratis,Spyridon Kamvissis,Alain Miranville,Tohru Ozawa*

Main category: math.AP

TL;DR: 本文将著名的Fokas统一变换方法（unified transform method, UTM）严格推广至含时间依赖系数的线性发展偏微分方程（linear evolution PDE），并以半直线上的非齐次初边值问题（initial-boundary-value problems）为实例进行详细分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Fokas统一变换方法此前主要针对常系数线性发展PDE，其在时间依赖系数情形下的严格推广尚属空白，具有理论与应用价值。

Method: 针对含反应项与时间变化系数的热方程（heat equation）及修正热方程（Barenblatt伪抛物方程），在半直线上形式化地实施UTM导出解公式，并借助复分析工具（complex-analytic tools）与对积分表示的细致解释进行经典意义下的严格后验验证。

Result: 获得显式解公式并用于研究正则性（regularity）、区域坐标轴附近的边界行为，以及长程与最终周期性渐近（long-range and eventual periodicity asymptotics）；发现解直至边界的光滑性取决于初值、边界与强迫数据间的相容性条件（compatibility conditions），且该条件中现引入系数的初值。

Conclusion: 基于上述定性理论，进一步推出关于解的唯一性（uniqueness）、解析性（analyticity）与可控性（controllability）的结果。

Abstract: Established herein is the rigorous extension of the celebrated Fokas unified transform method for linear evolution PDE with time-dependent coefficients. As illustrative examples, considered below and rigorously analysed in detail are non-homogeneous initial-boundary-value problems, formulated on the half-line, for the heat equation and the modified heat (also widely known as Barenblatt's pseudo-parabolic) equation with reaction terms and temporally varying coefficients. Solution formulae are derived formally via suitable implementation of the UTM, and rigorously verified a posteriori, in the classical sense. The latter task relies on complex-analytic tools and careful interpretation of the obtained integral representations. The explicit solutions established here are then used for investigating qualitative properties. These include regularity, boundary behavior near the axes of the domain as well as long-range and eventual periodicity asymptotics. Notably, smoothness of the solution up to the boundaries depends on compatibility conditions between initial, boundary and forcing data, into which interjected now are initial values of the coefficients. Further results pertaining to solution uniqueness, analyticity and controllability of the addressed problems are thence deduced in light of the preceding qualitative theory.

</details>

### [138] [Degenerate complex structures on surfaces and stability conditions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40035)
*Antonios-Alexandros Robotis,Nicolás Vilches*

Main category: math.AG

TL;DR: 本文为“Bridgeland稳定性空间与镜像复结构相关”这一物理启发式提供数学证据：证明对曲线与曲面，模部分紧化中的某些边界层描述了镜像的退化复结构，并给出构造边界点的判据及K3、Enriques曲面导数范畴商上稳定条件的存在性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理启发式（physical heuristics）预测射影Calabi-Yau流形（projective Calabi-Yau manifold）$X$上的Bridgeland稳定性条件空间应与其镜像（mirror）$X^\vee$的复结构模空间（moduli space of complex structures）相关，但缺乏数学论证；本文旨在为该启发式提供数学证据。

Method: 利用文献中引入的稳定性条件空间商（quotient）的模部分紧化（modular partial compactification）$\mathcal{A}\mathrm{Stab}(X)$；对曲线与曲面情形，研究其中特定边界层（boundary strata）；并引入一个判据，用于在$\mathcal{D}$为任意$k$-线性三角范畴（$k$-linear triangulated category）时产生$\mathcal{A}\mathrm{Stab}(\mathcal{D})$的边界点。

Result: 证明了对曲线与曲面，$\mathcal{A}\mathrm{Stab}(X)$中的某些边界层描述了$X^\vee$上的退化复结构（degenerate complex structures）；作为副产品，推出K3与Enriques曲面导数范畴（derived categories）的某些商上Bridgeland稳定性条件的存在性。

Conclusion: 结果为稳定性空间与镜像复结构之间的启发式关系提供了数学支持，并将边界点的构造推广到任意$k$-线性三角范畴的框架，同时导出K3与Enriques曲面相关商范畴上稳定性条件的存在性。

Abstract: Physical heuristics suggest that the space of Bridgeland stability conditions of a projective Calabi-Yau manifold $X$ should be related to the moduli space of complex structures on its mirror $X^\vee$. On the other hand, recent work in the literature introduces a modular partial compactification, $\mathcal{A}\mathrm{Stab}(X)$, of a quotient of the space of stability conditions on $\mathcal{D}^{b}(X)$. We provide some mathematical evidence for the aforementioned heuristics by proving that for curves and surfaces, certain boundary strata in $\mathcal{A}\mathrm{Stab}(X)$ describe degenerate complex structures on $X^\vee$. Along the way, we introduce a criterion for producing boundary points of $\mathcal{A}\mathrm{Stab}(\mathcal{D})$ when $\mathcal{D}$ is an arbitrary $k$-linear triangulated category. As a byproduct, we deduce the existence of Bridgeland stability conditions on certain quotients of the derived categories of K3 and Enriques surfaces.

</details>


### [139] [Balancing tautological intersection numbers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39462)
*Kefeng Liu,Hao Xu*

Main category: math.AG

TL;DR: 本文证明了作者约二十年前提出的三条平衡不等式（balancing inequalities）猜想：将一单位从较大指标移至较小指标，不会减小混合同义相交数（mixed tautological intersection number），无论两个特出插入（distinguished insertions）为 psi 类、kappa 类或 Hodge Chern 类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 待证猜想源于作者约二十年前的猜想，指出混合同义相交数在指标向低端迁移时具有单调性，此前仅有猜想表述而缺证明。

Method: 摘要未透露方法细节，仅说明建立了三条平衡不等式，分别对应 psi 类、kappa 类与 Hodge Chern 类情形下的指标转移比较。

Result: 三条平衡不等式猜想均获证明：在 psi 类、kappa 类与 Hodge Chern 类三种设定下，指标重分配均不减小混合同义相交数。

Conclusion: 该结果给出了混合同义相交数关于指标的一种统一单调性陈述，验证了长期悬置的猜想。

Abstract: We prove the three balancing inequalities conjectured by the authors about 20 years ago: moving one unit from a larger index to a smaller one cannot decrease a mixed tautological intersection number, whether the two distinguished insertions are psi classes, kappa classes, or Hodge Chern classes.

</details>

### [140] [Characteristic identities for orthogonal quantum matrices: examples](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37813)
*Oleg Ogievetsky,Pavel Pyatov*

Main category: math.QA

TL;DR: 本文以与 O(3) 型典范正交 R-矩阵（orthogonal R-matrix）相关联的 RTT-代数（RTT-algebra）为最简非平凡示例，分量式验证正交量子矩阵代数（orthogonal Quantum Matrix algebras）结构理论的若干结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 摘要指出作者已有关于正交量子矩阵代数结构理论的系列结果，但需以最简单的非平凡实例加以具体演示与验证，从而使抽象的 R-矩阵方法结论获得分量层面的直接确认。

Method: 在生成元集合上引入适当的线性序（linear order），导出定义该代数的一组二次关系（quadratic relations）；进而考察其高次多项式之间的关系，以“分量形式”（in components）检验 Cayley-Hamilton 关系与互反关系（reciprocal relations）。

Result: 以分量方式验证了此前借助 R-矩阵技术（R-matrix techniques）得到的 Cayley-Hamilton 关系与互反关系，并显式计算了量子矩阵特征多项式（characteristic polynomials）的系数。

Conclusion: 作者提出关于该 RTT-代数 Hilbert-Poincaré 级数（Hilbert-Poincaré series）形式的猜想；整体工作表明 O(3) 示例可作为检验正交量子矩阵代数结构理论的有效试验场。

Abstract: In this note, we illustrate our recent results regarding structure theory of orthogonal Quantum Matrix algebras \cite{OP-BMW,OP-reciprocal,OP-ortho} using the simplest nontrivial example: the RTT-algebra associated with the canonical orthogonal R-matrix of type $O(3)$ (see, e.g., \cite{FRT}). By introducing a suitable linear order on the set of generators, we obtain a set of quadratic relations defining the algebra. Next, we investigate relations among its higher-degree polynomials. As a result, we verify `in components' the Cayley-Hamilton and the reciprocal relations, obtained earlier with the use of the R-matrix techniques. We explicitly calculate the coefficients of the characteristic polynomials of quantum matrices and propose a
  conjecture regarding the form of the Hilbert-Poincaré series for the RTT-algebra.

</details>


### [141] [G-equivariant Alterfold TQFT in any dimension](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40041)
*Zixuan Feng,Zhengwei Liu*

Main category: math.QA

TL;DR: 本文从满足强半单性（strong semisimplicity）、完全有限性（complete finiteness）与 Morita 不变性的 $G$-等变 $S^n$-代数出发，构造了 $(n+1)$ 维 $G$-等变 Alterfold 拓扑量子场论（topological quantum field theory, TQFT）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旨在将 Alterfold TQFT 框架推广到等变（equivariant）情形，即由 $G$-等变代数数据构造相应维度的等变拓扑量子场论，并建立其与已有理论的对应关系。

Method: 在三角剖分（triangulation）上以态和（state sum）方式定义配分函数（partition function），证明其在局部手术关系（local surgery relations）下不变，且在相对于边界（relative to the boundary）的规范变换（gauge transformations）下不变；当输入附加反射正性（reflection-positive）结构时理论为酉的（unitary）。

Result: 所定义配分函数满足局部手术与边界规范变换不变性；输入具有反射正性时理论酉化。对 $n=2$ 且输入由严格忠实球状 $G$-融合范畴（strict faithful spherical $G$-fusion category）重构时，限制到普通 $G$-配边（$G$-cobordisms）上与 Turaev–Virelizier 态和 HQFT 自然同构；Tambara–Yamagami 例子可将 Quon 语言（Quon language）恢复为 $\mathbb{Z}_2$-等变 Alterfold TQFT。

Conclusion: 该构造给出了一类由等变代数数据产生的等变 Alterfold TQFT，统一了 Turaev–Virelizier HQFT 与 Quon 语言等已有构造，并提供了酉性判据。

Abstract: For a discrete group $G$, we construct an $(n+1)$-dimensional $G$-equivariant Alterfold topological quantum field theory from a $G$-equivariant $S^n$-algebra satisfying strong semisimplicity, complete finiteness, and Morita invariance. We use state sum on triangulation to define a partition function and prove that it is invariant under local surgery relations and is invariant under gauge transformations relative to the boundary. If the input is given a reflection-positive structure, the theory is unitary. For $n=2$ and input reconstructed from a strict faithful spherical $G$-fusion category, the restriction to ordinary $G$-cobordisms is naturally isomorphic to the Turaev--Virelizier state-sum HQFT \cite{turaev20123}. A Tambara-Yamagami example recovers the Quon language \cite{liu2017quon} as a $\mathbb{Z}_2$-equivariant Alterfold TQFT.

</details>

### [142] [Zero-freeness for Random Regular Graphs up to the Replica Symmetry Breaking Threshold](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40510)
*Zejia Chen,Chunyang Wang,Xinyuan Zhang*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 该论文通过配分函数复零点的视角研究随机正则图上的反铁磁自旋系统，在复制对称（replica symmetry）区域内建立无零点区域，并据此得到多项式时间的确定性近似算法，突破了以往搜索算法可达的参数范围。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 核心动机在于：现有搜索类算法难以覆盖随机正则图上反铁磁模型（如硬核模型、反铁磁 Potts 模型）在复制对称区内的参数范围，而零点自由性（zero-freeness）可提供更强的算法保证，因此需要在更大参数区间内证明配分函数无复零点。

Method: 技术上提出增强型小子图条件化（reinforced small subgraph conditioning），将经典小子图条件化提升到随机全纯函数层面以处理复平面中的短环涨落；并通过证明复制对称性蕴含非正的 Bethe 泛函（Bethe functional）、将植入重叠集中性加强为指数小界，从而突破裸二阶矩的指数爆炸障碍。

Result: 对随机 d-正则图上的硬核模型与反铁磁 Potts 模型（含 β=0 的正常 q-染色），以高概率建立覆盖复制对称区内部的复无零点区域；参数边界分别达到 α<α_RSB(d)=(2log d−2log log d+2−2log 2+o_d(1))/d 与 d<d_RSB(q)=(2q−1)log q−2log 2+o_q(1)。

Conclusion: 借助无零点性的标准算法推论，得到在固定有理参数处乘性近似配分函数的确定性多项式时间算法（对图以高概率成立），显著改进了已有工作并超越已知搜索算法的参数覆盖范围。

Abstract: We study antiferromagnetic spin systems on random regular graphs through the lens of the phase transitions characterized by the complex zeros of the partition function. Our motivating examples include the hardcore model and the antiferromagnetic Potts model (including proper $q$-colorings at $β=0$). For both models on random $d$-regular graphs, we establish, with high probability over the graph, zero-free regions throughout the interior of the replica-symmetric regime. Asymptotically, this regime extends up to tree occupation density $$α< α_{\mathrm{RSB}}(d) = (2\log d - 2\log\log d + 2 - 2\log 2 + o_d(1))/d$$ for the hardcore model and up to degree $$d < d_{\mathrm{RSB}}(q) = (2q-1)\log q - 2\log 2 + o_q(1)$$ for proper $q$-colorings.
  Leveraging the standard algorithmic implications of zero-freeness, we obtain deterministic polynomial-time algorithms that multiplicatively approximate the corresponding partition functions at fixed rational parameters throughout this regime, with high probability over the graph. Our algorithmic guarantees significantly improve upon prior work and extend beyond the parameter ranges reached by previously known search algorithms.
  To establish our results, we first develop reinforced small subgraph conditioning, which resolves short-cycle fluctuations in the complex plane by lifting classical small subgraph conditioning on random regular graphs to random holomorphic functions. Second, we overcome the standard second-moment barrier caused by the exponential blowup of the bare second moment inside the replica-symmetric phase, by showing that replica symmetry implies a nonpositive Bethe functional and upgrading planted overlap concentration to an exponentially small bound, which enables a typical-graph truncation that controls complex second moments up to the replica symmetry breaking threshold.

</details>


### [143] [On Zeros and Algorithms for Disordered Systems II: The Antiferromagnetic Ising Model up to Kesten-Stigum](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40598)
*Ferenc Bencs,Brice Huang,Daniel Z. Lee,Kuikui Liu,Guus Regts*

Main category: cs.DS

TL;DR: 该论文给出首个可在多项式时间（polynomial time）内、对所有逆温度直至 Kesten-Stigum 阈值（Kesten-Stigum threshold）的情形，在均匀随机 d-正则图上以任意高精度估计反铁磁 Ising 模型（antiferromagnetic Ising model）配分函数（partition function）的算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该逆温度区间恰是模型处于复本对称（replica symmetric）的整个区域，并被猜测为多项式时间计数与采样（counting and sampling）的最优范围，因此在此范围内设计算法具有重要的理论意义。

Method: 作为算法结果的核心支撑，作者证明了在输入图随机性下以高概率成立的性质：配分函数在从 0 到 Kesten-Stigum 阈值区间周围的常数宽度条带内不存在 Fisher 零点（Fisher zeros）。

Result: 得到了首个在 Kesten-Stigum 阈值以内全部逆温度上以任意精度估计反铁磁 Ising 配分函数的多项式时间算法，并伴随上述 Fisher 零点不存在的概率性结论。

Conclusion: 该工作将算法能力覆盖到复本对称的完整区间，与关于多项式时间计数与采样最优性的猜想相吻合；摘要另附 AI 使用声明，说明证明架构由作者独立完成并经验证。

Abstract: We give the first polynomial-time algorithm to estimate the partition function of the antiferromagnetic Ising model on the uniformly random $d$-regular graph to arbitrarily high accuracy for all inverse temperatures up to the Kesten-Stigum threshold. This is the entire regime in which the model is "replica symmetric," and is conjectured to be optimal for polynomial-time counting and sampling. To achieve our algorithmic result, we establish the absence of Fisher zeros for the partition function in a constant-width strip around the interval from $0$ up to the Kesten-Stigum threshold, with high probability over the randomness of the input graph.
  AI Disclosure: The overarching vision and proof architecture were developed solely by the authors without AI input. GPT 5.5 Pro was used, with extensive guidance from the authors, for only a few minor technical aspects of the proof. The authors independently verified correctness and wrote everything by hand. We take full responsibility for its contents. A more detailed statement can be found in Section 1.2.

</details>

### [144] [Quantum Correlations Between Two Giant Dipole Resonances in Ultra-Peripheral Collisions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38324)
*Albandry Alshammri,Ashik Ikbal Sheikh,Declan Keane,Prithwish Tribedy,Gang Wang,Zhangbu Xu,Jie Zhao*

Main category: nucl-th

TL;DR: 该论文探讨超周边重离子碰撞中两个巨偶极共振（GDR）是否以关联量子相位被制备，并构建相位敏感的GDR衰变模型定量比较三种中子方位角关联机制，指出双中子相对方位角相关及其能量依赖可作为探测量子相位关联的可观测量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准描述假设对撞两核中激发的两个巨偶极共振（Giant Dipole Resonance, GDR）在统计上相互独立，仅由共同的光子极化轴给出四极方位角关联；作者希望检验二者是否可能在电磁脉冲重叠期间以关联量子相位（correlated quantum phase）形式被制备。

Method: 构建相位敏感的GDR衰变模型（phase-sensitive GDR decay model），并将其实现于修改版 \texttt{$n_{0}^{0}n$} 蒙特卡罗生成器（Monte Carlo generator）中，从而对三种竞争机制进行定量比较：电磁反冲导致的弱偶极调制、独立极化GDR衰变产生的四极关联，以及所提出的相位锁定（phase-lock）情景对应的相位敏感偶极调制。

Result: 对于相对发射时间差较小的中子对，关联相位情景在双中子相对方位角分布（relative-azimuth distribution）中产生显著的一阶谐波调制（first-harmonic modulation）；对所有相对发射时间平均后该调制显著减弱。在所采用的能量依赖角模型下，经时间筛选的偶极系数（dipolar coefficient）随中子对平均动能增大而幅度增加。

Conclusion: 中子相对方位角关联及其能量依赖被识别为可在实验上探测两个GDR激发之间量子相位关联（quantum phase correlations）的可观测量，并可能为未来在RHIC与LHC检验空间分离GDR激发间的量子纠缠（quantum entanglement）提供基础。

Abstract: Mutual Coulomb dissociation in ultra-peripheral heavy-ion collisions is dominated by Giant Dipole Resonance (GDR) excitation, whose subsequent decays produce forward neutrons. Standard descriptions treat the two GDRs excited in opposite nuclei as statistically independent, leading primarily to a quadrupolar azimuthal correlation determined by the common photon-polarization axis. In this work, we investigate the possibility that the two GDRs are instead prepared with a correlated quantum phase during the overlap of the electromagnetic pulses. We develop a phase-sensitive GDR decay model and implement it in a modified version of the \texttt{$n_{0}^{0}n$} Monte Carlo generator, allowing a quantitative comparison among three competing mechanisms: the weak dipolar modulation from electromagnetic recoil, the quadrupolar correlation from independent polarized GDR decays, and the phase-sensitive dipolar modulation associated with the proposed phase-lock scenario. For neutron pairs with small relative emission-time differences, the correlated-phase scenario produces a pronounced first-harmonic modulation in the two-neutron relative-azimuth distribution. Averaging over all relative emission times substantially reduces this modulation. Within the adopted energy-dependent angular model, the time-selected dipolar coefficient increases in magnitude with pair-mean neutron kinetic energy. These results identify neutron relative-azimuth correlations and their energy dependence as experimentally accessible observables for probing quantum phase correlations between the two GDR excitations. Such phase-sensitive correlations could also provide a basis for future tests of quantum entanglement between spatially separated GDR excitations at RHIC and the LHC.

</details>


### [145] [Irreducible representations of $SU(3)$ for nucleons in a oscillator shell $η$ with $η\le 8$: Application to nuclei with proxy-$SU(4)$ symmetry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39357)
*V. K. B. Kota*

Main category: nucl-th

TL;DR: 该文基于群论文献中的简单规则，生成可修改的代码以获取给定振子壳层（oscillator shell）η（η≤8）中给定核子数所对应的 SU(3) 不可约表示（irreps），并给出在核结构中的应用示例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为在壳模型（shell model）及相互作用玻色子模型（interacting boson models）的 SU(3) 极限下，便捷地获得给定壳层与核子数组合的 SU(3) 不可约表示表。

Method: 依据群论文献中的既定规则编写（易于按需修改的）代码：先求给定 η 壳层中无自旋费米子（spinless fermions）的 SU(3) 不可约表示，再扩展到给定总自旋 S 的全同核子（质子或中子），以及给定自旋-同位旋 SU(4) 不可约表示的核子情形。

Result: 生成 η≤8 范围内 SU(3) 不可约表示表，包括给定总自旋 S 的全同核子表与给定 SU(4) 不可约表示的核子表；并以 η=4 壳层、52≤Z,N≤78 且具 proxy-SU(4) 对称性的核为例展示表格应用。

Conclusion: 所给程序可推广至各类相互作用玻色子模型的 SU(3) 极限，摘要中亦给出相应示例，表明方法具有较好的可扩展性。

Abstract: Applying some simple rules, established in group theory literature, generated are codes (easy to modify as required) for obtaining $SU(3)$ irreducible representations (irreps) for a given number of nucleons in a given oscillator shell $η$ with $η\le 8$. In this approach, first the $SU(3)$ irreps are obtained for spinless fermions in a given $η$ shell. Using the codes developed, tables of $SU(3)$ irreps are generated for identical nucleons (protons or neutrons) with a given total spin $S$. Similarly, the $SU(3)$ irreps are generated for nucleons with a given spin-isospin $SU(4)$ irrep. Some applications of these tables for $η=4$ shell for $52 \le \mbox{Z,N} \le 78$ nuclei with proxy-$SU(4)$ symmetry are presented. Also, the procedure used for the shell model $SU(3)$ limits is easy to be extended for the $SU(3)$ limit of various interacting boson models and some examples for these are also presented.

</details>


### [146] [An Eigenvector-Continued Green's Function Method](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38780)
*Stefano Brolli,Carlo Barbieri*

Main category: nucl-th

TL;DR: 该文提出基于本征向量延拓（eigenvector continuation）与矩匹配（moment-matching）的可系统改进的格林函数（Green's function）仿真器（emulator），通过求解线性方程组获得近似格林函数，并实现离线与在线阶段的计算负载分离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 格林函数蕴含全能量谱的单粒子谱学、单体密度矩阵与基态能量等大量信息，用降阶方程模拟十分困难；但多体物理中参数标定、不确定性量化、相图绘制与几何优化等重复模型评估任务亟需仿真器带来的计算加速。

Method: 将本征向量延拓与矩匹配相结合，构造可系统改进的近似，称为“本征向量延拓的格林函数”（eigenvector-continued Green's function），其可通过求解线性方程组得到，从而把计算负担高效划分为离线（offline）与在线（online）两个阶段。

Result: 所形成的近似可通过线性方程求解获得，并使计算工作量得以分离为离线与在线阶段，支持重复模型评估场景下的效率提升。

Conclusion: 所提仿真器为格林函数提供了一种可系统改进且计算高效的降阶近似方案，适用于需要大量重复评估的多体物理应用。

Abstract: Emulating the Green's function using reduced-order equations is challenging because of the amount of information it contains. This information includes the one-particle spectroscopy over the entire energy spectrum, the one-body density matrix, and the ground-state energy. Nevertheless, the computational speedup offered by emulators is essential for applications requiring repeated model evaluations, which are ubiquitous in many-body physics. These include parameter calibration, uncertainty quantification, phase-diagram mapping, and geometry optimization. In this Letter, we introduce a systematically improvable emulator based on eigenvector continuation and moment-matching. The resulting approximation, which we refer to as an ``eigenvector-continued Green's function,'' can be obtained by solving linear equations, enabling an efficient separation of the computational workload into offline and online stages.

</details>

### [147] [Regional accuracy of physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) for recirculation in a deep lid-driven cavity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38814)
*Ehsan Roohi,Christopher J. McDevitt*

Main category: physics.flu-dyn

TL;DR: 该研究针对深宽比 D/W=5 的二维不可压缩顶盖驱动方腔流（lid-driven cavity flow），用无数据物理信息神经网络（physics-informed neural networks, PINNs）求解 Re=100–1000 的稳态流场，并以谱/hp 方法结果为参考，量化了内部与底部区域的速度、压力偏差及其随工作流改进的变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深腔流动中顶盖下方运动强、深处回流弱，仅比较整体（bulk）速度不足以完整评估计算流场；因此需要在内部与近底区域分别检验 PINN 的精度，明确其在旋转流场中的可信范围。

Method: 采用硬约束（hard-constrained）流函数（streamfunction）形式，结合指定区域配点（prescribed regional collocation）、迁移初始化（transferred initialization），以及若干残差缩放（residual scaling）与包络（envelope）变体；参考场由同款高斯正则化顶盖条件下的独立谱/hp 计算给出。

Result: 在 121×605 公共网格上，内部相对速度偏差为 5.130%–7.850%，底部区域相对速度偏差低于 5%，绝对 RMS 偏差为 1.255×10⁻¹⁰U 至 2.332×10⁻⁹U；在 Re=1000 的 161×801 网格上，改进工作流将内部速度偏差由 5.624% 降至 2.658%，规范对齐（gauge-aligned）压力 RMS 偏差由 2.793×10⁻³ 降至 1.167×10⁻³ ρU²。

Conclusion: 改进来自累积训练工作流的整体比较，未单独隔离区域采样（regional sampling）的作用，且配置排序依赖于区域与观测量；这些有限预算（finite-budget）比较界定了所保留工作流与参考解一致之处，以及旋转场偏差仍然显著的部位。

Abstract: Deep lid-driven cavities contain strong motion beneath the lid and much weaker recirculation at depth, so agreement in bulk velocity is an incomplete assessment of a computed flow. We examine data-free physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) for steady, two-dimensional incompressible flow in a cavity of depth-to-width ratio five at Reynolds numbers 100, 250, 500 and 1000. An established hard-constrained streamfunction formulation is combined with prescribed regional collocation, transferred initialization, and selected residual-scaling and envelope variants. Independent spectral/$hp$ calculations with the same Gaussian-regularized lid provide the reference fields. For a cavity of depth-to-width ratio $D/W=5$ at Reynolds numbers $\mathrm{Re}=100$, 250, 500, and 1000, evaluation on a common $121\times605$ grid gives interior relative velocity discrepancies of 5.130\%--7.850\%. Over the same cases, floor-region relative velocity discrepancies remain below 5\%, with absolute RMS discrepancies ranging from $1.255\times10^{-10}U$ to $2.332\times10^{-9}U$, where $U$ is the lid-velocity scale. In a separate $161\times801$ assessment at $\Rey=1000$, the refined workflow lowers interior velocity discrepancy from 5.624\% to 2.658\% and gauge-aligned pressure RMS discrepancy from $2.793\times10^{-3}$ to $1.167\times10^{-3}ρU^2$. The improvements compare accumulated training workflows and do not isolate regional sampling. Configuration rankings depend on both region and observable. These finite-budget comparisons establish where the retained workflows agree with the reference and where rotational-field discrepancies remain substantial.

</details>

### [148] [Moments of characteristic polynomials at random matrix Gram points](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39856)
*Christopher Hughes,Somin Kim*

Main category: math.NT

TL;DR: 该论文研究随机酉矩阵特征多项式在单位圆上取实值点（即"随机矩阵 Gram 点"）处的矩，证明其 2k 阶矩在此类点上的平均大于在整个单位圆上的平均，从而正面回答了 Richard Hall 的猜想。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 受 Riemann zeta 函数在 Gram 点上的行为类比启发，Richard Hall 预期 zeta 在 Gram 点上的取值应大于典型值；本文旨在随机矩阵（random matrix）框架下检验这一预期。

Method: 将单位圆上特征多项式取实值的点定义为"随机矩阵 Gram 点（random matrix Gram points）"，计算特征多项式（characteristic polynomial）在这些点上的 2k 阶矩，并与在整个单位圆上的平均作比较；附录中改造 Conrey–Farmer–Keating–Rubinstein–Snaith 的启发式方法（heuristic recipe）以猜想 zeta 在 Gram 点上的矩。

Result: 对任意固定正整数 k，特征多项式在随机矩阵 Gram 点上的 2k 阶矩大于其在整圆上的 2k 阶矩；当 N 较大时，两者的主导渐近项（leading-order asymptotic term）量级相同，但前者所有低阶项（lower-order terms）都更大。

Conclusion: 结果正面回答了 Hall 的问题，支持 zeta 在 Gram 点上偏大的预期；附录表明按改造后的启发式配方所计算的第二、四阶矩与已有严格证明的结果一致，验证了该配方的可靠性。

Abstract: We evaluate the characteristic polynomial of a random unitary matrix at the points on the unit circle where the polynomial takes real values. In analogy to the Riemann zeta function we call these the ``random matrix Gram points''. On the random matrix side we answer in the affirmative a question of Richard Hall, who expected that zeta on the Gram points should be larger than typical. We prove that for any fixed positive $k$, the $2k$th moment of the characteristic polynomial averaged over the random matrix Gram points is larger than the $2k$th moment of the characteristic polynomial averaged over the whole unit circle. For large $N$ the leading-order asymptotic term is the same size, but all lower-order terms are larger. In an appendix we show how to adapt the heuristic recipe of Conrey--Farmer--Keating--Rubinstein--Snaith to conjecture moments of zeta at Gram points, and show by example that the second and fourth moments calculated by following the recipe agree with previously proven results.

</details>

### [149] [Single-Temperature Ranked Greedy Cluster Exchange for Max-Cut on Two-Dimensional Tori](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40515)
*Hao Geng,Nan Su,Gabriele Cavallaro*

Main category: math.OC

TL;DR: 提出单温度排序贪心簇交换方法（single-temperature RGCX），通过副本间协作加速二维环面伊辛自旋玻璃（Ising spin glass）基态搜索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 二维环面伊辛自旋玻璃（等价于零场环面最大割（Max-Cut）问题）存在崎岖能垒（rugged energy barriers），使局部更新启发式难以在规模上快速可靠地收敛到基态，现有单自旋翻转/簇移动结合温度阶梯或退火的方法即使调参也难以兼顾速度与可靠性。

Method: 引入排序贪心簇交换（ranked greedy cluster exchange, RGCX），并与固定温度 Metropolis 扫描结合构成单温度 RGCX。副本按割值（cut）排序以确定配对处理顺序；每对副本确定性地交换所有能提升较优副本割值的不一致簇（disagreement cluster），保留补集并守恒该对的割值总和。

Result: 在 20,000 自旋的 Gset 实例 G81 上，8 核桌面计算机达到认证最优解且成功概率 99% 的估计运行时间（TTS99）为 12.1 秒；在相同种群规模、交换间隔与温度下，于全部 17 个环面 Gset 图上达到已知最佳割值，其中 9 个为认证最优。

Conclusion: 单温度 RGCX 作为一种高效的种群型（population-based）方法，将排序贪心簇交换与固定温度 Metropolis 动力学结合，推进了大规模二维环面上的基态搜索。

Abstract: Ground-state search in two-dimensional Ising spin glasses on large toroidal lattices remains challenging for local-update heuristics because rugged energy barriers impede relaxation across metastable states. Equivalent to zero-field toroidal Max-Cut problems, these spin-glass instances also serve as standard benchmarks for optimization heuristics. Many Monte Carlo approaches combine single-spin flips or cluster moves with temperature ladders or annealing schedules, yet even with tuned parameters, rarely achieve rapid, reliable ground-state convergence at scale. Here, we address the need for faster ground-state search through cooperation between replicas. We introduce ranked greedy cluster exchange (RGCX) and combine it with fixed-temperature Metropolis sweeps to form single-temperature RGCX. Replicas are ranked by cut to determine the pair-processing order. Each pair deterministically exchanges every disagreement cluster that raises the better replica's cut, retaining the complement and conserving the pair's summed cut. On the 20,000-spin Gset instance G81, the estimated runtime to reach the certified optimum with 99% success probability (TTS99) was 12.1 s on an 8-core desktop computer. With the same population size, exchange interval and temperature, the method reached the best known cuts on all 17 toroidal Gset graphs, including 9 certified optima. These findings advance ground-state search on large two-dimensional tori by establishing single-temperature RGCX as an efficient population-based method that combines ranked greedy cluster exchange with fixed-temperature Metropolis dynamics.

</details>

### [150] [High-Performance Nuclear Demagnetization Refrigerator Reaching 50 $μ$K](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38622)
*Zhengchao Liu,Junyang Song,Bingbing Tong,Hiroki Ikegami*

Main category: cond-mat.other

TL;DR: 该研究报告了一套核绝热去磁（nuclear demagnetization）系统的设计与性能，基于配备中型铜核级的标准湿式稀释制冷机（wet dilution refrigerator），可将温度降至50 μK级并实现100 μK长时间维持，为深亚毫开尔文（deep sub-mK）区间的广泛实验提供实用平台。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子技术与量子材料的快速发展使约0.1 mK的深亚毫开尔文区间凝聚态物理研究具有新机遇，因此需要能高效、便捷进入该温区的制冷实验平台。

Method: 采用标准湿式稀释制冷机配合中型铜核级构建核绝热去磁系统，并以Pt NMR温度计（Pt NMR thermometer）测温；同时通过数值分析（numerical analyses）评估铜核自旋系统降温与漏热的影响。

Result: Pt NMR温度计测得温度达50 μK，制冷机可在100 μK维持十余天；即使仅预冷（precooling）12小时，也能进入深亚毫开尔文区间并将100 μK维持三天以上，足以完成样品测量。数值分析显示铜核自旋系统冷却至约18 μK，而温度计处的局部漏热（local heat leak）将其读数限制在约50 μK。

Conclusion: 该系统的性能表明其可作为深亚毫开尔文区间高效实验的实用平台，且短预冷时间下的可用性增强了其操作便利性。

Abstract: Research in the deep sub-mK regime around 0.1 mK may open new opportunities in condensed matter physics in light of recent rapid progress in quantum technologies and quantum materials. Here, we report the design and performance of a nuclear demagnetization system that provides efficient access to the deep sub-mK regime for a wide range of experiments, using a standard wet dilution refrigerator with a medium-sized copper nuclear stage. We show that the temperature measured by a Pt NMR thermometer reaches 50 $μ$K and that the refrigerator can maintain 100 $μ$K for more than ten days. Remarkably, even with only 12 hours of precooling, the refrigerator cools into the deep sub-mK regime and can maintain 100 $μ$K for more than three days, providing sufficient time for sample measurements. Numerical analyses indicate that the copper nuclear-spin system is cooled to about 18 $μ$K, whereas a local heat leak to the thermometer limits the thermometer temperature to about 50 $μ$K. These features establish the system as a practical platform for efficient experiments in the deep sub-mK regime.

</details>


### [151] [Quantum Hamiltonian time crystals from covariant quantum Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert relaxation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39886)
*Antti J. Niemi*

Main category: cond-mat.other

TL;DR: 该工作提出经典哈密顿时间晶体（Hamiltonian time crystal）的量子对应物：在固定谱与固定电荷期望值的密度矩阵集合上最小化能量，并借助对称性协变的量子 Landau–Lifshitz–Gilbert 方程使其成为周期吸引子。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典哈密顿时间晶体被定义为沿对称性轨道以拉格朗日乘子（Lagrange multipliers）设定频率运动的受约束能量极小态，但其量子版本尚待构造，本文旨在建立这一对应框架。

Method: 在密度矩阵（density matrix）上施加固定谱（fixed spectrum）与固定电荷期望值两类约束后最小化能量；并引入对称性协变的量子 Landau–Lifshitz–Gilbert 方程，使这些受约束极小态成为周期吸引子（periodic attractors），从而在动态中保持谱不变并确定乘子。

Result: 对称性协变的量子 Landau–Lifshitz–Gilbert 方程会将受约束的能量极小密度矩阵选为周期吸引子，在演化中保持谱不变并动态固定拉格朗日乘子；由 Cu$_3$ 分子磁体（molecular magnets）启发的对称破缺自旋三聚体（chiral spin trimer）在特定制备磁化强度下可实现该运动，且无需塞曼项（Zeeman term）。

Conclusion: 该构造给出了经典哈密顿时间晶体的量子类比，并表明无需外磁场即可在分子磁体式三聚体平台上实现量子时间晶体式周期运动，为实验候选体系提供依据。

Abstract: Classical Hamiltonian time crystals are constrained energy minima that move along symmetry orbits at frequencies set by Lagrange multipliers. We construct quantum counterparts by minimizing the energy over density matrices with fixed spectrum and charge expectations. A symmetry-covariant quantum Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert equation selects them as periodic attractors, preserving the spectrum and fixing the multipliers dynamically. A chiral spin trimer motivated by Cu$_3$ molecular magnets realizes this motion at a prepared magnetization, without a Zeeman term.

</details>


### [152] [Quantum Metric Scaling and Its Exceptions in Classical Flat Bands](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40066)
*Kin Hung Fung,K. T. Law,C. T. Chan*

Main category: cond-mat.other

TL;DR: 本文在一维经典平带（flat band）局域共振质量-弹簧系统（locally resonant mass–spring system）中检验“量子几何度规长度（quantum metric length）”作为局域化长度尺度的普适性，发现其仅在平带附近成立，而在精确平带频率处及存在选择性质量无序（selective mass disorder）时出现偏离该标度关系的例外。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子度规长度被提出作为一维平带中的局域化长度尺度，但其适用边界与失效情形尚不明确；作者希望澄清该标度关系的成立范围及例外。

Method: 构建由局域共振质量-弹簧系统实现的经典平带模型，考察局域化长度与量子度规长度的比例关系，并引入选择性质量无序（selective mass disorder）检验其对局域化尺度的影响。

Result: 局域化长度在平带附近遵循量子度规长度的标度，但在精确平带频率处偏离正比关系；选择性质量无序可在不改变纯净体系度规的情况下，于平带频率附近产生发散的局域化长度或任意短的衰减尾（arbitrarily short tails）。

Conclusion: 量子度规长度并非唯一的局域化尺度决定因素；无序（disorder）可诱导超出量子度规单独预测的局域化尺度。

Abstract: The quantum metric length has been proposed as the localization length scale in one-dimensional flat bands. Here, we study this quantum metric scaling and the exceptions to it in a classical flat band formed by a locally resonant mass--spring system. We find that the localization length follows the quantum metric length near the flat band but departs from this proportionality at the exact flat-band frequency. Selective mass disorder also produces divergent localization lengths or arbitrarily short tails near the flat-band frequency without changing the clean metric. These exceptions show that disorder can select localization scales beyond those predicted by the quantum metric alone.

</details>

### [153] [An Integral Equation for the Surface Current in the Problem of the Natural Modes of a Waveguide Containing a Resistive Film](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37907)
*I. M. Braver,Kh. L. Garb,P. Sh. Fridberg*

Main category: physics.class-ph

TL;DR: 该文研究含电阻膜（resistive film）波导（waveguide）的本征模（eigenmode）问题，建立膜表面电流（surface current）的积分方程（integral equation），给出核（kernel）的计算方法，并对矩形与圆形波导导出核的显式表达式（explicit expression）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 论文关注带电阻膜的波导本征模求解，需要处理膜上表面电流与场之间的耦合；为便于求解，须建立相应的积分方程并获得可用的核表达式。

Method: 针对膜上表面电流建立积分方程（integral equation），描述核（kernel）的评估方法，并分别对矩形波导（rectangular waveguide）与圆形波导（circular waveguide）推导核的显式表达式。

Result: 给出核的评估方法，并得到矩形与圆形波导情形下核的显式表达式（explicit expression）。

Conclusion: 所建立的表面电流积分方程及矩形、圆形波导的显式核表达式，为含电阻膜波导本征模问题的求解提供了分析基础。

Abstract: This paper considers the eigenmode problem for a waveguide with a resistive film. An integral equation for the surface current on the film is formulated. A method for evaluating the kernel is described, and an explicit expression for the kernel is derived for rectangular and circular waveguides.

</details>
