### [154] [Meta-Altermagnetism and Enhanced Spin-Splitting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37754)
*Bogeng Wen,Hae-Young Kee*

Main category: cond-mat.str-el

TL;DR: 该文提出并研究“元交错磁性（meta-altermagnetism）”，即在二维体系中，由磁序-induced能带重构（band reconstruction）驱动自旋劈裂范霍夫奇点（van Hove singularities, vHSs）跨越费米面，从而产生的一阶（不连续）磁性转变；该转变可形成交错磁中间区间并显著增强自旋劈裂器电导（spin-splitter conductivity）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交错磁体（altermagnets）具有零净磁化与自旋劈裂能带，但其磁性是否会表现出类似亚稳态（metamagnetic）的不连续跳变尚未被探讨；作者希望检验这种“元交错磁”是否存在，并寻找增强自旋劈裂器效应（spin-splitter effect）的机制。

Method: 采用平均场理论（mean-field theory）研究两子格方形晶格（two-sublattice square lattice）上的扩展 t-J 模型（extended t-J model），并在模型中引入各向异性跃迁积分（anisotropic hopping integral）。

Result: 发现一阶元交错磁转变会产生一个中间交错磁区间（intermediate altermagnetic regime）：其交错磁化（staggered magnetization）降低，但磁八极矩（magnetic octupole）与时间反演奇的自旋劈裂器电导（time-reversal-odd spin-splitter conductivity）显著增强；随化学势（chemical potential）与各向异性跃迁强度变化，一阶转变线终止于量子临界端点（quantum critical endpoint），形成丰富的相图（phase diagram）。

Conclusion: 自旋劈裂范霍夫奇点（spin-split vHSs）被识别为增强自旋劈裂器效应的一条途径，可用于自旋电子学（spintronics）应用。

Abstract: Altermagnets are collinear magnets with zero net magnetization and spin-split electronic bands. Here, we explore whether altermagnetism can exhibit a discontinuous jump, a phenomenon we refer to as meta-altermagnetism. We show that meta-altermagnetism can emerge in 2D systems when magnetic-order-induced band reconstruction drives spin-split van Hove singularities (vHSs) across the Fermi level. Using mean-field theory for an extended $t$-$J$ model on a two-sublattice square lattice including anisotropic hopping integral, we find that a first-order meta-altermagnetic transition produces an intermediate altermagnetic regime with reduced staggered magnetization but strongly enhanced magnetic octupole and time-reversal-odd spin-splitter conductivity. We further show that the first-order transition line terminates at a quantum critical endpoint, giving rise to a rich phase diagram as the chemical potential and anisotropic hopping strength are varied. Our results identify the spin split vHSs as a route to enhancing spin-splitter effect for spintronic applications.

</details>


### [155] [Field theory of competing phases in the interacting Kitaev chain](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37761)
*Pradip Kattel,Thierry Giamarchi*

Main category: cond-mat.str-el

TL;DR: 本文结合玻色化（bosonization）与密度矩阵重整化群（DMRG），给出有限密度下相互作用 Kitaev 链（interacting Kitaev chain）的连续场论描述，并厘清拓扑超导、公度电荷序与不可公度 Luttinger 液体之间的相图与临界性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有研究多集中于可精确求解的格点极限，对偏离这些极限、且掺杂（doping）非微扰地改变超导配对与公度电荷序竞争的常规有限密度区域缺乏解析刻画。

Method: 采用玻色化与密度矩阵重整化群（density-matrix renormalization-group, DMRG）相结合的方法，在偏离精确可解格点极限处构建连续场论描述；并在半经典层面及自由费米子边界理论中分析边界激发，同时构造对偶的连续费米子表示。

Result: 相图包含拓扑超导（topological superconducting）相与公度电荷密度波 Mott 相之间的中间不可公度 Luttinger 液体（incommensurate Luttinger liquid），以及大化学势下的平庸能带绝缘区；公度—不可公度与不可公度—拓扑超导边界分别由 Pokrovsky–Talapov 与 Berezinskii–Kosterlitz–Thouless 临界性支配，拓扑相在界面处支持指数局域 Majorana 边缘模（Majorana edge modes）。

Conclusion: 结果提供了一维相互作用拓扑超导体的解析描述，涵盖拓扑与公度性竞争、相应量子临界性，以及拓扑相的对偶对称破缺（symmetry breaking）表述，即不同费米子表示间 SPT–SSB 对应的连续版本。

Abstract: We study the interacting Kitaev chain with nearest-neighbor interactions and finite chemical potential using a combination of bosonization and density-matrix renormalization-group calculations. Focusing away from special exactly solvable lattice limits, we develop a continuum field-theoretic description of the generic finite-density interacting regime, where doping nonperturbatively modifies the competition between superconducting pairing and commensurate charge ordering. We show that the phase diagram consists of an intermediate incommensurate Luttinger liquid between the topological superconducting and commensurate charge-density-wave Mott phases, as well as a trivial band-insulating regime at large chemical potential. The commensurate--incommensurate and incommensurate--topological-superconducting phase boundaries are governed by Pokrovsky--Talapov and Berezinskii--Kosterlitz--Thouless criticality, respectively. We analyze the interacting topological superconducting regime and its boundary excitations. At the semiclassical level, and explicitly in the free-fermion boundary theory, the topological phase supports exponentially localized Majorana edge modes at interfaces between topological and trivial regions. We also construct a dual continuum fermionic representation in which this topological bulk sector is described instead by conventional symmetry breaking. This gives a continuum version of the SPT--SSB correspondence between different fermionic representations. Overall, our results provide an analytical description of one-dimensional interacting topological superconductors, from the competition between topology and commensurability and the resulting quantum criticality to the dual symmetry-breaking description of the topological phase.

</details>


### [156] [Long-Range Toric Code: Finite-Temperature Topological Order in Two Dimensions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37765)
*Jacopo Gliozzi,Taylor L. Hughes,Kyung-Su Kim*

Main category: cond-mat.str-el

TL;DR: 该论文提出在二维环面码（toric code）中加入长程环相互作用（long-range loop interactions）的模型，在保持原有拓扑有序基态的同时于零温禁闭任意子（anyon），并在足够长程时实现有限温拓扑序（finite-temperature topological order）与自纠错量子存储器（self-correcting quantum memory）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 普通环面码的拓扑序在有限温度下易被任意子激发破坏，难以作为自纠错量子存储器，因此需要探索能抑制任意子自由移动、维持有限温拓扑序的机制。

Method: 构建带额外长程环相互作用的二维环面码模型，分析其在零温与有限温下对任意子的禁闭效应，并按相互作用程长（长程与较短程）分情形讨论。

Result: 模型保持原环面码的拓扑有序基态并在零温禁闭任意子；相互作用足够长程时，禁闭在有限温下持续存在，显著限制任意子迁移率并产生有限温拓扑序，该相具备自纠错量子存储与长程纠缠（long-range entanglement）；相互作用较短程时，拓扑序迹象仅在指数大的长度尺度内于有限温下存活，形成部分自纠错量子存储器（partially self-correcting quantum memory）。

Conclusion: 长程环相互作用可在有限温度下稳定二维拓扑序，为自纠错量子存储器提供可行路径；其性能依赖相互作用程长，较短程时仅能实现部分自纠错。

Abstract: We introduce two-dimensional toric code models with additional long-range loop interactions. Our models preserve the topologically ordered ground states of the ordinary toric code, while confining anyons at zero temperature. For sufficiently long-ranged interactions, we argue that this confinement persists at finite temperatures, strongly constraining anyon mobility and giving rise to finite-temperature topological order. This topological phase acts as a self-correcting quantum memory and exhibits long-range entanglement. For shorter-ranged interactions, signatures of topological order survive only up to an exponentially large length scale at finite temperature, yielding a partially self-correcting quantum memory.

</details>


### [157] [Spin Space Symmetry Without Spin Space Groups](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37770)
*Jeffrey G. Rau*

Main category: cond-mat.str-el

TL;DR: 提出直接用自旋空间群（spin space group）的实表示（real representation）替代群构造来分类磁结构对称性约束，将磁补偿、压磁、输运、Edelstein效应及动量空间自旋纹理等响应判据统一化为空间群表示论问题，并归结为定义表示的外幂（exterior power）与点群多极表示之间的重叠条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自旋空间群已成为组织磁相及其物理性质的有用语言，但逐个构造和识别群本身较为繁琐。作者希望直接以给定母空间群在自旋空间中的实表示作为出发点，从而在避免显式构造群的同时，简化和系统地组织对称性对允许响应的约束。

Method: 以自旋空间群对应的实表示为核心工具，将各类物理响应的存在性判定转化为空间群表示论中的标准问题：通过计算定义表示的三次外幂（exterior powers）与点群多极表示（multipole representations）的重叠来判断响应是否允许，并从外幂的波矢含量（wave-vector content）导出选择定则（selection rules）层级。

Result: 磁补偿、压磁（piezomagnetism）、自旋与电荷输运、Edelstein效应及动量空间自旋纹理的判据均化为定义表示上的重叠条件；物理上不同的响应可约化为同一条件（如p波自旋纹理与时间偶Edelstein效应，压磁与补偿序中的d波自旋纹理）。外幂的波矢含量给出进一步层级：均匀响应要求一、二或三个序波矢（ordering wave vectors）之和为倒格矢，该规则可在考虑点群对称性之前排除大量响应。

Conclusion: 该方法以广泛材料中共线（collinear）、共面（coplanar）和非共面（non-coplanar）磁序为例作了说明，并讨论了向磁空间群（magnetic space group）的推广、与共线序Landau理论的联系，以及奇宇称磁体（odd-parity magnets）的表征。

Abstract: Spin space groups provide a complete symmetry classification of magnetic structures in the non-relativistic limit and have become an increasingly useful language for organizing magnetic phases and their physical properties. Each spin space group with a given parent space group is specified, up to spin-only symmetries, by a real representation of that space group acting in spin space. We argue that working directly with this representation not only avoids the construction and identification of the group, but also organizes and simplifies the resulting symmetry constraints on allowed responses. Determining the presence or absence of magnetic compensation, piezomagnetism, spin and charge transport, the Edelstein effect, and momentum-space spin textures becomes an ordinary problem in the representation theory of space groups. The resulting conditions reduce to overlaps between the three exterior powers of the defining representation and multipole representations of the point group. Several physically distinct responses then reduce to the same condition on the defining representation. For example, a $p$-wave spin texture and the time-even Edelstein effect are allowed under the same condition, as are piezomagnetism and a $d$-wave spin texture in compensated order. The wave-vector content of the exterior powers gives a further hierarchy of selection rules: depending on the relevant power, a uniform response requires one, two, or three ordering wave vectors to sum to a reciprocal lattice vector. These rules can exclude many responses before point-group symmetry is considered. We illustrate the approach with examples drawn from a wide variety of materials hosting collinear, coplanar and non-coplanar magnetic order. Finally, we discuss extensions of these results to magnetic space groups, connections to Landau theories of collinear order, and the characterization of odd-parity magnets.

</details>


### [158] [Evidence for a charged vortex lattice in an exciton superfluid](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37781)
*Ryan L. Lee,Jungwoo Lee,Viliam Vaňo,Bo Zou,Cheng-Li Chiu,Kenji Watanabe,Takashi Taniguchi,Allan MacDonald,Ali Yazdani*

Main category: cond-mat.str-el

TL;DR: 该工作在双层石墨烯激子凝聚体中，利用扫描隧道显微镜成像带电涡旋，首次报道了强磁场下由分数电荷涡旋核相互排斥所稳定的涡旋-反涡旋晶格的实验证据，其周期与总过量电荷的标度关系与理论预测定量一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量化涡旋晶格是旋转超流体与第二类超导体（type-II superconductor）的标志性特征，但激子（exciton）由电中性电子-空穴对构成，在激子超流体中实现类似涡旋晶格长期存在困难。近期理论预测，强磁场下弱带电激子超流体可凭借分数电荷涡旋核间的相互排斥稳定出涡旋-反涡旋晶格，该预测尚缺实验验证。

Method: 在垂直磁场中，以薄六方氮化硼（hexagonal boron nitride）势垒隔开的两层石墨烯的朗道能级（Landau level）之间形成激子凝聚体，并采用扫描隧道显微镜（scanning tunnelling microscope）对其带电涡旋进行实空间成像。

Result: 观测到所预测的涡旋晶格；晶格周期随总过量电荷（total excess charge）变化，且对其在两层间的分配不敏感，与理论预测定量吻合。

Conclusion: 该结果为激子超流体系统中的相位相干（phase coherence）提供了实验证据，并验证了弱带电激子超流体中涡旋-反涡旋晶格的理论预言。

Abstract: Lattices of quantized vortices are a defining property of rotating superfluids and of type-II superconductors in magnetic fields. Realizing an analogous vortex lattice in an exciton superfluid-formed from bound electron-hole pairs-has remained challenging because excitons are electrically neutral. Building on previous theoretical studies of the low-energy excitations in an exciton superfluid, recent theory has predicted that in a strong magnetic field, a weakly charged exciton superfluid can stabilize a vortex-antivortex lattice arising from the mutual repulsion of fractionally charged vortex cores. Here we report evidence for this predicted vortex lattice in a bilayer exciton condensate by imaging its charged vortices with the scanning tunnelling microscope. The condensate forms between Landau levels of two graphene layers separated by a thin hexagonal boron nitride barrier in a perpendicular magnetic field. We find that the vortex lattice periodicity scales with the total excess charge and is insensitive to its distribution between the two layers, in quantitative agreement with theoretical predictions. Our observations provide evidence for phase coherence in an exciton superfluid system.

</details>


### [159] [From a Lifshitz Transition to Spin-Density-Wave Order: Sr$_2$RuO$_4$ under Uniaxial Strain](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38025)
*Evgeny A. Stepanov,Sophie Beck,Maria Chatzieleftheriou,Antoine Georges*

Main category: cond-mat.str-el

TL;DR: 在先进的多体理论框架下研究单轴应变对Sr$_2$RuO$_4$谱学与磁性质的影响，发现应变诱导各向异性Lifshitz转变，并据此捕捉大应变下的磁不稳定性，其磁响应由两个竞争波矢主导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近年实验显示单轴应变显著提升Sr$_2$RuO$_4$的超导临界温度，并伴随涌现磁有序态的迹象，但缺乏统一的理论解释，故需在理论层面考察应变对谱学与磁性质的影响。

Method: 采用先进的多体理论框架（many-body theoretical framework），在考虑应变诱导的各向异性行为基础上，计算并分析该材料的谱学与磁响应性质。

Result: 应变诱导各向异性Lifshitz转变（anisotropic Lifshitz transition）：沿拉伸方向的电子散射率（electron scattering rate）增强，而垂直方向呈现相干费米液体行为（Fermi-liquid behavior），与实验观测高度一致；计入该各向异性后可捕捉大应变下有限温磁有序态的出现。

Conclusion: 磁响应由两个竞争波矢（wave vectors）主导，分别对应γ片内嵌套矢量与α-β片间嵌套矢量，二者均可稳定磁序，其竞争敏感依赖于相应费米面片（Fermi surface sheets）的相干性。

Abstract: In recent years, the effects of uniaxial strain on Sr$_2$RuO$_4$ have been extensively investigated, revealing a pronounced enhancement of the superconducting critical temperature accompanied by experimental indications of an emergent magnetically ordered state. In this Letter, we study the impact of strain on the spectral and magnetic properties of this material within an advanced many-body theoretical framework. We find that strain induces an anisotropic Lifshitz transition, which enhances the electron scattering rate along the elongation axis while simultaneously promoting coherent Fermi-liquid behavior in the perpendicular direction, in close agreement with experimental observations. Taking into account this anisotropic behavior allows us to capture the magnetic instability leading to a finite-temperature ordered state at large strain values. Our analysis further reveals that the magnetic response is dominated by two competing wave vectors associated with distinct nesting vectors: one within the $γ$ sheet and the other between the $α$ and $β$ sheets of the Fermi surface. Both wave vectors can stabilize magnetic order, with their competition depending sensitively on the coherence of the respective Fermi surface sheets.

</details>


### [160] [Level ordering in the linear $E \otimes e$ dynamic Jahn-Teller model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38190)
*Naoya Iwahara*

Main category: cond-mat.str-el

TL;DR: 本文证明了线性 E⊗e 动态 Jahn-Teller 模型中，对任意耦合强度，固定振动角动量 j 子空间内各能级随 |j| 单调递增，故基态恒为 j=±1/2 双重态，并给出能隙的显式下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性 E⊗e 动态 Jahn-Teller 模型的基态长期被认为是对称的双重态（doublet），振动角动量（vibronic angular momentum）j=±1/2，但此前缺乏对任意耦合强度的严格证明。

Method: 构造一个使 j 降低 1 的幺正变换（unitary transformation），并结合变分原理（variational principle）完成严格证明。

Result: 证明了对每个能级序号 n，固定 j 子空间的第 n 个能级 E_{nj} 随 |j| 严格递增：E_{n,1/2} < E_{n,3/2} < E_{n,5/2} < …，故基态总为 j=±1/2 双重态；另给出能隙 E_{0,j+1} − E_{0j} 的显式下界。

Conclusion: 该结论对任意耦合强度成立，将此前关于基态性质的认识提升为严格定理，证明方法简洁，且提供的能隙下界具有定量价值。

Abstract: The ground level of the linear $E\otimes e$ dynamic Jahn-Teller model has long been believed to be the doublet with vibronic angular momentum $j = \pm\tfrac12$. We prove that, for arbitrary coupling strength, the $n$th level $E_{nj}$ in the subspace of fixed $j$ strictly increases with $|j|$ for every $n$, $E_{n,1/2} < E_{n,3/2} < E_{n,5/2} < \cdots$; in particular, the ground level is always the $j = \pm\tfrac12$ doublet. The proof uses only a unitary transformation that lowers $j$ by one, combined with the variational principle. We also give an explicit lower bound on the gap $E_{0,j+1} - E_{0j}$.

</details>


### [161] [Gravitational anomaly spectroscopy of a Kitaev spin liquid](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38704)
*Kumar Ghosh*

Main category: cond-mat.str-el

TL;DR: No AI summary available.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: No AI summary available.

Method: No AI summary available.

Result: No AI summary available.

Conclusion: No AI summary available.

Abstract: The chiral central charge $c$ measures the gravitational anomaly of a two-dimensional topological phase. It fixes the heat current carried along the edge. So far, it has been accessed through thermal transport, where phonons complicate the signal, or through wave-function probes that need a pure ground state. Here we show that $c$ is a spectroscopic quantity of the edge. A weak modulation of the edge couplings that travel along the edge is absorbed according to the Virasoro algebra. Normalized by the response to a static change of the same couplings, the absorbed weights obey $D_n=2n\langle L_0\rangle+\frac{c}{12}(n^3-n)$, so that $\mathcal{C}\equiv2D_2-4D_1=c$ in any state of the ideal edge theory, thermal or not. The central charge thus appears in transition weights, although it cancels from excitation gaps. The ratio of line weights with and without a vison in the bulk, $Λ=4h_σ/c$, needs no calibration and fixes the conformal spin $h_σ$ of the non-Abelian Ising anyon. For the Kitaev honeycomb spin liquid we find $\mathcal{C}=0.49999$ and $h_σ=0.06250$ on 7168 spins. Calibrating with the shift of the measured line itself gives $c$ within about $1\%$ on 96 spins and within $1\%$ under $20\%$ random coupling errors. Interacting edge Majoranas in a fixed flux sector, treated with DMRG, keep $\mathcal{C}$ within $1.5\%$ while the edge velocity changes by $\pm13\%$. An exact simulation of a quantum-processor protocol, including the native Floquet circuit, returns $c$ within $3.5\%$ on 96 to 600 spins.

</details>


### [162] [Mixed-State Topological Transition and Emergent Fractionalized Supersymmetry in the Non-Abelian Kitaev Spin Liquid](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38741)
*Zhou-Quan Wan,Hong Yao,Shao-Kai Jian*

Main category: cond-mat.str-el

TL;DR: 本文研究非阿贝尔 Kitaev 自旋液体（non-Abelian Kitaev spin liquid）在键退相位通道（bond-dephasing channel）驱动下的混合态拓扑相变（mixed-state topological transition）。退相位使 Choi 态中从 Ising⊠Isinḡ 序转变为环面码序（toric-code order），并在时间界面上诱导出携带 N=1 超对称的无能隙 Majorana 模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 论文旨在理解退相干如何驱动拓扑物态的混合态相变，并探索此类相变中可能涌现的临界性质与超对称（supersymmetry）。时间界面处 Chern 数失配导致的 Majorana 模提供了一个具体平台。

Method: 采用向量化图像（vectorized picture），将键退相位映射为两个时间反演的分裂 Majorana 系统与带隙 Z2 规范场（Z2 gauge fields）的相互作用，从而实现无符号问题蒙特卡洛（sign-problem-free Monte Carlo）模拟。

Result: 增大退相位会凝聚跨副本（inter-copy）费米子对，在 Choi 态中把 Ising⊠Isinḡ 转化为环面码序；展开（unfolding）后得到内禀混合态拓扑序。时间界面处 Chern 数失配强制产生无能隙 Majorana 模，退相位驱动的相变使其涌现 N=1 超对称，模拟给出 ν=1.27(3)、η_b≃η_f≃0.40，与精确值 5/4 和 2/5 相符。

Conclusion: 结果表明退相位可诱导内禀混合态拓扑序与超对称临界点；超对称伙伴是分裂的，并表现为可区分的规范不变自旋弦（gauge-invariant spin strings），为未来实验提供具体观测量。

Abstract: We study a mixed-state topological transition in the non-Abelian Kitaev spin liquid driven by a bond-dephasing channel. In the vectorized picture, bond dephasing maps onto interactions between two time-reversed fractionalized Majorana systems coupled to gapped $\mathbb Z_2$ gauge fields, enabling sign-problem-free Monte Carlo simulations. We show that increasing dephasing condenses an inter-copy fermion pair, converting ${\rm Ising}\boxtimes\overline{\rm{Ising}}$ to toric-code order in the Choi state and yielding intrinsically mixed-state topological order upon unfolding. More interestingly, at a temporal interface between topological and trivial Kitaev states, a Chern-number mismatch enforces a gapless Majorana mode. Dephasing then drives a mixed-state topological transition at which the gapless mode develops emergent $\mathcal N=1$ supersymmetry. Our Monte Carlo simulations yield $ν=1.27(3)$ and $η_b\simeqη_f\simeq0.40$, consistent with the exact supersymmetric values $5/4$ and $2/5$. The supersymmetric partners are fractionalized and appear physically as distinct gauge-invariant spin strings, providing concrete observables for future experiments.

</details>


### [163] [Topological Quantum Spin Liquids in a Ladder with Majorana fermions and p-wave Superconductivity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40297)
*Magali Korolev,Fan Yang,Erik S. Sørensen,Karyn Le Hur*

Main category: cond-mat.str-el

TL;DR: 本文通过将二维 Kitaev 蜂窝自旋模型（Kitaev honeycomb spin model）推广至条带（ribbon）几何，构造了一个可精确求解的梯子系统，用于研究整个相图内仅具短程自旋关联的拓扑量子自旋液体（topological quantum spin liquid）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旨在探讨梯子系统中是否存在整个相图内自旋关联均为短程的拓扑量子自旋液体，并为方形晶格上的拓扑量子自旋模型（如含 π 通量者）寻找可解方案。

Method: 采用可精确求解模型，基态中由 Majorana 费米子静态地产生 Z₂ 规范场（Z₂ gauge field）并形成 0 或 π 通量（flux）；结合量子场论（quantum field theory）视角、数学方法与密度矩阵重整化群（Density Matrix Renormalization Group, DMRG）结果，借助可观测量对相图进行几何、拓扑与物理分类。

Result: 相图包含三个带自旋能隙（spin gap）的自旋液体相与一个 Majorana 费米子意义下的金属相；提出体-边对应（bulk-edge correspondence），在能隙相中于边缘给出受保护的零能 Majorana 费米子，并在拓扑液相中揭示体内存在巡回 Majorana 费米子（itinerant Majorana fermion）。

Conclusion: 该方法可区分砖墙梯（brickwall ladder）所对应的特殊线与其允许无能隙 Majorana 液相的方形梯（square ladder）性质，为方形晶格上含 π 通量的拓扑量子自旋模型求解提供希望，并与拓扑超导（topological superconductivity）模型建立对应关系。

Abstract: In this article, we address the possibility of topological quantum spin liquids with only short-range (spin) correlations in the whole phase diagram in a ladder system, through an exactly solvable model which represents a generalization of the two-dimensional Kitaev honeycomb spin model to a ribbon geometry. This system gives rise to $\mathbb{Z}_2$ gauge fields emerging in a static way in the ground state through Majorana fermions which then produce either $0$ or $π$ flux. Through a quantum field theory perspective, mathematical and Density Matrix Renormalization Group results, we present our progress on the geometrical, topological and physical classification of this model through observables navigating on the whole phase diagram presenting three spin-liquid phases with a spin gap and a metallic phase in the sense of Majorana fermions. We propose a bulk-edge correspondence revealing the presence of protected zero-energy Majorana fermions at the edge in the phases with a gap and revealing also the presence of itinerant Majorana fermions in the bulk in the topological liquid phase. The proposed approach allows us to distinguish between properties of the brickwall ladder giving rise to a special line and those of the square ladder allowing for the gapless Majorana liquid phase. This model gives some hope on finding solutions for topological quantum spin models, e.g. with $π$ flux, on a square lattice geometry. This approach also allows for a correspondence onto models of topological superconductivity.

</details>


### [164] [Magnetism in a homometallic square-planar Cu$({\mathrm{II})}$$_4$Cu$({\mathrm{II})}$ metallacrown](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38989)
*Luca Bischof,Ariyan Tavakoli,Sascha Pietruska,Lena Spillecke,Ina Heckelmann,Changhyun Koo,Luca M. Carrella,Eva Rentschler,Hans Christian Schneider,Rüdiger Klingeler*

Main category: cond-mat.str-el

TL;DR: 通过在salicylhydroxamate配体上引入大位阻取代基，抑制分子间磁相互作用，从而精确解析Cu₄Cu金属冠配合物的本征基态自旋结构与交换相互作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典同金属金属冠（metallacrown）Cu(II)[12-MC_Cu(II)N(Shi)-4]²⁻是研究交换耦合Cu(II)团簇磁性的优良平台，但分子间磁相互作用会干扰对其本征基态性质的深入探讨。

Method: 在salicylhydroxamate配体中引入大位阻取代基（sterically bulky substituents）获得修饰衍生物Cu₄Cu，并结合静态磁化测量、从头算破对称密度泛函理论（DFT）以及X波段与高频/高场电子顺磁共振（EPR）进行表征。

Result: 静态磁化给出中心—外围与环上相邻位点间的竞争性反铁磁交换J₁=-8.1(2) THz（-33.5(8) meV）、J₂=-4.40(12) THz（-18.2(5) meV），DFT结果与之吻合；体系在低温下呈S=1/2基态，EPR确定g_x=2.028、g_y=2.056、g_z=2.222，接近轴向各向异性；磁化数据还显示双重态—四重态能隙Δ_{1/2→3/2}=4.8(4) THz的热跃迁，并有激发态EPR信号佐证。

Conclusion: 大位阻配体修饰可有效屏蔽分子间相互作用，使Cu₄Cu的本征交换耦合与基态自旋结构得以定量确定：基态为S=1/2，其空态具d_xy特征，并存在双重态至四重态的热激活跃迁。

Abstract: The well-established homometallic metallacrown Cu(II)[12-MC$_\text{Cu(II)N(Shi)}$-4]$^{2-}$, comprising four square-planarly arranged Cu(II) ions surrounding a slightly off-plane central Cu(II) ion, provides an excellent platform for investigating magnetism in exchange-coupled Cu(II) clusters both by experimental and ab initio numerical methods. In the present work, sterically bulky substituents are introduced into the salicylhydroxamate ligand to obtain a modified derivative, Cu$({\mathrm{II})}$[12-MC$_\text{Cu$({\mathrm{II})}$N(L)}$-4]$^{2-}$ (Cu$_4$Cu), thereby effectively suppressing intermolecular magnetic interactions and enabling a detailed investigation of its intrinsic ground-state spin structure and exchange interactions. Static magnetization reveals competing antiferromagnetic exchange interactions of $J_1=-8.1(2)$ THz ($-33.5(8)$ meV) between the central and the peripheral sites and $J_2=-4.40(12)$ THz ($-18.2(5)$ meV) between neighboring sites on the ring of the metallacrown, which are corroborated by ab initio broken symmetry-based density functional theory (DFT). These couplings yield an $S=1/2$ ground state for Cu$_4$Cu at low temperatures, for which X-band and high-frequency/high-field electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) precisely determine the $g$-factors $g_x = 2.028$, $g_y = 2.056$, and $g_z = 2.222$ close to axial anisotropy and in agreement with our DFT results. The ground-state spin-configuration is characterized by $d_{xy}$-character of the unoccupied states. Furthermore, our magnetization data evidence thermal transitions across a doublet-to-quartet gap of $Δ_{1/2\rightarrow3/2} = 4.8(4)$ THz which is also indicated by the emergence of an excited-state EPR signal.

</details>


### [165] [Algebraic theory of abelian fractons and beyond](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40596)
*Wilbur Shirley,Evan Wickenden,Bowen Yang,Agnès Beaudry,Michael Hermele*

Main category: cond-mat.str-el

TL;DR: 本文为阿贝尔有能隙分形子序（fracton order）与拓扑相建立融合、迁移率和统计的代数学理论，以“编织融合复形（braided fusion complex, BFC）”及其等价类“编织融合理论（BFT）”统一刻画点状与延展激发，并将激发-探测原理与“非退化性”证明为等价。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有阿贝尔任意子（anyon）的代数学描述难以覆盖具有受限迁移率（restricted mobility）和空间延展激发的分形子体系，因此需要一个更一般的代数框架。

Method: 限定于平移不变玻色系统且点状与延展激发的融合阶有限，引入链复形结构的BFC（同时编码融合与迁移率）并附加编码统计的编织链映射；以其等价类定义BFT，并提炼出仅含点状激发时的“互统计（mutual statistics）”理论（融合模加至其对偶的映射）。

Result: 框架可涵盖任意平移不变Pauli码及二维所有阿贝尔任意子理论（含手征理论）；给出非退化BFT均可由某有能隙相实现且为相不变量的猜想证据；导出对点状融合与迁移率的约束，如X-cube与各向异性模型的Pauli X、Z扇区均不能单独出现在非退化BFT中；在唯一无穷空间基态假设下证明激发-探测原理等价于非退化性。

Conclusion: 该代数框架将任意子理论推广至分形子序，互统计理论在奇融合阶时与完整BFT等价，远程探测（remote detection）被解释为互统计向分形子序的推广，从而为分形子相的判别与不变量构造提供代数基础。

Abstract: We develop an algebraic theory of fusion, mobility, and statistics in abelian gapped fracton orders and topological phases. The framework generalizes the algebraic description of abelian anyons to systems with restricted-mobility and spatially extended excitations. We consider translation-invariant bosonic systems whose pointlike and extended excitations have finite fusion order. The basic objects are braided fusion complexes (BFCs): chain complexes encoding fusion and mobility, equipped with a braiding chain map encoding statistics. Their equivalence classes define braided fusion theories (BFTs). Our framework encompasses arbitrary translation-invariant Pauli codes, as well as all abelian anyon theories in two spatial dimensions, including chiral theories. We give evidence for the conjecture that every nondegenerate BFT can be realized as the excitation theory of a gapped phase and that the BFT describing such a phase is a phase invariant. We derive constraints on pointlike fusion and mobility, showing, for example, that neither the Pauli X nor Z sectors of the X-cube and anisotropic models can occur alone in a nondegenerate BFT. For nondegenerate theories with only pointlike excitations, we extract a simpler theory of mutual statistics, consisting of a fusion module and a map to its statistical dual. This theory of mutual statistics is an invariant of the BFT and, at odd fusion order, gives an equivalent description of the full braided fusion theory. We interpret remote detection as the generalization of mutual statistics to fracton orders. In the BFC setting, we give a precise formulation of the excitation-detector principle: every nontrivial excitation can be detected by an operator supported at spatial infinity, and every nontrivial detector detects some excitation. Assuming a unique infinite-space ground state, we prove that this principle is equivalent to nondegeneracy.

</details>


### [166] [Atomic Charge Chirality from Electric Multipoles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39150)
*Satoru Hayami,Rikuto Oiwa*

Main category: cond-mat.str-el

TL;DR: No AI summary available.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: No AI summary available.

Method: No AI summary available.

Result: No AI summary available.

Conclusion: No AI summary available.

Abstract: We establish an electric-multipole ($Q_{lm}$) criterion for chirality of local atomic charge distributions. For the 11 crystallographic chiral point groups, we identify representative lowest-rank multipole contents required to distinguish the opposite handednesses. For the axial groups $C_n$ and $D_n$ with $n=2,3,4,6$, chirality arises from the relative orientation of two azimuthal anisotropies with $m=n$, belonging to consecutive ranks $l=n$ and $n+1$. Their coexistence produces a latitude-dependent twist of the $n$-fold charge distribution. The polar component, although allowed in $C_n$, is distinct from this chiral mechanism and is not required for handedness. The cubic groups $T$ and $O$ exhibit distinct realizations, with octahedral chirality first appearing at rank nine. We further show that, within a spinless $s$-$p$-$d$-$f$ atomic basis, the scalar charge density contains multipoles only up to rank six and therefore cannot encode the handedness of $C_6$, $D_6$, or $O$. These results connect electric-multipole content and atomic orbital degrees of freedom to the microscopic encoding of crystallographic handedness.

</details>


### [167] [A Zoo of Fermionic Relative Rényi Negativities in the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39349)
*Linjing Jiang,Pengfei Zhang*

Main category: cond-mat.str-el

TL;DR: 该文提出相对Rényi负度（relative Rényi negativities）作为纠缠目击者（entanglement witnesses），通过将费米子部分时间反演（partial time reversal）与尺度超算子（size superoperator）关联，建立路径积分表示并借助大N展开（large-N expansion）在SYK模型及其推广的热态中计算，揭示了简单可观测量不可见的一阶纠缠转变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强关联费米子系统中的混合态纠缠（mixed-state entanglement）刻画困难：对数负度（logarithmic negativity）等诊断量在相互作用体系中计算代价高，精确对角化（exact diagonalization）仅限小系统；而传统Rényi代理量（如twisted与untwisted Rényi negativities）对可分态（separable states）也可能为正，缺乏判别力。

Method: 引入一族相对Rényi负度作为纠缠目击者；将费米子部分时间反演与尺度超算子相联系，导出这些量的路径积分（path-integral）表示；进而通过大N展开在SYK模型（Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev model）及其推广的热态中进行计算。

Result: 在原始SYK模型与Maldacena-Qi耦合SYK模型中研究了纠缠性质；识别出一类可充当对数负度合理代理的相对Rényi负度，并发现对简单可观测量不可见的一阶纠缠转变（first-order entanglement transitions）。

Conclusion: 相对Rényi负度可作为强关联费米子体系中混合态纠缠的有效探针，并提示存在一类新的转变，其中这些负度充当自由能（free energies）。

Abstract: Quantum entanglement is a fundamental resource that gives rise to correlations with no classical counterpart in strongly correlated fermionic systems. However, its characterization in mixed quantum states remains challenging. Established entanglement diagnostics, such as logarithmic negativity, are computationally demanding in interacting systems, and their evaluation by exact diagonalization is restricted to small system sizes. Meanwhile, conventional Rényi proxies, including twisted and untwisted Rényi negativities, can be positive even for separable states. In this work, we introduce a family of \textit{relative Rényi negativities} that serve as entanglement witnesses. By relating fermionic partial time reversal to the size superoperator, we establish a path-integral representation for these Rényi negativities, enabling their evaluation in thermal states of the Sachdev-Ye-Kitaev (SYK) model and its generalizations via a large-$N$ expansion. Applying this method, we investigate entanglement in both the original SYK model and the Maldacena-Qi coupled SYK model. We identify a special class of relative Rényi negativities which serve as plausible proxies for logarithmic negativity and uncover first-order entanglement transitions that are invisible to simple observables. These results highlight the utility of relative Rényi negativities as probes of mixed-state entanglement in strongly correlated fermionic systems and suggest the existence of a new class of transitions where these negativities serve as free energies.

</details>


### [168] [High-Field Heat Capacity of Atacamite Cu$_2$Cl(OH)$_3$ for $\mathbf{H} \parallel b$ axis: From Antiferromagnetic Order to Correlated Disorder](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39669)
*L. Stödter,A. Demuer,T. Kotte,A. U. B. Wolter,B. Büchner,K. C. Rule,S. Süllow*

Main category: cond-mat.str-el

TL;DR: 在高达35 T的磁场（沿b轴）下测量阻挫锯齿链（sawtooth-chain）化合物atacamite Cu$_2$Cl(OH)$_3$的比热，观察到从反铁磁长程有序（antiferromagnetic long-range order）向场致类自旋液体（spin-liquid-like）态的转变，并在32 T以上出现可被自旋能隙（spin gap）热激活行为描述的宽峰。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前针对H∥c轴的高场态已提出锯齿链解耦为基位与顶位两套自旋子系统、形成M∼M$_\mathrm{sat}$/2部分极化态（partially polarized state）的设想，本文旨在以H∥b轴的比热数据检验该图像是否具有普适性。

Method: 对atacamite单晶在H∥b、最高35 T磁场下进行比热（heat capacity）测量，追踪转变异常随磁场的移动与消失，并对高场低温区数据作指数型拟合以考察热激活（thermal activation）行为。

Result: 随磁场升高，标志反铁磁长程有序的尖锐转变异常向低温移动并最终消失，进入无转变异常的场致类自旋液体态；32 T以上出现随磁场升高而向高温移动的宽峰，低温比热呈指数行为，指示存在自旋能隙。

Conclusion: H∥b轴结果与H∥c轴的高场态图像一致，支持atacamite高场态中锯齿链解耦为基位与顶位自旋子系统、形成M∼M$_\mathrm{sat}$/2部分极化态的解释。

Abstract: We present the heat capacity of the frustrated sawtooth-chain compound atacamite Cu$_2$Cl(OH)$_3$ in high magnetic fields up to 35 T for $\mathbf{H} \parallel b$ axis. We clearly observe the change from antiferromagnetic long-range order, indicated by a sharp transition anomaly shifted to lower temperatures when increasing field, to a field-induced spin-liquid-like state with the absence of any transition anomaly. Here, in highest magnetic fields above 32 T a broad anomaly is present which is shifted to higher temperatures as the field is increased. The low-temperature heat capacity in the high-field region can be described well by an exponential behavior indicating a thermal activation over a spin gap. The findings are consistent with our scenario for the high-field state in atacamite for $\mathbf{H} \parallel c$ axis, where we proposed the sawtooth chains to decouple into two spin subsystems, basal and apical spin sites, leading to a partially polarized state with $M \sim M_\mathrm{sat}/2$.

</details>


### [169] [Phonon Fluctuations Enhanced Superconductivity in a Three-Band Cuprate Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39710)
*Jiarui Liu,Yao Wang*

Main category: cond-mat.str-el

TL;DR: 在三带铜氧化物模型（three-band cuprate model）中，$B_{1g}$ 氧屈曲声子（oxygen buckling mode）对 $d$-波超导（$d$-wave superconductivity）的作用取决于其处于绝热（adiabatic）还是反绝热（antiadiabatic）区间：前者通过破坏准粒子相干性（quasiparticle coherence）抑制配对，后者则增强相干性与配对顶点，从而强化超导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 铜氧化物高-$T_c$ 超导（high-$T_c$ superconductivity）的微观起源仍因多种交织序（intertwined orders）的相互作用而未有定论；实验与理论研究提示声子（phonons）可能发挥关键作用，其中 $B_{1g}$ 氧屈曲模式被视为有前景的候选，但其微观影响尚待厘清。

Method: 基于三带铜氧化物模型，考察 $B_{1g}$ 声子在给定温度下分别处于绝热与反绝热区间时对超导的作用，并分析其对准粒子相干性、$d$-波配对顶点（pairing vertex）及电子-空穴不对称性（electron-hole asymmetry）的影响。

Result: 热激发的绝热声子通过损失准粒子相干性抑制 $d$-波配对；反绝热声子则同时增强相干性与吸引性 $d$-波配对顶点，在多项诊断指标（multiple diagnostics）上强化超导，且该增强表现出显著的电子-空穴不对称性，源于掺杂载流子（doped carriers）不同的轨道特征（orbital characters）。

Conclusion: 研究确立了 $B_{1g}$ 声子与电子关联（electronic correlations）协同、显著增强铜氧化物中 $d$-波超导配对的微观机制。

Abstract: The microscopic origin of high-$T_c$ superconductivity in cuprates remains an outstanding puzzle due to the interplay of intertwined orders. Experimental observations and theoretical studies have suggested crucial roles of phonons, with the $B_{1g}$ oxygen buckling mode emerging as a promising candidate. Here, we investigate the microscopic influence of this phonon in a three-band cuprate model. We find that the $B_{1g}$ phonon plays opposite roles in superconductivity depending on whether it lies in the adiabatic or antiadiabatic regime at a given temperature. Thermally populated adiabatic phonons suppress $d$-wave pairing through the loss of quasiparticle coherence, whereas antiadiabatic phonons simultaneously enhance coherence and the attractive $d$-wave pairing vertex, strengthening superconductivity across multiple diagnostics. This enhancement also exhibits pronounced electron-hole asymmetry arising from the different orbital characters of doped carriers. Our results therefore establish a microscopic mechanism through which $B_{1g}$ phonons can cooperate with electronic correlations to substantially enhance $d$-wave superconducting pairing in cuprates.

</details>


### [170] [Monte Carlo simulation of mixed spin-orbit ordering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39943)
*Yu. D. Panov,V. A. Ulitko*

Main category: cond-mat.str-el

TL;DR: 本文采用热浴算法（heat bath algorithm）的准经典蒙特卡洛方法（quasi-classical Monte Carlo method），研究磁场对具有最大纠缠（maximal entanglement）的Kugel-Khomskii模型热力学性质的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旨在揭示外加磁场如何改变Kugel-Khomskii模型中自旋与轨道自由度的耦合行为，特别是磁场与轨道序（orbital ordering）及自旋-轨道关联之间的关系。

Method: 使用基于热浴算法（heat bath algorithm）的准经典蒙特卡洛方法（quasi-classical Monte Carlo method），计算单格点关联函数（single-site correlators）随温度的变化，以考察磁场对系统热力学性质的作用。

Result: 单格点关联函数的温度依赖关系表明，施加磁场会产生非零磁化强度（magnetization），并在布里渊区（Brillouin zone）中与自旋-轨道关联函数（spin-orbit correlator）非零值相同的同一位置同时出现轨道序（orbital ordering）。

Conclusion: 磁场诱导的磁化与轨道序在同一动量位置协同出现，说明自旋-轨道关联在磁场驱动轨道有序化过程中起关键作用；纯轨道序不与磁化共存的情形未在结果中出现。

Abstract: The effect of a magnetic field on the thermodynamic properties of the Kugel-Khomskii model with maximal entanglement using the quasi-classical Monte Carlo method with the heat bath algorithm. The temperature dependencies of single-site correlators show that the application of a magnetic field results in non-zero magnetization and the simultaneous appearance of an orbital ordering at the same point in the Brillouin zone where a non-zero spin-orbit correlator exists.

</details>


### [171] [Electronic liquid crystals and superconductivity from doping a moiré Mott insulator](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39978)
*Yichi Zhang,Yiyu Xia,Zhongdong Han,Jekwan Lee,Brandon Bauer,Kenji Watanabe,Takashi Taniguchi,Wenjin Zhao,Kin Fai Mak,Jie Shan*

Main category: cond-mat.str-el

TL;DR: 该工作在扭转双层 WSe2 的掺杂莫特绝缘体（Mott insulator）中观测到条纹相（stripe phase）的普遍出现，并发现条纹相到超导体的量子相变（quantum phase transition）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电子液晶（electronic liquid crystals）如条纹相与向列相（nematic）被认为在掺杂莫特绝缘体中涌现，并与高温超导（high temperature superconductivity）的竞争序（competing order）或交织序（intertwined order）密切相关；莫尔半导体（moiré semiconductor）为此提供可控研究平台。

Method: 采用电输运测量（electrical transport studies）在扭转双层 WSe2 中探测条纹相的出现及其向超导体的转变，并借助热力学相变与费米面重构（Fermi surface reconstruction）作为判据。

Result: 在掺杂莫尔莫特绝缘体中观测到普遍存在的条纹相：表现为从高温各向同性相（isotropic phase）到低温各向异性相（anisotropic phase）的热力学相变，并伴随费米面重构。近条纹—超导转变处还观测到金属性条纹到钉扎绝缘条纹（pinned insulating stripes）的额外热力学相变；该转变呈现自相似性（self-similarity）。

Conclusion: 结果表明莫尔材料为研究交织序（intertwined orders）提供了可行路径，并揭示条纹序与超导序之间的紧密关联。

Abstract: Electronic liquid crystals, such as stripe phases and nematics, are self-organized states of matter with spontaneously broken rotational symmetry. They are expected to emerge in a doped Mott insulator as a compromise between short- and long-range Coulomb interactions, and are believed to be intimately connected to the emergence of high temperature superconductivity either as a competing order or an intertwined order. Moiré semiconductors provide a controllable platform to explore the relationship between stripe phases and superconductivity near a Mott insulator. Here we report the generic appearance of stripe phases in a doped moiré Mott insulator and the observation of a stripe to-superconductor quantum phase transition in twisted bilayer WSe2. The stripe phases were revealed by electrical transport studies as a thermodynamic phase transition from a high temperature isotropic phase to a low-temperature anisotropic phase accompanied by a Fermi surface reconstruction. Near the stripe-to-superconductor transition, we also observed an additional thermodynamic phase transition from metallic stripes to pinned insulating stripes. The stripe-to-superconductor transition further exhibits an intriguing self-similarity that highlights the intimate relationship between the two orders. Our results pave the path for studying intertwined orders in moiré materials.

</details>


### [172] [Static Response of the Strongly Coupled Electron Gas from Diffusion Monte Carlo](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40093)
*Muhammed H. Güneş,Yubo Yang,Vitaly Gorelov,Miguel A. Morales,Matteo Gatti,Lucia Reining,Shiwei Zhang*

Main category: cond-mat.str-el

TL;DR: 该工作采用扩散蒙特卡洛（diffusion Monte Carlo, DMC）计算了均匀电子气（homogeneous electron gas, HEG）在宽密度范围 $2\leq r_s\leq100$ 的静态密度响应函数 $\chi(q)$ 与局域场因子（local field factor）$G(q)$，提供了低于金属密度的零温数据并给出方法学指导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 精确的零温 $G(q)$ 数据此前仅限于金属密度区间（$r_s\leq10$），低密度区域缺乏可靠结果，而 $G(q)$ 是介电屏蔽（dielectric screening）、有效电子-电子相互作用及含时密度泛函理论（time-dependent density functional theory, TDDFT）交换关联核（xc kernel）的关键输入。

Method: 采用扩散蒙特卡洛计算静态密度响应函数 $\chi(q)$ 与 $G(q)$，并系统讨论使计算可行的技术步骤，包括试探波函数（trial wave function）中扰动势的优化、线性响应窗口（linear-response window）的密度依赖性，以及背流关联（backflow correlations）与体系尺寸的影响；同时提供最优扰动势的闭式表达式。

Result: 扰动势优化对结果影响显著，选择不当甚至会改变响应的符号；背流关联不改变 $\chi(q)$，且 $G(q)$ 在极低密度下对体系尺寸仅呈弱依赖，故 Slater–Jastrow 波函数与中等体系尺寸即可。结果在金属密度的 $q>k_F$ 区间与此前 DMC 数据一致并延伸至 $q<k_F$，在 $r_s=2$ 处与图解 QMC（diagrammatic QMC）一致；低密度下 $G(q)$ 在中等 $q$ 处呈现非单调结构，并与有限温度路径积分蒙特卡洛（path integral Monte Carlo）定量吻合。

Conclusion: 结果表明先前报道的有限温度结构源于基态性质；结合能复现液相区数据的 $G(q)$ 参数化，可将该非单调结构归因于对关联函数（pair correlation function）与静态结构因子（static structure factor）中的短程有序（short-range order），并为电子气及实际材料响应性质的后续 QMC 计算提供实用指南。

Abstract: The local field factor $G(q)$ of the HEG describes how exchange and correlation modify the response to a static perturbation, and enters dielectric screening, effective electron--electron interactions, and the xc kernel of TDDFT. Accurate zero-temperature data for $G(q)$, however, remain limited to metallic densities, $r_s\leq10$. In this work, we present diffusion Monte Carlo calculations of the static density response function $χ(q)$ and of $G(q)$ for $2\leq r_s\leq100$, and describe and discuss the methodological steps that enabled these calculations. We show how optimization of the perturbing potential in the trial wave function has an important effect, as a poor choice can reverse the sign of the response. A closed-form expression is provided for its optimal value, together with the density dependence of the linear-response window. We further show that backflow correlations leave $χ(q)$ unchanged and that $G(q)$ depends only weakly on system size even at very low density, so that Slater--Jastrow wave functions and modest system sizes suffice. Together, these results provide a practical guide for future QMC calculations of response properties of the electron gas and real materials. Our results agree with previous DMC data at metallic densities for $q>k_F$, and extend them below $k_F$. They also agree with diagrammatic QMC at $r_s=2$. At lower densities, our results show that $G(q)$ develops a nonmonotonic structure at intermediate-$q$, where the response approaches that of the noninteracting gas. Quantitative agreement is seen with finite-temperature path integral Monte Carlo, suggesting that the previously reported finite-temperature structure is inherited from the ground state. Using a parametrization of $G(q)$ that reproduces our data throughout the liquid phase, we relate this structure to short-range order in the pair correlation function and the static structure factor.

</details>


### [173] [Adiabatic Variational Principle: Born-Oppenheimer Theory for Emergent Electronic-Order Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40117)
*Yang Yang,Ali Rayat,Ho Jang,Yunhao Fan,Sankha Subhra Bakshi,Gia-Wei Chern*

Main category: cond-mat.str-el

TL;DR: 本文提出“绝热变分原理（Adiabatic Variational Principle, AVP）”，从相互作用多体哈密顿量直接导出序参量动力学，为相场类模拟提供与求解器无关的微观基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微观多体方法已能较精确描述平衡量子态，但涌现序（emergent order）动力学的大尺度模拟通常依赖唯象方程（phenomenological equations）与预设的自由能泛函（free-energy functionals），缺乏微观依据。

Method: 在微观弛豫快于序参量演化的假设下（类比 Born–Oppenheimer 分离），将瞬时序参量构型对应为受约束的准定态多体态，由约束的拉格朗日乘子（Lagrange multipliers）给出驱动力；并用非线性 Mori–Zwanzig 投影理论联系可逆动力学与耗散—涨落。

Result: 在电荷密度波与自旋密度波（charge- and spin-density-wave）动力学中重现 Allen–Cahn 畴生长（domain growth），可同时解析演化畴网络与其微观电子结构，并为巡游磁性（itinerant magnetism）导出广义 Landau–Lifshitz 动力学。

Conclusion: AVP 为涌现电子序非平衡动力学的相场类模拟提供了不依赖具体求解器的微观基础，并显式化了常规相场描述中隐含的绝热闭合（adiabatic closure）假设。

Abstract: Recent advances in microscopic many-body methods have enabled increasingly accurate descriptions of equilibrium quantum states, yet large-scale simulations of emergent-order dynamics typically rely on phenomenological equations with prescribed free-energy functionals. We introduce the Adiabatic Variational Principle (AVP), a framework for deriving order-parameter dynamics directly from an interacting many-body Hamiltonian. When microscopic relaxation is fast compared with order-parameter evolution, the many-body state follows the collective configuration adiabatically, in analogy with the Born--Oppenheimer separation of electronic and nuclear motion. This assumption makes explicit the adiabatic closure implicit in conventional phase-field descriptions. Each instantaneous order-parameter configuration then defines a constrained quasi-stationary many-body state, and the Lagrange multipliers enforcing these constraints directly provide the thermodynamic forces driving the collective evolution. Nonlinear Mori--Zwanzig projection theory further connects the reversible dynamics to the microscopic algebra of the collective variables and relates dissipation and fluctuations to the eliminated degrees of freedom. Applications to charge- and spin-density-wave dynamics recover Allen--Cahn domain growth, resolve evolving domain networks together with their microscopic electronic structure, and yield generalized Landau--Lifshitz dynamics for itinerant magnetism. The AVP thus provides a solver-independent microscopic foundation for phase-field-like simulations of the nonequilibrium dynamics of emergent electronic order.

</details>


### [174] [Investigation of perovskite related oxides: structural and magnetic properties](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40139)
*Antara Sarkar*

Main category: cond-mat.str-el

TL;DR: 该摘要报告对钙钛矿（perovskite）中稀土（rare-earth, R）与过渡金属（transition metal, TM）离子相互作用的结构依赖性研究，观察到居里温度（Curie temperature）、自旋玻璃转变（spin-glass transition）与自旋重取向转变（spin reorientation transition）随相互作用强度和结构性质而变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 钙钛矿（perovskite）具有多样结构及结构依赖的磁性质，在多铁性（multiferroics）、磁热（magnetocaloric）及自旋电子器件（spintronic devices）领域具有重要价值，故需厘清不同R与TM离子相互作用与其结构之间的关系。

Method: 研究不同稀土（R）与过渡金属（TM）离子相互作用随结构的变化，考察轨道相互作用（orbital interactions）、无序（disorder）在磁转变中的作用，以及A位或B位（A-site/B-site）取代对磁相互作用与结构畸变（structural distortions）的影响。

Result: 随相互作用程度与结构性质不同，观察到不同的居里温度、自旋玻璃转变和自旋重取向转变；A位或B位取代会改变磁相互作用并产生结构畸变；并获得涉及TM–R自旋相互作用、磁各向异性（magnetic anisotropy）、轨道取向及无序诱导相互作用的实验结果。

Conclusion: 轨道相互作用与无序通过改变超交换（superexchange）和双交换（double exchange）相互作用影响磁转变；结构畸变与位点取代共同调控钙钛矿的磁相互作用与各向异性。

Abstract: Perovskites exist in varied structures and show structure dependent magnetic properties which is of great interest in the field of multiferroics, magnetocaloric and spintronic devices. Here we intend to study the various rare-earth(R) and transition metal (TM) ion interactions depending on their structures. Different Curie temperature, spinglass transition and spin reorientation transitions were observed depending on the degree of interactions and structural properties. It is interesting to study the role of orbital interactions, disorder in magnetic transitions leading to change in superexchange and double exchange interaction. On substitution at A-site or B-site results in change in magnetic interactions, as well as creates structural distortions. We also obtained results where the spin interaction of the transition metal and rare-earth interaction, magnetic anisotropy, orientations of orbitals, disorder induced interactions were observed.

</details>


### [175] [Cage-related crystal-field effects in the paramagnetic range of PrB$_6$](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40176)
*Mehdi Amara,Christine Opagiste,Natalya Yu. Shitsevalova*

Main category: cond-mat.str-el

TL;DR: 通过比热（specific heat）、热膨胀（thermal expansion）与磁性测量，揭示 PrB₆ 在 50 K 以下顺磁区（paramagnetic range）的磁熵（magnetic entropy）行为：首序磁有序温度以上熵接近二重态（doublet）而非晶体场三重基态，暗示硼笼内晶体场基态的动力学劈裂（dynamical splitting），并观测到离心 Jahn-Teller 效应相关的热膨胀异常。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有中子散射表明 PrB₆ 晶体场基态为三重态（triplet crystal-field ground state），但顺磁区的热力学行为是否与之相符尚不清楚；本文旨在通过磁熵与磁化率等测量检验该基态图像，并与 CeB₆ 情形作类比。

Method: 结合比热、热膨胀和磁性测量；利用两次连续磁转变的潜热（latent heat）及改进的晶格贡献（lattice contribution）描述，确定磁熵随温度的详细变化，并分析低温顺磁磁化率（paramagnetic susceptibility）。

Result: 在首序磁有序温度（T_N = 6.7 K）之上，每个 Pr³⁺ 的磁熵接近二重态而非三重基态，需超过 30 K 才达到三重简并基态的熵值；低温顺磁磁化率表现为非磁性基态特征；20 K 以下出现与离心 Jahn-Teller 效应（centrifugal Jahn-Teller effect）相符的显著热膨胀异常。

Conclusion: 结果与 CeB₆ 情形类似，强烈提示硼笼内晶体场基态存在动力学劈裂，且该劈裂得到磁化率与热膨胀异常的共同支持。

Abstract: New insights into the paramagnetic range of PrB$_6$ below 50 K are revealed through specific-heat, thermal-expansion and magnetic measurements. The latent heats of the two successive magnetic transitions, together with an improved description of the lattice contribution, enable a detailed determination of the thermal variation of the magnetic entropy. Immediately above the first-order magnetic ordering temperature ($T_N = 6.7$ K), the magnetic entropy per Pr$^{3+}$ is close to that of a doublet, instead of the triplet crystal-field ground state identified by inelastic neutron scattering. Temperatures in excess of 30 K are required to reach the entropy of the threefold-degenerate ground state. This is reminiscent of the CeB$_6$ case and, similarly, strongly suggests a dynamical splitting of the crystal-field ground state within the boron cage. Further evidence of this splitting is provided by the analysis of the low-temperature paramagnetic susceptibility, which resembles that of a non-magnetic ground state. In addition, a large thermal-expansion anomaly is observed below 20 K, consistent with the expected centrifugal Jahn-Teller effect.

</details>


### [176] [Quasi-Phases of Quantum Matter](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40526)
*Nick G. Jones,Paul Fendley,Nathanan Tantivasadakarn,Ruben Verresen*

Main category: cond-mat.str-el

TL;DR: 该文提出“准相（quasi-phase）”概念，用以刻画连续相变线终止点附近的有能隙区域；这些区域在整体相图中连通，但无法通过临界理论小扰动下的有隙路径相连，并借助多重临界母理论（multicritical parent theory）给出构造性判据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子多体相图中连续相变线可终止，但终止线两侧的有隙区域能否像水与蒸汽那样被视为可区分的相，此前尚不清楚，因为任何尖锐刻画都需超越常规物相概念。该文旨在肯定地回答这一问题。

Method: 引入准相（quasi-phase）：临界点附近的有隙区域，在更广相图中连通，但不存在从临界理论小扰动出发可及的有隙路径。以中心荷（central charge）c=1 的连续终止线自旋链为例，构造 c=3/2 与 c=9/5 的 orbifold 多重临界母理论，并通过弱化 Lieb-Schultz-Mattis 反常（anomaly）将其转化为构造性原理。

Result: 准相带来同相内区域间的界面模式（interface modes）；同时描述延伸的临界线与连接两侧的有隙路径需要更大的多重临界母理论。所得例子对应“商对称保护（quotient symmetry protected）”与“表示对称保护（representation symmetry protected）”拓扑现象，其界面模式可携带高维线性表示，而非仅由投影表示类标记。

Conclusion: 区分不同准相使一个在紫外尺度上非必要的临界点成为红外必要（infrared-necessary）。该条件比仅存在余维一（codimension-one）临界线更严格，表明物相内部结构比常规分类所揭示的更为丰富。

Abstract: Within quantum many-body phase diagrams, continuous transition lines can appear and then terminate. However, it has remained unclear whether the neighboring regimes can be meaningfully described as distinct phases, akin to water and vapour, since any sharp characterization would have to go beyond the usual notion of phases of matter. We answer this in the affirmative by introducing quasi-phases: gapped regimes near a critical point that are connected in the broader phase diagram, but not by any gapped path accessible from small perturbations of the critical theory. The physical consequences include interface modes between regimes in the same phase of matter. More striking still, describing both the extended critical line and the gapped path connecting the regimes requires a bigger multicritical parent theory. In spin-chain examples with continuous terminating lines with central charge $c=1$, we find multicritical $c=3/2$ and $c=9/5$ orbifolds describing so-called 'quotient symmetry protected' and 'representation symmetry protected' topological phenomena. While one-dimensional symmetry-protected topological phases are labeled by projective representation classes, these quasi-phases can have interface modes carrying higher-dimensional linear representations. We turn this into a constructive principle through a weakening of the Lieb-Schultz-Mattis anomaly. Supporting distinct quasi-phases makes an unnecessary critical point infrared-necessary, even if it is unnecessary at the ultraviolet scale. This condition is more restrictive than simply having a codimension-one critical line, revealing richer structure within phases of matter than their conventional classification suggests.

</details>


### [177] [Variational wavefunctions for ideal anyon gas: superfluid and skyrmion Hall crystal](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40657)
*Ya-Hui Zhang*

Main category: cond-mat.str-el

TL;DR: 该文用球面（sphere）上构建的严格满足任意子统计（anyon statistics）的变分波函数（variational wavefunction），结合复合玻色子、复合费米子、parton 波函数与神经网络关联（neural-network correlations），系统比较任意子理想气体的量子液相与晶体态，并应用于扭角 MoTe$_2$。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 统计角 $\theta\in(0,\pi)$ 的任意子理想气体基态是长期悬而未决的问题，近来分数陈绝缘体（fractional Chern insulator）的实验观测使其重新受到关注，需要既能精确编码任意子统计、又具足够变分能力来判别液相与晶体竞争的方法。

Method: 在球面上构造严格内嵌任意子统计的变分波函数，将理论指导的复合玻色子（composite boson）、复合费米子（composite fermion）与 parton 波函数与神经网络关联因子相结合，并比较其与晶体态的能量。

Result: 无自旋与 SU(2) 半子（semion）情形确认配对任意子超流（paired anyon superfluid）远优于最佳晶体态；$\theta=\pi/3$ 无自旋情形液相与晶体能量接近。$\theta=\pi/3$ 的 SU(3) 味任意子给出两个候选：由自旋织构有效磁场中整数量子霍尔效应形成的 skyrmion 霍尔晶体，以及六任意子团簇的手征色超导体（chiral color superconductor），后者波函数为超行列式（hyperdeterminant）而非 parton 行列式之积，能量优于两种晶体及 U(1)$^2$、Z$_3$ 规范群的色味锁定相。

Conclusion: 对扭角 MoTe$_2$ 而言，重入整数量子反常霍尔相（reentrant integer quantum anomalous Hall）被解释为掺杂任意子的 skyrmion 霍尔晶体，观测到的超导可能为色超导体，后者可经跃变手征中心荷（chiral central charge）3 的方式转变为 $f+if$ BCS 超导体。

Abstract: The ground state of an ideal gas of anyons with statistical angle $θ\in(0,π)$ is a long-standing open problem, with renewed interest from the recent observations of fractional Chern insulators. In this work we construct variational wavefunctions that build in the exact anyon statistics and combine theory-guided composite-boson, composite-fermion and parton wavefunctions with neural-network correlations on the sphere. For spinless and SU(2) semions we confirm the paired anyon superfluid, well below the best crystal states. At $θ=π/3$ liquids and crystals are closer in energy for the spinless case. For $θ=π/3$ anyons with SU(3) flavor, we find two candidates. One is a skyrmion Hall crystal, in which the anyons form an integer quantum Hall state in the effective magnetic field from the spin texture. The other is a chiral color superconductor of six-anyon clusters, the color-flavor-locked pairing descendant of a holon metal with SU(3) color gauge symmetry and SU(3) flavor symmetry; its wavefunction is a hyperdeterminant rather than a product of parton determinants. Within our variational ansatz the color superconductor has better energy than both crystals and the color-flavor locked phases with U(1)$^2$ and Z$_3$ gauge groups. For twisted MoTe$_2$ this suggests that the reentrant integer quantum anomalous Hall phase is the skyrmion Hall crystal of the doped anyons, and that the observed superconductivity may be the color superconductor, which can undergo a transition to an $f+if$ BCS superconductor with a jump of the chiral central charge by 3.

</details>

### [178] [Seeing Unseen Gravitational Wave Inspirals at the Galactic Center](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37757)
*Pau Amaro Seoane,Qimin Song,Shao-Dong Zhao,Kostas Tzanavaris,Reinhard Genzel,Frank Eisenhauer,Thomas Ott,Stefan Gillessen,Guillaume Bourdarot,Diogo C. Ribeiro,Matteo Sadun Bordoni,Simran Joharle,Felix Mang,Andreas Burkert,Jorge Cuadra,Diego Calderón,Re'em Sari*

Main category: astro-ph.HE

TL;DR: 论文提出利用极端大质量比旋进（X-MRI）对高偏心率S星S301的长期引力力矩进行观测探测，并采用小波变换模极大值方法分离随机性引力撞击噪声，证明可在5–9年内探测到至少两个X-MRI。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 银河系中心预期存在大量向超大质量黑洞迁移的极端大质量比旋进（extremely large mass-ratio inspirals, X-MRIs），但在天基引力波探测器（space-based gravitational wave detectors）发射前缺乏可行的观测约束手段；同时恒星质量黑洞形成的颗粒状势场会引入随机噪声，使传统轨道拟合产生系统性偏差。

Method: 利用X-MRI对高偏心率S星S301施加的长期引力力矩（secular gravitational torque）作为探针；针对S301穿越恒星质量黑洞团（stellar-mass black hole cusp）产生的离散引力遭遇，采用基于小波变换模极大值（Wavelet Transform Modulus Maxima）的方法刻画轨道运动的局部Hölder正则性，从而区分X-MRI连续力矩与随机不连续速度跳变。

Result: 解析表明S301对内部X-MRI族群高度敏感，而与外部恒星团的长期影响动态解耦；结合精密天体测量（precision astrometry）与径向速度投影，证明在5至9年时间尺度内可探测到至少两个X-MRI的存在。

Conclusion: 该方法可在天基引力波探测器发射之前，对尚未观测到的轨道天体族群（unseen orbiter population）施加约束，为X-MRI的预先探测提供可行途径。

Abstract: The Galactic Center is expected to host a population of extremely large mass-ratio inspirals (X-MRIs) migrating toward the supermassive black hole. We propose an observational approach utilizing the secular gravitational torque exerted by X-MRIs on the highly eccentric S-star S301. This approach is intrinsically limited by the stochastic nature of the surrounding stellar-mass black hole cusp. As S301 propagates through this granular medium, it experiences discrete gravitational encounters. Standard orbital fitting procedures inherently assume a smooth background potential; applying them to stochastic trajectories averages these discrete velocity discontinuities into a continuous secular drift. This introduces a systematic bias that mimics the X-MRI precession signal, invalidating traditional mass estimation techniques. To resolve this degeneracy, we implement a methodology based on the Wavelet Transform Modulus Maxima method to characterize the local Hölder regularity of the orbital motion. This model isolates the singular discontinuities induced by stellar-mass black hole encounters from the continuous torque of the X-MRI distribution, allowing for detection even when instantaneous accelerations are below the instrumental noise threshold. We demonstrate analytically that S301 is highly sensitive to the interior X-MRI population while remaining dynamically decoupled from the secular influence of the exterior cusp. Combining precision astrometry and radial velocity projections, we establish that a minimal population of two X-MRIs is detectable within a five to nine-year timeframe, allowing us to constrain the presence of an unseen orbiter population prior to the launch of space-based gravitational wave detectors.

</details>


### [179] [Considering Numerical Relativity Surrogate Models for AGN Channel Merger Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37895)
*Shawn Ray,Keefe Mitman,Vera Delfavero,Emily McPike,Jake Postiglione,Harrison E. Cook,Kaila Nathaniel,Nicolas Posner,Barry McKernan,K. E. Saavik Ford,Richard O'Shaughnessy*

Main category: astro-ph.HE

TL;DR: 该工作将 McFACTS 中演化的活动星系核（AGN）通道双黑洞（BBH）交予数值相对论（NR）代理模型计算并合残余性质，发现相比简单解析方法，NR 代理模型显著改变残余自旋与反冲速度分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AGN 通道中 BBH 并合的动力学过程尚不清楚，且 McFACTS 原有实现仅考虑气体阻尼与动力学相互作用、忽略相对论效应，导致并合残余性质（质量、自旋、反冲速度）预测不准确。

Method: 在开源软件 McFACTS 中把正在旋近（inspiralling）的 BBH 交接给数值相对论代理模型（NR surrogate model），与简单解析方法对比残余质量、自旋与反冲速度的预测。

Result: NR 代理模型对残余自旋的预测显著更准确，改进了有效自旋（χ_eff）与进动自旋（χ_p）计算及反冲核 kick；并显著改变残余自旋与反冲速度的分布，说明替代方法需谨慎使用。

Conclusion: 建议后续研究采用 NR 代理模型或经校准的高效方法；论文还提出若干计算效率较高、可重现大部分 NR 代理模型结果的简化模型。

Abstract: Binary black hole mergers (BBH) are currently observed by the gravitational-wave detectors LIGO, Virgo, and KAGRA (LVK). A fraction of these mergers are likely to originate in active galactic nuclei (AGN), but the details of the dynamical processes driving AGN channel mergers remain poorly understood. Monte Carlo For AGN Channel Testing and Simulation (McFACTS) is an open-source, public software used to simulate AGN channel BBH formation and evolution with configurable options for exploring various AGN and Nuclear Star Cluster (NSC) parameter options. Within McFACTS, BBH mergers evolve through gas drag and dynamical interactions, ignoring relativistic effects which can influence merger remnant properties. Here we demonstrate in McFACTS the effect of handing off inspiralling BBH to a numerical relativity (NR) surrogate model, which more accurately predicts the masses, spins, and kick velocities of merger remnants. Compared to a simple analytic approach to calculating merger and remnant properties the NR surrogate model is significantly more accurate at predicting remnant spins, which improve $χ_{eff}$ and $χ_{p}$ calculations, and recoil kicks, parameters especially important for higher generation BBH mergers. Our findings show the NR surrogate significantly changes distributions of remnant spins and kick velocities, as well as showing that alternative methods should be used cautiously in future studies. We also outline some simple models which are computationally efficient and can reproduce much of the NR surrogate model results.

</details>


### [180] [Search for Eccentric Neutron Star-Black Hole Binaries in Advanced LIGO's Fourth Observing Run using Effective-One-Body Waveforms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37997)
*Aleyna Akyüz,Keisi Kacanja,Rahul Dhurkunde,Alexander H. Nitz*

Main category: astro-ph.HE

TL;DR: 该工作提出一种快速匹配滤波（matched-filter）搜索方法，使时域有效单体（effective-one-body）波形可直接用于偏心致密双星搜索，计算成本降低约20倍，并用8860万个模板在O4a/O4b数据中给出偏心中子星—黑洞（NSBH）并合率密度的90%可信上限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双星轨道偏心率（orbital eccentricity）是动力学形成环境的直接标志，但此前偏心NSBH匹配滤波搜索受计算限制，只能采用忽略拱线进动（apsidal precession）与轨道间谐波（inter-orbit harmonics）的简化波形，损失灵敏度。

Method: 采用多重分带（multibanding）与高频比滤波（high-frequency ratio-filtering）加速时域有效单体波形，构建含8860万个模板的模板库（为此前偏心分析的15倍），对O4a与O4b Advanced LIGO数据进行匹配滤波搜索。

Result: 完整物理特征使0.2≤e20≤0.28系统的敏感搜索体积增加约25%–30%；管道计算成本降低约20倍。回收GW230518_125908与GW230529_181500且参数与零偏心率一致；未发现新偏心事件（e20≥0.05），给出局部并合率密度上限R90%≤7.5–57 Gpc⁻³ yr⁻¹，较此前界限改善最多约4倍；在GW200105_162426参数处上限为12.1 Gpc⁻³ yr⁻¹。

Conclusion: 若将GW200105_162426视为偏心探测，O4的后续非探测将该群体的局部并合率密度更新为R=6.6(+6.3/−3.8) Gpc⁻³ yr⁻¹；该管道使全物理偏心波形的大规模搜索在计算上可行。

Abstract: The observation of orbital eccentricity in compact binary coalescences would provide a direct signature of dynamical formation environments. Previous matched-filter searches for eccentric neutron star-black hole (NSBH) binaries have been severely limited by computational constraints, necessitating the use of simplified waveform models that capture secular dephasing but omit apsidal precession and inter-orbit harmonics. Including these physical features increases the sensitive search volume for systems with $0.2 \le e_{20} \le 0.28$ by $\sim 25\%$ to $30\%$. We present a rapid matched-filter search methodology that makes the direct use of time-domain effective-one-body waveforms computationally feasible. By multibanding and high-frequency ratio-filtering, our pipeline achieves a $\sim 20\times$ reduction in computational cost. This allows a bank of 88.6 million effective-one-body templates, fifteen times larger than prior eccentric analyses, to search O4a and O4b Advanced LIGO data. We recover the known low-mass mergers GW230518_125908 and GW230529_181500 with parameters consistent with zero eccentricity. Finding no new gravitational-wave events with orbital eccentricity ($e_{20} \ge 0.05$), we place $90\%$ credible upper limits on the local merger rate density of eccentric NSBH systems across the search space of $\mathcal{R}_{90\%} \le 7.5\text{-}57\ \mathrm{Gpc}^{-3}\ \mathrm{yr}^{-1}$, up to a factor of $\sim 4$ improvement over previous observational bounds. At the parameters of GW200105_162426, this non-detection establishes an upper limit of $\mathcal{R}_{90\%} \le 12.1\ \mathrm{Gpc}^{-3}\ \mathrm{yr}^{-1}$. Alternatively, if GW200105_162426 is treated as an eccentric detection, the lack of subsequent detections in O4 updates the inferred local merger rate density of this population to $\mathcal{R} = 6.6^{+6.3}_{-3.8}\ \mathrm{Gpc}^{-3}\ \mathrm{yr}^{-1}$.

</details>


### [181] [RAKI: High-Order Alternative Finite Differences for General Relativistic Magnetohydrodynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39792)
*Rahime Matur,Beyhan Karakas,Ian Hawke,Nils Andersson*

Main category: astro-ph.HE

TL;DR: RAKI 是首个采用高阶替代有限差分（AFD-WENO-AO）重构与全非交错、节点中心矢量势格式的 GRMHD 代码，用于双中子星并合模拟，在磁化 TOV 星测试中磁能损失比参考代码低一个量级，并以机器精度维持无磁单极约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双中子星（BNS）与黑洞—中子星并合是重要多信使源，其磁场放大、磁星与喷流形成等现象的解读依赖准确的磁场演化建模；而现有广义相对论磁流体力学（GRMHD）模拟在这方面仍具挑战。

Method: 开发 RAKI 代码，采用高阶替代有限差分方法配合自适应阶 WENO（AFD-WENO-AO）重构，并使用完全非交错、节点中心的矢量势（vector-potential）表述。

Result: 光滑测试问题收敛阶最高达九阶且能准确捕捉间断；磁化 TOV 星测试中约 2 ms 内保留 99.2% 初始最大磁场强度，同分辨率下磁能损失比参考 GRMHD 代码低一个量级；BNS 并合中五阶重构使引力波相位在磁化与非磁化模型均呈约三阶收敛；离散无磁单极约束在非交错网格（含移动加密区）下保持到机器精度。

Conclusion: RAKI 确立了高阶、非交错 GRMHD 框架，可用于中子星并合中磁场演化的准确建模及其多信使天体物理意义的研究。

Abstract: Binary neutron star (BNS) and black hole--neutron star mergers are among the most important multimessenger sources. Observations of these events could provide valuable insights into several unresolved phenomena, ranging from the efficiency of magnetic field amplification during and after mergers to the formation of magnetars and jets. Understanding these phenomena requires accurate modelling of magnetic field evolution, which remains a challenge for state-of-the-art general relativistic magnetohydrodynamics (GRMHD) simulations. In this work, we present \texttt{RAKI} (Relativistic Astrophysics Code Implementation of the Alternative Finite Difference Approach for GRMHD), the first GRMHD code to simulate BNS mergers using high-order alternative finite-difference methods with adaptive-order WENO (AFD-WENO-AO) reconstruction and a fully non-staggered, node-centred vector-potential formulation. The code achieves up to ninth-order convergence in smooth test problems while accurately capturing discontinuities. In magnetised Tolman--Oppenheimer--Volkoff (TOV) star tests, \texttt{RAKI} retains $99.2$ per cent of the initial maximum magnetic field strength over ${\sim}2$ ms, exhibiting an order of magnitude less magnetic field loss than a reference GRMHD code at the same resolution. In BNS merger simulations, fifth-order AFD-WENO-AO reconstruction yields approximately third-order convergence of the gravitational-wave phase in both magnetised and unmagnetised models. The discrete no-monopole constraint is preserved to machine precision without staggered grids, even during BNS mergers with moving refinement regions. These results establish \texttt{RAKI} as a high-order, non-staggered GRMHD framework for accurate modelling of magnetic field evolution in neutron star mergers and its implications for multimessenger astrophysics.

</details>

### [182] [Distilling Large-Scale Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials to Predict Long-Timescale Electrolyte Transport Properties](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39513)
*Ishan Amin,Yue Jian,Nitesh Kumar,Christine Zhang,Jianwei Lai,Casey S. Mezerkor,Aaron M. Melemed,Jonathan R. Thurston,Neil P. Dasgupta,J. David Bazak,Ethan J. Crumlin,Samuel Blau,Aditi S. Krishnapriyan*

Main category: physics.chem-ph

TL;DR: 该文提出一种知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation）流程，将大型预训练机器学习原子间势（machine learning interatomic potentials, MLIPs）的精度迁移至快速、针对特定体系的“学生”模型，实现约40倍加速，使液态电解质（liquid electrolytes）输运性质（transport properties）的长时程模拟与高通量筛选（high-throughput screening）成为可能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 准确预测液态电解质输运性质对下一代电池设计至关重要，但现有大型预训练MLIP虽接近密度泛函理论（density-functional-theory）精度，计算速度过慢，难以收敛输运性质所需的时间尺度。

Method: 采用知识蒸馏（knowledge distillation），在无需额外从头算（ab initio）数据的前提下，将大型“教师”MLIP的精度迁移到快速、体系专用的“学生”模型。

Result: 蒸馏模型运行速度约为教师的40倍，能复现教师预测的结构可观测量（structural observables），并可在数天内生成稳定的20 ns轨迹，而教师模型需数月。在多种钠离子与锂离子电解质上，学生模型预测的自扩散系数（self-diffusivities）、离子电导率（ionic conductivities）与剪切黏度（shear viscosities）与实验吻合，且优于经典力场（classical force-field）预测。

Conclusion: 知识蒸馏是获得准确长时程模拟的可行途径，可支撑高通量电解质筛选。

Abstract: Accurately predicting the transport properties of liquid electrolytes is critical for next-generation battery design and requires force fields that are both quantum-mechanically accurate and fast enough for long-timescale simulation. Recent large-scale pretrained machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) approach density-functional-theory accuracy, but remain too slow to access the necessary timescales to converge transport properties. We provide a knowledge distillation procedure to transfer the accuracy of a large-scale "teacher" MLIP into fast, system-specific "students", without any additional ab initio data. Our distilled models run ~40x faster, reproduce teacher-predicted structural observables, and produce stable 20 ns trajectories in days, rather than the months the teacher would require. Across a diverse set of sodium- and lithium-ion electrolytes, student-predicted self-diffusivities, ionic conductivities, and shear viscosities track experiment and outperform classical force-field predictions, establishing distillation as a practical route to accurate, long-timescale simulations necessary for high-throughput electrolyte screening.

</details>


### [183] [Electrochemical functionalization of graphene rationalized by Hammett and Swain-Lupton parameters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39997)
*L. Chen,H. Li,C. Li,X. Zhang,Q. Dai,M. Alhashmi,J. Tong,E. Hoenig,Y. Li,A. Campbell,K. Hu,Y. -C. Soong,C. Sevik,L. F. Vega,F. M. Peeters,M. Lozada-Hidalgo*

Main category: physics.chem-ph

TL;DR: 在非水电解质中施加约1 V nm⁻¹电场，可实现单层石墨烯与多种取代基的电化学官能化，电导调制达两个数量级且可稳定循环5000次，并呈现半可逆的导体-绝缘体转变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 石墨烯的sp²键合碳晶格使其极难共价官能化，现有方法依赖化学特异性强且往往苛刻的条件，导致对其反应性的理解呈碎片化。

Method: 在非水电解质（non-aqueous electrolytes）中施加约1 V nm⁻¹的电场，对单层石墨烯（monolayer graphene）进行电化学官能化（electrochemical functionalization）；并分析不同取代基的氧化电位（oxidation potentials）与经典描述符（classical descriptors）的关系。

Result: 实现两个数量级的电导调制（conductance modulation）并在5000次循环中保持稳定，观察到半可逆的导体-绝缘体转变（conductor-insulator transitions）。形成定域σ键的物种，其氧化电位随间位哈米特常数（meta-Hammett constant, σ_m）增大而升高；通过离域π轨道相互作用的取代基则与修正的Swain-Lupton共振参数（R）呈反向依赖。

Conclusion: 上述关系表明石墨烯的氧化电位随取代基吸电子能力增强而升高，为惰性材料在强电场下的电化学活性提供了新认识。

Abstract: Graphene's sp^{2}-bonded carbon lattice makes it exceptionally resistant to covalent functionalization, with existing approaches relying on chemically specific and often harsh methods, fragmenting our understanding of its reactivity. Here we show that electric fields of approximately 1 V nm^{-1} in non-aqueous electrolytes enable the electrochemical functionalization of monolayer graphene with a broad range of substituents, leading to two-order-of-magnitude conductance modulation stable over 5,000 cycles and semi-reversible electronic conductor-insulator transitions. Analysis of the oxidation potentials across substituents reveals trends governed by classical descriptors. Species forming localised σ bonds display increasing oxidation potentials with the meta-Hammett constant (σ_m), whereas substituents interacting via delocalised π orbitals follow an inverse dependence on the modified Swain-Lupton resonance parameter (R). These relationships indicate that graphene's oxidation potential increases with the electron-withdrawing strength of the substituent. Our results provide new insights into the electrochemical activity of inert materials under strong electric fields.

</details>

### [184] [Willmore inequalities beyond the injectivity radius](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40546)
*Philippe G. LeFloch*

Main category: math.DG

TL;DR: 该文推广 Li–Yau–Simon–Topping 的方法，对浸入完备黎曼三维流形（可能非嵌入）的闭曲面，建立了带显式割迹贡献的 Willmore 能量全局估计，并引入加权 Willmore 泛函。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原始方法仅适用于浸入平坦欧氏空间的闭曲面；本文旨在将其推广到截面曲率有上界、单射半径可有限、且曲面无需嵌入的一般完备黎曼三维流形背景。

Method: 推广 Li–Yau–Simon–Topping 的估计技术，建立带显式割迹（cut locus）贡献的 Willmore 能量全局估计；在正曲率上界情形下附加显式半径限制，并考察常数曲率空间中测地球（geodesic spheres）的最优性。

Result: Willmore 能量由涉及曲面自交数（self-intersection number）与环境空间单射半径（injectivity radius）的泛函所下界；由此引入适配测地球并计入截面曲率的加权 Willmore 泛函，并给出曲面可嵌入（embedded）的充分条件。

Conclusion: 该工作将闭曲面 Willmore 能量的全局下界推广至弯曲环境空间，并借由加权 Willmore 泛函刻画不等式的最优性，进而导出浸入曲面嵌入性的充分条件。

Abstract: We generalize a method first introduced by Li, Yau, Simon, and Topping (for closed surfaces immersed in the flat Euclidean space), and we establish a global-in-nature estimate, with an explicit cut-locus contribution, on the Willmore energy of closed surfaces that are immersed in a complete Riemannian three-manifold and need not be embedded. Our estimate applies to ambient spaces whose sectional curvature is bounded above and whose injectivity radius may be finite. For positive upper curvature bounds, the global weighted estimates require an explicit radius restriction. The Willmore energy is bounded below by a functional involving the self-intersection number of the surface and the injectivity radius of the ambient space. Furthermore, by investigating in what sense our inequalities are optimal and realized by geodesic spheres in constant curvature spaces, we are led to introduce a weighted version of the Willmore functional, which is adapted to geodesic spheres in the model spaces and takes the sectional curvature of the ambient space into account. As a corollary, we obtain sufficient conditions for an immersed surface in a curved space to be embedded.

</details>

### [185] [chATLAS: A Retrieval-Augmented Conversational Assistant for the ATLAS Experiment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37697)
*Joe Egan,Ben Elliot,Samuel Van Stroud,Alex Sopio,Ki Ryeong Park,Daniele Dal Santo,Zhaohui Li,Runze Li,Jeremy Couthures,Joe George,Cary Randazzo,Juerg Beringer,Daniel Murnane,Gabriel Facini*

Main category: cs.IR

TL;DR: chATLAS 是面向 CERN 的 ATLAS 实验部署的检索增强生成（Retrieval-Augmented Generation, RAG）助手，为协作组成员提供对逾 3 万份内部文档的对话式检索访问，并通过领域自适应微调与上下文检索显著提升检索准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型科学协作产生的内部文档分散于异构系统，成员难以定位与复用既有知识；且这些材料大多未被通用语言模型覆盖，因而需要领域专用的检索访问手段。

Method: 系统基于部署于 CERN 基础设施的稠密—稀疏混合检索（hybrid dense--sparse retrieval），并构建由自动生成问答对组成的领域基准（benchmark）来评估检索与生成性能；研究涵盖嵌入模型（embedding model）的选择与领域微调、上下文检索（contextual retrieval）、排序策略（ranking strategies）及生成器选型，另包含意图路由、安全处理、Mattermost 集成与 MCP 服务器。

Result: 在技术难度最高的文档来源上，微调结合上下文检索使正确文档被返回为首条结果的比例提升逾一倍；领域基准亦用于指导系统设计决策。

Conclusion: chATLAS 表明领域自适应 RAG 可提供带来源归属（source-attributed）、领域特定的协作知识访问，为依赖专有文档进行准确、及时检索的科研协作与其他组织提供可落地的基础。

Abstract: Large scientific collaborations produce extensive internal documentation spread across heterogeneous systems, making it difficult for collaborators to locate and reuse existing knowledge. We present chATLAS, a deployed Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) assistant developed for the ATLAS experiment at CERN. The system provides conversational access to more than 30,000 documents from several collaboration resources, material largely unavailable to general-purpose language models, using hybrid dense--sparse retrieval deployed on CERN infrastructure. A domain-specific benchmark built from automatically generated question--answer pairs is used to evaluate retrieval and generation performance and to guide design choices. We study the selection and domain-specific fine-tuning of an embedding model, contextual retrieval, ranking strategies, and generator choice. Fine-tuning combined with contextual retrieval more than doubles how often the correct document is returned as the top result on the most technically challenging documentation source. The deployed system also includes intent routing, safety handling, Mattermost integration, and an MCP server for future agentic workflows. chATLAS demonstrates that domain-adapted RAG can provide source-attributed, domain-specific access to collaboration knowledge, and offers a practical foundation for scientific collaborations and other organisations that rely on accurate, up-to-date retrieval from proprietary documentation.

</details>
