# math.DS [[Back]](#toc)

### [186] [Nonlinear springs with orbits in radicals: a solvability criterion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37730)
*Unnikrishna Pillai*

Main category: math.DS

TL;DR: 本文研究奇多项式振子（odd polynomial oscillator）的周期轨道闭式表达，将其转化为有理映射的单值群（monodromy group）与伽罗瓦问题（Galois problem），确定根式可解（radical solvability）的力阶与充分条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 奇多项式振子的周期轨道由求积（quadrature）给出，但当能量多项式零点均为单根或偶重根时，其初等性与位移反演的可解性长期缺乏统一判据，故需要澄清其代数本质。

Method: 将位移反演表述为伽罗瓦问题（Galois question），把相关群识别为有理映射的单值群（monodromy group），由参数计算分支数据（branch data），并证明相位角奇点处分支值恒不为零，从而任何分解都成对互反地配对各振幅；同时把能量多项式分解为平方部分与无平方因子部分，将求积化为超椭圆曲线（hyperelliptic curve）上的第三类微分（differential of the third kind）。

Result: 在实因子互异的可公度族（commensurate family）中，轨道为根式可解当且仅当本原反演次数不超过四，或互反对（reciprocal pairs）剩余约化弹簧次数不超过四；根式轨道出现在第五、九、十三、十七力阶，最后一个仅对互反成员成立，并逐一记录表达式。首个非平方初等成员出现于第九力阶，幂拉回（power pullback）在每个此类阶上均可闭式反演。

Conclusion: 重数假设（multiplicity hypothesis）不可去除；初等性等价于极点除子（divisor of poles）的挠条件（torsion condition）并要求全纯余项（holomorphic remainder）为零；由此得到任意高次限制弹簧（confining spring）的根式轨道及正系数充分条件。

Abstract: An odd polynomial oscillator has a periodic orbit given by a quadrature. When the zeros of the energy polynomial are all simple or all of even multiplicity, that quadrature is elementary exactly when the polynomial is a perfect square, and the time is a sum of inverse tangents. Recovering the displacement inverts that relation, algebraic when their coefficients are commensurate, making a closed form a Galois question. This paper identifies the group as the monodromy group of a rational map, computes its branch data from the parameters, and shows the branch value at the phase-angle singularity never vanishes, so every decomposition pairs the amplitudes reciprocally. In the commensurate family with distinct real factors, the orbit is radical exactly when the primitive inversion degree is at most four, or when reciprocal pairs leave a reduced spring of that degree. Radical orbits occur at the fifth, ninth, thirteenth and seventeenth force orders, the last only for reciprocal members, an expression recorded for each. The multiplicity hypothesis cannot be dropped. Factoring the energy polynomial into square and squarefree parts turns the quadrature into a differential of the third kind on a hyperelliptic curve, where elementarity is a torsion condition on the divisor of its poles with a vanishing holomorphic remainder. The first nonsquare elementary member appears at the ninth force order, and the power pullback inverts in closed form at every such order, giving a radical orbit for a confining spring of arbitrarily high degree with a sufficient condition for positive coefficients.

</details>


### [187] [Symmetry-resolved periods in a cyclic-dominance automaton: separating intrinsic from lattice-induced periodicity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37990)
*Francisco J. Muñoz,Juan Carlos Nuño*

Main category: math.DS

TL;DR: 该文研究环面上同步阈值型循环占优模型（等价于Fisch–Gravner–Griffeath三色循环元胞自动机）的周期吸引子，提出用周期元组（种群周期、全构型周期、模颜色旋转、模格点对称、模全空间–颜色群）刻画其周期层级，并给出周期可除关系与分解式Tst=TG·m。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空间延展系统的周期吸引子具有依观测层级与对称商（symmetry quotient）而定的周期层级，单一周期无法区分“图案如何演化”与“图案如何嵌入有限区域”，因此需要一种能分离二者并刻画吸引子相对周期轨（relative periodic orbit）性质的多重周期描述。

Method: 在L×L环面（torus）上定义同步阈值循环占优模型，对每个吸引子测量周期元组：种群周期Tpop、完整构型周期Tst，以及模颜色旋转（Tcol）、模格点对称（Tgeo）、模全空间–颜色群（TG）的周期；利用等变性（equivariance）导出精确可除关系与分解式Tst=TG·m，并在矩形环面与大规模数值运行（L=8、L=9各逾4.5×10^5次）中估计吸引域（basin of attraction）。

Result: 围绕一对反向旋转螺旋（counter-rotating spirals）的吸引子族（Tpop=24、TG=8）在L=9至L=40范围内持续存在，Tst由24变到960且均等于对称h的阶；在9×12矩形环面上Tst=48，该值不出现在任何方形环面。吸引域估计显示不动点占构型空间的95–97%，且无单一周期足以区分各振荡吸引子。

Conclusion: 吸引子的完整周期源于内在动力学与格点对称的相互作用，TG与h的类型属于图案本身而m属于格点；该分析还可定位局部多样性（local diversity）：当循环具有颜色对称时多样性均衡，在大格点上则集中于螺旋核心（spiral cores）。

Abstract: Periodic attractors of spatially extended systems possess not one period but a hierarchy of periods, one for each level of observation and symmetry quotient, and this hierarchy separates how a pattern evolves from how it fits the finite domain. For a synchronous threshold model of cyclic dominance on an $L\times L$ torus, equivalent to the three-color cyclic cellular automaton of Fisch, Gravner and Griffeath, we measure for every attractor a \emph{tuple} of periods: that of the populations ($\Tpop$), of the full configuration ($\Tst$), and of the configuration up to color rotations ($\Tcol$), lattice symmetries ($\Tgeo$) and the full space--color group ($\TG$). Equivariance implies exact divisibility relations and the factorization $\Tst=\TG\,m$, where $m$ counts the applications of the symmetry $h$ that maps the configuration onto itself after $\TG$ steps: $\TG$ and the type of $h$ belong to the pattern, $m$ to the lattice, and the attractors are relative periodic orbits whose full period emerges from the interaction between the intrinsic dynamics and the lattice symmetries. A family of attractors built around a pair of counter-rotating spirals, with $\Tpop=24$ and $\TG=8$, persists from $L=9$ to $L=40$ while $\Tst$ takes values from 24 to 960, given in every case by the order of $h$; on a rectangular $9\times12$ torus it takes the value 48, absent from all square tori. With more than $4.5\times10^5$ runs at each of $L=8$ and $L=9$ we estimate the basins of attraction: fixed points take 95--97\% of the configuration space, and no single period is enough to tell the oscillating attractors apart. The same analysis locates local diversity: it is balanced whenever the cycle has a color symmetry and, on large lattices, it is concentrated at the spiral cores.

</details>


<div id='astro-ph.CO'></div>

# astro-ph.CO [[Back]](#toc)

### [188] [The Redshift-Space Cluster-Galaxy Cross-Correlation as a Probe of Gravity on Cosmic Scales](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37782)
*Nicole Marcelina Gountanis,David H. Weinberg,Andrés N. Salcedo,Claire Lamman*

Main category: astro-ph.CO

TL;DR: 基于DESI BGS的星系团-星系交叉相关函数，论文用Fisher矩阵预报可将修正引力参数$F_{\rm G}$约束到$\sigma(F_{\rm G})=0.033$（$z\sim0.3$），足以在$\gtrsim4\sigma$水平区分代表性$f(R)$与Galileon引力模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在宇宙学尺度检验广义相对论（General Relativity, GR）需要直接对引力动力学敏感的可观测量，而星系团内落速度场（infall velocity field）提供了这样一类探针，本文旨在评估DESI BGS对该类信号的检验能力。

Method: 以红移空间星系团-星系交叉相关函数（redshift-space cluster-galaxy cross-correlation function）$\xi^{\rm s}_{\rm cg}(r_p, r_\pi)$为主可观测量，基于AbacusSummit N体模拟构建mock星表（星系用HOD模型，星系团选择用对数正态质量-可观测量关系），并用单一乘性因子$F_{\rm G}$参数化对晕内落速度的偏离，做Fisher矩阵预报并对HOD、质量-可观测量与宇宙学参数边缘化。

Result: DESI BGS可将$F_{\rm G}$约束到$\sigma(F_{\rm G})=0.033$（$z\sim0.3$），能对代表性$f(R)$与Galileon模型实现$\gtrsim4\sigma$的区分；主要限制来自$F_{\rm G}$与质量-可观测量关系散射的简并，而与单个HOD参数无明显强简并。若完全已知星系-晕连接，约束可提升至$\sigma(F_{\rm G})\approx0.015$；同时该数据向量给出$\sigma(\Omega_m)=0.010$、$\sigma(\sigma_8)=0.010$。

Conclusion: 结果表明DESI BGS星系团-星系相关函数可在准线性尺度（quasi-linear scales）检验引力，与现有修正引力（modified gravity）探针及弱透镜（weak-lensing）星系团质量轮廓测量形成互补。

Abstract: Testing General Relativity (GR) on cosmological scales requires probes that are directly sensitive to gravitational dynamics. We present a Fisher matrix forecast of how well the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument (DESI) Bright Galaxy Survey (BGS) can constrain departures from GR through the cluster infall velocity field, using the redshift-space cluster-galaxy cross-correlation function $ξ^{\rm s}_{\rm cg}(r_p, r_π)$ as the primary observable. We construct mock catalogs from the AbacusSummit N-body simulations, using a Halo Occupation Distribution (HOD) model for galaxies and a log-normal mass-observable relation for cluster selection. We parameterize departures from GR with a single multiplicative factor $F_{\rm G}$ that rescales halo infall velocities relative to the GR prediction. Marginalizing over the HOD, mass-observable, and cosmological parameters, we find that DESI BGS can constrain $F_{\rm G}$ to $σ(F_{\rm G}) = 0.033$ at $z \sim 0.3$. This precision is sufficient to distinguish representative $f(R)$ and Galileon gravity models from GR at $\gtrsim 4σ$. The strongest limitation is a degeneracy between $F_{\rm G}$ and the scatter in the cluster mass-observable relation, while the constraint shows no strong degeneracy with any individual HOD parameter. Perfect knowledge of the galaxy-halo connection would improve the constraint to $σ(F_{\rm G}) \approx 0.015$, and including the galaxy autocorrelation function in the data vector could recover part of this improvement. The same data vector yields tight constraints on the cosmological parameters, $σ(Ω_m) = 0.010$ and $σ(σ_8) = 0.010$, only moderately correlated with $F_{\rm G}$. These results demonstrate the potential of DESI BGS cluster-galaxy correlations to test gravity on quasi-linear scales, complementary to existing modified gravity probes and to weak-lensing cluster mass profiles.

</details>


### [189] [Testing Extended Exponential Infrared Teleparallel Gravity with CMB, DESI, and PantheonPlus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38684)
*Mahmoud Hashim,Jackson Levi Said,Waleed El Hanafy,Eleonora Di Valentino*

Main category: astro-ph.CO

TL;DR: 该文对扩展指数红外（EExpIR）$f(T)$ 远平行引力模型施加宇宙学约束，结合 CMB（Planck、ACT、SPT）与后期探针（DESI BAO、PantheonPlus）得到 $b=0.573^{+0.016}_{-0.060}$、$H_0=70.67^{+0.31}_{-0.35}\ \mathrm{km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}}$；贝叶斯证据显示仅用 CMB 时与 $Lambda$CDM 无统计差别，加入含 SH0ES 的全数据集后对 $Lambda$CDM 呈弱偏好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究旨在利用当前观测数据检验含额外参数 $b$ 的扩展指数红外（extended exponential infrared, EExpIR）$f(T)$ 远平行引力（teleparallel gravity）模型的宇宙学可行性，并量化其与标准 $Lambda$CDM 模型的可区分性。

Method: 由于模型存在两个解分支，采用相空间分析（phase-space analysis）选取宇宙学分支并确定新参数的先验范围；随后联合早期宇宙 CMB 观测（Planck、ACT、SPT）与后期探针（DESI BAO、PantheonPlus Ia 型超新星）进行参数约束，并以贝叶斯证据（Bayesian evidence）开展模型比较。

Result: 在含 SH0ES 标定的全数据集下得到 $b=0.573^{+0.016}_{-0.060}$ 与 $H_0=70.67^{+0.31}_{-0.35}\ \mathrm{km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}}$（68% CL）。扭转（torsion）部分充当有效暗能量成分，从类 quintessence 相平滑过渡到 phantom 区，并在早期恢复标准宇宙学行为。仅用 CMB 数据时 EExpIR $f(T)$ 与 $Lambda$CDM 在统计上不可区分，而加入含 SH0ES 的全数据集后对 $Lambda$CDM 呈弱偏好。

Conclusion: EExpIR $f(T)$ 模型可在观测上给出合理的宇宙学演化与哈勃常数取值，但现有数据尚不足以显著区别于 $Lambda$CDM；全数据集下的弱偏好表明该扩展模型的观测支持有限。

Abstract: We place cosmological constraints on an extended exponential infrared (EExpIR) $f(T)$ teleparallel gravity model using current observational datasets. The extension is characterized by an additional parameter, $b$, which governs the late-time cosmological dynamics. Owing to the existence of two solution branches, phase-space analysis is employed to select the cosmological branch and to establish an appropriate prior range for the new parameter. In this framework, the torsion sector acts as an effective dark-energy component, exhibiting a smooth evolution from a quintessence-like phase to a phantom regime, while recovering the standard cosmological behavior at early times. To constrain the model parameters, we combine early-Universe observations from Planck, ACT, and SPT measurements of the CMB with late-time probes from DESI BAO and PantheonPlus Type Ia supernovae. Using the full dataset, including the SH0ES calibration, we obtain $b=0.573^{+0.016}_{-0.060}$ and $H_0=70.67^{+0.31}_{-0.35}~{\rm km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}}$ at 68\% CL. Model comparison based on Bayesian evidence reveals that the EExpIR $f(T)$ and the $Λ$CDM models are statistically indistinguishable when only CMB data are considered, whereas the inclusion of the full cosmological dataset with SH0ES leads to a weak preference in favor of $Λ$CDM.

</details>


### [190] [Running cosmological constant in light of recent CMB-BAO data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38973)
*A. Racioppi,M. Vijar*

Main category: astro-ph.CO

TL;DR: 本文基于最新CMB-BAO数据重新检验由跑动宇宙学常数（running cosmological constant）驱动的单场慢滚暴胀（single-field slow-roll inflation），将相对辐射修正δ视为可取正负的自由参数并分析其观测兼容性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 宇宙学常数中的对数辐射修正（logarithmic radiative correction）可能影响暴胀预言，需借助最新宇宙微波背景与大尺度结构数据检验该模型是否仍具观测可行性。

Method: 在慢滚近似下计算标量谱指数与张标比等暴胀观测量的理论预言，将δ作为自由参数分别取正、负情形，并与CMB单独数据及CMB-BAO联合数据进行对比；对负δ情形进一步计入对数修正内部的有效质量贡献。

Result: δ为正时预言在“对数区间”与“线性暴胀（linear inflation）”之间过渡：仅用CMB数据时，兼容区域限于δ较大、接近2σ边界的狭窄条带，而联合BAO数据后可在较宽参数范围内良好拟合。δ为负时慢滚近似在小场值处失效，预言被数据排除；计入有效质量贡献后势能出现局部极大值、表现为山顶模型（hilltop model），可与CMB单独数据兼容，但与CMB-BAO数据仅能在2σ水平上相符。

Conclusion: 跑动宇宙学常数驱动的暴胀模型在正δ情形下与CMB-BAO联合数据契合良好，负δ情形则需借助有效质量效应形成的山顶型势能方能部分恢复兼容性。

Abstract: We revisit single-field slow-roll inflation driven by a running cosmological constant, i.e. a cosmological constant receiving a logarithmic radiative correction, in light of the latest CMB-BAO data. The relative radiative correction $δ$ is treated as a free parameter of the model and allowed to be positive or negative. For positive $δ$, the predictions interpolate between a logarithmic regime and a linear inflation one. Compatibility with CMB-only data is confined to a narrow stripe near the $2σ$ border where $δ$ is relatively large. On the other hand, the predictions fit easily within the constraints including BAO data in a wide range of parameters. For negative $δ$, the slow-roll approximation breaks down at small field values and the predictions are excluded by data. However, once the effective mass contribution inside the logarithmic correction is taken into account, the negative $δ$ potential develops a local maximum and behaves like a hilltop model, achieving compatibility with CMB-only data, while agreement with CMB-BAO data is possible only at $2σ$.

</details>


### [191] [Benchmarking Quantum Neural Networks Developed for MBHB Coalescence in the Context of LISA Space Mission](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39980)
*Maria-Catalina Isfan,Laurentiu-Ioan Caramete,Ana Caramete*

Main category: astro-ph.CO

TL;DR: 该研究利用 LISA Data Challenge 的 Sangria 数据集，系统比较量子、混合量子-经典与经典机器学习模型在 LISA 大质量黑洞双星引力波信号检测与并合预测任务上的表现，结果表明未出现普适的量子优势（quantum advantage），但特定量子模型在特定任务上具有实用价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习方法已被越来越多地用于分析 LISA 预期获取的引力波（gravitational wave, GW）数据，而量子计算（quantum computing）的进展也激发了对量子机器学习（quantum machine learning）作为常规方法潜在替代方案的兴趣；因此需要评估其在 LISA 相关任务中的适用性。

Method: 基于 Sangria 数据集（LISA Data Challenge 提供），在标注数据上训练并在对应盲数据集（blind dataset）上评估，将变分量子分类器（variational quantum classifiers, VQCs）、post-VQC 混合模型、量子核方法（quantum kernel methods）、数据重上传分类器（data reuploading classifiers）与量子长短期记忆网络（QLSTM）等量子架构，与支持向量机、多层感知机、循环神经网络和 LSTM 等经典基线进行基准对比。

Result: 在信号检测任务中，多种量子模型达到或超过经典基线，其中表现最佳的混合 post-VQC 架构在盲数据集上正确识别全部信号样本，标准 VQC 与数据重上传分类器亦具竞争力；在并合检测与并合时间估计任务中，标准 VQC 最为可靠，以最低定位误差成功定位全部检测到的并合事件。论文还分析了预测性能、模型复杂度与量子线路资源之间的权衡。

Conclusion: 尽管未观察到普适的量子优势，选定的量子模型可在特定引力波分析任务中带来实际收益，是未来 LISA 数据分析流程（data analysis pipelines）的有前景候选方案。

Abstract: Machine learning (ML) techniques are increasingly explored to analyse gravitational wave (GW) data expected from the Laser Interferometer Space Antenna (LISA). At the same time, advances in quantum computing have stimulated interest in quantum machine learning as a potential alternative to conventional approaches. We investigate the applicability of quantum, hybrid quantum-classical, and classical ML models to two tasks relevant for LISA observations of massive black hole binaries: GW signal detection and merger prediction. Using the Sangria dataset from the LISA Data Challenge, we benchmark several quantum architectures, including variational quantum classifiers (VQCs), post VQC hybrid models, quantum kernel methods, data reuploading classifiers, and quantum long short-term memory (QLSTM) networks, against classical support vector machines, multilayer perceptrons, recurrent neural networks, and LSTM networks. The models are trained on labelled data derived from the Sangria training dataset and evaluated on the corresponding blind dataset. For signal detection, several quantum models match or outperform classical baselines. In particular, the best performing hybrid post VQC architecture correctly identifies all signal samples in the blind dataset, while the standard VQC and data reuploading classifier achieve competitive detection rates. For merger detection and coalescence time estimation, however, the standard VQC emerges as the most reliable model, successfully localising all detected merger events with the lowest localisation errors. We further analyse the trade-offs between predictive performance, model complexity, and quantum circuit resources. Our results indicate that, although no universal quantum advantage is observed, selected quantum models can provide practical benefits for specific GW analysis tasks and represent promising candidates for future LISA data analysis pipelines.

</details>


### [192] [Phenomenological implications of cosmic (super)strings with time-varying tension](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40020)
*Anastasios Avgoustidis,Edmund J. Copeland,Adam Moss,Juhan Raidal,Filippo Revello,Gonzalo Villa*

Main category: astro-ph.CO

TL;DR: 该文严肃对待宇宙弦（cosmic strings）张力随时间变化的可能性，对五种时变张力模型计算其引力波（GW）与宇宙微波背景（CMB）贡献，并通过MCMC分析发现：在脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）与干涉仪之间的频段存在有趣谱特征，但特征并不唯一，不过时变张力宇宙弦对现有引力波数据的拟合与其它受青睐模型同样良好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 宇宙弦与宇宙超弦（cosmic superstrings）可能在早期宇宙形成；在特定模型中，弦张力因弦由演化的模场（moduli fields）构成或与演化标量场（scalar fields）直接耦合而具有时间依赖性。作者据此考察这种时变性的现象学后果，并与传统固定张力情形作对比。

Method: 针对五种由不同张力演化形式所驱动的时变模型，评估其引力波贡献及对宇宙微波背景的影响，并对这些模型进行马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）分析。

Result: 发现在当前脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）与干涉仪（interferometer）数据所覆盖的频率之间存在有趣的引力波谱特征；但这些特征并非时变张力弦所独有，因而难以用现有数据唯一确定。时变张力宇宙弦对引力波数据的拟合程度与其它受青睐模型相当。

Conclusion: 时变弦张力模型与现有引力波观测相容，可作为有竞争力的解释之一，但其独特谱特征不足以凭当前数据加以甄别，需依赖未来观测加以区分。

Abstract: Cosmic strings and cosmic superstrings could have formed in the early universe. In a particular class of models, the tension associated with these defects is time dependent, either because the strings themselves are composed of evolving moduli fields, or because they are directly coupled to evolving scalar fields leading to an effective time dependence in the string tension. Here we take seriously the possibility of this time dependence and investigate the phenomenological consequences of such an evolution, comparing the results to the more traditional case of a fixed time independent tension. In particular, for five different time varying models, motivated by different possible forms of evolution of the string tension, we evaluate their Gravitational Wave (GW) contributions as well as their impact on the Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB). Performing an MCMC analysis of the models we find there are indeed interesting spectral signatures in the GW emission at frequencies between the current PTA and interferometer data, but the signatures are not unique to these strings, making them hard to pin down using current data. However, we do find cosmic strings with evolving tension fit the GW data as well as other favoured models.

</details>


### [193] [Theoretical Consistency and Observational Constraints on Entropic Cosmology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40205)
*Yunliang Ren,Xiaofeng Yang,Xuwei Zhang,Shuangnan Chen,Yangjun Shi,Hoernisa Iminniyaza*

Main category: astro-ph.CO

TL;DR: 基于DESI DR2暗示暗能量随时间演化的结果，本文重新审视熵宇宙学（entropic cosmology）的三类代表性模型（驱动项分别为H²、H²+Ḣ、H²+Ḣ+H⁴），并通过早期宇宙一致性、跨普朗克审查猜想（TCC）与Quintom-B穿越等理论条件及Pantheon+、DESI DR2 BAO、Planck 2018数据联合约束进行比较分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DESI DR2的最新结果表明暗能量可能随时间演化，这为重新检验熵宇宙学提供了动机；研究旨在评估不同熵宇宙学模型在理论自洽性与观测拟合两方面的可行性。

Method: 建立熵宇宙学的通用框架，考察驱动项为H²（模型A）、H²+Ḣ（模型B）、H²+Ḣ+H⁴（模型C）的三个模型，检验其早期宇宙一致性、TCC条件与Quintom-B穿越，并用Pantheon+、DESI DR2 BAO与Planck 2018 CMB距离先验进行联合约束与拟合比较；对模型C采用一阶微扰处理以保证含高阶项时的数值稳定性。

Result: 模型A最为简单，但难以同时满足早期宇宙一致性与TCC条件；模型B引入导数修正项，其数据拟合与模型A差别较小，且与理论约束更为相容；模型C包含更多修正项，但并未带来更好的数据拟合。观测偏好的参数区域与理论一致性所偏好的区域并不完全重合。

Conclusion: 熵宇宙学或需进一步发展，才能在不同宇宙时期实现自洽的统一描述；理论自洽性与观测偏好之间的张力是当前模型面临的主要挑战。

Abstract: Recent DESI DR2 results suggest that dark energy may evolve with time, which motivates a re-examination of entropic cosmology. In this work, we study three representative entropic models, denoted as Models A, B, and C, corresponding to the driving terms $H^2$, $H^2+\dot H$, and $H^2+\dot H+H^4$, respectively. We establish a general framework for entropic cosmology and examine these models through early universe consistency, the Trans-Planckian Censorship Conjecture (TCC), and the realization of Quintom-B crossing. We constrain these models using the Pantheon+ sample, DESI DR2 BAO measurements, and Planck 2018 CMB distance priors, and compare their fits to the data. For Model C, we adopt a first-order perturbative treatment in the full data analysis to maintain numerical stability in the presence of the higher-order term. We find that Model A is the simplest among the three models, but it is difficult to make it compatible with both early universe consistency and the TCC condition. Model B, which includes a derivative correction term, shows a small difference in the fit to observational data compared to Model A, and is more consistent with the theoretical constraints. Model C includes more correction terms, but does not provide a better fit to the data. The parameter region favored by observations does not fully overlap with that preferred by theoretical consistency, which suggests that entropic cosmology may require further development to achieve a self-consistent description across different cosmic epochs.

</details>


### [194] [Going off the (momentum) grid: A simple implementation of noncold relics in linear Boltzmann solvers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40275)
*Arad Nasiri,Murali Saravanan,Caio B. de S. Nascimento*

Main category: astro-ph.CO

TL;DR: 在CLASS中实现了色散流体近似（DFA）与广义玻尔兹曼层级（GBH），二者结合可在低成本下大幅提升非冷遗迹微扰计算的精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性玻尔兹曼求解器通常在动量网格上演化非冷遗迹（如大质量中微子）的微扰，小尺度上为效率而切换到流体近似，但默认流体近似精度有限。

Method: 在CLASS的ncdm模块中实现捕捉尺度依赖声速（scale-dependent sound speed）的DFA流体方案，并首次开源实现GBH，通过积分掉微扰的动量依赖（momentum dependence）简化非冷遗迹处理。

Result: DFA在交叉谱与中微子功率谱上显著优于CLASS默认流体近似，冷暗物质功率谱误差降低最多一个数量级，运行时间仅增加1-4%；GBH结合DFA对物质功率谱复现精度优于千分之一，宇宙学参数约束偏差优于0.05 sigma，计算成本与标准实现相当。

Conclusion: GBH特别适用于分布函数随时间或参数空间变化的非热遗迹（non-thermal relics）；DFA与GBH的CLASS实现已公开于GitHub。

Abstract: Linear Boltzmann solvers typically evolve the perturbations of noncold relics, such as massive neutrinos or hot subcomponents of the dark matter, on a momentum grid, often switching to a fluid approximation on small scales for efficiency. We implement in CLASS the Dispersive Fluid Approximation (DFA), a fluid scheme that captures the scale-dependent sound speed of these species. Within the standard ncdm module, the DFA significantly outperforms the default CLASS fluid approximation in the cross and neutrino power spectra, and reduces errors in the cold dark matter power spectrum by up to an order of magnitude, while adding only 1-4% to the total runtime. We also present the first open-source implementation of the Generalized Boltzmann Hierarchy (GBH), which simplifies the implementation of noncold relics by integrating out the momentum dependence of their perturbations altogether. Combined with the DFA and tested on massive neutrinos, the GBH reproduces the matter power spectrum to better than permille accuracy and cosmological parameter constraints to better than 0.05 sigma, at a computational cost comparable to that of the standard implementation. We argue that the GBH is particularly well suited to non-thermal relics whose distribution function varies with time or across parameter space. Our implementation of both the DFA and the GBH in CLASS is publicly available at https://github.com/aradn97/class_GBH.

</details>

# cond-mat.quant-gas [[Back]](#toc)

### [195] [Tan's Contact for Trapped Spin-Orbit-Coupled Fermi Gases at Finite Temperature](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38512)
*Tianhao Wu,Yuanbang Wei,Rui Tian,Dongdong Pu,Beizhi Chen,Qihang Ying,Hongyan Shi,Yue Zhang,Shuai Li,Bo Liu*

Main category: cond-mat.quant-gas

TL;DR: 该文通过路径积分蒙特卡洛（path integral Monte Carlo, PIMC）方法研究有限温度下自旋轨道耦合（spin-orbit coupling, SOC）费米气体的Tan contact（Tan's contact），发现热效应从根本上改变了contact与SOC强度之间的线性标度关系，使其转为非单调依赖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Tan contact（Tan's contact）是连接多体量子系统微观特征与两体接触相互作用的关键量，但此前关于自旋轨道耦合费米气体contact的研究均局限于零温，而多数实验条件下不可忽略的热效应尚未被探讨。

Method: 采用路径积分蒙特卡洛（PIMC）方法，考察有限温度下自旋轨道耦合费米气体的Tan contact随SOC强度的变化，并分析相互作用范围内相反自旋费米子配对占据情况。

Result: 零温下Tan contact随SOC强度的线性标度被热效应显著削弱；基于相互作用范围内相反自旋费米子对的平均占据（mean occupancy）与能量重加权占据（energy-reweighted occupancy）之间的竞争机制，线性标度被根本性地改变为非单调依赖。

Conclusion: 热效应对强相互作用自旋轨道耦合费米气体的Tan contact具有显著且非常规的影响，该结果可为后续相关实验探索提供参考。

Abstract: Tan's contact, bridging microscopic features of many-body quantum systems to two-body contact interactions, is pivotal in the description of quantum gases. However, past studies of Tan's contact of the spin-orbit coupled Fermi gases have been exclusively discussed at zero temperature. The thermal effects on that, which cannot be neglected in most experimental conditions, has not been explored so far. Here, through a path integral Monte Carlo (PIMC) study, we show that thermal effects fundamentally alter the scaling relation between spin-orbit coupling (SOC) and Tan's contact. The linear scaling of Tan's contact with respect to the strength of SOC found at zero temperature is drastically undermined by the thermal effects. And a new mechanism based on the competition between the mean occupancy and the energy-reweighted occupancy of the opposite spin fermion pairs within the interaction range has been unveiled, which radically changes the above linear scaling to a non-monotonic dependence. Our work should be useful for future experiments to explore the preternatural thermal effects on Tan's contact of the strongly interacting spin-orbit-coupled Fermi gas.

</details>


### [196] [Nonreciprocal Floquet tunneling dynamics of spin-orbit-coupled bosonic atoms in a non-Hermitian double-well potential](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38597)
*Limei Ju,Yingying Zhang,Jilei Liang,Shoukang Chang,Zunlue Zhu,Lu Qin,Wuming Liu,Xingdong Zhao*

Main category: cond-mat.quant-gas

TL;DR: 该文研究非厄米（non-Hermitian）双势阱中自旋轨道耦合玻色原子的稳定隧穿动力学，通过Floquet态与准能谱分析给出PT对称相图，并揭示非互易耦合、增益-损耗与周期驱动对稳定自旋翻转隧穿的协同调控机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非厄米量子系统中的稳定隧穿动力学是量子输运（quantum transport）研究的基础问题之一；非互易耦合（nonreciprocal coupling）作为非厄米性的重要表现，对量子器件稳定性与自旋隧穿动力学具有显著调控作用，但其与其他因素的协同机制尚待阐明。

Method: 将自旋轨道耦合（spin-orbit-coupled）玻色原子置于带增益与损耗的双势阱（double-well potential）中，对周期驱动下的Floquet态与准能谱（quasi-energy spectrum）进行解析分析，获得系统的PT对称相图，并考察非互易耦合强度、增益-损耗导致的非厄米强度及周期驱动等因素的协同调控。

Result: 精确调控非互易性与增益-损耗可显著扩大稳定参数区域；在增益与损耗平衡的非互易系统中，稳定参数区域的连续性或离散性由驱动频率比Ω/ω的奇偶性决定，自旋翻转隧穿可通过参数λ与2ε/ω精确控制；在增益-损耗非平衡情形下，进一步给出了不同Ω/ω奇偶性下实现稳定自旋翻转隧穿的平衡条件。

Conclusion: 研究为实现鲁棒的自旋翻转隧穿提供了新的理论途径，对非厄米超冷原子（ultracold atomic）系统中量子态输运研究具有指导意义，并为新型自旋量子器件的实验设计提供参考。

Abstract: The stable tunneling dynamics in non-Hermitian quantum systems is one of the fundamental issues in the study of quantum transport. Nonreciprocal coupling, as another crucial manifestation of non-Hermiticity, exerts significant regulatory effects on the stability of quantum devices and on spin tunneling dynamics. Here we place spin-orbit-coupled bosonic atoms in a double-well potential with gain and loss, and investigate the effect of nonreciprocal coupling on the system dynamics. Through an analytical analysis of the Floquet states and the quasi-energy spectrum under periodic driving, we obtain the PT-symmetry phase diagram of the system. We further explore the synergistic regulation mechanism of several factors---including the strength of nonreciprocal coupling, the non-Hermitian strength arising from gain-loss, and the periodic driving---on stable spin-flip tunneling. The results show that precise manipulation of nonreciprocity and gain-loss can substantially enlarge the stable parameter region. In nonreciprocal systems with balanced gain and loss, the continuity or discreteness of the stable parameter region is determined by the parity of the driving-frequency ratio $Ω/ω$, and the spin-flip tunneling can be precisely controlled through the parameters $λ$ and $2\varepsilon/ω$. For the unbalanced gain-loss scenario, the equilibrium conditions for achieving stable spin-flip tunneling under different parities of $Ω/ω$ are further provided. These findings offer a new theoretical approach for realizing robust spin-flip tunneling, provide guiding significance for the study of quantum-state transport in non-Hermitian ultracold atomic systems, and also serve as a reference for the experimental design of novel spin-based quantum devices.

</details>


### [197] [Transverse momentum transport and collective-mode localization in dipolar tube arrays](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38801)
*Camilla Polvara,Nishchhal Verma,Sarang Gopalakrishnan,Vadim Oganesyan*

Main category: cond-mat.quant-gas

TL;DR: 本文在零温Bogoliubov理论框架下研究无粒子隧穿的偶极耦合一维玻色气体阵列中纵向动量的横向输运，以管间动量关联函数（振幅与强度）刻画弹道传播、无序局域化及等时关联的相互作用程依赖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对仅由偶极相互作用（dipolar interactions）耦合、无粒子隧穿的一维玻色气体阵列，探讨纵向动量如何在管间横向输运，以及无序与相互作用程如何影响该输运。

Method: 采用零温Bogoliubov理论（Bogoliubov theory），以管间动量关联函数（inter-tube momentum correlator）及其模平方（分别称振幅与强度）为表征量；并将管间密度失衡（density imbalance）视为淬火无序（quenched disorder）。

Result: 均匀阵列中Bogoliubov准粒子对（Bogoliubov quasiparticles）弹道式跨管传播，退相位导致长波振幅按$t^{-3}$衰减；密度失衡局域化横向集体模，使强度增长停止，其时间平均空间衰减给出局域化长度（localization length）。等时关联对无序不敏感，主要由相互作用程决定：偶极耦合下按$r^{-7}$衰减，最近邻耦合下为指数衰减。足够强的管间排斥使纵向均匀态失稳，形成相邻管间交错的密度调制，阈值与密度失衡无关。

Conclusion: 偶极耦合玻色管阵列中纵向动量的横向输运可由动量关联的振幅与强度统一刻画：弹道传播、退相位衰减与无序诱导的局域化分别主导不同时间尺度，而等时关联与交错密度失稳主要由相互作用程与管间排斥强度决定。

Abstract: We study transverse transport of longitudinal momentum in an array of one-dimensional Bose gases coupled by dipolar interactions without particle tunneling. Within zero-temperature Bogoliubov theory, we characterize this transport using the inter-tube momentum correlator and its squared magnitude, termed amplitude and intensity. In a uniform array, pairs of Bogoliubov quasiparticles propagate ballistically across the tubes, while their dephasing produces a $t^{-3}$ decay of the long-wavelength amplitude. Tube-to-tube density imbalance acts as quenched disorder and localizes the transverse collective modes. At fixed longitudinal momentum, this arrests the growth of the intensity profile, whose time-averaged spatial decay measures the localization length. Equal-time correlations are much less sensitive to disorder and primarily reflect the interaction range: in the uniform array they decay with tube separation as $r^{-7}$ for dipolar coupling, compared with exponential decay for nearest-neighbor coupling. Finally, sufficiently strong inter-tube repulsion destabilizes the longitudinally uniform state toward density modulations staggered between neighboring tubes, at a threshold independent of density imbalance.

</details>


### [198] [Metastability, collective excitations, and traveling states of one-dimensional spin-orbit-coupled quantum droplets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39361)
*Harsimranjit Kaur,Ritu,Rajat,Kuldeep Suthar,Sandeep Gautam*

Main category: cond-mat.quant-gas

TL;DR: 本文研究含Lee-Huang-Yang修正的自旋-轨道耦合一维Bose-Bose混合体系中的静态与运动液滴相，通过变分分析、数值求解与Bogoliubov分析，揭示条纹液滴相与零动量液滴相之间的一阶相变，并确认运动液滴相的稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究动机在于刻画自旋-轨道耦合量子气体中液滴相（droplet phase）的基态结构与动力学行为，特别是有限尺寸和运动情形下相图与稳定性的空白。

Method: 采用变分分析（variational analysis）处理无限大混合体系，并与热力学极限及有限尺寸"平顶区"液滴的数值解对比；通过激发谱计算检验稳定性，并在液滴共动系（comoving frame）中结合实时间演化与Bogoliubov分析研究运动液滴。

Result: 静态情形下体系存在条纹液滴相（stripe droplet phase）与零动量液滴相（zero-momentum droplet phase），二者间为一阶相变；有限尺寸条纹相可具多峰多稳态且稳定。共动系中液滴获得有限纵向磁化（longitudinal magnetization），相图出现行波条纹液滴与平面波液滴两相且均稳定。

Conclusion: 自旋-轨道耦合与LYY修正共同塑造了丰富的液滴相图，变分结果与数值解吻合，运动液滴相在共动系分析与实时演化下均稳定。

Abstract: We study the static and traveling droplet phases of spin-orbit coupled, one-dimensional Bose-Bose mixtures with a Lee-Huang-Yang correction. For the static droplets, employing a variational analysis for an infinitely extended mixture, we show that the system can feature two ground-state droplet phases: a stripe droplet phase up to a critical Rabi coupling strength, at which it undergoes a first-order transition to a zero-momentum droplet phase. The variational results for the ground-state properties are shown to be in good agreement with numerical solutions for droplets in the thermodynamic limit as well as finite-size droplets in the "flat-top regime". For finite-size droplets, the stripe phase can feature multiple stationary states with different numbers of peaks in their stripe density patterns. The calculation of the excitation spectrum for these stationary states confirms their stability. To study the moving droplets, we investigate the ground-state phases of the system in the droplet's comoving frame. We show that in the comoving frame, droplets acquire a finite longitudinal magnetization. As a consequence, the phase diagram features two distinct phases: a traveling stripe droplet and a plane-wave droplet. The real-time evolution of these droplets in the space-fixed frame, complemented by the Bogoliubov analysis in the comoving frame, illustrates the stability of these traveling droplet phases.

</details>


### [199] [Kelvin-Wave Multiplication by Sound Emission](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39909)
*Weican Yang*

Main category: cond-mat.quant-gas

TL;DR: 亚声速开尔文量子（Kelvin quantum）可通过发射声子（phonon）分裂为两个更软量子，使开尔文布居增加而能量降低；旋转不变性将反转奇性的声学剪切振幅与释放能量联系起来，并在反射腔中由 Gross–Pitaevskii 演化得到验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究亚声速开尔文量子的能量弛豫与布居演化机制，明确声子发射导致的分裂过程及其在软声子极限下的对称性约束。

Method: 在软声子极限下利用旋转不变性（rotational invariance）推导声学剪切振幅（acoustic shear amplitude）与释放能量的关系，并用微观计算检验色散依赖；在含相干声波与开尔文种子的反射腔（reflecting cavity）中进行 Gross–Pitaevskii 演化。

Result: 微观计算支持该色散依赖；腔内演化显示开尔文增益、更大的均方位移（mean-square displacement）与更小的均方斜率（mean-square slope），且初始声相位移动 $π$ 会使这些变化反转。

Conclusion: 开尔文量子的声子发射分裂是一个受对称性约束的能量耗散通道，其宏观效应可由声波相位调控，并在 Gross–Pitaevskii 动力学中体现为可逆的统计与几何变化。

Abstract: A subsonic Kelvin quantum can emit a phonon and split into two softer quanta, increasing Kelvin population while losing energy. In the soft-phonon limit, rotational invariance relates the leading acoustic shear amplitude, odd under reversal of phonon axial momentum, to the energy released. Microscopic calculations support this dispersion dependence. In a reflecting cavity with coherent sound and Kelvin seeds, Gross--Pitaevskii evolution shows Kelvin gain, larger mean-square displacement and smaller mean-square slope; a $π$ shift of the initial sound phase reverses these changes.

</details>


### [200] [Single-atom billiards in an ultracold bath with energy-tunable collisions and threshold-sensitive detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40098)
*Silvia Hiebel,Sabrina Burgardt,Julian Feß,Artur Widera*

Main category: cond-mat.quant-gas

TL;DR: 该研究利用超冷量子气体构建能量可调的单原子对撞机（single-atom collider），将单个铯原子以可控速度输运通过超冷铷原子浴，从而把微观碰撞能量转移转化为可观测的二元单原子信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微观尺度的输运过程（transport processes）可能显著不同于宏观对应情形，尤其当环境并非明确定义的表面，而是无序热介质（thermal medium）时。超冷量子气体（ultracold quantum gases）具备高可控性与可直接观测的动力学，为在精确可控条件下研究此类输运提供了理想平台。

Method: 通过将单个铯原子以受控速度经由光晶格输运穿过超冷铷原子浴，实现能量可调的单原子对撞机。恒定晶格速度设定碰撞能量分布中的定向贡献，晶格深度（lattice depth）提供碰撞诱导输运中断的可调能量阈值；并结合浴密度与温度独立改变上述参数。

Result: 该方法将碰撞事件数目与其破坏输运的概率分离。在每次通过仅预期发生少量碰撞的区域内，当碰撞能量超过晶格束缚尺度（lattice confinement scale）时，推断出的单次碰撞弹出概率（single-collision ejection probability）由小值上升至接近 1。

Conclusion: 实验将微观碰撞能量转移转化为二元的单原子可观测量，并在个体散射事件（scattering events）与涌现的耗散输运（dissipative transport）之间建立了受控联系。

Abstract: Transport processes at the microscopic scale can differ strongly from their macroscopic counterparts, particularly when the environment is not a well-defined surface but an unordered thermal medium. Ultracold quantum gases offer a high degree of controllability and directly observable dynamics, thereby providing a versatile platform to study such transport processes under precisely controllable conditions. Here, we realize an energy-tunable single-atom collider by transporting individual cesium atoms at controlled velocity through an ultracold rubidium bath. The constant lattice velocity sets the directed contribution to the collision-energy distribution, while the lattice depth provides a tunable energy threshold for collision-induced transport disruption. By independently varying these parameters together with bath density and temperature, we separate the number of collision events from their probability to disrupt transport. Across a regime with only a few expected collisions per passage, the inferred single-collision ejection probability rises from small values to near unity as the collision energy exceeds the lattice confinement scale. The experiment thus converts microscopic collisional energy transfer into a binary single-atom observable and provides a controlled link between individual scattering events and emergent dissipative transport.

</details>


### [201] [Multidimensional revival dynamics in a bosonic many-body system](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40353)
*Denis Ullmo,Steven Tomsovic,Gabriel M. Lando,Peter Schlagheck*

Main category: cond-mat.quant-gas

TL;DR: 本文研究对称双位Bose-Hubbard模型在强自囚禁区中，从单侧相干初态出发的非平衡动力学中出现的量子复苏（quantum revival）现象，通过半经典理论结合经典相空间结构解释五个在薛定谔语境中未知的新特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往量子复苏研究多集中于薛定谔力学（Schrödinger mechanics）语境下的有效一维系统，且主要以自相关函数（autocorrelation function）为观测量；而玻色多体语境具有更多观测量与本质高维性，复苏问题更为复杂，亟需在最简单非一维的多体系统中加以考察。

Method: 以可积的对称双位Bose-Hubbard模型为对象，考虑强自囚禁（self-trapping）区中制备于其中一个格点的相干初态，理论上推导期望值、相干性（coherences）与自相关函数中的复苏行为，并刻画纠缠（entanglement）行为；进而基于底层经典（平均场）相空间结构构建完整的半经典理论（semiclassical theory），并与半经典预言及量子微扰计算作定量对比。

Result: 发现五个此前在薛定谔语境中未知的新特征，包括同步复苏（synchronized resurgence）行为、不同观测量对应不同复苏时间，以及底层平均场动力学中呈现的进动（precession）现象；半经典理论、半经典预言与量子微扰计算的定量比较整体高度吻合。

Conclusion: 这些新现象可完全通过基于经典相空间结构的半经典理论加以理解，表明完整的半经典理论对于理解这类真正量子的多体干涉（many-body interference）现象至关重要。

Abstract: The collapse and revival of localized states in many-body systems is a quintessential example of a quantum interference phenomenon that cannot be explained purely within mean-field theories. Historically, the majority of previous work on quantum revivals has been in a Schrödinger mechanics context, typically for effectively 1D systems with a focus on the autocorrelation function as the key detection observable. The general revival subject acquires a far greater complexity in the bosonic many-body context that offers a larger variety of observables and intrinsically implies high dimensionality. Here, the focus is on the simplest nontrivial (i.e., not 1D) bosonic many-body system, namely a symmetric two-site Bose-Hubbard model. The non-equilibrium situation of a coherent initial state prepared on one of the two sites of this integrable 2D system in the strongly self-trapping regime is considered. The revival behaviors emerging from the resulting dynamics within expectation values, coherences, and the autocorrelation function are theoretically derived, and the entanglement behavior is illustrated. Several new features, unknown so far in the Schrödinger context and identified here in terms of five ``puzzles'', are encountered and discussed, among them, a synchronized resurgence behavior, differing revivals times depending on the specific observable, and a manifestation of a precession that appears in the underlying mean field dynamics. These new phenomena can be entirely understood through a comprehensive semiclassical theory, building upon the underlying classical (mean-field) phase-space structure. A quantitative comparison of the latter with semiclassical predictions and quantum perturbative calculations yields an overall excellent agreement and confirms that a full semiclassical theory is pivotal for the understanding of these genuinely quantum many-body interference phenomena.

</details>


### [202] [Static dipolar impurity in a Fermi gas](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40460)
*Eugen Dizer,Xin Chen,Richard Schmidt,Arthur Christianen*

Main category: cond-mat.quant-gas

TL;DR: 研究偶极杂质在费米气体中的少体散射与极化子物理，指出基态可同时占据偶极可调的偶波与奇波束缚态，且长程偶极相互作用削弱Anderson正交灾变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究偶极相互作用如何同时影响少体散射性质与极化子（polaron）物理，并厘清该体系中束缚态结构与准粒子权重的行为。

Method: 基于Fumi定理将各向异性相移（anisotropic phase shifts）直接与基态能量关联，并采用泛函行列式方法（functional determinant approach）精确计算杂质谱；同时以一粒子-空穴激发（particle-hole excitation）的变分拟设（variational ansatz）作对照。

Result: 所得谱为独立的偶波与奇波贡献的卷积（convolution），基态同时占据偶波与奇波束缚态，其间距可由偶极长度（dipole length）调节；仅含单个粒子-空穴激发的变分拟设无法描述该双重占据基态。此外，长程偶极相互作用削弱Anderson正交灾变（Anderson's orthogonality catastrophe），使准粒子权重（quasiparticle weight）的幂律衰减减缓。

Conclusion: 偶极相互作用显著改变少体谱与基态结构，相关预言可在超冷极性分子（ultracold polar molecules）体系中借助微波屏蔽（microwave shielding）与相互作用的独立可调性进行实验检验。

Abstract: We consider a static dipolar impurity immersed in a Fermi gas and show how dipolar interactions shape both the few-body scattering properties and the resulting polaron physics. Using Fumi's theorem, we connect the anisotropic phase shifts directly to the ground-state energy, and compute the exact impurity spectrum via the functional determinant approach. The resulting spectrum is a convolution of independent even- and odd-wave contributions, giving rise to a ground state with simultaneously occupied even- and odd-wave bound states whose separation is tunable via the dipole length. A variational ansatz limited to one particle-hole excitation fails to capture this doubly occupied ground state. We further find that long-range dipolar interactions weaken Anderson's orthogonality catastrophe, reducing the power-law decay of the quasiparticle weight. These effects can be tested with ultracold polar molecules, where microwave shielding and independent tunability of interactions enable experimental access to the predicted regimes.

</details>
