### [203] [Exact Solution of the $(2+1)$-Dimensional Dunkl-Klein-Gordon Oscillator with a Uniform Magnetic Field in Non-Commutative Phase Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37820)
*R. D. Mota,D. Ojeda-Guillén*

Main category: math-ph

TL;DR: 论文在引入 Dunkl 导数（Dunkl derivatives）的非对易相空间（non-commutative phase space）中精确求解 Klein-Gordon 振子（Klein-Gordon oscillator），涵盖有、无均匀磁场两种情形，得到本征函数与能谱，并给出非相对论极限及能谱的图形分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究动机在于将 Dunkl 形变、非对易相空间几何与外磁场三种修正效应统一纳入 Klein-Gordon 振子框架，以考察它们对能级的联合影响，并检验新解与既有对易 Dunkl 模型的一致性。

Method: 先在标准对易相空间中引入 Dunkl 导数以分析反射宇称对称性（reflection parity symmetries），再借助 Seiberg-Witten 映射将推广后的系统延拓至非对易相空间；对无磁场与有均匀磁场两种情形分别精确求解本征函数与能谱（后者对应推广的朗道能级（Landau levels）），并计算非相对论极限、进行能谱的图形分析。

Result: 两类情形均获得精确解；结果表明 Dunkl 形变参数、非对易相空间几何与磁场的组合产生依赖于宇称（parity-dependent）的能级修正。

Conclusion: 当外磁场或非对易参数趋于零时，精确解正确退化为先前工作建立的对易 Dunkl 模型，为结果的合理性提供了检验。

Abstract: We solve the Klein-Gordon oscillator in a non-commutative phase space, generalized using Dunkl derivatives, both with and without interaction with a uniform magnetic field. For each of these cases, we begin by introducing the Dunkl derivative into the standard commutative phase space to evaluate the reflection parity symmetries. Then, using the Seiberg-Witten map, we extend the generalized system to a non-commutative phase space. In both cases, we determine the eigenfunctions and the energy spectrum exactly (which correspond to generalized Landau levels when a magnetic field is present). Furthermore, we compute the non-relativistic limit of the system and graphically analyze the behavior of the energy spectra. Our results demonstrate that the combination of the Dunkl deformation parameters, the non-commutative phase space geometry, and the magnetic field produces a parity-dependent modification of the energy levels. Finally, we verify that when the external magnetic field or the non-commutative parameters vanish, our exact solutions correctly reduce to the commutative Dunkl models established in previous works.

</details>


### [204] [Algebraic Quantum Field Theory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37904)
*Kasia Rejzner*

Main category: math-ph

TL;DR: 该文系统阐述代数量子场论（algebraic quantum field theory, AQFT）：以可观测量、时空局域化与态的三元结构为出发点，从熟悉量子力学逐步构建自由标量场，并综述Reeh–Schlieder定理、局域von Neumann代数、分裂性质、超选择理论及弯曲时空扩展等核心结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统量子场论依赖特定希尔伯特空间与表示选择，难以平等比较真空态、热态与荷电态。将可观测量规格与态选择分离，可在不预设共同希尔伯特空间的前提下比较不同表示，并刻画连续统量子理论区别于有限自由度量子力学的特征。

Method: 采用公理化与代数化进路：从量子力学出发定义可观测量代数及其时空局域结构，构造自由标量场，借助因果性与正能条件约束局域测量；进而引入局域von Neumann代数、分裂性质与超选择理论，并通过局域协变性及微扰与同调方法推广至弯曲时空、相互作用与规范理论。

Result: 由Reeh–Schlieder定理、局域von Neumann代数结构与分裂性质揭示连续统QFT与有限自由度量子力学之间的关键差异；超选择理论将可观测荷与统计及内部对称性相联系；局域协变性及微扰、同调方法使框架可延伸至弯曲时空、相互作用与规范理论。

Conclusion: AQFT提供了一个不依赖特定表示的量子场论框架，能统一处理真空、热与荷电表示，并在连续统、弯曲时空、相互作用及规范理论层面给出结构性结论；文中亦讨论了其在测量理论与量子信息方面的意涵。

Abstract: Algebraic quantum field theory describes a quantum system through its observables, their localisation in spacetime, and the states that assign them expectation values. The separation of the specification of observables from the choice of a state makes it possible to compare vacuum, thermal and charged representations without assuming that they share a preferred Hilbert space. We develop the framework from familiar quantum mechanics, construct the free scalar field, and explain how causality and positive energy constrain local measurements. The Reeh--Schlieder theorem, the structure of local von Neumann algebras and the split property reveal key differences between quantum theory in the continuum (i.e. QFT) and ordinary quantum mechanics with finitely many degrees of freedom. Superselection theory relates observable charges to statistics and internal symmetries. Finally, local covariance and perturbative and homological methods extend the discussion to curved spacetime, interactions and gauge theories. We also discuss measurement theory and quantum information aspects of AQFT.

</details>


### [205] [From gauge-covariant Noether invariants to electromagnetic velocity-dependent mechanics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38128)
*A. S. de Castro*

Main category: math-ph

TL;DR: 本文在 Noether--Bessel-Hagen 构造下，显式给出从相对论性规范不变世界线电荷到非相对论速度依赖力学广义守恒量的归约映射，并保留准不变边界项。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 带电粒子情形下，时空对称性仅需在规范变换（gauge transformation）意义下保持电磁势不变，因此守恒量的规范性质与相对论—非相对论对应关系需要被系统地阐明。

Method: 从标准 Noether--Bessel-Hagen 构造出发，采用作用量约定 S_p=-mc∫ds+q∫A，给出正则世界线一形式 P=-m u^♭+qA，并由满足 L_XA=dχ_X 的 Killing 矢量生成电荷 C_X=P(X)-qχ_X；随后取低速极限对应到坐标时拉格朗日量的守恒电荷。

Result: 广义线动量、角动量与能量可逐个生成元地从世界线电荷的低速极限得到；均匀磁场给出一个规范依赖的代表元但具有规范不变的平移电荷，Darwin 相互作用在消去场后提供保守的 O(c^{-2}) 多体实现，而闭合粒子—场系统由总应力—能量 Killing 电荷支配。

Conclusion: 结果是一个显式的归约映射（reduction map），将三种已有描述联系起来，同时不把其各自不同的守恒量相互等同。

Abstract: For a charged particle, a spacetime symmetry need preserve the electromagnetic potential only up to a gauge transformation. Starting from the standard Noether--Bessel-Hagen construction, we make explicit the reduction from the relativistic gauge-invariant worldline charge to the generalized constants of nonrelativistic velocity-dependent mechanics, retaining the quasi-invariance boundary term throughout. With the convention $S_p=-mc\int ds+q\int A$, the canonical worldline one-form is $P=-m u^\flat+qA$, and a Killing vector satisfying $\mathcal L_XA=dχ_X$ generates $C_X=P(X)-qχ_X$. Its low-velocity limit is the Noether--Bessel-Hagen charge of the coordinate-time Lagrangian, from which generalized linear momentum, angular momentum and energy follow generator by generator. A uniform magnetic field gives an elementary gauge-dependent representative but gauge-invariant translational charge. The Darwin interaction then supplies the conservative $O(c^{-2})$ many-particle realization after field elimination, while a closed particle--field system is governed by the total stress-energy Killing charge. The result is an explicit reduction map linking three established descriptions without identifying their distinct conserved quantities.

</details>


### [206] [Homogenization theory of topological Anderson insulators: genuine gaps and pseudo-gaps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38150)
*Guillaume Bal*

Main category: math-ph

TL;DR: 该文建立了拓扑安德森绝缘体（topological Anderson insulator）的均匀化理论（homogenization theory）：在尺度 ε 上振荡的涨落经二阶（Born）修正 M 产生阶一（order-one）效应，使算子在预解范数意义下收敛到均匀化极限，并能改变拓扑相；对随机涨落，作者通过沿避开稀有区域（rare regions）的割线定义指标，证明其几乎必然等于 Born 近似下均匀化算子的体差不变量（bulk-difference invariant）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 拓扑安德森绝缘体的非平凡拓扑相由无序诱导，但缺乏一个能刻画“无序如何改变拓扑相”的均匀化框架。文中尤其关注一个反直觉问题：通常被视为拓扑平庸扰动的零均值电势与磁场，为何会产生改变拓扑相的修正。

Method: 研究对象为受尺度 ε 振荡涨落扰动的常系数椭圆系统（constant-coefficient elliptic systems）。作者发展均匀化理论，证明低于算子阶数的各阶周期涨落在适当振幅下不被平均掉，而产生由二阶（Born）公式给出的阶一修正 M，算子在预解范数意义下收敛；并分析半平面受限涨落形成的界面、局部缺陷下的稳定性，以及随机涨落情形下沿变形割线定义的指标。

Result: 低于算子阶的各阶周期涨落（含零均值电势与磁场）产生阶一修正 M 并可改变拓扑相；算子在预解范数意义下收敛到均匀化极限。半平面涨落形成的界面在所有足够小的 ε 下携带均匀化算子的体差不变量，且该性质对局部缺陷稳定。随机涨落中稀有区域通常填满均匀化能隙使其成为赝能隙（pseudo-gap），标准界面指标可能不再有定义。

Conclusion: 作者沿避开稀有区域的变形割线定义指标，并证明该指标几乎必然等于 Born 近似下均匀化算子的体差不变量，适用于低阶矩消失的一阶合金（first-order alloys）以及一类临界标量无序的二阶系统，其中包括 BHZ 模型。

Abstract: A topological Anderson insulator is an insulator whose non-trivial topological phase is induced by disorder. We develop a homogenization theory of this phenomenon for constant-coefficient elliptic systems perturbed by fluctuations oscillating at scale $\varepsilon$. Periodic fluctuations of every order below that of the operator, with appropriate amplitudes, do not average out: they produce an order-one correction $M$ given by a second-order (Born) formula, and the operator converges in the norm-resolvent sense to its homogenized limit. In particular, electric potentials and magnetic fields of zero mean, usually regarded as topologically trivial perturbations, generate corrections $M$ that change the topological phase. Fluctuations confined to a half-plane create an interface that carries the bulk-difference invariant of the homogenized operator for all $\varepsilon$ sufficiently small, a property that is stable under local defects. For random fluctuations, rare regions typically fill the homogenized gap, which becomes a pseudo-gap, and the standard interface index need no longer be defined. We define an index along cuts deformed so as to avoid the rare regions, and prove that it equals almost surely the bulk-difference invariant of the operator homogenized in the Born approximation, for first-order alloys with vanishing low moments and for a class of second-order systems with scalar disorder at criticality that includes the BHZ model.

</details>


### [207] [Nonequilibrium Thermodynamics of Semilinear Stochastic Partial Differential Equations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38166)
*Zelin Liu,Hao Ge*

Main category: math-ph

TL;DR: 本文为半线性随机偏微分方程（semilinear stochastic partial differential equations）建立严格的非平衡热力学（nonequilibrium thermodynamics）数学框架，以非时间可逆的 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 过程不变高斯测度作为参考测度，推导熵平衡方程、显式熵产生率，并证明样本路径熵产生满足涨落定理（fluctuation theorems）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有非平衡热力学理论多针对有限维或可逆参考测度情形，缺乏对参考测度非时间可逆的随机偏微分方程（SPDE）的严格处理，本文旨在填补这一理论空白。

Method: 以关联 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 过程的不变高斯测度（invariant Gaussian measure）为参考测度，用概率密度定义热力学量并导出熵平衡方程（entropy balance equation）；将样本路径熵产生（sample-path entropy production）刻画为前向路径测度关于时间反演路径测度的 Radon-Nikodym 导数对数，并对非平稳系统分解为 housekeeping heat 与自由能耗散（free-energy dissipation）。

Result: 获得熵产生率的显式表达式，并证明稳态下其为零等价于时间可逆性（time reversibility）；样本路径熵产生满足涨落定理，非平稳情形的两个分解项各自满足积分涨落定理且期望非负，平均自由能耗散等于相对熵（relative entropy）相对平稳分布的减少量。

Conclusion: 该理论被应用于空间相关噪声的半线性随机热方程（stochastic heat equations）、随机聚合物模型（random polymer model）、含无散度漂移（divergence-free drift）的非线性模型，以及两个与不同温度热浴接触的耦合随机热方程，表明框架具有广泛适用性。

Abstract: We develop a rigorous mathematical framework for the nonequilibrium thermodynamics of semilinear stochastic partial differential equations. The invariant Gaussian measure of the associated Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process, which need not be time-reversible, serves as the reference measure. We define thermodynamic quantities in terms of probability densities and derive the entropy balance equation. We obtain explicit expressions for the entropy production rate and prove that its vanishing in the stationary state is equivalent to time reversibility. Sample-path entropy production is identified with the logarithm of the Radon-Nikodym derivative of the forward path measure with respect to the time-reversed path measure and is shown to satisfy fluctuation theorems. For nonstationary systems, sample-path entropy production decomposes into housekeeping heat and free-energy dissipation, each satisfying an integral fluctuation theorem. Both have nonnegative expectations, and the mean free-energy dissipation equals the decrease in relative entropy with respect to the stationary distribution. The theory is applied to semilinear stochastic heat equations with spatially correlated noise, a random polymer model, a nonlinear model with a divergence-free drift, and two coupled stochastic heat equations in contact with heat baths at different temperatures.

</details>


### [208] [Finite-volume and thermodynamic-limit lower bounds for the coherently driven Bose--Hubbard model via the Lieb--Yamazaki method](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38464)
*Maciej Janowicz,Joanna Kaleta,Filip Krzyżewski,Andrzej Zembrzuski*

Main category: math-ph

TL;DR: 利用 Lieb–Yamazaki 正算子分解（positive-operator decomposition）推导相干驱动 Bose–Hubbard 模型基态能量的严格下界，并通过位移与 Bogoliubov 变换对角化二次型界 Hamiltonian，给出一系列解析与数值结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 相干驱动 Bose–Hubbard 模型相互作用强、难以精确求解，其基态能量的严格下界与稳定性判据不足，需要可解析处理的严格界（rigorous bounds）。

Method: 采用 Lieb–Yamazaki 正算子分解构造二次型界 Hamiltonian（quadratic bounding Hamiltonian），再用位移变换（displacement transformation）与 Bogoliubov 变换将其对角化。

Result: 得到显式稳定性条件（stability conditions）与任意维度下的有限体积（finite-volume）界，确定热力学极限（thermodynamic limit）能量密度，刻画界 Hamiltonian 的激发谱（excitation spectrum），并导出填充、粒子数涨落与二阶关联等高斯态（Gaussian-state）可观测量，识别反聚束（antibunching）与亚泊松统计（sub-Poissonian statistics）区域。

Conclusion: 数值计算在代表性参数区间评估了下界的紧致性（tightness），表明该分解方法是分析驱动玻色格点模型基态能量与统计性质的有效且严格可控的途径。

Abstract: We derive rigorous lower bounds on the ground-state energy of the coherently driven Bose--Hubbard model using a Lieb--Yamazaki positive-operator decomposition. The resulting quadratic bounding Hamiltonian is diagonalized by displacement and Bogoliubov transformations, yielding explicit stability conditions and finite-volume bounds in arbitrary dimension. We establish the thermodynamic-limit energy density and characterize the excitation spectrum of the bounding Hamiltonian. We also derive its Gaussian-state observables, including filling, number fluctuations, and second-order correlations, and identify regimes of antibunching and sub-Poissonian statistics. Numerical calculations assess the tightness of the bounds across representative parameter regimes.

</details>


### [209] [A Primer on Instanton Physics - A Short Course](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38717)
*Pervez Hoodbhoy*

Main category: math-ph

TL;DR: 该文为六讲系列讲座的导论性材料，面向高年级本科生与初学研究生，系统介绍量子力学（quantum mechanics）与量子场论（quantum field theory）中的瞬子（instanton）概念，前四讲聚焦粒子力学基础，后两讲延伸至半经典场论（semi-classical field theory）应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 瞬子作为非微扰（non-perturbative）效应的重要概念，对初学研究者存在较高的入门门槛，需要一条由粒子力学到场论的渐进式教学路径。

Method: 采用讲座式教学设计：前四讲仅讨论粒子力学（particle mechanics），为后续内容构建必要背景；后两讲在此基础上处理半经典场论中的应用。

Result: 摘要未给出具体研究结果，仅说明讲座的知识覆盖范围与教学结构安排。

Conclusion: 该系列讲座为瞬子主题提供了面向初学者的分层入门材料，其结构体现了从量子力学到半经典场论的逻辑递进。

Abstract: These six lectures, delivered at the University of New Brunswick 6-21 October 2026, are an introduction to instantons in quantum mechanics and quantum field theory for senior undergraduate and beginning graduate students. The first four lectures deal solely with particle mechanics, building the necessary background for the last two that cover applications in semi-classical field theory.

</details>


### [210] [From Entanglement Bootstrap to DHR Theory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38821)
*Kohtaro Kato,Yoshiko Ogata*

Main category: math-ph

TL;DR: 该论文在二维量子自旋系统（two-dimensional quantum spin systems）中建立了纠缠自举（entanglement bootstrap）与 Doplicher–Haag–Roberts（DHR）超选择扇区理论之间的直接联系，证明了 Haag 对偶性，并给出简单任意子类型与不可约超选择扇区的一一对应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 任意子（anyons）存在熵描述与算子代数描述两条路径，此前两者缺乏直接联系，往往需要借助可精确求解的格点模型（exactly solvable lattice models）作为中介。论文旨在消除这一迂回。

Method: 在纠缠自举（entanglement bootstrap）假设下，采用算子代数（operator-algebraic）方法，证明 Haag 对偶性（Haag duality），并构造融合空间（fusion space）上的密度矩阵与相应融合通道（fusion channel）中归一化正交织算子（normalized positive intertwiners）之间的仿射双射（affine bijection）。

Result: 证明了在纠缠自举假设下 Haag 对偶性成立；建立了简单纠缠自举任意子类型（simple entanglement-bootstrap anyon types）与不可约超选择扇区（irreducible superselection sectors）之间的一一对应；对每个融合通道构造了从密度矩阵到归一化正交织算子的仿射双射。

Conclusion: 研究结果将任意子的熵描述与算子代数描述直接联系起来，无需经过可精确求解的格点模型，为两种框架的统一提供了理论桥梁。

Abstract: We establish a direct connection between the entanglement bootstrap and the Doplicher--Haag--Roberts theory of superselection sectors for two-dimensional quantum spin systems. Under the entanglement-bootstrap assumptions, we prove Haag duality and establish a one-to-one correspondence between simple entanglement-bootstrap anyon types and irreducible superselection sectors. For each fusion channel, we further construct an affine bijection from density matrices on the entanglement-bootstrap fusion space to normalized positive intertwiners in the corresponding operator-algebraic fusion channel. These results connect the entropic and operator-algebraic descriptions of anyons directly, without passing through exactly solvable lattice models.

</details>


### [211] [The geometry of Floquet states](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38845)
*Vladimir Y. Cherynak,John R. Klein*

Main category: math-ph

TL;DR: 本文研究“良好”周期哈密顿量（good periodic Hamiltonians，即 Floquet 谱非简并的周期哈密顿量）的模空间，给出其几何模型并确定该空间的有理上同调环，同时提出绝热驱动下的两条 Floquet 型绝热定理猜想。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 周期哈密顿量在 Floquet 谱非简并条件下具有良好性质，但其模空间（moduli space）的整体几何与拓扑结构尚未得到刻画，且缺乏与之对应的绝热演化理论框架。

Method: 通过 Floquet 态构造该模空间的几何模型，并将其用构型空间（configuration spaces）、旗流形（flag manifolds）与主丛（principal bundles）加以表达；进而分析良好周期哈密顿量单参数族的绝热驱动（adiabatic driving）。

Result: 建立了良好周期哈密顿量模空间的几何模型，并作为主要结果的推论，完整确定了该哈密顿量空间的有理上同调环（rational cohomology ring）；对绝热驱动给出两条描述渐近量子演化的猜想。

Conclusion: 该工作将模空间的几何描述与上同调计算统一起来，并提出量子力学绝热定理（adiabatic theorem）的 Floquet 类比猜想，为周期驱动量子系统的拓扑与绝热动力学研究提供框架。

Abstract: This paper studies the moduli space of "good" periodic Hamiltonians, i.e., periodic Hamiltonians with nondegenerate Floquet spectrum. The corresponding Floquet states determine a geometric model for the moduli space of such Hamiltonians. The model is expressed in terms of configuration spaces, flag manifolds, and principal bundles. A corollary of the main result is the complete determination of the rational cohomology ring of the space of good periodic Hamiltonians.
  The paper also considers the adiabatic driving of a 1-parameter family of good periodic Hamiltonians. We formulate two conjectures describing the resulting asymptotic quantum evolution. These are Floquet analogues of the adiabatic theorem in quantum mechanics.

</details>


### [212] [A First-Order Phase Transition in Spin-Imbalanced BCS Theory of Superconductivity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38961)
*Marius Lemm,Barbara Roos*

Main category: math-ph

TL;DR: 该文证明自旋不平衡（spin-imbalanced）BCS超导泛函（BCS functional）中存在一级相变：在足够低的温度和足够小的固定自旋不平衡下，存在共存耦合常数λ_fo严格小于正常态线性稳定性阈值λ_lin，此时库珀对密度（Cooper pair density）出现非零跳变、最小化能量出现拐点（kink）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有数值工作（Caldas 与 Mota）和分析工作（Freiji、Hainzl、Seiringer）提示自旋不平衡BCS模型中可能出现反常的一级相变（first-order phase transition）：正常态在局域稳定的同时却在全局上不稳定。本文旨在对这一现象给出严格证明。

Method: 研究对象是带自旋相关化学势（μ_+≠μ_-）的自旋-1/2费米子系统的平移不变BCS泛函。方法上的关键是将BCS能量极小化分解为两部分，其中"内层"问题在固定配对（pairing）下对单体密度矩阵（one-particle density matrices）极小化，可由Legendre–Fenchel变换（Legendre–Fenchel transform）精确求解，由此得到强制性估计（coercivity estimate）。

Result: 证明了对每个足够小的固定自旋不平衡和足够低的温度，存在共存耦合常数λ_fo严格小于正常态的线性稳定性阈值λ_lin；在该耦合下库珀对密度出现非零跳变，且极小化能量出现拐点，从而确证一级相变的发生。

Conclusion: 自旋不平衡BCS泛函中的一级相变得到严格数学证明，为"正常态局域稳定而全局不稳定"这一反常相变图像提供了分析依据；其方法学核心是借助Legendre–Fenchel变换求解内层问题所获得的强制性估计。

Abstract: We study a translation-invariant BCS functional of superconductivity for a system of spin-$1/2$ fermions with spin-dependent chemical potentials, $μ_+\neqμ_-$. Numerical work of Caldas and Mota and analytical work of Freiji, Hainzl, and Seiringer has suggested an unusual first-order phase transition in spin-imbalanced BCS models, in which the normal state becomes globally unstable while remaining locally stable. Here, we prove that a first-order phase transition occurs in such spin-imbalanced BCS functionals. For each sufficiently small fixed spin imbalance and sufficiently low temperature, there is a coexistence coupling $λ_{\mathrm{fo}}$ strictly below the linear-stability threshold $λ_{\mathrm{lin}}$ of the normal state at which the Cooper pair density exhibits a nonzero jump and the minimized energy has a kink. The methodological insight is a coercivity estimate obtained by decomposing the BCS energy minimization into two parts, where the ``inner'' problem minimizes over the one-particle density matrices at fixed pairing and can be exactly solved by a Legendre--Fenchel transform.

</details>


### [213] [Minimally-coupled Quasilinear Symmetric Hyperbolic Systems, Naturally](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39107)
*Eleanor March,James Owen Weatherall*

Main category: math-ph

TL;DR: 该文在自然丛（natural bundles）与其射流丛（jet bundles）的闭子对象——自然方程（natural equations）框架下，讨论对称双曲性（symmetric hyperbolicity）与适定性（well-posedness），并提出"自然化（naturalization）"与精确化"最小耦合（minimal coupling）"的构造方法，证明因果锥与度规光锥一致等结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旨在为（尤其是最小耦合的）自然方程建立对称双曲性与适定性的严格框架，并厘清"最小耦合"这一常用但不够精确的构造原则，以统一地恢复标准的存在性与唯一性结果。

Method: 将自然方程视为自然丛上射流丛的闭子对象；说明非自然方程如何被"自然化"；给出可证唯一（up to isomorphism）的最小耦合方法，从单流形上定义的方程构造自然方程；并定义对称化子（symmetrizer）、双曲化（hyperbolization）与约束（constraints）。

Result: 借助上述工具，相对于任意背景结构（对最小耦合系统即度规）恢复标准的存在性与唯一性结果；并证明最小耦合与自然性共同蕴含：一阶拟线性最小耦合的自然对称双曲自然方程，其因果锥（causal cones）必与度规光锥（metric lightcones）重合，且与自然双曲化相关联的某个二阶张量相对于相应 Levi-Civita 导数算子必无散度（divergence free）。

Conclusion: 自然性与最小耦合对双曲性施加了强约束：因果结构由背景度规唯一决定，且自然双曲化伴随的张量满足守恒型恒等式，从而为标准适定性结果提供统一而几何化的基础。

Abstract: We consider symmetric hyperbolicity and well-posedness in the context of natural equations, which are closed subobjects of jet bundles over natural bundles. We show how non-natural equations can be "naturalized", and we discuss how a precise version of "minimal coupling" offers a (provably unique, up to isomorphism) method for constructing natural equations from certain equations defined on a single manifold. We discuss how to define symmetrizers, hyperbolizations, and constraints for minimally coupled natural equations, and we show how these can be used to recover standard existence and uniqueness results, relative to any choice of background structure (a metric, for minimally coupled systems). Additionally, we show that minimal coupling and naturality together imply that the causal cones associated with a (first order, quasilinear, minimally coupled) naturally symmetric hyperbolic natural equation must always coincide with the metric lightcones, and that a certain rank-2 tensor, associates with a natural hyperbolization, must always be divergence free relative to the associated Levi-Civita derivative operator.

</details>


### [214] [Higher genus polylogarithms associated with the D'Hoker-Hidding-Schlotterer connection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39382)
*Takashi Ichikawa*

Main category: math-ph

TL;DR: 该文研究定义在带标记点任意亏格黎曼曲面族上的DHS联络（D'Hoker-Hidding-Schlotterer connection）所对应的高亏格多重对数（polylogarithms）。通过分离退化（separating degenerations），证明该联络可由椭圆曲线上的BL联络（Brown-Levin connection）与带点黎曼球面上的KZ联络（Knizhnik-Zamolodchikov connection）粘合构造，并给出多重对数以形变参数及其对数表示的显式幂级数展开。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高亏格黎曼曲面上多重对数的构造与显式表达尚缺乏系统刻画，作者希望借助低亏格（椭圆曲线、带点球面）上已知的联络结构，为任意亏格情形提供统一的构造途径。

Method: 在黎曼曲面的分离退化（separating degenerations）下，将DHS联络分解为椭圆曲线上的BL联络与带点黎曼球面上的KZ联络的粘合（gluing）构造。

Result: 所关联的高亏格多重对数可显式表示为形变参数（deformation parameters）及其对数的幂级数，其系数由多重zeta值（multiple zeta values）与椭圆多重zeta值（elliptic multiple zeta values）表达。

Conclusion: DHS联络在高亏格情形下可由BL联络与KZ联络粘合得到，从而高亏格多重对数具有以多重zeta值和椭圆多重zeta值为系数的显式幂级数描述。

Abstract: We study higher genus polylogarithms associated with the D'Hoker-Hidding-Schlotterer (DHS) connection defined on families of Riemann surfaces of any genus with marked points. Under separating degenerations of Riemann surfaces, we show that the DHS connection can be constructed by gluing the Brown-Levin (BL) connections on elliptic curves and the Knizhnik-Zamolodchikov (KZ) connections on pointed Riemann spheres. Therefore, the associated higher genus polylogarithms can be described explicitly as power series in deformation parameters and their logarithms for the families of Riemann surfaces whose coefficients are expressed by multiple zeta values and elliptic multiple zeta values.

</details>


### [215] [Generalized Frobenius Structures on Hurwitz Spaces, Their Open Extensions and Associated Principal Hierarchies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39411)
*Shilin Ma*

Main category: math-ph

TL;DR: 本文利用扩展主微分（extended primary differentials）在任意亏格的 Hurwitz 空间（Hurwitz spaces）上构造广义 Frobenius 结构（generalized Frobenius structures），并通过 Cauchy 核（Cauchy kernel）的围道积分给出其无弥散 Lax 表示（dispersionless Lax representations）、开 WDVV 方程（open WDVV equations）解及秩一扩张（rank-one extensions），且证明这些构造容许 Shramchenko 形变（Shramchenko deformations）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 摘要未明确陈述研究动机，仅从构造目标看，旨在将广义 Frobenius 结构及相应可积层级推广至任意亏格的 Hurwitz 空间，并覆盖几乎对偶（almost-dual）情形与开 WDVV 框架。

Method: 以扩展主微分为基本工具在任意亏格 Hurwitz 空间上构造广义 Frobenius 结构；借助含 Cauchy 核的围道积分（contour integrals）推导主层级（principal hierarchies）及其几乎对偶对应物的显式无弥散 Lax 表示，并构造开 WDVV 方程的解与秩一扩张的显式主层级。

Result: 获得了任意亏格 Hurwitz 空间上广义 Frobenius 结构的显式无弥散 Lax 表示，覆盖主层级与几乎对偶结构；同时给出原结构与几乎对偶结构的开 WDVV 方程解，以及由此得到的秩一扩张的显式主层级。

Conclusion: 所构造的广义 Frobenius 结构及相关层级具有统一性：原结构与几乎对偶结构均可纳入同一框架，且这些构造容许 Shramchenko 形变，表明该构造族在形变下具有封闭性或可延拓性。

Abstract: We construct generalized Frobenius structures on Hurwitz spaces of arbitrary genus using extended primary differentials. Through contour integrals involving the Cauchy kernel, we derive explicit dispersionless Lax representations for the principal hierarchies of these structures and their almost-dual counterparts. We also construct solutions to the open WDVV equations for both the original and almost-dual structures, and derive explicit principal hierarchies for the resulting rank-one extensions. Finally, we show that these constructions admit Shramchenko deformations.

</details>


### [216] [Arithmetic localization for quasiperiodic long-range operators with monotone potentials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39448)
*Hongyi Cao*

Main category: math-ph

TL;DR: 该文证明：具有 α-Hölder 单调势（α-Hölder monotone potentials）与长程跃迁（long-range hopping）的一维准周期算子，在 ε 显式小性条件与 ρ>αβ 时具有一致 Anderson 局域化（uniform Anderson localization）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有单调准周期 Schrödinger 算子的算术局域化方法主要针对短程（最近邻）情形，将其推广到长程跃迁设定是本文动机所在。

Method: 将 Jitomirskaya–Kachkovskiy 的算术局域化策略（arithmetic localization strategy）推广至长程跃迁框架，且证明过程不依赖 Lyapunov 指数（Lyapunov exponent）。

Result: 在跃迁满足 |T(x,y)|≤εe^{-ρ|x-y|}、ε 满足显式小性条件、且 ρ>αβ（β 为频率共振的指数强度）时，得到一致 Anderson 局域化。

Conclusion: 结果表明算术局域化方法可脱离 Lyapunov 指数而适用于长程单调准周期算子，覆盖 ρ>αβ 的参数区域。

Abstract: We study one-dimensional quasiperiodic operators with $α$-Hölder monotone potentials and long-range hopping satisfying $|T(x,y)|\leq \varepsilon e^{-ρ|x-y|}$. Under an explicit smallness condition on $\varepsilon$, we establish uniform Anderson localization for such operators in the regime $ρ>αβ$, where $β$ is the exponential strength of frequency resonances. Our proof extends the arithmetic localization strategy for monotone quasiperiodic Schrödinger operators by Jitomirskaya and Kachkovskiy to the long-range setting, without relying on the Lyapunov exponent.

</details>


### [217] [A Combinatorial Formula and a Hilbert Scheme Realization of a Rank-One Virasoro Irregular Conformal Block](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39786)
*Hajime Nagoya*

Main category: math-ph

TL;DR: 该论文给出秩一 Virasoro 不规则共形块（irregular conformal block）形式展开的组合公式与几何实现，并在 c=1 情形下证明作者猜想，用斜表数与 Littlewood–Richardson 系数刻画系数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究动机在于为 Virasoro 不规则共形块的形式展开提供组合与几何双重视角的刻画，特别是 c=1 时系数非负性与整数性的来源，以及此前提出的猜想。

Method: 对一般中心荷，构造型 (0,0,1) 秩一 Virasoro 不规则共形块的组合公式，并将归一化块实现为 C^2 上 Hilbert 概形（Hilbert schemes）对应的局部化等变 Hilbert–Fock 空间（equivariant Hilbert–Fock space）上的逐系数矩阵元；证明结合 screening 积分的扇形渐近（sectorial asymptotics）与 Laguerre–Jack 赋值，并用升次微分算子流表达 screening 核，由一盒 Pieri 规则和 Okounkov–Olshanski 的移位 Jack 系数公式计算其指数项的 Jack 系数。

Result: 在 c=1 时证明了作者猜想，将参数无关系数表示为斜表数（skew-tableau numbers）与 Littlewood–Richardson 系数，从而建立其非负性与整数性。

Conclusion: 该工作将 Virasoro 不规则共形块的展开系数与 Hilbert 概形上的几何矩阵元及对称函数组合量（斜表数、Littlewood–Richardson 系数）相联系，为 c=1 情形下的非负性与整数性提供了统一证明框架。

Abstract: For general central charge, we give a combinatorial formula and a geometric realization of the formal expansion of the rank-one Virasoro irregular conformal block of type $(0,0,1)$ at its irregular singular point. We realize the normalized block as a coefficientwise matrix element on the localized equivariant Hilbert--Fock space associated with Hilbert schemes of points on $\mathbb C^2$. At $c=1$, we prove the author's conjecture and express the parameter-independent coefficients in terms of skew-tableau numbers and Littlewood--Richardson coefficients, establishing their nonnegativity and integrality. The proof combines sectorial asymptotics of screening integrals with Laguerre--Jack evaluations. We express the screening kernel using the flow of a degree-raising differential operator and compute the Jack coefficients of its exponential from the one-box Pieri rule and the shifted Jack coefficient formula of Okounkov and Olshanski.

</details>


### [218] [An Egorov-type Theorem for Analytic Wick Observables in Quantum Field Theory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39806)
*Julien Malartre*

Main category: math-ph

TL;DR: 本文针对一类具有超指数衰减系数的解析 Wick 可观测量（analytic Wick observables），在时间依赖二次哈密顿量（quadratic Hamiltonian）作用下，给出精确的 Egorov 型公式，该公式在半经典参数（semi-classical parameter）ε>0 下为收敛展开。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将 S. Breteaux 针对多项式符号（polynomial symbols）建立的 Egorov 型结果推广到更一般的、系数超指数衰减的解析 Wick 可观测量类，以覆盖此前无法处理的情形。

Method: 构造在半经典参数 ε 下收敛的展开，从而得到精确的 Egorov 型公式；分析对象为解析 Wick 可观测量，时间演化由时间依赖二次哈密顿量生成。

Result: 所得公式在半经典参数下收敛且为精确等式；应用范围涵盖空间截断 P(φ)₂ 模型（spatially cutoff P(φ)₂ model）以及 Höegh-Krohn 模型的一个变体。

Conclusion: 该工作推广了 Breteaux 的多项式符号结果，并将 Egorov 型传播公式的适用性扩展至包含 P(φ)₂ 与 Höegh-Krohn 型模型的解析 Wick 可观测量框架。

Abstract: We provide an exact Egorov-type formula, given by a convergent expansion in the semi-classical parameter $\varepsilon > 0$, for the propagation of a certain class of analytic Wick observables with super-exponentially decaying coefficients, under the action of a time-dependent quadratic Hamiltonian. This work generalizes a result established by S. Breteaux for polynomial symbols, and includes the spatially cutoff $P(\varphi)_2$ model, as well as a variant of the Höegh-Krohn model.

</details>


### [219] [Three-dimensional stress-gradient non-locality problem: Displacement field for an arbitrary and a conservative force](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39888)
*Slađan Jelić,Dušan Zorica*

Main category: math-ph

TL;DR: 本文在无界域上解析求解三维应力梯度非局部介质（stress-gradient non-local medium）的静力学问题，考虑任意体力与保守体力两种情形，基于每种非局部模型将位移场表示为局部项与非局部项（non-local-type displacement field）的叠加，并给出六个互不相同的解析位移场表达式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为获得任意体力（general arbitrary body force）以及保守体力（conservative body force）情形下的位移场（displacement field），需对三维应力梯度非局部介质的静力学问题进行解析求解，以区分不同非局部算子对位移场的影响。

Method: 以平衡方程（equilibrium equation）、无穷小应变（infinitesimal strain）及标量型与张量型应力梯度 Eringen 三维模型构成线性方程组，在无界域（unbounded domain）上解析求解；由于方程线性，各模型解写为局部型位移场（common local-type field）与非局部型位移场（model-specific non-local field）的叠加。

Result: 针对三种标量型（scalar-type）与五种张量型（tensor-type）模型，对任意体力共得到六个不同的解析位移场表达式：一个为某标量型模型特有，三个为各自张量型模型特有，另两个表达式各由一标量型与一张量型模型共用。在重力体力（gravitational body force）情形下给出位移场的图形表示，此时两模型重合，共五种不同模型。

Conclusion: 研究表明，应力梯度非局部模型的位移场可分解为与模型无关的局部部分和非局部算子相关的非局部部分；保守体力下不同张量型模型可能退化为相同结果，从而减少独立模型数目。

Abstract: In order to obtain the displacement field, both generally in the case of an arbitrary body force and specifically in the case of a conservative body force, the mechanical problem of statics of three-dimensional stress-gradient non-local medium is analytically solved on unbounded domain by considering a system of equations consisting of an equilibrium equation, infinitesimal strain, and both scalar- and tensor-type stress-gradient Eringen three-dimensional models. Since the system of equations is linear, for each model the solution is obtained in the form of a superposition of the local-type displacement field, common to each model, and the non-local-type displacement field, specific to the non-locality operator of the model. Among the three scalar-type and five tensor-type considered models, six distinct analytical displacement field expressions are obtained for an arbitrary body force: one expression specific to a scalar-type model, three specific to individual tensor-type models, while each of the remaining two expressions are common to one scalar- and one tensor-type model. The displacement vector fields are graphically represented in the case of gravitational body force, yielding five different models, since two tensor-type models become the same when the force is conservative.

</details>


### [220] [Optimization Inverse Spectral Problems for Sturm--Liouville Operators with Potentials in $L^p(0,1)$](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40231)
*Nur Valeev*

Main category: math-ph

TL;DR: 该文研究有限区间上一维Sturm–Liouville算子的优化逆谱问题（optimization inverse spectral problem, OISP）：在L^p(0,1)中寻找势函数V，使其实现给定的有限个特征值并最接近先验势V_0。工作建立了等谱流形正则性、解的存在性、最优势的解析表示与（泛函意义下的）唯一性，并给出数值方法与多解示例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典逆谱问题关注由谱数据重构势函数，而该文关注在有限谱约束下附加最小偏离先验势的优化准则，从而把逆谱重构与最优设计/诊断需求联系起来。此类问题的动机还包括非线性边值问题及声学、电磁谐振腔的谱设计与诊断应用。

Method: 采用平方特征函数（squared eigenfunctions）的统一微分-代数方法，刻画等谱流形并给出最优势的解析表示；对p=2讨论非退化驻点的孤立性与全局极小点个数，对一般1<p<∞用Baire范畴论证一般意义下的全局唯一性。另提出冻结特征函数迭代与在谱数据上延拓的局部Newton–KKT方法，并用带高有限对称势垒的构造给出多全局极小示例。

Result: 证明了等谱流形的正则性与OISP解的存在性，并给出最优势为平方特征函数线性组合的幂映射形式的显式解析表示；当平方特征函数线性相关时，相应势可表示为它们的解析函数。p=2时非退化驻点孤立，且在每个全局极小均非退化时全局极小个数有限；1<p<∞时在λ_1^*≥λ_1(V_0)下第一特征值情形唯一，并在Baire范畴意义下具一般全局唯一性。还构造出m=1,2时至少存在两个全局极小的例子。

Conclusion: OISP理论对每个1<p<∞建立了存在性、解析结构与（一般意义下的）唯一性结论，同时明确指出多解情形的存在，从而界定唯一性的适用范围。文末讨论该理论在非线性边值问题以及声学、电磁谐振腔诊断与最优谱设计中的应用。

Abstract: We study an optimization inverse spectral problem (OISP) for a one-dimensional Sturm--Liouville operator on a finite interval. The problem is to find a potential $V \in L^p(0,1)$ that realizes a prescribed finite set $λ_1^* < λ_2^* < \dots < λ_m^*$ and has the smallest $L^p(0,1)$-distance from an a priori given potential $V_0 \in L^p(0,1)$.
  We formulate and prove results on the regularity of the isospectral manifold, the existence of an OISP solution, and an explicit analytic representation of the optimal potential by means of a power map applied to a linear combination of squared eigenfunctions.
  Using a unified differential-algebraic approach to squared eigenfunctions, we show that whenever these squares are linearly dependent, the corresponding potential can be expressed in terms of them and is an analytic function.
  For $p=2$, we prove that nondegenerate stationary points are isolated and that the number of global minima is finite provided that each of them is nondegenerate. For every $1<p<\infty$, we establish uniqueness for the first eigenvalue when $λ_1^*\geλ_1(V_0)$ and generic global uniqueness in the sense of Baire category in $L^p(0,1)$.
  A separate section provides examples with at least two global minima for $m=1,2$ in the presence of a sufficiently high finite symmetric barrier. We describe an iteration with frozen eigenfunctions and a local Newton--KKT method with continuation in the spectral data, and state explicitly the limits of their guarantees.
  The final part discusses applications of OISP theory to nonlinear boundary value problems and to applied problems of diagnostics and optimal spectral design of acoustic and electromagnetic resonators.

</details>


### [221] [Three-dimensional QCA that are not stably circuits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40235)
*Bowen Yang*

Main category: math-ph

TL;DR: 该文证明 Haah 与 Sun–Yang–Wang–Tantivasadakarn–Chen 提出的三维手性 ℤ_p Clifford 量子元胞自动机（quantum cellular automaton, QCA）对任意奇素数 p 均不是有限深度量子电路（finite-depth quantum circuit），即使张量任意辅助自由度并复合平移后仍成立，并由此得出三维 QCA 模稳定化电路与平移的群非有限生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前同类非有限深度结论仅在 Clifford 范畴内已知，缺少超越该范畴的判据；本文旨在突破这一限制，并刻画三维 QCA 群的生成结构。

Method: 引入可逆子代数（invertible subalgebra）的新不变量作为核心工具，并猜想该不变量等于所承载任意子理论（anyon theory）总量子维数（total quantum dimension）的平方，模去有理平方。

Result: 对每个奇素数 p，上述三维手性 ℤ_p Clifford QCA 在允许任意辅助自由度与平移复合的条件下仍非有限深度；推论是三维 QCA 模稳定化电路与平移之群非有限生成（not finitely generated）。

Conclusion: 三维手性 Clifford QCA 的复杂性无法通过辅助系统与平移消解，提示存在超出 Clifford 范畴的更强不变量；所提不变量与任意子总量子维数的联系仍为猜想。

Abstract: We prove that the three-dimensional chiral $\Z_p$ Clifford quantum cellular automata of Haah and of Sun--Yang--Wang--Tantivasadakarn--Chen are, for every odd prime $p$, not finite-depth quantum circuits, even after tensoring with arbitrary ancillary degrees of freedom and composing with translations. Previously such statements were known only inside the Clifford category. As a consequence, the group of three-dimensional QCA modulo stabilized circuits and translations is not finitely generated. The key ingredient is a new invariant of invertible subalgebras, which we conjecture to be the square of the total quantum dimension of the hosted anyon theory, modulo rational squares.

</details>


### [222] [Bulk gap stability and spectral flow for fermions with weak long-range interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40299)
*Stefan Teufel*

Main category: math-ph

TL;DR: 该论文证明弱长程多体相互作用（long-range many-body interactions）不破坏自由费米子系统的体能隙（bulk gap），并构造准局域谱流（quasi-local spectral flow）将自由基态映射为相互作用系统的纯基态，且给出多项式衰减条件下的定量间隙估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究弱长程相互作用是否保持自由费米子体能隙及基态结构，是理解长程相互作用系统稳定性的核心问题；已有结果多限于短程或指数衰减情形，多项式衰减的 hopping、pairing 系数与相互作用缺乏系统处理。

Method: 设自由相互作用 Φ_h 的 Majorana 系数算子 h 在 (-g,g) 无谱，对 Φ_λ=Φ_h+λ𝒱 在 |λ| 充分小时构造纯基态 ω_λ 与准局域自同构 β_{0,λ}，使 ω_λ=ω_0∘β_{0,λ}；证明通过激发数比较（excitation-number comparison）并结合伴生论文中的多项式传播界（propagation bounds）建立间隙。

Result: 每个 ω_λ 的 GNS 哈密顿量（GNS Hamiltonian）间隙至少为 g−C_*|λ|‖𝒱‖_*；允许自由系数与相互作用多项式衰减，在 Γ⊂ℝ^d 上两体相互作用充分条件为衰减 (1+|x−y|)^{−ϖ}、ϖ>2d。谱流生成元保持多项式相互作用范数的空间指数，其自同构满足该指数下的局域性界；若 h 与 𝒱 为拉伸指数衰减（stretched-exponential decay），生成元亦然。

Conclusion: 弱长程相互作用在多项式衰减条件下保持自由费米子体能隙，自由基态可通过准局域谱流连续变形为相互作用基态，且间隙与局域性具有对 |λ| 与相互作用范数的显式控制。

Abstract: We prove that weak long-range many-body interactions preserve the bulk gap of a free fermion system and that a quasi-local spectral flow transports the free ground state to ground states of the interacting system. Let $Φ_h$ be a free fermionic interaction, possibly including pairing terms, whose infinite-volume Majorana coefficient operator $h$ has no spectrum in $(-g,g)$, and let $\mathcal V$ be an even self-adjoint many-body interaction. For sufficiently small $|λ|$, we construct pure ground states $ω_λ$ of the interacting bulk system $Φ_λ=Φ_h+λ\mathcal V$ and quasi-local automorphisms $β_{0,λ}$ such that $ω_λ=ω_0\circβ_{0,λ}$, where $ω_0$ is the free ground state of $Φ_h$. Each $ω_λ$ has a GNS Hamiltonian with gap at least $g-C_*|λ| \|\mathcal V\|_*$, where $\|\cdot\|_*$ is the relevant interaction norm.
  Our result allows polynomial decay of both the free coefficients and the many-body interaction. For two-site interactions on a uniformly discrete point set $Γ\subset\mathbb{R}^d$, a sufficient condition is decay as $(1+|x-y|)^{-\varpi}$ with $\varpi>2d$, for both the hopping and pairing coefficients and the interaction terms. The spectral-flow generator preserves the spatial exponent of the polynomial interaction norm, and its automorphisms satisfy locality bounds at that exponent. If $h$ and $\mathcal V$ have stretched-exponential decay, so does the spectral-flow generator.
  The proof constructs the spectral flow and establishes the gap through an excitation-number comparison, using polynomial propagation bounds for evolved interactions proved in a companion paper.

</details>


### [223] [Symmetries and exact solutions of stochastic differential equations: the CIR model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40316)
*Miguel A. Rodríguez*

Main category: math-ph

TL;DR: 本文通过研究随机微分方程（stochastic differential equation, SDE）的对称性，解释了Cox-Ingersoll-Ross（CIR）利率模型中参数临界关系（critical relation）的来源，并借助该对称性求得模型解，同时重现了近期关于SDE对称性与前向Kolmogorov方程关系的部分结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CIR利率过程中参数之间存在一个众所周知的临界关系，但其理论来源尚未被清晰解释，本文旨在从对称性角度阐明这一关系的本质。

Method: 对CIR对应的随机微分方程进行对称性分析（symmetry analysis），并利用所识别的对称性求解该模型。

Result: 通过SDE的对称性解释了CIR模型中的参数临界关系，并由此得到模型解；同时复现了已有文献中在更广泛框架下关于SDE对称性与前向Kolmogorov方程（forward Kolmogorov equation）关系的结果。

Conclusion: 对称性分析为CIR模型临界关系提供了统一解释，并可作为求解该模型的有效工具，且与既有基于前向Kolmogorov方程的研究结果一致。

Abstract: It is well known that in the celebrated Cox-Ingersoll-Ross process for interest rates there exists a critical relation among the model parameters. In the present work, we explain this critical relation by studying the symmetries of the stochastic differential equation and compute the solution of the model using this symmetry. In this way we also recover results of a recent paper where this property has been studied within a broader context by analyzing the relationships among the symmetries of stochastic differential equations and their corresponding forward Kolmogorov equations.

</details>


### [224] [Local determination of low-energy states in gapped fermion systems with weak long-range interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40337)
*Stefan Teufel*

Main category: math-ph

TL;DR: 该论文研究本体能隙（bulk-gapped）费米子系统在弱相互作用下的低能态局域确定性（local determination），证明在U区域深处的低能态局域期望值接近本体基态，误差随距离衰减，并由此导出基态唯一性、LPPL原理、边界局域化及关联衰减等结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对带谱隙自由哈密顿量加入弱多体相互作用后，低能态是否被本体（bulk）唯一、局域地确定这一问题，需要定量刻画，以支撑基态唯一性、局域扰动局域影响等强结论。

Method: 结合准绝热输运（quasi-adiabatic transport）将自由基态输运至相互作用本体基态，并引入新条件局域激发可检测性（local excitation detectability, LED），在足够弱耦合下证明LED；抽象定理为非微扰形式，凡满足输运与LED假设即可适用。

Result: 证明：当另一相互作用在区域U内与本体一致时，其激发能量在[0,3g/4]内的所有态在U深处的局域期望值接近本体基态，误差随与U补集的距离衰减，且与U外相互作用项及所选低能态无关。

Conclusion: 由此得到：(i) 本体相互作用具唯一代数基态；(ii) 强形式的“局域扰动局域影响（LPPL）”原理成立；(iii) 有限样品低能激发在任意偶边界项下始终局域于边界附近（至衰减尾部）；(iv) U内外关联随空间分离与到U^c距离定量减小。

Abstract: We consider bulk-gapped fermion systems whose infinite-volume bulk is obtained by adding sufficiently weak even many-body interactions to a free Hamiltonian with spectral gap $g>0$, allowing polynomial spatial decay of both parts. We prove quantitative local determination of low-energy states: whenever another interaction agrees with the bulk interaction inside a finite or infinite region $U$, with bulk terms crossing its boundary unchanged or removed, all its states with excitation energies in $[0,3g/4]$ have local expectations close to those of the bulk ground state deep inside $U$. The error decays with the distance to the complement of $U$, independently of the interaction terms supported outside $U$ and of the chosen low-energy state.
  Quantitative local determination has strong consequences. (i) The bulk interaction has a unique algebraic ground state. (ii) A strong "local perturbations perturb locally" (LPPL) principle holds: arbitrary distant defects change local ground-state expectations only by a spatially decaying error. (iii) Low-energy excitations in finite samples remain localized near the boundary for all times, up to spatially decaying tails, uniformly over arbitrary even boundary terms. (iv) Correlations from deep inside $U$ to outside $U$ are small, with quantitative bounds in terms of spatial separation and distance to $U^c$.
  To prove local determination of low-energy states, we combine quasi-adiabatic transport of the free ground state to the interacting bulk ground state with a new condition, local excitation detectability (LED). A companion paper establishes gap stability and constructs the transport for weak interactions, while we prove LED at sufficiently weak coupling. The abstract theorem is nonperturbative and applies whenever the transport and LED hypotheses hold.

</details>


### [225] [Twinor Theory: Field Equations from $(A)dS_4^{\mathbb C}$ Spin-Tractors: A Twin to Twistor Theory Modelled on $(A)dS_4^{\mathbb C}$](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40435)
*Chen-Hsu Chien*

Main category: math-ph

TL;DR: 该文提出“twinor 理论（twinor theory）”，以复化 (A)dS₄ 为模型的纯全纯约化 Cartan 几何（holomorphic reductive Cartan geometry）构造 twist（twistor theory）的时空对应物，统一给出有质量 Dirac–Fierz–Pauli 系统与无质量零静止质量方程，并将非线性引力表述为伴随曲率的 Einstein–Cartan 动力学。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动机是建立 twist（twistor theory）的、以时空为基（spacetime-based）的对应框架，使高自旋场、质量耦合相位与非线性引力能够在同一几何结构（旋量-张量丛与耦合联络）下统一描述。

Method: 以旋量-张量丛（spin-tractor bundle）定义 Dirac twinor，其对称幂给出 ladder twinor，极端 Lorentz 分量给出手征 twinor；核心场方程为 D**Y**=**J**，并对相邻缩并、混合散度施加源关系约束，平坦无挠 Lorentz 背景下约化为 Dirac–Fierz–Pauli 系统与零静止质量方程。

Result: 在固定质量归一化下，给出正实质量平方的现实条件即粒子尺度上的反 de Sitter 现实条件（anti-de Sitter reality condition），且不依赖于宇宙学尺度与背景曲率；非线性引力通过完整伴随曲率（adjoint curvature）与能量-动量、自旋流确定 Einstein–Cartan 动力学而无需作用量。

Conclusion: 伴随 Bianchi 恒等式约束源兼容性，BGG 型序列（BGG-type sequence）组织无挠无穷小形变；物质相互作用经由耦合联络与缩并源关系进入，曲率兼容性由 D**J**=ℱ_D**Y** 记录，并保留两种手征性，同时将相互作用高自旋场的额外一致性要求与丛构造本身相区分。

Abstract: Twinor theory is formulated as a spacetime-based counterpart to twistor theory using holomorphic reductive Cartan geometry modelled on complexified $(A)dS_4$. The fundamental spin-tractor bundle defines Dirac twinors, its symmetric powers define ladder twinors, and their extremal Lorentz components define chiral twinors. The general \textit{twinor field equation} is $D\mathbf Y=\mathbf J$. Its adjacent contractions and mixed divergence are constrained by source relations; no additional equation is imposed on its completely symmetric projection. On a flat torsion-free Lorentzian background, the adjacent equations with the mass-normalization source and vanishing additional contracted sources, together with vanishing mixed divergence, reproduce the massive \textit{Dirac--Fierz--Pauli system}; the massless chiral realization gives the zero-rest-mass equations. Within the fixed mass normalization, the reality condition yielding a positive real mass squared is the \textit{anti-de Sitter reality condition} on the particle scale, independently of the cosmological scale and background curvature. The mass-coupling phase is therefore present in the classical connection before quantization. Nonlinear gravity is formulated through the full adjoint curvature, with energy--momentum and spin currents specifying Einstein--Cartan dynamics without requiring an action. The adjoint Bianchi identity constrains source compatibility, while a BGG-type sequence organizes torsion-free infinitesimal deformations. Matter interactions enter through the coupled connection and contracted source relations, with curvature compatibility recorded by $D\mathbf J=\mathcal F_D\mathbf Y$. Both chiralities are retained, and the additional consistency requirements for interacting higher-spin fields are distinguished from the underlying bundle construction.

</details>


### [226] [Entropic Fluctuations in Quantum Statistical Mechanics: A Review](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40463)
*Tristan Benoist,Laurent Bruneau,Vojkan Jakšić,Aannalisa Panati,Claude-Alain Pillet*

Main category: math-ph

TL;DR: 本文综述并比较了熵产生涨落定理（fluctuation theorem, FT）在量子系统中的若干推广路径，重点介绍作者近期系列工作中的代数框架，并给出 Gallavotti–Cohen（稳态）版本向两时测量熵产生的此前缺失的推广。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典情形下 Evans–Searles 与 Gallavotti–Cohen 涨落定理刻画了瞬态与稳态熵产生率的普适统计特征，如何将其推广到量子系统尚缺乏统一图景，因此有必要系统梳理与比较现有方案。

Method: 以开放量子系统（小系统耦合多个无限延伸热库）为对象，在量子动力系统的代数框架下综述四条路径：朴素方案（naive）、两时测量（two-time measurement）、相空间收缩（phase space contraction）与辅助态层析（ancilla state tomography），并结合模理论（modular theory）讨论经典概念的量子化。

Result: 给出 Gallavotti–Cohen 稳态版本对两时测量熵产生的缺失推广；讨论正则熵涨落原理（principle of regular entropic fluctuations）的量子版本；并将各类熵产生的统计性质与量子转移算子（quantum transfer operator）的谱共振（spectral resonances）相联系，应用于自旋-费米子模型（spin-fermion model）。

Conclusion: 该综述为量子统计力学中熵涨落（entropic fluctuations）的本质提供了新的视角，并表明谱共振方法是连接涨落定理与具体非平衡模型的有效工具。

Abstract: The celebrated Evans--Searles, respectively Gallavotti--Cohen, fluctuation theorem concerns certain universal statistical features of the entropy production rate of a classical system in a transient, respectively steady, state. In this paper, we review and compare several possible extensions of these fluctuation theorems to quantum systems. We present, in an introductory way, the approach proposed in a recent series of works [Lett. Math. Phys. 114, 32 (2024): doi:10.1007/s11005-024-01777-0], [Rev. Math. Phys 38, 2461006 (2026): doi:10.1142/S0129055X24610063], [Commun. Math. Phys. 406, 201 (2025): 10.1007/s00220-025-05360-z] and [J. Math. Phys. 67, 022101 (2026): doi:10.1063/5.0311182] including a previously missing extension of the Gallavotti--Cohen (steady state) version of the FT to two-time measurement entropy production in the algebraic setting of quantum dynamical systems. We focus on the open quantum systems, where a small system interacts with several (infinitely extended) reservoirs, and discuss the following approaches: naive, two-time measurement, phase space contraction and ancilla state tomography. We review the connection with modular theory. The latter provides a way to extend the classical notions to the quantum domain. We discuss the quantum version of the principle of regular entropic fluctuations, introduced in the classical context in [Nonlinearity 24, 699 (2011): doi:10.1088/0951-7715/24/3/003]. Finally, we relate the statistical properties of these various notions of entropy production to spectral resonances of quantum transfer operators and apply this approach to a paradigmatic model of non-equilibrium statistical mechanics: the spin-fermion model. The results presented here shed a new light on the nature of entropic fluctuations in quantum statistical mechanics.

</details>


### [227] [Generalized Dirac Equation in Metric-Affine Spacetimes: Consistency, Effective Mass, and Spinor Curvature](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.23609)
*Muzaffer Adak,Ali Bagci,Caglar Pala,Ozcan Sert*

Main category: math-ph

TL;DR: The paper formulates a generalized Dirac equation in four-dimensional metric-affine spacetimes with curvature, torsion, and non-metricity, reduces 16 real parameters to 8 via consistency conditions, and derives an effective mass and chiral phase from coframe couplings.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Standard Dirac equations are usually formulated in Riemannian or flat spacetimes, leaving the general coupling of the full metric-affine geometry (curvature, torsion, non-metricity) to the spinor connection untreated; a general formulation and clarification of its parameter freedom are needed.

Method: The spinor connection is expanded over the complete Clifford algebra cl(1,3) basis with eight complex couplings; agreement between direct covariantization of the Dirac equation and variation of the symmetrized Lagrangian imposes eight real consistency conditions; Hermiticity of the Hamiltonian with respect to the curved-space Dirac inner product in the static isotropic symmetric teleparallel sector constrains non-metricity and coframe couplings.

Result: Consistency conditions reduce 16 independent real parameters to 8; Hermiticity reproduces restrictions on non-metricity and coframe couplings. Coframe-dependent terms yield scalar and pseudoscalar mass contributions persisting in Minkowski spacetime; for a single free Dirac field with constant coefficients, one effective mass m_eff=√((m−4b_3)²+16b_4²) and a chiral phase removable by constant chiral field redefinition arise, so nonzero effective mass is possible even when the original mass parameter vanishes. A Clifford decomposition of the generalized spinor curvature is derived, showing it can remain nonzero when affine curvature, torsion, and non-metricity all vanish; for m=0, b_3²+b_4² determines both the effective mass squared and the surviving spinor curvature.

Conclusion: In metric-affine spacetimes, coframe couplings can induce an effective mass and chiral phase that persist even in flat spacetime, and may generate nonzero spinor curvature independent of curvature, torsion, and non-metricity; for m=0, b_3²+b_4² algebraically links the effective mass and spinor curvature.

Abstract: We formulate a generalized Dirac equation in four-dimensional metric-affine spacetimes with curvature, torsion, and non-metricity. The spinor connection is expanded over the complete basis of the Clifford algebra $cl(1,3)$ and contains eight complex coupling constants. Requiring agreement between direct covariantization of the Dirac equation and variation of the corresponding symmetrized Lagrangian imposes eight real consistency conditions, reducing the number of independent real parameters from sixteen to eight. In the static isotropic symmetric teleparallel sector, formal Hermiticity of the Hamiltonian with respect to the curved-space Dirac inner product reproduces the corresponding restrictions on the non-metricity and coframe couplings. The coframe-dependent terms introduce scalar and pseudoscalar mass contributions that persist in Minkowski spacetime. For a single free Dirac field with constant coefficients, they yield one effective mass, $m_{\mathrm{eff}}=\sqrt{(m-4b_3)^2+16b_4^2}$, and a chiral phase removable by a constant chiral field redefinition. A nonzero effective mass is therefore possible even when the original mass parameter vanishes. We also derive the Clifford decomposition of the generalized spinor curvature and show that it can remain nonzero when affine curvature, torsion, and non-metricity all vanish. When $m=0$, the combination $b_3^2+b_4^2$ determines both the effective mass squared and the surviving spinor curvature, establishing an algebraic link between these contributions.

</details>

### [228] [Search for $^4\overline{\mathrm{Li}}$ from $\overline{\mathrm{p}}+{}^3\overline{\mathrm{He}}$ femtoscopy in Pb-Pb collisions at $\sqrt{s_\mathrm{NN}} =5.36$ TeV with ALICE](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38549)
*Giorgio Alberto Lucia*

Main category: nucl-ex

TL;DR: 本文报道了在 ALICE 实验的 Pb-Pb 碰撞中利用飞秒关联（femtoscopic correlations）技术，通过 $^4\overline{\mathrm{Li}} \rightarrow \overline{\mathrm{p}} + {}^3\overline{\mathrm{He}}$ 两体衰变道搜索反超氘核类超核 $^4\overline{\mathrm{Li}}$，并扣除组合背景后将产额与 $^4\overline{\mathrm{He}}$ 比较。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 由于存在多个 $^4\mathrm{Li}$ 共振态及其自旋简并（spin degeneracy），$^4\overline{\mathrm{Li}}$ 的产额预计相对于结构紧凑的 $^4\overline{\mathrm{He}}$ 有所增强，因此该测量可作为检验高能强子碰撞中核合成（nucleosynthesis）模型的灵敏探针。

Method: 采用飞秒关联（femtoscopic correlations）方法，通过 $^4\overline{\mathrm{Li}} \rightarrow \overline{\mathrm{p}} + {}^3\overline{\mathrm{He}}$ 两体衰变道重建该粒子，并发展专门的分析流程以扣除 $\overline{\mathrm{p}} + ^3\overline{\mathrm{He}}$ 的关联与非关联组合背景（combinatorial background）。

Result: 在扣除组合背景后获得 $^4\overline{\mathrm{Li}}$ 的产生产额（production yield），并将其与 $^4\overline{\mathrm{He}}$ 的产额进行对比。

Conclusion: 该测量为检验高能强子碰撞中的核合成模型提供了灵敏探针，其中 $^4\overline{\mathrm{Li}}$ 相对 $^4\overline{\mathrm{He}}$ 的预期产额增强源于共振态与自旋简并效应。

Abstract: In these proceedings, the search for $^4\overline{\mathrm{Li}}$ in Pb-Pb collisions with ALICE is presented. The particle is reconstructed via its two-body decay channel $^4\overline{\mathrm{Li}} \rightarrow \overline{\mathrm{p}} + {}^3\overline{\mathrm{He}}$, using femtoscopic correlations. A dedicated analysis procedure has been developed to subtract the correlated and uncorrelated $\overline{\mathrm{p}} + ^3\overline{\mathrm{He}}$ combinatorial background. The production yield of $^4\overline{\mathrm{Li}}$ is compared with that of $^4\overline{\mathrm{He}}$. Owing to the presence of several $^4\mathrm{Li}$ resonances and their spin degeneracy, the production of $^4\overline{\mathrm{Li}}$ is expected to be enhanced with respect to the compact $^4\overline{\mathrm{He}}$, making this new measurement a sensitive probe for testing nucleosynthesis models in high-energy hadronic collisions.

</details>

### [229] [Drift-induced nonreciprocity in image-polariton-mediated dipole emission](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38348)
*Christian Nicolaisen Hansen,Eduardo J. C. Dias,Christos Tserkezis,Joel D. Cox*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 通过电流偏置（current bias）在石墨烯-六方氮化硼（hBN）异质结构中实现无磁非互易等离激元传输；像极化激元（image polariton）结构可同时增强模式限制（confinement）并保持相当的Fizeau频移，偶极-偶极相互作用左右不对称度可达约40%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电偏置提供无需磁场的纳米尺度非互易光传播途径，但石墨烯等离激元与hBN声子极化激元（phonon polariton）耦合对漂移诱导非互易性的影响尚需阐明。

Method: 采用随机相位近似（random-phase approximation）与玻尔兹曼输运方程（Boltzmann transport equation）表征漂移偏置石墨烯的非局域光学响应，并对比石墨烯/hBN结构与石墨烯-薄hBN间隔层-金衬底构成的像极化激元结构。

Result: 载流子漂移使极化激元色散（polariton dispersion）产生显著方向性频移，与hBN声子极化激元耦合强烈改变非互易响应；像极化激元结构中限制增强至多两倍且保留相近Fizeau频移，并产生方向性近场发射及经光学态交叉密度（cross density of optical states）量化的非互易偶极-偶极相互作用。

Conclusion: 漂移偏置石墨烯中的像极化激元构成紧凑、电可调平台，可用于纳米尺度量子发射器间的方向性耦合。

Abstract: Electrical current bias offers a magnet-free route to nonreciprocal light propagation at the nanoscale. Here, we theoretically explore drift-induced nonreciprocity in graphene heterostructures containing hexagonal boron nitride (hBN), where graphene plasmons interact with hBN phonon polaritons in the infrared. Both the random-phase approximation and the Boltzmann transport equation are used to characterize the nonlocal optical response of drift-biased graphene. We compare graphene on hBN with an image-polaritonic structure comprising graphene, a thin hBN spacer, and a gold substrate. Carrier drift produces pronounced directional shifts of the polariton dispersion, while coupling to hBN phonon polaritons strongly modifies the nonreciprocal response. In the image-polaritonic structure, the graphene polaritons become up to twice as confined while retaining a comparable Fizeau shift. The nonreciprocal polariton dispersion produces directional near-field emission and nonreciprocal dipole-dipole interactions, the latter quantified through the cross density of optical states, reaching a left-right dissymmetry of up to ~40%. Our results identify image polaritons in drift-biased graphene as a compact, electrically tunable platform for directional coupling between quantum emitters at the nanoscale.

</details>


### [230] [Non-Markovian quantum-emitter dynamics and bound-state formation in an Aubry--André--Harper photonic lattice](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39707)
*Zahra Jalali-Mola,Jule Neidhart,Saeid Asgarnezhad-Zorgabad,Ortwin Hess*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 在耦合到Aubry-André-Harper（AAH）光子晶格的两能级量子发射体中，准周期调制通过改变耦合位点的局域态密度与模式重叠，从扩展态经多重分形临界态到局域态地调控发射体非马尔可夫动力学，并在临界点产生显著相干反馈振荡与发射体-光子束缚态导致的长期布居俘获。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非马尔可夫光-物质相互作用中，谱结构化的浴会通过改变真空涨落影响量子发射体演化，但准周期势诱导的局域化转变及其多重分形临界模式如何塑造发射体动力学尚不清楚。

Method: 在单激发子空间研究耦合到AAH光子晶格的两能级发射体，通过外部调节准周期在位调制强度使晶格从扩展区经多重分形临界点进入局域区，并用模式分析（modal analysis）考察耦合位点局域态密度与有效谱耦合。

Result: 瞬态动力学强烈依赖发射体与晶格模式的空间与谱重叠：临界调制以下的扩展模式通常导致快速布居衰减，而临界与局域模式产生相干反作用与持续的类拉比振荡（Rabi-like oscillations），临界点尤为显著；同时识别出由浴的准周期谱结构控制形成、并可导致部分长期布居俘获的发射体-光子束缚态（emitter-photon bound states）。

Conclusion: 结果建立了准周期局域化、非马尔可夫动力学与发射体-光子束缚态形成之间的直接联系。

Abstract: In non-Markovian light-matter interactions, a spectrally structured bath can alter the evolution of a quantum emitter by modifying the vacuum fluctuations experienced by the emitter. This raises the question of how the localization transition and the associated multifractal critical modes induced by a quasiperiodic potential shape the emitter dynamics. We investigate this scenario in the single-excitation sector for a two-level quantum emitter coupled to an Aubry-André-Harper (AAH) photonic lattice. By externally tuning the strength of the quasiperiodic onsite modulation, the lattice is tuned from the extended to the localized regime through a critical point characterized by multifractal modes. Using modal analysis, we show that the quasiperiodic modulation reshapes the local density of states at the coupling site and thereby controls the effective spectral coupling between the emitter and the lattice. The transient dynamics depend strongly on the spatial and spectral overlap between the emitter and the lattice modes: extended modes below the critical modulation generally produce rapid depopulation, whereas critical and localized modes give rise to coherent back-action and persistent Rabi-like oscillations, with particularly pronounced behavior at the critical point. We further identify emitter-photon bound states whose formation is controlled by the quasiperiodic spectral structure of the bath and whose overlap with the initially excited state leads to partial long-time population trapping. These results establish a direct connection between quasiperiodic localization, non-Markovian dynamics, and emitter-photon bound-state formation.

</details>


### [231] [Ghosts in the nanomachine: dynamical slowing-down in the phase-space of nanomechanical strings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39968)
*Samer Houri,Agnes Zinth,Menno Poot*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 该工作利用高灵敏度、低耗散的腔光力系统（cavity opto-mechanical system）研究纳机电杜芬谐振器（Duffing resonator）的振铃衰减（ringdown）动力学，揭示单音与双音驱动下截然不同的相空间（phase space）行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微纳机械器件的线性行为已被大量研究，而其非线性行为仍不断呈现新颖动力学；本文旨在捕捉强驱动非线性谐振器弛豫至平衡态过程中的快速瞬态动力学。

Method: 采用具有极高灵敏度与低耗散率的腔光力系统，在时域与相空间中实验研究纳机械杜芬谐振器的振铃衰减，并对比单音（one tone）与双音（two tone）驱动两种情形。

Result: 单音驱动下振铃表现为规则的指数衰减（exponential decay）；双音驱动下则出现天平动（libration）、相空间中散射同时减速以及幽灵减速（ghost slowing-down）等奇特动力学，差异可归因于相空间本身的结构。谐振器能量呈非单调变化，且驱动关闭后运动幅度衰减存在长延迟，形成动力学亚稳态（dynamical meta-states）。

Conclusion: 单音与双音驱动下振铃衰减的显著差异源于相空间结构差异；非线性谐振器的能量非单调演化与长延迟效应可产生动力学亚稳态。

Abstract: The linear behavior of micro- and nanomechanical devices has been the topic of intense study over the past years. Their nonlinear behavior, on the other hand, continues to provide new and interesting dynamics. This work leverages a cavity opto-mechanical system whose very high sensitivity and low dissipation rate allows to capture the dynamics of fast transients that occur when strongly-driven nonlinear resonators relax to their equilibrium state. We experimentally study the ringdown dynamics of a nanomechanical Duffing resonator in both the time domain and in phase space. The resonator exhibits very different ringdown dynamics depending on whether it is subject to one or two tone driving. In the former case the ringdown follows a regular exponential decay, whereas the latter case shows exotic dynamics such as libration, slowing-down while scattering in phase-space, and ghost slowing-down. We demonstrate that this distinct difference can be attributed to the structure of the phase space itself. Surprisingly, we find that the energy in the resonator changes non-monotonously and that long delay between turning off the drive and the decay of the motion amplitude results in dynamical meta-states.

</details>


### [232] [Multistable nematic liquid crystal pores as reconfigurable optical vortex metasurfaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40123)
*Claire Doré,Brian Edwards,Nader Engheta,Kathleen J. Stebe*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 亚波长圆柱孔中向列相液晶（nematic liquid crystals）的导向矢拓扑（radial、escaped、arches）会将近场圆偏振光转换为具有不同相位奇点签名的涡旋，但该签名在约一个波长内即被衍射与孔间干涉抹除；电场可在拓扑间切换且各态局域稳定，构成可重构、非易失的近场拓扑编码读出平台。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 孔中液晶存在多种稳定导向矢拓扑，已有研究关注其光学印记，但孔径向光学波长（optical wavelength）收缩时该机制是否保留、以及拓扑编码信息能否在远场被读取，尚不明确。

Method: 采用Landau–de Gennes理论模拟与Jones计算（Jones calculus）建模，并以微米尺度实验验证；进一步对周期性亚波长孔阵列进行全波Maxwell仿真（full-wave Maxwell simulations），考察近场至远场的传播行为，并用Landau–de Gennes模拟研究电场切换。

Result: 各拓扑的涡旋拓扑荷（topological charge）由投影导向矢绕数（director winding number）决定，为ℓ = 2m；孔径缩小至波长尺度时机制仍成立。各拓扑在阵列正下方留下可区分的相位奇点签名（核的多重性、核宽、环振幅不同），但传播约一个波长后被衍射与孔间干涉擦除，故属纯近场现象。外加电场可实现拓扑及其近场签名的切换。

Conclusion: 亚波长向列相液晶孔阵列可作为电可重构、非易失（non-volatile）的拓扑编码近场光学读出平台，潜在应用于光学标记（optical labeling）与防伪（anti-counterfeiting）；但其读出必须在近场完成，远场读取不可行。

Abstract: Nematic liquid crystals confined in cylindrical pores adopt multiple stable director topologies --- radial, escaped, and arches --- each imprinting a distinct optical signature on transmitted circularly polarized light, with topological charge set by the projected director winding number, $\ell = 2m$. Using Landau--de Gennes and Jones-calculus modeling validated against micron-scale experiments, we show that this mechanism persists as the pore diameter shrinks toward the optical wavelength. However, full-wave Maxwell simulations of periodic sub-wavelength pore arrays reveal that the resulting vortex is a near-field phenomenon only: each topology imprints a distinguishable phase-singular signature --- differing in core multiplicity, core width, and ring amplitude --- directly below the pore array, but this signature does not survive propagation into the far field, where diffraction and inter-pore interference erase it within about one wavelength. Landau--de Gennes simulations further demonstrate that an applied electric field switches the pore between topologies, and hence between their near-field optical signatures. Because each topology is locally stable, sub-wavelength NLC pore arrays constitute an electrically reconfigurable, non-volatile platform for topology-encoded near-field optical readout, with potential application to optical labeling and anti-counterfeiting.

</details>


### [233] [Scale-free wave localization at topological multicriticality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40125)
*Zhijie Xue,Yuan Tian,Nanyu Chen,Xiujuan Zhang,Tao Li,Shuang Zhang,Fuxin Guan*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 本文在声学超材料（acoustic metamaterials）中观测到一种无标度（scale-free）边界模式，其空间包络呈严格线性而非传统指数衰减，并将其归因于拓扑多临界性（topological multicriticality）与突变理论（catastrophe theory）中的A_n型突变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空间波局域化（spatial wave localization）通常被认为局限于指数衰减形式，而现有临界拓扑（critical topology）框架依赖纠缠谱（entanglement spectra）判断无能隙区模式是否存在，难以直接给出实空间波函数的确定性刻画。

Method: 将n阶拓扑多临界性映射到Arnold A_n突变（Arnold A_n catastrophe），建立基于奇点理论（singularity theory）的几何体-边对应（bulk-boundary correspondence）；并证明空间转移矩阵（spatial transfer matrix）的亏损性（defectiveness）导致边界模式的(n-1)次幂空间衰减；在声学超材料平台将体系调至三临界点进行一维与二维实验验证。

Result: 拓扑三临界点（topological tricritical point）处绕数函数（winding function）的奇点表现为A_2折叠突变（A_2 fold catastrophe），对应严格线性空间衰减；一维实验观测到线性衰减包络，并推广至二维体系实现沿正交方向同时线性衰减的无标度角模式（scale-free corner modes）。

Conclusion: 该工作将突变理论与多临界性下的拓扑物质相连接，把研究从抽象的模存在性判别推进到确定性的实空间波函数工程（real-space wavefunction engineering），突破了指数标度（exponential scaling）的传统范式。

Abstract: Spatial wave localization at boundaries is conventionally restricted to exponential decay. Here, we observe a scale-free boundary mode exhibiting anomalous polynomial decay, highlighted by strictly linear spatial envelopes, driven by topological multicriticality in acoustic metamaterials. We establish a universal geometric bulk-boundary correspondence rooted in singularity theory by mapping n-th order topological multicriticality onto Arnold An catastrophe. We prove that defectiveness in the spatial transfer matrix enforces a (n-1)-th power spatial decay of boundary modes. At a topological tri-critical point, the singularity of winding function manifests as an A2 fold catastrophe. This dictates a strictly linear spatial decay, marking a sharp departure from the conventional exponential scaling paradigm. Using acoustic metamaterial platforms tuned to a tricritical point, we experimentally demonstrate this linear decay envelope in 1D, and further generalize it to two-dimensional systems to realize scale-free corner modes with simultaneous linear decay along orthogonal directions. While existing critical topology frameworks rely on entanglement spectra to diagnose mode existence in gapless regimes, our work bridges catastrophe theory with topological matter at multicriticalities, advancing the field from abstract mode identification to deterministic real-space wavefunction engineering.

</details>

### [234] [The coupled spread of information and potential-driven motion in evacuating agent populations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40081)
*Benjamin A. Jasperson,Logan Dehay,Rahul Gulati,Siddhartha Srivastava,Krishna Garikipati*

Main category: physics.soc-ph

TL;DR: 该文提出一个基于智能体（agent-based）的耦合框架，将警报信息传播的流行病学状态（易感、暴露、知情、逆转）与个体运动相耦合，用伊藤随机微分方程（Ito stochastic differential equation）驱动智能体在含危险区与安全区的势场中移动，并考察势场结构与引导路径对疏散效果的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人群能否安全疏散取决于两个耦合过程：警报在人群中的传播，以及该信息如何驱动人们移动。既有研究往往将信息传播与运动分离处理，因而需要一个能显式刻画二者相互作用的建模框架。

Method: 构建智能体框架：每个智能体的信息状态（易感 susceptible、暴露 exposed、知情 informed、逆转 reverted）对其运动构成门控；仅知情智能体响应编码危险与安全区的全局背景势，所有智能体通过伦纳德-琼斯势（Lennard-Jones potential）发生局部相互作用；智能体所受总势驱动一个伊藤随机微分方程。

Result: 含势能极小值的景观相比平坦均匀势场的对照组，使“从未暴露”的智能体数量大幅减少，原因是知情智能体被驱向极小值途中会掠过易感邻居；引导路径（conduit routes）提高安全区极小值中的智能体比例，但相比无引导疏散会留下更多从未暴露的智能体，因其缩短行程却减少了知情者与易感邻居的接触；由这些接触估计的有效信息传播率（effective information transmission rate）在首个时间单位内约比其充分混合（well-mixed）值低六十倍。

Conclusion: 空间结构显著改变信息传播与疏散结果：势场极小值与引导路径存在“效率—覆盖”权衡。状态转换会产生净传播抑制的空间机制，平均场封闭（mean-field closure）无法刻画，因而估计传播率须考虑空间效应。

Abstract: Whether a population evacuates safely depends on two coupled processes: how a warning spreads through it, and how that information moves people. We model this coupling with an agent-based framework, in which each agent's information state--susceptible, exposed, informed or reverted--gates its motion. Only informed agents respond to a global background potential encoding hazards and safe zones, while all agents interact locally through a Lennard-Jones potential. The total potential experienced by an agent drives an Ito stochastic differential equation. Tests show that landscapes with potential minima leave far fewer agents never exposed than in a flat, uniform potential control landscape, as informed agents driven toward the minima sweep past susceptible neighbors. In our tests, conduit routes raise the fraction of agents in the safe-zone minima, but leave greater numbers of agents never exposed, when compared to an unguided evacuation. This is attributed to conduits shortening trips at the cost of informed agents having fewer encounters with susceptible neighbors who could receive their information. Independently, the effective information transmission rate estimated from these encounters falls roughly sixty-fold below its well-mixed value within the first time unit, because state transitions create spatial mechanisms of net transmission suppression that mean-field closure does not capture.

</details>
