### [235] [GæniceN: a minimal model to relax magnetization states self-consistently in general artificial spin ices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37889)
*H. Braun,E. Freeman,G. Alatteili,E. Iacocca*

Main category: cond-mat.mes-hall

TL;DR: 该工作基于 Gaenice 框架提出 GaeniceN，一种通过迭代实现 Landau-Lifshitz 方程耗散项的弛豫方法，可自洽稳定人工自旋冰（artificial spin ices）的磁化状态，并正确预测金字塔型人工自旋冰在外场下的相变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人工自旋冰在 GHz 频段的动力学研究因存在多个模式以及纳米磁体边缘磁化偏差而具有挑战性，需以每个纳米磁体三个宏观自旋（macrospins）的最小模型来描述；然而缺乏可自洽获得稳定初始磁化状态的手段。

Method: 在 Gaenice 框架内实现 Landau-Lifshitz 方程（Landau-Lifshitz equation）的耗散项，采用迭代方式高效收敛至弛豫态；该方法即 GaeniceN，并为 Gaenice 提供计算动力学所需的初始条件。

Result: 以受低强度外场的金字塔型人工自旋冰（pyramid ASI）为例，通过计算系统平均能量，该方法能够正确预测相之间的转变。

Conclusion: GaeniceN 与 Gaenice 基于同一框架，前者产生初始条件、后者计算铁磁共振（ferromagnetic resonance）或能带结构等动力学，两工具结合可辅助面向磁子学（magnonics）应用的人工自旋冰设计。

Abstract: Artificial spin ices are geometric arrangement of nanomagnets that exhibit reconfigurable magnetization states and GHz dynamics. Their investigation in the GHz regime is challenging because of the existence of multiple modes and the impact of magnetization deviations at the edges of the nanomagnets. A minimal model to capture such dynamics require three macrospins per nanomagnet, an approach that was implemented for generic artificial spin ices in the tool Gaenice. Here, we use the Gaenice framework to realize a relaxation method to stabilize magnetization states self-consistently, called GaeniceN. We implement the dissipative component of the Landau-Lifshitz equation in an iterative approach to efficiently converge to the relaxed state. As an example, we find our approach to correctly predict the transition between phases in a pyramid ASI subject to a low-magnitude external field by computing the system's average energy. Because they are rooted on the same framework, GaeniceN produces the initial condition needed for Gaenice to compute dynamics such as ferromagnetic resonance or band structures. Combined, these tools will be able to aid in the design of artificial spin ices with applications in magnonics.

</details>


### [236] [Anomalous Hall Conductivity as an Intrinsic Property of a Tight-Binding Graph](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37939)
*E. S. Andriyakhina,G. Lemut,P. W. Brouwer*

Main category: cond-mat.mes-hall

TL;DR: 在弹道输运（ballistic transport）体系中，反常直流霍尔响应（anomalous dc Hall response）通常依赖微观细节（几何嵌入与测量实现方式）。本文指出，引入杂质散射弛豫后，完整霍尔电导率（full dc Hall conductivity）变为与嵌入（embedding）无关，但各分项贡献仍依赖嵌入，并给出能带项本身嵌入无关的对称性判据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 弹道体系中反常霍尔响应依赖轨道几何嵌入（geometric embedding）与测量协议（measurement protocol）等微观细节，因此需要厘清在何种条件下该响应可视为系统的内禀（intrinsic）性质。

Method: 通过区分霍尔电导率中的内禀能带项（intrinsic band term）、外禀侧跳项（side-jump）与反常分布项（anomalous-distribution），分析其在杂质散射（impurity scattering）弛豫下对嵌入的依赖关系，并推导能带项嵌入无关的对称性判据（symmetry criterion）。

Result: 在存在杂质散射弛豫时，完整直流霍尔响应 σ_xy^H 变为与嵌入无关；而内禀能带项及外禀侧跳、反常分布各项单独仍保持嵌入依赖。此外，能带项本身嵌入无关的对称性条件既不能使其等同于完整霍尔电导率，也不足以使其成为 σ_xy^H 的可靠近似。

Conclusion: 嵌入依赖性（embedding dependence）可作为判别响应系数是否为材料稳态内禀性质、抑或仍对测量协议敏感的诊断指标。

Abstract: In a ballistic system, the anomalous dc Hall response generically depends on microscopic details, including the geometric embedding of the orbitals and the precise implementation of the measurement. Here, we consider the question under what circumstances the anomalous Hall conductivity can be regarded as an intrinsic property of a system. We show that the full dc Hall response $σ_{xy}^{\rm H}$ becomes embedding-independent in the presence of relaxation by impurity scattering, although the individual (intrinsic) band and (extrinsic) side-jump and anomalous-distribution contributions to the Hall conductivity separately remain embedding-dependent. We further derive a symmetry criterion for when the band term itself becomes embedding-independent, but argue that this alone neither identifies it with the full Hall conductivity $σ_{xy}^{\rm H}$, nor makes it a reliable approximation for $σ_{xy}^{\rm H}$. More broadly, our results establish embedding dependence as a diagnostic of whether a response coefficient represents a stationary intrinsic property of a material or retains sensitivity to measurement protocol.

</details>


### [237] [Few-Electron Partitioning in the Fractional Quantum Hall Regime](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37950)
*T. Jonckheere,J. Rech,B. Grémaud*

Main category: cond-mat.mes-hall

TL;DR: 本文研究分数量子霍尔点接触处 $N$ 电子态的分割统计（partition statistics），在可解点 $g=1/2$ 给出任意驱动下的非微扰电流与噪声公式，并指出电荷仅以 $e$ 为单位转移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究动机来自少电子分割实验（few-electron partitioning experiments，Shaju et al., Nature 642, 928 (2025)），需要理论刻画分数量子霍尔点接触处的电子分割统计。

Method: 在可解点 $g=1/2$ 推导任意驱动下的非微扰（nonperturbative）电流与噪声公式；对洛伦兹脉冲（Lorentzian pulses，即 Levitons），将全计数统计（full counting statistics）化为 $N\times N$ 行列式。

Result: 电荷仅以 $e$ 为单位转移；$N=2,3,4$ 的对称化累积量（symmetrized cumulants）显示强反聚束（antibunching）与高阶关联，并可在 $(\\nu_1,\\nu_2)=(1,1/3)$ 结中观测。

Conclusion: 该工作为少电子分割实验提供了非微扰理论框架，并给出在 $(1,1/3)$ 分数量子霍尔结中检验反聚束与高阶关联的可观测预言。

Abstract: Motivated by few-electron partitioning experiments [Shaju et al., Nature 642, 928 (2025)], we study the partition statistics of $N$-electron states at a fractional quantum Hall point contact. At the solvable point $g=1/2$, we obtain nonperturbative current and noise formulas for arbitrary drives, while for Lorentzian pulses (Levitons) the full counting statistics reduces to an $N\times N$ determinant. We show that the charge is transferred solely in units of $e$, and that symmetrized cumulants for $N=2,3,4$ reveal strong antibunching and higher-order correlations, observable in a $(ν_1,ν_2)=(1,1/3)$ junction.

</details>


### [238] [Coherent control and high purity single-photon emission from telecom quantum dots on metamorphic InGaAs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38060)
*Beatrice Costa,Bianca Scaparra,Hubert Riedl,Gregor Koblmüller,Eugenio Zallo,Jonathan J. Finley,Lukas Hanschke,Kai Müller*

Main category: cond-mat.mes-hall

TL;DR: 该工作利用相干准共振激发与声子辅助激发，系统表征了面向通信波段（telecom bands）的InAs量子点（quantum dots）本征光学性质，获得21 μeV窄线宽与10⁻²量级单光子纯度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 发射于通信O波段与C波段的半导体量子点是光纤量子通信（fiber-based quantum communication）单光子源（single-photon sources）的候选体系，但需厘清激发诱导效应与本征发射体性质，以评估其在量子技术中的实际潜力。

Method: 研究对象为生长于弛豫InGaAs基质（relaxed InGaAs matrices）及变质缓冲InGaAs层（metamorphic InGaAs layers）上的InAs量子点；通过系统比较相干准共振激发（quasi-resonant excitation）、声子辅助激发（phonon-assisted excitation）等方案，分离激发诱导效应与本征性质，并结合光致发光激发谱（photoluminescence excitation）与相干控制测量。

Result: 观测到窄至21 μeV的线宽、慢衰减通道（slow decay channels）消失，以及二阶自相关（second-order autocorrelation）值达10⁻²量级的单光子纯度；激发谱揭示更高激发态，实现对三激子跃迁（trion transitions）的相干控制，并在两个通信波段均观察到类Rabi振荡（Rabi-like oscillations）。

Conclusion: 结果确认该类通信波段InAs量子点在量子技术应用方面具有良好潜力，并表明激发方案的系统比较是提取发射体本征光学参数的有效途径。

Abstract: Semiconductor quantum dots emitting in the telecommunication O- and C-bands are promising candidates as single-photon sources for fiber-based quantum communication. In this work, we show how coherent quasi-resonant and phonon-assisted excitation help reveal the intrinsic optical properties of InAs quantum dots embedded in relaxed InGaAs matrices on top of metamorphic InGaAs layers for achieving emission in the telecom bands. By systematically comparing excitation schemes, we separate excitation-induced effects from intrinsic emitter properties. This allows us to observe linewidths as narrow as 21 $μ$eV, the disappearance of slow decay channels, and single-photon purity reaching second-order autocorrelation values in the order of $10^{-2}$. Photoluminescence excitation reveals higher excited states, enabling coherent control of trion transitions and the observation of Rabi-like oscillations in both telecom bands. These results confirm the promising potential of these quantum dots for applications in quantum technologies.

</details>


### [239] [Incoherent dark excitons extend Floquet-like physics across time and momentum](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38156)
*Xing Zhu,Jacques Hawecker,Enrico Perfetto,Vivek Pareek,David R. Bacon,Harley Suchiang,Nanami Tomoda,Amrita Mitra,Takumi Fukuda,Sebastien Roux,Ouri Karni,Jack Featherstone,Kenji Watanabe,Takashi Taniguchi,Michael K. L. Man,Julien Madéo,Felipe H. da Jornada,Gianluca Stefanucci,Keshav M. Dani*

Main category: cond-mat.mes-hall

TL;DR: 利用WSe₂/MoS₂异质结中的非相干暗层间激子（dark interlayer excitons），实验实现了类Floquet（Floquet-like）的能带杂化现象，且寿命延长至近纳秒量级，并可通过激子密度与扭转角调控能带色散与动量偏移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统Floquet现象依赖相干、时间周期性的驱动场，其效应仅在驱动相干时间内（亚皮秒）存在，限制实际应用；本文旨在验证超越平均场（mean-field）图像的理论预测，寻找一种长寿命的类Floquet电子态调控途径。

Method: 采用时间分辨与角分辨光电子能谱（time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy）测量WSe₂/MoS₂异质结，引入非相干且密集的暗层间激子布居，并改变激子密度与扭转角（twist angle）以考察能带演化。

Result: 暗层间激子使导带与价带的能量复制副本（energy-replicated copies）发生杂化，效应持续近纳秒；随激子密度增加，价带及其副本由倒抛物型（inverted-parabolic）演化为墨西哥帽型（Mexican-hat）色散，标志存在非零静态耦合（static coupling）且与激子密度线性标度；调节扭转角可使具有净动量的暗激子产生在能量与动量上均有偏移的杂化副本。

Conclusion: 该工作确立了一条稳健、长寿命的电子态工程（electronic state engineering）路径，突破了对相干、零动量驱动的依赖，并提供动量偏移作为超越常规Floquet工程（Floquet engineering）的额外调控自由度。

Abstract: Floquet phenomena - where a coherent, time-periodic drive hybridizes the conduction band with energy-replicated copies of the valence band - have been demonstrated with intense optical fields and, more recently, other bosonic excitations. However, within mean-field approximations and the current understanding of Floquet phenomena, these effects survive only for the coherence time of the drive, limiting practical use and current demonstrations to the sub-picosecond regime. Here, consistent with recent theoretical predictions beyond the mean-field picture, using time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy in WSe$_2$/MoS$_2$ heterostructures, we show that incoherent, dense populations of dark interlayer excitons hybridize the conduction band with energy-replicated copies of the valence band, mimicking Floquet-like phenomena - now persisting for nearly a nanosecond. With increasing interlayer exciton density, the valence band and its replica evolve from an inverted-parabolic to a Mexican-hat dispersion, a signature of the predicted non-zero static coupling that hybridizes the bands and scales linearly with the exciton density. By tuning twist angle, we further show that dark excitons with net momentum create replicas that hybridize with bands offset not just in energy but also in momentum, providing another powerful degree of freedom beyond conventional Floquet engineering. These results establish a robust, long-lived route to engineering electronic states, beyond a coherent, zero-momentum drive.

</details>


### [240] [Charge Filling-Dependent Valley Polarization and its Dynamics Driven by Correlated Interlayer Exciton States in WSe2/WS2 Heterobilayer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38251)
*Zhiwei Li,Haonan Wang,Yubei Xiang,Wataru Idehara,Hailin Liu,Shinichiro Matano,Kenji Watanabe,Takashi Taniguchi,Kazunari Matsuda*

Main category: cond-mat.mes-hall

TL;DR: 该研究结合时间分辨光谱（time-resolved optical spectroscopy）与蒙特卡洛模拟（Monte Carlo simulation），揭示WSe₂/WS₂莫尔异质双层中间层激子（interlayer excitons, IXs）的谷弛豫（valley relaxation）动力学随电荷填充的演化，发现整数填充（n=±1）处辐射复合增强、谷弛豫显著减慢。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 莫尔异质结构（moiré heterostructures）是研究强关联电子与激子态的新平台，但其强关联态对谷自由度（valley degree of freedom）及其动力学的影响尚未被探索，而这对谷电子学（valleytronics）的基础理解与应用至关重要。

Method: 以WSe₂/WS₂莫尔异质双层为对象，测量中间层激子的电荷填充依赖谷弛豫动力学，并将时间分辨光学光谱与蒙特卡洛模拟相结合，追踪IXs动力学跨越莫特转变（Mott transition）的演化。

Result: 在整数填充因子n（=−1）处，IXs的辐射衰减与复合速率增强；在n=±1处谷弛豫速率显著降低，归因于波函数交叠（wavefunction overlap）减小与声子散射（phonon scattering）过程减弱，从而抑制非辐射复合与谷间散射（intervalley scattering）。

Conclusion: 上述反常行为源于莫尔格点整数填充时引入载流子的局域化（localization）所导致的IXs复合路径改变与激子相干性（excitonic coherence）增强；结果表明激子与谷动力学可作为探测莫尔体系强关联态的灵敏探针，并为二维量子材料中激子相干与谷电子学性质调控提供可能途径。

Abstract: Moiré heterostructures of transition metal dichalcogenides provide an emerging platform for studying the strongly correlated electronic and excitonic states. The valley degree of freedom and its dynamics in the strongly correlated electronic and excitonic states in the moiré system are crucial for fundamental understanding and applications of valleytronics. Although the strongly correlated states in moiré systems have been extensively investigated, their impact on valley degrees of freedom and its dynamics remains unexplored. Here, we study the charge filling-dependent valley relaxation dynamics of interlayer excitons (IXs) in WSe2/WS2 moiré heterobilayer system. The evolution of moiré IXs dynamics across the Mott transition is elucidated by combining time-resolved optical spectroscopy with Monte Carlo simulation. Our results show that the radiative decay and recombination rate of IXs are enhanced at the integer filling factors n (=-1). Moreover, the valley relaxation rate of IXs at n=$\pm$1 is significantly decreased. The resulting reduction in wavefunction overlap and phonon scattering process suppresses the nonradiative recombination and intervalley scattering of IXs. These anomalous behaviors are attributed to the modification of IXs recombination pathways and enhance excitonic coherence due to the localization of introduced charge carriers at integer filling of moiré site. Our results explore exciton and valley dynamics as sensitive probes of strongly correlated states in moiré systems and highlight possible ways to control excitonic coherence and valleytronic properties in two-dimensional quantum materials.

</details>


### [241] [The Flexoelectric Twist: Persistence of Heavy Fermion Picture in Small-Angle Twisted Bilayer Graphene](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38305)
*Qirong Yao,Ka Cheuk Fan,Tianyu Qiao,Hao Shi,Xi Dai,Berthold Jäck*

Main category: cond-mat.mes-hall

TL;DR: 在极小扭角（θ≈0.3–0.7°）的双层石墨烯（TBG）中，扫描隧道显微镜（scanning tunneling microscopy）观测到AA位点的dI/dV峰、谱线关于电荷中性点的不对称、以及原子晶格在AA位点的膨胀，可用包含莫尔晶格重构（moiré lattice reconstruction）与柔性电（flexo-electricity）响应的重费米子（heavy fermion）f态模型做唯象描述。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 第一魔角附近TBG的平带已被广泛研究，但在更小扭角（θ<1°）下晶格弛豫会显著改变莫尔势场，不同长度尺度的莫尔晶格重构经机电耦合（electro-mechanical coupling）对电子结构的影响程度尚未解决。

Method: 对小角TBG器件（θ≈0.3–0.7°）进行扫描隧道显微镜／扫描隧道谱测量，空间分辨地获取dI/dV谱与晶格形貌，并在唯象层面构建包含莫尔晶格重构与原子晶格膨胀的模型。

Result: 在莫尔晶格的AA位点观测到显著dI/dV峰，其谱线关于电荷中性点（charge neutrality point）不对称；同时观察到莫尔长度尺度上的晶格重构及AA位点的原子晶格膨胀。莫尔晶格重构支持局域于AA位点的紧致局域重费米子f态；叠加原子晶格膨胀后产生强柔性电响应，显式破坏粒子—空穴对称性（particle-hole symmetry），使f态能量下移，从而与AB/BA位点的巡游c电子在能量上共存。

Conclusion: 空间分辨谱学测量定量呈现了f态与c电子的共存，证实重费米子模型在小角区（θ<1°）仍成立；研究揭示了柔性电对低能电子结构的影响，并将小角TBG确立为可通过扭角与静电背栅分别调控f占据数与c密度的相互作用近藤晶格（Kondo lattice）问题研究平台。

Abstract: Twisted bilayer graphene (TBG) near the first magic angle ($θ\approx1.05^{\circ}$) hosts flat bands that provide a fertile ground for exploring strongly correlated and topological phases. At smaller twist angles ($θ<1^{\circ}$), attice relaxation profoundly alters the moiré landscape. The extent to which moiré lattice reconstruction at different length scales affects the electronic structure through electro-mechanical coupling remains unresolved. Here, using scanning tunneling microscopy on small-angle TBG devices ($θ\approx0.3-0.7^{\circ}$), we observe a pronounced $dI/dV$ peak at the AA site of the moiré lattice on top of a spectrum that is asymmetric about the charge neutrality point, lattice reconstruction over moiré lattice length scales, as well as a dilation of the atomic lattice at the AA sites. We demonstrate at a phenomenological level that the inclusion of moiré lattice reconstruction supports compact localized heavy fermion $f-$ states localized at AA sites. The additional inclusion of atomic lattice dilation enerates a strong flexo-electric response that explicitly breaks particle-hole symmetry, pushing compact, localized $f$-states at the AA sites down in energy. Consequently, these heavy fermion states energetically coexist with itinerant $c$-electrons at the AB/BA sites. Our spatially resolved spectroscopic measurements quantitatively visualize this coexistence, confirming the persistence of the heavy fermion model in the small-angle regime $θ<1^{\circ}$. Our findings provide microscopic insights into how flexo-electricity affects the low-energy electronic structure of small-angle TBG. More broadly, our study establishes small-angle TBG as a new class of moiré materials to explore the interacting Kondo lattice problem with high tunability of the $f-$occupation and $c-$density through twist-angle and electrostatic back gates, respectively.

</details>


### [242] [Time evolution in the multi-component dynamical Keldysh models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38338)
*M. N. Kiselev*

Main category: cond-mat.mes-hall

TL;DR: 该文构造了含长关联时间多分量随机高斯场（random Gaussian field）的动力学量子模型的时间演化算符（time evolution operator），并分析SU(2)、U(1)、Z₂三类对称性情形，通过Keldysh模型极限求得Rice分布及单粒子格林函数（Green's function）的精确解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究具有长关联时间的多分量随机高斯场驱动的动力学量子模型的统计性质，借助Keldysh模型（Keldysh model）这一极限情形系统考察不同对称性类下的行为。

Method: 构造时间演化算符，分别对应三分量噪声的非阿贝尔SU(2)对称性类（non-Abelian symmetry class）与二分量、一分量噪声对应的阿贝尔U(1)和Z₂对称性类；以无穷关联时间的Keldysh模型为起点，推导并求解对角与非对角单粒子格林函数（single-particle Green's function）的耦合线性微分方程组；并用连分式方法（continuous fractions method）处理有限时间关联。

Result: 在无穷关联时间极限下，非零均值的二分量随机场（random field）统计由Rice分布（Rice distribution）描述；通过对角与非对角单粒子格林函数的耦合线性微分方程组获得精确解；有限时间关联可通过连分式方法纳入Keldysh模型。

Conclusion: Keldysh模型框架可统一处理不同对称性类的多分量随机场动力学问题，连分式方法为引入有限时间关联提供了可行途径。

Abstract: We construct a time evolution operator for a dynamical quantum models with a multi-component random Gaussian field characterized by a long correlation time. We analyze three paradigmatic cases: non-Abelian $SU(2)$ symmetry class for the three-component Gaussian noise and Abelian symmetry classes $U(1)$ and $Z_2$ for the two- and one-component noises correspondingly. Starting with a limiting case of the infinite correlation time (Keldysh model) we shown that statistics of the two-component random field with a non-zero mean is described by the Rice distribution. We derived and solved the system of coupled linear differential equations for the exact diagonal and off-diagonal single-particle Green's functions. We showed how the finite time correlation in Keldysh models are accounted by a continuous fractions method.

</details>


### [243] [Strain-overlap and surface-confinement engineering in AlScN/YIG magnetoacoustic devices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38399)
*Kevin Künstle,Kaya Gauch,Agnė Žukauskaitė,Stephan Barth,Mathias Weiler*

Main category: cond-mat.mes-hall

TL;DR: 该工作将 AlScN/YIG/GGG 确立为集成压电-磁性异质结构，用于电学激发声表面波（surface acoustic waves, SAWs）并与单晶 YIG 中的自旋波（spin waves）耦合，并指出 AlScN 厚度是平衡磁弹性衰减与纯 SAW 传输的关键设计参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旨在实现声表面波与自旋波的电学驱动耦合，并厘清 AlScN 压电层厚度如何通过改变应变场影响 YIG 中的磁弹性耦合（magnetoelastic coupling）。

Method: 结合叉指换能器延迟线（interdigital-transducer delay lines）的电学传输测量与有限元仿真（finite-element simulations），识别激发模式为 Rayleigh 型 SAW；并利用仿真的复应变分量与有效驱动场模型（effective-driving-field model）计算不同 AlScN 厚度与波长下的相对 SAW 衰减。

Result: 计算定性重现测量结果：在所研究的全部波长下，较薄 AlScN 层给出更强的相对衰减；实验中 54.5 nm 厚 AlScN、1.2 μm 波长时衰减接近 70 dB/mm。但最强相对衰减并不对应最大可探测信号，绝对场致传输变化在 AlScN 厚度约 100 nm 处达到峰值，精确最优值依赖声学波长。

Conclusion: AlScN 厚度是 AlScN/YIG 器件中平衡磁弹性衰减与纯 SAW 传输的关键设计参数，最优厚度需结合目标声学波长选取。

Abstract: We establish AlScN/YIG/GGG as an integrated piezoelectric-magnetic heterostructure for electrically generating surface acoustic waves (SAWs) and coupling them to spin waves in monocrystalline YIG. Combining electrical transmission measurements of interdigital-transducer delay lines with finite-element simulations, we identify the excited modes as Rayleigh-type SAWs whose surface confinement varies strongly with AlScN thickness. The resulting changes in the strain field within YIG directly modify the magnetoelastic coupling. Using the simulated complex strain components and an effective-driving-field model, we calculate the relative SAW attenuation for several AlScN thicknesses and wavelengths. The calculations qualitatively reproduce the measurements: at all investigated wavelengths, thinner AlScN layers yield stronger relative attenuation. Experimentally, the attenuation approaches 70dB/mm for a 54.5nm-thick AlScN layer at a wavelength of 1.2$μ$m. However, the strongest relative attenuation does not maximize the detectable signal. Instead, the absolute field-induced transmission change peaks at an AlScN thickness of approximately 100nm, with the precise optimum depending on the acoustic wavelength. These results identify the AlScN thickness as a key design parameter for balancing magnetoelastic attenuation and pure SAW transmission in AlScN/YIG devices.

</details>


### [244] [Coherent Electronic Lensing in Proximitized Graphene](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38476)
*Ivan Villani,Samuele Fracassi,Niccolò Traverso Ziani,Maura Sassetti,Matteo Carrega,Vaidotas Mišeikis,Camilla Coletti,Fabio Beltram,Kenji Watanabe,Takashi Taniguchi,Sergio Pezzini,Stefan Heun*

Main category: cond-mat.mes-hall

TL;DR: 利用扫描栅显微镜（Scanning Gate Microscopy, SGM）在弹道石墨烯约瑟夫森结（ballistic graphene Josephson junction）的 n-p-n 腔中观测并调控 Fabry-Pérot（FP）干涉，揭示全局费米波矢移动与局域相干电子透镜（coherent electron lensing）两类机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空间分辨地控制相干电子输运（coherent electron transport）是理解与工程化混合超导器件（hybrid superconducting devices）中干涉现象的重要途径，而石墨烯弹道约瑟夫森结的 n-p-n 腔提供了研究 FP 干涉的平台。

Method: 采用扫描栅显微镜（SGM）对超导开关电流（switching current）与常态电导（normal-state conductance）做空间成像，并结合解析模型（analytical model）分析探针势对干涉条纹的影响。

Result: 空间图中出现圆形干涉条纹，源于探针势的两种效应：费米波矢（Fermi wave vector）的全局移动调制腔的 FP 共振；局域扰动在固定费米波矢下随探针偏压变化产生额外振荡。解析模型将该局域响应归因于相干电子透镜，即探针改变干涉轨迹上的相位积累；开关电流条纹表明该机制影响超导输运，与探针诱导的 Andreev 束缚态（Andreev bound states）共振条件移动一致。

Conclusion: 该工作确立了 SGM 作为可调局域透镜（tunable local lens）在控制超导弹道石墨烯器件干涉中的作用。

Abstract: Spatially resolved control of coherent electron transport offers a route to understanding and engineering interference phenomena in hybrid superconducting devices. Here, we use Scanning Gate Microscopy (SGM) to investigate Fabry-Pérot (FP) interference in the n-p-n cavity of a ballistic graphene Josephson junction. Spatial maps of the superconducting switching current and normal-state conductance reveal circular interference fringes arising from two distinct effects of the SGM tip potential. A global shift of the Fermi wave vector modulates the FP resonances of the cavity, while a local perturbation produces additional oscillations that persist at fixed Fermi wave vector as the tip bias is varied. An analytical model identifies the origin of this local response with coherent electron lensing, in which the tip modifies the phase accumulated along interfering trajectories. The measured fringe patterns in the switching current indicate that this mechanism affects superconducting transport, consistent with tip-induced shifts of the resonance conditions for Andreev bound states. These results establish SGM as a tunable local lens for controlling interference in superconducting ballistic graphene devices.

</details>


### [245] [Topology of Wannierizable Insulators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38626)
*Ken Shiozaki*

Main category: cond-mat.mes-hall

TL;DR: 该文研究非相互作用可Wannier化绝缘体中Wannier中心（Wannier centers）选择的自由度及其对称性表示，比较原子构型的Wyckoff形变（Wyckoff deformations）与占据态的对称保持绝热形变（adiabatic deformations），并给出两者等价的分类判据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Wannier中心的选择存在自由度，需厘清"Wyckoff等价"（基于原子构型）与"绝热等价"（基于占据态）这两种描述拓扑与对称性的框架在何种条件下一致、何时彼此不同。

Method: 对比原子构型的Wyckoff形变与占据态的对称保持绝热形变（包括是否添加共同占据原子轨道的情形），并通过具体实例与拓扑不变量（如Euler class、Chern insulator pumps）及磁空间群（magnetic space groups）分类进行分析。

Result: 明确构造的反例显示稳定Wyckoff等价与固定填充下的绝热等价互不蕴含：无自旋Fm'm'm'中Euler class可区分稳定Wyckoff等价的构型；无自旋P1̄'中绝热等价的构型在稳定Wyckoff形变下仍保持区别。二者在二维及以下维度、以及三维自旋系统（spinful systems）中一致；三维无自旋系统中，Chern绝缘体泵（Chern insulator pumps）在134个保持时空定向的磁空间群中给出额外等价。

Conclusion: Wyckoff等价与绝热等价并非普遍互推，其一致性依赖于维度、自旋与磁空间群的具体性质；文中给出了稳定Wyckoff与稳定绝热等价重合情形的完整分类。

Abstract: We study the freedom in choosing Wannier centers and the associated symmetry representations in noninteracting Wannierizable insulators. We compare Wyckoff deformations of atomic configurations with symmetry-preserving adiabatic deformations of occupied states, both with and without adding common occupied atomic orbitals. Explicit examples show that stable Wyckoff equivalence and adiabatic equivalence at fixed filling do not imply each other. In spinless $Fm'm'm'$, an Euler class distinguishes stably Wyckoff-equivalent configurations. In spinless $P\overline1'$, adiabatically equivalent configurations remain distinct under stable Wyckoff deformations. We also classify when stable Wyckoff and stable adiabatic equivalence coincide. They agree in two or fewer dimensions and in three-dimensional spinful systems. For three-dimensional spinless systems, Chern insulator pumps give additional equivalences in 134 magnetic space groups. These groups preserve spacetime orientation and have a point whose site-symmetry group contains $222$, $\overline1'$, or $\overline4'$.

</details>


### [246] [Symmetries and Propagation of Surface Plasmon Polaritons in Axion Electrodynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38692)
*Marco Peluso*

Main category: cond-mat.mes-hall

TL;DR: 该文以唯象模型研究轴子电动力学导体与普通介质界面上的表面等离激元极化激元（surface plasmon polaritons），系统讨论手征磁效应（chiral magnetic effect）与反常霍尔效应（anomalous Hall effect）单独及共存时的平面与柱面几何情形。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旨在将手征磁效应分析从平面几何拓展至柱面几何，并考察其与反常霍尔效应共存时对界面表面模式的共同影响。

Method: 采用一般唯象模型，以轴矢量 G 描述反常霍尔效应、赝标量 W 描述手征磁效应，推导轴子介质的精确本征模，并通过色散关系的解析与渐近分析揭示对称性与传播特征。

Result: 平面界面得到 W 的上界、需两种效应共同存在的非互易性（nonreciprocity），以及依赖 G 取向的禁止自由传播模式；柱面几何则发现模式的线动量与轨道角动量（orbital angular momentum）之间的新型耦合，该耦合仅由手征磁效应即可产生并在反常霍尔效应存在时持续。

Conclusion: 轴子电动力学介质界面的表面模式在平面与柱面几何下呈现显著不同的传播特征，两种效应的共存产生非互易性与角动量耦合等新颖现象。

Abstract: Surface plasmon polaritons at the interface between a conductor governed by axion electrodynamics and an ordinary dielectric are studied using a general phenomenological model, in which the macroscopic response is described by an axial vector $ \mathbf{G} $, responsible for the anomalous Hall effect, and a pseudoscalar $ W $, accounting for the chiral magnetic effect. We extend the analysis of the chiral magnetic effect in the planar geometry, address its role in the cylindrical one and, in both geometries, discuss the case in which the two effects coexist. We find an upper bound on $ W $, a nonreciprocity requiring both effects and the absence of freely propagating modes, depending on the orientation of $ \mathbf{G} $, for the planar interface, and, for the cylindrical one, a novel coupling between the linear and orbital angular momenta of the modes, which already arises from the chiral magnetic effect alone and persists when the anomalous Hall effect is also present. The exact eigenmodes of the axion medium are derived, and the symmetries and propagation features of the surface modes are made explicit by analytical and asymptotic evaluation of the dispersion relations.

</details>


### [247] [Spectrum of the steady-state distribution function of disordered Lindbladian fermions at large channel number](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38805)
*Maksim Parfenov,Igor Burmistrov*

Main category: cond-mat.mes-hall

TL;DR: 自由费米子耦合粒子增益与损耗通道可弛豫至高斯稳态，每个自然轨道有独立占据数；对随机哈密顿量与多个随机增益/损耗通道，本文给出占据数分布，并证明哈密顿量的平均不完全，其展宽随每能级通道数的平方根倒数衰减。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前仅知自由费米子加增益/损耗系统弛豫到各自然轨道有独立占据数的高斯稳态，但该占据数分布在多随机通道、随机哈密顿量下的具体形式，以及哈密顿量能否通过跨能级输运"抹平"轨道间差异，尚不清楚。

Method: 对随机哈密顿量耦合许多随机增益与损耗通道的系统，分析各轨道的填充与排空速率；研究哈密顿量在粒子寿命内跨能级转移粒子所产生的平均效应，并考察大系统极限下分布对哈密顿量的依赖及展宽的界。

Result: 该平均是不完全的：占据数展宽仅按每能级通道数（number of channels per level）的平方根倒数（inverse square root）衰减。大系统尺寸下，分布对哈密顿量的依赖仅通过其态密度（density of states）$u(E)$。展宽由热浴（baths）单独限定上界，即使哈密顿量具有无界重尾谱（heavy-tailed spectra）也不能使其超过该界。

Conclusion: 稳态占据数展宽受热浴本身约束而非由哈密顿量谱结构放大，因而抑制了粒子数涨落（particle-number fluctuations），使其低于二项式值（binomial value）。

Abstract: Free fermions coupled to particle gain and loss relax to a Gaussian steady state, in which every natural orbital has its own occupation. We find the distribution of these occupations $\varrho_{\rm st}$ for a random Hamiltonian coupled to many random gain and loss channels. Each orbital is filled and emptied at its own rates, and the Hamiltonian, moving particles across the levels during their lifetime, averages the differences between the orbitals. We show that this averaging is incomplete: the spread of the occupations decreases only as the inverse square root of the number of channels per level. At large system size the distribution depends on the grain Hamiltonian only through its density of states $ν(E)$. The spread is bounded by the baths alone: even Hamiltonians with unbounded, heavy-tailed spectra cannot widen it beyond this bound. The spread suppresses the particle-number fluctuations below their binomial value.

</details>


### [248] [Effect of the surface on the energy levels in PbS and PbSe nanocrystals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38874)
*O. Lundgren,A. V. Rodina,Al. L. Efros*

Main category: cond-mat.mes-hall

TL;DR: 该研究在四带有效质量模型（four-band effective-mass model）框架下，采用通用边界条件（general boundary conditions, GBCs）刻画纳米晶表面对球形 PbS 与 PbSe 纳米晶（nanocrystals, NCs）中电子与空穴量子限制能级（quantum confinement levels）的影响，并定量解释裸表面与 Cl 钝化（Cl-passivated）纳米晶吸收光谱的差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原 Kang–Wise 模型采用载流子波函数在纳米晶表面为零的标准边界条件，无法计入表面对能级结构的影响，因而难以解释不同表面状态下的光谱差异。

Method: 在四带有效质量模型中对包络波函数（envelope wave functions）施加通用边界条件（GBCs），以此引入表面效应，重新计算电子与空穴的量子限制能级随尺寸的变化。

Result: 表面性质改变电子与空穴限制能级的尺寸依赖关系，并导致 1P_{h,e} 能级产生额外的自旋–轨道分裂（spin–orbit splitting）；借助 GBCs 可定量描述裸 PbS 与 PbSe 纳米晶最低光学跃迁的尺寸依赖，并解释裸与 Cl 钝化 PbS 纳米晶吸收光谱的差异。

Conclusion: 通用边界条件为纳入纳米晶表面效应对能级结构的作用提供了可行途径，并能定量解释实验吸收光谱，说明表面钝化对半导体纳米晶电子结构具有显著调控作用。

Abstract: The structure of the electron and hole quantum confinement levels in spherical PbS and PbSe nanocrystals (NCs) is studied within the framework of a four-band effective-mass model. This level structure was initially calculated within the Kang--Wise model, which employs the standard boundary condition of vanishing carrier wave functions at the NC surface. This model, however, does not allow one to account for the effect of the NC surface on the level structure. Here, the effect of the NC surface is modeled using general boundary conditions (GBCs) imposed on the envelope wave functions at the surface. We show that the surface properties modify the size dependence of the electron and hole confinement levels and lead to an additional spin--orbit splitting of the $1P_{h,e}$ levels. Using the GBCs, we are able to quantitatively describe the size dependence of the lowest optical transitions in bare PbS and PbSe NCs and explain the differences between the absorption spectra of bare and Cl-passivated PbS NCs

</details>


### [249] [Transport in spinful non-Hermitian gauge lattices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40317)
*Hamed Ghaemi-Dizicheh,Shahram Dehdashti,Janis Nötzel*

Main category: cond-mat.mes-hall

TL;DR: 该文将广义转移矩阵方法推广至含矩阵值阿贝尔与非阿贝尔规范耦合的一维自旋非厄米紧束缚晶格，统一刻画周期与开边界谱、广义布里渊区、趋肤局域化及有限样品散射，并揭示自旋杂化激光与相干完美吸收等新输运现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有广义转移矩阵方法（generalized transfer-matrix method）仅适用于标量情形，缺乏对带自旋及矩阵值规范耦合的非厄米晶格的统一处理，因而无法在同一框架内关联谱、边界条件与散射输运。

Method: 构建最小通道分辨转移矩阵（channel-resolved transfer matrix），将其本征值等同于广义布洛赫因子（generalized Bloch factors）；同一转移矩阵同时给出周期与开边界谱、广义布里渊区（generalized Brillouin zone）、趋肤局域化与有限样品散射条件，并在阿贝尔极限下用切比雪夫多项式（Chebyshev polynomials）给出精确谱与闭式输运表达式。

Result: 阿贝尔情形下模型解耦为固定自旋扇区，出现双极自旋依赖趋肤局域化（bipolar spin-dependent skin localization），并区分支配极点、零点与无反射的互易跃迁尺度与支配透射不对称、透明与隐身的定向放大因子；非阿贝尔情形下非对易链路矩阵（link matrices）相干混合自旋扇区，四个转移本征模共同决定非布洛赫谱（non-Bloch spectrum）与输运本征通道，产生自旋杂化激光、相干完美吸收（coherent perfect absorption）、塞曼可调激射阈值及伴随显著自旋转换的方向依赖无反射输运。

Conclusion: 所得的边界条件判据统一描述激射、相干完美吸收、无反射、透明与隐身，并将自旋极化与自旋转换确定为实验上可区分阿贝尔与非阿贝尔非厄米输运的可及特征。

Abstract: We extend the generalized transfer-matrix method introduced in [H. Ghaemi-Dizicheh, Phys.\ Rev.\ B \textbf{107}, 125155 (2023)] to one-dimensional spinful non-Hermitian tight-binding lattices with matrix-valued Abelian and non-Abelian gauge couplings. We derive a minimal channel-resolved transfer matrix and identify its eigenvalues with the generalized Bloch factors. The same transfer matrix determines the periodic- and open-boundary spectra, generalized Brillouin zone, skin localization, and finite-sample scattering conditions. In the Abelian limit, the model separates into fixed spin sectors, yielding exact spectral results and closed finite-length transport expressions in terms of Chebyshev polynomials. These results reveal bipolar spin-dependent skin localization and distinguish the reciprocal hopping scale, which governs poles, zeros, and reflectionlessness, from the directed-amplification factor controlling transmission asymmetry, transparency, and invisibility. For non-Abelian gauge fields, noncommuting link matrices coherently mix the spin sectors, such that four transfer eigenmodes jointly determine the non-Bloch spectrum and transport eigenchannels. We show that this mixing produces spin-hybridized lasing and coherent-perfect-absorption channels, Zeeman-tunable lasing thresholds, and direction-dependent reflectionless transport accompanied by pronounced spin conversion. The resulting boundary-condition criteria describe lasing, coherent perfect absorption, reflectionlessness, transparency, and invisibility, while identifying spin polarization and conversion as experimentally accessible signatures that distinguish Abelian from non-Abelian non-Hermitian transport.

</details>


### [250] [HERA: Assessing an Autonomous Agent for Quantum Device Measurement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39074)
*Zachary W. Gomez,Nathan Bittner,Jordan T. McCourt,Qingrui Cao,Sandesh S. Kalantre,Benjamin H. Alexander,Zhiren Zheng,Kenji Watanabe,Takashi Taniguchi,Aaron Sharpe*

Main category: cond-mat.mes-hall

TL;DR: HERA 是一个面向量子器件低温输运测量（cryogenic transport measurements）的自主语言模型智能体（LLM agent），依托实验室成员整理的知识库（knowledge base）运行。盲法试验中其结论与专家一致，消融与离线重放（offline replay）实验表明知识库能普遍提升各模型设计测量与推理的质量，且该智能体可快速迁移到新的材料体系任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型智能体已开始执行实验室测量，但模型具有随机性（stochastic）且其结论受给定上下文影响，因此须通过受控研究（controlled studies）验证其科学结论能否经得起审查。

Method: 提出 HERA 自主智能体，依托由实验室成员维护、包含测量协议（protocols）、软件工具与文献引用的知识库执行量子器件低温输运测量；评估手段包括：对两个多层石墨烯（multilayer graphene）器件堆叠顺序（stacking order）问题与专家进行盲法对照、知识库消融（ablation）实验、以及数百次由模型仅设计核心测量而不实际执行的离线重放（offline replay），并迁移至新材料的超导性（superconductivity）表征任务。

Result: HERA 的结论在两个测试器件上均与专家封存的结论一致；消融与重放研究跨模型评估了知识库的作用，显示具备知识库时每个模型都能设计更优测量并给出更严谨的推理；迁移任务仅需数小时专家时间开发新实验协议，此后 HERA 可自主完成超导性的发现与表征。

Conclusion: 在配备面向任务设计的知识库时，语言模型智能体能够开展可靠、严谨的实验科学工作，并具备向新问题迁移的可行性。

Abstract: Large language model agents have begun to carry out laboratory measurements, but their scientific conclusions are useful only if they hold up under scrutiny. Demonstrating this requires controlled studies because models are stochastic and the context a model is given steers its conclusions. Here we introduce HERA, an autonomous agent designed to carry out cryogenic transport measurements of quantum devices. HERA draws on a knowledge base curated by lab members that holds measurement protocols, software tools, and literature references. We assessed HERA with a blinded trial against an expert on the stacking order of two multilayer graphene devices, an ablation of its knowledge base, and hundreds of offline replays in which models designed the trial's central measurement without running it. HERA's conclusions matched the expert's sealed conclusions on both tested devices. The ablation and the replay studies measured the impact of the knowledge base across different models, showing that with it every model designed better measurements and reasoned more soundly. To test how readily HERA extends to a new problem, we tasked it with finding and characterizing superconductivity in a different material system. This required a few hours of expert time to develop a new experimental protocol, after which HERA did both autonomously. These results show that, with a knowledge base designed for the task, language model agents are capable of sound experimental science.

</details>


### [251] [Berry curvature dipole circuit quantum electrodynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39186)
*Oles Matsyshyn,Valla Fatemi,Justin C. W. Song*

Main category: cond-mat.mes-hall

TL;DR: 该文提出 Berry 曲率偶极（Berry curvature dipole, BCD）量子电路元件，在无需破缺时间反演对称性的条件下实现量子三波混频（three-wave mixing），并展示其在超导微波电路中的多光子真空 Rabi 劈裂与玻色子薛定谔猫态动力学稳定化应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统量子三波混频依赖约瑟夫森结阵列（Josephson junction arrays）并由磁通激活，通常需破缺时间反演对称性；该文旨在寻找一种无需磁场、保持时间反演对称性的替代实现方式。

Method: 引入基于非中心对称量子材料（noncentrosymmetric quantum materials）中非线性霍尔效应（nonlinear Hall effect）的 BCD 电路元件，将其推广至无耗散（dissipationless）、量子相干的少光子区域，并与超导微波电路集成。

Result: 所构建的 BCD 电路量子电动力学（circuit QED）体系可实现多光子真空 Rabi 劈裂（multiphoton vacuum Rabi splittings）以及玻色子薛定谔猫态（bosonic Schrödinger cat states）的动力学稳定化。

Conclusion: BCD 电路量子电动力学提供了以量子材料非线性响应作为量子信息处理物理资源的明确范例。

Abstract: Quantum three-wave mixing is an important resource in superconducting quantum circuits. The traditional implementation uses Josephson junction arrays and is activated by magnetic flux. Here we introduce the Berry curvature dipole (BCD) quantum circuit element, which achieves quantum three-wave mixing without breaking time-reversal symmetry. This quantum three-wave mixing results from the BCD nonlinear Hall effect in noncentrosymmetric quantum materials taken to a dissipationless, quantum coherent few-photon regime. We show how nonlinear Hall materials can be integrated to superconducting microwave circuits to accomplish multiphoton vacuum Rabi splittings and dynamical stabilization of bosonic Schrödinger cat states. Such BCD circuit quantum electrodynamics are a concrete exemplar of a physical resource for quantum information processing enabled by nonlinear response in quantum materials.

</details>


### [252] [Nodal magnon spin current at an antiferromagnet/altermagnet junction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39206)
*Koki Mizuno*

Main category: cond-mat.mes-hall

TL;DR: 研究 $d$ 波交错磁体（altermagnet, AM）与铁磁体（ferromagnet, FM）或反铁磁体（antiferromagnet, AFM）结中的热驱动磁子自旋流（magnon spin current），揭示其角依赖分量与界面对称性决定的符号行为，并预言 AFM/AM 结可作为磁子阀（magnon valve）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旨在厘清交错磁体结中热驱动磁子自旋流的角依赖结构，并借此区分 FM/AM 与 AFM/AM 两类结在交错磁畴反转下的不同响应。

Method: 采用分析性理论框架，将电流分解为与界面角无关的分量及具 $d$ 波形式（$d$-wave form）的角依赖分量，并以跨界面成键自旋对的选择性隧穿（selective tunneling）机制加以解释。

Result: 在子晶格对称界面（sublattice-symmetric interface）下，FM/AM 结的角依赖分量为奇函数，对磁畴平均后抵消；AFM/AM 结的角无关分量因对称性消失，而角依赖分量在固定奈尔矢量（Néel vector）下经磁畴平均仍保留。成键自旋对平行时可透射磁子、反平行时被阻断，使 AFM/AM 结成为磁子阀；各向异性隧穿可由法向 $[310]$ 与 $[130]$ 界面间电流变号检测。

Conclusion: AFM/AM 结的磁子阀效应可在固定界面下通过电流大小读取交错磁体相对反铁磁体的奈尔矢量取向；电流符号反转与阀效应均由选择性隧穿机制统一导出。

Abstract: We investigate the thermally driven magnon spin current across a junction between a $d$-wave altermagnet (AM) and a ferromagnet (FM) or an antiferromagnet (AFM).
  The current consists of a component independent of the interface angle and an angularly dependent component with the $d$-wave form.
  For a sublattice-symmetric interface, the two junctions behave oppositely under reversal of the altermagnetic domain: in the FM/AM junction the angularly dependent component is odd and cancels on averaging over the domains, whereas in the AFM/AM junction the angularly independent component vanishes by symmetry and the angularly dependent component survives the domain average at a fixed Néel vector of the AFM.
  Both follow from a selective tunneling: a pair of spins bonded across the interface transmits magnons when the spins are parallel and not when antiparallel, which makes the AFM/AM junction a magnon valve: the configuration in which the bonded spins are antiparallel blocks the current up to the sublattice admixture of the magnons.
  The anisotropic tunneling is detectable as the sign reversal of the current between the interfaces normal to $[310]$ and $[130]$, and the valve reads the Néel vector of the altermagnet relative to that of the antiferromagnet through the magnitude of the current at a fixed interface.

</details>


### [253] [Dissipation dilution enhances SiV coupling to vdW diamond nanomechanics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39271)
*Guanhao Huang,Amberly Xie,Chang Jin,Evelyn Hu,Marko Lončar*

Main category: cond-mat.mes-hall

TL;DR: 该工作实验展示了金刚石张应变纳米梁平台（tensioned diamond nanobeam），可在提升SiV-轨道态与机械模式应变耦合的同时保持长机械相干时间，并给出更高精度的SiV应变灵敏度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金刚石中的负电荷硅空位色心（SiV-）因自旋-应变敏感性高且易于器件集成，适合与纳米机械谐振器耦合；但张应变谐振器虽具有超长机械相干时间（ultra-long mechanical coherence times），其缺陷耗散稀释效应是否同时削弱与缺陷色心的应变耦合尚不明确。

Method: 构建张应变金刚石纳米梁（nanobeam）平台，通过监测SiV对谐振器静态应变（static strain）与动态应变（dynamical strain）的光学响应，表征应变分布与耦合强度。

Result: 观测到在静态应变下动态应变局域化（localization）于谐振器钳位（clamp）附近，从而实现SiV-机械耦合与机械相干性的同步增强，并获得精度显著优于以往文献值的SiV-应变灵敏度（strain sensitivity）。

Conclusion: 结果表明缺陷耗散稀释不会必然牺牲应变耦合，该平台为基于金刚石纳米机械学中点缺陷的秒级相干（seconds-long coherence）混合量子系统（hybrid quantum systems）及量子信息处理提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Solid-state color centers embedded into mechanical resonators, where orbital states mediate interactions between spins and long-lived phonons, are a promising platform for hybrid quantum systems. The negatively charged silicon vacancy center in diamond (SiV-) is particularly favorable for strain-coupling to nanomechanical resonators because of its large spin-strain susceptibility and compatibility with device integration. Tensioned nanomechanical resonators offer an attractive route due to their ultra-long mechanical coherence times enabled by diluting defect-induced dissipation, though it is unclear if the same dilution effect undermines strain-mediated coupling to material defect centers. Here, we experimentally demonstrate a tensioned diamond nanobeam platform that enables enhanced strain coupling to SiV- orbital states. Through monitoring the optical response of the SiVs to the static and dynamical strain of the mechanical resonator, we observe that dynamical strain localizes near the clamps of these resonators under static strain. This allows us to enhance SiV-mechanical coupling and the mechanical coherence simultaneously, and provide a SiV-strain sensitivity with greatly improved accuracy over previous literature values. Thus, our work opens a pathway towards seconds-long coherence hybrid quantum systems utilizing point defects in diamond nanomechanics for quantum information processing.

</details>


### [254] [Graphene Islands as a Platform for Band-Structure Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39428)
*Yonah Mann,Tobias Holder*

Main category: cond-mat.mes-hall

TL;DR: 该工作在紧束缚近似（tight-binding approximation）框架下研究纳米尺度多层石墨烯岛（multilayer graphene islands）与其化学同一的接触环境之间的邻近效应，发现动量匹配导致异常强的能带重整化，并可由随岛面积标度的有效单胞哈密顿量描述。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期实验已实现直径小于 50 nm、且层构型与同一石墨烯片接触部分（作为输运探测的引线）不同的多层石墨烯岛；需要理解这类岛与其化学同一环境之间的邻近（proximity）如何改变电子结构。

Method: 采用紧束缚近似（tight-binding approximation）进行理论计算，分析岛与引线之间动量匹配对邻近效应的影响，并推导以层间跃迁参数（interlayer hopping parameters）表示、随岛相对面积标度的有效单胞哈密顿量（effective single-unit-cell Hamiltonian）。

Result: 邻近效应因两部分动量高度匹配而增强，产生异常强的能带重整化（band renormalization）；该效应随岛尺寸增大而持续存在，仅受相干长度（coherence length）限制。对 3 层与 4 层石墨烯岛，预测其低能态密度（low-energy density of states）显著改变。

Conclusion: 多层石墨烯岛的电子结构可通过空间尺寸进行调控（tunability），为探索新颖电子相提供了途径。

Abstract: Multilayer graphenes have emerged as a versatile avenue towards exploring novel electronic phases of matter. Recently, nanoscale multilayer graphene islands have been realized experimentally, where the island is less than 50 nm in diameter and distinct in layer configuration from the contact portion of the same graphene sheets, the latter of which act as leads for transport probes. Here, we theoretically investigate how the proximity between these islands and their chemically identical environment modifies the electronic structure. Within the tight-binding approximation, we find that the proximity effect is enhanced by the closely matched momenta between both parts, creating an unusually strong band renormalization which persists as the island size is increased, and only limited by the coherence length. An effective single-unit-cell Hamiltonian to capture these modifications is derived, expressed in terms of interlayer hopping parameters that scale with the relative island area. We predict a substantially altered low-energy density of states for 3- and 4-layer graphene islands, demonstrating the tunability of the electronic structure by spatial size.

</details>


### [255] [Multiple Current Enhancement Regimes and Interaction Induced Re-entrant Transport in a Quasiperiodic Hubbard Ring with Antiferromagnetic Order](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39529)
*Souvik Roy,Ranjini Bhattacharya*

Main category: cond-mat.mes-hall

TL;DR: 本研究在Aharonov-Bohm（AB）磁通穿透的一维量子环中，结合广义Aubry-André-Harper（AAH）调制、交错格点势与反铁磁（AFM）序，揭示了半满与四分之一满下持续电荷流与自旋流的多峰增强结构及其对Hubbard相互作用的差异化响应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究对持续电流的认识多集中于均匀或简单无序环，而准周期调制（quasiperiodic modulation）、反铁磁序、能带填充与电子关联如何共同决定持续电流的大小及自旋分辨特征尚不清楚，本文旨在系统厘清这些因素的综合作用。

Method: 构建受AB磁通穿透的一维量子环模型，引入含交错格点能与AFM序的广义AAH调制；非相互作用情形直接求解，相互作用情形采用自洽Hartree-Fock平均场理论（mean field theory, MFT），并以逆参与比（inverse participation ratio, IPR）、通量依赖的自旋分辨基态能量、Drude权重进行表征，同时用精确对角化（exact diagonalization, ED）与密度矩阵重整化群（density-matrix renormalization group, DMRG）在有限半满体系上校验。

Result: 半满时随调制强度增大出现两个电流增强峰，准周期跃迁调制在受限参数区间内对双峰结构的形成起关键作用；自旋分辨键流分布显示两峰之间主导自旋贡献发生切换。四分之一满时仅出现单一自旋流增强峰，与半满双峰形成对比。Hubbard相互作用对两峰影响不同：抑制主峰，而次峰呈现非单调的重入（re-entrant）响应，并在有限相互作用强度下电流恢复；ED与DMRG结果支持MFT描述的可靠性。

Conclusion: 准周期调制、AFM序、能带填充与电子关联共同调控持续电流的幅度与自旋分辨特性，可产生多重增强区间及相互作用诱导的重入行为。该结论为关联无序量子环中持续电流的调控提供了理论依据。

Abstract: We investigate persistent charge and spin currents in a one-dimensional quantum ring threaded by an Aharonov-Bohm (AB) flux, considering generalized Aubry-André-Harper (AAH) modulation with staggered onsite energies and antiferromagnetic (AFM) ordering in both the noninteracting and interacting regimes, with the latter treated using a self-consistent Hartree-Fock mean field theory (MFT). At half filling, two distinct current-enhancement peaks emerge as the modulation strength increases, with quasiperiodic hopping modulation playing a crucial role in establishing the two-peak structure within a restricted parameter regime. Spin-resolved bond-current profiles reveal a switch in the dominant spin contribution between the two peaks, while the inverse participation ratio (IPR) and flux-dependent spin-resolved ground-state energies provide complementary insights into the spatial characteristics of the eigenstates and their spin-dependent flux sensitivity. At quarter filling, the spin current exhibits a single enhancement peak, in contrast to the two-peak response observed at half filling. The Hubbard interaction affects the two half-filled peaks differently: it suppresses the primary peak, whereas the secondary peak exhibits a nonmonotonic, re-entrant response, with the current recovering at finite interaction strength. The interacting results are further characterized through the Drude weight, and comparisons with exact diagonalization (ED) and density-matrix renormalization group (DMRG) calculations for a finite half-filled system support the reliability of the MFT description. Our findings elucidate how quasiperiodic modulation, AFM order, band filling, and electronic correlations collectively govern the magnitude and spin-resolved character of persistent currents, giving rise to multiple enhancement regimes and interaction-induced re-entrant behavior.

</details>


### [256] [Edge-Plasmon-Induced Magnetization in Higher Chern Insulators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39555)
*Prathyush P. Poduval,Rofii,Muhammad S. Ukhtary,Thomas L. Schmidt,Eddwi H. Hasdeo*

Main category: cond-mat.mes-hall

TL;DR: 本文用半经典库仑相互作用模型研究陈数（Chern number）为 $\mathcal{C}$ 与 $-\mathcal{C}$ 畴壁处高陈绝缘体边缘态的集体等离激元（plasmon）模式，揭示陈数对等离激元诱导轨道磁化（orbital magnetization）的调控作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高陈绝缘体具有多条无能隙手征边缘态，其边缘等离激元的集体行为及其诱导的磁化效应尚缺乏系统刻画，尤其陈数如何影响这些性质尚不明确。

Method: 采用含库仑相互作用的半经典模型（semiclassical model），考察陈数 $\mathcal{C}$ 与 $-\mathcal{C}$ 畴壁处边缘态的等离激元色散、电场极化与逆法拉第效应（inverse Faraday effect）所产生的静态轨道磁化。

Result: 长波极限下等离激元呈线性色散，速度随 $\mathcal{C}$ 线性增大；边缘等离激元驱动电子做圆周运动产生轨道磁化，其空间分布由边缘态有限宽度与等离激元波长两个竞争尺度决定。固定边缘电荷振幅时磁化随 $\mathcal{C}$ 显著增强；在畴壁处低频趋于有限平台、高频按 $1/\omega^2$ 衰减，温度依赖呈非单调并在中间温度出现极大值。

Conclusion: 陈数可有效调控等离激元诱导的磁化，其行为显著区别于传统边缘等离激元，凸显拓扑边缘态中磁化响应的独特空间、频率与温度特征。

Abstract: Higher Chern insulators host multiple dissipationless chiral edge states, one per unit of Chern number. We study the collective plasmon modes of these edge states at a domain wall between Chern numbers $\mathcal{C}$ and $-\mathcal{C}$, using a semiclassical model with Coulomb interactions. The plasmon dispersion is linear at long wavelengths, with a velocity that increases linearly with $\mathcal{C}$. As in conventional two-dimensional metals, the edge plasmon generates an elliptically polarized electric field that decays into the bulk and drives electrons in circular orbits, producing a static orbital magnetization (inverse Faraday effect). For topological edge plasmons, the magnetization has a nontrivial spatial profile set by two competing length scales: the finite extent of the edge states and the plasmon wavelength. At fixed edge-charge amplitude, it grows strongly with $\mathcal{C}$. At the domain wall, it approaches a finite plateau at low frequency and decays as $1/ω^2$ at high frequency. Its temperature dependence is nonmonotonic, with a maximum at an intermediate temperature. These results show how the Chern number controls plasmon-induced magnetization, in contrast to conventional edge plasmons.

</details>


### [257] [Non-Volatile Memory Devices for Neuromorphic Computing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39625)
*Debasis Das*

Main category: cond-mat.mes-hall

TL;DR: 本章综述新兴非易失存储器（emerging non-volatile memory, eNVM）器件在神经形态计算（neuromorphic computing）中的关键作用，涵盖ReRAM、PCM与自旋电子存储器等类型及其神经形态应用、挑战与机遇。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经形态计算受大脑神经元与突触机制启发，有望在硬件中实现复杂神经网络（neural networks, NNs）；而构建密集、低功耗电路需要具备类突触行为与非易失存储能力的器件，eNVM因此成为理想候选。

Method: 采用综述性论述方式，从大脑神经元（neurons）与突触（synapses）的基本工作原理出发，说明突触强度可调性对学习与记忆的意义，进而分析eNVM器件通过电导调制（conductance modulation）模拟突触可塑性（synaptic plasticity）的机制，并分类讨论各类器件。

Result: 指出eNVM器件因具备类突触行为、非易失信息存储、可模拟突触可塑性的电导调制特性以及良好可扩展性（scalability），适合大规模神经形态架构；并梳理了电阻式RAM（resistive RAM, ReRAM）、相变存储器（phase-change memory, PCM）、自旋电子学存储器（spintronics-based memory）等类型在神经形态系统中的集成进展。

Conclusion: eNVM器件在神经形态计算中具有核心地位，其特性契合突触功能与低功耗密集集成需求；本章进一步讨论了相关器件在神经形态系统集成中的挑战与机遇，并强调近期进展。

Abstract: This chapter explores the critical role of emerging non-volatile memory (eNVM) devices in advancing neuromorphic computing. Inspired by the human brain's remarkable ability to perform complex tasks like pattern recognition and adaptation, neuromorphic computing offers immense potential for implementing complex neural networks (NNs) in real hardware. Despite ongoing research into the brain's complexities, its fundamental operation relies on neurons (processing units communicating via electrochemical signals) and synapses (junctions between neurons). The modifiable strength of the synapse is key to learning and memory functionality, allowing the brain to adapt and rewire itself. For dense and low-power circuits in neuromorphic computing, these eNVM devices are ideal due to their synaptic-like behavior and non-volatile information storage. Properties such as conductance modulation of these devices emulate synaptic plasticity, which is crucial for learning, and their scalability makes them promising for large-scale neuromorphic architectures. This chapter will delve into the various types of eNVM devices such as resistive RAM (ReRAM), phase-change memory (PCM), spintronics-based memory devices, and their applications in neuromorphic computing, discussing their challenges and opportunities, and highlighting recent advances in their integration within neuromorphic systems.

</details>


### [258] [Moiré-enabled chiral plasmons in twisted bilayer graphene nanoislands](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39737)
*Magnus Husted,Viktor Kanstrup,Eduardo J. C. Dias,Joel D. Cox*

Main category: cond-mat.mes-hall

TL;DR: 该工作以原子级紧束缚（tight-binding）与自洽密度矩阵（density-matrix）方法计算含数千原子的扭转双层石墨烯纳米岛（twisted bilayer graphene nanoislands），揭示扭转角可调控其等离激元（plasmon）响应，并在临界角处出现共振阶梯与莫尔（moiré）诱导的Born–Kuhn手性等离激元。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扭转双层石墨烯的莫尔超晶格（moiré superlattice）已知能重塑电子结构，但其对有限尺寸纳米级双层结构集体光学响应的影响尚未被充分研究，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 采用原子级紧束缚结合自洽密度矩阵方法，计算由数千原子构成的扭转双层石墨烯纳米岛的扭转依赖等离激元响应，并对比三角形岛以区分边界与莫尔晶格的作用。

Result: 光谱高度可调，并在单一莫尔波长跨越整个岛的临界角处分为两个区间；超过该角度后，当整数个莫尔周期恰好嵌入重叠双层时会出现有序共振阶梯。掺杂岛中，层间耦合产生莫尔诱导的Born–Kuhn手性等离激元：两层中反向的横向偶极形成电四极子（electric quadrupole）并与亮偶极杂化，在临界角附近出现反交叉（anticrossing），其手性随扭转方向反转。

Conclusion: 三角形岛的对照结果表明，上述两种效应由莫尔晶格而非薄片边界主导，从而确立扭转角是调控手性石墨烯等离激元的机械手段（mechanical handle）。

Abstract: Twisting two stacked graphene layers superimposes a moiré superlattice that reshapes their electronic structure, yet how it shapes the collective optical response of finite, nanoscale bilayers remains largely unexplored. Using an atomistic tight-binding and self-consistent density-matrix approach, we compute the twist-dependent plasmonic response of twisted bilayer graphene nanoislands comprising thousands of atoms. The spectra are strongly tunable and split into two regimes at a critical angle where a single moiré wavelength spans the island; beyond it, an ordered ladder of resonances emerges whenever an integer number of moiré periods fits within the overlapping bilayer. In doped islands, the interlayer coupling also produces a moiré-enabled Born--Kuhn chiral plasmon: opposite transverse dipoles in the two layers form an electric quadrupole that hybridizes with the bright dipole, opening an anticrossing near the critical angle, with a handedness that reverses with the twist direction. Triangular islands confirm that the moiré lattice, not the flake boundary, governs both effects, establishing twist as a mechanical handle on chiral graphene plasmons.

</details>


### [259] [Steering interfacial molecular structures by substrate-molecule charge transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39822)
*Benjamin Achatz,Matthias Zeilerbauer,Marco Thaler,Milan Ončák,Shadi Fatayer,Laerte L. Patera*

Main category: cond-mat.mes-hall

TL;DR: 该研究在Ag(111)表面识别出C60与Zn-TAPP的混合条纹相（intermixed stripe phase），并通过STS与KPFS证实其界面偶极更大、电荷转移增强，建立了分子组装结构与电荷转移之间的直接联系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合自组装单层（intermixed self-assembled monolayers, SAMs）是调控无机-有机界面（inorganic-organic interfaces）的有力手段，但其局部结构与能量学（local structure and energetics）往往难以阐明，分子组装与电荷转移之间的关系缺乏直接证据。

Method: 在Ag(111)表面制备C60与Zn(II)-5,10,15,20-四(4-氨基苯基)卟啉（Zn-TAPP）的混合条纹相，采用扫描隧道谱（scanning tunnelling spectroscopy, STS）与开尔文探针力谱（Kelvin probe force spectroscopy, KPFS）分别映射电子态与局部接触电势差（local contact potential differences, LCPD）。

Result: 与密排C60岛（close-packed C60 islands）相比，条纹相表现出更大的界面偶极（interfacial dipole），且原本未占据的C60态占据度增加，与Ag(111)向C60电荷转移增强相一致；分析表明条纹结构中较大的C60间距降低了库仑排斥（Coulomb repulsion）。

Conclusion: 结果提供了条纹结构中带电C60分子的直接证据，并为设计具有定制界面电子性质的混合自组装单层提供了指导原则。

Abstract: Intermixed self-assembled monolayers (SAMs) provide a powerful approach for tuning inorganic-organic interfaces, but their local structure and energetics often remain elusive. Here, an intermixed stripe phase of fullerene $C_{60}$ and Zn(II)-5,10,15,20-tetrakis(4-aminophenyl)porphyrin (Zn-TAPP) on a Ag(111) surface is identified, establishing a direct link between molecular assembly and charge transfer. Scanning tunnelling spectroscopy (STS) and Kelvin probe force spectroscopy (KPFS) have been used to map electronic states and local contact potential differences (LCPD). Compared to close-packed $C_{60}$ islands, the stripe phase exhibits a larger interfacial dipole and increased occupation of previously unoccupied $C_{60}$ states, consistent with enhanced charge transfer from Ag(111) to $C_{60}$. Analysis indicates that larger $C_{60}$ spacing in the stripe geometry reduces Coulomb repulsion, stabilizing the intermixed phase and enhancing charge transfer with respect to close-packed domains. These results provide direct evidence of charged $C_{60}$ molecules in stripe structures and guidelines for engineering intermixed SAMs with tailored interfacial electronic properties.

</details>


### [260] [Non-Bloch Dynamical Quantum Phase Transitions with Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39994)
*Zhesen Yang,Wei-Wei Yang,Henning Schomerus,Jiangping Hu*

Main category: cond-mat.mes-hall

TL;DR: 论文识别出一类“非Bloch动力学量子相变（non-Bloch DQPTs）”，它仅出现在开边界链中，由复动量而非实Bloch动量决定，其起源是投影传播子的点隙绕数（point-gap winding number）W。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有对周期链动力学量子相变（dynamical quantum phase transitions, DQPTs）的理解基于实Bloch动量，而开边界与记忆效应下的动力学临界行为尚缺乏刻画，因此需要厘清边界条件如何改变DQPT。

Method: 研究对象为与简单基底耦合的厄米链（Hermitian chain），基底记忆被精确处理；通过投影传播子（projected propagator）的点隙绕数W，并将动量解析延拓至复平面来分析动力学自由能与临界时间。

Result: 当W≠0时，即使取热力学极限（thermodynamic limit），开边界也会改变动力学自由能与临界时间；二者均可由复动量的解析延拓（analytic continuation）给出，且W可通过粒子计数（particle counting）测量。

Conclusion: 研究揭示了一种动力学体-边对应（dynamical bulk-boundary correspondence）：非厄米拓扑（non-Hermitian topology）可由带记忆的厄米动力学中涌现。

Abstract: Dynamical quantum phase transitions (DQPTs) of periodic chains are determined by real Bloch momenta. We identify non-Bloch DQPTs, which occur only in open chains and are determined by complex momenta instead. They arise in a Hermitian chain coupled to a simple substrate, whose memory is treated exactly, and originate from the point-gap winding number $W$ of the projected propagator: for $W\neq0$, open boundaries change both the dynamical free energy and the critical times, even in the thermodynamic limit. We find that both follow from an analytic continuation to complex momenta, and show that $W$ can be measured by particle counting. This reveals a dynamical bulk-boundary correspondence, in which non-Hermitian topology emerges from Hermitian dynamics with memory.

</details>


### [261] [Influence of pairing and correlations on transport properties in three-terminal superconducting nanostructure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40059)
*G. Górski,V. Pokorný,T. Domański*

Main category: cond-mat.mes-hall

TL;DR: 本文研究由关联量子点（correlated quantum dot）连接两个金属电极与一个超导体构成的三端纳米结构的局域与非局域电荷输运性质，利用线性响应理论分析诱导的量子点内配对与关联效应的相互作用，及其对电导和热电势的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旨在揭示超导邻近效应诱导的量子点内配对（on-dot pairing）与电子关联之间的竞争如何影响局域及非局域电荷输运，并探索利用输运特征识别量子点基态构型的可能。

Method: 采用线性响应理论（linear response theory），计算三端纳米结构中的电导与热电势（thermopower），考察诱导配对与关联效应共同作用下的子能隙电荷输运，并聚焦交叉Andreev散射（crossed Andreev scattering）与Kondo效应。

Result: 当量子点基态为BCS型单态（BCS-type singlet）构型时，出现非局域电导为负及Seebeck系数反号，此现象在子能隙输运主要由交叉Andreev散射贡献时实现；在双重态（doublet）一侧，低温下电荷电导增强并在热电势中清晰显现，为Kondo效应的特征。

Conclusion: 此类温度依赖的局域与非局域输运性质可明确识别关联量子点的具体构型，并揭示双重态—单态交叉（doublet-to-singlet crossover）区域中涌现的丰富物理。

Abstract: We study the local and nonlocal charge transport properties of three-terminal nanostructure, consisting of the correlated quantum dot embedded between two metallic electrodes and superconductor. Using the linear response theory, we analyze interplay of the induced on-dot pairing with the correlation effects, inspecting their influence on the conductance and thermopower. Our calculations predict negative values of the nonlocal conductance and reversal of the Seebeck coefficient when the quantum dot ground state is represented by the BCS-type singlet configuration. These phenomena are realized when the subgap charge transport is predominantly contributed by the crossed Andreev scattering. In contrast, on the doublet side, we obtain signatures for the Kondo effect manifested by the low-temperature enhancement of the charge conductance and clearly evident in the thermopower. Such temperature-dependent local and nonlocal transport properties can unambiguously identify the specific configuration of the correlated quantum dot and reveal the rich physics emerging in the doublet-to-singlet crossover region.

</details>


### [262] [Magnetotransport experiments on side-contacted topological insulator three-terminal Josephson junctions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40083)
*Christoph Wassmer,Ella Nikodem,Oliver Breunig,Yongjian Wang,Yoichi Ando,Jakob Schluck*

Main category: cond-mat.mes-hall

TL;DR: 该文在侧向接触的拓扑绝缘体（topological insulator, TI）三端结平台上给出多端约瑟夫森效应（multiterminal Josephson effect）的实验证据，并系统刻画了磁场下各单结的超电流行为与二维临界电流轮廓（critical current contour, CCC）的非凸形变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多端约瑟夫森结可在多相位参数空间中研究安德列夫束缚态（Andreev bound states），被认为是在超导器件中产生拓扑非平庸相、并在TI三端结中实现马约拉纳零模（Majorana zero modes）的潜在平台，故需实验验证该平台的多端约瑟夫森效应。

Method: 采用侧向接触的TI三端结样品，测量其输运性质；在不同方向磁场下考察三端结内各单结的超电流，并用计入上下表面态的单个TI结半经典模拟（semiclassical simulations）进行对照；针对垂直磁场下CCC的形变提出简单模型。

Result: 观察到二维临界电流轮廓的典型特征，以及仅单个结保持无耗散（dissipationless）的偏置区间；单结超电流随磁场方向呈现Fraunhofer图案、SQUID振荡或单调衰减，与半经典模拟吻合良好；在垂直磁场下CCC出现明显的非凸形变，可由三端结回路中的磁通积累解释。

Conclusion: 结果确立了该侧向接触TI三端结作为多端约瑟夫森平台的实验基础，为后续在该平台上研究马约拉纳零模提供了依据。

Abstract: Multiterminal Josephson junctions have recently attracted substantial attention. The ability to study Andreev bound states in a multi-phase parameter space opens up exciting avenues for generating topologically non-trivial phases in superconducting devices. A particularly interesting case is the trijunction based on a topological insulator (TI), which is predicted to host Majorana zero modes for suitable phase configurations (Fu and Kane, PRL 2008). Here we turn to the platform of the side-contacted TI trijunction and present experimental evidence for a multiterminal Josephson effect. We study the transport properties and find typical features of a two-dimensional critical current contour (CCC) as well as bias regimes in which only a single junction remains dissipationless. We pay particular attention to these features and study the effects of magnetic fields on single junctions within the trijunction, where, depending on the field direction, the supercurrents show Fraunhofer patterns, SQUID oscillations, or a monotonic decay. We find good agreement with semiclassical simulations for a single TI junction that take into account the top and bottom surface states. We observe pronounced non-convex shape deformations of the CCC under perpendicular magnetic fields that reflect the flux buildup in the loop formed by our trijunctions and provide a simple model sufficient to explain the observed effect. Our results provide the foundations for future studies of Majorana zero modes on this platform.

</details>


### [263] [Continuous tuning of quantum critical behavior in hybrid Josephson junction arrays](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40104)
*E. Fugl,L. L. Olsen,S. Sasmal,M. Efthymiou-Tsironi,G. Nagda,F. Krizek,L. Casparis,S. Vaitiekėnas*

Main category: cond-mat.mes-hall

TL;DR: 该工作通过双栅极调控的约瑟夫森结阵列（Josephson junction arrays）研究电压驱动的量子相变（quantum phase transitions）的有限温度标度行为，发现临界电阻率（critical resistivity）与标度指数（scaling exponent）随静电调控连续演化，并在三相交汇处分别趋近 h/4e² 的自对偶极限（self-dual limit）与量子逾渗（quantum percolation）估计值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往报道的二维超导系统中不同的标度区间（scaling regimes）彼此分离，缺乏一个可通过静电手段连续调节、从而统一连接这些区间的实验平台。

Method: 采用双栅极几何（dual-gate geometry）器件，分别独立调控岛间耦合（interisland coupling）与近邻诱导超导（proximity-induced superconductivity），从而获得超导、绝缘与金属三种输运区间，并对电压驱动量子相变进行有限温度标度分析。

Result: 临界电阻率与标度指数随静电调控连续变化：在三种区间汇聚处，临界电阻率接近 h/4e²，与自对偶极限一致，标度指数接近量子逾渗估计值；向更强绝缘行为调节时临界电阻率升高、标度指数趋向经典逾渗（classical percolation）值；向金属区间调节时两者均下降。

Conclusion: 结果表明，此前在不同二维超导体系中分别报道的标度行为，可通过连续的静电调控加以连接，双栅极约瑟夫森结阵列为统一研究这些标度区间提供了可控平台。

Abstract: We report finite-temperature scaling of voltage-driven quantum phase transitions in hybrid Josephson junction arrays. A dual-gate geometry separately tunes interisland coupling and proximity-induced superconductivity, providing access to superconducting, insulating, and metallic transport regimes. The critical resistivity and scaling exponent evolve continuously with electrostatic tuning. Where the three regimes converge, the critical resistivity approaches $h/4e^2$, consistent with the self-dual limit, while the scaling exponent approaches the quantum-percolation estimate. Tuning toward stronger insulating behavior raises the critical resistivity and shifts the scaling exponent toward the classical-percolation value, while both parameters decrease toward the metallic regime. These results connect scaling regimes previously reported in different two-dimensional superconducting systems through continuous electrostatic control.

</details>


### [264] [Coexistence of Superconductivity and Chern insulators with |C| $\geq 1$ in twisted rhombohedral bilayer-trilayer graphene](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40170)
*Qiu Yang,Zihao Huo,Le Liu,Tianqi Song,Fankun Wang,Jingwei Dong,Kenji Watanabe,Takashi Taniguchi,Weibo Gao,Xiaobo Lu,Guangyu Zhang,Wei Yang*

Main category: cond-mat.mes-hall

TL;DR: 在扭转菱面体双层-三层石墨烯莫尔超晶格（twisted rhombohedral bilayer-trilayer graphene moiré superlattice）中，同时观测到超导（superconductivity）与陈绝缘体（Chern insulator）共存，超导表现出远超泡利极限（Pauli limit）的面内磁场鲁棒性，并与关联绝缘体（correlated insulator）竞争。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 菱面体多层石墨烯（rhombohedral multilayer graphene, RMG）已被证明是研究强关联物相（strongly correlated phases）的有前景平台，本文旨在探索扭转RMG体系中超导、高陈数拓扑（high Chern number topology）及其相互作用的共存与竞争。

Method: 采用扭转菱面体双层-三层石墨烯莫尔超晶格器件，通过输运测量（临界温度、非线性I-V、BKT转变、相位敏感干涉）表征超导，并用位移场（displacement field）与扭转角（twist angle）调控，同时测量面内磁场下的Ginzburg-Landau相干长度与临界电流。

Result: 超导转变温度约180 mK、BKT温度135 mK，起源于v = -2与D = 0附近的对称破缺费米面，并在高达2 T面内磁场下存活；相干长度随面内磁场由467 nm缩短至145 nm而临界电流Ic几乎不变。同一器件中还观测到v = -2处超导与关联绝缘体的竞争，以及大D > 0下v = 1/2、1、3处C = 1、3、-3的整数量子陈绝缘体。

Conclusion: 该工作确立扭转菱面体石墨烯多层体系为研究非常规超导（unconventional superconductivity）、高陈数拓扑及其相互作用的引人注目的平台。

Abstract: Rhombohedral multilayer graphene (RMG) has been demonstrated as a promising platform for investigating strongly correlated phases of matter. Here, we observe a coexistence of superconductivity and Chern insulators in a twisted rhombohedral bilayer-trilayer graphene moiré superlattice. Superconductivity, evidenced by a sharp transition with a critical temperature of ~180 mK, nonlinear I-V with a BKT temperature of 135 mK, and a signature of phase-sensitive interference patterns, emerges from a symmetry-breaking Fermi surface near v = -2 and D = 0, and it survives at a large in-plane magnetic field up to 2 T, strongly deviating from the Pauli limit. Moreover, we observe a strong modulation of the Ginzburg-Landau coherence length from 467 nm to 145 nm as the in-plane magnetic field increases from 0 to 2 T, whereas the critical current Ic barely changes. Unlike previous studies in RMG, we observe a competition between superconductivity and a correlated insulator at v = -2, monitored by displacement fields and twist angles. Note that we also observe integer Chern insulators with C = 1, 3, and -3 at v = 1/2, 1, and 3, respectively, for large D > 0 in the same superconducting device. The observations establish twisted rhombohedral graphene multilayers as a fascinating system to investigate unconventional superconductivity, high Chern number topology, and their interplay.

</details>


### [265] [Stabilizing fluctuating Cooper pairs with a terahertz resonator](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40222)
*Frieder Lindel,Jonathan B. Curtis,Jérôme Faist,Eugene Demler*

Main category: cond-mat.mes-hall

TL;DR: 该论文建立一个平衡态理论，研究无序二维超导体与亚波长太赫兹谐振腔耦合时的超导相涨落与电磁涨落相互作用，发现耦合可增强超导转变温度，且相涨落使增强效应放大一个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将量子材料与电磁腔或谐振器耦合（无需外部驱动）已成为一种新的调控手段，但缺乏对超导相涨落与腔电磁涨落耦合的平衡态理论描述。

Method: 将谐振器建模为集总元件电路（lumped-element circuit），构建介观无序二维超导体与亚波长太赫兹谐振器耦合的平衡态理论，同时纳入样品的电阻性准粒子响应（quasiparticle response）。

Result: 耦合增强而非抑制超导转变温度Tc；当样品尺寸小于Pearl长度时，BKT转变附近的相涨落显著放大该增强。对1 μm×1 μm、8 nm厚无序薄膜，相对Tc增强约1%，比忽略相涨落时的0.1%大一个数量级。

Conclusion: 具有软相涨落的超导体是太赫兹谐振器平衡态调控的有前景平台；分析中必须包含准粒子响应，因低频下超流对正常流体通道的分流会降低样品总阻抗。

Abstract: Coupling quantum materials to electromagnetic cavities or resonators without external driving has gained prominence as a new control mechanism. Here we develop an equilibrium theory of a mesoscopic, disordered two-dimensional superconductor coupled to a subwavelength terahertz resonator, focusing on the interplay between superconducting phase fluctuations in the sample and electromagnetic fluctuations of the resonator. Modeling the resonator as a lumped-element circuit, we show that the coupling enhances, rather than suppresses, the superconducting transition temperature $T_c$. When the sample is smaller than the Pearl length, phase fluctuations near the Berezinskii--Kosterlitz--Thouless (BKT) transition strongly amplify this enhancement. Crucially, the resistive quasiparticle response of the sample must be included in the analysis: at low frequencies the superfluid shunts the normal-fluid channel, reducing the total sample impedance. For representative parameters, a $1 \,μ\mathrm{m} \times 1 \,μ\mathrm{m}$, $8 $nm-thick disordered film, we find a relative $T_c$ enhancement of about $1\%$, an order of magnitude larger than the $0.1\% $ obtained when phase fluctuations are neglected. These results identify superconductors with soft phase fluctuations as promising platforms for equilibrium control with terahertz resonators.

</details>


### [266] [Micromagnetic Lagrangian and Hamiltonian Normal-Mode Formulation of Cavity Magnon-Photon Interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40416)
*Claudio Serpico,Marco Lembo,Giovanni Miano*

Main category: cond-mat.mes-hall

TL;DR: 本文从线性化 Maxwell 与 Landau-Lifshitz 方程出发，通过引入电矢量势与合适相互作用拉格朗日量，建立腔内磁振子-光子相互作用的多模非规范哈密顿表述，并用广义 Bogoliubov 变换对角化得到极化激元变量，应用于 YIG 圆盘-矩形腔体系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统以磁矢量势描述的方案中，大静磁贡献在模态截断（modal truncation）下会发生抵消导致结果不准确，因此需要一个避免该问题的腔磁振子-光子耦合理论框架。

Method: 从任意微磁基态线性化的耦合 Maxwell 与 Landau-Lifshitz 方程出发，引入电矢量势（electric vector potential）与相互作用拉格朗日量；将磁化与腔场按未耦合子系统简正模展开，耦合系数由本征函数重叠积分给出；针对回旋项（gyrotropic terms）造成的非规范结构，采用 Faddeev-Jackiw 方法构建哈密顿形式，并通过广义 Bogoliubov 变换对角化。

Result: 所得泊松括号（Poisson-bracket）结构编码了辐射型磁振子-光子相互作用，腔诱导的静磁场修正显式进入哈密顿量；对垂直磁化 YIG 圆盘置于矩形微波腔的算例显示腔模与多个静磁模（magnetostatic modes）发生杂化，且样品靠近导电壁时出现明显的腔壁诱导频移。

Conclusion: 该表述给出可自然用于量子化（quantization）的规范极化激元（polariton）变量，为腔磁振子学（cavity magnonics）中多模耦合与腔壁效应提供了自洽的理论基础。

Abstract: We investigate magnon-photon interactions in a resonant cavity starting from the coupled Maxwell and Landau-Lifshitz equations linearized about an arbitrary micromagnetic ground state. By introducing an electric vector potential and a suitable interaction Lagrangian, the formulation avoids the cancellation of large magnetostatic contributions that arises in the conventional magnetic-vector-potential description and becomes inaccurate under modal truncation. The magnetization and cavity fields are expanded in the normal modes of the uncoupled magnetic and electromagnetic subsystems, with coupling coefficients given by overlap integrals of the corresponding eigenfunctions. The resulting multimode Lagrangian has a noncanonical structure due to the gyrotropic terms, and the corresponding Hamiltonian formulation is obtained using the Faddeev-Jackiw approach. The radiative magnon-photon interaction is encoded in the resulting Poisson-bracket structure, while the cavity-induced modification of the magnetostatic field enters explicitly in the Hamiltonian. The coupled system is diagonalized through a generalized Bogoliubov transformation, yielding canonical polariton variables that provide a natural basis for quantization. Application to a perpendicularly magnetized YIG disk in a rectangular microwave cavity shows hybridization between the cavity mode and several magnetostatic modes, together with appreciable cavity-wall-induced frequency shifts when the sample is placed close to the conducting walls.

</details>


### [267] [Electric field control of anisotropic spin traffic between spin-filtering and magnon-scattering in a layered antiferromagnet](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40423)
*Mohamed Soliman,Jaime Garrido Aldea,Davy Borowski,Dorye L. Esteras,Neeraj K. Rajak,Niels Chapuis,Abdelkarim Ouerghi,Arnaud Gloppe,Jérôme Robert,Bernard Doudin,Takashi Taniguchi,Kenji Watanabe,José H. García,Stephan Roche,Jean-François Dayen*

Main category: cond-mat.mes-hall

TL;DR: 通过CrSBr双栅场效应晶体管（dual-gate field-effect transistor）实现对载流子密度与位移场（displacement field）的独立调控，发现位移场而非掺杂主导磁阻比（magnetoresistance ratio, MRR）的符号与大小，并由理论计算与等效自旋电路模型（spin-circuit model）解释其各向异性磁输运。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 层状A型反铁磁（A-type antiferromagnetic, AFM）半导体兼具稳健磁性与可栅调控的半导体特性，被视为自旋电子学器件（spintronic devices）的潜在平台，但其自旋输运的电学调控机制尚待厘清。

Method: 构建基于CrSBr的双栅场效应晶体管，实现载流子密度与位移场的独立控制，并开展系统性输运测量；结合第一性原理计算（ab initio calculations）与等效自旋电路模型对实验现象进行解释。

Result: 测量表明磁阻比的符号与大小主要由位移场而非掺杂决定；研究进一步区分负与正磁阻比分量，并将其归因于层间（interlayer）与层内（intralayer）的自旋相关输运机制，理论计算与自旋电路模型可重现各向异性磁输运行为。

Conclusion: 位移场被确立为CrSBr中自旋输运的有效电学调控参量，且多栅架构（multi-gate architectures）有望在其他层状反铁磁半导体中实现类似调控。

Abstract: Layered A-type antiferromagnetic (AFM) semiconductors offer a unique platform for spintronic devices by combining robust magnetism with gate-tunable semiconducting properties. We present a dual-gate field-effect transistor based on CrSBr, a layered A-type AFM with pronounced transport anisotropy and complex spin dynamics. Our device provides independent control over carrier density and displacement field. Systematic transport measurements reveal that the displacement field, rather than doping, predominantly governs the sign and magnitude of magnetoresistance ratio (MRR). We identify the origins of both negative and positive MRR components and connect them to interlayer and intralayer spin-dependent transport mechanisms. We interpret these findings with ab initio calculations and an effective spin-circuit model that reproduces the anisotropic magnetotransport. Our results identify the displacement field as an efficient electrical control parameter of spin transport in CrSBr and suggest that multi-gate architectures could provide similar control in other layered antiferromagnetic semiconductors.

</details>


### [268] [Time Reflection-Refraction Crossover at Topological Kramers Edge States](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40442)
*Junpeng Hou,Ya-Jie Wu*

Main category: cond-mat.mes-hall

TL;DR: 该文指出，空间均匀的时间调制可在保持瞬时哈密顿量时间反演对称的前提下，于同一量子自旋霍尔相内实现从时间反射到时间折射的渡越（crossover），并据此探讨受保护边缘态与量子几何的调控。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间反演对称性（time-reversal symmetry）通常保护螺旋边缘态（helical edge states）免受静态非磁性背散射，作者关注在维持该对称性的条件下，是否仍能通过时间调制诱导边缘通道间的相干转换。

Method: 采用空间均匀的时间调制，利用有限的体隙（bulk gap）与在Kramers交叉点（Kramers crossing）处消失的边缘劈裂，使调制抑制体激发的同时在边缘通道间保持非绝热；并通过体态的虚跃迁（virtual transitions）在固定晶格动量下实现反向传播边缘通道的相干转换，以qT（q为动量偏移，T为调制持续时间）刻画渡越动力学。

Result: 渡越动力学由qT主导；随调制变慢，相干干涉可使反射被抑制并再度恢复；在绝热极限下，两个初始时间反演共轭波包沿各自传播分支获得相等的几何位移，群速度贡献相消，从而使贝里曲率（Berry curvature）的贡献可被直接观测。

Conclusion: 时间调制为沿拓扑边缘调控受保护态与量子几何（quantum geometry）提供了途径。

Abstract: Time-reversal symmetry protects helical edge states against static nonmagnetic backscattering. We show that spatially uniform temporal modulation produces a time reflection-refraction crossover within the same quantum spin Hall phase while preserving time-reversal symmetry of the instantaneous Hamiltonian. A finite gap to the bulk and an edge splitting that vanishes at the Kramers crossing allow the modulation to suppress bulk excitation while remaining nonadiabatic between the edge channels. Virtual transitions through bulk states enable coherent conversion between counter-propagating edge channels at fixed crystal momentum. Near the crossing, $qT$ governs the leading crossover dynamics for a fixed ramp shape, where $q$ is the momentum offset and $T$ the ramp duration. Coherent interference can suppress and restore reflection as the ramp slows. In the adiabatic limit, two initially time-reversed wave packets follow their respective propagation branches and acquire equal geometric displacements. Their group-velocity contributions cancel, isolating the contribution from the Berry curvature to be directly observable. Temporal modulation thus controls protected states and quantum geometry along a topological edge.

</details>


### [269] [Light-Cone Friedel Oscillations: a Window into van Hove Superconductivity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40648)
*Archisman Panigrahi,Vladislav Poliakov,Leonid Levitov*

Main category: cond-mat.mes-hall

TL;DR: 该文提出利用单个杂质周围的 Friedel 振荡（Friedel oscillations）作为探针，借助 vH 点（Van Hove point）鞍点色散产生的“光锥式”（light-cone）选择性行为，通过扫描隧道显微镜（STM）判断 vH 点附近的准粒子是否存在超导能隙。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: vH 奇异性（Van Hove singularities）可产生大的配对磁化率（pairing susceptibility）从而增强超导，但在实验上难以确定配对是否真的发生在这些点附近。

Method: 从 vH 点附近的鞍点色散（saddle-point dispersion）出发，理论推导 Friedel 振荡呈现“光锥”状的 vH 选择性行为，并据此设计 STM 测量单个杂质周围振荡的探测方案。

Result: 每个 vH 点对应各自实空间的光锥扇区（light-cone sector），使 STM 可测量该鞍点准粒子扇区是否以及多强地打开能隙；超导能隙会在能隙函数角向依赖取峰的方向上抑制振荡。

Conclusion: 该 STM 方案可在实验可及的实空间尺度上提供 vH 相关配对的指纹，并能判别超导配对是出现在 vH 点附近还是费米面（Fermi surface）其他区域。

Abstract: Van Hove (vH) singularities can enhance superconductivity by generating a large pairing susceptibility. Yet, it remains challenging to experimentally establish whether pairing really occurs near these points. We show that the saddle-point dispersion near a vH point gives rise to a `light-cone' vH-selective behavior of Friedel oscillations, which is drastically different from the familiar concentric circles. Each vH point maps onto its own real-space light-cone sector, allowing STM around a single impurity to measure whether---and how strongly---that saddle-point quasiparticle sector is gapped. A superconducting gap near vH points suppresses the oscillations in the directions corresponding to peaks in the gap function angular dependence, a behavior that provides a signature of vH-related pairing at STM-accessible length scales. This STM protocol, targeting vH superconductivity, is capable of determining whether superconducting pairing emerges near the vH points or elsewhere on the Fermi surface.

</details>
