# hep-ph [[Back]](#toc)

### [270] [Model-Independent Determination of Intrinsic Leptonic CP Violation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37744)
*Ting Cheng,Kevin J. Kelly,Max Knobbe,Pedro A. N. Machado*

Main category: hep-ph

TL;DR: 本文提出一种不依赖具体模型的方式，利用高斯过程回归（Gaussian Process regression）从 DUNE 与 Hyper-Kamiokande 数据中无参数化地推断 ν_μ→ν_e 与反中微子对应道的出现概率（appearance probabilities），并证明两实验联合可在标准三中微子框架基准下对超过 60% 的 δ_CP 取值以 3σ 置信度确立模型无关（model-independent）的 CP 破坏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 确立轻子电荷-宇称破坏（Charge-Parity violation, CP violation）是下一代长基线中微子振荡实验的核心目标；现有实验分析依赖在标准三中微子框架内排除 CP 守恒值 δ_CP=0, π，其结果带有模型依赖性。作者因此希望以模型无关方式确立 CP 破坏这一现象本身。

Method: 采用高斯过程回归，以无参数化（parametrization-free）方式推断 DUNE 与 Hyper-Kamiokande 中 ν_μ→ν_e 及 ṽ_μ→ṽ_e 的出现概率；再在关于物质效应对振荡影响的温和假设下联合两个实验，估计其共同探测中微子振荡中内禀 CP 破坏（intrinsic CP violation）的能力。

Result: 以标准三中微子框架作为基准（benchmark），两实验联合可在 δ_CP 超过 60% 的取值范围内以 3σ 显著性确立模型无关的 CP 破坏。

Conclusion: 结果表明，模型无关的 CP 破坏确立在下一代长基线实验联合分析中是可行的，且覆盖面显著；这为超越特定框架假设的轻子 CP 破坏检验提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Establishing leptonic Charge-Parity (CP) violation is a central goal of the next generation of long-baseline neutrino oscillation experiments. To achieve this, experimental analyses focus on excluding the CP-conserving values $δ_{\mathrm{CP}}=0,π$ within the standard three-neutrino framework. We propose instead to establish CP violation as a phenomenon in a model-independent way. We use Gaussian Process regression to infer the $ν_μ\toν_e$ and $\barν_μ\to\barν_e$ appearance probabilities in a parametrization-free manner at DUNE and Hyper-Kamiokande. By combining the two experiments, with mild assumptions on how matter impacts oscillations, we estimate how they can probe intrinsic CP violation in neutrino oscillations together. Taking the standard three-neutrino framework as a benchmark, we show that these experiments, when combined, can establish model-independent CP violation at $3σ$ for over 60% of the values of $δ_{\mathrm{CP}}$.

</details>


### [271] [Probing micron-range fifth forces with cold atoms in optical tweezer arrays](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38660)
*Marios Galanis,Andrew A. Geraci*

Main category: hep-ph

TL;DR: 论文提出在光镊阵列（optical tweezer arrays）中通过共振激发基态冷却原子的运动态来搜寻微米尺度第五力（fifth forces），并基于边带测温（sideband thermometry）发展可逼近标准量子极限（Standard Quantum Limit）的零差读出（homodyne readout）协议，将发现范围扩大至多四个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有微米尺度第五力约束（constraints）灵敏度有限，且额外维度（extra dimensions）模型缺乏桌面实验（tabletop）检验手段，需要新的高灵敏度探测方案。

Method: 以光镊阵列中基态冷却原子的运动态为目标进行共振激发，并构建基于边带测温的零差读出协议，该协议可逼近标准量子极限；同时利用高维引力（higher-dimensional gravity）的参数化增强（parametric enhancement）效应。

Result: 相较现有约束，第五力的发现范围（discovery reach）提升至多四个数量级；该灵敏度还可探测有充分动机的额外维度模型，超越当前桌面实验技术水平。

Conclusion: 光镊阵列中的共振运动态激发结合近标准量子极限读出，为微米尺度第五力与额外维度模型提供了高灵敏度探测途径。

Abstract: We propose a new method to search for fifth forces at micron scales, by resonantly exciting the motional state of ground-state-cooled atoms in optical tweezer arrays. We develop a homodyne readout protocol based on sideband thermometry, which can approach the Standard Quantum Limit, and expand the discovery reach for fifth forces by up to four orders of magnitude compared to existing constraints. We show that this level of sensitivity can also probe well-motivated models of extra dimensions beyond the current tabletop state of the art, by leveraging the parametric enhancement of higher-dimensional gravity.

</details>


### [272] [Collinear Factorization and Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38666)
*George Sterman,Zhite Yu*

Main category: hep-ph

TL;DR: 该文是一篇关于高能遍举截面（inclusive cross sections）中共线因子化（collinear factorization）方法的综述性导引，系统介绍因子化截面的形式、部分子分布（parton distributions）与碎裂函数（fragmentation functions）的定义及演化，并以Drell-Yan过程说明次领头阶（next-to-leading order）QCD修正的计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 共线因子化方法在强子碰撞（hadronic collisions）分析中被广泛使用，但相关概念（部分子模型、演化、红外面安全等）分散于多类文献，需要一个从基础概念出发、贯通至全阶论证的系统性导引。

Method: 以部分子模型（parton model）概念为起点，给出因子化截面的形式，讨论部分子分布、强子碎裂函数及其演化；以Drell-Yan过程为例演示次领头阶QCD修正的计算，并简介深度非弹性散射（deep-inelastic scattering）结构函数与强子结构的关系；进而给出因子化与红外面安全（infrared safety）的全阶（all-order）论证导引。

Result: 摘要为导引性综述，未给出新的定量结果；其"结果"体现为对因子化框架各要素的系统梳理：因子化截面形式、分布与碎裂函数的定义和演化、NLO修正的计算示例、结构函数的作用，以及全阶因子化论证与相关因子化形式的简要评述。

Conclusion: 共线因子化构成分析强子碰撞遍举截面的统一框架；文章以教学式结构串联部分子模型、微扰QCD修正与全阶论证，并以对相关因子化形式（related factorization formalisms）的简短回顾作结。

Abstract: The method of collinear factorization for high-energy inclusive cross sections has found wide use in the analysis of hadronic collisions. We introduce the form of factorized cross sections, and discuss the roles and definitions of parton distributions, hadronic fragmentation functions, and their evolution, starting with parton model concepts. The Drell-Yan process is used to illustrate the calculation of QCD corrections at next-to-leading order. The special role of deep-inelastic scattering structure functions and their relation to hadronic structure are also briefly discussed. We provide an introduction to all-order arguments for factorization and infrared safety, and close with a brief review of related factorization formalisms.

</details>


### [273] [Precision Studies of Boosted Polarized Vector Bosons with Energy Correlators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38688)
*Anjie Gao,Kyle Lee,Xiaoyuan Zhang*

Main category: hep-ph

TL;DR: 该文提出用能量关联函数（energy correlators）对高能（boosted）极化矢量玻色子（W/Z）的强子衰变进行精密研究：实验室系两点能量关联函数在窄宽度极限下可写为纵/横极化衰变谱的加权和，极化效应使高横动量 W/Z 谱相对非极化处理偏移约 10%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高能强子衰变的 W、Z 玻色子是对撞机上最常见的重要对象之一，其矢量性质使子结构（substructure）比标量情形更丰富；而此前缺乏对极化矢量玻色子强子衰变谱的精密理论刻画。

Method: 在窄宽度极限（narrow-width limit）下，将实验室系两点能量关联函数表示为纵、横衰变谱之和，各自由极化产生率加权，并由作用在静止系关联函数上的闭式 boost 核（boost kernel）给出；结合 QCD 中 $pp\to V+X$ 的 NNLO 与 $e^+e^-\to W^+W^-$ 的领头阶极化产生密度矩阵（density matrix），以及包含 NNLO 固定阶、NNLL 共线重求和与 N$^4$LL 背靠背重求和的衰变关联函数。

Result: 对高 $p_T$ 的 W/Z 产生，极化使谱相对朴素非极化处理偏移 $\mathcal{O}(10\%)$；即使不做任何重建（reconstruction），强子 W/Z 衰变在未标记喷注样本的真实 QCD 背景上仍以局域角度凸起（angular bump）显现。

Conclusion: 结果为通过强子衰变利用能量关联函数对电弱玻色子做极化测量（polarimetry）、对喷注内电弱玻色子的标准烛光（standard-candle）测量，以及更灵敏的新共振态（new resonances）搜寻开辟了途径。

Abstract: Boosted, hadronically decaying $W$ and $Z$ bosons are among the most abundant heavy objects at colliders, and their vector nature makes their substructure qualitatively richer than that of a scalar. We initiate precision studies of the hadronic decays of boosted polarized vector bosons with energy correlators. In the narrow-width limit, the laboratory-frame two-point energy correlator is a sum of longitudinal and transverse decay spectra, each weighted by its polarized production rate and obtained by a closed-form boost kernel acting on rest-frame correlators. Combining polarized production density matrices, computed at NNLO in QCD for $pp\to V+X$ and at leading order for $e^+e^-\to W^+W^-$, with decay correlators that combine NNLO fixed order with NNLL collinear and N$^4$LL back-to-back resummation, we find for high-$p_T$ $W/Z$ production that polarization shifts the spectrum by $\mathcal{O}(10\%)$ relative to a naive unpolarized treatment. Even without any reconstruction, hadronic $W/Z$ decays stand out over the realistic QCD background of untagged jet samples as a localized angular bump. Our results open the door to using energy correlators for polarimetry of electroweak bosons through their hadronic decays, for standard-candle measurements of electroweak bosons inside jets, and in sharper searches for new resonances.

</details>


### [274] [Positive-weight moment matching at NNLO and beyond](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38712)
*Benoît Assi,Rene Poncelet,James Whitehead*

Main category: hep-ph

TL;DR: 本文提出一种生成正权重（positive-weighted）事件样本的方法，使样本在可控近似下以任意可用计算的最高微扰精度重现红外安全（IR-safe）可观测量的集合，并首次在正权重样本中同时达到Drell–Yan与Z+jet的NNLO精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高精度微扰下的部分子簇射（parton-shower）模拟会产生大量负事件权重（negative event weights），稀释统计效力，在许多用途下使样本不可用，因此需要构造正权重事件样本。

Method: 构建一种在相空间上可任意微分、且不依赖分bin（binning-dependence）等非物理假象的正权重事件生成方法，在可控近似范围内重现IR-safe可观测量的最高微扰精度结果。

Result: 将该方法应用于领头阶（leading-order）Pythia样本后，首次在正权重事件样本中同时对Drell–Yan与Z+jet可观测量达到NNLO精度。

Conclusion: 该方法可立即推广到更高阶微扰理论、更高多重数（multiplicities），以及其他过程、可观测量与事件产生器（event generators）。

Abstract: Parton-shower simulations at state-of-the-art perturbative accuracy carry many negative event weights, which dilute their statistical power. For many purposes, this makes them unusable. We formulate a method for the generation of positive-weighted event samples which reproduce, up to a controllable approximation, suites of IR-safe observables with the highest perturbative accuracy of any available calculation. This method is arbitrarily differential in phase space, and free from unphysical artefacts such as binning-dependence. Applied to a leading-order Pythia sample, the method gives simultaneous NNLO accuracy for Drell--Yan and $Z+\text{jet}$ observables in a positive-weighted event sample, for the first time. The method generalises immediately to higher orders of perturbation theory, higher multiplicities, and other processes, observables, and event generators.

</details>


### [275] [Searching for Dark Photons and ALPs using Gamma-rays from Nuclear Reactors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38745)
*Lucia Angel,Manfred Lindner,Farinaldo S. Queiroz,Bilge S. Solak*

Main category: hep-ph

TL;DR: 该文给出反应堆伽马射线产生轻弱耦合粒子（暗光子、类轴子）及其在近旁探测器中被探测的、与具体探测器无关的描述，并据此推导CONUS+与CONUS100的预期灵敏度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 反应堆是兆电子伏特（MeV）伽马射线的强源，源于裂变、辐射中子俘获与裂变产物退激；在既有唯象研究基础上，需建立不依赖具体探测器的产生与探测统一描述，以评估轻弱耦合粒子的探测潜力。

Method: 考虑动力学混合暗光子（kinetically mixed dark photons，经康普顿类过程产生与探测）与耦合光子、电子、核子的类轴子粒子（axion-like particles, ALPs），后者的产生机制包括普里马科夫转换（Primakoff conversion）、康普顿类散射及磁性核跃迁（如p(n,γ)d的2.23 MeV线）；并推导CONUS+锗实验及100 kg级CONUS100升级的预期灵敏度。

Result: 对亚MeV暗光子，在0.5 keV≲m_A'≲0.5 MeV范围内，CONUS+与CONUS100分别达到ε≃1.65×10⁻⁵与1.2×10⁻⁵的动力学混合灵敏度；对ALPs，CONUS100在MeV质量区可探测尚未探索的参数空间，尤其依赖氘核线发射ALP的a→e⁺e⁻衰变，并假定能量窗口扩展至10 MeV。

Conclusion: 反应堆伽马射线可用于探测暗光子与ALPs，CONUS+具即时灵敏度，CONUS100升级在MeV质量ALP参数空间具有探索新区域的潜力。

Abstract: Nuclear reactors are intense sources of MeV gamma rays, produced in fission, radiative neutron capture and the de-excitation of fission products. Building on earlier phenomenological studies, we present a detector-independent description of the production of light, weakly coupled particles by reactor gamma rays and of their detection through scattering, absorption and decay in a nearby detector. We consider kinetically mixed dark photons, produced and detected through Compton-like processes, and axion-like particles (ALPs) coupled to photons, electrons and nucleons, produced through Primakoff conversion, Compton-like scattering and magnetic nuclear transitions such as the $2.23~\mathrm{MeV}$ line of $p(n,γ)d$. As a concrete application, we derive the projected sensitivities of the CONUS+ germanium experiment at the Leibstadt reactor and of a conceivable $100$-kg CONUS100 upgrade. For sub-MeV dark photons, CONUS+ and CONUS100 reach kinetic mixings of $ε\simeq1.65\times10^{-5}$ and $1.2\times10^{-5}$, respectively, for $0.5~\mathrm{keV}\lesssim m_{A'}\lesssim0.5~\mathrm{MeV}$. For ALPs, we show that CONUS100 can probe an unexplored region of parameter space at MeV masses, in particular through $a\to e^+e^-$ decays of ALPs emitted in the deuteron line, assuming a energy window extended to $10~\mathrm{MeV}$.

</details>


### [276] [Predicting $B^{(*)}\bar D{}^{(*)}$ states from a reanalysis of lattice QCD data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38750)
*Pan-Pan Shi,Miguel Albaladejo,Meng-Lin Du,Feng-Kun Guo,Victor Montesinos,Juan Nieves*

Main category: hep-ph

TL;DR: 基于晶格QCD数据并结合重夸克自旋对称性与手征对称性约束的短程和长程相互作用，系统预言了同位旋标量 $B^{(*)}\bar D^{(*)}$ 分子态谱，并将晶格报告的两个共振态分别解释为 $B^*\bar D^*$ 与 $B\bar D^*$ 强子分子。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 晶格QCD已在 $J^P=0^+$ 和 $1^+$ 的 $\bar b\bar c ud$ 通道报告了两个共振态，但其动力学本质尚缺乏统一解释；本文旨在借助对称性约束的相互作用框架对这些晶格谱进行统一解读。

Method: 重新分析 $m_\pi\simeq 220$ MeV 下同位旋标量 $\bar b\bar c ud$ 系统的晶格QCD数据，在相互作用中同时纳入受重夸克自旋对称性（heavy-quark spin symmetry）和手征对称性（chiral symmetry）约束的短程与长程相互作用，并用拟合晶格结果的相互作用预言 $J^P=0^+,1^+,2^+$ 的 $B^{(*)}\bar D^{(*)}$ 分子态谱。

Result: 预言的 $J^P=0^+$ 与 $1^+$ 的 $B\bar D$、$B^*\bar D$ 束缚态与晶格结果一致；晶格合作组报告的两个共振态可分别自然解释为 $B^*\bar D^*$ 与 $B\bar D^*$ 强子分子（hadronic molecules）；另预言两个此前未报道的 $B^*\bar D^*$ 态（$J^P=1^+$ 与 $2^+$），分别对应一个束缚态和一个浅态，后者极点可能对应虚态（virtual state）或束缚态。

Conclusion: 结果为晶格谱提供了统一解释，并凸显短程与长程相互作用在 $B^{(*)}\bar D^{(*)}$ 系统动力学中的相互配合作用。

Abstract: We reanalyze the lattice QCD data for the isoscalar $\bar b\bar c ud$ systems with $J^P=0^+$ and $1^+$ at $m_π\simeq 220$ MeV, incorporating both short- and long-range interactions constrained by heavy-quark spin and chiral symmetries. Using the interaction fitted to the lattice results, we predict a spectrum of isoscalar $B^{(*)}\bar D{}^{(*)}$ molecular states with quantum numbers $J^P=0^+$, $1^+$, and $2^+$. The predicted $J^P=0^+$ and $1^+$ $B\bar D$ and $B^*\bar D$ bound states are consistent with the lattice results. Furthermore, the two resonances reported by the lattice collaboration in the $J^P=0^+$ and $1^+$ $\bar b\bar c ud$ channels can be naturally interpreted as $B^*\bar D{}^*$ and $B\bar D{}^*$ hadronic molecules, respectively. We also predict two previously unreported $B^*\bar D{}^*$ states with $J^P=1^+$ and $2^+$: a bound state and a shallow state whose pole may correspond to either a virtual state or a bound state, respectively. Our results provide a unified interpretation of the lattice spectrum and highlight the interplay between short- and long-range interactions in the dynamics of the $B^{(*)}\bar D{}^{(*)}$ systems.

</details>


### [277] [Linking a 152 GeV diphoton excess to dark matter and gravitational waves in the singlet-extended 2HDM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39057)
*Yabo Dong,Jun Fan,Kun Wang,Haijun Yang,Jingya Zhu*

Main category: hep-ph

TL;DR: 本文在引入复标量单态的Type-I双希格斯二重态模型（two-Higgs-doublet model, 2HDM）框架下，解释152 GeV附近伴随缺失横向动量（missing transverse momentum, MET）的双光子超出（diphoton excess），并探讨其与暗物质（dark matter, DM）遗迹密度及电弱相变引力波信号的关联。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 152 GeV附近的双光子超出与MET信号需要理论解释，本文检验复标量单态扩展的Type-I 2HDM能否同时容纳该信号、满足暗物质遗迹密度，并产生可探测的引力波。

Method: 以复标量单态的虚部作为赝-Nambu-Goldstone暗物质候选χ，通过级联过程gg→h₃→h₂h₂→γγχχ产生信号；在施加理论与实验约束后扫描参数空间，筛选同时满足低MET/高MET超出（1σ内）与遗迹密度的样本，并计算一阶电弱相变（first-order electroweak phase transition）与引力波谱。

Result: 存在参数区域可至少容纳低MET或高MET超出之一（1σ内），并在假定10%理论不确定度下重现观测遗迹密度；部分样本支持具有显著过冷（supercooling）的一阶电弱相变，三年观测期内于LISA、TianQin、DECIGO与BBO的信噪比（SNR）超过10。

Conclusion: 同时容纳两类超出（各自1σ内）并满足遗迹密度要求的代表性基准点，给出约173的三年期BBO信噪比，表明该模型可在单一框架内统合双光子超出、暗物质与引力波探测。

Abstract: We investigate the diphoton excesses near $152~\mathrm{GeV}$ accompanied by missing transverse momentum (MET) in the Type-I two-Higgs-doublet model extended by a complex scalar singlet, whose imaginary component serves as a pseudo-Nambu-Goldstone dark matter (DM) candidate $χ$. The signal arises from the cascade process $gg\to h_3\to h_2h_2\toγγχχ$, where $h_2$ is the scalar resonance near $152~\mathrm{GeV}$ and $h_3$ is a heavier CP-even scalar. After imposing the theoretical and experimental constraints, we identify parameter regions that accommodate at least one of the Low-MET and High-MET excesses within $1σ$ and simultaneously reproduce the observed DM relic density within an assumed $10\%$ theoretical uncertainty. A subset of these samples supports first-order electroweak phase transitions with substantial supercooling. For a three-year observation, selected samples yield gravitational-wave signals with signal-to-noise ratios (SNRs) above $10$ at LISA, TianQin, DECIGO, and BBO. A representative benchmark that accommodates both excesses within their respective $1σ$ intervals and satisfies the relic-density requirement yields a three-year BBO SNR of approximately $173$.

</details>


### [278] [A doubly charmed strange molecule from coupled-channel dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39143)
*Hee-Jin Kim,Hyun-Chul Kim*

Main category: hep-ph

TL;DR: 采用离壳耦合道形式研究双粲分子态 $T_{cc\bar{s}}$（$C=+2$、$\mathcal{S}=+1$、$I=1/2$），仅在 $J^P=1^+$ 通道找到极点，质量为 3972.90 MeV，对应相对 $D^*D_s$ 阈值的结合能 4.01 MeV，极点主要归属于三重态（$\mathbf{3}_A$）表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究具有奇异数的双粲分子态 $T_{cc\bar{s}}$ 的束缚态性质，并判别其在 SU(3) 味对称性下的表示归属，同时探讨重夸克自旋对称性（heavy-quark spin symmetry）对该束缚态的相关性。

Method: 在离壳耦合道（off-shell coupled-channel）形式下，基于有效拉格朗日量（effective Lagrangian）的介子交换模型（meson-exchange model）构造相互作用核，并在 Blankenbecler-Sugar 约化下求解耦合道散射方程，提取极点位置与极点留数（pole residues）所给出的 $S$ 波道耦合符号与大小。

Result: 在 $J^P=0^\pm$、$1^\pm$、$2^\pm$ 中仅在 $J^P=1^+$ 出现极点；取约化截断质量 600 MeV 时质量为 3972.90 MeV，相对 $D^*D_s$ 阈值的结合能为 4.01 MeV；由 $S$ 波道耦合的相对符号与大小判定该极点主要属于三重态（$\mathbf{3}_A$）表示。

Conclusion: 所研究的 $T_{cc\bar{s}}$ 可作为 $J^P=1^+$ 的 $D^*D_s$ 分子束缚态存在，且以三重态（$\mathbf{3}_A$）分量为主；摘要还讨论了重夸克自旋对称性对该束缚态的相关性。

Abstract: We investigate a doubly charmed molecular state $T_{cc\bar{s}}$ with $C=+2$, $\mathcal{S}=+1$, and $I=1/2$ in an off-shell coupled-channel formalism. Constructing the interaction kernel from a meson-exchange model based on an effective Lagrangian and solving the coupled-channel scattering equation in the Blankenbecler-Sugar reduction, we find a pole only for $J^P=1^+$ among $J^P=0^\pm$, $1^\pm$, and $2^\pm$. With the reduced cutoff mass of $600$~MeV, we obtain a mass of $3972.90$~MeV, which corresponds to a binding energy of $4.01$~MeV relative to the $D^*D_s$ threshold. Examining the relative signs and magnitudes of the $S$-wave channel couplings extracted from the pole residues, we demonstrate that the pole belongs predominantly to the triplet ($\mathbf{3}_A$) representation. We also discuss the relevance of heavy-quark spin symmetry to the bound state.

</details>


### [279] [Manifestation of near-threshold $Λ\barΛ$ resonances in $e^{+}e^{-}\rightarrowΛ\barΛη$ process](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39526)
*A. I. Milstein,S. G. Salnikov*

Main category: hep-ph

TL;DR: 该文表明，$e^{+}e^{-}\rightarrow\Lambda\bar{\Lambda}\eta$ 过程中 $\Lambda\bar{\Lambda}$ 对的不变质量分布（invariant-mass distribution）可由阈附近两个共振态（$J^{PC}=1^{--}$ 的松散束缚态与 $J^{PC}=1^{+-}$ 的虚态）共同解释，理论与实验数据吻合良好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 摘要指出实验上 $\Lambda\bar{\Lambda}$ 对的不变质量分布需要理论解释，故研究引入阈附近特定量子数（quantum numbers）的共振态（resonances）以描述该分布及 $\eta$ 介子角分布（angular distribution）。

Method: 构建包含两个近阈共振态的模型：$J^{PC}=1^{--}$ 对应松散束缚态（loosely bound state），$J^{PC}=1^{+-}$ 对应阈值以上的虚态（virtual state），并据此计算不变质量分布与 $\eta$ 介子角分布。

Result: 同时计入两个共振态后，理论预言与实验数据符合良好；预言的 $\eta$ 介子角分布也与实验数据一致，且该角分布对 $\Lambda\bar{\Lambda}$ 对的不变质量表现出强烈依赖。

Conclusion: 阈附近 $J^{PC}=1^{--}$ 与 $J^{PC}=1^{+-}$ 两类共振态可解释 $e^{+}e^{-}\rightarrow\Lambda\bar{\Lambda}\eta$ 的观测特征；模型中 $\eta$ 介子角分布强烈依赖于 $\Lambda\bar{\Lambda}$ 的不变质量。

Abstract: It is shown that the invariant-mass distribution of $Λ\barΛ$ pairs in the process $e^{+}e^{-}\rightarrowΛ\barΛη$ can be explained by near-threshold resonances with quantum numbers $J^{PC}=1^{--}$ and $J^{PC}=1^{+-}$. The resonance with $J^{PC}=1^{--}$ corresponds to a loosely bound state, while the resonance with $J^{PC}=1^{+-}$ is a virtual state above the threshold. Accounting for both resonances results in good agreement between theoretical predictions and experimental data. The predicted angular distribution of $η$ mesons is also consistent with experimental data. It is shown that in our model there is a strong dependence of $η$-meson angular distribution on the invariant mass of $Λ\barΛ$ pair.

</details>


### [280] [$P$--wave quarkonia in jets at the LHC](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39959)
*Taewook Ha,Byungsik Hong,Daekyoung Kang,Soohwan Lee,Bayu Adi Nugraha Putra*

Main category: hep-ph

TL;DR: 本文首次在次领头阶（next-to-leading order, NLO）精度下，利用碎裂喷注函数（fragmenting jet function）框架系统研究了 LHC 上喷注内部 $P$-波粲偶素 $\\chi_{cJ}$ 与底偶素 $\\chi_{bJ}(nP)$ 的产生。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 喷注内 $P$-波夸克偶素（quarkonium）产生缺乏系统的理论计算，且粲偶素与底偶素扇区可能存在显著差异，需要统一的微扰框架加以刻画并与实验运动学选择对接。

Method: 采用碎裂喷注函数框架，在 $\\alpha_s$ 次领头阶计算，在碎裂函数（fragmentation functions）中同时重求和共线 DGLAP 对数与阈值双对数（threshold double logarithms），并计入更高夸克偶素态的馈降（feeddown）贡献；同时与 \\textsc{Pythia}~8 模拟进行比较。

Result: $\\chi_{bJ}(nP)$ 的归一化动量分数分布呈现近乎普适的形状，对长程矩阵元（long-distance matrix element）集合、径向激发（$n=1,2,3$）与总角动量（$J=0,1,2$）依赖极弱，作者归因于 ${}^3S_1^{[8]}$ 碎裂道的主导地位；相反，$\\chi_{cJ}$ 的分布形状对矩阵元集合依赖更强。文中给出了 CMS 与 LHCb 运动学选择下、多个喷注横动量区间的预测。

Conclusion: 底偶素与粲偶素扇区在喷注内 $P$-波产生中表现出鲜明对比，其物理根源在于 ${}^3S_1^{[8]}$ 与 ${}^3P_J^{[1]}$ 道相对贡献的差异；该框架可为 LHC 相关测量提供理论预言。

Abstract: We present the first systematic theoretical study of the production of $P$-wave charmonium states $χ_{cJ}$ and bottomonium states $χ_{bJ}(nP)$ within jets at the LHC using the fragmenting jet function framework at next-to-leading order in $α_s$. Our calculation resums both collinear DGLAP logarithms and threshold double logarithms in the fragmentation functions and accounts for feeddown contributions from higher quarkonium states. We observe a notable contrast between the charmonium and bottomonium sectors. For $χ_{bJ}(nP)$, the normalized momentum-fraction distributions exhibit a nearly universal shape, with remarkably weak dependence on the choice of long-distance matrix element sets, the radial excitation ($n=1,2,3$), and the total angular momentum ($J=0,1,2$). We attribute this universality to the overwhelming dominance of the ${}^3S_1^{[8]}$ fragmentation channel, while feeddown contributions from higher bottomonium states remain small. In contrast, the shape of $χ_{cJ}$ distributions exhibits a stronger dependence on the matrix-element set, reflecting the different relative contributions of the ${}^3S_1^{[8]}$ and ${}^3P_J^{[1]}$ channels. We provide predictions for the $χ_{cJ}$ and $χ_{bJ}(nP)$ distributions for the CMS and LHCb kinematic selections across a range of jet transverse momenta. We also compare our predictions with \textsc{Pythia}~8 simulations for selected $P$-wave quarkonium states.

</details>


### [281] [Nonlinear response and retarded three-point correlators of charge transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38571)
*Jin Hu*

Main category: hep-ph

TL;DR: 本文在弛豫时间近似下研究相对论动理学理论中的电荷输运非线性响应，对无质量带电粒子的玻尔兹曼方程按外源微扰展开，得到任意响应阶的分布函数递推解，并在二阶解析给出完全推迟的三点关联函数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有研究多集中于线性响应与平衡态附近输运，非线性响应下电荷输运的完整推迟关联结构及其守恒律约束尚缺乏系统刻画；本文旨在建立可推广至任意阶的动理学框架。

Method: 采用弛豫时间近似（relaxation time approximation）处理经典无质量带电粒子气体与外部 U(1) 规范场（U(1) gauge field）的耦合，将玻尔兹曼方程（Boltzmann equation）按外源做微扰展开，推导分布函数的递推解；在二阶解析计算一般频率与动量下的完全推迟三点关联函数（fully retarded three-point correlators）。

Result: 获得任意响应阶分布函数的递推解；二阶解析得到一般频率与动量下的完全推迟三点关联函数，并验证了电荷守恒所蕴含的沃德恒等式（Ward identities）；进一步讨论关联函数的解析结构、一致性极限（consistency limits）及其与扩散涨落的 Schwinger–Keldysh 有效理论（Schwinger–Keldysh effective theories）的关系。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了相对论动理学中非线性电荷输运关联函数的系统计算方案，二阶结果满足守恒律约束，并与扩散涨落的 Schwinger–Keldysh 有效描述相衔接，为高阶非线性响应研究奠定基础。

Abstract: We study nonlinear response of charge transport in relativistic kinetic theory within the relaxation time approximation. For a classical gas of massless charged particles coupled to an external $U(1)$ gauge field, we organize the Boltzmann equation perturbatively in the source and derive a recursive solution for the distribution function to arbitrary response order. At second order we analytically obtain fully retarded three-point correlators at generic frequencies and momenta, verify the Ward identities implied by charge conservation. We also discuss the general properties of these correlators, including their analytic structure, consistency limits, and relation to Schwinger--Keldysh effective theories of diffusive fluctuations.

</details>


### [282] [Circular Axion String Loop Simulations: Field Theory and Effective Description](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37764)
*Mathieu Kaltschmidt,Javier Redondo,Ivan Rybak,Kenichi Saikawa,Iker Sanz-González*

Main category: hep-ph

TL;DR: 本文通过对比场论模拟与重整化 NGKR 方程解，研究了轴子弦（axion string）环的坍缩与辐射，发现两者在 $1/\mathcal{T}$ 领头修正上存在 20–35% 差异，且场论坍缩在紫外谱中产生额外结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 准确描述轴子弦（axion string）及其辐射对理解其宇宙学影响至关重要，而此前研究结论存在分歧，故需要一个简单可控的设定来检验不同方法的一致性。

Method: 研究 Minkowski 背景下初始静止圆环的坍缩，将传统复标量场与高张力 Klaer–Moore 模型的场论模拟（field-theory simulations）与重整化 Nambu–Goto–Kalb–Ramond（NGKR）运动方程的解进行对比，覆盖无量纲弦张力 $3 \lesssim \mathcal{T} \lesssim 100$ 的范围。

Result: 场论与 NGKR 均趋近 Nambu–Goto（NG）极限，修正按 $1/\mathcal{T}$ 标度；但同一张力范围内 NGKR 给出的半衰期（halving-time）领头修正比场论模拟大约 20–35%，而大张力下与独立微扰计算吻合至 0.2%。晚期轴子谱在红外端与 NGKR 一致，但坍缩在紫外端产生额外结构。

Conclusion: 紫外额外结构被归因于外传波前（outgoing wave front）携带相当比例能量或初始环回弹（rebound）等不同事件；结果为更准确理解宇宙学弦网络（string network）的轴子辐射提供了基准。

Abstract: An accurate description of axion strings and their radiation is crucial for understanding their cosmological implications. Motivated by the differing conclusions of previous works, we study a simple, controlled setup: the collapse of an initially static circular loop in a Minkowski background. We compare field-theory simulations of the conventional complex scalar and high-tension Klaer--Moore models with solutions of the renormalised Nambu--Goto--Kalb--Ramond (NGKR) equation of motion, covering the range $3 \lesssim \mathcal{T} \lesssim 100$ in dimensionless string tension. Both the field theory and NGKR approach the Nambu--Goto (NG) limit with corrections scaling as $1/\mathcal{T}$. However, the leading correction to the halving-time is $20-35\%$ larger in NGKR than in the field-theory simulations over the same range of tensions, while for large tensions the value agrees with an independent perturbative calculation to $0.2\%$. The late-time axion spectrum agrees with NGKR in the infrared, but the collapse generates additional structure in the ultraviolet part of the spectrum, which we attribute to different events such as an outgoing wave front that carries a sizable fraction of the energy or the rebound of the initial loop. These results provide a useful benchmark for a more accurate understanding of axion radiation from cosmological string networks.

</details>


### [283] [Gauge-parameter cancellation and finite form factors in one-loop quark scattering in the refined Gribov-Zwanziger framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38463)
*Wan Wu*

Main category: hep-ph

TL;DR: 本文计算了在局部BRST不变的精炼Gribov-Zwanziger（refined Gribov-Zwanziger）理论中、最小耦合无质量不同味夸克散射的一圈振幅（one-loop amplitude），并给出由八个色-旋量形状因子（color-spin form factors）与三十项标量积分清单构成的有限结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究动机在于在包含Gribov-Zwanziger质量项与约束行列式的局部BRST不变理论框架下，考察不同味无质量夸克散射的一圈量子修正，并厘清规范依赖、紫外与红外极点结构以及质量与维数极限次序所遮蔽的贡献。

Method: 在作用量中纳入约束行列式与两个动力学夸克味，并在圈图求和中保留精炼Gribov-Zwanziger质量于自由场矩阵；合并混合自能插入、完整顶点与箱图修正及外腿留数，采用指定维数正规化方案移除Stueckelberg调节子后比较一般线性协变规范与参考规范。

Result: 规范差异在移除Stueckelberg调节子后符号上消失；紫外极点由局部修正最小减除（modified-minimal-subtraction）抵消项消除，红外极点在所述非零质量区域内相互抵消。有限结果以八个色-旋量形状因子对三十项标量积分清单的形式给出，全部144个有限函数系数以电子形式提供。

Conclusion: 该结果在指定解析分支上定义了一个部分子振幅（partonic amplitude），但不假设存在带色渐近态，也未建立包含性的次领头阶（next-to-leading-order）截面。

Abstract: We calculate the one-loop amplitude for distinct-flavor massless quark scattering in a local BRST-invariant refined Gribov-Zwanziger theory with minimally coupled quarks. The constraint determinant and two dynamical quark flavors are included in the action and in the loop sum. Retaining the refined Gribov-Zwanziger masses in the free field matrix, we combine the mixed self-energy insertion, complete vertex and box corrections, and external-leg residues. The difference between a general linear covariant gauge and a reference gauge vanishes symbolically after removal of the Stueckelberg regulator in the specified dimensional prescription. We separate ultraviolet and infrared poles, retaining contributions hidden by scaleless integrals and by the order of mass and dimensional limits. Local modified-minimal-subtraction counterterms close the ultraviolet poles, and the remaining infrared poles cancel in the stated nonzero-mass domain. The finite answer is supplied as eight color-spin form factors over a thirty-entry scalar integral inventory, with all 144 finite-function coefficients provided electronically. The result defines a partonic amplitude on a specified analytic branch; it does not assume colored asymptotic states or establish an inclusive next-to-leading-order cross section.

</details>


### [284] [Two-loop BRST-restoring finite counter-terms for chiral non-abelian gauge theories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38618)
*Achilleas Lazopoulos,Vera Paroutiadou*

Main category: hep-ph

TL;DR: 本文在无标量场的无反常手征 SU(N) 规范理论中，采用 BMHV 方案处理 γ5，于两圈阶推导出恢复 BRST 对称性所需的有限抵消项（counter-terms），适用于一般（可能可约）的费米子表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在维数正规化（dimensional regularization）中，γ5 的处理方案会人为破坏 BRST 对称性（BRST symmetry），因此除紫外发散抵消外还需引入有限对称性恢复抵消项；此前该类抵消项的系统推导尚未覆盖一般费米子表示的两圈情形。

Method: 采用 Breitenlohner–Maison–'t Hooft–Veltman（BMHV）方案处理 γ5，对无标量场的无反常手征 SU(N) 规范理论开展两圈阶重整化计算，并针对一般、可能可约的费米子表示推导有限对称性恢复抵消项。

Result: 给出了在两圈阶恢复 BRST 对称性所需的有限抵消项的显式推导结果，其适用范围涵盖一般（可能可约）的费米子表示。

Conclusion: 在 BMHV 方案下，无标量场无反常手征 SU(N) 规范理论可通过所推导的有限抵消项在两圈阶恢复 BRST 对称性。

Abstract: We study the renormalization of anomaly-free chiral $SU(N)$ gauge theories without scalar fields through two-loop order. We adopt the Breitenlohner--Maison--'t Hooft--Veltman (BMHV) scheme for the treatment of $γ_5$ in dimensional regularization. This prescription induces spurious breaking of BRST symmetry, requiring finite symmetry-restoring counter-terms in addition to the subtraction of ultraviolet divergences. We derive these counter-terms for a general, possibly reducible fermion representation, thus restoring the BRST symmetry, through two loops.

</details>


### [285] [Quantum Observables of Nonperturbative Superradiant Scattering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38690)
*Asimina Arvanitaki,Savas Dimopoulos,Marios Galanis,Derek J. Li*

Main category: hep-ph

TL;DR: 该文提出一个非微扰理论（nonperturbative theory），用于描述来自N个相干自旋（coherent spins）或任意二能级系统的超辐射散射（superradiant scattering）及其对自旋的反作用（backreaction），并指出即使在大N、弱耦合下玻恩近似（Born approximation）失效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 由于来自N个相干自旋的非弹性散射（inelastic scattering）截面按N²标度增长，在大N时即使耦合很弱，玻恩近似（Born approximation）也会失效，因此需要发展非微扰描述。

Method: 建立一个关于超辐射散射（superradiant scattering）及自旋反作用（backreaction）的非微扰理论（nonperturbative theory）；核心分析点是单粒子可交换多个量子（exchange many quanta），并考察守恒律（conservation law）对每次碰撞只允许交换一个量子的限制情形。

Result: 当粒子可交换多个量子时，即使截面（cross section）饱和，靶的能量转移速率（energy-transfer rate）与能量方差速率（energy-variance rate）仍保持有利的N²标度；除非守恒律将每次相遇限制为单量子交换。

Conclusion: 该理论应用于毫电荷粒子（millicharged-particle）搜寻，以及可检验用于探测宇宙遗迹（cosmic relics）的量子协议的中子束（neutron beams）与带电粒子束（charged-particle beams）。

Abstract: Inelastic scattering from $N$ coherent spins, or any two-state system, scales as $N^2$, invalidating the Born approximation at large $N$ even at weak coupling. We develop a nonperturbative theory of this superradiant scattering and its backreaction on the spins. Since one particle can exchange many quanta, the target's energy-transfer and energy-variance rates keep their favorable $N^2$ scaling even after the cross section saturates, unless a conservation law limits each encounter to exchange of one quantum. We apply the theory to millicharged-particle searches, as well as neutron and charged-particle beams that can test quantum protocols for detecting cosmic relics.

</details>


### [286] [Searching for axion-like particles with space-based optical lattice clock networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39725)
*Yu-Song Cao,Nick Houston,YanXia Liu,QingZheng Lv,She-Sheng Xue*

Main category: hep-ph

TL;DR: 该文提出利用天基光晶格钟网络（SOLCN）通过宇宙双折射（cosmic birefringence）探测轴子类粒子（ALPs）暗物质，借助交叉相关信号与网络链路频率优化，可在约10^-18–10^-14 eV质量区间达到g_aγ低至10^-16 GeV^-1的灵敏度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 轴子类粒子（ALPs）是暗物质及超出标准模型（beyond the Standard Model）物理的优选候选，但其相互作用极弱导致直接探测极为困难，因此需要新的探测手段。

Method: 提出对原用于探测随机引力波背景（SGWB）的天基光晶格钟网络（SOLCN）进行激光链路（laser links）的小幅改造，借助宇宙双折射效应探测轴子暗物质，并利用ALPs较长相干长度（correlation lengths）带来的交叉相关信号（cross-correlated signals）提升灵敏度。

Result: 在ALPs质量区间10^-18.55–10^-14 eV（重点为10^-18–10^-14 eV）内，可探测至g_aγ ≥ 10^-12 GeV^-1；灵敏度关键依赖于网络链路频率，采用8 GHz链路时该区间有望达到g_aγ ≥ 10^-16 GeV^-1。

Conclusion: SOLCN经小幅改造可成为低质量ALPs暗物质的灵敏探针，且链路频率是决定其对ALP-光子耦合（ALP-photon coupling）探测能力的关键参数。

Abstract: Axion like particles (ALPs) are particularly well motivated candidates for dark matter, and physics beyond the Standard Model more generally. However, direct detection remains extremely challenging due to the weakness of their interactions. In this work, we propose to employ space-based optical lattice clock networks (SOLCN), originally targeted to probe the stochastic gravitational wave background (SGWB), to detect axion dark matter through cosmic birefringence via minor modifications to their laser links. Searching for cross-correlated signals then provides significant sensitivity to low mass ALPs as a result of their large correlation lengths. In this work we focus on ALPs in the mass range $10^{-18.55}\text{eV}-10^{-14}\text{eV}$, For ALPs mass region $10^{-18}-10^{-14}\text{eV}$, finding that we can probe down to $g_{aγ}\geq 10^{-12}\,\text{GeV}^{-1}$. Moreover, we find that the SOLCN sensitivity to the ALP-photon coupling depends crucially on the frequency of the network link. With an $8$ GHz frequency link, we then have the potential to reach $g_{aγ}\geq10^{-16}\,\text{GeV}^{-1}$ in this region.

</details>


### [287] [Nucleon Wave Functions from QCD Vacuum Topology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39215)
*Wei-Yang Liu,Ismail Zahed*

Main category: hep-ph

TL;DR: 基于瞬子液体模型（instanton liquid model, ILM）导出双夸克（diquark）相互作用核，并嵌入协变、置换对称的 Bethe–Salpeter–Faddeev 方程，得到核子质量 $m_N=939.53$ MeV、轴荷 $g_A=1.265$ 及领头三夸克光锥波函数与部分子分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 瞬子（instanton）作为拓扑非平庸的规范场构型，为 QCD 中手征对称性破缺与 $U_A(1)$ 反常提供微观机制；作者希望在此框架下建立核子的微观描述，说明 QCD 真空拓扑不仅决定核子质量与自旋结构，也组织其领头价部分子内容。

Method: 在 ILM 中由单瞬子与瞬子—反瞬子分子（instanton--anti-instanton molecule）导出夸克—夸克关联对应的双夸克相互作用核，发现标量道强吸引、自旋一道关联较弱；再将这些相互作用嵌入协变且置换对称的 Bethe--Salpeter--Faddeev 方程，并将所得协变振幅解析延拓到光锥以获取领头三夸克波函数。

Result: 得到核子质量 $m_N=939.53$ MeV，质量极点附近以标量双夸克分量为主（$98\%$），轴矢分量占 $2\%$；虽权重小，该混合产生显著的旋—同位旋干涉，给出 $g_A=1.265$，接近实验值。由光锥波函数进一步得到非极化、螺旋度（helicity）与横向度（transversity）部分子分布及其 QCD 演化矩，可与格点 QCD 计算和全局拟合分析直接对比。

Conclusion: 结果表明 QCD 真空的拓扑结构不仅组织核子质量与自旋结构，也决定其领头价部分子内容，为包含禁闭（confinement）与更高 Fock 分量的更完整描述提供微观基础。

Abstract: Instantons, as topologically nontrivial gauge field configurations, provide a microscopic mechanism for chiral symmetry breaking and the $U_A(1)$ anomaly in QCD. Within the instanton liquid model (ILM), instantons generate multi-fermion interactions governed by their density and size. Using this framework, we develop a microscopic description of the nucleon based on instanton-induced quark--quark correlations. We derive the diquark interaction kernels arising from single instantons and instanton--anti-instanton molecules, revealing a strong attraction in the scalar channel and weaker correlations in the spin-one channels. Embedding these interactions in a covariant, permutation-symmetric Bethe--Salpeter--Faddeev equation yields a nucleon mass $m_N=939.53~{\rm MeV}$, with a predominantly scalar-diquark component ($98\%$) and a small axial-vector admixture ($2\%$) around the mass pole. Despite its small weight, the small admixture generates substantial spin--isospin interference, yielding an axial charge $g_A=1.265$, close to experiment. The resulting covariant amplitude is analytically continued to the light front to obtain the leading three-quark wave function. The corresponding unpolarized, helicity, and transversity parton distributions, along with their QCD-evolved moments, provide a direct connection to lattice QCD calculations and global-fit analyses. Our results show that the topology of the QCD vacuum organizes not only the nucleon mass and spin structure, but also its leading valence partonic content, providing a microscopic foundation for a more complete description including confinement and higher Fock components.

</details>


### [288] [Heavy-Particle Effective Theory: from On-Shell Formalism to Gravitational Compton Amplitudes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40263)
*Yong-Kang Li,Yi-Ning Wang,Jiang-Hao Yu*

Main category: hep-ph

TL;DR: 本文提出在壳重粒子有效理论（heavy-particle effective theory, HPET）振幅的新构造方式：将旋量-螺旋度变量（spinor-helicity variables）投影到类时参考速度的 SU(2) 小群上，得到速度投影振幅，并在按重粒子质量倒数展开前施加重参数化不变性（reparameterization invariance），随后积分掉小分量获得按重粒子幂次计数组织的 HPET 振幅。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有重粒子有效理论振幅构造通常直接做质量展开，难以在展开前系统施加重参数化不变性并与定阶局域算符建立直接对应；本文旨在提供一个中间的速度投影振幅层次，使重参数化不变性的实施与幂次计数组织更为清晰。

Method: 将旋量-螺旋度变量投影到类时参考速度 v^μ 的 SU(2) 小群，保留速度投影旋量的大、小两类分量以构造中间的速度投影振幅；在该层次施加重参数化不变性，再积分掉小分量得到 HPET 振幅。并确定任意自旋 S 的两个等质量粒子与螺旋度 h 的无质量软玻色子耦合的三点速度投影振幅，用其构造四点引力康普顿（Compton）振幅并展开为 HPET 振幅。

Result: 给出了任意自旋 S 等质量粒子与软无质量玻色子耦合的三点速度投影振幅；四点引力康普顿振幅可由速度投影三点振幅构造性获得，其 HPET 展开在次领头阶以内不含赝极点（spurious poles）。在引力应用中，投影后的引力最小耦合可重现 Kerr 自旋诱导多极（spin-induced multipoles）至 2S 阶；树级弹性引力散射与引力康普顿振幅的经典极限在接触项（contact terms）之外与文献一致，而该接触项无法由因子化确定。

Conclusion: 速度投影振幅为 HPET 振幅提供了一个可施加重参数化不变性、并与定阶局域算符直接对应的中间层次；该方法在引力情形下能重现 Kerr 多极结构并给出与文献相符的经典散射极限，说明其在重粒子有效理论振幅构造与引力应用中的有效性。

Abstract: We formulate on-shell heavy-particle effective theory (HPET) amplitudes by projecting the spinor-helicity variables onto the $SU(2)$ little group of a timelike reference velocity $v^μ$. Retaining both large and small components of the velocity-projected spinors gives an intermediate velocity-projected amplitudes in which reparameterization invariance can be imposed before expanding in the inverse heavy-particle mass. Integrating out the small component then yields HPET amplitudes organized by heavy-particle power counting, with a direct correspondence to local operators at fixed order. We determine the three-point velocity-projected amplitudes for two equal-mass particles of arbitrary spin $S$ coupled to a soft massless boson of helicity $h$. Four-point gravitational Compton amplitudes can be constructively obtained using velocity-projected three-point amplitudes, and expanded into HPET amplitudes which is free of spurious poles up to sub-leading order. As a gravitational application, we show that the projected gravitational minimal coupling reproduces the Kerr spin-induced multipoles up to order $2S$, and find the classical limits of the tree-level elastic gravitational scattering and gravitational Compton amplitudes agreed with the literature up to contact terms undetermined by factorization.

</details>


### [289] [A Lighter QCD-Axion from Small Instantons](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40629)
*Sourav Bera,Susobhan Chattopadhyay,Rick S. Gupta*

Main category: hep-ph

TL;DR: 该文提出在紫外（UV）区同时修改量子色动力学（QCD）与标准模型味结构的模型中，QCD轴子（axion）质量可远小于通常预期：当小的瞬子（instanton）贡献占上夸克汤川耦合较大比例时轴子更轻，否则更重；并给出两个具体模型实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准预期下QCD轴子质量与上夸克汤川耦合紧密关联，难以显著偏离；作者希望探索在紫外（UV）完成中同时改变QCD与味结构、从而放宽这一质量预期的可能性。

Method: 考虑紫外瞬子对轴子质量与上夸克汤川耦合的非微扰（non-perturbative）贡献，并在二者被一致计入的条件下分析轴子质量；构建两个模型：其一为QCD规范群作为多个SU(3)群乘积的子群出现，其二为实现部分复合性（partial compositeness）的复合希格斯（composite Higgs）模型。

Result: 若小瞬子贡献占上夸克汤川的较大份额，QCD轴子可轻于标准预期，反之则更重；在两个模型中轴子既可位于QCD轴子带（QCD axion band）右侧，也可远在其左侧，后者与拟议的晕镜（haloscope）和日镜（helioscope）实验探测区域相关。

Conclusion: 在UV同时修改QCD与味结构的框架下，QCD轴子质量具有比标准图像更大的可能性范围，尤其是远低于通常预期的区域，可为新一代轴子实验提供动机。

Abstract: We propose models where the QCD axion mass can be much smaller than the standard expectation. We show that this is possible in models where both QCD and the Standard Model flavor structure get modified in the ultraviolet (UV). In these models, both the axion mass and the up-quark Yukawa can receive sizeable non-perturbative contributions from instantons in the UV. If both these effects are carefully taken into account, the QCD axion is not necessarily heavier than usual expectations and can, in fact, be much lighter. We show that if small instanton contributions account for a large fraction of the up-quark Yukawa, the QCD axion can be lighter than standard expectations whereas it is heavier otherwise. We propose two different models where this condition is realised: (1) one where the QCD gauge group emerges as a subgroup from a product of $SU(3)$ groups in the UV; and (2) a composite Higgs model that also implements partial compositeness. In both these models the QCD axion can lie not only in the region to the right of the QCD axion band but also far to its left. This is especially relevant for a range of proposed haloscope and helioscope experiments that will probe a region mostly to the left of the QCD band.

</details>

### [290] [The Pointing Error Due To Laser Propagation in Space Plasma for TianQin Gravitational Wave Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39587)
*S. W. Zhou,W. Su,S. Y. Zhou,C. F. Li,J. X Zhang*

Main category: astro-ph.SR

TL;DR: 本文定量评估空间等离子体（space plasma）对天琴（TianQin）星间激光链路指向精度（pointing accuracy）的影响，结果表明在中等空间天气条件下该效应可忽略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 天琴通过激光干涉测距（laser interferometry）探测引力波（gravitational-wave）信号，而星间激光链路处于非均匀空间等离子体中，激光在其中传播可能引入指向误差噪声（pointing error noise），因此需评估该效应是否威胁任务指标。

Method: 采用磁流体动力学模型（magnetohydrodynamic model）模拟不同轨道取向下天琴轨道周围的等离子体分布，并以四阶龙格-库塔法（fourth-order Runge-Kutta method）在接近23年均值的太阳风动压（solar wind dynamic pressure）下对一个轨道周期进行光线追迹（ray-tracing）计算。

Result: 等离子体引起的激光偏折角（deflection angle）量级约为 $10^{-20}\ \mathrm{rad}$，指向偏心（pointing eccentricity）为皮米（picometer）量级，均显著低于天琴的任务要求。

Conclusion: 在中等空间天气条件下，空间等离子体对天琴指向误差的影响可忽略，天琴任务具备良好可行性前景。

Abstract: TianQin, a space-borne gravitational wave observatory, is designed to detect gravitational-wave signals via laser interferometry. As the inhomogeneous space plasma surrounds the inter-satellite laser links, the propagation of the laser in space plasma can introduce pointing error noise. In this work, we quantitatively assess the effect of plasma on the pointing accuracy of TQ's inter-satellite laser links. We employ a magnetohydrodynamic model to simulate the plasma distribution around the TQ orbit for different orbital orientations. Using the fourth-order Runge-Kutta method to conduct the ray-tracing calculations over a TQ orbital cycle under a solar wind dynamic pressure close to the 23-year average, we find that the plasma-induced laser deflection angle and pointing eccentricity are on the order of $10^{-20} \ \mathrm{rad}$ and picometers, respectively. These values are significantly lower than TQ's requirements. Our results demonstrate that the impact of space plasma on TQ's pointing error is negligible in moderate space weather conditions, indicating a positive outlook for the TQ mission.

</details>

### [291] [A $B_{1g}$ phonon unlocks $d$-wave superconductivity in the repulsive Hubbard model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37746)
*Wen O. Wang,Tianshu Li,Xiaoyue Ma,Rong Zhang,Lei Zhang,Shruti Agarwal,Benjamin Cohen-Stead,Emily Z. Zhang,Brian Moritz,Steven Johnston,Zhi-Xun Shen,Thomas P. Devereaux*

Main category: cond-mat.supr-con

TL;DR: 有限温度量子蒙特卡洛（quantum Monte Carlo）表明，耦合于掺杂 $t$-$t'$ 排斥 Hubbard 模型的 $B_{1g}$ 声子可产生真正的 $d$ 波超导（$d$-wave superconductivity），其转变温度高于任一单独相互作用，并在掺杂上呈现超导穹顶（superconducting dome）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究动机在于识别 Hubbard 模型中稳健 $d$ 波超导的微观成因，并寻找可提升超导转变温度的物理途径。

Method: 采用数值精确的有限温度量子蒙特卡洛（numerically exact finite-temperature quantum Monte Carlo），在掺杂 $t$-$t'$ 排斥 Hubbard 模型中引入与载流子耦合的 $B_{1g}$ 声子。

Result: 超导转变温度超过单独 Hubbard 相互作用或声子相互作用的结果；更强 Hubbard 排斥在与声子协同下可进一步提高配对能标（pairing scale），该增强在受费米子符号问题（fermion sign problem）限制的可及范围内持续存在；以推迟能标（retardation scale）$2\pi T/\Omega$ 归一后，不同声子频率 $\Omega$ 遵循共同趋势；掺杂依赖上出现明确的超导穹顶。

Conclusion: $B_{1g}$ 声子被视为 Hubbard 模型中稳健 $d$ 波超导的可行微观要素，并为获得更高超导转变温度的材料提供了一条具体且具物理依据的路径。

Abstract: Using numerically exact finite-temperature quantum Monte Carlo, we demonstrate that a $B_{1g}$ phonon coupled to the doped $t$-$t'$ repulsive Hubbard model produces genuine $d$-wave superconductivity at a substantial transition temperature, in excess of either interaction alone. The observed trends suggest that stronger Hubbard repulsion may cooperate with the phonon to further raise the pairing scale. The enhancement persists at stronger repulsion within the accessible window, limited by the fermion sign problem, and follows a common trend across phonon frequencies $Ω$ when organized by a retardation scale $2πT/Ω$. We also find a well-defined superconducting dome in doping, echoing a characteristic feature of correlated superconductors. Our results identify the $B_{1g}$ phonon as a plausible microscopic ingredient for robust $d$-wave superconductivity in the Hubbard model and suggest a concrete, physically motivated route toward materials with higher superconducting transition temperatures.

</details>


### [292] [Parity-Resolved Many-Body Kinetics of a Topological Qubit under Nonequilibrium Phonon Pulses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37793)
*Han Huang*

Main category: cond-mat.supr-con

TL;DR: 该工作以两段近邻化纳米线构成的马约拉纳量子比特为对象，结合格点Lutchyn–Oreg模型、微观电子–声子耦合与宇称分辨多体动力学，追踪声子脉冲下的激发、弛豫与逻辑相干性，揭示声子交换可造成永久退相干并给出器件设计指引。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电离辐射产生的声子爆发会在超导量子处理器中引起关联错误，但声子脉冲如何影响马约拉纳量子比特（Majorana qubit）的激发、准粒子中毒与逻辑相干性尚缺乏微观层面的定量刻画。

Method: 采用格点Lutchyn–Oreg模型结合微观电子–声子耦合（electron–phonon coupling）与宇称分辨的多体动力学（parity-resolved many-body dynamics），在两根2 μm近邻化纳米线构成的马约拉纳量子比特中模拟指定非平衡声子脉冲，并与其他模型（Kitaev链、高密度硬壁边界对照）进行比较。

Result: 无准粒子逃逸时，复合（recombination）约在130 ns内恢复初始马约拉纳占据，但激发与恢复过程中交换的声子可保留逻辑态信息，导致永久相干损失；镜像对称纳米线中每根线的分数相干损失为两逻辑态平均激发概率的0.75–1.0倍（即使马约拉纳劈裂为零），破坏镜像对称可在小劈裂下抑制退相位。因子化玻尔兹曼动力学（Boltzmann kinetics）忽略准粒子关联并高估残余宇称翻转；等沉积能量密度下不同声子谱给出不同激发概率与相干损失。

Conclusion: 与匹配能隙和马约拉纳衰减长度的Kitaev链对照表明，低电子密度抑制高能声子激发，而高密度硬壁边界对照在1 meV中心脉冲下激发效率高出5×10⁴倍；磁场与化学势调节通过改变自旋与电子–空穴结构在相同体能隙下产生不同声子敏感性；当隧穿耦合等于母超导能隙时，计入杂化态的半导体权重使近阈激发率降低四倍。该框架将声子谱与泄漏、中毒及相干损失联系起来，可指导马约拉纳器件设计。

Abstract: Phonon bursts from ionizing radiation cause correlated errors in superconducting quantum processors. We study prescribed nonequilibrium phonon pulses in a Majorana qubit formed by two $2\,μ\mathrm{m}$ proximitized nanowires. Combining the lattice Lutchyn--Oreg model, microscopic electron--phonon coupling, and parity-resolved many-body dynamics, we track excitation, relaxation, and logical coherence. Without quasiparticle escape, recombination restores the initial Majorana occupations in about 130 ns, while phonons exchanged during excitation and recovery can retain logical-state information, leaving permanent coherence loss. For mirror-symmetric wires, the fractional coherence loss per wire is 0.75--1.0 times the excitation probability averaged over the two logical states, even at zero Majorana splitting; breaking mirror symmetry can suppress dephasing at small splitting. Factorized Boltzmann kinetics neglects quasiparticle correlations and overestimates residual parity flips. At equal deposited energy density, phonon spectra yield different excitation probabilities and coherence losses. Comparisons with Kitaev chains matched to the wire's gap and Majorana decay length reveal that low electron density suppresses excitation by energetic phonons, whereas hard-wall boundaries in a high-density control increase excitation efficiency by a factor of $5\times10^4$ relative to the wire for pulses centered at 1 meV. Magnetic-field and chemical-potential tuning yield different phonon sensitivities at the same bulk gap through changes in spin and electron--hole structure. Including hybrid states' semiconductor weights reduces near-threshold excitation rates fourfold when the tunnel coupling equals the parent superconducting gap. Our framework connects phonon spectra to leakage, poisoning, and coherence loss to guide Majorana-device design.

</details>


### [293] [Influences of $N_2$ flow rate on the superconducting properties and dimensionality of epitaxial TiN thin films](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38250)
*Shilong Chen,Yuchuan Liu,Yihui Sun,Xiaoni Wang,Wei Peng,Yu Wu,Gang Mu,Zhirong Lin*

Main category: cond-mat.supr-con

TL;DR: 该研究采用直流反应磁控溅射（DC reactive magnetron sputtering）在MgO衬底上外延生长35 nm厚TiN薄膜，系统考察N₂流量对表面形貌与超导性能的影响，发现1.5 sccm时性能最优，并揭示薄膜质量优化可使超导维度行为偏离二维特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TiN薄膜因低损耗、化学与热稳定性好及导电性优异，在超导量子计算（superconducting quantum computing）领域受到广泛关注，因而有必要厘清生长参数与超导性能之间的关系。

Method: 利用直流反应磁控溅射技术在MgO衬底上外延生长35 nm厚TiN薄膜，表征晶体结构、膜厚与表面形貌，并系统研究N₂流量对表面形貌、超导转变温度（Tc）、剩余电阻比（RRR）、正常态电阻率（ρn）、上临界场及超导维度的影响。

Result: N₂流量为1.5 sccm时样品性能最优，具有最高Tc（4.93 K）、最大RRR、最低ρn及最低的面外上临界场斜率；生长腔背景真空显著影响超导性能，真空度下降会导致Tc降低；上临界场呈现明显各向异性，且面内上临界场数据显示样品质量优化使超导行为偏离二维特征。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明超导维度不仅受膜厚制约，还受样品质量等因素影响，为全面理解生长参数与薄膜超导性能的关系提供了有用参考。

Abstract: TiN thin films have received great attention in the field of superconducting quantum computing due to their low loss characteristics derived from stable chemical and thermal properties, as well as excellent electrical conductivity. In this study, TiN thin films with a thickness of 35 nm were epitaxially grown on MgO substrates using the DC reactive magnetron sputtering technique. The crystal structure, film thickness, and surface morphology of the thin films were characterized. The films exhibit a very flat surface with a root mean square roughness of only a few tenths of a nanometer. The influences of nitrogen ($N_2$) flow rate on the surface morphology, superconducting transition temperature ($T_c$), residual resistivity ratio (RRR), normal-state resistivity ($ρ_n$), upper critical field, and superconducting dimensionality were investigated systematically. The experimental results show that the TiN film deposited with a $N_2$ flow rate of 1.5 sccm exhibits optimal performance, including the highest $T_c$ (4.93 K), the largest RRR, the lowest $ρ_n$, and the lowest slope of the out-of-film upper critical field near Tc. Moreover, it is found that the background vacuum inside the growth chamber has a significant impact on the superconducting properties of TiN films, and the degradation of vacuum degree can lead to the decrease of $T_c$. The upper critical field reveals a significant anisotropic feature. Importantly, the in-film upper critical field data demonstrates that the optimization of sample quality leads to deviation from two-dimensional superconducting behavior, which provides a new perspective on the influencing factors of superconducting dimensionality beyond the thickness of films. The present results provide useful references for a comprehensive understanding of the relationship between growth parameters and the superconducting properties of thin films.

</details>


### [294] [Direct real-space imaging of sign-reversal superconducting state by scanning Josephson tunneling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38421)
*Tianheng Wei,Yanzhao Liu,Wei Ren,Zhen Liang,Ziqiang Wang,Jian Wang*

Main category: cond-mat.supr-con

TL;DR: 该研究利用扫描约瑟夫森隧道显微镜（SJTM），在SrTiO3(001)衬底上外延生长的单层Fe(Te,Se)薄膜中观测到半原胞周期的约瑟夫森隧穿调制，结果支持符号反转的无节点d波配对对称性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于约瑟夫森隧穿（Josephson tunneling）的相位敏感实验是判定铜氧化物高温超导体配对对称性的关键手段，但铁基超导体因多带系统中配对对称性的复杂性而使传统相位敏感实验面临困难，需发展原子尺度的新方法。

Method: 采用扫描约瑟夫森隧道显微镜（scanning Josephson tunneling microscopy, SJTM），对在SrTiO3(001)上外延生长的单层高温超导Fe(Te,Se)薄膜进行约瑟夫森隧穿测量，并结合单粒子隧穿谱（single-particle tunneling spectra）表征全超导能隙。

Result: 在s波超导针尖下，约瑟夫森隧穿呈现半原胞周期调制，且沿连接次近邻（next-nearest-neighbor）Fe原子的方向几乎消失；单粒子谱显示完整的超导能隙，实验现象与符号反转的无节点d波（sign-reversal nodeless d-wave）配对对称性一致。

Conclusion: 研究给出了亚原胞尺度的超导相位信息，有助于理解高温超导机理，并有望成为在各类非常规超导体中开展原子分辨约瑟夫森干涉实验的起点。

Abstract: Phase-sensitive experiments based on Josephson tunneling have been considered as a pivotal method to determine the pairing symmetry in high-temperature (high-Tc) cuprate superconductors. However, in iron-based superconductors, traditional phase-sensitive experiments face setbacks because of the complexity of pairing symmetry in multiband systems. Here, using scanning Josephson tunneling microscopy (SJTM), we report the half-unit-cell periodic Josephson tunneling modulations in monolayer high-Tc Fe(Te,Se) film epitaxially grown on SrTiO3(001). The Josephson tunneling almost vanishes along the lines connecting next-nearest-neighbor Fe atoms under an s-wave superconducting tip. Combined with single-particle tunneling spectra showing the full superconducting gap, our experimental results are consistent with the sign-reversal nodeless d-wave pairing symmetry. Our findings provide sub-unit-cell scale superconducting phase information for understanding the mechanism of high-Tc superconductivity. We anticipate our work as a starting point for atomically resolved Josephson interference experiments using SJTM in various unconventional superconductors.

</details>


### [295] [Layer-Parity Control of the Superconducting Diode Effect in Monolayer NbSe$_2$](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38449)
*Yusuf Wicaksono,Toshikaze Kariyado*

Main category: cond-mat.supr-con

TL;DR: 该文用Wannier基、自洽有限动量Bogoliubov-de Gennes方法研究单层NbSe₂中超导二极管效应（superconducting diode effect），指出磁邻近效应的层宇称（layer parity）与取向决定二极管响应，并区分出螺旋型（helical）与三方型（trigonal）两个二极管通道。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超导二极管效应常被与有限动量配对相联系，但模型研究表明整流反映的是自由能关于其极小值的不对称性，而非平衡配对动量本身；同时NbSe₂/CrBr₃中零场整流的微观来源尚待澄清。

Method: 采用基于Wannier的自洽有限Q Bogoliubov-de Gennes方法（finite-Q Bogoliubov-de Gennes approach），配合费米面自适应求积（Fermi-surface-adaptive quadrature）以保证临界电流收敛，计算单层NbSe₂在不同磁邻近构型下的二极管响应。

Result: 面内交换场下，平衡配对动量Q_eq与二极管效率均线性正比于层奇（layer-odd）交换对比度：两个Se亚层上平行邻近为互易（reciprocal），反平行邻近使响应加倍。面外分量几乎不改变Q_eq，但通过破坏配对将效率压低一个数量级以上，并在低温下使其反号。纯面外交换由于C₃对称性禁戒螺旋项而保持Q_eq=0，却产生由层偶（layer-even）交换控制的三方二极管效应，低温下在0.65 meV以上大于面内响应。

Conclusion: 磁层宇称在螺旋型与三方型二极管通道之间起选择作用；三方通道是NbSe₂/CrBr₃中报道的零场整流的本征、对称性允许贡献，并预言双面面外邻近在反平行时相互抵消、在每层交换相同时（计算范围内）约增强四倍。

Abstract: The superconducting diode effect is often associated with finite-momentum pairing, although model studies indicate that rectification reflects the asymmetry of the free energy about its minimum rather than the equilibrium pair momentum itself. Using a Wannier-based, self-consistent finite-$\mathbf Q$ Bogoliubov-de Gennes approach with a Fermi-surface-adaptive quadrature that converges the critical currents, we show that the layer parity and orientation of magnetic proximity select the diode response of monolayer NbSe$_2$. For in-plane exchange, the equilibrium pair momentum $\mathbf Q_{\rm eq}$ and the diode efficiency are both linear in the layer-odd exchange contrast: parallel proximity on the two Se sublayers is reciprocal, and antiparallel proximity doubles the response. An out-of-plane component separates the two observables. It leaves $\mathbf Q_{\rm eq}$ nearly unchanged but, through pair breaking, suppresses the efficiency by more than an order of magnitude and, at low temperature, reverses it. Purely out-of-plane exchange, for which $C_3$ symmetry forbids a helical term, keeps $\mathbf Q_{\rm eq}=0$ yet produces a trigonal diode effect, controlled by the layer-even exchange and larger than the in-plane one above $0.65$~meV at low temperature. Magnetic layer parity thus selects between a helical and a trigonal diode channel. The trigonal channel is an intrinsic, symmetry-allowed contribution to the field-free rectification reported in NbSe$_2$/CrBr$_3$ and predicts that two-sided out-of-plane proximity cancels it when antiparallel and, at the same exchange per layer, enhances it about fourfold when parallel, in the computed range.

</details>


### [296] [Separating the Density Wave Phase from Zero-Resistance Superconductivity in La$_4$Ni$_3$O$_{10}$](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38959)
*P. Puphal,A. Suthar,B. Wehinger,V. Sundaramurthy,T. Priessnitz,M. Knauft,P. Sosa-Lizama,Y. -M. Wu,M. Hepting,J. Nuss,M. Isobe,P. A. van Aken,Y. E. Suyolcu,B. Keimer,H. Takagi,P. Reiss*

Main category: cond-mat.supr-con

TL;DR: 该研究通过双轴压应力（biaxial, compressive pressure）在洁净的三层La₄Ni₃O₁₀单晶中实现零电阻态，将超导所需压力降低约60%，并排除密度波（density wave）量子临界涨落作为配对机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Ruddlesden-Popper镍酸盐（nickelates）加压超导的关键要素难以厘清，原因在于结构变化、氧含量与位置、电子有序相以及高压需求之间存在复杂耦合。

Method: 研究一系列洁净的三层La₄Ni₃O₁₀单晶（single crystals），施加增强的双轴面内压应力，并将低压密度波相与超导态进行分离。

Result: 双轴压应力在比先前报道低60%的压力下诱导零电阻态；同时低密度波相与超导性被完全分离，有效排除密度波序参量的软量子临界涨落（quantum critical fluctuations）作为配对胶。

Conclusion: 双轴面内压力是促进镍酸盐超导的有力手段，可统一不同Ruddlesden-Popper结构中超导所需的压力尺度，并与近期发现的薄膜样品建立联系。

Abstract: Identifying the key ingredients for superconductivity under pressure in the Ruddlesden-Popper nickelates remains a formidable challenge, due to a complex interplay between structural variations, oxygen content and location, electronically ordered phases, and the need for high pressures to reach the superconducting phase. To disentangle these complex inter-dependencies, here we study a series of clean single crystals of trilayer La$_4$Ni$_3$O$_{10}$. We discover that enhanced biaxial, compressive pressures induce a zero-resistance state at a 60\% lower pressure compared to previous reports. At the same time, we completely separate the low-pressure density wave phase from superconductivity, effectively ruling out that soft, quantum critical fluctuations of the density wave order parameter act as the pairing glue in this system. Our results establish biaxial, in-plane pressures as a powerful tool for promoting superconductivity in nickelates, unifying the required pressure scales for superconductivity in different Ruddlesden-Popper structures, and providing a connection to the recently discovered thin film samples.

</details>


### [297] [Coexistence of superconductivity and magnetic order in BaFe$_2$S$_3$: evidence for orbital-selective delocalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38966)
*Y. Oubaid,N. S. Dhami,P. Fertey,C. V. Colin,C. Ritter,A. Forget,D. Bounoua,J. -P. Rueff,M. Verseils,P. Foury-Leylekian,V. Balédent*

Main category: cond-mat.supr-con

TL;DR: 高压下准一维自旋梯化合物（spin-ladder compound）中长程条纹型反铁磁序（stripe-type antiferromagnetic order）在超导（superconductivity）出现时仍保持稳定，而局域铁磁矩（local iron magnetic moment）被抑制近80%，二者解耦指向轨道选择性机制（orbital-selective mechanism）：部分Fe 3d电子保持局域以维持磁性，另一些则退局域化形成巡游超导态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解超导如何从关联电子态（correlated electronic states）中涌现是凝聚态物理（condensed matter physics）的核心难题；该准一维自旋梯化合物缺乏多数铁基超导体典型的二维正方晶格（two-dimensional square lattice），为研究磁性与超导的相互作用提供了独特平台。

Method: 联合使用高压X射线与中子衍射（x-ray and neutron diffraction）、X射线发射光谱（x-ray emission spectroscopy）及电输运（electrical transport）测量，追踪该化合物在压力下进入超导区的结构、磁性与电子演化。

Result: 观测到压力诱导的显著解耦：长程条纹型反铁磁序在直至超导起始的压力范围内保持稳健，而局域铁磁矩被抑制近80%；超导与长程磁序共存。

Conclusion: 该二分性（dichotomy）归因于多轨道电子自由度（multiorbital electronic degrees of freedom）的选择性响应，即轨道选择性机制下局域与巡游电子行为的并存。

Abstract: Understanding how superconductivity emerges from correlated electronic states is a central challenge in condensed matter physics. The quasi-one-dimensional spin-ladder compound \bfs\ serves as a unique platform to study this interplay, as it lacks the two-dimensional square lattice characteristic of most iron-based superconductors. Here, we combine high-pressure x-ray and neutron diffraction, x-ray emission spectroscopy, and electrical transport to map its structural, magnetic, and electronic evolution into the superconducting regime. We \revised{observe} a striking pressure-induced decoupling: while the long-range stripe-type antiferromagnetic order remains remarkably robust under pressure up to the onset of superconductivity, the local iron magnetic moment is suppressed by nearly 80\%. This dichotomy \revised{points to an orbital-selective mechanism}, where specific Fe $3d$ electrons remain localized to sustain magnetism while others delocalize to form the itinerant and superconducting state. \revised{Superconductivity emerges while long-range magnetic order is still present, revealing that the two coexist in \bfs, which we attribute to} the selective response of multiorbital electronic degrees of freedom.

</details>


### [298] [Local Josephson response near nonmagnetic impurities and vortices in a two-orbital $s_{\pm}$ superconductor](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39192)
*Yuanyuan Zhao*

Main category: cond-mat.supr-con

TL;DR: 该文用自洽双轨道 $s_{\pm}$ 超导体模型，研究非磁杂质与涡旋附近的局域约瑟夫森响应（local Josephson response），表明其符号与相位由异常谱（anomalous spectrum）及针尖—样品耦合共同决定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对 $s_{\pm}$ 超导体中局域约瑟夫森探测如何受杂质与涡旋影响的问题，考察异常谱贡献的符号抵消与重构机制，而非仅关注全局配对对称性。

Method: 采用自洽双轨道（two-orbital）$s_{\pm}$ 超导模型，计算非磁杂质与涡旋附近的局域约瑟夫森耦合；设定局域 $s$ 波针尖（local $s$-wave tip）与两轨道等耦合，并扫描杂质势、针尖能隙、隧穿强度与能量位置。

Result: 洁净样品中反号的异常谱贡献近乎抵消；非磁杂质可反转局域耦合而不伴随键对场（bond pair fields）的 $\pi$ 相位移动，负耦合在偏离杂质中心处于更弱杂质势下出现。零场下改变针尖能隙可使耦合变号，增大隧穿强度可反转电流的 $m=1$ 正弦分量（sine component）而不改变样品态。双涡旋态中约瑟夫森响应相对凝聚体（condensate）出现空间变化相位，近核处绕数一致而更大回路包含额外绕数。

Conclusion: 局域约瑟夫森符号与相位是异常谱与针尖—样品耦合的联合体现；杂质诱导变化集中于低准粒子能量，而总耦合来自更宽能量范围，说明局域探测可揭示 $s_{\pm}$ 态的谱学细节。

Abstract: We study the local Josephson response near nonmagnetic impurities and vortices in a self-consistent two-orbital $s_{\pm}$ superconductor. For a local $s$-wave tip that couples equally to the two orbitals, anomalous spectral contributions of opposite sign nearly cancel in the clean sample. Nonmagnetic impurities redistribute these contributions and can reverse the local coupling without a corresponding $π$ phase shift of the bond pair fields. Negative coupling appears at off-center sites at weaker impurity potentials than at the impurity site. The impurity-induced change is concentrated at lower quasiparticle energies, while states over a broader energy range contribute to the total clean and impurity couplings. In zero field, the coupling also changes sign as the tip gap is varied, and increasing the tunneling strength can reverse the $m=1$ sine component of the current without changing the sample state. At the chosen coherence-peak energy, increasing impurity strength mainly changes the relative intensities of existing quasiparticle-interference features. In a self-consistent two-vortex state, the Josephson response develops a spatially varying phase relative to the condensate. The response and condensate share the winding close to each core, while larger loops enclose additional winding of the Josephson response. The local Josephson sign and phase reflect the anomalous spectrum and the tip--sample coupling.

</details>


### [299] [Thermalization-Controlled Superconducting Diode-Like Transport in Disordered Molybdenum and NbN Thin Films](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39523)
*Akhilesh Kumar,Shivani Soni,Gomathi Natarajan,Ramanathaswamy Pandian,Thameemul Ansari M,Pooja Gupta,Sanjay Rai,Edward Prabu Amaladass*

Main category: cond-mat.supr-con

TL;DR: 128 nm 厚 Mo 薄膜在闭环制冷机中出现强烈电流方向不对称与迟滞，但在热化更好的 14 T 低温系统中响应显著对称；该表观"超导二极管效应（superconducting diode effect）"被归因于电热效应（electrothermal effects）而非本征非互易超导性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 输运测量中观测到的方向依赖临界电流常被直接解读为超导二极管效应，但测量环境引起的热效应可能产生类似假象，需要厘清二者界限。

Method: 采用直流磁控溅射（DC magnetron sputtering）在 Si_SiO2 衬底上制备 128 nm 厚 Mo 薄膜（TC = 5.8 K），分别在闭环制冷机与 14 T 低温系统中测量电流-电压特性，并以 NbN 参考薄膜作对照。

Result: 闭环制冷机中观察到明显的电流方向不对称与迟滞，而热化改善的 14 T 系统中响应大幅对称化；NbN 参考膜表现出类似行为。

Conclusion: 由于焦耳热（Joule heating）功率 P = I²R 与电流极性无关，所观测不对称并非源于极性依赖加热，而来自热弛豫、扫场历史与热边界条件的共同作用；识别超导二极管效应时须区分热开关/迟滞与本征非互易超导性。

Abstract: Superconducting diode effects are characterized by direction-dependent critical currents in the superconducting state. Here, we investigate diode-like transport in 128-nm-thick Mo thin film deposited on Si_SiO2 substrate by DC magnetron sputtering. The thin film exhibit a superconducting transition temperature TC of 5.8 K. Pronounced current-direction asymmetry and hysteresis are observed in current-voltage characteristics measured in a closed-cycle refrigerator. In contrast, the same thin film exhibits a substantially more symmetric response in a 14T cryogenic system with improved sample thermalization. We attribute this strong dependence on the measurement environment to electrothermal effects arising from current-induced Joule heating and finite thermal relaxation. As the current approaches the superconducting-to-resistive switching condition, the emergence of a resistive component leads to a rapid increase in Joule heating, raising the sample temperature and modifying the switching condition. Conversely, during the resistive-to-superconducting transition, residual heating and finite thermal relaxation reduce the switching current. Since P is equal to I2R it is independent of current polarity, the observed asymmetry is not associated with polarity-dependent Joule heating but with the interplay of thermal relaxation, sweep history, and thermal boundary conditions. The suppression of the asymmetry under improved thermalization, together with similar behavior observed in NbN reference films, indicates that the apparent diode-like response is strongly influenced by electrothermal effects. These results highlight the need to distinguish thermal switching and hysteresis from intrinsic nonreciprocal superconductivity when identifying superconducting diode effects in transport measurements.

</details>


### [300] [Majorana Zero Modes in Fractional Vortices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39942)
*Lecheng Fang,Haotian Li,Haijiao Ji,Quanxin Hu,Hong Ding,Noah F. Q. Yuan*

Main category: cond-mat.supr-con

TL;DR: 在铁基超导体中，整数 Abrikosov 涡旋可分裂为携带分数磁通量子的分数涡旋（fractional vortices, FVs）；由于拓扑保护，FVs 所承载的 Majorana 零模（Majorana zero modes, MZMs）会沿各 FV 核心空间展开（spatially unfolded），而常规费米束缚态仍局域于单个 FV 核心，从而在局域隧穿与非局域交叉 Andreev 反射中均产生零偏压电导峰，可作为 MZM 的替代判据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MZMs 是拓扑量子计算（topological quantum computation）的重要资源，拓扑超导体中的涡旋是其主要平台；近期实验发现铁基超导体中的整数 Abrikosov 涡旋可分裂为分数涡旋，因此需要厘清分数涡旋中 MZM 的存在形式与可探测特征。

Method: 基于拓扑保护（topological protection）的理论分析，对比分数涡旋核心中 MZM 与费米束缚态（fermionic bound states）的空间分布，并考察局域隧穿（local tunneling）与非局域交叉 Andreev 反射（nonlocal crossed Andreev reflection）两种探测方式下的输运响应。

Result: MZM 在空间上沿 FV 核心展开，而费米束缚态仍局域于各个 FV 核心；该差异使得局域隧穿与非局域交叉 Andreev 反射中均出现零偏压电导峰（zero-bias conductance peaks）。

Conclusion: 分数涡旋中 MZM 的空间展开特征及其在局域与非局域输运中共同呈现的零偏压电导峰，构成一种新的 MZM 判别特征，为基于铁基超导体分数涡旋的拓扑量子计算方案提供了可能路径。

Abstract: Majorana zero modes (MZMs) are promising for topological quantum computation, with vortices in topological superconductors serving as a leading platform. Recent experiments show that integer Abrikosov vortices in iron-based superconductors can split into fractional vortices (FVs) carrying fractional flux quanta. We show that due to topological protection, MZMs hosted by FVs are spatially unfolded over the FV cores, while fermionic bound states remain localized at individual FV cores. This yields zero-bias conductance peaks in both local tunneling and nonlocal crossed Andreev reflection, offering an alternative MZM signature.

</details>


### [301] [Selective effects of selenium substitution on superconductivity and magnetic memory in 4Hb-TaS2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39969)
*Shalev Gur,Sajilesh K. P.,Shubam Purwar,Irena Feldman,Ilay Mangel,Nitzan Ragoler,Amit Kanigel,Beena Kalisky*

Main category: cond-mat.supr-con

TL;DR: 在4Hb-TaS2中通过Se取代调控无序，发现超导性保持稳健而磁记忆被显著抑制，揭示超导与隐藏磁记忆相之间存在清晰分离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 关联量子材料中无序（disorder）效应在多种电子序共存时可能具有高度选择性，4Hb-TaS2同时具备超导、电荷序倾向、强散射与自发涡旋（spontaneous vortices）体现的磁记忆，作者希望厘清无序与该隐藏磁记忆之间的关系。

Method: 采用Se取代（Se substitution）作为对4Hb-TaS2无序景观（disorder landscape）的可控局域微扰，并在不同Se浓度下比较超导性与磁记忆的响应。

Result: 超导性在Se取代下依然异常稳健（robust），而磁记忆在高Se浓度下被强烈抑制；自发涡旋响应对无序高度敏感。

Conclusion: Se取代并非磁记忆的来源，而是选择性削弱其宏观表现；结果表明稳健超导相与隐藏磁记忆相之间存在明显分离，且4Hb-TaS2的自发涡旋响应对无序极为敏感。

Abstract: Disorder plays a central role in correlated quantum materials, but its effects can be highly selective when several electronic orders coexist. The van der Waals heterostructure 4Hb-TaS2 provides such a case, combining superconductivity, charge-order tendencies, strong scattering, and magnetic memory manifested through spontaneous vortices. Here we use Se substitution as a controlled local perturbation of the disorder landscape in 4Hb-TaS2. We find that superconductivity remains remarkably robust while the magnetic memory is strongly suppressed at higher Se concentrations. These results show that Se substitution does not create the hidden magnetic memory, but instead selectively weakens its macroscopic manifestation. More broadly, they reveal a sharp separation between robust superconducting and hidden-memory phases, and a highly disorder-sensitive spontaneous-vortex response in 4Hb-TaS2.

</details>


### [302] [Evidence for an effective gauge field in flakes of superconducting 4Hb-TaS2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39979)
*Shalev Gur,T. R. Devidas,Eylon Persky,Roni Anna Gofman,Irena Feldman,Avior Almoalem,Sudip Kumar Saha,Mark H. Fischer,Avraham Klein,Jonathan Ruhman,Amit Kanigel,Beena Kalisky*

Main category: cond-mat.supr-con

TL;DR: 该研究在无涡旋的迈斯纳区（Meissner regime）观察到 4Hb-TaS₂ 的磁记忆效应，表现为超导屏蔽响应的稳定剩磁改变，从而排除捕获磁通解释，并指向隐藏电子相。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解非常规超导体（unconventional superconductors）的正常态是揭示超导起源的关键，而 4Hb-TaS₂ 的磁记忆效应与涡旋交织，使此前无法区分其来源是捕获磁通（trapped flux）、弱常规磁性还是真正的隐藏电子序（hidden electronic order）。

Method: 采用剥离的 4Hb-TaS₂ 薄片（exfoliated flakes），在无涡旋的迈斯纳区（vortex-free Meissner regime）测量磁记忆，并将其表征为超导屏蔽响应（superconducting screening response）的剩磁改变；同时分析训练样品在零场下所产生磁通的空间分布（spatial profile）。

Result: 磁记忆在无涡旋迈斯纳区中依然存在，且表现为稳定的屏蔽响应剩磁改变，由此排除基于捕获涡旋的解释；此外，零场下训练样品所产生磁通的空间分布与常规弱磁性不符。

Conclusion: 结果表明 4Hb-TaS₂ 中可能存在一种隐藏电子相（hidden electronic phase），该相在超导凝聚体（superconducting condensate）上印记出有效磁通（effective flux），而非源于捕获涡旋或弱常规磁性。

Abstract: Understanding the normal state of unconventional superconductors is central to uncovering the origin of superconductivity itself. Unconventional superconductivity often emerges from correlated electronic states characterized by intertwined symmetry-breaking orders. A striking example is 4Hb-TaS2, whose superconducting state exhibits a remarkable range of phenomena, including an unusual magnetic memory effect. Previous experiments showed that magnetic memory can be encoded above Tc and later revealed through spontaneous vortices below Tc, suggesting time-reversal symmetry breaking. However, since memory and vorticity are intertwined, this prevents establishing whether the effect results from trapped flux, weak conventional magnetism, or a true hidden electronic order. Here, we show that magnetic memory persists in the vortex-free Meissner regime of exfoliated 4Hb-TaS2 flakes, where it appears as a stable remanent modification of the superconducting screening response. Our results rule out explanations based on trapped vortices. Furthermore, the spatial profile of the flux generated by trained samples at zero field is inconsistent with conventional weak magnetism, suggesting a hidden electronic phase that imprints an effective flux on the superconducting condensate.

</details>


### [303] [Chiral superconductivity on a closed Klein bottle: a chirality wall and its Majorana seam spectrum](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40251)
*Junhao,Wang*

Main category: cond-mat.supr-con

TL;DR: 该文针对一个正常态动量空间基本域为克莱因瓶（Klein bottle）的无自旋 π-通量晶格超导体，分析配对与拓扑障碍的相容性，并刻画闭合实空间克莱因瓶上接缝（seam）的低能谱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究动机是理解非平凡动量空间拓扑（克莱因瓶基本域）下配对（pairing）与对称性如何约束 BdG 陈数（Chern number），以及闭合非定向面上手性态接缝谱的性质。

Method: 方法包括：论证滑移提升（glide lift）与隐藏反幺正对称性（antiunitary symmetry）各自迫使 BdG 陈数为零；用显式普法夫量（Pfaffian）判定陈奇偶性并给出三类能隙闭合解析族；在实配对截面（real-pairing section）中构造 ΔC=2 的手性壁，并以平移不变的展开（unfolding）与切割圆柱对照（cut-cylinder control）分析谱。

Result: 结果表明：对角配对（diagonal pairing）实部非零仅是手性相的必要非充分条件；闭合克莱因瓶上产生 ΔC=2 的手性壁，展开后出现两支同向传播的马约拉纳支（Majorana branches），其有限尺寸能级依赖周长与完整群（holonomy），近零能级对允许的局部接缝微扰在一阶上被抬起；切割圆柱对照具有相同的低能通道数。

Conclusion: 结论强调：胶合（gluing）只是重连已有的无能隙内容，且须区分字面胶合与覆叠投影（deck projection），粒子—空穴对称性交换覆叠本征块，故不能视为独立的 BdG 商哈密顿量。该工作为模型特定的配对相容性与闭合曲面接缝谱分析，能量代价在固定配对背景下评估，未主张受保护的零模或自洽壁解。

Abstract: We study a spinless $π$-flux lattice superconductor whose normal-state momentum-space fundamental domain is a Klein bottle. Within this model, a glide lift and a hidden antiunitary symmetry independently force the Bogoliubov--de Gennes (BdG) Chern number to vanish. A diagonal pairing breaks the antiunitary obstruction exactly when its real part is nonzero; this is necessary, not sufficient, for a chiral phase. We derive explicit Pfaffians determining Chern parity and identify three analytic families of gap closings in a real-pairing section. For a chiral state on a closed real-space Klein bottle, the prescribed pairing and gluing produce a $ΔC=2$ chirality wall. A translation-invariant unfolding resolves two co-propagating Majorana branches. Their finite-size levels depend on circumference and holonomy; the near-zero pair is lifted at first order by allowed local seam perturbations. A cut-cylinder control has the same low-energy channel count, so gluing reconnects existing gapless content. We also distinguish literal gluing from deck projection: particle--hole symmetry exchanges the deck eigenblocks, precluding their interpretation as independent BdG quotient Hamiltonians. The contribution is a model-specific account of pairing compatibility and closed-surface seam spectra. The energy cost is evaluated for a fixed pairing background; neither a protected zero mode nor a self-consistent wall solution is claimed.

</details>


### [304] [Chiral $p$-Wave Superconductivity Proximate to a Fractional Chern Insulator and a Topological Charge Density Wave in a Moiré Chern Band](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40469)
*Yunze Ouyang,Fengcheng Wu*

Main category: cond-mat.supr-con

TL;DR: 在扭转MoTe$_2$的自旋极化莫尔陈带（moiré Chern band）中，短程排斥作用可在分数陈绝缘体（fractional Chern insulator, ν=2/3）和拓扑电荷密度波（topological charge density wave, ν=3/4）附近诱导超导，配对表现为手性p波（chiral p-wave）且BdG陈数为-1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究强关联莫尔体系中超导、分数拓扑与电荷序之间的相互作用，特别是排斥相互作用如何在与分数陈绝缘体邻近的填充区域产生超导。

Method: 对填充ν=2/3与ν=3/4附近的扭转MoTe$_2$自旋极化莫尔陈带施加短程排斥，采用精确对角化（exact diagonalization）计算配对、超流刚度（superfluid stiffness）与配对关联；并结合弱排斥下的Kohn-Luttinger理论分析费米面不稳定性。

Result: 精确对角化显示在0.7≲ν≲0.77出现配对，与实验一致，并具有有限超流刚度、手性p波配对关联及向吸引模型的绝热连通性；弱排斥下Kohn-Luttinger理论给出相同配对对称性的费米面不稳定性；超导态BdG陈数C=-1，与ν=1时正常态陈数相反。

Conclusion: 结果表明超导性、分数拓扑与电荷序之间存在相互关联，手性p波超导可在排斥驱动的莫尔陈带中邻近分数陈绝缘体出现。

Abstract: We study a spin-polarized moiré Chern band of twisted MoTe$_2$ with short-range repulsion, finding superconductivity proximate to a fractional Chern insulator at filling $ν=2/3$ and a topological charge density wave at $ν=3/4$. Exact diagonalization reveals pair binding over $0.7\lesssimν\lesssim0.77$, consistent with experiment, along with finite superfluid stiffness, chiral $p$-wave pairing correlations, and adiabatic connectivity to an attractive model. At weak repulsion, Kohn-Luttinger theory supports a Fermi-surface instability with the same pairing symmetry. The superconducting state has a Bogoliubov-de Gennes Chern number $C_{\mathrm{BdG}}=-1$, opposite to the normal-state Chern number at $ν=1$. Our results reveal interplay among superconductivity, fractional topology, and charge order.

</details>


<div id='quant-ph'></div>
