### [305] [Defining 2-group symmetries on lattices and extracting their anomalies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37745)
*Yitao Feng,Yu-An Chen*

Main category: quant-ph

TL;DR: 该文为有限2-群（2-group）对称性给出具体格点定义，通过对称算符间的局域关系识别刻画混合的Postnikov类，并提出在一维中提取反常（anomaly）的方法；同时在d=1,2,3维构造量子比特（qubit）实现，覆盖全部上同调分类所允许的反常类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 普通0-形式对称性（0-form symmetry）G可与1-形式对称性（1-form symmetry）Π₂混合形成2-群𝒢，但缺乏具体的格点（lattice）表述，难以在微观层面研究其反常。论文旨在将高阶群对称性及其反常与具体格点操作联系起来。

Method: 以对称算符之间的局域关系（local relations）给出有限2-群对称性的格点定义，这些关系可识别刻画混合的Postnikov类[ρ]∈H³(BG,Π₂)；并将对称操作限制到区间上，通过比较区间端点附近的复合方式提取一维空间中的反常。

Result: 对G=Π₂=ℤ₂的2-群，在d=1,2,3维构造了显式量子比特对称作用，它们共享同一非平凡Postnikov类，却同时包含无反常与有反常实现。上同调反常由上同调群（cohomology group）H^{d+2}(B𝒢,U(1))分类，d=1,2时为ℤ₂，d=3时为ℤ₂×ℤ₂，且所构造的实现覆盖这些维度中的每一个类。

Conclusion: 结果为高阶群对称性及其反常提供了具体的格点微观框架，可用于系统研究反常对称性（anomalous symmetry）的实现与分类。

Abstract: Ordinary $0$-form symmetries $G$ can mix with $1$-form symmetries $Π_2$ to form a $2$-group $\mathcal{G}$. We give a concrete lattice definition for a class of finite $2$-group symmetries in terms of local relations among symmetry operators. These relations identify the Postnikov class $[ρ]\in H^3(BG,Π_2)$ that characterizes the mixing. We develop a method to extract anomalies of these symmetries in one spatial dimension by restricting symmetry operations to an interval and comparing their composition near its endpoints. We also construct explicit qubit symmetry actions in $d=1,2,3$ spatial dimensions for a $2$-group with $G=Π_2=\mathbb{Z}_2$. These actions share the same nontrivial Postnikov class but include both anomaly-free and anomalous realizations. Their cohomological anomalies are classified by $H^{d+2}(B\mathcal G,U(1))$, which is $\mathbb{Z}_2$ for $d=1,2$ and $\mathbb{Z}_2\times\mathbb{Z}_2$ for $d=3$, and our constructions realize every class in these dimensions. Our results connect higher-group symmetry and its anomalies to concrete lattice operations, providing a microscopic framework for studying anomalous symmetries.

</details>


### [306] [Fundamental limits on photonic state preparation from phase-space majorization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37755)
*Twesh Upadhyaya,Oliver Hahn,Ulysse Chabaud,Nikolaos Koukoulekidis*

Main category: quant-ph

TL;DR: 本文基于相空间函数的“弱完全相对优序化（weak, fully relative majorization）”理论，给出量子态概率性转换（probabilistic conversions）的基本界限，并据此导出多模光子系统中若干态之间精确与近似转换的禁戒结果与权衡关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子信息处理中复杂光量子态常需由简单态经实验可实现的操作用概率性方式转换得到，但此类转换的根本性限制此前缺乏系统刻画。

Method: 建立比较相空间函数无序度的弱完全相对优序化理论，框架可按系统与允许操作集合定制；针对多模光子系统的维格纳函数（Wigner functions），用于分析精确与近似转换。

Result: 得到涉及压缩态（squeezed states）、猫态（cat states）、Gottesman–Kitaev–Preskill 态与福克态（Fock states）的严格禁戒结果与权衡关系，既导出新界限，也重现了已知的紧致界限。

Conclusion: 相空间无序度对光子态制备构成强限制，表明相空间层面的资源性约束是光量子态工程的基本障碍。

Abstract: Preparing complex quantum states of light for quantum information processing tasks often proceeds by converting from simpler states via experimentally accessible operations. We provide fundamental bounds on such probabilistic conversions, both exact and approximate. To do so, we establish a theory of weak, fully relative majorization that compares the disorder of phase-space functions. Our framework is versatile and can be tailored to different systems and sets of allowed operations. Focusing on Wigner functions in multimode photonic systems, we establish rigorous no-go results and tradeoff relations for exact and approximate conversions involving squeezed states, cat states, Gottesman--Kitaev--Preskill states, and Fock states. In doing so, we derive novel bounds and recover known tight ones. Our results demonstrate that phase-space disorder imposes strong limitations on photonic state preparation.

</details>


### [307] [Stellar Representation of Gottesman Kitaev Preskill States on the Double Discrete Cylinder](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37831)
*Aidan Zlotak,Nicolas Fabre,Romain Murenzi*

Main category: quant-ph

TL;DR: 论文在双离散柱面相空间（double discrete cylinder phase space）上建立协变积分量子化（covariant integral quantization），导出Wigner分布（Wigner distribution）与星形表示（stellar representation），并用以刻画GKP态的零点结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GKP（Gottesman–Kitaev–Preskill）态是容错量子计算架构的核心，但其量子资源性质仍缺乏清晰刻画；需要合适的相空间形式体系来研究其平移不变结构与零点分布。

Method: 以环面（torus）为位形空间，在双离散柱面相空间上构造协变积分量子化，得到相应的Wigner分布与星形表示，并分析理想GKP逻辑态、其叠加态、真空态及有限压缩GKP态的星形表示零点特征。

Result: 理想GKP逻辑态作为该相空间的相位本征态，其星形表示在此相空间上无零点；其叠加态则有无穷多个零点。真空态虽为高斯态，却存在零点；有限压缩GKP态的零点随峰宽与包络宽度移动，并在特定调谐宽度下进入该相空间。

Conclusion: 上述零点结构呼应了真空态作为使GKP架构难以经典模拟的量子资源的作用，表明该相空间量子化框架可用于分析GKP态的量子资源。

Abstract: Covariant integral quantization is developed on the double discrete cylinder phase space, with the torus as configuration space, and yields the Wigner distribution and the stellar representation. This phase space is particularly well suited to translationally invariant states, such as the Gottesman Kitaev Preskill (GKP) states. These states are central to fault-tolerant quantum computing architectures, yet their quantum resources are still under investigation. The stellar representations of ideal GKP logical states, which behave as phase eigenstates of the double discrete cylinder, have no zeros on this phase space, whereas those of their superpositions have infinitely many. The vacuum, although Gaussian, has zeros on this phase space, and the zeros of finitely squeezed GKP states move with the widths of the peaks and of the envelope, and reach this phase space for fine-tuned widths. These features echo the role of the vacuum as the resource that makes GKP-based architectures hard to simulate.

</details>


### [308] [The Geometry of Quantum Teleportation in Phase Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37861)
*Jasel Berra-Montiel,Alberto Molgado,Mar Sánchez-Córdova*

Main category: quant-ph

TL;DR: 该文在形变量子化（deformation quantization）框架下重构了标准量子隐形传态协议，利用 Stratonovich–Weyl（SW）对应与 SU(2) 余伴随轨道上的星积（star product），以球面相空间（spherical phase space）$S^2$ 表示量子比特，几何化地刻画了量子信息的再分配与重建过程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旨在为量子隐形传态提供相空间与几何层面的表述，借助 SW 对应的协变性揭示信息再分配与重建的几何机制，并为推广至更一般相空间几何奠定基础。

Method: 每个量子比特由赋予 Kirillov–Kostant–Souriau（KKS）辛结构的球面相空间 $S^2$ 表示；显式构造 Bell 纠缠资源、受控非门（controlled-NOT）与 Hadamard 算符、投影测量及条件性 Pauli 修正的相空间表示，并借助二分与三分相空间关联追踪 Wigner 函数的演化。

Result: 在考虑条件酉变换后，测量结果在接收方余伴随轨道上产生的 Wigner 函数与输入之间相差一个依赖测量结果的旋转（outcome-dependent rotation），该旋转可通过实施相应的 Pauli 修正予以逆转。

Conclusion: SW 对应的协变性提供了该过程的几何解释：量子信息在不转移底层辛几何（symplectic geometry）的前提下被再分配与重建；该表述可推广至配备合适星积的更一般相空间几何中的量子隐形传态研究。

Abstract: We formulate the standard quantum teleportation protocol within the framework of deformation quantization, employing the Stratonovich--Weyl (SW) correspondence and the associated star product on the coadjoint orbits of $SU(2)$. Each qubit is represented by a spherical phase space $S^2$ endowed with the Kirillov--Kostant--Souriau (KKS) symplectic structure. Within this setting, we explicitly construct the phase space representations of the entangled Bell resource, the controlled-NOT and Hadamard operators, the projective measurements, and the conditional Pauli corrections. We demonstrate how the quantum information initially encoded in the Wigner function for the input qubit is redistributed through bipartite and tripartite phase space correlations. Upon consideration of a conditional unitary transformation, the measurement outcome produces a Wigner function on the receiver's coadjoint orbit that is related to the input by an outcome-dependent rotation, which can subsequently be inverted through the implementation of an appropriate Pauli correction. The covariance of the SW correspondence provides a geometric interpretation of this process, in which quantum information is redistributed and reconstructed without transferring the underlying symplectic geometry. Our formulation can also be extended to study quantum teleportation in more general phase space geometries equipped with suitable star products.

</details>


### [309] [Goldbach Representations in Quantum Optics and Metrology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38675)
*Akira Sone,Maxim Olshanii*

Main category: quant-ph

TL;DR: 该文建立了哥德巴赫表示（Goldbach representations）与量子光学中光子数统计（photon-number statistics）的对应关系，并借助Hardy–Littlewood渐近公式，指出固定透射率下的测量后态在相位估计中仅达到标准量子极限（standard quantum limit）标度，而哥德巴赫表示的等权叠加则呈现海森堡标度（Heisenberg scaling）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究动机在于将数论中的哥德巴赫表示与量子光学统计联系起来，并进一步考察其统计性质在量子度量学（quantum metrology）精密测量极限中的意义。

Method: 构造将偶数Fock态注入透射率均匀分布的随机分束器（stochastic beam splitter），并把两输出模投影到素数子空间；随后结合Hardy–Littlewood渐近公式，分析测量后态在相位估计中的最终精度极限标度。

Result: 每个成功探测结果对应一个哥德巴赫表示，平均探测概率恰与哥德巴赫表示数目成正比；固定透射率分束器产生的测量后态在相位估计中呈标准量子极限标度，而哥德巴赫表示的等权叠加呈海森堡标度。

Conclusion: 该工作给出了哥德巴赫表示的量子光学实现，并将其统计特性与量子度量学相关联。

Abstract: We derive a relation between Goldbach representations and photon-number statistics in a quantum-optical setup. Considering an even-number Fock state injected into a stochastic beam splitter with uniformly distributed transmissivity and projections of the two output modes onto prime subspaces, we demonstrate that each successful outcome corresponds to an Goldbach representation and that the averaged detection probability is exactly proportional to the number of Goldbach representations. Then, employing the Hardy--Littlewood asymptotic formula, we demonstrate that the post-measurement state generated by a beam splitter with fixed transmissivity exhibits standard quantum limit scaling of the ultimate precision limit in terms of phase estimation, whereas an equally weighted superposition of Goldbach representations exhibits Heisenberg scaling. These results provide a quantum-optical realization of Goldbach representations and relate their statistics of with quantum metrology.

</details>


### [310] [Beyond energy bounds: comparing Schrödinger eigenstates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39136)
*Xiao-Ke Wang,Han Jia,Shengjun Wu,Zeng-Bing Chen*

Main category: quant-ph

TL;DR: 该文从有序薛定谔算子（ordered Schrödinger operators）导出本征态比较，将能量界推广至重叠积分、空间分布与节点结构，并应用于Yukawa基态的屏蔽临界值给出约1.13611的下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统算子比较定理主要给出能量本征值的序关系，缺乏对本征态之间重叠（overlaps）、空间分布及节点位置的可比性刻画，本文旨在弥补这一空白。

Method: 对三个形式有序（form-ordered）算子，在离散比较基态与基态能隙条件下，用三个比较谱值约束三个基态重叠的平方；结合能隙估计控制低能子空间与激发态重叠；一维与径向情形利用势差相对于能量移位的单次穿越（或非减势差）对似然比与单调可观测量排序，并用双侧Sturm论证（Sturm argument）对内部节点排序。

Result: 结果覆盖非对称势阱与右端Dirichlet壁缩短情形，并给出子模参考势（submodular reference potentials）的逐坐标比较；对Yukawa基态，Hulthén比较在屏蔽参数0<δ<2/√6时给出重叠、径向矩与核处密度的双侧界；优化标度Hulthén优函数得到n²δ_c(n,0)的下界约1.13611，且在该双参数比较族内最优。

Conclusion: 有序算子比较可系统地将能量序关系扩展为本征态层面的定量比较，并在Yukawa–Hulthén体系中给出可验证且在该比较族内最优的临界屏蔽下界。

Abstract: We derive eigenstate comparisons from ordered Schrödinger operators, extending energy bounds to overlaps, spatial distributions and nodes. For three form-ordered operators with discrete comparison ground states, suppose the upper ground-state energy lies in the lower operator's ground-state gap. Three comparison spectral values then bound all three squared ground-state overlaps and guarantee a simple discrete intermediate ground state. Related gap estimates control low-energy subspaces and individual excited-state overlaps under additional gap conditions. In one dimension and radially, a single crossing of the potential difference relative to the energy shift orders ground-state likelihood ratios and monotone observables; a nondecreasing difference suffices. The results cover asymmetric wells and shortened right Dirichlet walls, with coordinatewise comparisons for submodular reference potentials and coordinatewise nondecreasing perturbations. A two-sided Sturm argument orders corresponding internal nodes for nondecreasing potential differences, even between orthogonal one-dimensional excited states. For Yukawa ground states, Hulthén comparisons bound overlaps, radial moments and the density at the nucleus; the latter two-sided bounds hold for screening $0<δ<2/\sqrt6$. Optimizing scaled Hulthén majorants gives a lower bound of approximately $1.13611$ for $n^2δ_c(n,0)$, where $δ_c(n,0)$ is the critical screening for the $n$th $s$-wave bound state. This bound is optimal within that two-parameter comparison family.

</details>


### [311] [Analytic Solutions To Fully Quantized Parametric Amplification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39387)
*Wanli Xing,Timothy C. Ralph*

Main category: quant-ph

TL;DR: 该工作针对全量子三线性哈密顿量（trilinear Hamiltonian）下的三波混频与参量放大，给出可观测动力学的解析表达式，无需参量近似或拟合参数，并在整个泵浦耗尽区实现约10^-12量级的数值精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统处理三波混频（three-wave mixing）与参量放大（parametric amplification）常依赖参量近似（parametric approximation），难以刻画泵浦耗尽（pump depletion）等强耦合区域；本工作旨在给出不依赖该类近似的全量子解析描述。

Method: 以相干泵浦（coherent pump）与真空信号、闲频光为初态，将海森堡绘景展开（Heisenberg expansion）重组为重求和形式的耗尽与回转换剖面（resummed depletion and return profiles），从而得到可直接求值的一、二、三阶关联函数表达式；构造过程不含参量近似与拟合参数。

Result: 代表性数值基准显示：在整个泵浦耗尽过程中误差约为10^-12量级，在数十个耗尽—回转换周期内误差低于10^-3，直至振荡首次完全坍缩；首次耗尽处理还可给出四阶关联（4th-order correlations），并支持明亮的压缩泵浦输入（bright squeezed-pump inputs）。

Conclusion: 该框架提供了无参量近似的全量子三波混频解析工具，揭示对未来光量子技术（optical quantum technologies）具有重要意义的现象，并可推广至更高阶矩（higher moments）。

Abstract: We derive analytic expressions for observable dynamics under the fully quantized trilinear Hamiltonian, governing quantum three-wave mixing and parametric amplification. Starting from a coherent pump and vacuum signal and idler, the calculation reorganizes the Heisenberg expansion into resummed depletion and return profiles, yielding directly evaluable expressions for all 1st-, 2nd- and 3rd-order correlations. The construction uses no parametric approximation or fitted parameters. Representative numerical benchmarks show errors of order $10^{-12}$ throughout the entire pump depletion, and below $10^{-3}$ across dozens of depletion-and-back-conversion cycles, up to the first total collapse of the oscillation. The first-depletion treatment additionally provides 4th-order correlations, accommodates bright squeezed-pump inputs and reveals phenomena important to future optical quantum technologies. The framework can be extended to higher moments.

</details>


### [312] [Pöschl-Teller type of Jaynes-Cummings Hamiltonians: SUSY transformations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39401)
*İsmail Burak Ateş,Şengül Kuru,Javier Negro,Efe Serbest*

Main category: quant-ph

TL;DR: 该工作利用超对称量子力学方法定义并研究广义Jaynes-Cummings（JC）哈密顿量，以三角型与双曲型Pöschl-Teller势作为修正标准JC模型的两个要素，并表明其与标准JC哈密顿量共享一系列特性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目标是借助超对称量子力学（supersymmetric quantum mechanics, SUSY QM）方法推广标准Jaynes-Cummings（JC）模型，考察将其纳入更一般哈密顿量框架的可行性。

Method: 采用三角型与双曲型Pöschl-Teller（PT）势作为修正标准JC模型的两个自然要素，构造广义JC哈密顿量；并结合超对称量子力学方法进行分析。

Result: 广义JC哈密顿量与标准JC哈密顿量具有多项共同特征，包括矩阵交织（matrix intertwining）、激发数对称性（excitation number symmetry）、Rabi频率（Rabi frequency），以及原子反转（atomic inversion）与经典时间、复现时间（revival times）的计算公式。

Conclusion: 据此认为，标准JC哈密顿量可视为更广泛的广义哈密顿量类中的一个特例，该类哈密顿量有望应用于更一般的相互作用问题。

Abstract: The aim of this work is to define and investigate the generalized Jaynes-Cummings (JC) Hamiltonian by means of supersymmetric (SUSY) quantum mechanics methods. We have considered trigonometric and hyperbolic Pöschl-Teller (PT) potentials as two natural ingredients to modify the standard JC model. We show that these generalized JC Hamiltonians have a list of characteristics in common with the JC Hamiltonian, for example: matrix intertwining, excitation number symmetry, Rabi frequency, formulas for atomic inversion and classical and revival times. Therefore, we conclude that JC Hamiltonians can be considered as one example of a wider a class of generalized Hamiltonians which can be useful in broader interaction problems.

</details>


### [313] [Fermionic Unruh effect revisited: Entanglement and correlation dynamics under symmetric transformations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38387)
*Omid Yahyayi Monem,Hosein Mohammadzadeh*

Main category: quant-ph

TL;DR: 该文引入一种对称的类 Unruh 映射（Unruh-like map），使真空态与单粒子态同时与不可及 Rindler 区域交换振幅；对 Bell 态得到翻转概率等于 Unruh 温度下 Fermi-Dirac 占据数的比特翻转信道，并发现惯性观测者与可及模之间的纠缠与量子失协在无限加速度下同时消失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准处理中 Dirac 场的 Unruh 效应给出单边振幅阻尼信道（one-sided amplitude-damping channel），纠缠与量子失协（quantum discord）在无限加速度下仍存留；作者质疑该结论对映射结构的依赖性。

Method: 构造对称的类 Unruh 映射，令真空态与单粒子态均与不可及 Rindler 区域发生振幅交换；对 Bell 态导出比特翻转信道（bit-flip channel），并以负度（negativity）、互信息（mutual information）及全部六种两两量子失协作为度量。

Result: 比特翻转概率等于 Unruh 温度下的 Fermi-Dirac 占据数；在无限加速度极限下，惯性观测者与可及模之间的纠缠和失协一同归零，仅剩一比特经典关联（classical correlation）。

Conclusion: 非惯性参考系中量子关联的命运取决于 Minkowski-Rindler 映射的结构，而非仅由加速度决定；标准单边处理下的“纠缠幸存”结论并非普适。

Abstract: A uniformly accelerated observer perceives the Minkowski vacuum as a thermal bath, so acceleration acts as a noise channel on correlations shared with an inertial partner. For a Dirac field in the standard treatment, the resulting map is a one-sided amplitude-damping channel, and entanglement and quantum discord survive at infinite acceleration. We introduce a symmetric Unruh-like map in which the vacuum and the one-particle state both exchange amplitude with the inaccessible Rindler region; for a Bell state it yields a bit-flip channel whose flip probability is the Fermi-Dirac occupation at the Unruh temperature. Using negativity, mutual information, and all six pairwise quantum discords, we find that the entanglement and discord between the inertial observer and the accessible mode vanish together at infinite acceleration, leaving only one bit of classical correlation. These results show that the fate of quantum correlations in noninertial frames depends on the structure of the Minkowski-Rindler map.

</details>


### [314] [Gravitational Interactions in Nuclear Clocks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38832)
*Konstantin Beyer,Niklas E. Önne,Shimon Kolkowitz,Dolev Bluvstein,Mikhail Lukin,Jun Ye,Igor Pikovski*

Main category: quant-ph

TL;DR: 本文探讨利用大系综核钟（nuclear clock）原子核观测相互引力作用，发现宏观数目核的引力红移（gravitational redshift）及量子引力相互作用可能不可忽略，并提出抑制电磁效应与探测质量叠加的方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原子钟精度随原子数与量子控制不断提升，核钟将钟态编码于核跃迁而非电子跃迁，为精密测量开辟新前沿；本文旨在检验此类核系综能否用于观测核间的相互引力相互作用。

Method: 研究邻近原子引起的引力红移，将核能级叠加态（nuclear energy superpositions）作为引力源，分析核对之间的量子引力相互作用；并提出利用空间对称性与高精度光谱学（high-precision spectroscopy）抑制电磁场效应，以及用外部引力场传感器直接探测能量诱导的质量叠加（mass superpositions）。

Result: 对于宏观数目的核（例如固态钍钟（solid-state thorium clock）），相互引力导致的钟频移（clock frequency shift）可能不可忽略；而观测涉及钟的引力诱导纠缠（gravity-induced entanglement）因自发辐射（spontaneous emission）退相干，需显著更大的实验进展。

Conclusion: 核钟单独或与光机械系统（optomechanical systems）等互补传感器结合，可能成为未来在短距离探测引力、检验超出牛顿极限（Newtonian limit）的引力量子源质量的途径。

Abstract: Atomic clocks achieve extraordinary precision through quantum control over large ensembles of atoms, with precision increasing and atom number advancing steadily. Emerging nuclear clock technology encodes clock states in nuclear rather than electronic transitions, offering a new frontier for precision measurement. Here we study whether a large ensemble of such clock nuclei could be used to observe their mutual gravitational interaction. We investigate the gravitational redshift induced by neighboring atoms, including nuclear energy superpositions as sources of gravity, giving rise to a genuinely quantum gravitational interaction between pairs of nuclei. We find that the resulting clock frequency shift due to mutual gravity may become non-negligible for a macroscopic number of nuclei, for instance in a solid-state thorium clock, and we propose approaches to mitigate electromagnetic field effects by exploiting spatial symmetry and high-precision spectroscopy. We further discuss how energy-induced mass superpositions could be directly probed using external gravitational field sensors. By contrast, observing gravity-induced entanglement involving clocks would require substantially greater experimental advances due to decoherence from spontaneous emission. Taken together, our results suggest that nuclear clocks, either alone or in combination with complementary sensors such as optomechanical systems, may offer a future route toward probing gravity at short distances and testing gravitating quantum source masses beyond the Newtonian limit.

</details>


### [315] [Quantum communication: a discrimination approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40358)
*Hao-Chung Cheng*

Main category: quant-ph

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于态判别（state discrimination）的方法，用于研究噪声量子信道（noisy quantum channel）中的无辅助量子通信（unassisted quantum communication），并构造出基于 Petz 恢复映射（Petz recovery maps）的纠缠生成码（entanglement-generation codes）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究动机源于纠缠恢复（entanglement recovery）与态判别之间的操作对偶性（operational duality），借此将态判别工具引入无辅助量子通信的编码构造。

Method: 从上述操作对偶性出发，构造显式解码器由 Petz 恢复映射给出的纠缠生成码；误差界以 Petz-Rényi 相干信息（Petz-Rényi coherent information）表示。

Result: 所得误差界对任意信道使用次数（every number of channel uses）均成立；对乘积源（product sources），在低于相干信息（coherent information）的速率下实现误差指数衰减（exponential error decay）。

Conclusion: 该工作通过态判别视角给出无辅助量子通信的显式编码与解码方案，并以 Petz-Rényi 相干信息刻画其误差行为，在乘积源情形下得到指数级误差衰减。

Abstract: We develop a state discrimination approach to unassisted quantum communication through a noisy quantum channel. Starting from the operational duality between entanglement recovery and state discrimination, we construct entanglement-generation codes with explicit decoders constructed from Petz recovery maps. The resulting error bounds hold for every number of channel uses and are expressed in terms of Petz-Rényi coherent information. For product sources, they yield exponential error decay at rates below coherent information.

</details>


### [316] [Fate of Quantum Magic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39059)
*Liuke Lyu,Erik S. Sørensen,William Witczak-Krempa*

Main category: quant-ph

TL;DR: 该文提出一个评估一般多体态中“魔力（magic）”程度的通用框架，并用以研究魔力在热化、淬火与空间分离等轨迹下的命运，发现魔力常出现随体系尺寸饱和的“突然死亡（sudden death）”且时序与纠缠不同。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 魔力是区别于纠缠（entanglement）的量子资源，衡量状态偏离泡利算符乘积所稳定（stabilizer）态的程度；稳定态可高度纠缠却仍具高效经典描述，故量子优势（quantum advantage）需要魔力，但多体态中魔力的定量刻画及其在演化下的行为尚缺系统框架。

Method: 构建一个强有力的框架来评估一般多体态的魔力程度，并将其应用于横场伊辛模型（transverse field Ising model）、一般自旋链、蜂窝格点上的 Kitaev 量子自旋液体（quantum spin liquid）以及量子淬火（quantum quench）过程；同时引入合适的非局域魔力（non-local magic）概念处理空间分离情形，并提出利用中子散射（neutron scattering）实验见证 frame-robust magic 的体积律。

Result: 在横场伊辛模型中发现魔力随体系尺寸饱和的热“突然死亡”，且发生在纠缠死亡之后；一般自旋链与蜂窝格点 Kitaev 自旋液体中得到类似结论，且后者阈值对子区域形状有复杂依赖。量子淬火下一般自旋链子区域的魔力通常先于纠缠消亡，与热化轨迹相反；该差异以非魔力态（non-magical states）的几何给出解释。空间分离情形下亦确立魔力的突然死亡，并给出基于中子散射的实验见证方案。

Conclusion: 魔力在多体演化中的衰减并非纠缠的简单伴随量：热化与淬火轨迹下二者的死亡时序相反，且魔力行为可由非魔力态几何与子区域形状刻画；所得框架为量化多体魔力并提供可实验检验的体积律见证奠定基础。

Abstract: Magic, a quantum resource distinct from entanglement, measures departure from states stabilized by products of Pauli operators. Such stabilizer states can be maximally entangled yet admit efficient classical description: quantum advantage requires magic. We develop a powerful framework to evaluate the degree of magic in generic many-body states. We use it to study the fate of magic under thermal and dynamical evolution. In the transverse field Ising model, we find a thermal sudden death of magic that saturates with system size, and occurs after the death of entanglement. We reach similar conclusions in generic spin chains, and in the Kitaev quantum spin liquid on the honeycomb lattice, where the threshold shows an intricate dependence on subregion shape. We then study how magic equilibrates after a quantum quench. In quenches of generic spin chains, the magic of a subregion typically dies before entanglement, contrary to thermal trajectories. An explanation is given in terms of the geometry of non-magical states. As a third type of trajectory, we examine the fate of magic with separation with an appropriate notion of non-local magic and establish a sudden death. Finally, we show how to experimentally witness a volume law of frame-robust magic in quantum materials by using neutron scattering.

</details>


### [317] [Lattice moments and quantum designs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40481)
*Jonathan Conrad,Kristian Holm*

Main category: quant-ph

TL;DR: 该文证明幺模 Gottesman–Kitaev–Preskill（GKP）分布集合不构成刚性的量子 3-设计（rigged quantum 3-design），并定量刻画导致该失败的副本缺陷（replica defect），其基础是独立重推了辛格（symplectic lattice）的第二矩公式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究 GKP 态分布是否具备高阶设计性质（design property），即能否在低阶矩意义上模拟 Haar 随机性；这关系到连续变量量子信息中基于 GKP 态的随机化与伪随机性论证。

Method: 以自包含（self-contained）方式重新推导辛格（symplectic lattice）的第二矩公式（second moment formula），据此分析幺模（unimodular）GKP 分布集合的矩行为。

Result: 该分布集合不构成刚性量子 3-设计（rigged quantum 3-design）；作者给出用于判定该失败的副本缺陷（replica defect）的定量表达。

Conclusion: GKP 分布在设计层面存在结构性不足，其偏离 3-设计的程度可由副本缺陷精确度量；辛格第二矩公式为这类设计性判定提供了可复用的技术工具。

Abstract: We show that the ensemble of unimodular Gottesman$-$Kitaev$-$Preskill distributions fails to form a rigged quantum $3$-design and quantify the replica defect that determines this failure. This is established by rederiving a second moment formula for symplectic lattices in a self-contained manner.

</details>


### [318] [Classical communication over quantum channels: does entanglement help in nature?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40585)
*Peixue Wu*

Main category: quant-ph

TL;DR: 本文提出广义 Schur 加权块熵不等式，证明所有相位协变信道在经典通信中均不存在纠缠优势，并由此重新导出“所有量子比特信道无纠缠优势”的结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 关于“跨独立信道使用纠缠码字能否提升经典通信速率”的旧猜想已被 Hastings 结果及后续工作否证，但所构造的信道维度极大，提示许多物理信道或所有低维信道可能无纠缠优势，因而需在具体信道族上判定。

Method: 受（广义）振幅阻尼信道（amplitude damping channels）近期进展的启发，提出一般的 Schur 加权块熵不等式（Schur-weighted block entropy inequality），并据此分析相位协变信道（phase-covariant channels）。

Result: 证明对所有相位协变信道（包括多能级振幅阻尼信道、广义退相位信道（generalized dephasing channels）与阻尼-退相位信道（damping-dephasing channels））不存在纠缠优势；作为副产品，重新得到所有量子比特信道（qubit channels）无纠缠优势的既有结果。

Conclusion: 纠缠对经典通信速率的优势在相位协变信道这一类物理相关信道中不出现，支持“低维或众多物理信道无纠缠优势”的判断，并将量子比特信道结论统一为特例。

Abstract: Can entangling codewords across independent uses of a quantum channel improve the rate of classical communication? An old conjecture states that there is no such entanglement advantage for all channels. Although Hastings's result and follow-up works disproved this conjecture, it turns out that enormous dimension is required to construct a channel where entanglement enhances classical communication. This indicates that there might be no entanglement advantage for many physical channels, or for all low dimensional channels. Motivated by recent progress on (generalized) amplitude damping channels, we propose a general Schur-weighted block entropy inequality, and show that there is no entanglement advantage for all phase-covariant channels including multi-level amplitude damping channels, generalized dephasing channels, and damping-dephasing channels. As a by-product, we also recover the recently established result that there is no entanglement advantage for all qubit channels.

</details>


### [319] [Exceptional Points as Witnesses of Non-Gaussian Noise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40612)
*Aritra Ghosh,Subhashish Banerjee,M. Bhattacharya*

Main category: quant-ph

TL;DR: 该文指出噪声平均退相位响应中的奇异点（exceptional points, EPs）可暴露非高斯统计的可观测特征，并借此区分具有相同低阶统计的环境，进而提出由EP阶数推断噪声源数目与高阶统计的方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子器件的高效控制需要了解环境噪声，但常用测量的功率谱（power spectrum）不足以刻画真实环境的非高斯涨落（non-Gaussian fluctuations），因此需要能够揭示非高斯统计的观测手段。

Method: 理论分析噪声平均退相位响应中的奇异点（EPs），构造以相同独立噪声源描述退相位环境并保持功率谱不变的理论模型；并设计原子电子学读出（atomtronic readout）方案，将EP特征映射到演化中的系综平均原子干涉图样上。

Result: 噪声平均退相位响应中的EP可给出非高斯统计的可观测标志，能够区分低阶统计相同的环境；在已校准单源模型下，从测量退相位响应中提取的最大EP阶数决定噪声源数目，并可预测组合噪声的高阶统计。

Conclusion: 研究将非厄米动力学（non-Hermitian dynamics）与环境噪声统计联系起来，为计算、计量学（metrology）与精密测量中量子器件的噪声表征提供了一条途径。

Abstract: Efficient control of quantum devices requires the knowledge of their environmental noise, yet the commonly measured power spectrum does not fully characterize non-Gaussian fluctuations of realistic environments. Here we show that exceptional points (EPs) in the noise-averaged dephasing response can expose observable signatures of non-Gaussian statistics, distinguishing environments with identical lower-order statistics. We also introduce a theoretical model that describes dephasing environments in terms of identical independent noise sources while preserving the power spectrum. Given a calibrated single-source model, the largest EP order extracted from the measured dephasing response determines the number of sources and predicts the higher-order statistics of the combined noise. We illustrate an atomtronic readout that maps distinct EP signatures onto an evolving ensemble-averaged atomic interference pattern. Our results connect non-Hermitian dynamics to environmental noise statistics, providing a route to characterize noise in quantum devices used in computing, metrology, and precision measurement.

</details>


### [320] [Trajectory sharpening under quantum reference frame transformations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40452)
*Matteo Fadel,Giulia Gubitosi*

Main category: quant-ph

TL;DR: 该文将“轨迹锐化（trajectory sharpening）”效应解释为向负质量参考系（negative-mass frame）的量子参考系变换（quantum reference frame, QRF），并在自由粒子玩具模型中建立关系型可观测量、动力学QRF映射及锐化的分配规律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: QRF变换用于联系不同量子观察者下的系统描述，但其与实际实验现象的具体关联仍不清楚，本文旨在为连续变量系统提供可操作、与实验相关的QRF解释。

Method: 采用带符号质量的自由粒子最小玩具模型（minimal toy model），将导致轨迹锐化的EPR型可观测量（Einstein-Podolsky-Rosen-type observables）识别为一对可对易的关系型可观测量（relational observables），并考察瞬时与动力学QRF变换下的映射；同时引入QRF不变锐度度量（QRF-invariant sharpness measures）。

Result: 在瞬时QRF变换下，该对关系型可观测量映射为分属不同子系统的局域算符；动力学QRF变换可重现相应的关系型轨迹，且变换后的关系型位置显含时间依赖。锐度度量导出单配关系（monogamy relations），表明轨迹不能同时对两个不同负质量参考系任意锐化。

Conclusion: 轨迹锐度可分布于由两个物理系统编码的集体参考模式（collective reference mode）中，即使单个组分均不能提供任意锐的参考；锐化因此可在参考系间分配而非局域于单一参考系，为连续变量QRF变换提供了与实验相关的操作性解释。

Abstract: Quantum reference frame (QRF) transformations relate the description of a physical system to different quantum observers, but their connection to concrete experimental phenomena remains largely unclear. Here we show that the trajectory-sharpening effect obtained by correlating a probed system with an effective negative-mass reference admits a natural interpretation as a QRF transformation to the frame of a negative-mass system. Using a minimal toy model of free particles with signed masses, we identify the Einstein-Podolsky-Rosen-type observables responsible for this effect with a pair of commuting relational observables that, under the instantaneous QRF transformation, are mapped to operators local to distinct subsystems. We then show that the corresponding relational trajectory is reproduced by the dynamical QRF transformation, where the transformed relational position acquires an explicit time dependence. We introduce QRF-invariant sharpness measures for relational trajectories and derive monogamy relations showing that a trajectory cannot be made simultaneously arbitrarily sharp with respect to two distinct negative-mass frames. We further show that trajectory sharpness can instead reside in a collective reference mode encoded across two physical systems, even when neither constituent alone provides an arbitrarily sharp reference, so that sharpness can be distributed rather than localized in a single constituent frame. These results provide an operational, experimentally relevant interpretation of QRF transformations for continuous-variable systems.

</details>


### [321] [Operator quantum singular value transformation: Spectral mapping, design and topological invariants](https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.09007)
*Chusei Kiumi,Yohei Tanaka,Akito Suzuki*

Main category: quant-ph

TL;DR: 论文将量子奇异值变换（QSVT）从矩阵推广到无限维算子，建立谱映射定理，并揭示核扇区的拓扑指标，从而统一了算法与凝聚态两类量子行走。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: QSVT 作为量子算法的统一框架此前主要作用于有限维矩阵与块编码，与凝聚态物理的谱分析和拓扑保护研究相互割裂，亟需建立理论联系。

Method: 提出算子 QSVT（operator QSVT），将 QSP 多项式作用于算子各块而无需奇异值分解，并证明决定含连续谱在内的完整谱的谱映射定理（spectral mapping theorem）。

Result: 谱映射使 QSP 相位可用于能带的拉伸、折叠与分离及本征值配置；核扇区（kernel sectors）携带在 QSP 相位、局域扰动与保隙形变下不变的拓扑指标，保障拓扑保护态。

Conclusion: 该框架统一了 Szegedy 行走与 split-step 行走，二者核扇区分别编码图的欧拉示性数与体绕数之差；对 split-step 行走，QSP 破坏手征对称性但保留拓扑保护，可将受保护态移入连续带形成连续谱束缚态（BIC）。

Abstract: Quantum singular value transformation (QSVT) provides a unifying framework for quantum algorithms by applying the polynomials of quantum signal processing (QSP) to block-encoded matrices. We connect this framework with spectral analysis, design and topological protection in condensed matter physics. Extending QSVT beyond matrices to possibly infinite-dimensional operators (operator QSVT), we establish the following. First, it transforms every block of the operator by the QSP polynomials; no singular value decomposition is needed. Second, a spectral mapping theorem determines the full spectrum of the QSVT operator, including continuous spectra, from the embedded operator through the QSP polynomial, allowing spectral analysis without translation invariance. Third, the spectral mapping turns QSP into spectral design: the QSP phases can stretch, fold and separate the bands and place the eigenvalues. Finally, the kernel sectors that conventional QSVT usually sets aside carry a topological index, invariant under the choice of QSP phases, local perturbations and gap-preserving deformations, which guarantees topologically protected states. These results unify two quantum walks: Szegedy's walk from quantum algorithms and the split-step walk from condensed matter physics. Their kernel sectors encode the graph's Euler characteristic and the difference of bulk winding numbers, respectively. For the split-step walk, QSP breaks chiral symmetry but not the topological protection, and can move the protected state into a continuous band to form a bound state in the continuum (BIC).

</details>


### [322] [Reducing the cost of ancilla purification for Majorana quantum computation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37991)
*Piotr {Ć}wikli{ń}ski,Łukasz Fojcik,Michał Studzi{ń}ski*

Main category: quant-ph

TL;DR: 该工作改进了Bravyi方案中用于纠缠门的非高斯辅助态（non-Gaussian ancilla）纯化流程，通过增加一层稳定子符号乘积比较，使制备错误从二次下降变为三次下降，并显著降低渐近原始副本开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编织马约拉纳零模（Majorana zero modes）本身不能提供通用量子门集合，需借助辅助态补充操作，但辅助态制备缺乏编织那样的保护，因此需要提升其纯化效率与容错性。

Method: 保留Bravyi方案中基本的“编织—融合”（braid-and-fusion）比较，改变输出组合方式：新增一层对三个稳定子符号（stabilizer signs）乘积的比较；并构造将已处理块与同一噪声源的新鲜副本配对的预备序列。

Result: 首个被接受的错误输出需三个而非两个故障输入块，制备错误随错误率三次（而非二次）下降，渐近原始副本开销降低。在偶宇称扇区独立输入与理想纯化操作下，自由高斯扭变（Gaussian twirling）后充分可蒸馏保真度为59.95%；在相同源保真度下，递归输入制备的期望成本较平衡构造降低七个数量级以上。

Conclusion: 在有效综合噪声模型（effective syndrome-noise model）下，新增层不改变主导操作误差系数，但仍存在非零误差下限（error floor）。

Abstract: Braiding Majorana zero modes does not by itself provide a universal set of quantum gates. Additional operations can be supplied through ancillary states, whose preparation need not have the same protection as braiding. Here, we consider purification of the non-Gaussian ancilla used for an entangling gate in Bravyi's scheme. We keep his elementary braid-and-fusion comparison and change how its outputs are combined. An additional layer compares the product of the three stabilizer signs. The first accepted errors giving an incorrect output then require three faulty input blocks rather than two. As a result, the preparation error decreases cubically instead of quadratically, and the asymptotic raw-copy overhead is reduced. We also construct a preliminary sequence in which a processed block is paired with a fresh copy from the same noisy source. For independent inputs supported in the even-parity sector and ideal purification operations, this sequence establishes a sufficient distillability fidelity of 59.95 percent after free Gaussian twirling. At a common source fidelity, it reduces the expected cost of preparing an input for the recurrence by more than seven orders of magnitude relative to the balanced construction studied here. Finally, we examine imperfect purification operations in an effective syndrome-noise model. The additional layer leaves the leading operation-error coefficient unchanged, although a nonzero error floor remains.

</details>


### [323] [Sample Complexity for Generative Learning of Quantum Measurement Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38028)
*Shuhan Zhang,Yi-Zhuang You*

Main category: quant-ph

TL;DR: 该文提出一个偏差-方差（bias-variance）框架，将模型容量 s 与样本量 N 下的期望总体 KL 误差分解为表示偏差 B(s) 与估计方差 V(s,N)，并据此给出最优误差的四种标度模板，用于指导从有限数据生成学习量子测量分布时的模型容量选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从有限数据生成学习量子测量分布（quantum measurement distribution）时，需在表示精度与估计代价之间权衡模型容量（model capacity），但缺乏刻画该权衡的定量框架。

Method: 构建偏差-方差分解 E(s,N)=B(s)+V(s,N)，在充分采样区取 V≈[NC(s)]^{-1}；对局部自回归模型（local autoregressive models）以上下文半径设定容量，B 为截断上下文损失的求和条件互信息；对平滑直方图学习器推导精确有限样本估计代价；并在横场 Ising 模型（transverse-field Ising）Born 分布上分别独立评估偏差与估计代价。

Result: B 与 C 的指数或代数律给出四种最优误差标度模板，从 N 的逆幂到 ln N 的逆幂；估计代价随上下文半径指数增长，与有能隙区近似指数偏差衰减竞争预测误差随 N 的幂律衰减，而临界点处代数偏差衰减预测误差随 ln N 的逆幂渐近衰减；Bulk-site 结果与有限样本预测一致。

Conclusion: 研究将量子测量分布的结构与有限数据所支持的模型容量相联系，独立评估的偏差与估计代价可同时预测最优上下文半径与最优误差。

Abstract: Generative learning of a quantum measurement distribution from finite data requires choosing a model capacity that balances representation accuracy against estimation cost. We develop a bias-variance framework that decomposes the expected population Kullback-Leibler error at model capacity $s$ and sample size $N$ as $\mathcal E(s,N)=B(s)+V(s,N)$, with representation bias $B$ and a variance term $V$ capturing the mean estimation error. In the well-sampled regime, $V(s,N)\simeq[NC(s)]^{-1}$, and exponential or algebraic laws for $B$ and $C$ yield four scaling templates for the optimal error, from inverse powers of $N$ to inverse powers of $\ln N$. For local autoregressive models, the context radius sets the model capacity, and $B$ is the summed conditional mutual information lost by truncating the context. For a smoothed histogram learner, we derive an exact finite-sample estimation cost that accounts for rarely observed contexts and recovers the parameter-count law in the well-sampled regime. For transverse-field Ising Born distributions, the independently evaluated bias and estimation cost predict both the optimal context radius and the optimal error. In the well-sampled regime, the estimation cost grows exponentially with context radius. Its competition with approximately exponential bias decay in the gapped regimes predicts power-law error decay in $N$, while algebraic bias decay at criticality predicts asymptotic inverse-power decay in $\ln N$. Bulk-site results are consistent with the corresponding finite-sample predictions. These results connect the structure of quantum measurement distributions to the model capacity justified by finite data.

</details>


### [324] [Quantum Gate Engineering in Superconducting NISQ Platforms: Experimental Methods and Emerging Directions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38635)
*Alessandro Sarno,Viviana Stasino,Antonio Pio Italiano,Alessandra Pizza,Carlo Cosenza,Wladislav Guarino,Domenico Montemurro,Francesco Tafuri,Davide Massarotti,Halima Giovanna Ahmad*

Main category: quant-ph

TL;DR: 该综述面向超导NISQ器件中的量子门实现，系统梳理从超导量子比特与处理器架构、单/双比特门脉冲合成到校准与基准测试的完整链路，力图搭建理论电路综合与实验实现之间的桥梁，并指向硬件—软件协同设计框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目标是为研究者、实验人员和量子工程师提供关于超导NISQ器件量子门实现的最新且技术扎实的视角，弥合理论量子电路综合与实际实验实现之间的差距。

Method: 系统考察超导量子比特与处理器架构（从传统transmon到替代性、非传统设计），评估其设计取舍、连通性约束、器件物理与材料影响；并详述基于微波驱动与磁通激活脉冲的单/双比特操作合成、脉冲工程、波形整形与校准流程。

Result: 提出面向特定评估维度选择更高效指标的基准测试方法（benchmarking methodologies），包括真值表（truth tables）与量子过程层析（quantum process tomography），并给出最基本门的实验实现与实用工作流程。

Conclusion: 综述同时讨论门合成背后的理论概念并展示基本门的实验实现，指向硬件—软件协同设计（hardware-software co-design）框架，以在抽象门模型与真实硬件局限之间建立衔接。

Abstract: This review aims to provide researchers, experimentalists, and quantum engineers with an updated and technically grounded perspective on the implementation of quantum gates in superconducting NISQ devices. The goal is to establish a comprehensive bridge between theoretical quantum circuit synthesis and its practical, experimental implementation, focusing on superconducting quantum technologies. We systematically examine the diverse landscape of superconducting qubits and processor architectures, ranging from conventional transmons to alternative and unconventional designs, evaluating their unique design trade-offs, connectivity constraints, device physics, and materials impact. Moving from theory to actual implementation, we detail how single- and two-qubit operations are synthesized via microwave-driven and flux-activated pulses. We here present our pulse engineering, wave shaping, calibration workflows, demonstrating how to bridge the gap between abstract gate models and real-world hardware limitations in the direction of a hardware-software co-design framework. To validate these operations, we choose benchmarking methodologies with the purpose to get the more efficient metric for the specific evaluation aspect, including truth tables and quantum process tomography. Therefore, we both discuss the theoretical concepts behind the gate synthesis and show experimental implementation of most fundamental gates by proposing a practical workflow.

</details>


### [325] [Generating Multipartite Entanglement via Structured-Bath Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38807)
*Baptiste Debecker,Philipp Westhoff,Visal So,Sebastian Paeckel,Guido Pagano,John Martin,Mattia Moroder,François Damanet*

Main category: quant-ph

TL;DR: 本文提出利用阿贝尔强对称性（Abelian strong symmetry）与时间浴关联（temporal bath correlations），通过相互独立的局域浴（local reservoirs）耗散性地制备真正的多体纠缠稳态，并在相互作用伊辛链中验证该机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 耗散性制备多体纠缠通常依赖协同或共享的浴环境；本文旨在说明如何以相互独立的局域浴实现真正的多体纠缠（genuinely multipartite entanglement）稳态。

Method: 在相互作用伊辛链（interacting Ising chains）中分析平坦浴（flat baths）与结构化浴（structured baths）的作用：结构化浴将时间浴关联转换为经典空间关联，强对称性再将其提升至量子层面；在弱耦合理论（weak-coupling theory）框架内构造精确稳态，并结合精确马尔可夫嵌入（exact Markovian embeddings）与张量网络模拟（tensor-network simulations）检验。

Result: 对广泛一类系统-环境耦合，平坦浴会指数抹除伊辛轴关联；结构化浴可克服该障碍。强对称性将稳态构造约化为经典问题（对任意伊辛耦合成立），并揭示经典可区分性（classical distinguishability）与纠缠之间的精确联系；调节浴谱可增大关联长度，从可分初态制备类 GHZ 态（GHZ-like states）。

Conclusion: 该机制适用于超导（superconducting）与离子阱（trapped-ion）平台，并提出基于协同冷却运动模式（sympathetically cooled motional modes）的离子阱具体实现方案。

Abstract: We present how to dissipatively prepare genuinely multipartite-entangled steady states with mutually independent local reservoirs by harnessing an Abelian strong symmetry and temporal bath correlations. In interacting Ising chains, we demonstrate that, for a broad class of system-environment couplings, flat baths exponentially erase Ising-axis correlations. Structured baths overcome this obstruction by converting temporal bath correlations into classical spatial correlations. Strong symmetry then promotes these correlations to the quantum domain, enabling global multipartite entanglement. Within weak-coupling theory, we obtain exact steady states despite the generator's nonquadratic nature: strong symmetry reduces their construction to a classical problem for arbitrary Ising couplings. This reduction reveals an exact connection between classical distinguishability and entanglement. We then show how to engineer the bath spectrum to increase the correlation length and enable the preparation of GHZ-like states from separable initial conditions. We test the mechanism beyond the analytical regime using exact Markovian embeddings and tensor-network simulations. Our approach is particularly suited to superconducting and trapped-ion platforms, and we propose a concrete implementation for the latter using sympathetically cooled motional modes.

</details>


### [326] [Resonance and Transition-Channel Competition in Cavity-Assisted Floquet-State Stabilization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39169)
*Zhuocheng Ma,Hongzheng Zhao,Liang-You Peng*

Main category: quant-ph

TL;DR: 该文指出，在中频驱动下，静态耗散腔（dissipative cavity）仅凭共振条件不足以自主稳定 Floquet 本征态（Floquet eigenstates），稳态由共振选择与腔诱导跃迁强度之间的协同或竞争共同决定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有方案提出利用与耗散腔的静态耦合（static coupling）实现 Floquet 本征态的自主稳定，其机制被视为能量选择性弛豫通道（energy-selective relaxation channel）。该文旨在检验这一共振条件在有限驱动频率下是否充分。

Method: 基于 Floquet 态之间的腔介导跃迁与随后的不可逆光子损失（irreversible photon loss）图像，分析共振选择（resonance selection）与腔诱导跃迁强度（cavity-induced transition strengths）的相互作用，并推广至多能级自旋-S（spin-S）系统。

Result: 中频驱动下，共振条件本身并不充分；二者的相互作用可导致成功稳定、共振下仍出现混合稳态（mixed steady states），以及 Floquet 区杂化（Floquet-zone hybridization）附近的完全失效。

Conclusion: 静态耗散能否可靠稳定驱动量子态，取决于共振选择与跃迁强度的竞争关系；该机制可推广至多能级自旋-S 系统，为判断此类稳定方案的有效性提供一般性框架（general framework）。

Abstract: Static coupling to a dissipative cavity has been proposed as a route to autonomously stabilize Floquet eigenstates. The cavity provides an energy-selective relaxation channel: when its photon energy matches a quasienergy difference modulo drive quanta, it mediates transitions between Floquet states, followed by irreversible photon loss. Here, we show that at intermediate driving frequencies, this resonance condition alone is not sufficient for stabilization. Instead, the steady state is controlled by the interplay between resonance selection and the cavity-induced transition strengths between Floquet states, which can either cooperate or compete. This interplay leads to successful stabilization, mixed steady states despite resonance, and complete breakdown near Floquet-zone hybridization. We further show that the same mechanism extends to multilevel spin-S systems, providing a general framework for understanding when static dissipation can reliably stabilize driven quantum states.

</details>


### [327] [Maximum-Entropy Ensemble of Quantum Subsystems with a Fixed Average State](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39712)
*Charlie Shakeshaft,Christopher David White,Harry J. D. Miller*

Main category: quant-ph

TL;DR: 该文论证固定系综平均下最大熵混合态的本征值密度渐近收敛于相关Wishart系综（correlated Wishart ensemble, CWE），并借助自由乘法卷积（free multiplicative convolution）公式与随机POVM测量将其应用于横场Ising模型（TFIM），给出MP律的高温修正与有限温度Page曲线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Haar随机二分态（Haar-random bipartite states）的约化密度矩阵（reduced density matrices）对应定迹Wishart系综，其本征值密度由Marchenko–Pastur（MP）律给出；论文旨在为固定系综平均约束下的最大熵混合态寻找类似的普适本征值密度形式。

Method: 将最大熵分布的本征值密度归约为相关Wishart系综（CWE）的密度，并采用自由乘法卷积公式求解；随后对横场Ising模型（TFIM）的热平均态计算高温领头阶修正，并分析对混合参考态纯化（purification）施加随机POVM测量后所得混合态系综与CWE的渐近等价性。

Result: 所得密度由自由乘法卷积公式给出，据此导出MP律的高温领头阶修正；论证经随机POVM测量后的混合态系综在渐近意义上等价于CWE，并给出支持该结论的数值证据；对TFIM计算测量后系统与辅助系统（ancilla）之间的纠缠，得到平均纠缠熵的有限温度Page曲线（Page curves）。

Conclusion: 固定系综平均下的最大熵混合态存在与MP律相对应的普适本征值密度，可由CWE刻画；该框架将随机矩阵谱理论与随机测量下的纠缠熵统计联系起来，并在TFIM中给出可计算的有限温度结果。

Abstract: The reduced density matrices of Haar-random bipartite states form a fixed-trace version of the Wishart ensemble of random matrices, with an asymptotic eigenvalue density given by the Marchenko--Pastur (MP) law. We establish a similar universal form for the maximum-entropy distribution of mixed states subject to a fixed ensemble average, arguing that its eigenvalue density converges asymptotically to that of the correlated Wishart ensemble (CWE). The density is thus obtained by a free multiplicative convolution formula, which we apply to the transverse-field Ising model (TFIM) with a thermal average state to derive a high-temperature leading-order correction to the MP law. We then consider measurement by a random POVM on the purification of the mixed reference state. We show that the resulting mixed-state ensemble is asymptotically equivalent to the CWE, and provide confirming numerical evidence. We return to the TFIM example to compute the entanglement of the system with the ancilla after measurement, and give finite-temperature Page curves for the average entanglement entropies.

</details>


### [328] [Dissipative controller as a hidden source of errors in quantum gates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40072)
*Serhat C. Kadıoğlu,Saulo V. Moreira,Mark T. Mitchison,Anthony Kiely*

Main category: quant-ph

TL;DR: 该论文研究经典控制器因耗散产生的噪声与量子控制误差之间的关系，在一个具体最小模型中揭示了快速、高保真控制区间内耗散与控制误差之间的权衡关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子系统通常由经典器件控制，而经典器件必然向环境耗散能量；根据涨落耗散定理（fluctuation-dissipation theorem），这会在控制场中引入噪声。论文旨在厘清这种噪声所导致的控制误差与宏观控制器所产生熵之间的关系。

Method: 在具体的极简模型（minimal model）框架下开展分析，聚焦于实验上最相关的快速控制与高保真度（high fidelity）区间，并通过微扰计算（perturbative calculations）考察简单门实现的门保真度（gate fidelity），以及在 Landau-Zener 模型中利用绝热捷径（shortcuts to adiabaticity）进行态传输的保真度。

Result: 在快速控制与高保真度区间内，发现耗散与控制误差之间存在权衡（tradeoff）；门保真度与态传输保真度的微扰计算实例印证了该结论。

Conclusion: 结果定量表明，抑制量子控制中的误差通常以宏观耗散为代价，而这种耗散正是抑制经典控制器中涨落（fluctuations）所必需的。

Abstract: Quantum systems are typically controlled by classical devices that necessarily dissipate energy to the surrounding environment. By the fluctuation-dissipation theorem, this implies noise in the control field produced. We investigate the relationship between the resulting errors and the entropy produced by the macroscopic controller, working in the context of a concrete minimal model. In the most experimentally relevant regime of fast control and high fidelity, we find a tradeoff between dissipation and control errors. These findings are exemplified by perturbative calculations of the gate fidelity for simple gate implementations and of the fidelity of state transfer via shortcuts to adiabaticity in the Landau-Zener model. Our results quantitatively demonstrate that suppressing errors in quantum control typically comes at the cost of macroscopic dissipation, which is needed to tame fluctuations in the classical controller.

</details>


### [329] [Algebraic strong-to-weak symmetry breaking and partial decodability in the surface code](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40567)
*Stephen W. Yan,Yimu Bao,Sagar Vijay*

Main category: quant-ph

TL;DR: 该文研究相干噪声（coherent noise）诱导的非常规量子信息恢复与混合态序（mixed-state order），借助Wegner对偶（Wegner duality）将三角晶格表面码的单比特Pauli-Z旋转噪声与受强对称退相干的Z2顺磁体相联系，并用复本极限（replica limit）下的SO(n)非线性sigma模型统一描述其临界行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 相干噪声可能带来超越传统纠错与热化图像的新奇量子信息恢复机制与混合态有序相，但其普适描述与可判据特征尚不清楚；同时强到弱自发对称破缺（SWSSB）的代数型实现及其"非经典"性质缺乏系统刻画。

Method: 在Wegner对偶联系的两个体系中研究：受单比特Pauli-Z旋转加伴随测量（syndrome measurements）的三角晶格表面码，以及受强对称退相干（strongly symmetric decoherence）的Z2顺磁体；以复本极限n→1下弱耦合SO(n)非线性sigma模型（nonlinear sigma model）建立统一描述，并解析取复本极限，辅以大规模数值模拟验证。

Result: 随旋转角增大，码从可解码相（decodable phase）转变为部分可解码的临界相（partially decodable critical phase），对偶顺磁体则从强对称相转变为具代数型Z2强到弱自发对称破缺的相。解析给出临界相的普适特征：最优Pauli解码保真度在热力学极限下趋于仅依赖系统纵横比的普适函数，对偶保真度关联子（fidelity correlator）按普适幂律衰减，二者对应sigma模型中twist算符的关联。数值模拟证实上述预测。

Conclusion: 代数型SWSSB相无法由任何作用于Z2顺磁体的Pauli退相干信道（Pauli dephasing channel）实现，属"非经典"性质；通过输出态对初始态中相距很远的Z2磁通（fluxes）插入的敏感性可探测该性质，并揭示不同Z2电荷轨迹（charge trajectories）在长距离上持续存在的相干性。

Abstract: Coherent noise can give rise to unconventional regimes of quantum information recovery and mixed-state order. We study these phenomena in two settings related by Wegner duality: the triangular-lattice surface code subject to single-qubit Pauli-$Z$ rotations followed by syndrome measurements, and a $\mathbb{Z}_2$ paramagnet subject to strongly symmetric decoherence. Increasing the rotation angle drives a transition from a decodable phase to a \emph{partially decodable} critical phase in the code, and from a strongly symmetric phase to a phase with \emph{algebraic} $\mathbb{Z}_2$ strong-to-weak spontaneous symmetry breaking (SWSSB) in the dual paramagnet. We develop a common description of these phenomena in terms of a weakly coupled $\mathrm{SO}(n)$ nonlinear sigma model in the replica limit $n\to1$. Taking this replica limit analytically, we derive universal signatures of the critical phase: an optimal Pauli decoding fidelity that approaches a universal function of the system's aspect ratio in the thermodynamic limit, and a dual fidelity correlator that decays as a universal power law. These observables relate to correlations of twist operators in the sigma model description. Large-scale numerical simulations confirm these analytical predictions. We also argue that the algebraic SWSSB phase cannot be realized by any Pauli dephasing channel acting on the $\mathbb{Z}_{2}$ paramagnet. We probe this "non-classical" character through the output state's sensitivity to well-separated $\mathbb{Z}_{2}$ fluxes inserted in the initial state, which reveals persistent coherence between distinct $\mathbb{Z}_{2}$ charge trajectories at long distances.

</details>


### [330] [Toric codes all the way down: decoupling translation-invariant topological CSS codes in higher dimensions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40592)
*Mingxin He,Yifei Wang,Hao Song,Yingfei Gu*

Main category: quant-ph

TL;DR: 该工作给出高维平移不变素数次 CSS 码可解耦（decoupling）为堆叠高阶环面码（higher-form toric codes）的充要判据：粗粒化后平移在每一超选择层（superselection layer）上平凡作用且层间黏合（gluing）消失；并给出显式构造电路。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 二维以上的拓扑 CSS 码（topological Calderbank-Shor-Steane codes）具有横截非 Clifford 门（transversal non-Clifford gates）与单次译码（single-shot decoding）等容错量子计算优势，但缺乏系统理解。已有解耦方法在二维仅需平移在任意子类型上平凡作用，而高维情形是否存在额外障碍尚不清楚。

Method: 对平移不变的 p 元（p 为素数）CSS 码，要求电路与超晶格（superlattice）平移对易；通过有限深度、保持 CSS 的局域 Clifford 电路（可加辅助比特）将码映射为高阶环面码堆叠。作者分析高维激发按维度分层的超选择层结构，刻画层间黏合障碍，并设计显式由 SUM（qudit CNOT）与 SWAP 门构成的构造算法。

Result: 证明黏合是唯一剩余障碍：码可在超晶格上解耦，当且仅当粗粒化到该超晶格后平移在每层平凡作用且黏合消失。此外，若每层激发类型有限且有 m 个非零层，则在平移逐层平凡作用后，沿各方向再粗粒化 p^{m-1} 倍即可消除黏合。物理上同一判据决定有限环面上码能否编码最大数目的逻辑 qudit。

Conclusion: 该文建立了高维拓扑 CSS 码解耦的系统判据，将二维条件推广到超选择层与黏合的语言，并给出可实现的 Clifford 电路算法，同时把判据与有限环面上的逻辑 qudit 容量相联系。

Abstract: Topological Calderbank-Shor-Steane (CSS) codes in more than two spatial dimensions offer features useful for fault-tolerant quantum computation, such as transversal non-Clifford gates and single-shot decoding, but a systematic understanding of them is still lacking. One approach is to decouple a code: map it to a stack of higher-form toric codes by a finite-depth local CSS-preserving Clifford circuit, possibly after adding ancillas. For translation-invariant $p$-ary CSS codes, where $p$ is prime ($p=2$ for qubits), we require the circuit to commute with the translations of a superlattice. In two dimensions, such a decoupling exists once these translations act trivially on every anyon type. In higher dimensions, excitations are sorted by their dimension into superselection layers, which can remain glued together even when translations act trivially on each layer. We show that this gluing is the only remaining obstruction: a code can be decoupled on a superlattice exactly when, after coarse-graining to it, translations act trivially on every layer and the gluing vanishes. Moreover, for a code with finitely many excitation types in each layer and $m$ nonzero layers, once translations act trivially on every layer, further coarse-graining by a factor of $p^{m-1}$ in every direction removes the aforementioned gluing. Physically, the same criterion determines when the code encodes the maximal number of logical qudits on a finite torus. Finally, we give an explicit algorithm that constructs the decoupling as a circuit of SUM (qudit CNOT) and SWAP gates.

</details>


### [331] [Probing fluctuations in photon emission statistics of spin injected quantum dots with time dependent electronic excitation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40593)
*Chiran Wijesundara,Vincent Iglesias-Cardinale,Yuan Lu,Herbert Fotso,Bo Xu,Tim Thomay*

Main category: quant-ph

TL;DR: 电注入自旋的InGaAs/GaAs量子点系综可发射圆偏振单光子，其螺旋度由注入电子自旋极化决定。利用四探测器扩展Hanbury Brown-Twiss干涉仪测量时间分辨光子数统计，可在单个激发周期内分辨至|2⟩ Fock态；双光子统计的显著涨落在自旋注入层退磁后消失，表明自旋注入同时调控光子高阶时间关联。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旨在实现无需外部泵浦激光、与微电子工艺兼容的电驱动量子光源，并探究自旋极化对发射光子的高阶时间关联（higher-order temporal correlations）的影响，而非仅限于光子螺旋度控制。

Method: 采用具垂直磁各向异性（perpendicular magnetic anisotropy）的铁磁CoFeB自旋注入层与MgO隧穿势垒，在零外加磁场下向量子点有源区注入自旋极化电子；并用四探测器、时间标记读出的扩展Hanbury Brown-Twiss干涉仪测量时间分辨光子数统计。

Result: 在单个激发周期内可分辨至|2⟩ Fock态；单光子（n=|1⟩）发射随电激发脉冲同步变化，而双光子（n=|2⟩）统计在脉冲内多个时间位置出现显著涨落，且该涨落于自旋注入层退磁后消失，证实多光子发射动力学与注入载流子自旋极化直接相关。

Conclusion: 自旋注入不仅控制发射光子的螺旋度，还调控发射的高阶时间关联；该现象可通过在随机波函数演化（stochastic wave function evolution）中引入可变激发机制与一组多发射体坍缩算符（multi-emitter collapse operators）进行唯象描述。该平台为电驱动、自旋控制的单光子与多光子Fock态源提供路径，并可作为自旋条件下多发射体动力学的固态量子光源测试平台。

Abstract: Electrically spin-injected ensembles of InGaAs/GaAs quantum dots emit circularly polarized single photons, with the emission helicity determined by the spin polarization of the injected electrons. A ferromagnetic CoFeB spin-injection layer with perpendicular magnetic anisotropy, combined with an MgO tunnel barrier, enables spin-polarized electron injection into the quantum-dot active region, resulting in circularly polarized photon emission at zero applied magnetic field. These devices realize direct spin-charge-photon conversion in an electrically driven, microelectronics-compatible quantum light source that operates without an external pump laser. Using an extended Hanbury Brown-Twiss interferometer with four detectors and time-tagged readout, we measure time-resolved photon-number statistics that resolve up to $|2\rangle$ Fock states within a single excitation cycle. While single-photon ($n=|1\rangle$) emission tracks the electrical excitation pulse as expected, the two-photon ($n=|2\rangle$) statistics exhibit pronounced fluctuations at multiple temporal positions within the pulse. These fluctuations vanish upon demagnetization of the spin-injection layer, establishing a direct link between the multi-photon emission dynamics and the spin polarization of the injected carriers. The observations indicate that spin injection controls not only the helicity of the emitted photons but also higher-order temporal correlations of the emission. The behavior is phenomenologically captured by inserting both a variable excitation mechanism and a set of multi-emitter collapse operators within a stochastic wave function evolution. The platform thus opens a route to electrically driven, spin-controlled single and multi-photon Fock-state sources and provides a testbed for spin-conditioned multi-emitter dynamics in solid-state quantum light sources.

</details>


### [332] [Locality in Dissipative Ground-State Preparation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40628)
*Qicheng Tang,Ruhanshi Barad,Xueda Wen*

Main category: quant-ph

TL;DR: 本文研究了局部耗散（local dissipation）能否制备局域哈密顿量（local Hamiltonian）基态这一问题，针对自由费米子（free-fermion）体系，利用带线性跳跃算符（linear jump operators）的二次 Lindbladian，给出了指数局域线性跳跃算符存在的完整谱判据（spectral criterion），并据此提出禁止性定理（no-go theorem）：费米面穿越处符号改变会排除指数局域制备基态的可能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 核心动机是回答“局域哈密顿量的基态能否由局域耗散制备”这一开放问题，并将讨论限定在可解析处理的自由费米子情形，以厘清目标哈密顿量的谱结构与耗散制备局域性之间的关系。

Method: 采用二次 Lindbladian（quadratic Lindbladian）配合线性跳跃算符进行耗散基态制备；对平移不变（translation-invariant）目标，通过傅里叶对应（Fourier correspondence）将空间局域性与动量空间解析性（momentum-space analyticity）相联系，导出谱判据；并用两个具有代数衰减基态关联的二次能带接触（quadratic-band-touching）模型说明高维中的额外阻碍。

Result: 得到指数局域线性跳跃算符存在性的完整谱判据，并由此给出禁止性定理：符号改变的费米面穿越（sign-changing Fermi-level crossings）排除指数局域线性跳跃算符。该穿越在一维是唯一阻碍，但在更高维一般还存在额外阻碍；此外，短程基态关联（short-range ground-state correlations）虽非必要，却足以保证局域耗散制备，即使不具平移不变性。

Conclusion: 结果表明，目标哈密顿量的谱结构决定了耗散基态制备的局域性，为局域耗散能否制备局域哈密顿量基态提供了基于自由费米子框架的系统性回答。

Abstract: Can the ground state of a local Hamiltonian be prepared by local dissipation? We address this question for free-fermion Hamiltonians, using a quadratic Lindbladian with linear jump operators for the dissipative ground-state preparation. For translation-invariant targets, Fourier correspondence relates spatial locality to momentum-space analyticity, allowing us to derive a complete spectral criterion for the existence of exponentially local linear jump operators that prepare the ground state. This criterion leads to a no-go theorem that, sign-changing Fermi-level crossings exclude exponentially local linear jump operators for preparing the ground state. While these crossings are the complete obstruction in one dimension, additional obstructions generally arise in higher dimensions. We illustrate these additional obstructions using two quadratic-band-touching models with algebraically decaying ground-state correlations. We further show that short-range ground-state correlations, although not necessary, are sufficient for local dissipative preparation even without translation invariance. Our results establish how the spectral structure of the target Hamiltonian governs the locality of dissipative ground-state preparation.

</details>


### [333] [Entanglement diagnostics of stochastic-resetting steady states: theory and measurement on superconducting qubits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40638)
*Jakob Murauer,Sabine Tornow,Manas Kulkarni,Eli Barkai,Satya N. Majumdar,Monalisa Singh Roy*

Main category: quant-ph

TL;DR: 该工作在横场Ising链中研究随机重置（stochastic resetting）下解析与平均纠缠熵的差异，给出两比特闭式解与最多12比特的精确结果，并在IBM超导处理器上验证：熵与噪声无关地吻合无拟合参数的理论预测，而concurrence受去极化压低；两熵之差（Jensen gap）等于子系统对"距上次重置时间"保留的Holevo信息，且无需后选择即可获得。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随机重置可使量子系统进入无幺正演化无法达到的非平衡定态（nonequilibrium stationary state），其纠缠取决于重置历史是被解析（resolved）还是被平均（averaged over）。论文旨在厘清这一相互作用机制，并寻找在实验上可无后选择获取轨迹平均纠缠的途径。

Method: 在横场Ising链（transverse-field Ising chain）框架下推导两比特的闭式结果（closed-form results），并对最长12比特的链做精确计算；同时在IBM超导处理器上实施测量，将测量熵与无拟合参数的无噪声预测对比，并用单参数去极化模型（depolarizing model）描述concurrence的压低。

Result: 两比特闭式解表明，能量本征态间的相位匹配（phase matching）产生共振，其在定态中的可见度由重置态的对称性决定。硬件测量中，重置平均前后的熵紧密跟随无拟合参数的无噪声预测，而多数测量中concurrence低于预测；两种诊断因读取同一重构态的不同成分而响应不同，去极化模型以单参数刻画concurrence的抑制。纠缠熵的Jensen gap等于子系统关于"距上次重置时间"的Holevo信息；在Bell态重置下，该信息在半链切割处随链长增长，且在较小重置概率下于所研究尺寸内未见饱和。

Conclusion: 由于重置时间被经典地采样并记录，轨迹平均熵及Jensen gap可在无后选择（without postselection）条件下获得，这与监测线路（monitored circuits）中需采样指数稀有测量记录才能得到轨迹解析纠缠形成对比，为实验上研究重置诱导的非平衡纠缠提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Stochastic resetting drives quantum systems into nonequilibrium stationary states unreachable under uninterrupted unitary evolution, and their entanglement depends on whether the reset history is resolved or averaged over. We study this interplay in the transverse-field Ising chain, deriving closed-form results for two qubits and evaluating chains of up to 12 qubits exactly. In the two-qubit system, these closed-form results show that phase matching between energy eigenstates produces resonances, and their visibility in the stationary state is determined by the symmetry of the reset state. Measurements on an IBM superconducting processor show the entropies evaluated before and after the reset average closely following noiseless predictions with no fitted parameter, while concurrence lies below prediction across most of the hardware measurements. The two diagnostics respond differently because they read different components of the same reconstructed state, and a depolarizing model captures the concurrence suppression with one fitted parameter. The difference between the two entropies, i. e., the Jensen gap of entanglement entropy, equals the Holevo information that a subsystem retains about the time since the last reset. With a Bell-state reset, this information grows with chain length across a half-chain cut over the sizes studied, without visible saturation at the smaller reset probabilities. Since reset times are sampled and recorded classically, the trajectory-averaged entropy, and with it the Jensen gap, is obtained without postselection, in contrast to monitored circuits, where trajectory-resolved entanglement requires sampling exponentially rare measurement records.

</details>


<div id='math.CA'></div>

# math.CA [[Back]](#toc)

### [334] [Diffraction of rotated measures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37992)
*Jan Mazáč,Nicolae Strungaru*

Main category: math.CA

TL;DR: 论文证明：将直线上平移有界测度（translation-bounded measure）按面积比例旋转质量分布，得到二维旋转不变测度，其衍射（diffraction）恰为原测度衍射的归一化旋转。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究旋转操作如何将一维平移有界测度的衍射结构传递到二维旋转不变测度，从而建立低维与高维衍射之间的联系。

Method: 对直线上的平移有界测度，按面积比例旋转分配质量，构造二维旋转不变平移有界测度，再计算并比较两者的衍射。

Result: 二维对象的衍射等于原测度衍射的归一化旋转（normalised rotation）；文中亦讨论了若干示例及向 d&gt;2 的推广。

Conclusion: 旋转构造保持了衍射结构，仅引入归一化旋转，该结论可推广至更高维情形。

Abstract: Consider a translation-bounded measure on the line. We can rotate the measure, distributing the mass proportionally to the area, to create a two-dimensional rotationally invariant translation-bounded measure. We show that the diffraction of the two-dimensional object is the normalised rotation of the diffraction of the original measure. We discuss some examples and generalisation beyond $d=2$.

</details>


### [335] [The S-function at arbitrary order: hyperplanes of symmetries and the realisability condition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40033)
*L. G. S. Duarte,L. A. C. P. da Mota*

Main category: math.CA

TL;DR: 该文用射影几何（projective geometry）与弗罗贝尼乌斯可积性（Frobenius integrability）刻画扩展Prelle–Singer方法中S-函数系统的解，判定哪些解来自首次积分（first integral），并说明为何λ-对称与S-函数仅在n=2时一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩展Prelle–Singer方法中的S-函数（亦称null-form向量）被广泛使用，但其解系统的内在结构以及哪些解真正对应首次积分尚缺乏统一解释；同时λ-对称（λ-symmetry）与S-函数的对应关系在不同阶数下的差异需要解释。

Method: 内在描述S所满足系统的解；在首次积分域C上把解等同于n维对称特征空间VV的超平面（由n-1个独立特征经Plücker公式恢复），并在流动盒坐标（flow-box coordinates）下对应局部叶空间上的超平面场；以超平面场的可积性（Frobenius条件）作为来自首次积分的判据，并给出S系统的标量Riccati型约化。

Result: S-解是某首次积分的S-向量当且仅当其超平面场可积；该Frobenius条件可拆为S系统本身加上C(n,3)个附加微分条件，故对n=2真空成立，而对所有n≥3构成真实限制，并给出显式的不可实现解。λ-对称与S-函数仅在n=2时重合，因为线场与超平面场只在曲面上一致。

Conclusion: S系统等价于最后一个分量的单个标量方程，即伴随变分方程的Riccati形式；文中明确了这对有理函数搜索（rational search）意味着什么、不意味着什么，从而界定了该方法的适用范围。

Abstract: For a scalar equation $y^{(n)}=\varphi(x,y,\dots,y^{(n-1)})$ the $S$-function of the extended Prelle--Singer method is a vector $S=(S_0,\dots,S_{n-2})$, the null-form vector of Chandrasekar, Senthilvelan, Lakshmanan and collaborators, and the jet gradient of a first integral solves the adjoint of the variational equation. We describe the solutions of the system satisfied by $S$ intrinsically, and determine which of them come from first integrals. Over the field $C$ of first integrals the solutions are exactly the hyperplanes of the $n$-dimensional space $VV$ of symmetry characteristics, recovered from $n-1$ independent characteristics by a Plücker formula; in flow-box coordinates they are the hyperplane fields on the local space of leaves. A solution is the $S$-vector of a first integral if and only if the corresponding hyperplane field is integrable. This Frobenius condition splits into the $S$-system itself plus $\binom n3$ further differential conditions, so it is vacuous for $n=2$ and a genuine restriction for every $n\ge3$, for which we give an explicit non-realisable solution. The same picture explains why $λ$-symmetries and $S$-functions coincide only when $n=2$: line fields and hyperplane fields agree only on surfaces. For the computation of $S$ we record that the system is equivalent to one scalar equation for the last component, which is the Riccati form of the adjoint variational equation, and we spell out what this does and does not imply for a rational search.

</details>

### [336] [Linking-form splitting and four-dimensional genera of knots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40183)
*Seong-Jin Lee*

Main category: math.GT

TL;DR: 论文指出Gilmer分裂引理（splitting lemma）及其导出的切片亏格与非定向曲面秩判别准则在其原始陈述下为假，并构造反例，同时给出在Witt等价意义下及避开例外素数时仍成立的修正结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Gilmer分裂引理是Gilmer切片亏格定理以及Murakami–Yasuhara、Gilmer–Livingston关于非定向曲面与四维clasp数（clasp number）秩判别准则的基础，其正确性直接影响这些结论的适用范围，因此需要检验该引理及其推论是否严格成立。

Method: 对每个满足 p ≡ 3 (mod 8) 的素数 p，构造两类纽结：一类界定光滑Möbius带（Möbius band），另一类界定clasp数为1的光滑带 puncture 环面；并考察其环绕形式（linking form）不存在秩至多二的相应直和项（summand）。

Result: 上述构造给出反例，表明Gilmer分裂引理及其推论（如非定向切片亏格与四维clasp数的秩准则）按原文陈述不成立；其环绕形式不具备秩≤2的相应summand。

Conclusion: 该引理在Witt等价（Witt equivalence）意义下成立，且对cube-free阶（cube-free orders）成立；关于summand的结论在避开例外素数（exceptional primes）时以及对亏格至少为二的可定向曲面成立。此外确定了拓扑非定向四维亏格（topological nonorientable 4-genus）的最优Witt类界（Witt-class bound）。

Abstract: By Gilmer's splitting lemma, the linking form of a rational homology sphere that bounds a 4-manifold is the orthogonal sum of a metabolic summand and a summand presented by a form of the rank of the intersection form. The lemma underlies Gilmer's slice genus theorem and the rank criteria of Murakami-Yasuhara and Gilmer-Livingston for nonorientable surfaces and the 4-dimensional clasp number. We show that the lemma and these results, as stated, are false. For each prime $p \equiv 3 \pmod 8$ we construct knots bounding smooth Möbius bands, and knots bounding smooth punctured tori with clasp number one, whose linking forms have no such summand of rank at most two. We then determine what remains true: the lemma holds up to Witt equivalence and for cube-free orders, and its conclusions about summands hold away from exceptional primes and for orientable surfaces of genus at least two. Finally, we find the optimal Witt-class bound for the topological nonorientable 4-genus.

</details>

### [337] [Creation of the Universe in Lorentzian Classical Gravity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37748)
*Avipsa Chakrabarti,Avik Chakraborty,Martín Molina,Ayan Mukhopadhyay,Salomón Romero*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 该文提出，通过允许“引力结（gravitational junctions）”使整体时空不必是光滑流形，可在洛伦兹引力（Lorentzian gravity）框架内理解宇宙创生，并构造了连接多个局部de Sitter区域的宇宙创生门（cosmic creation gates）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 奇点定理（singularity theorems）与暴胀时空（inflationary spacetimes）的过去不完备性表明，宇宙开端超出半经典引力（semiclassical gravity）的适用范围，因此需要在该范围之外寻找新的描述方式。

Method: 在D≥3维时空中，于类时完美流体（perfect-fluid）结面（状态方程P=wρ）处连接任意有限数n≥2个局部de Sitter区域，构造旋转不变的创生门，并在线性化层面分析微扰（扰动）谱，同时借助非线性均匀反作用（backreaction）构造精确的变形解。

Result: 当w>−(D−3)/(D−2)时解在时间两个方向均测地完备（geodesically complete），全局时间叶层上空间体积在过去与未来趋于有限正值；变形解保持初始体积而使未来体积无界增长，结面流体始终膨胀，w>0时冷却、允许的w<0时升温。三维中非均匀扇区含一个混合声学模式（hybrid sound mode）与n−1个相对横向模式，四维及以上仅存均匀混合声学模式；有限体积开端需微调（fine-tuned）初值，因果响应一般导致未来体积无界。

Conclusion: 引力方程确定了经过条件筛选的容许历史（conditioned admissible histories），并讨论了更宽泛的创生判据（允许有界的过去体积振荡）及其宇宙学含义。

Abstract: The singularity theorems and the past incompleteness of inflationary spacetimes suggest that the beginning of the Universe lies beyond the domain of semiclassical gravity. We show that the creation of the Universe can nevertheless be understood within Lorentzian gravity by allowing gravitational junctions, so that the full spacetime need not be a smooth manifold. We construct rotationally invariant cosmic creation gates joining any finite number $n\geq2$ of locally de Sitter regions in $D\geq3$ spacetime dimensions at a timelike perfect-fluid junction with $P=wρ$. For $w>-(D-3)/(D-2)$, they are geodesically complete in both temporal directions. The total spatial volume approaches finite, positive limits in the infinite past and future on the global-time foliation adapted to the junction fluid. We also construct exact deformed cosmic creation gates through nonlinear homogeneous backreaction that retain the initial volume while the future volume grows without bound. In these solutions, the junction fluid always expands, cooling for $w>0$ and heating for allowed $w<0$. Keeping the bulk regions locally de Sitter, we determine the linearized perturbations: in three dimensions, the generic inhomogeneous sector contains one hybrid sound mode and $n-1$ relative transverse modes; in four and higher dimensions, only the homogeneous hybrid sound mode survives. A finite-volume beginning requires fine-tuned homogeneous and inhomogeneous initial data, while causal response generically leads to unbounded future spatial volume. We also discuss a broader creation criterion allowing bounded past-volume oscillations. The gravitational equations determine conditioned admissible histories. We discuss implications for cosmology.

</details>


### [338] [Black Hole Entropy from Entangled Quantum Reference Frames](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37750)
*Ludovic Varrin*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 该文在 Donnelly–Freidel 扩展相空间中，将 Schwarzschild 黑洞的边模视为动力学参考系，并在 Carlip–Teitelboim 规范下量子化这些参考系，从而导出与紫外截断无关的 Bekenstein–Hawking 熵及对数修正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目标是理解黑洞熵的起源与普适性，特别是其是否依赖于紫外截断（ultraviolet cutoff）。作者利用扩展相空间（extended phase space）中边模（edge modes）作为动力学参考系（dynamical reference frames）的框架，探讨两个外部区域之间的纠缠结构。

Method: 在分叉点（bifurcation point）粘合两个外部区域后仅剩单一正则对（canonical pair），可用 Kuchař 质量与渐近时间差，或面积与两参考系相对快度（relative rapidity）两种规范描述，后者即 Carlip–Teitelboim 对。作者在此规范下量子化参考系，并构造两外部的引力纠缠积（gravitational entangling product）；将因果性要求施加于参考系，使其限制在半群 SL⁺(2,ℝ)，并用其 Plancherel 测度计算纠缠熵。

Result: 半群 SL⁺(2,ℝ) 的 Plancherel 测度给出的两外部区域间纠缠熵（entanglement entropy）恰为 Bekenstein–Hawking 熵，并附带一项对数修正（logarithmic correction），二者均与紫外截断无关。

Conclusion: 结果表明 Bekenstein–Hawking 熵及其对数修正可由参考系量子化与因果性约束自然导出，而非依赖截断细节，支持边模/扩展相空间视角下黑洞熵的普适解释。相对快度与交叉积（crossed product）构造中的时间平移相对应，提示该框架与代数途径存在联系。

Abstract: In the extended phase space of Donnelly and Freidel, the edge modes of a Schwarzschild black hole are dynamical reference frames whose phase space is the cotangent bundle of $\mathrm{SL}(2,\mathbb{R})$. Gluing the two exterior regions at the bifurcation point leaves a single canonical pair. Within the extended phase space, this pair can be described either by Kuchař's mass and difference of asymptotic times or by the area and the relative rapidity of the two frames, which are two gauge choices of the same system. The latter is the pair of Carlip and Teitelboim, and the relative rapidity is the time shift of the crossed product construction. We quantize the frames in this gauge and construct the gravitational entangling product of the two exteriors. Requiring the frames to be causal restricts them to the semigroup $\mathrm{SL}^+(2,\mathbb{R})$, whose Plancherel measure yields the Bekenstein--Hawking entropy as the entanglement entropy between the two exteriors, together with a logarithmic correction, both independent of the ultraviolet cutoff.

</details>


### [339] [Holomorphic fermions in $\text{AdS}_{2}$](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37762)
*Calvin Y. -R. Chen,Lukas W. Lindwasser*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 本文研究二维反德西特空间（two-dimensional Anti-de Sitter space）中具有离散精细调节非零质量的马约拉纳费米子（Majorana fermions），利用其守恒对称无迹旋量-张量（spinor-tensors）构造全息/反全息半整数自旋流（holomorphic and anti-holomorphic half-integer spin currents），并以任意（反）全息函数完全参数化经典相空间，揭示隐藏共形对称性（hidden conformal symmetry）及手征代数（chiral algebras）结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动机在于探究弯曲背景（二维反德西特空间）下马约拉纳费米子的守恒量结构，并检验其是否具备类似二维共形场论（conformal field theory）的流与代数结构，从而揭示可能的隐藏共形对称性。

Method: 方法基于离散精细调节的非零质量参数下存在的对称无迹守恒旋量-张量；在复坐标下将其对应为成对的全息与反全息半整数自旋流，并作洛朗级数（Laurent series）模式展开，进而用任意（反）全息函数参数化运动方程对应的经典相空间，并将该参数化以共形Killing旋量-张量（conformal Killing spinor-tensor）协变地重写。

Result: 结果表明经典相空间可被（反）全息函数完全参数化，且该参数化可协变地用共形Killing旋量-张量表达，暗示存在隐藏共形对称性；同时这些流所携带的手征代数是平坦空间对应理论中手征代数的真子代数（strict subalgebras）。

Conclusion: 结论是二维反德西特空间中该特殊质量马约拉纳费米子体系具有类似二维共形场论的流与模式展开结构，并呈现隐藏共形对称性迹象，但其手征代数严格小于平坦空间情形，体现了背景曲率对代数结构的约束。

Abstract: On two-dimensional Anti-de Sitter space, Majorana fermions with a discrete set of finely tuned, non-zero mass parameters possess conserved spinor--tensors that are symmetric and traceless. In complex coordinates, these correspond to pairs of holomorphic and anti-holomorphic half-integer spin currents and admit Laurent series mode expansions reminiscent of standard two-dimensional conformal field theories. We exploit this fact in order to fully parameterise the classical phase space associated with the equation of motion in terms of arbitrary (anti-)holomorphic functions. We further show that this parameterisation can be written covariantly in terms of a conformal Killing spinor--tensor, hinting at a hidden conformal symmetry. We also show they possess chiral algebras which are strict subalgebras of the one present in the corresponding theory on flat space.

</details>


### [340] [Quiver Lab -- A Computing Tool for Quiver Gauge Theories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37766)
*Zhenghao Zhong*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: Quiver Lab 是一个基于浏览器的工作空间，用于绘制箭图并探索三维 $\mathcal{N}=4$ 理论的模空间，可计算 Higgs 与 Coulomb 分支的 Hilbert 级数、plethystic 对数、支持的精细化及 Decay and Fission Hasse 图，并介绍了 Light 与 Expert 两种工作流程及主要计算方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 摘要未明确陈述研究动机，仅指出该工具旨在为绘制箭图、探索三维 $\mathcal{N}=4$ 理论的模空间提供基于浏览器的集成工作空间。

Method: 以浏览器端工作空间形式实现，分为 Light 与 Expert 两种使用流程，并配套说明其主要计算方法；具体算法细节摘要未展开。

Result: 工具可计算 Higgs 与 Coulomb 分支的 Hilbert 级数（Hilbert series）、plethystic 对数、所支持的精细化（refinements），以及 Decay and Fission Hasse 图（Hasse diagram）。

Conclusion: 该工作以工具说明（note）形式呈现，重点在于介绍 Quiver Lab 的 Light 与 Expert 工作流程及主要计算方法，摘要未给出定量评估或对比结论。

Abstract: Quiver Lab is a browser-based workspace for drawing quivers and exploring the moduli spaces of three-dimensional $\mathcal{N} = 4$ theories. It computes Higgs and Coulomb branch Hilbert series, plethystic logarithms, supported refinements, and Decay and Fission Hasse diagrams. This note explains the Light and Expert workflows and the main computational methods

</details>


### [341] [Go with the flow(s): radial de Sitter holography and $T^2 (+ Λ_2)$](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37776)
*Matthew J. Blacker*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 该工作构造局域于史瓦西–德西特时空（Schwarzschild-de Sitter spacetime）的 midisuperspace Wheeler-DeWitt 态，并据此在静态区（static patch）建立切片无关（slice-independent）的 worldtube 全息框架，进而与截断全息（cut-off holography）的 $T^2$ 及 $T^2+\Lambda_2$ 框架建立字典对应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 论文关注德西特时空（de Sitter spacetime）可能存在对偶理论的双向问题：从体（bulk）能学到什么，以及候选对偶理论能反推体的何种信息；为此需要在体侧构造可用于截断全息对偶的具体态与框架。

Method: 构造局域于史瓦西–德西特时空的 midisuperspace Wheeler-DeWitt 态，用其建立静态区中切片无关的 worldtube 全息框架，并将该 proposal 与 $T^2$、$T^2+\Lambda_2$ 截断全息框架建立字典对应，给出 dS$_4$ 黑洞的 $T^2+\Lambda_2$ 体实现。

Result: 识别出 worldtube proposal 的平均哈密顿量（average Hamiltonian）对应 $T^2(+\Lambda_2)$ 理论的种子能量（seed energy）；同时发现若要由 worldtube 理论的平均哈密顿量恢复 $T^2(+\Lambda_2)$ 能谱，必须使体框架变为切片依赖（slice-dependent）。

Conclusion: 研究建立了 worldtube 框架与截断全息 $T^2(+\Lambda_2)$ 理论之间的对应字典，并指出切片无关性与能谱复现之间存在权衡（trade-off），论文对该权衡的后果进行了讨论。

Abstract: What can we learn about a putative dual to de Sitter spacetime from the bulk? Conversely, what can a candidate dual theory teach us about the bulk? In this work, we construct midisuperspace Wheeler-DeWitt states that are localised on the Schwarzschild-de Sitter spacetime. Using these states, we construct a slice-independent worldtube holographic framework in the static patch. We then construct a dictionary between this worldtube proposal and both the $T^2$ and $T^2 + Λ_2$ frameworks for cut-off holography. In doing so, we provide a bulk realisation of $T^2+ Λ_2$ for dS$_4$ black holes. We identify the average Hamiltonian of our worldtube proposal as the seed energy of the $T^2 (+ Λ_2)$ theories. To recover the $T^2 (+ Λ_2)$ energy spectrum as the average Hamiltonian of a worldtube theory, one must make the bulk framework slice-dependent, and we discuss the consequences of this trade-off.

</details>


### [342] [Differential Equations for Dressed "in-in" Correlators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37856)
*Ivo Sachs*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 本文将微分方程（differential equations）与分部积分恒等式（Integration-by-Parts identities）的形式体系推广到共形耦合标量场（conformally coupled scalar fields）的宇宙学 in-in 关联函数，该类关联函数可表述为“着衣的”（dressed）平坦空间振幅。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 宇宙学 in-in 关联函数的函数类（class of functions）结构难以直接刻画，需要借用振幅计算中成熟的形式工具来提取相关信息。

Method: 把微分方程方法与分部积分恒等式推广至可写为 dressed flat space amplitudes 的宇宙学 in-in 关联函数，并给出可算法化（algorithmically）的表述；以宇宙学 bubble-triangle 图与交换图（exchange diagram）作为示例说明。

Result: 所构造的微分方程在提取对应振幅积分所得函数类的信息方面颇为有效，且可算法化实现；摘要以 bubble-triangle 与 exchange diagram 的实例进行了展示。

Conclusion: 微分方程与 IBP 恒等式为宇宙学关联函数提供了一种强大且可自动化的分析框架，其适用范围可由平坦空间振幅方法延伸至宇宙学 in-in 情形。

Abstract: We extend the formalism of differential equations and Integration-by-Parts identities, to cosmological in-in correlators of conformally coupled scalar fields, that can be formulated as dressed flat space amplitudes. These differential equations turn out to be quite powerful for extracting information about the class of functions which the corresponding amplitudes integrate to. Furthermore, they can be formulated algorithmically. Here we illustrate this for the cosmological bubble- triangle and exchange diagram.

</details>


### [343] [Near-horizon BF bounds for the $t^+$ KK tower on extremal AdS$_5$ black holes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37908)
*Xiao-Long Liu,Zheng Miao,Yuezhang Tang*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 本文系统研究等转动极端带电AdS₅黑洞上，IIB型t⁺ Kaluza–Klein塔所有视界谐波的带电Breitenlohner–Freedman（BF）束缚。结果表明BF束缚的满足情况由电荷-自旋二次型的符号与BPS曲线位置决定，且高自旋模式可破坏低阶截断下的稳定性结论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 带电黑洞视界附近标量模式的BF束缚是判断超引力解稳定性的关键判据，但对完整Kaluza–Klein塔（尤其高谐波与高自旋模式）的系统性理解仍不充分，本文旨在填补这一空白。
