Method: 在零阶由五维极大规范超引力（maximal gauged supergravity）、更高阶由线性化例外场论（exceptional field theory）方程导出标量方程，对等转动极端带电AdS₅黑洞的全部视界谐波逐阶计算带电BF束缚，并借助电荷与自旋构成的二次型分析其符号变化。

Result: 电荷与转动同向时，该二次型在超对称（BPS）黑洞曲线上变号，此时所有模式均满足束缚；曲线上方（Ω_H>1）每个黑洞都存在破坏模式，但任何有限的阶数或自旋截断都无法在每个黑洞上探测到破坏；曲线下方（Φ_H>1）BF通过集被限制在薄带内，受电荷与自旋离散性支配。大半径固定转动下，自旋正比于半径的四阶模式即使所有U(2)单态满足束缚仍会破坏它。

Conclusion: 结论限于两导数超引力中单一塔的近视界BF束缚，完整的径向稳定性（radial stability）问题仍未解决。

Abstract: We study the charged Breitenlohner--Freedman (BF) bound for all horizon harmonics of the type IIB $t^+$ Kaluza--Klein tower on extremal charged AdS$_5$ black holes with equal rotations. The scalar equation follows from maximal five-dimensional gauged supergravity at level zero and the linearized exceptional-field-theory equations at higher levels. For aligned charge and rotation, a quadratic form in charge and spin changes signature on the curve of supersymmetric (BPS) black holes, where every mode satisfies the bound. Above the curve, where $Ω_H>1$, every black hole has a violating mode, although no finite truncation in level or spin detects violation at every such black hole. Below the curve, where $Φ_H>1$, the BF-passing set is confined to a thin strip and controlled by charge and spin discreteness. At large radius and fixed rotation, a level-four mode with spin proportional to the radius violates the bound even where all U(2) singlets satisfy it. These results concern the near-horizon BF bound of one tower in two-derivative supergravity; full radial stability remains open.

</details>


### [344] [Quotient Quiver Subtraction -- Product Groups](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38052)
*Sam Bennett,Amihay Hanany,Guhesh Kumaran*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 该文借助膜系统（brane systems），提出一套系统化方法，用于对三维 $\mathcal{N}=4$ 规范理论中涌现的库仑分支整体对称性（emergent Coulomb branch global symmetries）$\mathrm{U}(n)\times\mathrm{U}(n')$ 与 $\mathrm{SU}(n)\times\mathrm{SU}(n')$ 进行规范化（gauging）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 商奎弗减法（quotient quiver subtraction）已将库仑分支整体对称性的规范化转化为三维 $\mathcal{N}=4$ 规范理论上的组合操作，但此前尚缺乏通过膜系统系统处理一般酉群与特殊酉群因子的方法。

Method: 采用膜系统构造，将规范化设计为两步过程，其中涉及把酉规范因子辛化（symplectisation）为辛群（symplectic groups），从而系统给出对 $\mathrm{U}(n)\times\mathrm{U}(n')$ 及 $\mathrm{SU}(n)\times\mathrm{SU}(n')$ 涌现对称性的规范化流程。

Result: 通过大量显式算例（explicit examples）验证了该规范化程序的有效性，并建立了其与 Class $\mathcal{S}$ 理论及实现极大内爆空间（maximal implosion spaces）的三维理论之间的联系。

Conclusion: 膜系统方法为三维 $\mathcal{N}=4$ 理论中涌现库仑分支整体对称性的规范化提供了系统化途径，且与已有组合技术及其他理论构造相容，可推广至相关理论类别的分析。

Abstract: Quotient quiver subtraction translates the gauging of Coulomb branch global symmetries into a combinatoric operation on 3d $\mathcal{N}=4$ gauge theories. This work uses brane systems to introduce a systematic method to gauge $\textrm{U}(n)\times\textrm{U}(n')$ and $\textrm{SU}(n)\times\textrm{SU}(n')$ emergent Coulomb branch global symmetries. Similar to other recently-introduced techniques, the gauging operation is a two-step process; in this case, it involves the symplectisation of unitary gauge factors into symplectic groups. A host of explicit examples are used to verify the procedure, and connections are made to Class $\mathcal{S}$ theories and three-dimensional theories realising maximal implosion spaces.

</details>


### [345] [Covering Surfaces, Conical-Defect Continuation, and Multi-Entropy at Arbitrary Genus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38208)
*Chen-Te Ma*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 该文推导了任意亏格（genus）下置换扭转关联函数（permutation-twist correlators）的归一化几何因子（normalized geometric factors），并给出一系列推广与全息极限（holographic limit）条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为完整确定置换扭转关联函数的归一化几何因子，并厘清几何多熵（geometric multi-entropy）的复本指标（replica-index）修正及全息极限成立所需条件。

Method: 对三个一致分歧分支值（uniformly ramified branch values）采用超几何单值化（hypergeometric uniformization）分析连续锥形缺陷指数（continued conical-defect exponent）；并将归一化推广至更多分支值。

Result: 连续锥形缺陷指数的实部等于覆盖空间反常因子（covering-space anomaly factor），虚部为欧拉示性数形式的 Weyl 相位（Euler-characteristic Weyl phase）；进一步得到几何多熵的高阶复本指标修正及全息极限的附加条件。

Conclusion: 一个可约共形/拓扑（reducible conformal/topological）示例表明，仅凭大中心荷（large central charge）无法确定完整的纠缠结果。

Abstract: We derive normalized geometric factors for permutation-twist correlators at arbitrary genus. For three uniformly ramified branch values, hypergeometric uniformization shows that the real part of the continued conical-defect exponent equals the covering-space anomaly factor. Its imaginary part is an Euler-characteristic Weyl phase. We extend the normalization to additional branch values, derive higher replica-index corrections to the geometric multi-entropy, and state the extra condition required for a holographic limit. A reducible conformal/topological example demonstrates why large central charge alone does not fix the complete entanglement result.

</details>


### [346] [Entropically favored scalar hair on AdS black branes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38226)
*Alex Buchel*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 本文构造了带无源标量毛发（source-free scalar hair）的中性 AdS$_5$ 黑膜（black brane）解，该相在熵上优于对称相。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究对象为中性 AdS$_5$ 黑膜中标量毛发相的稳定性问题：需要使毛发相在熵上（entropically）优于对称相，同时保持紫外算符维度固定。

Method: 引入标量—Gauss–Bonnet 二次耦合（quadratic scalar–Gauss–Bonnet coupling）使热态失稳，同时将紫外算符维度固定为 Δ=3；完整回反（fully backreacted）解只需二次标量势（quadratic scalar potential）。模型通过神经网络搜索（neural-network search）获得。

Result: 得到中性 AdS$_5$ 黑膜的无源标量毛发完全回反解，该毛发相在熵上优于对称相，且紫外算符维度保持 Δ=3 不变。

Conclusion: 一个仅含二次标量势与二次标量—Gauss–Bonnet 耦合的简单模型即可实现熵上占优的无源标量毛发，并说明该模型由神经网络搜索引导得出。

Abstract: We construct neutral AdS$_5$ black branes with source-free scalar hair that is entropically favored over the symmetric phase. A quadratic scalar--Gauss--Bonnet coupling destabilizes the thermal state while leaving the ultraviolet operator dimension fixed at $Δ=3$. The fully backreacted solutions require only a quadratic scalar potential. We describe how a neural-network search led to this simple model.

</details>


### [347] [Circuit complexity of coupled four-mode squeezed states in two-field inflation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38254)
*Tao Li,Hai-Bing Fu,Lei-Hua Liu*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 该文研究双场暴胀（two-field inflation）中曲率与熵扰动耦合时的电路复杂度（circuit complexity），基于二次作用量推导完整哈密顿量并求四模压缩态（four-mode squeezed state）的配对振幅，进而用Nielsen电路复杂度衡量量子态演化，发现场间耦合对复杂度影响较小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者希望将电路复杂度这一量子信息工具推广到更一般的双场暴胀模型中，考察曲率扰动（curvature perturbation）与熵扰动（entropy perturbation）耦合情形下的量子态复杂性，为后续更一般模型的研究提供参考基准。

Method: 从二次作用量（quadratic action）出发推导包含全部对角与非对角二次项的哈密顿量，得到四模压缩态配对振幅的三个耦合方程，由振幅计算两个主要压缩强度（squeezing strengths），并据此确定Nielsen电路复杂度；对等权重高斯电路（equal-weight Gaussian circuit）采用形式 C_{2,k}=√(2(r_{1k}^2+r_{2k}^2))。

Result: 复杂度仅依赖压缩强度而不显含压缩角（squeezing angles）。数值结果显示，无论耦合或非耦合模型，复杂度在视界穿越（horizon crossing）后均增长；场间耦合会改变配对振幅与四模压缩态，但在所考虑参数范围内对电路复杂度影响很小，表明不同四模配对振幅矩阵可给出相近的等权重电路复杂度值。

Conclusion: 该计算为研究更一般双场暴胀模型中的高斯电路复杂度（Gaussian circuit complexity）提供了参考；同时也提示所选等权重复杂度对态结构的区分能力有限。

Abstract: We study the circuit complexity of coupled curvature and entropy perturbations in two-field inflation. We start from the quadratic action and derive the full Hamiltonian. The Hamiltonian includes all diagonal and off-diagonal quadratic terms. We then obtain three coupled equations for the pair amplitudes of the four-mode squeezed state. From these amplitudes, we calculate the two principal squeezing strengths. We use them to determine the Nielsen circuit complexity. For an equal-weight Gaussian circuit, the complexity takes the form $\mathcal{C}_{2,k}=\sqrt{2(r_{1k}^{2}+r_{2k}^{2})}$. It depends on the squeezing strengths but not explicitly on the squeezing angles. Our numerical results show that the complexity grows after horizon crossing in both coupled and uncoupled models. Interfield coupling changes the pair amplitudes and the four-mode squeezed state. However, its effect on the circuit complexity is small for the parameters considered. This result shows that different four-mode pair-amplitude matrices can yield similar values of the chosen equal-weight circuit complexity. The present calculation provides a reference for studying Gaussian circuit complexity in more general two-field inflationary models.

</details>


### [348] [Tachyon and massless sectors of the bosonic string effective action](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38364)
*Mohammad R. Garousi*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 本文研究玻色弦有效作用量中 T-对偶（T-duality）不变的耦合集合与 S-矩阵（S-matrix）元的一致性，指出需借助适当的场重定义（field redefinition），使耦合分离为无质量扇区（massless sector）与快子扇区（tachyon sector）。作者确定了无质量扇区的六阶导数耦合（全部耦合常数被固定），并在快子扇区找到两个耦合常数任意的 T-对偶耦合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究中，某些玻色弦有效作用量方案的非导数快子（tachyon）仅出现在快子势（tachyon potential）中，其余耦合均含协变导数（covariant derivative）；由此得到的极小基耦合常数在圆周紧化（circle reduction）下受 T-对偶约束。作者旨在检验这些 T-对偶耦合集合与 S-矩阵元的一致性条件。

Method: 通过引入适当的场重定义（field redefinition），要求 T-对偶耦合集合与 S-矩阵元相符，使得每个集合在 Buscher 规则（Buscher rules）加上高阶导数修正下保持不变，但适用范围排除度规（metric）、伸缩子（dilaton）与快子。据此将耦合划分为无质量扇区与快子扇区并逐项确定 α' 各阶耦合。

Result: 确定了无质量扇区中全部耦合常数固定的六阶导数耦合（six-derivative couplings），并在快子扇区找到两个耦合常数任意的 T-对偶耦合。验证了领头阶作用量（leading-order action）与无质量扇区耦合在六动量阶（six-momentum order）精确重现两个快子与两个无质量顶点的球面级 S-矩阵元展开；快子扇区中四快子耦合（four-tachyon coupling）的常数由四快子 S-矩阵元在六动量阶的展开确定。

Conclusion: T-对偶耦合集合与 S-矩阵元的一致性要求特定场重定义，且该重定义将耦合自然分离为无质量扇区与快子扇区；无质量扇区的六阶导数耦合被完全固定，而快子扇区部分耦合常数仍需由相应 S-矩阵元确定，从而为弦有效作用量的耦合结构提供了约束方案。

Abstract: Recently, it has been observed that in certain schemes of the bosonic string effective action, the non-derivative tachyon appears only in the tachyon potential, while all other couplings involve covariant derivatives of the tachyon and massless fields. Within these schemes, a minimal basis can be found whose coupling constants are constrained by T-duality upon circle reduction. Using this constraint, one obtains sets of couplings at each order of \(α'\) that are invariant under Buscher rules supplemented by higher-derivative corrections for all base-space fields except the tachyon. In this paper, we observe that consistency of these T-dual sets with S-matrix elements requires an appropriate field redefinition, such that each set becomes invariant under Buscher rules supplemented by higher-derivative corrections for all base-space fields except the metric, dilaton, and tachyon. This separates the couplings into a massless sector and a tachyon sector. We determine the six-derivative couplings in the massless sector, with all coupling constants fixed, and find two T-dual couplings in the tachyon sector with arbitrary coupling constants. We show that the leading-order action and the massless-sector couplings exactly reproduce the expansion of the sphere-level S-matrix element of two tachyons and two massless vertex operators at six-momentum order, and that the coupling constant of the four-tachyon coupling in the tachyon sector is fixed by the expansion of the four-tachyon S-matrix element at six-momentum order.

</details>


### [349] [The Topological String on the Quintic to Genus 83 and the Rank-Two D4-D2-D0 Indices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38473)
*Michael Hecht*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 该文通过积分全纯反常方程（holomorphic anomaly equations）计算了亏格 2–83、次数至 44 的五次 Gopakumar–Vafa 不变量（quintic GV invariants），并借助墙穿越（wall-crossing）方程消除全纯模糊性，在低亏格输入下完整给出至次数 32 的 GV 数据及相应 PT 与 DT 表。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 五次三维 Calabi–Yau 流形（quintic CY）的高亏格 GV 不变量计算长期受限于全纯模糊性与高亏格边界数据缺失，本文旨在将递归推进到远高于既有工作的亏格范围。

Method: 在所需 Gieseker 不变量（Gieseker invariants）满足秩一模性（rank-one modularity）、并采用秩二电荷共轭（rank-two charge conjugation）的前提下，用边界与盈余墙穿越方程（boundary and surplus wall-crossing equations）组成的耦合系统固定全纯模糊性，并辅以计算机辅助的墙穿越扩展补足方程与边界数据；全程不假设任何秩二指标（rank-two index）。

Result: 递归可闭合至亏格 83；结合已知低亏格输入，GV 数据在次数 32 内完整，并导出 PT 与 DT 表；部分高亏格墙穿越不变量达到亏格 216，其中 33 个条目需要额外假设。

Conclusion: 事后选取的外推给出亏格 84、85 的条件性候选值；若进一步假设秩二 mock 模性（rank-two mock modularity），还可给出其余极系数（polar coefficients）的候选。

Abstract: We compute quintic Gopakumar-Vafa invariants for genera 2-83 and degrees up to 44 by integrating the holomorphic anomaly equations. Under rank-one modularity for the required Gieseker invariants and rank-two charge conjugation, a coupled system of boundary and surplus wall-crossing equations fixes the holomorphic ambiguities and 22 of the 36 polar rank-two D4-D2-D0 coefficients, without assuming any rank-two index. A computer-assisted extension of wall crossing supplies additional equations and the boundary datum needed to close the recursion through genus 83. With known low-genus input, the GV data are complete through degree 32 and yield PT and DT tables. Selected higher-genus wall-crossing invariants reach genus 216; 33 entries require additional hypotheses. Retrospectively selected extrapolations give conditional candidates at genera 84 and 85 and, with rank-two mock modularity, for the remaining polar coefficients.

</details>


### [350] [Resurgence and Modularity in the First Painlevé Equation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38584)
*Kohei Iwaki,Noam Tamarin*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 该文将第一 Painlevé 方程（first Painlevé equation）中绕无穷远一整圈对应的三个非线性 Stokes 映射（Stokes maps）与两参数 tau 函数的模变换（modular transformations）相联系，得到关系 $\boldsymbol S_\pi\circ\boldsymbol S_0\circ\boldsymbol S_{-\pi}=\mathsf S\circ\mathsf T$，并给出其显式实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究动机在于建立 Painlevé 方程 Stokes 乘子（Stokes multipliers）演化与 tau 函数模变换之间的精确对应，从而刻画绕无穷远一整圈后 Painlevé 超越函数与其 tau 函数的单值性（single-valuedness）。

Method: 在拓扑递归（topological recursion）与精确 WKB 构造的解析假设下，比较相关等单值系统（isomonodromy system）的 Stokes 乘子，并追踪自变量旋转时椭圆谱曲线（elliptic spectral curve）的同调基（homology basis）变化；将 $8\pi/5$ 旋转诱导的已知参数变换识别为模 $T$ 作用，并导出实现 $S$ 作用（$2\pi/5$ 旋转）的新参数关系。

Result: 对所考虑的区域，确认 $8\pi/5$ 旋转对应的参数变换即模 $T$-作用，并给出对应 $2\pi/5$ 旋转的 $S$-作用的显式参数关系；同时确定了 tau 函数关系中含归一化常数的乘性因子。

Conclusion: 结果给出了绕无穷远一整圈后 Painlevé 超越函数及其 tau 函数单值性的显式实现，其中 tau 函数前因子（prefactors）借助 Rogers 二重对数（Rogers dilogarithm）的 Abel 五项恒等式（Abel's five-term identity）相互抵消。

Abstract: For the first Painlevé equation, we relate three nonlinear Stokes maps associated with a full turn around infinity to modular transformations of the two-parameter tau function through the identity $\boldsymbol S_π\circ\boldsymbol S_0\circ \boldsymbol S_{-π}=\mathsf S\circ\mathsf T$. Here the subscripts label Borel directions, while $\mathsf S$ and $\mathsf T$ denote the modular generators. Working under the analytic assumptions of the topological recursion and exact WKB constructions, we compare Stokes multipliers of the associated isomonodromy system while tracking the homology basis of its elliptic spectral curve under rotations of the independent variable. For the sectors considered, we identify the known parameter transformation induced by an $8π/5$ rotation with the modular $T$-action and derive a new explicit parameter relation realizing the $S$-action for a $2π/5$ rotation. We also determine the multiplicative factors in the corresponding tau-function relations, including their normalization constants. Together, these results give an explicit realization of single-valuedness after one full turn around infinity for both the Painlevé transcendent and its tau function, with the tau-function prefactors cancelling by Abel's five-term identity for the Rogers dilogarithm.

</details>


### [351] [The Non-Relativistic Limit of Five-Dimensional Boson Stars and Scale Invariance Violation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38606)
*Eduard Kim,Oleg Kondrashov,Emin Nugaev,Yakov Shnir*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 本文研究 (4+1) 维广义相对论（general relativity, GR）中球对称玻色子星（boson stars）的非相对论极限（non-relativistic limit），揭示其牛顿理论具有精确标度不变性（scale invariance），并由此产生具有固定全局 U(1) 荷与零束缚能的临界玻色子星构型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者意在厘清非相对论极限下临界玻色子星特殊性质（固定 U(1) 荷、零束缚能）的物理起源，并理解相对论与引力修正如何破坏标度对称性、进而影响构型的能量-荷关系与运动学稳定性（kinematic stability）。

Method: 通过将完整的 (4+1) 维 Einstein-Klein-Gordon 系统与 Wick-Cutkosky 模型进行对比，分析相对论与引力修正对标度对称性的破坏，并量化其对能量-荷关系（energy-charge relation）和运动学稳定性的影响。

Result: 结果表明，标度不变性的弱破坏会解除非相对论解的简并（degeneracy），并决定玻色子星在偏离临界极限时的行为；相对论与引力修正对标度对称性的破坏程度可通过能量-荷关系与稳定性变化加以量化。

Conclusion: 临界玻色子星的固定 U(1) 荷与零束缚能性质源于恢复的标度对称性；弱破坏标度不变性是理解玻色子星偏离临界极限行为的关键机制。

Abstract: We investigate the non-relativistic limit of spherically symmetric boson stars in (4+1)-dimensional general relativity (GR). In this limit, the resulting Newtonian theory exhibits an exact scale invariance, leading to a critical boson star configuration with a fixed global U(1) charge and vanishing binding energy. We identify the origin of these properties in the restored scale symmetry and analyze how relativistic and gravitational corrections break this symmetry. By comparing the full (4+1)-dimensional Einstein-Klein-Gordon system with the Wick-Cutkosky model, we quantify the effects of these corrections on the energy-charge relation and the kinematic stability of the configurations. Our results demonstrate how weak violation of scale invariance lifts the degeneracy of the non-relativistic solutions and determines the behavior of boson stars away from the critical limit.

</details>


### [352] [Conformal Spectrum of (Super) Chiral Ising and XY Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38614)
*Oleg Antipin,Jahmall Bersini,Jacob Hafjall,Giulia Muco,Francesco Sannino*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 本文通过次领头阶（next-to-leading order）半经典计算，确定临界 Gross-Neveu-Yukawa 与 Nambu-Jona-Lasinio-Yukawa 模型中复合算符（composite operators）的标度维谱（scaling dimensions），其红外不动点分属手征 Ising 与手征 XY 普适类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目标是刻画手征 Ising 与手征 XY 普适类中复合算符的标度维谱，并检验红外区域预期出现的超对称（supersymmetry）与超共形动力学（superconformal dynamics）。

Method: 采用次领头阶半经典（semiclassical）计算，在次领头阶上解析算符谱的洛伦兹结构（Lorentz structure）；在预期红外出现超对称的参数取值处，给出编码完整谱的闭式表达式（closed-form expression）。

Result: 获得两个模型中复合算符的标度维谱，并在次领头阶分辨其洛伦兹结构；在超对称预期出现的参数点上得到半经典框架内的完整谱闭式表达，算符可组织为超共形多重态（superconformal multiplets）。

Conclusion: 算符谱可按超共形多重态组织，这一结构为涌现超共形动力学（emergent superconformal dynamics）提供了进一步证据。

Abstract: We determine the spectrum of scaling dimensions of composite operators in the critical Gross-Neveu-Yukawa and Nambu-Jona-Lasinio-Yukawa models through a next-to-leading order semiclassical computation. Their infrared fixed points belong to the chiral Ising and chiral XY universality classes, respectively. At next-to-leading order, we resolve the Lorentz structure of the operator spectrum. For the parameter values at which supersymmetry is expected to emerge in the infrared, we obtain a closed-form expression encoding the full spectrum within the semiclassical methodology. The resulting organization of operators into superconformal multiplets provides further evidence for emergent superconformal dynamics.

</details>


### [353] [Bootstrapping Wilson lines in Critical Bosonic QED$_3$ Part 1: Large-$N$ endpoint correlators and CFT data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38663)
*Jun Maeda,Toshiki Onagi,Soichiro Shimamori*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 该文在临界玻色量子电动力学（QED₃，三维）中研究带一般电荷 q 的共形威尔逊线（conformal Wilson line），结合四点图计算与端点交叉（endpoint crossing）方程，首次在 1/N 次领头阶给出四端点关联函数的闭式结果，并发现体（bulk）与威尔逊线谱在所有非单态味道（non-singlet flavor channel）上到 1/N 阶一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临界玻色 QED₃ 是强关联临界现象与共形场论（conformal field theory）的重要模型，而带电荷威尔逊线提供缺陷（defect）视角；此前缺乏对一般电荷、完整 SU(N) 味结构且保持正定性的端点交叉方程及高阶 1/N 谱信息的系统处理。

Method: 将图解四点计算与端点交叉方程结合，构建保持正定性显式的完整 SU(N) 味结构交叉方程；对任意正整数电荷 q 在 N 大极限下固定，计算四端点关联函数及涉及两个体希格斯-斯特拉托诺维奇场（Hubbard–Stratonovich field）的混合关联函数，至 1/N 的第一亚领头阶。

Result: 获得闭式关联函数并由此确定端点维数（endpoint dimension）、缺陷 g-函数（defect g-function），以及最低非单态威尔逊线主算符的维数与端点 OPE 系数；发现体谱与威尔逊线谱在每个非单态味道到 1/N 阶一致，在简并情形下该一致性针对端点关联函数所探测的反常维数（anomalous dimension）的 OPE 加权平均；对单位电荷，独立地从已知体高自旋谱（higher-spin spectrum）重现这些平均值。

Conclusion: 图解关联函数与端点交叉方程的结合可有效刻画任意电荷共形威尔逊线的谱与 OPE 数据，并揭示体与缺陷非单态谱到 1/N 阶的意外一致性，为临界玻色 QED₃ 的缺陷共形场论提供定量约束。

Abstract: We study the conformal Wilson line with general charge $q$ in critical bosonic QED$_3$ with $N$ complex scalar flavors by combining diagrammatic four-point calculations with endpoint crossing. We formulate the endpoint crossing equations with the full $\mathrm{SU}(N)$ flavor structure, keeping positivity manifest. For arbitrary positive integer charge $q$ held fixed at large $N$, we obtain closed-form expressions for four-endpoint correlators and mixed correlators involving two bulk Hubbard--Stratonovich fields through first subleading order in $1/N$. These results determine the endpoint dimension, the defect $g$-function, and the dimensions and endpoint OPE coefficients of the lowest non-singlet Wilson-line primaries. Moreover, combining the diagrammatic correlator with endpoint crossing, somewhat surprisingly, we find agreement between the bulk and Wilson-line spectra in every non-singlet flavor channel through order $1/N$. At degenerate levels, this agreement concerns the OPE-weighted averages of anomalous dimensions probed by the endpoint correlator. For unit charge, we independently reproduce these averages from the known bulk higher-spin spectrum.

</details>


### [354] [Topological interfaces between universes and generalized families of 2d QFTs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38680)
*Pinak Banerjee,Yuhan Gai,Alonso Perez-Lona,Daniel Robbins,Subham Roy,Eric Sharpe,with an appendix by Xingyang Yu*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 该文研究含拓扑点算符（topological point operators）的二维量子场论（2d QFT）分解为多个"宇宙"（universes）的结构，用多融合范畴（multi-fusion category）描述其有限对称性，并对宇宙对（pairs of universes）按拓扑界面（topological interfaces）类型进行分类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 正如融合范畴（fusion category）对理解非可逆对称性（non-invertible symmetries）至关重要，分解型理论的对称性需要多融合范畴这一推广框架来刻画，包括平凡作用的对称性与宇宙间的拓扑界面。

Method: 将有限对称性表述为多融合范畴及其作用函子（action functor）；相对于给定对称性，按所含拓扑界面将宇宙对分类：不同不可分解直和分量间无界面（Type III），同分量内由可逆（Type I）或仅非可逆（Type II）界面相连。对具平凡作用阿贝尔正规子群的 orbifold 推导完整继承对称性，并从 2-群（2-group）扩张与共同紫外理论的重整化群流（RG flows）构造 Type III 对。

Result: orbifold 情形给出 Type I 与 Type II 对，但从不产生 Type III 对；Type III 对改由 2-群扩张与 RG 流构造。此外提出与 Brennan–Intriligator 广义族（generalized families）的对应：等变族（equivariant families）对应 Type I，范畴族对应规范保持对称性的 Type II，族反常（family anomalies）表现为携带不同对称保护拓扑相（SPT phases）的宇宙，Type III 对可实现离散参数上的族。

Conclusion: 多融合范畴为分解型二维量子场论的对称性提供统一框架，Type I/II/III 分类刻画宇宙间界面的可逆性结构，并与广义族、族反常及 SPT 相建立对应；附录以高荷 Schwinger 模型作为拉格朗日实例。

Abstract: Two-dimensional quantum field theories with topological point operators decompose into universes. Just as fusion categories have played an important role in understanding non-invertible symmetries, multi-fusion categories play an analogous role for the symmetries of such decomposing theories. We describe a finite symmetry as a multi-fusion category together with its action functor, which keeps track of trivially acting symmetries and of the topological interfaces between universes. Relative to a chosen symmetry, we classify pairs of universes by the topological interfaces it contains, which reflect the structure of the multi-fusion category: universes in different indecomposable summands are joined by no interface (Type~III), while within a summand they are related by invertible (Type~I) or only non-invertible (Type~II) interfaces. For orbifolds with a trivially acting abelian normal subgroup, we derive the full inherited symmetry, which characterizes the operators between universes found case by case by Robbins, Sharpe and Vandermeulen and yields pairs of Types~I and~II but never of Type~III. We construct Type~III pairs instead from extensions of $2$-group type and from renormalization group flows out of a common ultraviolet theory. Finally, we propose a correspondence with the generalized families of quantum field theories of Brennan and Intriligator, in which equivariant families correspond to Type~I pairs and categorical ones to Type~II pairs whose gauging preserves the symmetry, family anomalies appear as universes carrying different symmetry-protected topological phases, and Type~III pairs can realize families over a discrete parameter. An appendix by Xingyang Yu works out the higher-charge Schwinger model as a Lagrangian example.

</details>


### [355] [The Effective Field Theory Origin of the Fuzzy Sphere Method](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38702)
*Mykola Dedushenko*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 该文提出以 S^2×R 上的“母理论（mother theory）”为出发点，将模糊球（fuzzy sphere）哈密顿量组织为母理论的后代（descendants）框架，并据此构造出首个模糊球上 z=2 的非相对论临界点实例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模糊球哈密顿量通常直接写在最低朗道能级（lowest Landau level）上，缺乏与常规局域场论之间的联系，也缺少系统性构造新模型的途径；本文旨在为这些哈密顿量提供统一的场论来源与生成机制。

Method: 在 S^2×R 上构造局域母理论，通过积分掉实中介场 φ 与高朗道能级得到模糊哈密顿量，而积分掉费米子则得到流向 Ising 点的常规局域 φ 有效场论；随后将 φ 提升为复场 Φ 构造新例子。还对母理论空间作了探索（轻微修改可达高斯点与 Lee-Yang 延拓）。

Result: 以两个带电狄拉克费米子耦合实场 φ 的 Ising 母理论为例，其后代即模糊哈密顿量；修改后可达高斯点（三临界路线，tricritical route）与 Lee-Yang 延拓。新构造的复场 Φ 模型后代为模糊球上的易面铁磁体（easy-plane ferromagnet），其自发对称破缺相给出赝戈德斯通相对论标量，临界点为非相对论性，是模糊球上 z=2 标度的首个例子。

Conclusion: 该框架可解析处理：新模型存在精确单磁振子（one-magnon）解，且 z=2 临界点可解析求解；作者并勾勒了该方法的丰富应用前景。

Abstract: Fuzzy sphere Hamiltonians for (2+1)D conformal field theories are usually written directly on the lowest Landau level. We introduce a framework organizing them as descendants of local ``mother theories'' on $S^2\times\mathbb R$. We start with the example of Ising mother theory built from two charged Dirac fermions coupled to a real mediator $φ$. Integrating out $φ$ and the higher Landau levels produces the fuzzy Hamiltonian, while integrating out the fermions gives a conventional local $φ$ effective field theory flowing to the Ising point. Mild modifications of the same theory reach the Gaussian point (tricritical route) and the Lee-Yang continuation. Exploring the space of mother theories, we next promote $φ$ to a complex field $Φ$ and construct a new example, whose descendant is an easy-plane ferromagnet on the fuzzy sphere. Its spontaneous symmetry breaking phase gives a pseudo-Goldstone relativistic scalar, similar to the model introduced by Y.-C. He, while its critical point is non-relativistic, providing the first example of $z=2$ scaling on the fuzzy sphere. Remarkably, it admits exact one-magnon solutions, and the $z=2$ critical point can be found analytically. We then outline a rich landscape of further applications of our approach.

</details>


### [356] [Unifying energy-entropy bounds in semiclassical gravity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38713)
*Jackson R. Fliss,Andrew Rolph*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 该文重新审视半经典引力中的能量与熵界，提出一类新界——引力能量-熵条件（GEECs），其同时蕴含量子聚焦猜想（QFC）与涂抹零能条件（SNEC），并在经典极限下退化为零能条件（NEC）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: QFC与SNEC虽各自在相应层级中最强且应用广泛，但二者互不蕴含，且均不能在经典极限下退化为NEC，缺乏统一框架。

Method: 定义满足特定判据的GEEC类，将其施加于一组广泛的应力张量（stress tensor）界上，构造显式GEEC族，并通过测试用例、借助有效场论（effective field theory）启发式方法约束其余参数空间。

Result: 构造出显式的GEEC族，该族同时蕴含QFC与SNEC，并在经典极限下退化为NEC，其剩余参数空间经测试用例得到约束。

Conclusion: GEECs是半经典引力中能量与熵的有力候选界，为统一已有界提供了新框架。

Abstract: We revisit bounds on energy and entropy in semiclassical gravity, aiming to strengthen and unify established bounds, in particular the quantum focussing conjecture (QFC) and the smeared null energy condition (SNEC). Both the QFC and SNEC have important applications and are the strongest in their respective hierarchies; however, neither implies the other, nor reduces to the null energy condition (NEC) in the classical limit. To that end, we define a new class of bounds dubbed gravitational energy-entropy conditions (GEECs) that imply both the QFC and SNEC, and reduce to the NEC classically. We construct an explicit family of GEECs by imposing the defining criteria on a broad set of stress tensor bounds, and constrain its remaining parameter space through test cases, in an effective field theory-inspired approach. Our GEECs are powerful candidate bounds on energy and entropy in semiclassical gravity.

</details>


### [357] [Collective Bootstrap for Matrix Quantum Mechanics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38716)
*Xianlong Liu*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 本文提出一种集体自举（collective bootstrap）框架，直接在大 N 矩阵量子力学的单迹坐标矩所构成的圈空间（loop space）中建立半定规划（semidefinite program），从而给出平面基态能量的下界并估计圈期望值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大 N 矩阵量子力学中动量含矩（momentum containing moments）若被当作独立变量处理会带来不自然的约束结构，需要一种系统性组织动力学约束、并能在更高字长（word length）处截断的方法。

Method: 借助圈连接与分裂操作（loop joining and splitting）系统化组织动能约束；结合位力定理（virial theorem）、Schur 补（Schur complement）以及对圈二次乘积的松弛（relaxation），将集体能量的非线性约束优化重构为半定规划，并配合序列半定优化启发式搜索满足平面因子化（planar factorization）的构型。

Result: 在单矩阵、双矩阵与三矩阵模型中，所得结果与解析解及主场优化（master field optimization）高度吻合；每次截断均给出平面基态能量的严格下界（lower bound）。

Conclusion: 仅使用坐标矩即可实现更高字长的截断，该框架有望推广至含更多矩阵的模型，包括 BFSS 与 BMN 模型的玻色子部分（bosonic sectors）。

Abstract: We develop a collective bootstrap framework for large $N$ matrix quantum mechanics formulated directly in the loop space of single trace coordinate moments. Loop joining and splitting operations organize the kinetic constraints systematically and avoid treating momentum containing moments as independent variables. Employing the virial theorem, a Schur complement, and a relaxation of quadratic products of loops, we recast the nonlinear constrained optimization of the collective energy into a semidefinite program, which yields a lower bound on the planar ground state energy at every truncation. A sequential semidefinite optimization heuristic then searches for configurations satisfying planar factorization and estimates the ground state energy and loop expectation values. Applications to one-, two-, and three-matrix models exhibit close agreement with analytic solutions and master field optimization. By working exclusively with coordinate moments, the framework permits truncations at higher word length and offers a promising approach to models with more matrices, including the bosonic sectors of the BFSS and BMN models.

</details>


### [358] [Elliptic master integrals and the one-loop cosmological wavefunction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38725)
*Amara McCune,Matthew D. Schwartz*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 本文用自举法（bootstrap）精确计算共形耦合标量（conformally coupled scalar）的单圈三角形波函数系数，发现椭圆周期（elliptic periods）相消，结果仅为双对数（dilogarithm）组合；而单圈盒图（one-loop box）则非多对数型，其阈值非连续性含椭圆积分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 宇宙学波函数（cosmological wavefunction）的圈修正涉及与散射振幅（scattering amplitudes）类似的积分。此前基于主积分（master integrals）为椭圆型，预期三角形波函数系数亦为椭圆型，本文旨在检验这一预期。

Method: 采用自举方法（bootstrap approach）精确计算单圈三角形波函数系数，并分析圈被积函数（loop integrand）在椭圆扇区（elliptic sector）上的留数（residue）结构；同时对单圈盒图进行考察。

Result: 三角形系数中的椭圆周期相消，平坦空间（flat-space）波函数系数为双对数的组合；相消源于椭圆扇区上的留数为平直空间振幅，且对圈动量（loop momentum）是有理的。单圈盒图即使每个顶点仅一条外腿也非多对数型（polylogarithmic），其阈值非连续性涉及椭圆积分，本文给出闭式表达；在正四面体（regular-tetrahedron）动量下，K3 曲面的周期进入其圈被积函数。

Conclusion: 主积分为椭圆型并不意味着波函数系数亦为椭圆型；三角形与盒图在超越性（transcendentality）结构上存在本质差异，后者需引入椭圆积分乃至 K3 曲面周期。

Abstract: Loop corrections to the cosmological wavefunction involve similar integrals to those required for scattering amplitudes. For the one-loop triangle of a conformally coupled scalar, the master integrals are elliptic, and so the triangle wavefunction coefficient was expected to be elliptic as well. Using a bootstrap approach, we compute this triangle coefficient exactly and show that it is not: the elliptic periods cancel, and the flat-space wavefunction coefficient is a combination of dilogarithms. The cancellation occurs because the residue of the loop integrand on the elliptic sector is a flat-space amplitude, rational in the loop momentum. The one-loop box, by contrast, is not polylogarithmic, even with a single external leg at each site. Its threshold discontinuity involves elliptic integrals, which we also give in closed form. For regular-tetrahedron momenta the periods of a K3 surface enter its loop integrand.

</details>


### [359] [From pq-webs to magnetic quivers and back I: dictionary and deformations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38769)
*Sebastiano Garavaglia,Sara Pasquetti,Palash Singh*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 本文提出一个精确参数字典（parameter dictionary），将五维N=1理论（由(p,q)五膜网实现）的味质量与瞬子耦合对应到其三维N=4磁颤振（magnetic quiver）的FI参数，并通过超共形指数与压扁球配分函数验证该字典。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旨在建立五维超共形理论与三维磁颤振之间的定量映射，使三维精确可观测量可用于重构五维物理并遍历形变网络。

Method: 研究对象为N+SU(N)_0^{k-1}+N箱形颤振理论；在五维侧于超共形指数（superconformal index）层面实现质量形变、弱耦合极限与真空期望值等流，在三维侧用追踪希格斯化（Higgsing）、解耦扇区与红外理论的新方法分析磁颤振的压扁球配分函数（squashed-sphere partition function）。

Result: 该字典在一大类形变下通过检验：它确定相应的FI形变与磁单极子真空期望值，并在三维侧与五维指数流一致。

Conclusion: 磁颤振由此成为定量研究五维超共形指数对形变响应的工具；已知参数字典后，三维精确可观测量可重构五维物理并双向导航完整形变网络。

Abstract: This is the first of two companion papers in which we study five-dimensional $\mathcal{N}=1$ theories engineered by $(p,q)$ five-brane webs and their associated three-dimensional $\mathcal{N}=4$ magnetic quivers. We focus on the $N+\mathrm{SU}(N)_0^{k-1}+N$ box quiver theories. We propose an exact parameter dictionary relating the five-dimensional flavour masses and instanton couplings to the Fayet-Iliopoulos parameters of the corresponding strong-coupling magnetic quiver.
  We test this dictionary through a broad class of deformations, including mass deformations, weak-coupling limits, and vacuum expectation values. On the five-dimensional side, we implement these flows directly at the level of the superconformal index. The dictionary fixes the corresponding FI deformations and monopole VEVs. We analyse them in the magnetic-quiver squashed-sphere partition function using a new method that tracks Higgsing, decoupled sectors, and infrared theories. Our results promote magnetic quivers to tools for the quantitative study of how the five-dimensional superconformal index responds to deformations. Once the parameter dictionary is known, exact three-dimensional observables can be used to reconstruct the corresponding five-dimensional physics and to navigate the full deformation network in both directions.

</details>


### [360] [From pq-webs to magnetic quivers and back II: distributional indices and 5d theories breaking bad](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38770)
*Sebastiano Garavaglia,Sara Pasquetti,Palash Singh*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 本文是系列论文的第二篇，研究由(p,q)五膜网（five-brane web）构造的五维$\mathcal{N}=1$理论及其三维磁颤振（magnetic quiver）。基于第一篇给出的精确参数字典，分析幂零矩映射真空期望值（nilpotent moment-map VEV）形变及其三维对应物。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前作已建立$N+\mathrm{SU}(N)_0^{k-1}+N$理论与磁颤振在无限耦合下的精确参数字典，本文旨在利用该字典深入考察希格斯化（Higgsing）形变，并理解其五维与三维对应关系。

Method: 通过幂零矩映射真空期望值形变及其三维对应物进行研究，并发展五膜网的解释，识别与希格斯化级联相关的Hanany-Witten移动，同时将不等价标架（inequivalent frames）对应于广义环面图（generalised toric diagram）的不同镶嵌。

Result: 当希格斯化过度（excessive）时，五维超共形指标（superconformal index）呈现分布型（distributional），与三维中坏理论（bad theories）和破缺理论的特征相呼应。

Conclusion: 五维超共形指标的分布性行为与三维坏/破缺理论特征相对应，五膜网图像可通过Hanany-Witten移动与广义环面图镶嵌给出统一理解。

Abstract: This is the second of two companion papers in which we study five-dimensional $\mathcal{N}=1$ theories engineered by $(p,q)$ five-brane webs and their associated three-dimensional magnetic quivers. Leveraging the exact parameter dictionary between the $N+\mathrm{SU}(N)_0^{k-1}+N$ theories and their magnetic quivers at infinite coupling, proposed in the first paper, we investigate nilpotent moment-map VEV deformations and their three-dimensional counterparts. We show that, when the Higgsing is excessive, the five-dimensional superconformal index becomes distributional, mirroring a characteristic feature of bad and broken theories in three dimensions. We also develop a five-brane web interpretation of these results, identifying the Hanany-Witten moves associated with the Higgsing cascade and relating inequivalent frames to distinct tessellations of the generalised toric diagram.

</details>


### [361] [Holography and localization in fractional field theory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38806)
*Gianluca Calcagni,Iván Salvador-García*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 本文旨在将分数场论（fractional field theory）改写为局部对偶（local dual）形式，提出两条路径：推广 Caffarelli–Silvestre 延拓定理至多尺度动能项与非局域相互作用的分数场论，以及引入质量连续谱的谱局部化（spectral localization）方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分数场论是量子化引力相互作用的有前景框架，但非局域算符（nonlocal operators）的存在使其处理困难，因此需要构造局部对偶以简化问题。

Method: 第一，将 Caffarelli–Silvestre 延拓定理推广到含多尺度动能项与非局域相互作用的自伴分数场论，以标量场为例，将其重解释为全息对偶于高维体（bulk）中两个标量场局部理论的非局域边界自由度；第二，针对局域非线性势难以纳入的问题，提出不向高维延拓、而以引入质量连续谱为代价实现局部化的替代图景。

Result: 谱局部化方案可自然实现 fakeon 规定（fakeon prescription）及相关的经典化程序（classicization procedure），该程序此前已用于含高阶导数和复鬼（complex ghosts）的局部理论。

Conclusion: 论文讨论了上述方法在分数量子引力（fractional quantum gravity）中的应用，并与二次量子引力（quadratic quantum gravity）进行了比较。

Abstract: Fractional field theory is a promising framework wherein to quantize the gravitational interaction but the presence of nonlocal operators can make its handling difficult. With the purpose of easing this problem, we recast the theory as a local dual in two ways. First, we generalize the Caffarelli--Silvestre extension theorem to self-adjoint fractional field theories with multi-scale kinetic terms and nonlocal interactions, taking the example of a scalar field. The latter is reinterpreted as a nonlocal boundary degree of freedom holographically dual to a local theory of two scalars living in a higher-dimensional bulk. However, inclusion of a local non-linear potential is not straightforward. We therefore propose an alternative picture where the nonlocal theory is not extended to a higher-dimensional space but is localized at the price of introducing a continuum of masses. This \emph{spectral localization} allows for a natural implementation of the fakeon prescription and the related classicization procedure, already employed in local theories with higher-derivative and complex ghosts. Applications to fractional quantum gravity and its comparison with quadratic quantum gravity are discussed.

</details>


### [362] [Gluons and Knots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10673)
*Alfredo Guevara*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 论文论证单负螺旋度胶子（single minus helicity gluon）与任意多正螺旋度胶子的散射振幅（scattering amplitude）具有拓扑性质：振幅在运动学空间的“腔”（chambers）内为常数，共振位于壁上，分解行为由穿墙（wall-crossing）决定；该振幅可由二维零 Wilson 环（2d null Wilson loop）对应到三维正性横向链环（3d link），并以 HOMFLY-PT 多项式的“角”（corners）构造态计数（state-counting）描述。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动机在于揭示最大螺旋度破坏（maximally helicity violating）类振幅背后的拓扑结构：若振幅只依赖运动学腔而非连续参数，则其共振与分解可由墙与穿墙统一刻画，并可能与拓扑场论及弦论建立精确联系。

Method: 方法包括：用 Yangian 不变性（Yangian invariance）将振幅归结为二维零 Wilson 环，再提升为三维正性横向链环；把穿墙与 Weinberg 软定理（Weinberg soft theorem）分别重新解释为子纽结（subknots）的 skein 关系与 Reidemeister 移动；据此构造以 HOMFLY-PT 多项式之“角”相加为核心的态计数。新公式通过 Lean 形式化的依赖图（DAG）严格推导，显式列出含 Reidemeister III 不变性的假设。

Result: 结果为：振幅在运动学腔中为常数，共振定位于壁，分解由穿墙决定；态计数由 HOMFLY-PT 多项式“角”的相加给出；在经典极限之外，该构造给出与拓扑场论（topological field theory）和弦论（string theory）的精确联系猜想。测试包含新颖的“星形”（star）运动学情形，其中振幅与态计数均化为 Catalan 数，与纽结论文献一致。

Conclusion: 结论是单负螺旋度胶子振幅本质上是拓扑对象，其组合态计数与链环不变量（link invariants）结构相通，并可延伸至拓扑场论与弦论的非微扰猜想；形式化推导与穷举测试（含 Catalan 数检验）支持该框架的自洽性。

Abstract: We argue that the scattering amplitude of a single minus helicity gluon with arbitrarily many positive helicity gluons is topological. The amplitude is constant in chambers of kinematic space, its resonances are located at walls and its factorization is determined by wall-crossing. Yangian invariance dictates the amplitude to be determined by a 2d null Wilson loop that can be lifted into a positive and transverse 3d link. By reinterpreting wall-crossing and the Weinberg soft theorem as skein relations and Reidemeister moves of the subknots, we construct a state-counting description consisting of adding the `corners' of their HOMFLY-PT polynomials. Beyond the classical limit, we argue that this provides a conjectured but precise connection to topological field and string theory.
  The new formula is rigorously derived via a Lean-formalized dependency graph (DAG) as detailed in a companion paper, laying out the precise assumptions including Reidemeister III invariance. It is further tested exhaustively, including novel `star' kinematics where the amplitude and state count are shown to become Catalan numbers, in agreement with knot theory literature.

</details>


### [363] [Gravitational Reconstruction in $AdS_{4}$](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38887)
*David A. Lowe,Yiru Wang,Juanyi Yang*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 该文在共形平坦边界上以守恒、无迹的应力张量重构 AdS₄ 中的线性化引力扰动，并给出收敛条件及向平直空间极限的推广。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将此前实洛伦兹号差下的重构构造推广到更一般的边界动量情形，并处理含非零频率及零频极限的扰动，以衔接 BMS 对称性与天体全息。

Method: 对无类空傅里叶支撑的容许数据，将物理响应化为边界光锥截面上的积分；通过边界改进恢复 Fefferman–Graham（FG）规范；并用实应力数据上的显式位置空间广义函数处理一般类空边界动量。

Result: 边界改进在保持可归一化性与线性化外尔张量的同时恢复 FG 规范；构造了可归一化扰动的边界核，并给出了重构收敛的充分条件。

Conclusion: 结果为受控的平直空间极限提供依据，并指向 Bondi–Metzner–Sachs（BMS）对称性与天体全息（celestial holography）的相关研究。

Abstract: We reconstruct linearized gravitational perturbations in $AdS_{4}$ from a conserved, traceless stress tensor on a fixed conformally flat boundary metric, extending our earlier real Lorentzian construction. For admissible data with no spacelike Fourier support in a flat conformal frame, the physical response reduces to an integral over boundary light-cone cuts. Boundary improvements restore Fefferman--Graham (FG) gauge while preserving normalizability and the linearized Weyl tensor. We then reconstruct perturbations with general spacelike boundary momentum, including nonzero frequency and its zero-frequency limit, using explicit position-space generalized functions on real stress data. Boundary kernels are constructed for normalizable perturbations and sufficient conditions are derived for the reconstruction to converge. The results motivate controlled flat-space limits relevant to Bondi--Metzner--Sachs symmetries and celestial holography.

</details>


### [364] [Generalized Symmetries of QED$_4$ on Non-Spin Manifolds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38907)
*Michele Del Zotto,Vivek Saxena*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 本文研究无质量量子电动力学（QED）在定向非自旋四维流形上的广义对称性（generalized symmetries）与时空切结构（tangential structure）的相互作用：光子成为 spin^c 联络，磁 1-形式对称性被 w2-扭曲，并伴随一个二阶混合磁-引力反常（mixed magnetic-gravitational anomaly）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 广义对称性对时空的切结构敏感，而既往讨论多限于自旋流形；因此有必要考察在定向但非自旋的四维流形上，光子作为 spin^c 联络并对 spin^c 结构求和时对称性结构如何改变。

Method: 在定向非自旋四维流形上研究无质量 QED，将光子视为 spin^c 联络并对 spin^c 结构求和；利用移位通量量子化（shifted flux quantization）刻画 w2-扭曲的 1-形式对称性，并用约化定向配边（reduced oriented bordism）对混合反常分类、在 Wu 流形上探测，辅以复射影平面（complex projective plane）显式示例。

Result: 磁 1-形式对称性被扩展为 w2-扭曲的 1-形式对称性，其 2π 旋转表现为由算符所绕曲面的法丛（normal bundle）决定的引力符号；阻碍其成为普通磁 1-形式对称性的是一个二阶混合磁-引力反常，该反常在固定 spin^c 扇区可由抵消项（counterterm）移除，因而属于对 spin^c 结构求和的性质。手征反常由 spin^c Dirac 算子的指标（index）支配，spin^c Hall 拓扑场论可抵消电磁部分但留下 framing anomaly，后者可通过堆叠中性且一般非可逆的 Witten-Reshetikhin-Turaev 层在对任意有理角度的反常流入（anomaly inflow）层面抵消。

Conclusion: 该混合磁-引力反常是 spin^c 求和的整体性质而非单一扇区性质，并对手征缺陷（chiral defects）、有能隙相、Coulomb 相与 Higgs 相均有影响；同一 framing 微妙性也影响弯曲自旋流形上 QED 的手征缺陷。

Abstract: Generalized symmetries are sensitive to the tangential structure of spacetime. We study this interplay for massless QED on oriented non-spin four-manifolds, where the photon becomes a spin$^c$ connection and the path integral sums over spin$^c$ structures. The shifted flux quantization extends the magnetic 1-form symmetry into a $w_2$-twisted 1-form symmetry: its $2π$ rotation acts as a gravitational sign, fixed by the normal bundle of the surface the operator wraps. The obstruction to treating it as an ordinary magnetic 1-form symmetry is an order-two mixed magnetic-gravitational anomaly, which is classified by reduced oriented bordism and detected on the Wu manifold. In a fixed spin$^c$ sector, this anomaly is removable by a counterterm, so it is a property of the sum over spin$^c$ structures. We discuss its consequences for gapped, Coulomb, and Higgs phases. The chiral anomaly is governed by the index of the spin$^c$ Dirac operator, so rational chiral defects carry gravitational as well as electromagnetic responses. A spin$^c$ Hall topological field theory cancels the electromagnetic part but leaves a framing anomaly. At the level of anomaly inflow, this is canceled for every rational angle by stacking a neutral, generally noninvertible Witten-Reshetikhin-Turaev layer. The same framing subtlety affects the chiral defects of QED on curved spin manifolds. The complex projective plane illustrates each of these features explicitly.

</details>


### [365] [Are Black Hole and Cosmological Horizon Thermodynamics Necessarily Inequivalent?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39048)
*Zachary J. Hoelscher*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 本文以含单个不转动黑洞与正宇宙学常数的宇宙为玩具模型（toy model），在 Nariai 极限与宇称不变（parity invariant）假设下，发现半经典区域内观测者难以区分黑洞视界与宇宙学视界邻近物理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有论点认为，在任何自洽的紫外完备量子引力（UV complete quantum gravity）理论中，宇宙学视界热力学与黑洞热力学普遍不等价，并主张可通过寻找反例予以否证；该猜想部分源于宇宙学视界缺乏弦论（string theory）黑洞的诸多便利特征。

Method: 构建含单个不转动黑洞与正宇宙学常数的宇宙玩具模型，取黑洞质量趋于最大值的 Nariai 极限（Nariai limit），并假定该背景上的量子场论严格宇称不变；在半经典区域忽略精确 Nariai 平衡在量子涨落下的不稳定性。

Result: 在此设定下，观测者无法轻易区分黑洞视界邻域与宇宙学视界邻域的物理，提示二者一般而言并非完全无关，但并未证明其在任意宇宙中普遍等价。

Conclusion: 任何旨在描述正宇宙学常数宇宙中黑洞的自洽量子引力理论，都应为该特定极限邻域内的领头半经典宇宙学熵（cosmological entropy）与黑洞熵提供相关联的微观起源。

Abstract: It has recently been argued that cosmological horizon thermodynamics and black hole thermodynamics are generically inequivalent in any consistent, UV complete theory of quantum gravity, where it was suggested that this could be falsified by the identification of a counterexample. This conjecture was motivated in part by noting that cosmological horizons do not incorporate many of the convenient features found in the black holes described by string theory. In this work, we consider as a toy model a universe with a single non-rotating black hole and a positive cosmological constant. We work in the Nariai limit where the mass of the black hole is taken to its maximum possible value, and where we also assert that the quantum field theory living on this background is strictly parity invariant. In the semi-classical regime where we neglect instability of the exact Nariai equilibrium under quantum fluctuations, we find that the observer cannot readily distinguish the physics in the neighborhood of the black hole horizon from the physics in the neighborhood of the cosmological horizon. This does not prove that the two are generically equivalent in any universe, though it does suggest that they cannot be entirely unrelated in general. We propose that any consistent theory of quantum gravity that aims to describe black holes in a universe with a positive cosmological constant should provide a related microscopic origin for the leading semiclassical cosmological entropy and black hole entropy in the neighborhood of the particular limit considered here.

</details>


### [366] [Deformed Amplituhedra and Interpolating Anomalous Dimensions on the Coulomb Branch](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39052)
*Francesco Calisto,Subramanya Hegde,Martín Lagares,Elia Mazzucchelli*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 该文将形变 Amplituhedron 构造推广至六参数嵌入空间 Gram 矩阵描述的一般外运动学，证明本文重点讨论逆 Gram 矩阵的全正性约束控制实几何并把两圈正则形式分子限制在双箱结构张成空间内；随后在三参数大质量构型下用四维微分方程求出多对数解析结果，并发现两圈指数化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有形变 Amplituhedron 研究多限于特定大质量运动学，缺乏对多参数大质量族的一般处理；同时"walking"反常维度的全圈结构及其与尖点（cusp）、八边形（octagon）反常维度的关系尚待检验。

Method: 把形变 Amplituhedron 构造推广到由六参数嵌入空间 Gram 矩阵刻画的一般外运动学，利用逆 Gram 矩阵的全正性（copositivity）约束分析实几何与两圈正则形式分子；再取三参数大质量构型，直接在四维中用微分方程（differential equations）计算一圈与两圈积分。

Result: 得到以多重多对数（multiple polylogarithms）表示的解析表达式；两圈振幅在多重标度红外极限下实现指数化（exponentiation）。该运动学族包含由尖点与八边形反常维度支配的极限，并通过 walking 反常维度在二者间插值，结果重现一圈插值并确定其全圈拟设中的两圈系数。

Conclusion: 结果表明 walking 反常维度可能完全由尖点与八边形反常维度在所有圈阶上确定，从而为该全圈拟设提供支持性证据。

Abstract: We study planar four-point scattering amplitudes on the Coulomb branch of $\mathcal N=4$ super Yang--Mills theory, focusing on multi-parameter families of massive kinematics. We extend the deformed Amplituhedron construction of \cite{Arkani-Hamed:2023epq,Flieger:2025ekn} to general external kinematics characterized by a six-parameter embedding-space Gram matrix. We show that copositivity constraints on the inverse Gram matrix control the real geometry and restrict the numerator of the two-loop canonical form to the span of the two planar double-box structures expected for the scattering amplitude. We then specialize to a three-parameter massive configuration and evaluate the relevant one- and two-loop integrals using differential equations directly in four dimensions, obtaining analytic expressions in terms of multiple polylogarithms. We investigate multiscale infrared limits of the proposed two-loop amplitude and find exponentiation through two loops. The kinematic family contains the limits governed by the cusp and octagon anomalous dimensions and interpolates between them through the walking anomalous dimension introduced in~\cite{Alday:2026cpk}. Our result reproduces the one-loop interpolation and fixes the two-loop coefficients in their proposed all-loop ansatz. Interestingly, our results suggest that the walking anomalous dimension may be entirely determined through all loop orders by the cusp and octagon anomalous dimensions.

</details>


### [367] [Regularized Master-Field Approximation for Mass-Deformed Supersymmetric Yang-Mills Matrix Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39101)
*Yue Lei,Reishi Maeta*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 本文将正则化主场近似（regularized master-field approximation, RMA）应用于含三、四、十个矩阵的质量形变超对称杨–米尔斯型矩阵模型，定量重现了模糊球（fuzzy-sphere）解及其崩溃行为，并指出狄拉克算子（Dirac operator）零模在部分情形下会使模糊球构型失稳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RMA 已被证明是大N约化矩阵模型（large-N reduced matrix models）的高效计算方法，可处理多矩阵与复积分权重；本文旨在检验其在质量形变超对称杨–米尔斯型矩阵模型中的适用性与定量精度。

Method: 对含三个、四个和十个矩阵的质量形变超对称杨–米尔斯型矩阵模型施加 RMA 计算；这些模型均以模糊球构型作为经典解，故以该解及其崩溃作为检验基准，并考察狄拉克算子零模的作用。

Result: RMA 定量重现了模糊球解及其崩溃（breakdown）；在某些情形下，狄拉克算子的零模（zero modes）可使模糊球构型失稳（destabilize）。

Conclusion: RMA 可有效且定量地描述此类质量形变超对称矩阵模型的非微扰行为，模糊球解的稳定性受狄拉克零模影响。

Abstract: The regularized master-field approximation (RMA) is an efficient computational method for large-$N$ reduced matrix models, including those with multiple matrices or complex integration weights. In this work, we apply the RMA to mass-deformed supersymmetric Yang--Mills-type matrix models with three, four, and ten matrices. All three models admit fuzzy-sphere configurations as classical solutions. We show that the RMA quantitatively reproduces these fuzzy-sphere solutions and their breakdown, and that zero modes of the Dirac operator can destabilize fuzzy-sphere configurations in certain cases.

</details>


### [368] [virasoro_blocks: Software for the 2d bootstrap](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39106)
*David Poland*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 该文介绍软件 virasoro_blocks，可在任意中心荷下以适合数值bootstrap的形式计算Virasoro共形块（Virasoro conformal blocks），并用最优插值（optimal interpolation）减少Kac极点、实现高精度任意精度计算，最后展示标量能隙（scalar gap）与平均交换维度（average exchanged dimension）两类界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Zamolodchikov递推（Zamolodchikov's recursion）在椭圆nome每个有限阶给出“正前因子×交换维度的有理函数”，但大量Kac极点（Kac poles）使其难以用于bootstrap的半定规划（semidefinite programming）方法，因此需要减少极点数同时保持高精度。

Method: 软件采用最优插值（optimal interpolation）压缩极点数并保持高精度；支持任意精度（arbitrary precision）计算，可处理奇异中心荷（singular central charges），包括极小模型（minimal models）与 c=1；同时可计算全局块（global blocks）、N=1超共形块（N=1 superconformal blocks）、环面特征标（torus characters）与环面单点块（torus one-point blocks）。

Result: 仅假设标量Virasoro主算子（scalar Virasoro primaries）时，得到的标量能隙界逼近Liouville解窗口，即 (c-1)/16 到 (c-1)/12 之间；并在若干中心荷下给出相同标量四点函数中平均交换维度的界，这些界结构丰富，许多已知二维CFT位于其边界上或附近。

Conclusion: virasoro_blocks 提供了在任意中心荷下高精度、可用于数值bootstrap的Virasoro共形块计算工具，并有效应用于标量能隙与平均交换维度的界估计。

Abstract: We introduce virasoro_blocks, software that computes Virasoro conformal blocks at any central charge in a form suitable for the numerical bootstrap. At each finite order in the elliptic nome, Zamolodchikov's recursion gives the block as a positive prefactor times a rational function of the exchanged weight. However, its many Kac poles make it difficult to use in semidefinite programming approaches to the bootstrap. In this software we use optimal interpolation to reduce the number of poles while keeping high accuracy. The software works in arbitrary precision and handles singular central charges, including the minimal models and $c=1$. It also computes global blocks, $N=1$ superconformal blocks, torus characters, and torus one-point blocks. We illustrate it with two applications. Assuming only scalar Virasoro primaries, we compute bounds on the scalar gap that approach the window of Liouville solutions between $(c-1)/16$ and $(c-1)/12$. We also bound the average exchanged dimension in four-point functions of identical scalars at several central charges. These bounds have a rich structure, and many known 2d CFTs lie on or near their boundary.

</details>


### [369] [Ortho-symplectic interface line operators in $\mathcal{N}=4$ SYM theories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39207)
*Yasuyuki Hatsuda,Tadashi Okazaki*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 研究正交与辛规范群的四维 $\mathcal{N}=4$ 超杨-米尔斯（super Yang-Mills, SYM）理论中半-BPS 界面（half-BPS interface）上的线算符（line operator），提出界面处威尔逊线（Wilson line）与涡旋线（vortex line）在 S-对偶（S-duality）下的对偶性，并用线缺陷半指数（line defect half-index）匹配作为证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将线算符与界面的研究从幺正/特殊酉群推广到正交（orthogonal）与辛（symplectic）规范群，并检验界面处 S-对偶对偶关系的适用性。

Method: 对 NS5 型界面，线算符由界面两侧规范群下的电或磁荷对标记；对 D5 型界面，则由界面所保持的单一规范群下的电或磁荷标记。在此基础上提出界面处威尔逊线与涡旋线之间的 S-对偶对偶性。

Result: 作为线算符与界面交界处对偶性的高度非平凡证据，发现对偶线对（dual pairs）的线缺陷半指数相互匹配。

Conclusion: 半-BPS 界面上线算符的分类及威尔逊线—涡旋线对偶性在正交与辛规范群情形下成立，半指数匹配为其提供强证据。

Abstract: We study the line operators at the half-BPS interfaces in 4d $\mathcal{N}=4$ super Yang-Mills (SYM) theories of orthogonal and symplectic gauge groups. For the NS5-type interfaces, line operators are labeled by pairs of electric or magnetic charges under the gauge groups on either side of the interface, whereas for the D5-type interfaces they are labeled by electric or magnetic charges under the single gauge group preserved by the interface. We propose dualities between the Wilson lines and vortex lines at the interfaces under the action of S-duality. As highly non-trivial evidence of the dualities on the junctions of the line operators and the interfaces, we find matching of the line defect half-indices for the dual pairs.

</details>


### [370] [Schwinger--Keldysh worldline effective field theory for quantum black holes: dissipation, noise and decoherence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39243)
*Hajime Kobayashi*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 论文构建了量子黑洞的Schwinger–Keldysh世界线有效场论，将耗散、涨落与退相干统一纳入单一实时影响泛函，并以因果响应核与对称噪声核编码约化动力学。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旨在为量子黑洞提供一个可在实时框架内同时处理耗散、涨落与退相干的统一有效场论描述，克服这些效应通常被分开处理的局限。

Method: 采用Schwinger–Keldysh世界线有效场论（worldline effective field theory），以因果响应核（causal response kernel）与对称噪声核（symmetric noise kernel）刻画约化动力学，其谱满足正定性约束并由热Kubo–Martin–Schwinger对称性通过涨落–耗散关系（fluctuation–dissipation relation）相联系；借助Hubbard–Stratonovich表示将噪声核转化为驱动度规与世界线的高斯源。

Result: 在领头后牛顿阶（post-Newtonian）Schwarzschild双星中，直接与度规中介的随机力合成为该阶完整的相对加速度噪声，保持质心动量平衡且保持普朗克压低（Planck suppressed）；同一噪声核给出支撑空间叠加态的四极退相干泛函，并在吸收匹配后重现Danielson–Satishchandran–Wald视界诱导标度。

Conclusion: 非热平衡时响应核与噪声核仍为独立的匹配数据；论文进一步讨论了世界线核中微观量子结构、向空间扩展粗粒化描述的匹配以及引力分裂（gravitational splitting）等扩展方向。

Abstract: We formulate a Schwinger--Keldysh worldline effective field theory for quantum black holes that treats dissipation, fluctuations, and decoherence within one real-time influence functional. The reduced dynamics is encoded in causal response and symmetric noise kernels. Their spectra obey positivity constraints, while thermal Kubo--Martin--Schwinger symmetry relates them through the fluctuation--dissipation relation. A Hubbard--Stratonovich representation turns the noise kernel into a Gaussian source driving the resolved metric and worldline. For a leading post-Newtonian Schwarzschild binary, direct and metric-mediated stochastic forces combine into the complete relative-acceleration noise at this order, preserve center-of-mass momentum balance, and remain Planck suppressed. The same noise kernel gives the quadrupolar decoherence functional for a supported spatial superposition and reproduces the Danielson--Satishchandran--Wald horizon-induced scaling after absorptive matching. Away from thermal equilibrium, response and noise remain independent matching data. We discuss extensions to microscopic quantum structure in the worldline kernels, matching to spatially extended coarse-grained descriptions, and gravitational splitting.

</details>


### [371] [Quantum field theory with scale-dependent weighted measures: nonlinear momentum representations, vacuum fluctuations, and causal structure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39285)
*S. González-Salud,R. Cartas-Fuentevilla*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 本文通过动量空间加权测度重构自由量子场，引入独立能标以在低动量恢复常规理论，并以无量纲谱函数刻画该场族，涵盖与Euclidean Snyder代数相关的空间权重情形。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 常规自由量子场构造缺乏可调能标与谱权重自由度，难以统一描述修正色散关系与非线性动量坐标等推广框架，故需借助动量空间加权测度建立更具一般性的场构造。

Method: 以动量空间加权测度构造自由量子场，引入独立能标与无量纲谱函数，并定义基于类时四速的观察者协变谱权重；对复Klein-Gordon场推导等时代数、守恒加权可观测量、真空涨落及任意空间维度的两点函数。

Result: 建立了该场族两点函数有限性的紫外条件，并借助普通Pauli-Jordan分布的空间卷积刻画其非局域因果结构；同时给出一个示意性相互作用推广及核与振幅的数值曲线。

Conclusion: 动量空间加权测度为推广自由量子场提供了系统框架，可在保持低动量常规极限的同时容纳修正色散关系与非局域因果性，并为相互作用情形提供可延展的出发点。

Abstract: We reconsider the construction of free quantum fields through momentum-space weighted measures, introducing an independent energy scale that restores the conventional theory at low momenta. The resulting family is characterized by a dimensionless spectral function and includes, as a distinguished case, the spatial weight associated with the Euclidean Snyder algebra. We discuss its relation to modified dispersion relations and nonlinear momentum coordinates, and introduce an observer-covariant spectral weight defined using a timelike four-velocity. For the complex Klein-Gordon field we obtain the equal-time algebra, conserved weighted observables, vacuum fluctuations, and two-point functions in arbitrary spatial dimension. The ultraviolet conditions for their finiteness are established, and the nonlocal causal structure is analyzed in terms of a spatial convolution of the ordinary Pauli-Jordan distribution. An illustrative interacting extension and numerical profiles of the kernels and amplitudes are also presented.

</details>


### [372] [Does SO(2,2) symmetry lead to an additional U(1) symmetry in 5-dimensional Einstein-scalar theories?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39400)
*Saeedeh Sadeghian*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 该文利用李对称方法研究五维含标量场爱因斯坦方程，构造出同时依赖 θ 与 ψ 坐标的解，从而对文献中关于额外 U(1) 对称性（进而轴对�称解唯一性）的猜想提出反例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维含物质场爱因斯坦方程计算困难，对称性可简化求解；四维及更高维极端黑洞近视界几何存在 SO(2,2) 对称性，已有工作对含标量与 Maxwell 场的解进行分类。但五维含标量场情形下 SO(2,2) 对称群不足以保证解的唯一性，额外 U(1) 对称性仅为猜想，需要检验。

Method: 采用求解偏微分方程的李对称方法（Lie symmetry method），分析五维含标量场理论的爱因斯坦方程，考察 SO(2,2) 对称性所允许的解空间结构。

Result: 找到了一个同时依赖于 θ 和 ψ 两个坐标的解，作为该猜想的反例，从而对 Sadeghian:2014 中额外 U(1) 对称性的猜想提出质疑。

Conclusion: 五维含标量场情形下，SO(2,2) 对称性并不必然导出额外 U(1) 对称性与轴对�称解的唯一性；标量场的存在使解空间更丰富，原猜想不成立。

Abstract: Solving Einstein equations including the matter fields in dimensions higher than four is computationally challenging. However, the existence of symmetries facilitates these calculations. Among these symmetries, we can mention the SO(2,2) symmetry that arises in the near-horizon geometries of extremal black holes with vanishing horizon area in four dimensions \cite{EVH/CFT} and higher dimensions \cite{Sadeghian:2015}. Solutions of Einstein theories including scalar and Maxwell fields with SO(2,2) symmetry have been classified in four, five, and higher dimensions \cite{Sadeghian:2014}. For the Einstein-Maxwell-Lambda theory, a theorem states that SO(2,2) symmetry leads to an additional U(1) symmetry and therefore unique axisymmetric solutions. Nevertheless, in the presence of a scalar field, this symmetry group is not large enough in five dimensions to guarantee solution uniqueness, and the additional U(1) symmetry remains a conjecture in \cite{Sadeghian:2014}. Here, we study the Einstein equations of theories with a five-dimensional scalar field using the Lie symmetry method for solving partial differential equations. We challenge the conjecture in \cite{Sadeghian:2014} and find a solution that depends on both $θ$ and $ψ$ coordinates as a counterexample to that conjecture.

</details>


### [373] [Absorption of bound supernova axion-like particles by the neutron star weakens the heating limits on their photon coupling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39402)
*Probit J Kalita,Subha Mitra,Bharat Kumar*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 该文重新审视由核心坍缩超新星（core-collapse supernova）产生、被新生中子星束缚的类轴子粒子（axion-like particles, ALPs）云对老年中子星的加热限制，指出前人工作忽略了束缚ALP被星体吸收的关键效应。结果表明冷星中的逆核子轫致辐射（inverse nucleon bremsstrahlung）会迅速吸收轨道进入星体的ALP，大幅削弱加热贡献，并据此重新给出PSR J2144$-$3933对ALP-光子耦合的排除窗口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Bose、Ganguly、Kumar 与 Raj（arXiv:2610.30255）提出束缚ALP云衰变产生的光子可再加热老年中子星，并由此导出强限制；但该工作忽略了星体对ALP的吸收。本文旨在评估吸收对原限制及排除参数窗口的影响。

Method: 自行计算原中子星（protoneutron-star）演化、ALP产生、广义相对论轨道（general-relativistic orbits）与吸收过程；对12种原中子星演化、3种归一化到相同超新星轻ALP能量损失的核子轫致辐射率，以及含与不含$Δ(1232)$同质异能素（isobars）的状态方程（equation of state）进行扫描。

Result: 轨道进入星体（至50 km）的束缚ALP约在数分钟内被吸收，远早于其衰变；仅诞生于末态星体外、近圆轨道上的ALP得以存活，仅贡献$9\times 10^{-9}-6\times 10^{-5}$的加热。PSR J2144$-$3933仍排除$m_a\simeq 7.7-196$ MeV的窗口，其光子耦合下边界比无吸收情形高280-700倍；引入π介子转换（pion conversion）与$Δ(1232)$共振后窗口扩展至$m_a\simeq 7.7-260$ MeV。

Conclusion: 该排除窗口对轫致辐射率与末态星体半径有相当程度的依赖；其成立要求直接光子耦合抵消由ALP-π介子混合（ALP-pion mixing）诱导的耦合，且现有超新星伽马射线限制可能已覆盖该窗口。

Abstract: Axion-like particles (ALPs) that couple to protons are produced in a core-collapse supernova, and the slow ones remain bound to the new neutron star. Bose, Ganguly, Kumar, and Raj [arXiv:2610.30255] proposed that the photons from the decay of this bound cloud reheat old neutron stars, and they derived strong limits on the ALP-photon coupling. They neglected the absorption of the ALPs by the star, but a bound ALP on an orbit that enters the star and reaches 50 km crosses it about $6\times 10^{18}$ times over the 333 Myr age of PSR J2144$-$3933. We show that inverse nucleon bremsstrahlung in the cold star absorbs every ALP whose orbit enters it within minutes, long before it decays, so only ALPs born outside the final star on nearly circular orbits survive; they carry $9\times 10^{-9} - 6\times 10^{-5}$ of the heating. We compute the protoneutron-star evolution, the production, the general-relativistic orbits and the absorption ourselves, for twelve protoneutron-star evolutions, three nucleon-bremsstrahlung rates normalized to the same supernova energy loss of light ALPs, and equations of state with and without $Δ(1232)$ isobars. PSR J2144$-$3933 still excludes a window at $m_a\simeq 7.7-196$\ MeV, with a lower edge in the photon coupling $280-700$ times higher than without absorption. Pion conversion and the $Δ(1232)$ resonance, which raise the production of surviving ALPs more than their absorption, widen this window to $m_a\simeq$ $7.7-260$\ MeV. The window depends at similar levels on the bremsstrahlung rate and on the radius of the final star. It requires a direct photon coupling that cancels the one induced by ALP-pion mixing, and existing supernova gamma-ray limits may already cover it.

</details>


### [374] [Carrollian CFTs and the Light Front](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39450)
*Arjun Bagchi,Kinjal Banerjee,Sourish Banerjee,Meghaa AK*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 本文利用四维庞加莱代数与三维共形 Carroll 代数的同构，将光前物理与 Carrollian 共形场论建立联系，构造可对接有质量体散射的新表示，并计算两点函数、给出三维 Carroll CFT 与渐近平坦时空中四维光前理论之间的映射。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Carrollian 对称性在构造渐近平坦时空（asymptotically flat spacetimes, AFS）全息对偶中至关重要，其基础是 AFS 渐近等距群与共形 Carroll 代数（conformal Carroll algebra）的同构；同时 Carroll 对称性也自然出现在光前（lightfront）上，作为光锥坐标下庞加莱代数（Poincare algebra）的余维一子代数。作者希望借此把光前物理与 Carrollian CFT 联系起来。

Method: 基于四维庞加莱代数与三维共形 Carroll 代数之间的同构关系，并借助光前文献中的洞见，构造与有质量体散射（massive bulk scattering）相衔接的 Carroll CFT 新表示，进而计算两点函数（two-point functions）。

Result: 构造出新的 Carroll CFT 表示，其与有质量体散射相关联；给出两点函数的计算结果，并建立了三维 Carroll CFT 与生活在 AFS 中的四维光前理论之间的映射。

Conclusion: 三维共形 Carroll 场论可作为描述 AFS 中四维光前理论的对偶框架，为连接 Carrollian 全息与光前物理提供了具体对应关系。

Abstract: Carrollian symmetries play an important role in building holographic duals to asymptotically flat spacetimes (AFS). This construction hinges on the isomorphism between the (asymptotic) isometries of AFS and the conformal Carroll algebra. Carroll symmetries also naturally arise on the lightfront, as co-dimension one subalgebras in the Poincare algebra written in lightcone coordinates. In this paper, building on the isomorphism between four dimensional (4d) Poincare and 3d conformal Carroll algebras, we make a connection between physics on the lightfront and Carrollian CFTs. Using insights from the lightfront literature, we construct new representations of Carroll CFTs that connect to massive bulk scattering. We compute two-point functions and build a map between 3d Carroll CFTs and 4d lightfront theories living in AFS.

</details>


### [375] [Large-$N$ limit of chiral quiver theories: free energy, supersymmetric indices and operator counting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39569)
*Edoardo Colombo,Hyojoong Kim,Nakwoo Kim,Hoseob Shin*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 该工作首次给出具有 M 理论对偶的手征 N=2 Chern-Simons-matter 理论在 S^3 上自由能的大 N 鞍点方程解析解，证实其 N^{3/2} 标度并与全息预言精确吻合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前矩阵模型中的长程力与大 N 下预期的 N^{3/2} 标度存在长期张力，缺乏解析解来澄清该问题，且算子计数方法（operator counting method）的猜想主要局限于非手征箭图。

Method: 针对对偶于 AdS_4×Q^{1,1,1}/Z_k 的手征箭图（chiral quiver），解析求解大 N 鞍点方程（large-N saddle point equations），并辅以多组 R-荷分配下的有限 N 数值分析。

Result: 证明矩阵模型的长程力在大 N 下相互抵消，所得自由能对所有试探 R-荷（trial R-charges）分配均精确匹配全息预言，并与算子计数方法的预测一致。

Conclusion: 结果可推广至 S^2×S^1 上的超共形指标与拓扑扭曲指标（其大 N 与 Cardy 极限由同一鞍点决定），并为算子计数猜想在手征箭图情形提供了强证据。

Abstract: We find the first analytic solution to the large-$N$ saddle point equations for the $S^3$ free energy of a chiral $\mathcal N=2$ Chern-Simons-matter theory with an M-theory dual. Focusing on the chiral quiver dual to AdS$_4\times Q^{1,1,1}/\mathbb Z_{\rm k}$, we show how the long-range forces of the matrix model cancel at large $N$, resolving a long-standing tension with the expected $N^{3/2}$ scaling. The resulting free energy precisely matches the holographic prediction for all assignments of trial R-charges. Our results extend to the superconformal and topologically twisted indices on $S^2\times S^1$, whose large-$N$ and Cardy limit is determined by the same saddle. The solution agrees with the predictions of the operator counting method, giving strong evidence for this conjecture beyond non-chiral quivers. We support the analytic solution with a finite-$N$ numerical analysis for multiple assignments of R-charges, extending recent numerical results obtained for this quiver.

</details>


### [376] [Superstring Field Theory with Double Background Independence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39594)
*Chris Hull*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 该摘要提出一种对称化的超弦场论（superstring field theory）作用量形式，将物理超弦与“影子”超弦扇区统一描述，并推广到两个扇区可围绕不同背景共形场论（conformal field theory）展开的情形。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期构造的超弦场论包含物理超弦与一个含第二份超弦的影子扇区（shadow sector）两个解耦部分，且二者共享同一背景；需要一个能显式体现两扇区对称性的作用量表述，并进一步推广至两扇区背景可不同的情形。

Method: 给出一种在两个扇区之间对称的作用量（action）形式；随后构造推广版本，使两个扇区分别围绕两个不同的背景共形场论展开，并要求理论对两个背景共形场论各自的边缘形变（marginal deformation）分别保持独立。

Result: 所提出的对称作用量形式涵盖原有两个解耦扇区且保持对共同背景边缘形变的不变性；推广后的理论允许两扇区在不同背景下展开，并对各自的边缘形变分别独立。

Conclusion: 该工作为超弦场论提供了两扇区对称的表述，并扩展至双背景情形，为研究影子扇区与背景形变的独立性提供了框架。

Abstract: A recently constructed superstring field theory has two decoupled sectors, the physical superstring and a shadow sector with a second copy of the superstring. These are both expanded around the same background conformal field theory and the theory is independent of marginal deformations of this common background. A form of the action is presented that is symmetric between the two sectors. A generalisation of this theory is given in which the two sectors can be expanded around two different backgrounds, and the theory is independent under separate marginal deformations of the two background conformal field theories.

</details>


### [377] [Majorana Neutrino Physics and Matter-Antimatter Asymmetry in Type IIA String Theory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39804)
*Yang Liu*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 该文在Type IIA弦论的交错D6膜模型（intersecting D6-branes）中，通过具有Sp(2) Chan-Paton对称性的欧几里得D2瞬子（Euclidean D2-instantons）同时生成seesaw机制与Weinberg算符，从而在存在性证明层面联系马约拉纳中微子质量与物质-反物质不对称。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目标是研究弦论框架下马约拉纳中微子质量（Majorana neutrino masses）与物质-反物质不对称（matter-antimatter asymmetry）能否在同一模型中统一描述。

Method: 采用T^6/(Z2×Z2) orientifold上的Type IIA弦论与交错D6膜构造；味向量（flavour vectors）并非由紧致化计算得到，而是通过匹配（matching）固定，因此结果属于存在性证明（existence proof）。同时用Swampland判据约束瞬子作用量与再加热温度（reheating temperature）。

Result: 与实测质量平方差匹配后，选出seesaw主导且为正序（normal ordering）的情形。一个基准算例（benchmark example）可复现中微子参数，给出η_B≈8.6×10^{-11}（与观测值相差一个数量级以内），并预言⟨m_ββ⟩=2.594 meV。参数扫描（parameter scan）表明质量层级是被容纳（accommodated）而非被预言。

Conclusion: D2瞬子在弦论中可同时实现seesaw机制与Weinberg算符并给出接近观测的重子不对称，但质量层级缺乏预言能力，结论限于存在性证明层面。

Abstract: We study Majorana neutrino masses and the matter-antimatter asymmetry in Type IIA string theory on a $T^6/(\mathbb{Z}_2 \times \mathbb{Z}_2)$ orientifold with intersecting D6-branes. Euclidean D2-instantons with $\text{Sp}(2)$ Chan-Paton symmetry generate both the seesaw mechanism and the Weinberg operator. The flavour vectors are not computed from a compactification but fixed by matching, so our results are an existence proof. Matching the measured mass-squared differences selects the seesaw-dominated case with normal ordering. Swampland criteria constrain the instanton action and the reheating temperature. A benchmark example reproduces the neutrino parameters, gives $η_B \approx 8.6 \times 10^{-11}$, within an order of magnitude of observation, and predicts $\langle m_{ββ} \rangle =2.594 \text{meV}$. A parameter scan shows the mass hierarchy is accommodated rather than predicted.

</details>


### [378] [On functional classes in higher-spin theory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39851)
*Yu. A. Tatarenko*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 该文研究 $d$ 维 Vasiliev 理论（Vasiliev theory）中关于理想（ideal）的因子化（factorization），通过精确刻画高阶自旋代数（higher-spin algebra）$\mathcal{A}$ 及其扭曲伴随模（twisted adjoint module）$\mathcal{A}^{tw}$ 作为函数空间的性质，给出自由层级（free-level）因子化的适定条件，并讨论了其与局域性（locality）问题的关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在 Vasiliev 理论中对理想作因子化需要准确描述高阶自旋代数及其扭曲伴随模的函数空间结构；此前 Soloviev 已考察了 $\mathcal{A}$ 情形的类似函数空间，而 $\mathcal{A}^{tw}$ 及相应的因子化程序仍需系统化。

Method: 要求 $\mathcal{A}$ 在 Moyal 星积（Moyal star product）作用下封闭，$\mathcal{A}^{tw}$ 构成星积 $\mathcal{A}$-模（star-product $\mathcal{A}$-module），并附加若干辅助条件，从而导出适定的自由层级因子化程序；对可容许函数（admissible functions）给出简洁的代数形式的条件。

Result: 在可容许函数条件具有简单代数形式；所得函数类与 Vasiliev 理论中局域性问题的关系得到讨论，并观察到某些非局域（non-local）表达式因 $\mathcal{A}^{tw}$ 的性质而发散，而自旋局域（spin-local）表达式则良定义。

Conclusion: 通过 $\mathcal{A}$ 的星积封闭性与 $\mathcal{A}^{tw}$ 的模结构等条件，可获得定义良好的自由层级因子化，所得函数类可用于分析 Vasiliev 理论中的局域性问题，并区分自旋局域与非局域表达式的行为。

Abstract: The factorization over the ideal in the $d$-dimensional Vasiliev theory requires an accurate description of the higher-spin algebra $\mathcal{A}$ and its twisted adjoint module $\mathcal{A}^{tw}$ as certain functional spaces. It is shown that the conditions of $\mathcal{A}$ to be closed under action of the Moyal star product, and of $\mathcal{A}^{tw}$ to be a star-product $\mathcal{A}$-module along with some auxiliary conditions lead to properly defined free-level factorization procedure. The conditions on admissible functions have simple algebraic form; in the case of $\mathcal{A}$ the analogous functional space has been considered by Soloviev \cite{Soloviev:2013iba}. The relation of the obtained functional classes to the locality problem in the Vasiliev theory is discussed. In particular it is observed that certain non-local expressions diverge due to properties of $\mathcal{A}^{tw}$ while the spin-local expressions are well-defined.

</details>


### [379] [Initial conditions leave IR imprints in quantum cosmology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39965)
*Manishankar Ailiga,Akash Mondal,Gaurav Narain*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 本文研究洛伦兹号差下 $\mathbb{R} \times S^3$ 几何的引力路径积分（gravitational path integral），引入无穷族协变边界作用量（covariant boundary actions），参数化为 $c$ 与 $\omega$，并在一圈阶（one-loop）计算宇宙波函数，讨论其对紫外（UV）与红外（IR）行为的调控作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标度因子（scale factor）的边界要求需通过边界作用量实现，但涨落场（fluctuation field）的边界行为不能被任意选取，故有必要考察无穷族协变边界作用量对宇宙波函数的具体影响。

Method: 将度规构型用 lapse、标度因子与涨落刻画并以 Einstein-Hilbert 作用量的指数加权；由路径积分中初始动量的主导贡献把 $\omega$ 限制为半整数，得到依赖 $c$ 的共轭动量族；再在相关 lapse 鞍点（lapse-saddles）上分离 UV 发散，系统性计算一圈波函数，并加入抵消项（counterterms）。

Result: 固定 $\omega$ 时出现四支依赖 $c$ 的主导共轭动量分支：两支对应 de Sitter，一支对应 Hartle-Hawking，一支对应隧穿宇宙（tunnelling Universe）；所有分支的 lapse 鞍点均适用，但仅一个 de Sitter 鞍点与 Hartle-Hawking 鞍点的微扰行为良好。协变边界参数 $c$ 可充当 UV 调节器（UV-regulator），并使 dS 鞍点的一圈行列式极点偏离实 $q_f$ 轴（$q_f$ 为宇宙最终尺度）。

Conclusion: 通过加入适当的抵消项可获得无边界（no-boundary）与 dS 情形下 UV 有限的波函数；其红外行为不仅展现 IR 发散，还对初始边界选择具有敏感性。

Abstract: We investigate the gravitational path integral of $\mathbb{R} \times S^3$ geometries in Lorentzian signature along with the metric fluctuations which live on the $S^3$ hypersurfaces. Each metric configuration is characterised by lapse, scale factor and fluctuations, and is weighted by the exponential of the Einstein-Hilbert action. A particular boundary requirement for the scale-factor is achievable via an infinite family of covariant boundary actions, each restricting the boundary behaviour of the fluctuation field which cannot be arbitrarily chosen. The paper explores the effect of this infinite family of covariant boundary actions on the wavefunction of Universe to one-loop. These boundary actions are characterized by parameters $c$ and $ω$. Dominant contribution of initial momentum in the path-integral restricts $ω$ to be half-integer, leading to an infinite family of $c$-dependent conjugate momenta. In special case for fixed $ω$, four such $c$-dependent dominant branches of conjugate momenta emerge: two lead to deSitter, one leads to Hartle-Hawking and one to the tunnelling Universe. For all these $c$-dependent initial conjugate momenta, the lapse-saddles are relevant, however only, one of deSitter saddle and Hartle Hawking saddle have well-behaved perturbations. The one-loop wavefunction at these well-behaved saddles is computed systematically by isolating the UV-divergences, where the covariant boundary parameter $c$ acts as a UV-regulator and also helps in shifting the poles of one-loop determinant, away from the real $q_f$ axis for dS saddles, where $q_f$ is the final size of the Universe. UV-finite wavefunction for no-boundary and dS is obtained by adding suitable counterterms. The infrared behaviour of these wavefunctions show not only IR-divergences but also sensitivity toward the initial boundary choices.

</details>


### [380] [The Effective Kerr-Compton Tree Amplitude from Black Hole Perturbation Theory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40101)
*N. Emil J. Bjerrum-Bohr,Gang Chen,Konstantinos Papadimos,Nabha Shah,Chenliang Su*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 该文提出一种在后闵可夫斯基有效场论（post-Minkowskian effective field theory）框架下构造引力波被Kerr黑洞散射的树级Compton振幅（tree-level Compton amplitude）的新方法，利用黑洞微扰论（black hole perturbation theory）的波散射函数唯一确定接触项（contact terms），并给出自旋六阶的显式结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前计算依赖振幅的物理自洽性来确定接触项，缺乏系统化的构造手段；本文旨在建立一种可靠方法，以唯一确定Kerr黑洞引力波散射Compton振幅所需的附加接触项。

Method: 基于黑洞微扰论中的波散射函数（wave scattering functions）来确定额外接触项，并以迭代程序（iterative procedure）逐阶构造树级Compton振幅，推导至自旋六阶的显式表达式。

Result: 得到自旋六阶以内的显式振幅，包含自旋五阶与六阶此前未知的部分；振幅呈现复杂的超越结构（transcendental structures），并在自旋六阶出现一个领头耗散接触项（leading dissipative contact term）。

Conclusion: 结果与文献中已知结果相符，并成功重现了黑洞微扰论给出的一圈尾巴结果（one-loop tail result），验证了该方法的正确性与自洽性。

Abstract: We develop a new method to construct the tree-level Compton amplitude for gravitational-wave scattering off a Kerr black hole in post-Minkowskian effective field theory. Building on previous computations that required physical consistency of the amplitude, the method uses wave scattering functions from black hole perturbation theory to uniquely determine additional contact terms. We illustrate the iterative procedure by deriving explicit expressions up to sixth order in spin, including previously unknown sectors at the fifth and sixth orders in spin. The amplitude features complex transcendental structures and a leading dissipative contact term at sixth order in spin. We verify our result against known results in the literature and reproduce the one-loop tail result from black hole perturbation theory.

</details>


### [381] [$\mathcal{N}=4$ Super Yang-Mills Flux Tube in AdS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40156)
*Victor Gorbenko,Orr Sela,Brian R. Zielazienski*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 本文在AdS₄中的N=4超杨-米尔斯理论边界上研究超对称威尔逊线，将其作为连接全息弦与禁闭流管的模型，通过弱/强耦合谱与超共形指数的对比，提出两类算符的映射。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边界破坏了四维共形对称性并预期消除可积性，使该系统更接近禁闭弦，同时保留足够超对称以约束动力学，从而为研究禁闭规范理论中的谱重组提供非可积模型。

Method: 在平面极限（planar limit）下分析缺陷谱（defect spectrum）的弱耦合与强耦合行为，并计算超共形指数（superconformal index），将微扰规范理论描述与长全息弦的世界面激发（worldsheet excitations）相联系。

Result: 基于互补视角，提出了弱/强耦合两种区域间算符的映射，其中世界面轴子（worldsheet axion）在强耦合下成为两粒子态；结果支持从指数增长的规范理论谱到弦世界面的Cardy型谱的平滑过渡。

Conclusion: 该体系提供了一个非可积的超对称模型，可用于研究禁闭规范理论中预期的谱重组（spectral reorganization），并在全息弦与禁闭流管之间建立了定量联系。

Abstract: We study a supersymmetric Wilson line on the boundary of $\mathcal{N}=4$ super Yang-Mills theory in AdS$_4$, or equivalently on a half-space, as a model for exploring the connection between holographic strings and confining flux tubes. The boundary breaks four-dimensional conformal symmetry and is expected to remove integrability, bringing this system closer to a confining string while preserving enough supersymmetry to constrain its dynamics. Working in the planar limit, we analyze the defect spectrum at weak and strong coupling and compute the superconformal index, thereby relating the perturbative gauge-theory description to the worldsheet excitations of a long holographic string. These complementary perspectives allow us to propose a map between operators in the two regimes, under which the worldsheet axion, in particular, becomes a two-particle state at strong coupling. The resulting picture supports a smooth interpolation from an exponentially growing gauge-theory spectrum to the Cardy-like spectrum of a string worldsheet, providing a non-integrable supersymmetric model for investigating the spectral reorganization expected in confining gauge theories.

</details>


### [382] [A density calculus for quantum field theory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40174)
*Tanay Kibe,Pratik Roy*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 本文为量子场论研究者提供 Haagerup 非交换 $L^p$ 空间的入门讲解，说明如何在无内禀迹的 type III 局部可观测量代数上重建密度矩阵、分数幂与 Schatten 范数演算，并给出手征流相干激发下 sandwiched Rényi 散度的具体计算。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子场论中的局部可观测量代数通常为 type III 型，缺乏内禀迹（intrinsic trace），使密度矩阵、分数幂与 Schatten 范数等熟悉的运算无法直接定义，需要引入 Haagerup 非交换 $L^p$ 空间作为替代框架。

Method: 先在矩阵代数上显式构造交叉积（crossed product）、其迹与对偶作用（dual action），再推广到一般冯诺依曼代数（von Neumann algebra）；重点讨论正规态（normal states）的 Haagerup 密度表示，以及交叉积迹与用于计算期望值的典范 Haagerup 泛函之间的区别。

Result: 作为具体应用，计算了手征流（chiral current）相干激发下的 sandwiched Rényi 散度（Rényi divergence），验证了其在限制下的单调性（monotonicity），并对所有实数阶 $α>1$ 验证了 Rényi 量子零能量条件（Rényi quantum null energy condition）。

Conclusion: 该讲义以量子力学与初等量子场论为基础，系统引入构造与计算所需的算子代数概念，表明 Haagerup $L^p$ 框架可将密度矩阵演算有效延拓至 type III 代数并支持具体的散度与能量条件计算。

Abstract: These notes provide an introduction to Haagerup noncommutative $L^p$ spaces for quantum field theorists. The aim is to explain how the familiar calculus of density matrices, fractional powers, and Schatten norms extends to local observable algebras of type~III, where an intrinsic trace is unavailable. We develop the construction first for a matrix algebra, making the crossed product, its trace, and the dual action explicit, before passing to general von Neumann algebras. Particular attention is paid to the representation of normal states by Haagerup densities and to the distinction between the crossed-product trace and the canonical Haagerup functional used to compute expectation values. As a concrete application, we calculate the sandwiched Rényi divergence for a coherent excitation of a chiral current, verifying monotonicity under restriction and the Rényi quantum null energy condition at every real order $α>1$.
