The presentation assumes familiarity with quantum mechanics and elementary quantum field theory, while introducing the operator-algebraic concepts needed for the construction and calculation.

</details>


### [383] [Quantum curves of 6d SCFTs on a -3 curve](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40203)
*Minsung Kim,Sung-Soo Kim,Xin Wang*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 该论文研究6维N=(1,0)超共形场论在负三曲线上半BPS缺陷与量子Seiberg-Witten曲线，利用广义blowup方程计算R^4×T^2上的缺陷配分函数，并提出以椭圆差分方程刻画其Nekrasov-Shatashvili极限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动机在于将量子Seiberg-Witten曲线与半BPS缺陷的研究拓展到6维N=(1,0)超共形场论在特定曲线上的紧化情形，以理解缺陷配分函数与量子可积结构之间的关系。

Method: 采用广义blowup方程（generalized blowup equations）计算R^4×T^2上含余维4与余维2缺陷的配分函数，并提出量子Seiberg-Witten曲线（quantum Seiberg-Witten curves）作为缺陷配分函数Nekrasov-Shatashvili极限所满足的椭圆差分方程（elliptic difference equations）。

Result: 该构造应用于最小su(3)规范理论，以及以最小su(3)理论为端点的Higgsing树（Higgsing tree）上的g_2与so(N)规范理论；并进一步考察了带Z_2扭曲（Z_2 twist）圆周紧化的su(3)规范理论的缺陷与量子曲线。

Conclusion: 研究给出了6维N=(1,0)超共形场论中缺陷配分函数与量子曲线的统一构造，并表明该方法可推广至多类规范理论及带扭曲的圆周紧化情形。

Abstract: We study half-BPS defects and quantum Seiberg-Witten curves in 6d $ \mathcal{N}=(1,0) $ SCFTs on a $ -3 $ curve. We compute the partition functions in the presence of codimension-4 and codimension-2 defects on $ \mathbb{R}^4 \times T^2 $ using generalized blowup equations. We then propose quantum Seiberg-Witten curves as elliptic difference equations satisfied by the Nekrasov-Shatashvili limits of the defect partition functions. We apply this construction to the minimal $ \mathfrak{su}(3) $ gauge theory, and to the $ \mathfrak{g}_2 $ and $ \mathfrak{so}(N) $ gauge theories on a Higgsing tree whose endpoint is the minimal $ \mathfrak{su}(3) $ theory. We also investigate defects and the quantum curve of the $ \mathfrak{su}(3) $ gauge theory compactified on a circle with a $ \mathbb{Z}_2 $ twist.

</details>


### [384] [Competition and coexistence of baryonic condensates in AdS hardwall model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40244)
*Akash Singh*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 在带完整背反应（full backreaction）的五维AdS硬壁模型（hardwall model）中，双夸克（diquark）与双重子（dibaryon）凝聚体并非必然互斥：当双夸克型算符固定为q₁=2、Δ₁=3时，两者仅在Δ₂的狭窄窗口内共存，该窗口随q₂增大而变宽、在算符重合时关闭。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 冷致密QCD（cold dense QCD）存在多种重子数破缺序参量，双夸克与双重子凝聚体是否互斥或共存尚不明确，需在全息框架下系统检验。

Method: 采用五维AdS硬壁模型并包含完整背反应，两个带电标量（dual to 荷为q_i、维度为Δ_i的算符）耦合到共同的U(1)_B规范场；固定双夸克型算符q₁=2、Δ₁=3，扫描Δ₂与q₂。

Result: 两算符仅在一段狭窄的Δ₂窗口内同时凝聚，窗口随q₂增大而展宽，并在两算符重合时消失；窗口之外仅形成单一凝聚。该结构在禁闭相（confined phase）与解禁闭相（deconfined phase）中均存在。在μ_B–T平面中，低温下双凝聚的禁闭物质更受偏好，其上方为狭窄的单凝聚解禁闭物质带。

Conclusion: 双夸克与双重子凝聚体可以共存，但共存受算符维度与电荷的严格限制；相结构对禁闭—解禁闭转变具有一定鲁棒性，并给出一幅低温双凝聚、上方单凝聚的μ_B–T相图。

Abstract: Cold dense QCD admits several order parameters for baryon-number breaking, among them diquark and dibaryon condensates. We ask whether they exclude one another or coexist, using a five-dimensional AdS hardwall model with full backreaction in which two charged scalars, dual to operators of charges $q_i$ and dimensions $Δ_i$, couple to a common $U(1)_B$ gauge field. With the diquark-like operator fixed at $q_1=2$, $Δ_1=3$, both operators condense only within a narrow window of $Δ_2$, which widens with $q_2$ and closes when the operators coincide. Outside the window, only a single condensate forms. The structure persists in both confined and deconfined phases. In the $μ_B$-$T$ plane, confined matter with both condensates is preferred at low temperature, below a narrow band of deconfined matter with one condensate.

</details>


### [385] [$\mathcal{N}=2$ conformal higher-spin actions in harmonic superspace](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40274)
*Evgeny Ivanov,Nikita Zaigraev*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 该文在调和超空间（harmonic superspace）中构造了线性化四维 $\mathcal{N}=2$ Weyl 型离壳作用量，用于描述超共形高自旋规范多重态；其prepotential与变换由Grassmann调和解析性原理决定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有关于超共形高自旋规范多重态的定义，但缺乏相应的离壳作用量表述；此前的类似构造仅完成于共形 $\mathcal{N}=2$ 超引力情形，需推广至高自旋情形并探索非线性推广的可能性。

Method: 在调和超空间（harmonic superspace）中构建线性化 $4D$、$\mathcal{N}=2$ Weyl 型离壳作用量；利用Grassmann调和解析性（Grassmann harmonic analyticity）原理确定prepotential结构及其规范与超共形变换，并借助Grassmann半解析性（Grassmann half-analyticity）原理构造不变作用量与广义 $\mathcal{N}=2$ 超Weyl张量。

Result: 验证了新作用量的超共形不变性与线性化规范不变性；在任意 $\mathcal{N}=2$ 超引力背景推广中表明，若不对规范变换律与调和零曲率方程作根本修改，线性化自旋-$s$规范不变性仅与 $\mathcal{N}=2$ Weyl 平坦超背景（Weyl-flat super-backgrounds）相容。

Conclusion: 该工作为线性化 $\mathcal{N}=2$ 超共形规范高自旋理论提供了新的几何框架，并提示了提升至完全非线性层次的可能途径。

Abstract: We construct linearized $4D, \mathcal{N}=2$ Weyl-type off-shell actions in harmonic superspace for the superconformal higher-spin gauge multiplets introduced in arXiv:2404.19016. This work is a followup of our arXiv:2511.16325, where an analogous construction was carried out for conformal $\mathcal{N}=2$ supergravity. We check the superconformal invariance of the new actions and their linearized gauge invariance. As the characteristic features of our formulation, the structure of the underlying prepotentials and their gauge and superconformal transformations are entirely determined by the fundamental \textit{principle of Grassmann harmonic analyticity}, while the construction of the invariant actions and of the generalized $\mathcal{N}=2$ super-Weyl tensors relies upon the \textit{principle of Grassmann half-analyticity}. This provides not only a new geometric framework for the linearized $\mathcal{N}=2$ superconformal gauge higher-spin theories, but also suggests possible ways of promoting them to the full nonlinear level. We consider a generalization to an arbitrary $\mathcal{N}=2$ supergravity background and show that the linearized spin-$\mathbf{s}$ gauge invariance, without radical modifications of the gauge transformation law and/or harmonic zero-curvature equations, is consistent only with $\mathcal{N}=2$ Weyl-flat super-backgrounds.

</details>


### [386] [Bounds on the Diagonal Degree of the Biadjoint Scalar Amplitude Matrix](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40355)
*Freddy Cachazo,Rajbir Longia*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 该论文研究双伴随标量理论（biadjoint scalar theory）部分振幅矩阵 $M_n$ 的最大非奇异对角子矩阵规模，证明其“对角度（diagonal degree）”$\\Delta_n$ 相对 CHY 秩 $(n-3)!$ 呈指数级抑制，从而否定了关于存在临界 $n_c$ 使所有更大 $n$ 均有满秩对角子矩阵的猜想。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在 KLT 关系（KLT construction）中，将引力子振幅（graviton amplitudes）与胶子振幅（gluon amplitudes）联系起来需要用到 $M_n$ 的最大秩可逆子矩阵；为寻找项数最少的 KLT 公式，作者之一提出是否存在临界 $n_c$，使得对所有 $n>n_c$ 都存在秩为 $(n-3)!$ 的对角子矩阵。

Method: 论文针对 $M_n$ 的最大非奇异对角子矩阵规模（即对角度 $\\Delta_n$）给出上界与下界估计，并据此对该临界 $n_c$ 存在问题给出（否定）回答。

Result: 证明对角度相对 CHY 秩呈指数抑制：当 $n\\to\\infty$ 时 $\\Delta_n/(n-3)! = \\exp(-\\Theta(n))$；具体界为 $\\exp(-1.5n)\\leq\\Delta_n/(n-3)!\\leq\\exp[-0.01n+O(1)]$。

Conclusion: 不存在所设想的临界 $n_c$：对角子矩阵无法达到 CHY 满秩，且其相对规模随 $n$ 指数衰减，因此以对角子矩阵为基础的 KLT 构造在渐近意义上受限。

Abstract: Biadjoint scalar theory partial amplitudes, $m_n(α,β)$, define an $(n-1)!/2\times (n-1)!/2$ matrix, $M_n$, with rows and columns labeled by orderings. The CHY construction of $M_n$ implies that its rank is $(n-3)!$. Invertible submatrices of maximal rank enter in the KLT construction relating graviton amplitudes to gluon amplitudes. Motivated by finding the KLT formula with the smallest number of terms, one of the authors posed the question of whether there is a critical $n_c$ such that for all $n>n_c$ there exists a diagonal submatrix of $M_n$ of rank $(n-3)!$. In this work we obtain bounds on the size of the largest non-singular diagonal submatrix of $M_n$, which we call its diagonal degree $Δ_n$, and we answer the question in the negative. We prove that the diagonal degree is exponentially suppressed relative to the CHY rank: $Δ_n/(n-3)! = \exp(-Θ(n))$ as $n\to \infty$. More explicitly, we establish the bounds $\exp(-1.5n)\leqΔ_n/(n-3)!\leq \exp \left[ -0.01n+O(1)\right]$.

</details>


### [387] [Exact holographic superfluid at the Bogomolny point: transport, large charge, and Rényi entropies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40371)
*Siqing Yu*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 在AdS₅探针极限的Abelian Higgs模型中，当标量质量饱和Breitenlohner-Freedman界且四次耦合取Bogomolny值时，凝聚相可在所有具有最大对称空间截面的静态不带电AdS₅背景上以闭式求得，并被证明线性稳定，从而对偶CFT在平面、整体与双曲切片下分别给出不同的闭式结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该模型通常只能数值求解，缺乏解析可控的强耦合超流（superfluid）描述；作者希望借助特殊参数点（BF界与Bogomolny耦合）获得闭式凝聚解，以便精确研究其稳定性及对偶共形场论（conformal field theory）的多种性质。

Method: 采用AdS₅探针极限下的Abelian Higgs模型，令标量质量饱和Breitenlohner-Freedman界、四次耦合取Bogomolny值，在任意静态不带电且空间截面最大对称的AdS₅背景上构造闭式凝聚解，并解析证明其线性稳定性（linear stability），推广至标准量子化下无非负四次耦合、无超流的无节点探针凝聚。

Result: 平面黑膜（planar black brane）上得到所有T<Tc的超流态：超流分数精确遵循Gorter-Casimir双流体定律，声速与声衰减均有闭式表达；整体AdS₅中给出ℝ×S³上电荷Q态（可能为最低能态）及其在所有Q下的标度维度；双曲切片给出计算球带电Rényi熵（Rényi entropy）的黑洞的齐次毛发相，其凝聚在纠缠面上不为零，且当零化学势下由该处插入的算符源激发时，相变恰在Rényi指数为1处出现。

Conclusion: 特殊参数点使探针极限凝聚相可完全解析求解并证明线性稳定，同一解在不同切片上分别刻画超流、ℝ×S³上的低能电荷态以及带电Rényi熵相关黑洞的毛发相；其激发谱包含超流有效理论未覆盖的能塔，来源于探针扇区的红外不动点（infrared fixed point）。

Abstract: The Abelian Higgs model in AdS$_5$, in the probe limit, is a standard holographic model of a strongly coupled superfluid, usually solved numerically. When the scalar mass saturates the Breitenlohner-Freedman bound and the quartic coupling takes the Bogomolny value, its condensed phase can be found in closed form on every static, uncharged AdS$_5$ background with maximally symmetric spatial sections. We prove that it is linearly stable, as is any nodeless probe-limit condensate in the standard quantization with a nonnegative quartic coupling and no superflow. On each slicing it answers a different question about the dual conformal field theory. On the planar black brane it is the superfluid at all temperatures below $T_c$: the superfluid fraction follows the Gorter-Casimir two-fluid law exactly, and the speed and the attenuation of sound are found in closed form. In global AdS$_5$ it describes a state of charge $Q$ on $\mathbb{R}\times S^3$, arguably the lowest-energy one, and gives its scaling dimension in closed form at all $Q$, classically in the bulk. Its excitations include towers that the superfluid effective theory does not describe; they come from an infrared fixed point of the probe sector. The hyperbolic slicing gives in closed form a homogeneous hairy phase of the black holes that compute the charged Rényi entropies of a ball. Its condensate does not vanish at the entangling surface. When sourced by operators inserted there, the phase sets in at Rényi index exactly one at zero chemical potential, as found for a neutral scalar.

</details>


### [388] [Breaking of integrability in elliptic deformations of AdS3 strings with mixed flux](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40386)
*Ian Le Meur,Fiona K. Seibold*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 本文构造了IIB型超引力（type IIB supergravity）中由混合NSNS与RR通量支持的AdS₃×S³×T⁴超弦的椭圆变形（elliptic deformations），并从Lax联络与树级世界面S矩阵两个角度考察其可积性（integrability）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究椭圆型变形下超弦背景是否保持可积性，并厘清NSNS通量、Wess-Zumino项与B场对可积性的影响，尤其针对已有理性（rational）与三角（trigonometric）模型中可积性成立的结论能否推广到椭圆情形。

Method: 在保持8个超对称（supersymmetry）的条件下构建变形背景，其中NSNS部分含Wess-Zumino项，并需引入耦合变形AdS₃与S³因子的B场；通过平坦Lax联络（flat Lax connection）的构造与树级世界面S矩阵（tree-level worldsheet S-matrix）的计算两条途径检验可积性。

Result: 对一般椭圆参数与NSNS通量，得到非弹性（inelastic）的2→2振幅，违反可积性所需的弹性（elasticity）要求；而在Lax分析判定的可积情形中，这些非弹性振幅消失，树级S矩阵满足经典Yang-Baxter方程（classical Yang-Baxter equation）。

Conclusion: Wess-Zumino项在理性与三角模型中保持可积性，但对椭圆变形会破坏可积性；两种判据（Lax联络与S矩阵）对可积情形的识别相互一致。

Abstract: We construct elliptic deformations of the $AdS_3 \times S^3 \times T^4$ superstring supported by mixed NSNS and RR fluxes in type IIB supergravity and investigate their integrability. The NSNS sector includes a Wess-Zumino term, and imposing that the theory preserves 8 supersymmetries also requires the presence of a B-field coupling the deformed $AdS_3$ and $S^3$ factors. We explore integrability from two different perspectives: through the construction of a flat Lax connection and the computation of the tree-level worldsheet S-matrix. For generic elliptic parameters and NSNS flux, we find inelastic $2 \rightarrow 2$ amplitudes, violating the elasticity required by integrability. In the integrable cases as identified by the Lax analysis, these inelastic amplitudes vanish and the tree-level S-matrix satisfies the classical Yang-Baxter equation. In particular, the addition of a Wess-Zumino term, which preserves integrability in the rational and trigonometric models, breaks integrability for elliptic deformations.

</details>


### [389] [Holographic duals of JT gravity at finite cutoff: the classical case](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40391)
*Andreas Belaey,Thomas G. Mertens,Lorenzo Russo,Alex Tarana*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 该文在一阶 BF 表述下构建了带有限截断边界与“世界末端膜”的 JT 引力，并将体模型动力学约化为边界上的一维系统，给出各边界相空间自由度的几何解释及有限截断下全息 Schwarzian 描述的相空间闭式表达。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旨在通过边界一维约化推广既有构造，厘清有限截断边界与世界末端膜对应相空间自由度的几何含义，并借此探测体时空局域性与底层时空结构。

Method: 采用一阶 BF 表述（first-order BF formulation）表述 JT 引力（JT gravity），将 BF 模型动力学约化为边界上的一维系统（one-dimensional system），并结合世界末端膜（end-of-the-world branes）与有限截断边界（finite-cutoff boundaries）进行分析。

Result: 获得了各边界相空间自由度的几何理解，并导出有限截断下 JT 引力全息 Schwarzian 描述（holographic Schwarzian description）在相空间中的闭式表达式；所得自由度描述有限截断曲线在 AdS$_2$ 中的嵌入。

Conclusion: 该框架为研究体局域性与时空结构提供工具，相关系统的量子化（quantization）将在姊妹篇中给出。

Abstract: We formulate JT gravity with finite-cutoff boundaries and end-of-the-world branes in the first-order BF formulation. We dynamically reduce the BF model into a one-dimensional system living at the boundaries, generalizing earlier constructions. We obtain in particular a geometrical understanding of the phase space degrees of freedom associated to each of these boundaries. We leverage these results to probe bulk locality and the underlying structure of spacetime. Within our framework, we are able to derive a closed-form expression for the holographic Schwarzian description of JT gravity at finite-cutoff in phase space. The resulting degrees of freedom describe the embedding of the finite-cutoff curve in AdS$_2$. A quantization of these systems is presented in a companion paper.

</details>


### [390] [A Simplified Born Rule for Cosmological Correlators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40412)
*Fan Zhu*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 该文证明平坦时空中等时 in-in 关联子（in-in correlators）的所有双边界极点（double-boundary poles）在任意图层面均相消，并据此提出以嵌入波函数系数（embedded wavefunction coefficients）表述的简化 Born 规则（simplified Born rule）。对共形耦合 Tr(φ³) 理论，该规则呈现为均匀加权森林切割展开，进而构造出 Born 多面体（Born polytope），其典范函数在匹配物理能量后重现归一化关联子。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 宇宙学关联子（cosmological correlators）是原初宇宙的天然可观测量，经 Born 规则与波函数系数相联系。理解极点结构及其物理起源，有助于厘清哪些极点可同时出现、并显式保留相互作用依赖。

Method: 对平坦时空中等时 in-in 关联子，证明任意图（含局域导数相互作用理论）中双边界极点均相消，且相消发生在空间圈动量（spatial loop momenta）积分之前；由此以嵌入波函数系数重写 Born 规则，并分析极点组合结构。对共形耦合 Tr(φ³) 理论给出均匀加权森林切割展开（forest-cut expansion），据极点组合构造 Born 多面体（Born polytope）。

Result: 双边界极点对所有图完全相消，得到简化的 Born 规则展开，可辨识可共存的物理极点并保持相互作用依赖性显式。Tr(φ³) 情形下展开为均匀加权森林切割形式；Born 多面体的典范函数（canonical function）在将各面支撑（facet supports）匹配至物理能量后，重现任意图的归一化关联子。

Conclusion: 关联子的极点结构可由多面体几何统一刻画，同一几何还给出关联子的弦论式（stringy）公式，表明波函数系数与关联子之间存在更简洁的组合几何表述。

Abstract: Cosmological correlators are natural observables of the primordial universe and are related to wavefunction coefficients by the Born rule. For equal-time in-in correlators in flat spacetime, we prove that all double-boundary poles cancel for arbitrary graphs, including in theories with local derivative interactions. These cancellations occur before integration over spatial loop momenta and yield a $\textit{simplified Born rule}$ in terms of what we call embedded wavefunction coefficients. The resulting expansion reveals which physical poles can occur together while keeping the interaction dependence explicit. For conformally coupled $\operatorname{Tr}(φ^3)$ theory in flat spacetime, the simplified Born rule takes the form of a uniformly weighted forest-cut expansion. From its pole combinatorics, we construct what we call the $\textit{Born polytope}$, whose canonical function reproduces the normalized correlator for arbitrary graphs after matching its facet supports to the physical energies. The same geometry also yields a stringy formula for correlators.

</details>


### [391] [Gravity between two masses beyond Newton's law](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40462)
*Zhengwen Liu,Xing-Bo Yuan*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 该论文在静态引力两体问题（static two-body problem）中，将牛顿常数（Newton's constant）展开推进至第九至第十二阶，并对任意质量比（arbitrary mass ratios）给出首个超越史瓦西试验粒子极限（Schwarzschild test-body limit）的反作用（backreaction）闭式表达。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 广义相对论（general relativity）中引力本身产生引力，两体相互作用需从耦合的时空几何中提取，即便在无运动、无辐射的静态情形下也包含无限层级的场耦合（field couplings），构成解析求解的基本难题。该工作旨在弥合无穷小探针（infinitesimal probe）与可比质量（comparable masses）之间的空白。

Method: 以驻定相互作用能（stationary interaction energy）为核心重构问题：用精确单体背景（one-body background）重整化一个源的自相互作用，利用驻定性（stationarity）约化另一源的场，并通过积分响应恒等式（integrated response identities）揭示耦合模式间的抵消；再以互补展开（complementary expansions）在有限阶上解析完整质量依赖。

Result: 获得任意质量比下牛顿常数第九至第十二阶的静态相互作用，并导出对引力耦合（gravitational coupling）所有阶成立的、超越史瓦西试验粒子极限的首个反作用闭式表达式。

Conclusion: 结果表明爱因斯坦理论内部隐藏着解析上的简洁性（analytical simplicity），并为轨道动力学（orbital dynamics）建模与引力波（gravitational-wave）产生提供基本构件。

Abstract: Newton's law of universal gravitation describes the attraction between two masses through an inverse-distance potential. In Einstein's theory gravity gravitates: each mass reshapes the spacetime geometry through which the other acts. More than a century later, extracting the two-body interaction from this coupled geometry remains a fundamental analytical challenge. Even without motion or radiation, the static sector of the interaction harbours an infinite hierarchy of field couplings: the purest laboratory for gravitational non-linearity. Here we determine the static interaction from ninth to twelfth order in Newton's constant for arbitrary mass ratios, and derive a closed expression for the first backreaction beyond the Schwarzschild test-body limit to all orders in the gravitational coupling. We achieve both advances by formulating the problem around the stationary interaction energy. An exact one-body background resums one source's self-interaction, stationarity reduces the fields required from the other, and integrated response identities reveal cancellations across the coupled modes. Complementary expansions then resolve the complete mass dependence at finite order. Together, these results bridge the gap between an infinitesimal probe and comparable masses, exposing hidden analytical simplicity within Einstein's theory and providing essential building blocks for modelling orbital dynamics and gravitational-wave generation.

</details>


### [392] [Generalised $Ω$-backgrounds in twisted $N=4$ super Yang-Mills](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40465)
*Elisa Iris Marieni,Itamar Yaakov*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 本文引入4维 \(\mathcal{N}=4\) 超杨-米尔斯理论的刚性超引力背景，用于变形其拓扑扭转并推广 \(\mathcal{N}=2\) 规范理论的 \(\Omega\)-形变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究动机是构造能变形4维 \(\mathcal{N}=4\) 超杨-米尔斯理论拓扑扭转（topological twists）的刚性背景，并将 \(\mathcal{N}=2\) 规范理论中已知的 \(\Omega\)-形变（\(\Omega\)-deformation）推广至 \(\mathcal{N}=4\) 情形。

Method: 方法是推导 \(\mathcal{N}=4\) 外尔多重态（Weyl multiplet）以及耦合到刚性玻色背景的 \(\mathcal{N}=4\) 物质多重态（matter multiplet）在三种不等价拓扑扭转下的扭化超对称变分（twisted supersymmetry variations）。

Result: 摘要给出对三种不等价拓扑扭转分别得到相应扭化超对称变分的结果，并提及还讨论了其他更奇异的背景（more exotic backgrounds），但未给出具体计算细节或显式结论。

Conclusion: 刚性超引力背景为变形 \(\mathcal{N}=4\) 超杨-米尔斯的拓扑扭转提供了框架，并构成 \(\mathcal{N}=2\) 中 \(\Omega\)-形变的自然推广；对奇异背景的讨论提示该构造具有进一步扩展空间。

Abstract: We introduce rigid supergravity backgrounds for 4d $\mathcal{N}=4$ super Yang-Mills which deform its topological twists and generalise the $Ω$-deformation of $\mathcal{N}=2$ gauge theories. We derive the twisted supersymmetry variations of the $\mathcal{N}=4$ Weyl multiplet, and the $\mathcal{N}=4$ matter multiplet coupled to a rigid bosonic background, for each of the three inequivalent topological twists. Other, more exotic backgrounds are also discussed.

</details>


### [393] [Localization in Seven-Dimensional Supergravity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40514)
*Florian Gaar,Michèle Levi*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 本文提出将相对等变局部化（relative equivariant localization）方法推广至七维最大卡尔坦规范超引力（maximal Cartan-gauged supergravity），在无需显式解的情况下，通过对辅助八维填充上的单一定点数据进行局部化，直接恢复一般超对称AdS₇黑洞作用量及电荷关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 七维超引力（seven-dimensional supergravity）是通向强耦合六维超共形理论（six-dimensional superconformal theories）的全息窗口，但其旋量双线性几何（spinor-bilinear geometry）与高阶形式动力学（higher-form dynamics）使系统分析与求解格外困难；相对等变局部化可在不显式求解的情况下获取奇数维超对称可观测量，作者希望将其推广到七维。

Method: 在最大卡尔坦规范超引力（maximal Cartan-gauged supergravity）框架下建立欧氏作用量与Killing旋量方程（表达为场强形式），针对旋量实性条件从辛-马约拉纳（symplectic-Majorana）到马约拉纳（Majorana）的变化构造双线性系统；通过一个代数规范修正与两个代数双线性投影将等电荷扇区推广到独立卡尔坦电荷，并利用质量3-形式自对偶性（massive 3-form self-duality）从阿贝尔矩映射（Abelian moment maps）确定高阶形式定点数据。

Result: 在填充空间的单一定点处局部化即可恢复一般超对称AdS₇黑洞作用量，无需延拓解；证明了联合超对称Killing流与R对称作用下的规范协变Killing旋量不变性，导出线性化学势约束；对约束熵泛函取极值并要求实数正定驻点熵，可在欧氏分析内部得到非线性电荷关系，与已知球面黑洞族的洛伦兹视界极值性（horizon extremality）等价。

Conclusion: 相对等变局部化可成功推广至七维，仅凭定点数据即可在欧氏框架内重现黑洞热力学量；质量3-形式自对偶性与矩映射为高阶形式定点数据提供确定性来源，且其高效重组织方式亦适用于洛伦兹理论。

Abstract: Seven-dimensional supergravity provides holographic access to strongly coupled six-dimensional superconformal theories through its highest-dimensional supersymmetric AdS vacua. Its unique spinor-bilinear geometry and massive higher-form dynamics make systematic analysis and solution-finding distinctively challenging. Relative equivariant localization can obtain supersymmetric observables in odd dimensions from fixed-point data on an auxiliary even-dimensional filling, without an explicit solution. We extend this approach to seven dimensions in maximal Cartan-gauged supergravity with all gauge fields active. We formulate the Euclidean action and Killing-spinor equations in terms of field strengths, and construct a bilinear system adapted to the change in spinor reality conditions from symplectic-Majorana to Majorana. On the non-null gauged active spinor branch, independent, oppositely R-charged spinors are paired by Majorana conjugation on the same complex background. One algebraic gauging correction and two algebraic bilinear projections suffice to extend the equal-charge sector to independent Cartan charges, and the underlying efficient reorganization also applies in the Lorentzian theory. Massive 3-form self-duality fixes the quartic anomaly class and determines the higher-form fixed-point datum from Abelian moment maps. Localization at the single fixed point of the filling recovers the general supersymmetric AdS$_7$ black-hole action, without extending the solution. We prove gauge-covariant Killing-spinor invariance under the combined supersymmetric Killing flow and R-symmetry action, deriving the linear chemical-potential constraint. Extremizing the constrained entropy functional and requiring real positive stationary entropy yields the nonlinear charge relation within the Euclidean analysis, equivalent to Lorentzian horizon extremality for the known spherical black-hole family.

</details>


### [394] [Thermodynamics of Swirling Black Holes and Kerr-Taub-NUT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40529)
*Ernesto Frodden,Diego Hidalgo,Francisco Manzano*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 本文为 Kerr swirling（KS）、accelerated Kerr swirling（AKS）及 Kerr-Taub-NUT（KTN）黑洞建立热力学第一定律。借助诺特（Noether）思想与适配的表面电荷（surface charge）方法，在存在轴向弦状缺陷（conical singularity）时得到有限准局域电荷，并发现 KS 与 KTN 的熵偏离四分之一面积规则，而 AKS 则满足标准熵公式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究尚未为新发现的 KS 与 AKS 黑洞解建立热力学第一定律，且此类时空沿轴存在弦状缺陷、渐近区非平坦，使常规质量与角动量定义及标准熵公式的适用性存疑，需要一种不依赖非平坦渐近区域的电荷计算方法。

Method: 以诺特（Noether）关于整体对称性产生守恒律的原始洞见为指导，采用并改造表面电荷（surface charge）方法，在 KS 与 KTN 时空轴线上的弦状缺陷（锥形奇点，conical singularity）存在下计算质量与角动量，以准局域（quasi-local）方式得到有限积分电荷；对 AKS 则先用 Christodoulou-Ruffini 公式确定质量，再与表面电荷结果比对。

Result: 在 KS 与 KTN 情形下获得有限准局域电荷，可在不引入与对称性无关的独立弦项的条件下建立第一定律；但扮演黑洞熵角色的量与四分之一视界面积（one-fourth of the horizon area）的几何规则不符。AKS 时空可在奇点外被正则化且无弦状缺陷，其电荷与采用标准四分之一面积熵的第一定律一致，且 Christodoulou-Ruffini 公式给出的质量与表面电荷法结果吻合。

Conclusion: KS 与 KTN 中熵与面积规则的不一致源于坚持使用与守恒律对应的第一定律电荷，表明带弦状缺陷的黑洞具有不同拓扑，标准公式不可直接套用，需新的几何框架；而 AKS 的结果显示，在无弦状缺陷、可正则化情形下标准熵公式仍然成立。

Abstract: We establish the first law of black hole thermodynamics for the recently discovered Kerr swirling (KS) and accelerated Kerr swirling (AKS) black hole solutions. We also revisit the first law for the Kerr-Taub-NUT (KTN) spacetime. Guided by Noether's original insight that global symmetries give rise to conservation laws, we employ and adapt the surface charge method for computing the associated charges (mass and angular momentum) in the presence of spacetime string-like defects (conical singularities) along the axes of both KS and KTN black holes. We obtain finite integrated charges in a quasi-local manner, without relying on the non-flat asymptotic regions characteristic of these spacetimes. We then establish a first law without introducing independent stringy terms unrelated to symmetries. For both KS and KTN, the quantities that play the role of the black hole entropy differ from the simple geometrical rule of one-fourth of the horizon area. This mismatch arises because we keep first-law charges associated with conservation laws. It indicates that standard formulas may not be naively used for black holes with string-like defects; they have a different topology and suggest the need for a new geometrical framework. In stark contrast, for the AKS spacetime, which can be regularized outside the singularity and lacks string-like defects, we find that the charges are consistent with a first law having the usual one-fourth of the area entropy. We first determine the mass using the Christodoulou-Ruffini formula and then check its agreement with the result obtained from the surface charge method.

</details>


### [395] [On Geometric Observables in Gravity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40615)
*Manthos Karydas,Murat Kologlu,Allic Sivaramakrishnan*

Main category: hep-th

TL;DR: 本文在微扰量子引力（perturbative quantum gravity）框架下研究几何可观测量（geometric observables），构造坐标不变的、可模拟测量的距离与时间算符，并计算其引力子（graviton）修正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典引力（classical gravity）以距离与时间为基本要素，量子引力中几何量虽广泛出现，但其引力子修正（graviton corrections）研究不足，缺乏连接测量操作与几何量的系统框架。

Method: 构造可模拟测量（含时空涨落情形）的距离与时间可观测量，借助引力 dressing 保证坐标不变性（coordinate invariant）；在渐近极限下将其与记忆效应（memory）及 Shapiro 时间延迟（Shapiro time delay）算符对应，并计算几何可观测量关联函数（correlators）中的领头引力子效应。

Result: 有限距离几何可观测量在渐近极限下化为记忆与 Shapiro 时间延迟算符；得到几何可观测量关联函数中的领头引力子修正，并识别出一类连接实验与天球（celestial sphere）上操作的几何可观测量。

Conclusion: 几何可观测量可作为衔接微扰量子引力计算与天球上实验操作的有效工具，为研究量子引力中的几何量及其引力子修正提供了统一框架。

Abstract: Measures of geometry like distance and time are staples of classical gravity. While geometric quantities arise broadly in quantum gravity, their graviton corrections are less explored. In this paper, we study geometric observables in perturbative quantum gravity. We form distance and time observables that model measurements, including in the presence of spacetime fluctuations. Gravitational dressing ensures these constructions are coordinate invariant. Then we show how these finite-distance observables become memory and Shapiro time delay operators upon taking asymptotic limits. We compute leading graviton effects in correlators of geometric observables throughout. Altogether, our results identify a class of geometric observables that link experiments and operations on the celestial sphere.

</details>

### [396] [Validity Domains for Semiclassical Time in Quantum Cosmology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37696)
*Gianpaolo Rosati,Sergio L. Cacciatori*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 本文研究半经典引力 WKB 流（semiclassical gravitational WKB flow）何时能作为受控时间参考。作者在引力构型空间（gravitational configuration space）上直接表述 Born–Oppenheimer 绝热条件，得到有效域 $D_t = D_{\mathrm{WKB}} \cap D_{\mathrm{ad}} \cap D_{\mathrm{sharp}}$。结果表明绝热域与 WKB 有效域并不等价，振荡半经典分支的存在不足以保证可靠的 WKB 时间描述。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统做法预先引入 WKB 时间（WKB time），未区分引力分支的 WKB 有效性与从属量子自由度的绝热控制，因此需要厘清半经典时间参考在何种条件下才是定量可控的。

Method: 借助 Hamilton–Jacobi 向量场（Hamilton–Jacobi vector field）在引力构型空间上直接构造 Born–Oppenheimer 绝热条件；在闭合 Friedmann–Robertson–Walker 迷你超空间（minisuperspace）耦合均匀大质量标量模的模型中，比较 WKB 控制参数与构型空间绝热参数，并用一致 Airy 处理（uniform Airy treatment）分析转折点。

Result: 从振荡区逼近引力转折点（turning point）时，常规 WKB 控制参数发散而构型空间绝热参数趋于零；Airy 处理消除了形式上的 WKB 发散但保留了不等价性：局域控制参数仍为 O(1)，而绝热参数被参数性压低为 $O(M^{-1/3})$。

Conclusion: 即使最简单的迷你超空间模型，Born–Oppenheimer 绝热性与引力 WKB 有效性也定义不等价的有效域；半经典时间描述的可靠性取决于支撑参考流的各有效域之交集，而非仅仅存在振荡半经典分支。

Abstract: We investigate the domain in which a semiclassical gravitational WKB flow can serve as a quantitatively controlled temporal reference for subordinate quantum degrees of freedom. Rather than introducing WKB time at the outset, we formulate the Born--Oppenheimer adiabatic condition directly on gravitational configuration space using the Hamilton--Jacobi vector field. This separates adiabatic control from the local WKB validity of the gravitational branch and from the sharpness of the candidate reference against quantum fluctuations. For a single selected semiclassical branch, these requirements define the validity domain $D_t = D_{\mathrm{WKB}} \cap D_{\mathrm{ad}} \cap D_{\mathrm{sharp}}$, with an additional decoherence condition when coherent branches coexist.In a closed Friedmann--Robertson--Walker minisuperspace coupled to a homogeneous massive scalar mode, the distinction is explicit: approaching the gravitational turning point from the oscillatory region, the ordinary WKB control parameter diverges while the configuration-space adiabatic parameter tends to zero. A uniform Airy treatment of the turning point removes the formal WKB divergence while preserving the inequivalence: the corresponding local control parameter remains of order unity, whereas the configuration-space adiabatic parameter is parametrically suppressed as $O(M^{-1/3})$.Thus Born--Oppenheimer adiabaticity and gravitational WKB validity define inequivalent domains even within the simplest minisuperspace model. We conclude that the existence of an oscillatory semiclassical branch is not sufficient for a reliable WKB temporal description: semiclassical temporal reliability is instead determined by the overlap of the validity domains supporting the reference flow.

</details>


### [397] [Classical traversability of a carbon BTZ wormhole](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37704)
*Valerie Tynianska,Alfredo Iorio*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 本文在二维弯曲碳膜上实现的模拟空间虫洞几何中，研究无质量狄拉克准粒子的经典可穿越性。结果表明经典可穿越性由守恒角动量的尖锐二值阈值决定，临界附近轨迹出现角度演化的对数发散。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旨在考察模拟虫洞几何中准粒子能否经典穿越喉部，并为后续介观（mesoscopic）研究提供几何骨架。

Method: 对非旋转 BTZ（Bañados-Teitelboim-Zanelli）黑洞外部空间扇区施加反射对称倍增技术，构造以光滑可穿越喉替代事件视界的背景；在该超静态时空（ultrastatic spacetime）中求解精确测地线方程（geodesic equations），分析自旋光线（spinorial light rays）的运动学。

Result: 经典可穿越性由守恒角动量（conserved angular momentum）的尖锐二值阈值决定，最小喉半径充当离心势垒（centrifugal potential barrier），将穿越路径与反射路径分开；近临界轨迹的角度演化呈对数发散，准粒子在逃逸前绕喉多次空间卷绕。

Conclusion: 这些经典光线追踪（ray-tracing）构型确立了未来介观研究所需的几何基础，本文聚焦于经典层面而未涉及量子或介观效应。

Abstract: We investigate the classical traversability of an analogue spatial wormhole geometry realized on a two-dimensional curved carbon membrane. The background is obtained by implementing a reflection-symmetric doubling technique on the exterior spatial sector of a non-rotating Bañados-Teitelboim-Zanelli black hole, effectively replacing the event horizon with a smooth traversable throat. Within this framework, massless Dirac quasiparticles propagate as spinorial light rays whose kinematics are governed exclusively by the metric curvature, forcing them to track the null geodesics of the ultrastatic spacetime. By evaluating the exact geodesic equations, we demonstrate that classical traversability is dictated by a sharp binary threshold in the conserved angular momentum, where the minimum throat radius acts as a centrifugal potential barrier that separates traversing paths from reflecting ones. We show that near-critical trajectories experience a logarithmic divergence in their angular evolution, causing the quasiparticles to execute multiple spatial windings around the throat before escaping. These classical ray-tracing configurations establish the necessary geometric backbones for future mesoscopic investigations.

</details>


### [398] [Thermodynamic and structural properties of the thin atmosphere of a white dwarf](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37708)
*Riccardo Fantoni*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 该工作采用路径积分蒙特卡洛方法（path integral Monte Carlo），在广义相对论（general relativity）星体描述框架下，测定白矮星（white dwarf）稀薄大气中库仑等离子体（Coulomb plasma，即 jellium）的热力学与结构性质。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 摘要指出研究对象为白矮星稀薄大气中的库仑等离子体，其热力学与结构性质需要确定；同时强调需在广义相对论描述星体的框架内处理该问题，暗示此前研究可能未同时结合强引力环境与量子多体模拟。

Method: 方法为路径积分蒙特卡洛模拟（path integral Monte Carlo, PIMC），并置于广义相对论（general relativity）的星体描述之内。

Result: 摘要仅说明确定了该体系的热力学性质（thermodynamic properties）与结构性质（structural properties），未给出具体数值或定量结论。

Conclusion: 结论是路径积分蒙特卡洛方法可用于在广义相对论框架下研究白矮星大气中库仑等离子体的热力学与结构性质；受摘要篇幅限制，未提供进一步推论。

Abstract: We determine thermodynamic and structural properties of the Coulomb plasma (jellium) in the thin atmosphere of a white dwarf using the path integral Monte Carlo method within a general relativity description of the star.

</details>


### [399] [Draining Without Emptying a Stringy Black Hole: Repetitive Electric Penrose Process](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37713)
*Huai-Fan Li,Xiong-Ying Guo,Ke Wang,Hong Lei*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 本文研究GMGHS黑洞在最大能量提取最优条件下的重复电彭罗斯过程（repetitive electric Penrose process），给出了迭代终止条件并揭示能量回报率可超100%，但能量利用效率不超过50%，且过程无法将黑洞电荷完全耗尽。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对GMGHS黑洞这一区别于RN黑洞的时空中，重复电彭罗斯过程的能量提取能力与终止机制尚不清晰，本文旨在最优条件下系统考察其能量提取的极限与效率。

Method: 在最大能量提取的最优条件下对GMGHS黑洞的重复电彭罗斯过程进行理论分析与数值模拟，分析入射粒子有效势（effective potential）的迭代行为、逃逸条件与负能粒子存在条件，并讨论衰变半径、粒子荷质比（charge-to-mass ratio）、比能及初始黑洞电荷的影响。

Result: 与RN黑洞不同，GMGHS黑洞中入射粒子的有效势曲线在迭代过程中保持不变；逃逸条件与黑洞电荷无关，而负能粒子存在条件要求黑洞电荷足够大；数值结果显示能量回报率（return on investment）可超100%，但能量利用效率不超过50%，大部分可提取能量转化为黑洞不可约质量（irreducible mass）的增加。

Conclusion: 更小的衰变半径和更大的粒子1荷质比绝对值可提升回报率与效率；入射粒子比能越大回报率越小而效率不变；初始非极端黑洞电荷增大时回报率单调上升、效率先升后降；迭代终止后黑洞仍保留可提取能量，电荷与质量均未消失。

Abstract: This paper studies the repetitive electric Penrose process in the Gibbons-Maeda-Garfinkle-Horowitz-Strominger (GMGHS) black hole under the optimal condition for maximum energy extraction. Unlike the Reissner-Nordström (RN) black hole, the effective potential curve of the incident particle in the GMGHS black hole remains unchanged during the iterations. The iteration termination conditions are determined by two aspects: the escape condition requires that particle 0 can overcome the effective potential peak and escape to infinity, and this condition is independent of the black hole charge; the existence condition for negative-energy particle 1 requires the black hole charge to be sufficiently large, indicating that the repetitive process cannot completely consume the charge of the GMGHS black hole to zero. Numerical simulations show that the return on investment of energy extraction can exceed $100\%$, but the energy utilization efficiency does not exceed $50\%$, and most of the extractable energy is converted into an increase in the irreducible mass of the black hole. In addition, a smaller decay radius and a larger absolute value of the charge-to-mass ratio of particle 1 can improve the return on investment and energy utilization efficiency of energy extraction; the larger the specific energy of the incident particle, the smaller the return on investment of energy extraction, while the energy utilization efficiency remains unchanged; for an initially non-extremal black hole, as the initial charge increases, the return on investment of energy extraction increases monotonically, while the energy utilization efficiency first increases and then decreases. After the iterations end, the black hole still retains extractable energy, and neither the charge nor the mass vanishes.

</details>


### [400] [On a model of quantum quadratic gravity in 7 + 1-dimensional spacetime](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37780)
*Vsevolod Chistiakov,Artur Mingaleev*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 本文研究含 $\nabla_\mu R\nabla^\mu R$ 与 $(\nabla^2 R)^2$ 项的二次引力模型，在耦合常数取特定关系时作用量呈完全平方形式；在空间平坦 FLRW 背景下约化为时间重参数化不变的动力学变量，并构造将其映射为 Wiener 测度高斯作用量的非线性变量变换，进而提出可观测量期望值关于 Wiener 测度的形式化积分表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 二次引力模型（quadratic gravity）在宇宙学背景下具有可约化结构，但缺乏与已知测度（如 Wiener 测度）联系的严格表述；本文旨在借助完全平方作用量与非平坦变量变换，为约化模型的量子描述建立形式化的路径积分基础。

Method: 在空间平坦 FLRW 度规下，先约化到时间重参数化（time reparameterization）不变的动力学变量；随后构造非线性变量变换，把约化作用量变为与 Wiener 测度对应的高斯作用量，并在时间离散化（time discretization）框架内分析变换的雅可比行列式（Jacobian）。

Result: 雅可比行列式分析表明，仅当时空维数为 $7+1$ 时，离散变换的雅可比行列式与动力学变量无关，从而在该维度下使变换与 Wiener 测度相容。

Conclusion: 据此提出在约化模型中以 Wiener 测度积分形式表示可观测量期望值（expectation values）的形式化方案；该结果为二次引力的路径积分表述给出候选框架，但依赖完全平方条件与 $7+1$ 维特殊性。

Abstract: We consider a quadratic gravity model supplemented by the terms $\nabla_μR\nabla^μR$ and $(\nabla^{2}R)^2$. For specific relations among the coupling constants, the action takes a perfect-square form. In the spatially flat FLRW model, we perform a reduction to a dynamical variable invariant under time reparameterizations. We construct a nonlinear change of variable that transforms the reduced action into the Gaussian action associated with the Wiener measure. An analysis of the transformation Jacobian within a time discretization singles out the case of $7+1$-dimensional spacetime, in which the Jacobian of the discrete transformation under consideration is independent of the dynamical variable. On this basis, we propose a formal representation of expectation values of observables in the reduced model as integrals with respect to the Wiener measure.

</details>


### [401] [Primordial Gravitational Waves in Loop Quantum Cosmology: Regularization Ambiguities and Initial State Dependence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37790)
*Mah Noor Jamil,Parampreet Singh*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 本文在标准圈量子宇宙学（loop quantum cosmology）及修正模型 mLQC-I、mLQC-II 中，演化原初张量功率谱（primordial tensor power spectrum）穿越反弹（bounce），并计算其对应的 CMB B 模谱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 需要在反弹穿越的全过程中确定张量微扰（tensor perturbations）的演化，并厘清初始态与正则化选择对张量-标量比（tensor-to-scalar ratio）及红外特征的影响。

Method: 在 hybrid 与 dressed metric 两种处方下、采用 Starobinsky 势演化张量微扰；mLQC-I 的 de Sitter 收缩支采用专门初始态（dressed metric 用 de Sitter 模函数，hybrid 用 Hankel 函数解），并对 N_e = 60 与 65 计算标度依赖的 r(k)=P_T/P_S。

Result: 在 N_e = 60、65 时，pivot 标度处的张量-标量比与标准暴胀（standard inflation）一致；r(k) 在标度不变区缓慢变化，在较小 k 处绕 r_* 振荡；标度不变区附近的振荡不依赖绝热阶（adiabatic order），而低 k 处的峰与尖峰依赖之；给定初始态时，正则化依赖在红外残留。

Conclusion: 长波模式保留反弹及反弹前支的印记，r(k) 可分离与初始态无关和相关的特征；归一化谱被传播至 CMB B 模谱以讨论观测前景。

Abstract: We compute the primordial tensor power spectrum in standard loop quantum cosmology and in the modified models mLQC-I and mLQC-II, evolving the tensor perturbations across the bounce in the hybrid and dressed metric prescriptions with a Starobinsky potential. In mLQC-I, the emergent de Sitter contracting branch requires the use of dedicated initial states. We use de Sitter mode function in the dressed metric approach and a Hankel-function solution in the hybrid approach. For inflationary e-foldings $N_e = 60$ and $65$, the pivot-scale tensor-to-scalar ratio agrees with the value of standard inflation with this potential. The scale-dependent ratio $r(k)=\mathcal{P}_T/\mathcal{P}_S$ cancels effects common to the two sectors and separates features that are independent of the initial state from those that depend on it. It varies slowly in the scale-invariant regime and oscillates around $r_\star$ at smaller $k$. The oscillations next to the scale-invariant regime do not depend on the adiabatic order, unlike the peaks and spikes at lower $k$. For a given initial state, the regularization dependence survives in the infrared, where long-wavelength modes retain a record of the bounce and of the pre-bounce branch. We propagate the normalized spectra to the CMB $B$-mode spectrum and discuss observational prospects.

</details>


### [402] [Inverse design of scalar-tensor EFT from odd-parity effective potentials](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37915)
*Kazufumi Takahashi,Yuki Watanabe*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 论文提出一种逆设计（inverse-design）方法，以奇宇称有效势（odd-parity effective potential）为输入，重构标量-张量引力（scalar-tensor gravity）静态度规球对称背景下的背景量与有效场论（EFT）数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旨在建立现象学势变形（如黑洞环降观测约束）与底层标量-张量EFT参数之间的对应关系，从而把对有效势的观测限制翻译为对EFT数据的限制。

Method: 在具有类时标量场梯度（timelike scalar-field gradient）的静态球对称背景中，由给定的奇宇称有效势反推相容的背景与EFT数据；并以Pöschl-Teller势、广义相对论（general relativity）的Regge-Wheeler势及其参数化变形作为可解析处理的实例进行显式构造。

Result: 成功构造出Pöschl-Teller势的显式实现，其准正规模（quasinormal-mode）谱可闭式求得；同时证明Regge-Wheeler势及其参数化变形均可在标量-张量EFT框架内实现。

Conclusion: 该逆设计框架为将黑洞环降（ringdown）观测对势变形的现象学约束解释为底层EFT数据提供了可行路径。

Abstract: We develop an inverse-design approach to the effective field theory (EFT) of perturbations in scalar-tensor gravity around static and spherically symmetric backgrounds with a timelike scalar-field gradient, taking the odd-parity effective potential as input and reconstructing compatible background and EFT data. As analytically tractable examples, we construct explicit realizations of the Pöschl-Teller potential, for which the quasinormal-mode spectrum can be obtained in closed form. We then study the Regge-Wheeler potential of general relativity and its parametrized deformations, showing how both can be realized within the scalar-tensor EFT. In particular, the latter realizations provide a route to interpreting phenomenological constraints on potential deformations from black hole ringdown observations in terms of the underlying EFT data.

</details>


### [403] [Quantum gravity phenomenology in quadrupolar Bose-Einstein condensates: Finite-temperature thermodynamics and projected bounds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37930)
*Asma Tahar Taiba,Abdelaali Boudjemaa*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 该文在广义不确定原理（generalized uncertainty principle, GUP）框架下研究四极矩玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚（quadrupolar Bose-Einstein condensate）的热力学性质，计算GUP对凝聚分数、临界温度、状态方程等的修正，并给出GUP形变参数的预估上限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者希望借助凝聚体的有限温度多体可观测量来理解与检验量子引力（quantum gravity, QG）现象学，并探索四极矩-四极矩相互作用（quadrupole-quadrupole interactions, QQIs）与GUP共同作用对体系性质的影响。

Method: 采用二次型GUP（quadratic GUP, QGUP）与线性-二次型GUP（linear-quadratic GUP, LQGUP）两种形式，引入修正的态密度（density of states），计算凝聚分数、临界温度、状态方程及其他热力学量的修正，并通过假定分数温度分辨率估算临界温度对GUP效应的敏感度。

Result: QQIs与GUP的耦合可能强烈改变凝聚体的有限温度性质；LQGUP通常给出比QGUP更大的修正，但相对大小依赖所选参数及微扰展开（perturbative expansion）的有效性；敏感度估算给出了GUP形变参数的预估上限。

Conclusion: 四极矩相互作用的玻色气体为检验GUP引起的对标准量子力学（standard quantum mechanics）的偏离、以及通过有限温度多体观测量探测QG现象学提供了有前景的平台，并推动采用真实体系特定参数的后续研究。

Abstract: We study the thermodynamics of quadrupolar Bose-Einstein condensates in the realm of the generalized uncertainty principle (GUP) for the quest of understanding and testing quantum gravity (QG). Using both quadratic GUP (QGUP) and linear-quadratic GUP (LQGUP) which incorporate modified density of states, we calculate corrections to the condensed fraction, critical temperature, equation of state and other thermodynamic quantities. We find that the intriguing interplay of quadrupole-quadrupole interactions (QQIs) and the GUP may strongly modify the finite-temperature properties of the condensate, with the LQGUP generally predicting larger corrections than the QGUP, although their relative magnitudes depend on the chosen parameters and the validity of the perturbative expansion. We further estimate the sensitivity of the critical temperature to GUP-induced effects by imposing an assumed fractional temperature resolution which provides projected upper bounds on the GUP deformation parameters. Our findings demonstrate that quadrupole-quadrupole interacting Bose gases provide a promising platform for testing GUP-induced deviations from standard quantum mechanics and for probing QG phenomenology through measurements of finite-temperature many-body observables. They also motivate future studies using realistic system-specific parameters.

</details>


### [404] [Apparent horizon mergers in analytic intial data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37938)
*Federico Elizondo Lopez,Ivan Booth*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 该文指出Brill-Lindquist-deSitter初始数据的参数演化可再现黑洞并合过程中视界（apparent horizon）与边缘外陷俘面（marginally outer trapped surface, MOTS）演化的诸多特征，因而可作为解析测试平台。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有工作（Pook-Kolb、Hennigar与Booth的三篇系列论文）显示，并合过程中视界与MOTS的演化远比事件视界（event horizon）的"裤子"（pair-of-pants）图像复杂，但缺乏便于解析处理的测试模型。

Method: 采用Brill-Lindquist-deSitter初始数据（Brill-Lindquist-deSitter initial data），通过参数演化（parameter evolutions）考察其对应MOTS的行为，并与先前数值结果作定性比较。

Result: 该解析初始数据的参数演化可模拟先前研究所揭示的并合视界演化特征的诸多方面。

Conclusion: Brill-Lindquist-deSitter初始数据可作为研究MOTS演化及时空几何（spacetime geometry）并合过程的有用解析测试平台（testing ground）。

Abstract: Five years ago Pook-Kolb, Hennigar and Booth published a series of three papers exploring the evolution of apparent horizons and other marginally outer trapped surfaces during a black hole merger. This was seen to be much more intricate than the well-known "pair-of-pants" merger associated with event horizons. In this paper we show that parameter evolutions of Brill-Lindquist-deSitter initial data mimic many of the features of that evolution. Hence, this analytic intial data is a useful testing ground for ideas about marginally outer trapped surface evolution and spacetime geometry during mergers.

</details>


### [405] [Systematic High Overtone Expansion of Kerr Quasinormal Modes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38019)
*Yasuyuki Hatsuda*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 该文提出一套系统方法，可在常规角分支（normal angular branches）上把 Kerr 黑洞准正规模（quasinormal modes）的高阶泛音展开（high overtone expansion）计算到任意阶，其核心是固定亏格一谱曲线（genus-one spectral curve）上的量子周期（quantum periods）仅由两个椭圆周期（elliptic periods）表出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高阶泛音（high overtone）区域的 Kerr 准正规模展开此前缺乏可推广到任意阶的系统计算框架，尤其是在角向本征值与径向 Teukolsky 方程耦合时。

Method: 先用简单的多项式递推（polynomial recursion）得到大频率下角本征值的展开；再将其代入径向 Teukolsky 方程的替代形式，证明所有 WKB 修正（WKB corrections）定义在固定亏格一谱曲线上，且二阶及更高阶的量子周期只用两个椭圆周期表达，从而逐阶确定展开系数。

Result: 截断展开复现了直接求解角向与径向方程得到的准正规模频率，覆盖标量（scalar）、电磁（electromagnetic）与引力（gravitational）场；标量结果还与极端 Kerr 黑洞（extremal Kerr black hole）的精确 WKB 分析（exact WKB analysis）进行了比较。

Conclusion: 高阶泛音展开可由谱曲线上的少量椭圆周期系统生成至任意阶，且对角分支上的多类扰动场均适用，并与精确 WKB 结果一致。

Abstract: We develop a systematic method to compute the high overtone expansion of Kerr quasinormal modes on normal angular branches to arbitrary order. We first obtain the expansion of the angular eigenvalue at large frequencies by a simple polynomial recursion. Using this result in an alternative form of the radial Teukolsky equation, we find that all the WKB corrections are defined on a fixed genus-one spectral curve, and that the quantum periods at the second and higher orders are expressed in terms of only two elliptic periods. This allows us to determine the expansion coefficients order by order. We confirm that the truncated expansions reproduce quasinormal frequencies obtained by solving the angular and radial equations directly, for scalar, electromagnetic and gravitational fields. We also compare the scalar results with the exact WKB analysis of extremal Kerr black holes.

</details>


### [406] [Physical Effects in the Vicinity of Black Holes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38068)
*Alex Koek*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 该论文在经典广义相对论（classical general relativity）框架内研究若干可解析的物理现象，其结果可能对宇宙学观测（cosmological observations）与黑洞观测（black hole observations）具有启示意义，背景是现代天文学正从电磁辐射时代（electromagnetic radiation epoch）转向引力波时代（gravitational wave epoch）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 广义相对论（general relativity）虽已逾百年，仍是仅引力显著的能量尺度下描述宇宙的最佳理论，且持续通过观测检验并不断催生新问题与新洞见。引力波天文学（gravitational wave astronomy）的兴起进一步凸显了在该框架内深入研究的价值。

Method: 采用经典广义相对论框架下的理论分析（theoretical analysis）方法，针对可在该框架内解析处理的现象展开研究；摘要未给出具体模型或计算细节。

Result: 摘要为论文总体性陈述，未报告具体定量结果，仅指出所研究现象的结果可能对宇宙学与黑洞观测产生有意义的推论（interesting implications）。

Conclusion: 经典广义相对论仍是研究引力主导现象的有效且富有生产力的框架，其相关研究可为当前引力波时代的天文观测提供理论与解释上的支持。

Abstract: General relativity, a theory that is already over a century old, is still the best theory that we have to describe the universe at energy scales where only the gravitational force is important. It has stood tall to any observational tests thrown at it since its inception, and it has remarkable predictive power when it is utilized to study and model astrophysical problems. It also continues to surprise us with its ability to generate new problems and insights that render themselves useful in the study of modern physics. This is especially highlighted by the transition of modern observational astronomy away from an electromagnetic radiation epoch, and into a new gravitational wave epoch. This thesis devotes its study to phenomena that can be analyzed within the framework of classical general relativity, but whose results may contain interesting implications for cosmological and black hole observations. (Full abstract can be found in document).

</details>


### [407] [Gravitational baryogenesis in Gauss-Bonnet braneworld cosmology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38188)
*Ian B Whittingham*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 本文研究在高斯-博内（Gauss-Bonnet, GB）修正的Randall-Sundrum（RS）II型膜世界宇宙学（braneworld cosmology）中实现引力重子生成（gravitational baryogenesis）的可行性，发现宇宙膨胀率经历GB、RS与标准广义相对论（general relativity, GR）三个演化阶段，且仅在GB与GR阶段满足生成条件，并给出了可获得观测重子不对称度的参数范围。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 引力重子生成依赖里奇标量导数（\dot{R}）且需满足\dot{R}<0，而标准GR与修正引力理论中的膨胀历史可能破坏该条件；因此有必要考察GB修正的RS II型膜世界宇宙学中重子生成能否成功实现。

Method: 分析该场景下膨胀率的三阶段演化：早期GB阶段H~ρ^{1/3}、RS阶段H~ρ、低能极限回归GR的H~ρ^{1/2}；检验各阶段\dot{R}的符号条件；并推导重子不对称度η(T)∝μ(1+w)(1-w)(1+1/β)的形式，借助GB-膜世界暴胀（inflation）研究给出的μ与β约束，在(μ, β, w)参数范围内数值计算η并与观测值比较。

Result: GB与GR阶段满足\dot{R}<0，RS阶段\dot{R}>0因而无法生成重子，需退耦温度（decoupling temperature）落在GB阶段或宇宙由GB直接跃迁至GR。计算表明，当μ=10^{12} GeV时β在(10^{-2}–10^{-3})内、当μ=10^{13} GeV时β在(10^{-1}–10^{-2})内可获得观测不对称度，而μ=10^{14} GeV时η全部偏高。此外，与GR中辐射主导（w=1/3）时η为零不同，GB膜世界宇宙学中η非零。

Conclusion: GB修正的RS II型膜世界宇宙学在特定参数范围内（μ=10^{12}–10^{13} GeV及相应β区间）能够重现观测到的重子不对称度，且因w=1/3时η非零，该框架提供了区别于GR的引力重子生成途径。

Abstract: The present study investigates the feasibility of gravitational baryogenesis in a Gauss-Bonnet (GB) modified Randall-Sundrum (RS) type II braneworld cosmology. The modified expansion rate of the Universe in this scenario evolves through three distinct expansion regimes, the GB regime at early times where the expansion rate $H \sim ρ^{1/3}$ falls more slowly than the standard expansion law $H\sim ρ^{1/2}$ of GR, then the RS type era with an enhanced expansion $H \sim ρ$, before finally reducing to the standard expansion law in the low energy limit. Gravitational baryogenesis depends on $\dot{R}$ and requires $\dot{R} <0$. This condition is satisfied for the GB and GR regimes. However, $\dot{R}>0$ for the RS regime and successful baryogenesis requires either that the decoupling temperature occurs during the GB regime or that the Universe makes a direct transition from the GB regime to the GR regime.
  The GB baryon asymmetry $η(T)$ is proportional to $μ(1+w)(1-w)(1+1/β)$, where $μ$ is the energy scale $μ\equiv 1/l$ associated with the bulk curvature scale $l$, $β\equiv 4 αμ^{2}$, where $α$ is the GB coupling, and $w$ is the equation of state parameter $p=w ρ$. Studies of inflation in GB-braneworld cosmology place constraints on the allowed ranges of the parameters $μ$ and $β$. Guided by these, the asymmetry has been calculated for ranges of $(μ, β, w)$ and it is found that the observed values can be obtained for a value of $β$ within the range $(10^{-2} - 10^{-3})$ for $μ=10^{12}$ GeV, and within the range $(10^{-1}- 10^{-2})$ for $μ=10^{13}$ GeV. All values of $η$ for $μ=10^{14}$ are too high. In contrast to GR where $η$ is zero for a radiation dominated Universe ($w=1/3$), it is non-zero in GB braneworld cosmology.

</details>


### [408] [Axion-angle dependence of the rotational and tidal properties of PNJL quark stars](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38343)
*Safiqul Islam,Ayan Banerjee,Javlon Rayimbaev,Safyan Mukhtar*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 在轴子扩展的PNJL物态方程框架下，空间均匀轴子角θ从0变到π会显著改变自束缚夸克星的质量、转动惯量与潮汐形变，但归一化后的I-Love-Q类普适关系仍可用统一的联合拟合精确描述。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究固定且空间均匀的轴子角（axion angle）如何影响广义相对论（general relativity）下自束缚夸克星（self-bound quark stars）的转动性质与静态潮汐性质，检验强相互作用物态中轴子自由度对可观测星体量的影响。

Method: 采用轴子扩展的Polyakov环Nambu–Jona-Lasinio物态方程（axion-extended Polyakov-loop NJL equation of state），在保持其余模型参数不变的前提下将θ从0扫描至π，计算最低阶转动惯量、二阶自旋诱导四极矩与质量移动，并计入有限表面密度（finite surface density）对转动质量移动和静态潮汐响应的贡献。

Result: 静态最大质量由1.68升至1.95 M☉，始终低于PSR J0740+6620所给1σ计时区间下沿；在M=1.338 M☉处转动惯量增加13%，无量纲潮汐形变率（dimensionless tidal deformability）由342升至547。相邻θ样本间的转动惯量差异超过插值与表格分辨率的敏感度。对五条序列的联合拟合仍能以最大偏差2.7%（Ī–C关系）和0.4%（I-Love-Q关系）描述这些关系，且预测的双星潮汐形变曲线落在GW170817后验90%可信区内。

Conclusion: 在该物态方程族内，星体性质随θ明显变化，而归一化量（normalized quantities）可在五条序列上获得准确的联合拟合，表明I-Love-Q类普适关系对轴子角的引入具有稳健性。

Abstract: We investigate how a fixed, spatially uniform axion angle modifies the rotational and static tidal properties of self-bound quark stars in general relativity, using an axion-extended Polyakov-loop Nambu--Jona-Lasinio equation of state. We vary $θ$ from $0$ to $π$ while holding the remaining model parameters fixed, and compute the leading-order moment of inertia and the second-order spin-induced quadrupole moment and mass shift. The calculation includes finite-surface-density contributions to the rotational mass shift and static tidal response. Across this range, the static maximum mass increases from $1.68$ to $1.95\,M_\odot$, remaining below the lower edge of the quoted $1σ$ timing interval for PSR~J0740+6620. At $M=1.338\,M_\odot$, the moment of inertia increases by $13\%$ and the dimensionless tidal deformability rises from $342$ to $547$. Over the common mass range examined, the differences in the moment of inertia between adjacent sampled angles exceed the tested interpolation and table-resolution sensitivities. Despite these changes, joint fits to the five sequences describe the $\bar I$--$C$ and I-Love-Q relations with maximum departures of $2.7\%$ and $0.4\%$, respectively, over the fitted domains. The predicted binary tidal-deformability curves lie within the estimated 90\% credible region of the adopted GW170817 posterior over the mass-ratio ranges examined. Within this EOS family, stellar properties vary appreciably with $θ$, while the normalized quantities admit accurate joint fits across the five sequences.

</details>


### [409] [Hamiltonian Analysis of the Newer General Relativity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38372)
*Chen-Yi Sia,Tee-How Loo,Avik De*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 本文对“新广义相对论（Newer General Relativity）”这一五参数二次非度规性（nonmetricity）理论类进行系统哈密顿分析，依据初级约束（primary constraints）结构将其分为九类，并逐类完成正则表述与自由度分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 二次非度规性理论在对称远平行引力（symmetric teleparallel gravity）框架下存在多种可能形式，其约束结构尚缺乏统一的哈密顿层面刻画，因此需要系统区分不同理论类型并厘清各自物理自由度。

Method: 先回顾对称远平行引力框架，推导新广义相对论的 ADM 表述（ADM formulation），讨论既有分类，并对各类理论计算共轭动量（conjugate momenta）、识别初级约束、构造正则哈密顿量（canonical Hamiltonian）与初级哈密顿量（primary Hamiltonian），进而确定约束结构。

Result: 按初级约束结构可将二次非度规性理论划分为九类；对每一类型均给出共轭动量、初级约束及相应哈密顿量的显式结果，并确定其约束结构与由此产生的物理自由度（physical degrees of freedom）。

Conclusion: 新广义相对论的五参数理论类可通过初级约束结构实现系统分类，且各类型的物理自由度数量由哈密顿约束分析确定，为该理论类的物理筛选与进一步研究提供了基础。

Abstract: We present a systematic Hamiltonian analysis of the five-parameter class of theories known as Newer General Relativity. Quadratic nonmetricity theories of this type can be divided into nine types according to the structure of their primary constraints. After reviewing the framework of symmetric teleparallel gravity, we derive the ADM formulation of Newer General Relativity, discuss the existing classification and perform the Hamiltonian formulation of the theory. For each type, we compute the conjugate momenta, identify the primary constraints, and construct both the canonical and primary Hamiltonians. We then determine the constraint structure and analyze the resulting physical degrees of freedom in each type.

</details>


### [410] [Quasinormal Modes of a Rotating Hořava Black Hole: Two Perturbative Approaches to Nonseparability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38428)
*Wen-Di Guo,Wentao Liu,Yu-Xiao Liu*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 本文研究Hořava引力低能区中渐近平坦旋转黑洞的标量准正规模（quasinormal modes, QNMs），针对旋转导致洛伦兹破缺（Lorentz violation）使标量方程不可分离的问题，发展了两种保持精确Kerr部分的近似方法并计算线性频率响应，揭示了洛伦兹破缺在黑洞铃宕（ringdown）中的独特旋转特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 准正规模是探测强场引力（strong-field gravity）的有力工具，而Hořava引力中旋转引起的洛伦兹破缺使标量方程不可分离，精确求解困难，因此需要在保留精确Kerr极限的前提下建立可行的近似计算框架。

Method: 提出两种互补近似：方法I仅对不可分离的洛伦兹破缺部分施加慢旋转近似（slow-rotation approximation）；方法II采用小η双正交球状投影（biorthogonal spheroidal projection），其中η为洛伦兹破缺参数。两者均保持精确Kerr部分，并结合残差控制延拓（residual-controlled continuation）与对称有限差分，以Kerr连分式（continued-fraction）基准和独立径向谱方法验证。

Result: 轴对称模式给出精确的Kerr零检验（null test）。对研究的同向旋转模式（corotating modes），实频响应为正且随自旋增大；在a/M=0.9处两种方法均给出约2%的角向修正，而虚频响应非单调，且因内部抵消对角向投影高度敏感。

Conclusion: 结果表明洛伦兹破缺在黑洞铃宕中具有区别于Kerr的独特旋转特征（rotational signatures），同时凸显虚频部分对角向处理方式的敏感性。

Abstract: Quasinormal modes (QNMs) provide a powerful probe of strong-field gravity. We study fundamental scalar quasinormal modes of an asymptotically flat rotating black hole in the low-energy sector of Hořava gravity, whose exact scalar equation is nonseparable due to rotation-induced Lorentz violation. We develop two complementary approximations that both preserve the exact Kerr sector: Method I applies a slow-rotation approximation only to the nonseparable Lorentz-violating part, whereas Method II employs a small-$η$ biorthogonal spheroidal projection, with $η$ the Lorentz-violating parameter. Using residual-controlled continuation and symmetric finite differences, validated by a Kerr continued-fraction benchmark and an independent radial spectral method, we compute the linear frequency response. Axisymmetric modes provide an exact Kerr null test. For the corotating modes studied, the real-frequency response is positive and increases with spin. At $a/M=0.9$, the two methods reveal a roughly $2\%$ angular correction to the real response, while the imaginary response is nonmonotonic and highly sensitive to angular projection due to internal cancellation. These results highlight the distinct rotational signatures of Lorentz violation in black-hole ringdown.

</details>


### [411] [Exact Rotating Wormholes in Five Dimensions and Their Exceptional-Point Instability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38659)
*Jose Luis Blázquez-Salcedo,Luis Manuel González-Romero,Fech Scen Khoo,Burkhard Kleihaus,Jutta Kunz,Pablo Navarro Moreno*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 本文对等角动量旋转五维 Ellis–Bronnikov 虫洞（wormhole）给出独立的闭式构造，并将径向不稳定性（radial instability）问题精确求解，指出实数本征值处理中“不稳定性消失”实为例外点（exceptional point）之后的振荡型不稳定性（oscillatory instability）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动机是独立地以闭式（closed-form）方式构造等角动量旋转五维 Ellis–Bronnikov 虫洞，并厘清此前实数本征值处理中径向不稳定性的表观消失是否意味着稳定化。

Method: 方法上将非平凡耦合度规方程（coupled metric equations）精确约化为开放的 A₂ Toda 系统（open A₂ Toda system），用初等 Toda tau 函数（Toda tau functions）表示双端通解；对称子类退化为在静态虫洞与极端等自旋 Myers–Perry 几何之间插值的单参数族，并在该精确背景上重做余一维（cohomogeneity-one）微扰问题。

Result: 结果发现，除静态虫洞原有的不稳定模外，旋转使非归一化零模（non-normalizable zero mode）的后代模变为可归一化（normalizable）；两支纯虚不稳定频率在 |J|/A=0.100628 处合并、本征矢亦合并，对应二阶例外点（second-order exceptional point），其后以 ω±=±ω_R+iω_I（ω_I>0）延续，进入快速旋转区后增长率被强烈压低。

Conclusion: 结论是原实数本征值处理中径向不稳定性的表观丧失并非稳定化，而是向振荡型不稳定性的转变；该不稳定分支可延伸至快速旋转区，其增长率显著受抑。

Abstract: We give an independent closed-form construction of rotating five-dimensional Ellis--Bronnikov wormholes with equal angular momenta and analyze the radial instability of the reflection-symmetric family. The nontrivial coupled metric equations reduce exactly to an open $A_2$ Toda system. The general two-ended solution is expressed in terms of elementary Toda tau functions; the symmetric subclass reduces to a particularly simple one-parameter family interpolating between the static wormhole and the extremal equal-spin Myers--Perry geometry. On this exact background we revisit the cohomogeneity-one perturbation problem. Besides the ordinary unstable mode of the static wormhole, rotation renders the descendant of its non-normalizable zero mode normalizable. The two purely imaginary unstable frequencies coalesce at $|J|/A=0.100628$, where their eigenvectors coalesce as well, identifying a second-order exceptional point. Beyond it the pair continues as $ω_\pm=\pmω_R+\mathrm iω_I$ with $ω_I>0$: the apparent loss of the radial instability found in the original real-eigenvalue treatment is therefore not stabilization, but a transition to an oscillatory instability. We follow this branch deep into the rapidly rotating regime, where its growth rate becomes strongly suppressed.

</details>


### [412] [Resonance correction to time-dependent finite-size effects in Effective Field Theory of binary black hole inspiral](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38668)
*Shani Avitan,Ram Brustein*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 该文利用点粒子有效场论（point-particle effective field theory）框架，计算双星旋进（binary inspiral）中谐振激发（resonant excitation）对超致密天体（UCOs）潮汐变形的增强效应，发现静态电四极Love数$k_2$为负，且谐振激发诱导出领先的2.5 Post-Newtonian项。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 广义相对论（General Relativity）预言黑洞无内部结构且潮汐Love数（tidal Love numbers）为零；若天体物理黑洞实为具内部结构的超致密天体（ultra-compact objects, UCOs），其潮汐变形会在双星旋进中向天体转移轨道能量并使引力波相位留下可观测印记。已有讨论指出谐振激发的增强效应，本文旨在定量计算该增强。

Method: 采用点粒子有效场论（point-particle effective field theory）框架，考虑圆轨道（circular orbits），聚焦内部电四极（internal electric quadrupole）的激发，将UCO谱建模为谐振子谱（harmonic oscillator spectrum）；通过积分掉（integrate out）内部四极，诱导出一系列含特定数值系数的时间依赖有限尺寸算符（finite-size operators）并予以计算。

Result: 静态电四极Love数$k_2$为负，且所有有限尺寸项均正比于$k_2$；谐振激发诱导出领先的2.5 Post-Newtonian项，而时间无关情形为5 Post-Newtonian项。

Conclusion: 结果证实双星旋进中的谐振激发是探测天体物理黑洞能否发生潮汐变形、并在可变形时了解其内部激发谱的最佳途径之一；所提方法可径直推广至更复杂情形。

Abstract: General Relativity predicts that black holes lack an internal structure and that their tidal Love numbers vanish. However, if astrophysical black holes were instead ultra-compact objects (UCOs) with internal structure, their tidal Love numbers would no longer vanish. Then, during a binary inspiral, their tidal deformation could transfer orbital energy to the UCO, increasing the orbital period and leaving an observable imprint on the phase of the emitted gravitational waves. As we discussed previously, the effect is enhanced if one binary companion is resonantly excited. Here we use the point-particle effective field theory framework to calculate this enhancement. We consider circular orbits and focus on excitations of the internal electric quadrupole, modelling the UCO spectrum as a harmonic oscillator spectrum. However, our methods could be straightforwardly extended to more complicated situations. Integrating out the internal quadrupole induces a series of time-dependent finite-size operators with specific numerical coefficients, which we calculate. We find that the static electric quadrupole Love number $k_2$ is negative, and that all finite-size terms are proportional to $k_2$. We further show that resonant excitation induces a leading 2.5 Post-Newtonian term, compared with the 5 Post-Newtonian term in the time-independent case. Our results confirm the expectation that resonant excitation during a binary inspiral offers one of the best ways to detect whether astrophysical black holes can undergo tidal deformation and, if they do, learn about their internal excitation spectrum.

</details>


### [413] [Gravitational field of spinors with torsion and matter$-$antimatter asymmetry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38738)
*Nikodem Popławski*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 该文在带挠率（torsion）的弯曲时空中推导球形旋量的狄拉克方程（Dirac equation），指出挠率导致物质与反物质之间的能量不对称（energy asymmetry）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自由狄拉克粒子在弯曲时空中轨道角动量与自旋角动量的守恒要求仿射联络（affine connection）具有反对称部分，即挠率张量（torsion tensor），从而把广义相对论（general relativity）推广为爱因斯坦-嘉当理论（Einstein–Cartan theory）。

Method: 采用旋量联络形式（spinor connection formalism），在带挠率的球对称引力场中推导球形旋量的狄拉克方程，并确定其能量-动量张量（energy–momentum tensor），进而给出爱因斯坦-嘉当-狄拉克方程（Einstein–Cartan–Dirac equations）。

Result: 在挠率存在时，狄拉克方程成为旋量波函数的非线性三次方程；电荷共轭（charge conjugation）下非线性项相对质量项变号，故旋量与其电荷共轭满足不同场方程。挠率的能量贡献对物质粒子为负、对反物质粒子为正，因而费米子（fermion）基态能量低于相应反费米子基态。

Conclusion: 所得爱因斯坦-嘉当-狄拉克方程表明存在类粒子孤子解（soliton solutions），并呈现物质-反物质能量不对称（matter–antimatter energy asymmetry）。

Abstract: The conservation law for the orbital plus spin angular momentum of a free Dirac particle in curved spacetime requires that the affine connection has the antisymmetric part: the torsion tensor, which extends general relativity to the Einstein$-$Cartan theory of gravity. In spacetime with torsion, the Dirac equation becomes a nonlinear, cubic equation in the spinor wave function. Under charge conjugation, the nonlinear term changes sign relative to the mass term. A Dirac spinor and its charge conjugate therefore satisfy different field equations. We use the spinor connection formalism to derive the Dirac equation for a spherical spinor in its centrally symmetric gravitational field with torsion. We determine the energy$-$momentum tensor for this spinor and show that the energy contribution from torsion is negative for matter particles and positive for antimatter particles. Consequently, the ground state of a fermion has a lower energy than the ground state of the corresponding antifermion. We also derive the Einstein$-$Cartan$-$Dirac equations for this spinor; they indicate the existence of particle-like soliton solutions exhibiting matter$-$antimatter energy asymmetry.

</details>


### [414] [Isospectrality breaking in the axial quasinormal modes of Reissner-Nordström black holes in dynamical Chern-Simons gravity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38742)
*Abhishek Rout*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 该文研究动力学陈-西蒙斯引力（dynamical Chern-Simons gravity）中Reissner-Nordström黑洞的奇宇称（odd-parity）微扰，指出赝标量微扰在领头阶仅进入轴矢扇区（axial sector），从而破坏广义相对论中轴矢—极化等谱性（isospectrality），并给出分支分辨的准正规模（quasinormal-mode）频移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: dCS作用量因两个赝标量之积而具有宇称不变性，但赝标量微扰本身为奇宇称，可能在线性阶耦合轴向引力与电磁微扰，从而破坏广义相对论中轴向—极化扇区的等谱性；论文旨在定量刻画该破缺及电荷的影响。

Method: 直接从线性化场方程导出赝标量与轴向引力、电磁微扰之间的有限电荷耦合，径向核为 (Mr−Q²)Δ/r⁸，耦合形式为 Ψ+χΨ_e，χ=2Q/[r√((l−1)(l+2))]。对Einstein–Maxwell扇区对角化后，用外复标度法（exterior complex scaling）计算光子球模的频移，用Frobenius打靶法处理近极端零阻尼模。

Result: Schwarzschild l=2 基模得 βδω=−0.7733−0.3946 i（M=α=1）。失谐时Q=0下引力主导频移随 ζ l³ 增长，固定非零电荷大l下则为 ζ l²/Q。电磁主导分支在 Q_c=2M√(l(l+1)+1)/[l(l(l+1)+2)]（原文分母为 l(l+1)+2）处与赝标量模严格简并，破缺为 O(√ζ)，l=2 时 M|Δω|≃2.4√ζ，且频移在 Q_c 两侧变号。近极端时光子球频移有限，而非简并的引力主导零阻尼基模被压低，l=2 时 δω/ω≃6.0×10³ ζ(1−Q²/M²)。

Conclusion: dCS引力中电荷使赝标量模与轴向扇区发生选择性耦合，导致等谱性破缺呈分支依赖与电荷依赖的标度行为，并在特定临界电荷处出现简并与频移符号反转；近极端黑洞中零阻尼模被显著抑制。

Abstract: We study odd-parity perturbations of Reissner-Nordström black holes in dynamical Chern-Simons gravity. The dCS action is parity invariant because $\vartheta\,{}^{*}RR$ is the product of two pseudoscalars; nevertheless, the pseudoscalar perturbation has odd parity and enters only the axial sector at linear order and so lifts the axial--polar isospectrality of general relativity. We derive the finite-charge couplings between the pseudoscalar and the axial gravitational and electromagnetic perturbations directly from the linearized field equations. Both directions are governed by the radial kernel $(Mr-Q^2)Δ/r^8$, and at nonzero charge the pseudoscalar couples to $Ψ+χΨ_e$, with $χ=2Q/[r\sqrt{(l-1)(l+2)}]$. After diagonalizing the Einstein--Maxwell sector, we compute branch-resolved quasinormal-mode shifts with exterior complex scaling for the photon-sphere modes and Frobenius shooting for the near-extremal zero-damping modes. For the Schwarzschild $l=2$ fundamental mode we obtain $β\,δω=-0.7733-0.3946\,i$ (units $M=α=1$). Off resonance, the gravitational-led shift scales as $ζ\,l^3$ at $Q=0$ but as $ζ\,l^2/Q$ at fixed nonzero charge and large $l$. The electromagnetic-led branch becomes exactly degenerate with the pseudoscalar mode at $Q_c=2M\sqrt{l(l+1)+1}/[l(l+1)+2]$, where the pseudoscalar potential coincides with the polar partner of the electromagnetic-led potential; there the breaking is $\mathcal{O}(\sqrtζ)$, $M|Δω|\simeq2.4\sqrtζ$ for $l=2$, and the shift reverses sign across $Q_c$. Near extremality the photon-sphere shifts remain finite, whereas the non-degenerate fundamental gravitational-led zero-damping mode is suppressed, $δω/ω\simeq6.0\times10^{3}\,ζ\,(1-Q^2/M^2)$ for $l=2$.

</details>


### [415] [Bosonic Dark Matter Cores Can Screen Scalar-Tensor Gravity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38746)
*Jorge Castelo Mourelle,Saeed Fakhry,Néstor Ortiz*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 该文在无质量 Damour-Esposito-Farèse 引力框架下，结合 MPA1 核物态方程与自相互作用复标量场（超轻玻色暗物质模型），检验标量化费米-玻色星（scalarized fermion-boson stars, FBSs）的可观测可行性，并给出三项主要结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目的是评估标量化费米-玻色星在观测上是否可行，即在多信使（multi-messenger）质量-半径约束窗口内检验无质量 Damour-Esposito-Farèse 引力中该类星体模型能否成立。

Method: 采用 MPA1 核物态方程（nuclear equation of state）描述费米子物质，并以自相互作用复标量场（self-interacting complex scalar field）作为超轻玻色暗物质（ultralight bosonic dark matter）模型，将恒星模型限制在多信使动机的质量-半径窗口内进行分析。

Result: 三项结果：其一，玻色暗物质充当自发标量化（spontaneous scalarization）的催化剂；其二，能量上占优的构型为标量化 FBSs，其玻色暗物质核心可协调强耦合区与半径上限；其三，暗物质核心倾向于压低标量荷（scalar charge），类似大质量引力标量场效应，或有助于规避观测约束。

Conclusion: 标量化 FBSs 仅在高质量区间出现这一排他性预言，提供了检验该理论情景的一种途径。

Abstract: We examine the observational viability of scalarized fermion-boson stars (FBSs) in massless Damour-Esposito-Farèse gravity, using the MPA1 nuclear equation of state and a self-interacting complex scalar field playing the role of an ultralight bosonic dark matter model. Constraining stellar models within a multi-messenger-motivated mass-radius window, we obtain three main results: First, bosonic dark matter acts as a catalyst for spontaneous scalarization. Second, energetically favored configurations are scalarized FBSs featuring bosonic dark matter cores that reconcile strongly coupled regimes with radius bounds. Third, dark matter cores tend to suppress scalar charges, which mimics the effect of a massive gravitational scalar field and could contribute to evade observational constraints. Additionally, the exclusive prediction of scalarized FBSs at high masses suggests a way to test this theoretical scenario.

</details>


### [416] [Fermion-Boson Stars in Scalar-Tensor Gravity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38747)
*Jorge Castelo Mourelle,Saeed Fakhry,Néstor Ortiz*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 本文在无质量 Damour-Esposito-Farèse 标量-张量引力理论中，数值构建了由费米子与玻色子物质（仅通过引力相互作用）混合组成的静态球对称星体模型，并系统研究其自发标量化（spontaneous scalarization）行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有星体标量化研究多集中于单一物质成分，混合费米子-玻色子体系在标量-张量理论下的自发标量化是否发生及其参数依赖性尚不明确，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 采用数值方法求解静态球对称混合星模型：费米子部分建模为理想流体（perfect fluid），玻色子部分描述为有质量自由复标量场（complex scalar field）；在不同玻色子质量、中心费米子压强与中心玻色子振幅下系统扫描参数，并考察解序列及质量-半径曲面。

Result: 混合费米子-玻色子星可发生自发标量化；参数间存在复杂耦合，产生多种标量化构型，从嵌入延展玻色子晕（bosonic halo）中的费米子物质，到被费米子物质包裹的玻色子核心（bosonic core）。同时确定了标量化起始的临界耦合参数（critical coupling parameter）。

Conclusion: 玻色子场在混合星标量化中起重要作用，其质量与振幅显著影响标量化构型形态；所得临界耦合参数与质量-半径解序列为后续稳定性与观测检验研究提供基础。

Abstract: In the massless Damour-Esposito-Farèse scalar-tensor theory of gravity, we numerically construct static, spherically symmetric star models composed of a mixture of fermionic and bosonic matter, interacting purely gravitationally. The fermionic sector is modeled as a perfect fluid, while the bosonic sector is described by a massive, free, complex scalar field. We demonstrate that mixed fermion-boson stars can undergo spontaneous scalarization, and we systematically investigate the role played by the bosonic field across different regimes of bosonic mass, central fermionic pressure, and central bosonic amplitude. Our analysis reveals a complex interplay among the parameters, giving rise to a variety of scalarized configurations, ranging from fermionic matter embedded within extended bosonic halos to bosonic cores confined within fermionic matter. We examine sequences of solutions, in particular mass-radius surfaces, and we determine the critical coupling parameter for the onset of scalarization.

</details>


### [417] [Constructing likelihoods for a non-Gaussian gravitational-wave background](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38765)
*Tore Boybeyi,Vuk Mandic,Joseph Romano*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 该文将多探测器随机引力波背景（stochastic gravitational-wave background）的数据分析问题重构为数据特征函数（characteristic function）框架，证明既有搜索方法均为其不同极限情形，并给出构造新近似充分统计量（approximate sufficient statistics）的途径，并用一个可精确求解的玩具模型（toy model）作示例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 恒星质量致密双星（stellar-mass compact binaries）产生的随机引力波背景由有限数目并合事件构成，因而具有非高斯性（non-Gaussian），标准互相关统计量（cross-correlation statistic）之外的多种搜索方法虽已发展，但缺乏统一的理论表述。

Method: 以多探测器数据的特征函数（characteristic function）重新表述该类天体物理背景的数据分析问题，考察既有搜索在其不同极限下如何复现，并通过特征函数的不同近似构造新的搜索统计量。

Result: 既有各类搜索被证明是该特征函数框架的不同极限情形（limiting cases）；通过对特征函数作不同近似，可获得构造合适近似充分统计量（approximate sufficient statistics）的具体方法。

Conclusion: 该框架为恒星质量双星非高斯随机背景的搜索提供了统一的表述与系统性构造新统计量的途径，并以一个可精确求解的玩具模型（toy model）验证了形式体系的可操作性。

Abstract: The stochastic gravitational-wave background from stellar-mass compact binaries is non-Gaussian since it is made up of a finite number of individual mergers. Over the years, several methods have been developed to search for this background beyond the standard cross-correlation statistic. We reformulate the data analysis problem for such astrophysical backgrounds in terms of the characteristic function of the data in multiple detectors, and show that the existing searches arise as different limiting cases. We also show that new searches can be constructed through different approximations of the characteristic function, which gives a concrete way to engineer suitable approximate sufficient statistics. To illustrate this framework in the context of a simple example, we use the formalism proposed here to analyze an exactly solvable toy model.

</details>


### [418] [Unifying stochastic and deterministic signals: a practical search for the intermittent binary black-hole background](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38766)
*Tore Boybeyi,Vuk Mandic,Joseph Romano*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 提出一种基于似然的快速精确搜索方法，用于探测由亚阈致密双星并合构成的间歇性引力波背景（gravitational-wave background）。该似然统一了模型无关互相关搜索与模板基确定性搜索，并通过对单个并合外在参数的完全边缘化及高阶广义重叠消减函数（generalized overlap reduction function）捕捉频率箱间关联。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Advanced LIGO、Advanced Virgo 与 KAGRA 已探测近400例致密双星并合，但多数并合过弱无法单独探测；由于单个双黑洞（binary black hole, BBH）并合在带内时长远短于平均并合间隔，这些亚阈事件构成必然存在却尚未被现有随机或确定性搜索探测到的间歇性引力波背景，需更灵敏统一的搜索方法。

Method: 构建截断似然比（truncated likelihood ratio），对单个并合的外在参数（extrinsic parameters）完全边缘化，将双探测器数据表示为近似充分统计量（approximate sufficient statistics）的展开；这些统计量为数据的高阶交叉矩，并由推广标准重叠消减函数（overlap reduction function, ORF）的几何因子加权。方法在一年模拟 Advanced LIGO 数据上验证。

Result: 分析表明，几乎全部关于 BBH 并合种群的贝叶斯证据（Bayesian evidence）与信息来自单个并合引起的频率箱间相关，并被高阶广义 ORF 捕获；因此任何忽略频率间相关的似然函数必然次优。在一年模拟数据上，结合已探测与未分辨并合信息的目录信息分析（catalog-informed analysis）可推断 BBH 种群红移分布（redshift distribution）的峰值。

Conclusion: 该统一似然框架为探测亚阈 BBH 并合背景提供了快速且精确的途径，并强调频率箱间相关性对最优搜索的必要性；数值验证支持其在种群推断（如红移分布峰值）方面的有效性。

Abstract: Over the past decade, the Advanced LIGO, Advanced Virgo, and KAGRA detectors have detected nearly 400 compact binary mergers, most of which are stellar-mass binary black-hole (BBH) mergers. Nevertheless, most mergers in the Universe are too weak to be individually detected at current sensitivity levels. Since a BBH merger in band is much shorter than the average time between successive mergers, the population of these subthreshold events gives rise to an intermittent background of gravitational waves (GWs). This GW background is guaranteed to exist, but it has not yet been detected with current stochastic or deterministic searches. Here we propose a fast and accurate likelihood-based search for this background, which unifies the standard model-agnostic cross-correlation search and a fully deterministic, template-based search in a single likelihood. Our search is based on a truncated likelihood ratio, which is fully marginalized over the extrinsic parameters of the individual mergers, and which represents the data in two detectors as an expansion in terms of approximate sufficient statistics. These statistics are higher-order cross-moments of the data, weighted by geometrical factors that generalize the standard overlap reduction function (ORF) used in cross-correlation searches. We show that almost all the Bayesian evidence and information on the BBH merger population comes from correlations between frequency bins induced by individual mergers and is captured in the higher-order generalized ORFs. Consequently, any likelihood function that does not take these inter-frequency correlations into account is necessarily suboptimal. We validate our search on one year of simulated Advanced LIGO data, and find that a catalog-informed analysis, which uses information from both the detected and unresolved mergers, can infer the peak of the redshift distribution of the population of BBH mergers.

</details>


### [419] [The General-Relativistic Limit of f(R) Gravity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38795)
*Philippe G. LeFloch,Yue Ma*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 本文建立了f(R)引力（f(R) gravity）耦合无质量标量场（massless scalar field）在闵可夫斯基时空（Minkowski spacetime）附近小初值下的广义相对论极限（general-relativistic limit），证明全局存在性、未来因果测地完备性（future causal geodesic completeness）以及在f(R)→R时向爱因斯坦-无质量标量解的一致收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为刻画修改引力理论（modified gravity）f(R)在弱场小初值情形下是否回归广义相对论（general relativity），需严格证明其广义相对论极限。

Method: 采用欧几里得-双曲叶状化方法（Euclidean-hyperboloidal foliation method）与适配波坐标（adapted wave coordinates），分析一个非线性项不满足经典零条件（null condition）的拟线性波-克莱因-戈尔登系统（quasilinear wave-Klein-Gordon system），并结合振荡估计（oscillatory estimates）、加权内外能量与迹关系偏差的传播估计。

Result: 证明了全局存在性与未来因果测地完备性，得到度规、物质场与重标度有效场的一致估计；物理与共形度规及物质场在未来整个时空上连同有限阶时空导数一致收敛到极限爱因斯坦解，有效场亦收敛到极限解的标量曲率。

Conclusion: 主要困难在于有效场质量趋于无穷、其演化方程退化为代数迹关系，且小幅值可与高频振荡及较大导数共存；紧凑区域上的定量收敛与一致时空衰减共同给出全局收敛，从而严格确认了f(R)引力的广义相对论极限。

Abstract: We establish the general-relativistic limit of f(R) gravity coupled to a massless scalar field for small, asymptotically Euclidean, well-prepared Cauchy data near Minkowski spacetime. We prove global existence and future causal geodesic completeness, with uniform estimates for the metric, matter, and rescaled effective field as an admissible family of modified Lagrangians f(R) approaches the Einstein-Hilbert Lagrangian R. The physical and conformal metrics and the matter field converge to the limiting Einstein-massless-scalar development, uniformly on the entire future spacetime, together with finitely many space and time derivatives. The effective field, defined by a nonlinear reparametrization of the physical scalar curvature, converges to the scalar curvature of the limiting Einstein development. The main analytical difficulty is that the effective-field mass tends to infinity, while its evolution equation becomes an algebraic trace relation. Small field amplitudes may coexist with high-frequency oscillations and comparatively large derivatives, whose quadratic contributions must be controlled uniformly. Using the Euclidean-hyperboloidal foliation method and adapted wave coordinates, we analyze a quasilinear wave-Klein-Gordon system whose nonlinearities do not satisfy the classical null condition. We combine oscillatory estimates, weighted interior and exterior energies, and propagation estimates for the discrepancy from the Einstein trace relation. Quantitative convergence on compact regions and uniform spacetime decay yield global convergence.

</details>


### [420] [Integrable singularities obstruct Cauchy horizons and mass inflation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38826)
*Francisco Tello-Ortiz*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 该文论证一类具有可积奇异密度（ρ∼A/r², A>1/(8π)）的静态球对称各向异性黑洞内部与Poisson-Israel-Ori质量膨胀机制不相容：紧致度q=m/r在其中单调下降并在事件视界处达1/2，形成严格正的“紧致度间隙”，从而排除第二零点（即内Cauchy视界）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 内Cauchy视界（inner Cauchy horizon）的不稳定性经质量膨胀（mass-inflation）机制被视为强宇宙监督（strong cosmic censorship）的动力学实现。作者试图检验是否存在一类物质源使该放大通道在结构上失效。
