Method: 采用广义相对论中的静态球对称各向异性解分析，结合零能量条件（null energy condition）与动力学屏蔽条件，考察零向演化下2m/r的单调性；并分别对入射辐射（广义Vaidya度规）、对向零尘埃（counter-streaming null dust）分析蓝移与Misner-Sharp质量μ的耦合方程，其薄壳极限即DTR关系。

Result: 在间隙存在时：(i) 2m/r沿陷阱区两个未来零向非减，间隙在非线性球对称演化中传播；(ii) 入射辐射在间隙区的先进时间有限，而在Cauchy视界处发散；(iii) μ满足∂u∂vμ=2∂uμ∂vμ/(r|f|)，耦合系数2/(r|f|)一致有界，给出先验质量上界；Ori薄壳模型中e-folding率受流入光度限制而非趋于内视界表面引力。

Conclusion: 可积奇异内部构成一类物质源，使质量膨胀的原始模型框架中的Poisson-Israel-Ori放大通道在结构上无法运作，从而对强宇宙监督的普适性提出限定。

Abstract: Black-hole interiors with an inner (Cauchy) horizon are unstable through the Poisson-Israel-Ori mass-inflation mechanism, governed by the Dray-'t Hooft-Redmount relation and widely regarded as a dynamical realization of strong cosmic censorship. We show that static, spherically symmetric anisotropic interiors supported by a marginally divergent but integrable density $ρ\sim A/r^2$, with $A>1/(8π)$ and mild screening at finite radius, are incompatible with this mechanism. The compactness $q=m/r$ decreases monotonically from a super-critical central value to $1/2$ at the unique event horizon, producing a strictly positive compactness gap throughout the trapped region and excluding any second zero of the lapse. This gap enters the dynamics quantitatively. (i) Under the null energy condition and a dynamical screening condition, $2m/r$ is non-decreasing along both future null directions of a trapped domain, so the gap propagates under nonlinear spherically symmetric evolution. (ii) For ingoing radiation (generalized Vaidya), the gap bounds the blueshift: the advanced time spent in the gapped region is finite, whereas it diverges at a Cauchy horizon. (iii) For counter-streaming null dust, the radiative part $μ$ of the Misner-Sharp mass obeys exactly $\partial_u\partial_vμ=2\,\partial_uμ\,\partial_vμ/(r|f|)$, of which the DTR relation is the thin-shell form; the in-out coupling $2/(r|f|)$ is uniformly bounded on the interior precisely when the gap is positive. This yields an a priori mass bound and, in the Ori thin-shell model, an e-folding rate bounded by the influx luminosity instead of tending to the inner-horizon surface gravity. Integrable-singularity interiors thus realize a class of sources for which the Poisson-Israel-Ori amplification channel is structurally inoperative in the models in which mass inflation was originally established.

</details>


### [421] [Probing Scalar Polarization with Next-Generation Gravitational-Wave Detectors: The Roles of Detector Geometry and Source Inclination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38956)
*Sk Md Adil Imam,Macarena Lagos*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 该文预测（forecast）未来多信使（multi-messenger）观测对引力波标量极化（scalar polarization）的约束能力，表明第三代探测器（CE、ET）可将PPE参数改善1–2个数量级，且电磁（EM）提供的倾角（inclination）先验能使标量振幅α_B约束收紧约56倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 引力波观测为检验广义相对论（general relativity）两个张量模式之外是否存在额外极化提供了直接途径，因此需评估未来多信使事件对标量极化的约束潜力。

Method: 采用双中子星（binary neutron star, BNS）注入（injection）进行预测，在PPE（parameterized post-Einsteinian）框架下对三个修改引力参数α（张量振幅）、α_B（标量振幅）与β（张量与标量相位）进行约束估计。

Result: Cosmic Explorer（CE）与Einstein Telescope（ET）相对O5 LIGO-Virgo网络对每个参数收紧1–2个数量级；ET三角几何对α_B较2×CE持续改善约2倍；在类GW170817事件中，加入基于EM的倾角ι先验后α_B约束相对各向同性先验收窄约56倍。

Conclusion: 探测器几何构型与位置良好的电磁外部信息，与网络原始灵敏度同为未来十年标量极化检验的重要杠杆。

Abstract: Gravitational-wave observations of compact binaries offer a direct way to test whether gravity admits polarizations beyond the two tensor modes of general relativity. We perform a forecast to assess how well future multi-messenger events will constrain the presence of scalar polarizations in gravitational waves. Performing binary neutron star injections, we forecast next-generation constraints on three modified gravity parameters in the PPE formalism: $α$ (tensor amplitude), $α_B$ (scalar amplitude) and $β$ (tensor and scalar phase). Cosmic Explorer (CE) and Einstein Telescope (ET) each tighten every parameter by 1--2 orders of magnitude over an O5 LIGO-Virgo network, with ET's triangular geometry giving a persistent $\approx2\times$ improvement over 2$\times$CE on the scalar-mode amplitude $α_B$ in both a GW170817-like and a second, representative BNS. We show that, if the sky position and luminosity distance are known from EM observations, adding an EM-based prior on the orbital inclination $ι$ narrows the $α_B$ constraint by $\approx56\times$ relative to an isotropic inclination prior, for a GW170817-like event. We also assess how EM inclination priors as well as assumptions on the neutron star equation of state may affect the inference on the scalar amplitude $α_B$. Overall, these results indicate that detector geometry and the availability of well-placed EM external information are both important levers --- alongside raw network sensitivity --- for next decade scalar-polarization tests.

</details>


### [422] [Early-time tails in Kerr black hole ringdown](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39058)
*Ansh Gupta,Naritaka Oshita*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 在线性微扰理论框架下，本文定量评估了Kerr黑洞对局域高斯波包散射中格林函数支割（branch cut）贡献相对于准正规模（QNM）振幅的大小，发现ringdown起始时刻支割振幅约为QNM振幅的10%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 黑洞ringdown通常被建模为准正规模（quasinormal modes, QNMs）的叠加，但格林函数的支割会产生非振荡尾巴，可能污染早期ringdown分析，其相对重要性尚缺乏定量刻画。

Method: 在线性微扰理论（linear perturbation theory）下，计算质量为M的Kerr黑洞散射局域高斯波包（Gaussian wave packets）时的支割贡献；将ringdown起始定义为QNM与支割贡献共同重构波形的 Earliest time，并据此比较支割振幅与QNM振幅。

Result: 对特征频率ω0~1/M的波包，ringdown起始处支割振幅典型约为QNM振幅的10%，且对自旋仅有轻微依赖；未与源卷积前的尾巴波形几乎与自旋无关，相对振幅的自旋依赖性主要来自QNM的激发。

Conclusion: 支割贡献可能影响黑洞光谱学（black hole spectroscopy）的精度，尤其在ringdown起始附近。

Abstract: Black hole ringdowns are modelled as a superposition of quasinormal modes (QNMs), although the branch cut of the Green's function produces a nonoscillatory tail that may contaminate early-time ringdown analyses. Within linear perturbation theory, we quantify this branch-cut contribution for the scattering of localised Gaussian wave packets by a Kerr black hole with mass $M$. Defining the onset of ringdown as the earliest time at which the QNM and branch-cut contributions reconstruct the waveform, we evaluate the branch-cut amplitude relative to the QNM amplitude. For wave packets with a characteristic frequency $ω_0\sim 1/M$, the branch-cut amplitude is typically of order $10\%$ of the QNM amplitude at ringdown onset with only a mild dependence on spin. We further find that the tail waveform before convolving with a source is almost independent of spin. The spin dependence of the relative amplitude therefore resides primarily in the excitation of the QNMs. Our results suggest that the branch-cut contribution may affect the accuracy of black hole spectroscopy, particularly near the onset of ringdown.

</details>


### [423] [Complete quasinormal modes of Type-D black holes. II. Extremal Kerr black holes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39095)
*Changkai Chen,Xiaohua Zhang,Zhoujian Cao,Jiliang Jing*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 该论文提出双合流 Heun（double-confluent Heun, HeunD）方法，将完整的准正规模（quasinormal-mode, QNM）谱构造推广至极端 Kerr 黑洞（extremal Kerr black hole），并首次揭示非常规 Class I 序列在极端极限下趋近负超辐射界（negative superradiant bound）等谱结构重组现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有完整 QNM 谱构造通常依赖从非极端自旋外推（extrapolation），缺乏在极端性（extremality）处直接求解的手段，因而难以刻画 Schwarzschild 模族在极端极限下如何重组、以及超辐射界附近的谱结构。

Method: 采用 HeunD 方法，将视界入射（horizon-ingoing）与无穷远出射（infinity-outgoing）的径向解与角向正则性（angular regularity）匹配，直接在极端性处得到频率；并结合自旋连续延拓、独立散射振幅（scattering-amplitude）计算与围道计数（contour count）进行验证与完备性判定。

Result: 对引力扰动（gravitational perturbations），在常规与非常规 Riemann 面（Riemann sheet）上均获得扩展谱，包含跨频率分支割（branch cut）解析延拓（analytic continuation）揭示的额外 QNM；首次表明源自非常规 Schwarzschild 模、m<0 的非常规 Class I 序列在极端极限下以消失的阻尼趋近负超辐射界；并识别出穿插于零阻尼序列之间的有限阻尼模。

Conclusion: 结果表明单一 overtone 截断（overtone cutoff）无法描述向极端性的过渡；超辐射界附近的均匀匹配（uniform matching）可区分临界累积与孤立极端 QNM 并厘清 Riemann 面结构，从而将极端 Kerr 纳入黑洞 QNM 谱的统一处理框架。

Abstract: We develop a double-confluent Heun (HeunD) method that extends our construction of complete quasinormal-mode (QNM) spectra to extremal Kerr black holes. Matching the horizon-ingoing and infinity-outgoing radial solutions together with angular regularity yields the frequencies directly at extremality, without extrapolation from nonextremal spins. For gravitational perturbations, we obtain an expanded spectrum on both conventional and unconventional Riemann sheets, including additional QNMs revealed by analytic continuation across frequency branch cuts. Continuation in spin connects the extremal modes to our complete Schwarzschild spectrum, including its unconventional branches. We show for the first time that unconventional Class I sequences with $m<0$, continued from unconventional Schwarzschild modes, approach negative superradiant bounds with vanishing damping in the extremal limit. We also identify finite-damping modes interspersed among sequences approaching zero damping, showing that a single overtone cutoff cannot describe the transition to extremality. Independent scattering-amplitude calculations verify representative frequencies and their sheet assignments, while a contour count establishes spectral completeness within a bounded frequency domain. Uniform matching near the superradiant bound further distinguishes critical accumulation from isolated extremal QNMs and resolves the associated Riemann-sheet structure. These results bring extremal Kerr into our unified treatment of black-hole QNM spectra and reveal how the Schwarzschild mode families reorganize in the extremal limit.

</details>


### [424] [Gravitational lensing of gravitational waves by a Kerr black hole](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39181)
*Jian-hua He*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 该工作采用(1+1)维时域模求和（mode-sum）方法数值模拟克尔黑洞（Kerr black hole）对引力波（gravitational waves, GWs）的引力透镜效应，发现克尔黑洞表现为衍射受限的厚透镜（diffraction-limited thick lens），并将引力波聚焦为前向光束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究动机在于考察强场引力透镜对引力波波形的影响，并评估自旋（spin）效应在透镜波形中的可辨识性，从而判断非自旋的史瓦西（Schwarzschild）模型能否作为经济有效的替代模型。

Method: 方法上采用(1+1)维时域模求和方案，结合局域化双曲叶状化（hyperboloidal foliation）与静态场重定义，在均匀龟坐标（tortoise-coordinate）网格上实现显式时间演化；入射初始数据由平面波外尔张量（Weyl tensor）投影到Kinnersley标架（tetrad）构造，并通过局域自旋二价旋转与Wigner D矩阵变换处理任意入射角与偏振角，共演化68,000个耦合(j,m)模。

Result: 结果显示：理想波包的主脉冲呈自旋无关的横向高斯分布，而随后的透镜尾波（lensing coda）对自旋敏感；对双星并合信号，强场透镜显著改变并合后铃宕（ringdown），但旋进与并合阶段在克尔与史瓦西背景下几乎一致，不同倾角与偏振下的波形失配（mismatch）低于2.2×10⁻⁵。

Conclusion: 结论表明，非自旋史瓦西模型可作为准确且计算经济的替代方案，用于在当前地面探测器数据中搜寻强场透镜特征。

Abstract: We simulate the gravitational lensing of gravitational waves (GWs) by a Kerr black hole using a $(1+1)$-dimensional time-domain mode-sum approach. To enable efficient explicit time evolution, we implement a localized hyperboloidal foliation combined with a static field redefinition, ensuring bounded characteristic speeds across an extended, uniform tortoise-coordinate grid. Incident GW initial data are constructed by projecting a plane-wave Weyl tensor onto the Kinnersley tetrad. Through local spin-dyad rotations and Wigner $D$-matrix transformations, our framework accommodates both idealized wave packets and realistic binary coalescence signals at arbitrary incidence and polarization angles. To accurately resolve the lensed waveforms, we evolve over $68,000$ coupled $(j,m)$ modes. Our results reveal that a Kerr black hole acts as a diffraction-limited thick lens, focusing GWs into a forward beam. For idealized wave packets, the primary prompt pulse exhibits a spin-independent transverse Gaussian profile, whereas the subsequent lensing coda is sensitive to the black hole's spin. For binary coalescence signals, strong-field lensing substantially modifies the post-merger ringdown. However, the lensed inspiral and merger phases in Kerr and Schwarzschild backgrounds are virtually identical, yielding waveform mismatches below $2.2\times10^{-5}$ across various inclinations and polarizations. These findings demonstrate that non-spinning Schwarzschild models provide an accurate and computationally economical surrogate to search for strong-field lensing signatures with current ground-based detectors.

</details>


### [425] [Energy-flux noise induced by imperfections of the Gaussian beam in the Li-Baker HFGW detector](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39248)
*Lin-Lin Yang,Hao Yu,Pan-Pan Wang,Jin Li,Cheng-Gang Shao*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 该文解析Li-Baker高频引力波探测器中高斯光束缺陷所诱发能量通量噪声，用高阶拉盖尔-高斯模建模，发现共偏振高阶模在最优探测面无切向噪声，而交叉偏振模需极小的功率占比（$10^{-49}$量级）方能使噪信比小于1，据此提出偏振滤波方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Li-Baker高频引力波（high-frequency gravitational wave, HFGW）探测器的实际高斯光束（Gaussian beam, GB）存在非理想性，其诱发能量通量噪声，需量化并加以抑制以保障探测灵敏度。

Method: 以高阶拉盖尔-高斯（Laguerre-Gaussian, LG）光束刻画光束缺陷，对共偏振与交叉偏振$\mathrm{LG}_{nl}$模分别解析推导噪信比（noise-to-signal ratio），并通过蒙特卡洛（Monte Carlo）模拟评估多模总功率占比的影响。

Result: 高阶共偏振LG模在最优探测面（$φ=π/2$或$3π/2$）不产生切向能量通量噪声；高阶交叉偏振LG模则引入不可忽略噪声，代表性参数下单模须满足$σ_{nl}<10^{-46}$，其中$\mathrm{LG}_{01}$最严格（$σ_{01}<6.0\times10^{-49}$），多模总功率占比需低于$10^{-49}$。

Conclusion: 建议在实际实验中加装偏振滤波器（polarization filter）仅保留GB的共偏振分量，从而在保持信号完整性的同时抑制噪声，为Li-Baker HFGW探测器的噪声控制提供理论依据。

Abstract: This paper investigates the energy-flux noise induced by imperfections of the Gaussian beam (GB) in the Li-Baker high-frequency gravitational wave (HFGW) detector. Modeling these imperfections with higher-order Laguerre-Gaussian (LG) beams, we analytically derive the resulting noise-to-signal ratio for both co- and cross-polarized $\mathrm{LG}_{nl}$ modes. It is found that higher-order co-polarized LG beams generate no tangential energy-flux noise at the optimal detection plane ($φ=π/2$ or $3π/2$), whereas higher-order cross-polarized LG beams introduce non-negligible noise. Specifically, for an individual higher-order cross-polarized $\mathrm{LG}_{nl}$ mode under our representative parameters, maintaining the noise-to-signal ratio below unity typically requires the power fraction to satisfy $σ_{nl}<10^{-46}$, with the $\mathrm{LG}_{01}$ mode imposing the most stringent constraint of $σ_{01}<6.0\times10^{-49}$. Monte Carlo simulations suggest that the total power fraction $σ_{\mathrm{total}}$ of multiple higher-order cross-polarized $\mathrm{LG}_{nl}$ modes needs to remain below $10^{-49}$. Consequently, we propose employing a polarization filter to retain only the co-polarized component of the GB adopted in the practical experiment, thereby suppressing the noise while preserving signal integrity. These results provide theoretical guidance for noise control in the Li-Baker HFGW detector.

</details>


### [426] [Scalar-induced gravitational waves in spatially covariant gravity with two tensorial degrees of freedom](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39252)
*Jia-Xi Feng,Yang Yu,Yan-Heng Yu,Xian Gao,Qing-Guo Huang*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 本文研究双张量自由度空间协变引力模型中、最小耦合到 k-essence 标量场的标量诱导引力波（scalar-induced gravitational waves, SIGWs），并考察有限 σ 效应与三次外曲率相互作用对 SIGW 能谱的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究在二次张量作用量与广义相对论（general relativity, GR）相同的前提下，修改后的标量动力学与非线性相互作用是否仍能改变 SIGWs 的能量密度谱。

Method: 在辐射主导期选定参数使二次张量作用与 GR 一致；推导有限 σ≡C₂N̄ 及大|σ|极限下的标量传递函数（scalar transfer functions），构建 SIGW 源函数；进一步引入不影响背景与二次作用的三次外曲率（extrinsic-curvature）相互作用，并对单色与对数正态原初曲率功率谱计算 SIGWs 分数能量密度。

Result: 在所研究的正 σ 取值下，有限 σ 效应相对于 σ→∞ 极限在较大尺度范围内压低谱；在该极限下，三次相互作用在小波数处压低谱、在较大波数处增强谱。

Conclusion: 即使二次张量作用量与 GR 相同，修改的标量动力学与非线性相互作用仍可改变 SIGWs 的分数能量密度。

Abstract: We study scalar-induced gravitational waves (SIGWs) in a spatially covariant gravity model with two tensorial degrees of freedom, minimally coupled to a $k$-essence scalar field. For the parameter choice considered during radiation domination, the quadratic tensor action coincides with that of general relativity (GR). We derive the scalar transfer functions at finite $σ\equiv C_2\bar N$ and in the large-$|σ|$ limit. We then construct the source function of SIGWs. We further examine a cubic extrinsic-curvature interaction that modifies the source function of SIGWs without affecting the background or quadratic actions. We calculate the fractional energy density of SIGWs for monochromatic and log-normal primordial curvature power spectra. We find that, for the positive values of $σ$ studied, finite-$σ$ effects suppress the spectrum over a broad range of scales relative to the result in the $σ\rightarrow \infty$ limit. In this limit, the cubic interaction suppresses the spectrum at small wavenumbers and enhances it at larger wavenumbers. These results show that modified scalar dynamics and non-linear interactions can alter the fractional energy density of SIGWs even when the quadratic tensor action is identical to that of GR.

</details>


### [427] [The seeds and silhouettes of optimal gravitational shielding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39262)
*Bruno Le Floch,Philippe G. LeFloch*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 该文构造具有指定渐近平坦外部几何的完备真空初始数据集（vacuum initial data sets），可将两个小质量（可为负）Schwarzschild 外部区域粘合，并允许任意慢衰减与非零第二基本形式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目标是突破调和衰减（harmonic decay）限制，建立超越调和衰减的最优局域化构造理论，实现外部几何与奇点/内部结构的自由粘合。

Method: 先构造局域种子数据集（seed data sets），使约束误差衰减到任意指定有限阶；再应用配套论文的投影与稳定性定理（projection and stability theorems），并借助调和项与超调和修正进行调节。

Result: 所得数据与种子的差异由 Hamiltonian 和 momentum silhouettes 控制的调和项刻画；引入相对 ADM 能量-动量（relative ADM energy-momentum），即使对不具 ADM 荷的慢衰减数据亦可定义，并可自由调控。

Conclusion: 通过调和衰减项或紧支横向无迹项（compact transverse-traceless terms）调整种子，可自由控制相对 ADM 荷及存在时的总 ADM 荷；粘合 Schwarzschild 度规时总 ADM 质量可独立于质量参数指定。

Abstract: We construct complete vacuum initial data sets with prescribed asymptotically flat exterior geometry, including the gluing of two Schwarzschild exterior regions with small masses (which need not be positive). The construction allows for arbitrarily slow leading decay and nonzero second fundamental form. For leading terms with a fixed radial power, we first construct localized seed data sets whose constraint errors decay to any prescribed finite order, then apply the projection and stability theorems of our companion papers. The resulting vacuum data sets differ from seeds by harmonic terms controlled by Hamiltonian and momentum silhouettes, and by super-harmonic corrections. This difference of harmonic terms is measured by a relative notion of ADM energy-momentum, which is defined even for slowly-decaying data sets that do not admit an ADM energy-momentum. Upon adjusting seed data sets by either harmonic-decaying terms or compact transverse-traceless terms, we freely control this relative ADM charge and, when it exists, the total ADM charge. In particular, when gluing Schwarzschild metrics the total ADM mass can be specified independently of the Schwarzschild mass parameters. Together with our companion papers, these results establish a constructive theory of optimal localization beyond harmonic decay.

</details>


### [428] [Radial pulsations of gravitationally decoupled anisotropic self-bound stars with a generalized linear equation of state](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39346)
*D. Santana,C. Usca,J. Andrade,J. O. Cedeño*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 该文在最小几何形变（minimal geometric deformation）框架下通过引力解耦（gravitational decoupling）构造各向异性自束缚星体，并在广义线性状态方程约束下检验其线性径向稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 平衡态的各向异性不能决定其动力学响应，故需引入额外物质规定并考察相同平衡构型是否可对应不同的径向振动谱。

Method: 保留 Tolman IV 时间分量势，对总物质分布施加广义线性状态方程 P_r=η(ρ-ρ_s)，由中心正则性与 Schwarzschild 匹配确定径向几何；对 η=1,1/2,1/3,1/4 给出闭式解（η=1/3 且 ρ_s=4B 时对应 MIT 袋模型径向关系），并采用两种保持各向异性（或其与 ρ+P_r 之比）的物质规定，计入度规扰动计算基模与三个泛音。

Result: 12 个平衡构型在两种规定下共 24 组背景响应均给出正的基模频率平方，表明在所用闭合方案内线性径向稳定；各构型族中基模本征值随致密度（compactness）增大而减小，改变各向异性响应所致的频移方向依赖背景。

Conclusion: 结果为自束缚星体提供了可解析处理的背景解，并表明相同的平衡构型在不同各向异性物质响应下可支持不同的径向频谱；同时部分构型的切向张力及最硬族极限下切向分布诊断的失效限制了其物理解释。

Abstract: We construct anisotropic self-bound stellar configurations through gravitational decoupling in the minimal geometric deformation framework and investigate their stability against linear radial perturbations. Retaining the Tolman IV temporal potential, we impose the generalized linear equation of state $P_r=η(ρ-ρ_s)$ on the complete matter distribution. Central regularity and Schwarzschild matching determine the radial geometry and relate the surface density to the compactness and stellar radius. Closed-form solutions are obtained for $η=1,1/2,1/3,1/4$, including the MIT bag radial relation when $η=1/3$ and $ρ_s=4B$. Since the equilibrium anisotropy does not determine its dynamical response, we introduce two material prescriptions that preserve either the anisotropy of each fluid layer or its ratio to $ρ+P_r$. Including metric perturbations, we compute the fundamental mode and three overtones for twelve equilibrium configurations under both prescriptions. All 24 background response combinations have positive fundamental squared frequencies, establishing linear radial stability within the adopted closures. The fundamental eigenvalue decreases with compactness within each sampled family, while changing the anisotropic response produces shifts whose direction depends on the background. Tangential tensions in several configurations and the failed tangential profile diagnostic of the maximally stiff family limit their physical interpretation. These results provide analytically tractable self-bound backgrounds and demonstrate that identical equilibrium configurations can support distinct radial spectra depending on their anisotropic material response.

</details>


### [429] [Emergence of an acoustic black hole in a lattice model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39369)
*Antonino Flachi*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 该工作在晶格模型（lattice model）中，用格子玻尔兹曼（lattice-Boltzmann）的局部碰撞-流动规则演化一个排水涡旋（draining vortex），在未人为施加声学度规（acoustic metric）的情况下从稳态测量出几何，从而构建出声学黑洞（acoustic black hole）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 目标是检验声学黑洞及其相关效应（视界（horizon）、准正规模（quasinormal frequencies）、超辐射（superradiance））能否作为涌现几何（emergent geometry）在微观晶格动力学中自发出现，而非预先写入。

Method: 以格子玻尔兹曼的局部 collide-and-stream 规则模拟排水涡旋，几何由稳态测量得到；视界先由测量的马赫数剖面（Mach profile）定位，再用测量的度规上的声子射线追踪（phonon ray tracing）确认。残余偏差用两种视界模型刻画：理想排水浴缸（draining bathtub）上的反射视界（两个自由参数：反射率的模与相位），以及实现流在其自身参考系中吸收的声速点（sonic point，无可调参数）。

Result: 涌现出视界；微扰后的铃宕（ringdown）近似服从排水浴缸的准正规模，残差归于视界的元胞尺度结构（cell-scale structure）使其非理想吸收体。第二种（声速点、无自由参数）模型对可见视界与不旋转谱的描述最佳。超辐射包含两部分：涌现几何在测量度规的无损计算中产生放大，视界的吸收参考系设定放大带的宽度与强度但不影响铃宕。

Conclusion: 两个模型均用于考察超辐射，但在当前玩具模型（toy model）中尚未观测到超辐射，晶格黑洞是否动态超辐射仍为开放问题。晶格自身也留下印记：声速面的四重各向异性（fourfold anisotropy）与由视界元胞尺度结构决定的表面引力（surface gravity）。

Abstract: We build an acoustic black hole in a lattice model: a draining vortex evolved by the local collide-and-stream rule of a lattice-Boltzmann model, with no acoustic metric imposed, the geometry being measured from the steady state. A horizon emerges, first located from the measured Mach profile and then confirmed by phonon ray tracing on the measured metric, and the ringdown after a perturbation follows approximately the quasinormal frequencies of the draining bathtub. The residual departures are traced to the cell-scale structure of the horizon, which is not an ideal absorber. We model it in two ways: as a reflective horizon on the ideal bathtub, with two free parameters (the modulus and phase of the reflectivity), and as the sonic point of the realised flow absorbing in its own frame, with no adjustable parameter. The second describes the horizon and the non-rotating spectrum best. Superradiance has two ingredients: the emergent geometry, which amplifies in a loss-free calculation on the measured metric, and the horizon, whose absorption frame sets the width and strength of the amplified band but leaves no trace in the ringdown. Both models are used to examine superradiance, which has not been observed in the present toy model: whether the lattice hole superradiates dynamically remains open. The lattice leaves its own imprint as well: a fourfold anisotropy of the sonic surface and a surface gravity set by the cell-scale structure of the horizon.

</details>


### [430] [Horizon Residues, Matter-Trace Winding and Test-Scalar Modes in f(Q,T) Gravity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39370)
*Wen-Xiang Chen,M. Zeeshan Gul*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 本文将二次非度量引力（quadratic non-metricity gravity）中局部视界遗迹的分析推广至含物质迹的功能形式 f(Q)=Q+αQ²+16πλT，并在多项式非线性电动力学下构造精确磁分支，其度规函数为 1-2M/r+q²/r²+C/r⁶（C=ξ(1-4λ)q⁴/10）。该分支上非度量标量消失、二次耦合失效，迹的对数导数给出绕数为 -8 的拓扑刻画，但温度与标量传播仍随修正系数连续变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动机是将此前二次非度量引力中局部视界遗迹（local horizon remnants）的研究扩展到显式含物质迹（matter trace）的理论，以考察迹耦合对毛分支与视界热力学的影响。

Method: 采用定义 f(Q)=Q+αQ²+16πλT 的理论框架，其中 T 由原始物质作用量的能量-动量张量与度规缩并得到；引入多项式非线性电动力学（polynomial non-linear electrodynamics）以产生非零迹，并在重合笛卡尔 Kerr-Schild 坐标（coincident Cartesian Kerr-Schild coordinates）中构造精确磁分支，推导度规与物质方程、欧氏温度、单视界遗迹、主标量方程及一阶规范移位。

Result: 该分支的非度量标量（non-metricity scalar）为零，物质迹正比于距离的负八次幂；度规分量为 1-2M/r+q²/r²+C/r⁶，其中 C=ξ(1-4λ)q⁴/10，故二次非度量耦合在此分支上无效（sterile）。环绕中心奇点的闭合围道上的迹对数导数绕数为 -8，而在足够小的视界围道上绕数为零；但温度与标量传播仍随修正系数连续变化。

Conclusion: 迹绕数（trace winding number）刻画的是除子数据（divisor data），而非取代物质迹或决定其反作用；同时发现迹耦合系数与非线性电磁系数之间存在简并（degeneracy）。结论仅适用于该特定分支，未展开完整耦合引力谱，也不主张该磁度规的首创性。

Abstract: We extend the analysis of local horizon remnants in quadratic non-metricity gravity to a specific matter trace theory with the functional form f(Q) = Q + alpha Q^2 + 16 pi lambda T. Here, the matter trace is defined by contracting the energy-momentum tensor with the metric from the original matter action. In the absence of explicit lambda-corrections, the theory inherits the vacuum logarithmic-connection hairy branch. To obtain a non-zero trace, we introduce polynomial non-linear electrodynamics and construct an exact magnetic branch in coincident Cartesian Kerr-Schild coordinates. The non-metricity scalar of this branch vanishes, while its matter trace is proportional to the inverse eighth power of the distance. Its metric component function is given by 1 - 2M/r + q^2/r^2 + C/r^6, where the correction term C equals xi(1 - 4 lambda)q^4 / 10. Consequently, the quadratic non-metricity coupling is sterile on this branch. We derive the metric and matter equations, the Euclidean temperature, the single-horizon remnant, the master scalar equation, and the first-order gauge shift. The logarithmic derivative of the matter trace imparts a winding number of -8 on a closed contour enclosing the central singularity, but a winding number of zero on a sufficiently small horizon contour. Nevertheless, the temperature and scalar propagation still vary continuously with the correction coefficient. Therefore, the trace winding number classifies divisor data rather than superseding the matter trace or determining its backreaction. This analysis also demonstrates a degeneracy between the trace coupling coefficient and the non-linear electromagnetic coefficient. These results are specific to this particular branch; this paper does not expound upon the full coupled gravity spectrum, nor does it claim priority for this magnetic metric.

</details>


### [431] [Robustness-based selection of laser-locking architectures for time-delay interferometry in space-based gravitational-wave detectors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39432)
*Hao-Kang Chen,Pan-Pan Wang,Cheng-Gang Shao*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 论文提出以鲁棒性（robustness）作为相位参考架构选择的附加判据：基于级联方程（cascade equations）与渗流测度（percolation measures），结合有向参考图（directed reference graphs）与 Erdős–Rényi 支撑层，构建定量比较框架，并证明在非均匀扰动（nonuniform disturbances）与部分依赖下，连通支撑判据（connected-support criterion）可给出与既有深度判据、局部锁定判据及参考路径基线不同的架构偏好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空间引力波探测器（space-based gravitational-wave detectors）依赖激光相位交换、偏频锁相（offset phase locking）与时间延迟干涉（time-delay interferometry, TDI）抑制激光频率噪声；若某一参考源受扰动，依赖它的功能会退化。因此鲁棒性成为选择相位参考架构（phase-reference architecture）的额外判据。

Method: 基于既有级联方程与渗流测度给出定量比较，构造有向参考图与 Erdős–Rényi 支撑层；以参考深度分布（reference-depth distribution）定义均匀扰动下的鲁棒性得分（robustness score），并在非均匀扰动与部分依赖情形下引入连通支撑判据，与深度判据、局部锁定（local-lock）判据及参考路径基线对比，辅以成对有限网络计算。

Result: 均匀扰动下鲁棒性得分由参考深度分布决定；非均匀扰动与部分依赖下，连通支撑判据选出的配置可不同于深度判据、局部锁定判据与参考路径基线。锁相比较偏好限制累积退化、并由保留更大连通支撑的参考向下游激光供源的配置，成对有限网络计算支持这一偏好差异；在 TDI 光输入支撑比较中，“所有航天器均需连通支撑”与“至少一个航天器具备连通支撑”给出不同偏好。

Conclusion: 扰动位置、参考依赖关系与所需支撑范围是改变架构选择的因素；在所设定的统计模型内，鲁棒性排序（robustness rankings）可作为锁相可行性（phase-locking feasibility）与干涉性能的补充，用于空间引力波探测器配置的优先级排序。

Abstract: Space-based gravitational-wave detectors compare laser phases exchanged between distant spacecraft. Offset phase locking keeps beatnotes in the phasemeter band, while time-delay interferometry suppresses laser frequency noise. A disturbance of one reference can degrade the functions that depend on it, making robustness an additional criterion for choosing a phase-reference architecture. We introduce a quantitative comparison based on established cascade equations and percolation measures, with directed reference graphs and Erdős--Rényi support layers. Under uniform disturbances, the robustness score is determined by the reference-depth distribution. Under nonuniform disturbances and partial dependence, the connected-support criterion can select a different configuration from both the published depth and local-lock criteria and a reference-path baseline. The phase-locking comparisons favor configurations that limit accumulated degradation and supply downstream lasers from references retaining greater connected support. Paired finite-network calculations support these differences in preference. In a separate comparison of optical-input support for time-delay interferometry, requiring connected support on all spacecraft gives a different preference from requiring it on at least one spacecraft. These findings identify disturbance location, reference dependence and the required extent of support as factors that can change architecture selection. Within the stated statistical model, robustness rankings can complement phase-locking feasibility and interferometric performance when prioritizing configurations for space-based gravitational-wave detectors.

</details>


### [432] [Covariant phase space analysis of static spherical vacua in power-law $f(R)$ gravity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39484)
*Mariam Campbell,Eduardo Bittencourt,Peter K. S. Dunsby*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 本文利用(1+1+2)分解将幂律度规 $f(R)$ 引力的静态球对称真空方程写成协变自治系统，分析其有限临界集与渐近区域，并对静态径向流做稳定性分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旨在把幂律度规 $f(R)$ 引力的静态球对称真空解组织为受限约化图表（reduced chart）中的动力学系统，从而系统刻画临界点与渐近区域。

Method: 采用(1+1+2)形式（(1+1+2) formalism）构建协变自治系统；结合庞加莱紧化（Poincaré compactification）辅以次级与加权图表处理渐近区域，并通过度规重构（metric reconstruction）识别特定解族。

Result: 有限临界集包括尺度不变的 Clifton–Barrow 解、与 Schwarzschild 族共享的 Minkowski 端点以及归一化图表的退化边界；Clifton–Barrow 平衡在幂律参数的正区间上为外向径向吸引子（attractor），而 Schwarzschild 端点则是多项式扩展系统的鞍点（saddle）。正曲率扇区出现大归一化曲率处的法向吸引叶（normally attracting sheets）；重构还识别出一个标量平坦（scalar-flat）解族，具有规则喉部、一个渐近平坦端与一个曲率奇异端。

Conclusion: 结果仅组织已解析的约化图表与边界区域，并不构成静态球对称真空解的完整分类；所有稳定性陈述仅针对静态径向流。

Abstract: We formulate the static, spherically symmetric vacuum equations of power-law metric $f(R)$ gravity as a covariant autonomous system using the $(1+1+2)$ formalism. The finite critical sets include the scale-invariant Clifton--Barrow solution, a Minkowski endpoint shared by the Schwarzschild family, and degenerate boundaries of the normalized chart. The Clifton--Barrow equilibrium is an outward-radial attractor over a positive interval of the power-law parameter, whereas the Schwarzschild endpoint is a saddle of the polynomially extended system. Poincaré compactification, supplemented by secondary and weighted charts, resolves several asymptotic regimes. In particular, normally attracting sheets at large normalized curvature occur in the positive-curvature sector and are separated from the negative-curvature Clifton--Barrow equilibrium. Metric reconstruction also identifies a selected scalar-flat family with a regular throat, one asymptotically flat end, and a curvature-singular end. These results organize the regular reduced chart and the boundary regimes resolved here; they do not constitute a complete classification of static spherical vacua. All stability statements concern the static radial flow.

</details>


### [433] [Quasinormal Modes of Slowly Rotating Black Holes in Hernquist Halos: Redshift and Angular Momentum](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39548)
*Xing-Hui Feng,Bo Wang*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 本文研究嵌入 Hernquist 晕（Hernquist halo）中黑洞的轴向准正规模式（quasinormal modes），采用含内真空腔（内边界 4M_BH）的静态解析几何并在转动一阶求解参考系拖曳（frame dragging），系统考察质量比与晕致密度（compactness）对基频及一阶泛音的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 黑洞并非孤立存在，其周围环境（如暗物质晕）会改变时空几何与准正规模式。已有工作缺乏对晕致密度与质量比系统性扫描的分析，尤其缺少对转动情形下参考系拖曳及角动量分配作用的定量刻画。

Method: 采用已知的含内真空腔静态解析几何，将参考系拖曳处理到转动一阶。对质量比 ε=M_BH/M_halo 取 0.1 与 0.01、晕致密度 C=M_halo/a_0 取 10^{-4} 至 0.3，计算基频与一阶泛音两支；并以"局部 Kerr 估计"（腔体红移重标度真空频率、视界角动量设定转动劈裂、均匀参考系拖曳叠加实频移）进行解释。

Result: 零自旋时，腔体红移可复现复 ℓ=2 频率，基频相对残差低于 0.04%、一阶泛音低于 0.31%；其弱致密度极限 1−C 解释了稀薄晕中微弱的质量比依赖，较大致密度下精确红移解释了两种质量比序列的大部分差异。固定总角动量时，局域角动量为零与坐标角速度为零的两类晕在实部自旋系数上呈相反致密度趋势；C=0.3 时两者差异在两质量比下分别约 38% 与 54%。而固定视界角动量后差异降至 1% 以下。

Conclusion: 环境（晕）对黑洞准正规模式的影响在很大程度上由角动量分配（angular momentum partition）决定：固定视界角动量即可基本消除不同晕构型的依赖，局部 Kerr 图像配合红移重标度可有效描述含晕黑洞的轴向振荡谱。

Abstract: We investigate axial quasinormal modes of black holes embedded in Hernquist halos, using an established analytic static geometry with an inner vacuum cavity extending to $4M_{\mathrm{BH}}$ and solving for frame dragging to first order in rotation. We compute the fundamental and first overtone branches for mass ratios $ε\equiv M_{\mathrm{BH}}/M_{\mathrm{halo}}$ of $0.1$ and $0.01$, and halo compactness $\mathcal C\equiv M_{\mathrm{halo}}/a_0$ in the range $10^{-4}\leq\mathcal C\leq0.3$. The cavity geometry gives a local Kerr estimate in which redshift rescales the vacuum frequencies, horizon angular momentum sets the rotational splitting, and uniform frame dragging adds a real frequency shift. At zero spin, the cavity redshift reproduces the complex $\ell=2$ frequencies with relative residuals below $0.04\%$ for the fundamental and $0.31\%$ for the first overtone. Its leading weak compactness behavior, $1-\mathcal C$, explains the weak mass ratio dependence in dilute halos; at larger compactness, the exact redshift accounts for most of the separation between the two mass ratio sequences. At fixed total angular momentum, halos with vanishing local angular momentum and those with vanishing coordinate angular velocity exhibit opposite compactness trends in the real spin coefficient. At $\mathcal C=0.3$, their real fundamental mode spin coefficients differ by approximately $38\%$ and $54\%$ for the two mass ratios. Fixing the horizon angular momentum reduces these differences below $1\%$ for both overtones, showing that angular momentum partition accounts for most of the configuration dependence.

</details>


### [434] [Quasinormal Mode Excitation in the Horizon Shear of Near-Extremal Kerr Black Holes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39729)
*Brennen Black*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 近极端Kerr黑洞视界剪切（horizon shear）在偏心极端质量比旋进（EMRI）通过近星点后出现低振幅、高频"抖动（wiggles）"，本研究证明其为Kerr准正规模（QNM）中衰减率在自旋趋于极端时保持有限的"阻尼模分支（damped-mode branch）"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前工作无法将抖动的频率与轨道对应，并据此否定其为准正规模；本文旨在澄清这些抖动的物理本质及其与Kerr QNM谱的关系。

Method: 对赤道顺行轨道（p=3M、e=0.85）在自旋 a/M=0.999 至 0.99999 范围内做时域剪切拟合，分别对基频 (ℓ,m)=(2,1) 与 (3,2) 模进行拟合，并尝试逐多极子单独拟合。

Result: (2,1) 与 (3,2) 基频模被识别为主导与首次主导激发；逐多极子拟合所得频率在Kerr理论值两个标准差以内，并为 (3,1)、(4,1)、(4,2) 基频模的激发提供证据（但全信号中不可分辨）；ℓ≤4 的 m=0 与 m=ℓ 多极子中未发现QNM激发迹象。

Conclusion: 抖动可归因于Kerr QNM的阻尼模分支，且同一抖动应存在于驱动剪切的潮汐场（tidal field）中，从而将抖动频率与轨道及黑洞自旋参数建立了定量对应。

Abstract: The horizon shear of a near-extremal Kerr black hole perturbed by an eccentric extreme mass ratio inspiral shows low amplitude, high frequency oscillations (''wiggles") after periapsis passage. Previous works are unable to tie the frequency of the wiggles to the orbit, and argue they cannot be quasinormal modes (QNMs). We show that they are Kerr QNMs belonging to the damped-mode branch --- that is, modes whose decay rate stays finite as the spin approaches extremality. For an equatorial prograde orbit with $p = 3M$ and $e = 0.85$ and spins ranging from $a/M = 0.999$ to $a/M = 0.99999$, fits to the time-domain shear identify the fundamental $(\ell,m) = (2,1)$ and $(3,2)$ modes as the dominant and first subdominant excitations. Fitting each multipole separately gives frequencies to within two standard deviations of the Kerr values and provides evidence for the excitation of the fundamental $(3,1)$, $(4,1)$ and $(4,2)$ modes, though these are not resolvable in the full signal. We further argue that the same wiggles must be present in the tidal field that drives the shear. For $\ell \leq 4$ we find no evidence of QNM excitation in the $m = 0$ or the $m = \ell$ multipoles.

</details>


### [435] [Topological Interpretations in Anisotropic Kerr-Newman-AdS Black Hole Thermodynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39732)
*Sreeshma A,Md Sabir Ali,C. L. Ahmed Rizwan*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 本文利用 Duan 的 φ-映射理论（φ-mapping theory）与复留数方法（complex residue approach），研究各向异性 Kerr-Newman-AdS 黑洞的热力学拓扑（thermodynamic topology），发现 AdS 项会改变全局拓扑分类，而各向异性物质（anisotropic matter）不改变其拓扑类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 黑洞热力学与拓扑的相互作用提供了坐标无关的框架，可用于揭示黑洞相变（phase transitions）的底层结构及普适特征，本文旨在刻画各向异性 Kerr-Newman-AdS 黑洞的热力学拓扑。

Method: 构造广义离壳自由能（generalized off-shell free energy），在参数空间中定义热力学矢量场（thermodynamic vector field），其零点对应平衡黑洞态；用 Duan φ-映射理论计算缺陷的绕数（winding number）以得到全局拓扑数（global topological number），并采用复留数方法作分析。

Result: 完整各向异性 Kerr-Newman-AdS 黑洞与 K=0 极限的 Kerr-Newman-AdS 黑洞均只有一个绕数为 +1 的热力学缺陷，给出 W = +1；而去除 AdS 贡献的 Kerr-Newman 黑洞有两个绕数 +1 与 −1 的缺陷，全局拓扑数为 W = 0。

Conclusion: AdS 贡献改变了全局拓扑分类，但本文研究的各向异性物质保持 Kerr-Newman-AdS 黑洞的拓扑类；对 Kiselev 型黑洞（Kiselev-type black hole）拓展研究表明，其度规约化为带电黑洞几何（charged black-hole geometry）的情形与其热力学拓扑一致。

Abstract: The interplay between black hole thermodynamics and topology provides a strong, coordinate-independent framework for discovering the underlying structure of black hole phase transitions as well as their universal features. We explore the thermodynamic topology of the anisotropic Kerr-Newman-AdS black hole using Duan's $φ$-mapping theory and a complex residue approach. By creating the generalized off-shell free energy, we propose a thermodynamic vector field in the parameter space with zero points corresponding to equilibrium black hole states. The winding numbers associated with these defects are utilized to calculate the black hole's global topological number. We begin with an analysis of the entire anisotropic Kerr-Newman-AdS black hole, followed by two limiting examples. Setting the anisotropic parameter $K = 0$ produces the Kerr-Newman-AdS black hole, while eliminating the AdS contribution produces the Kerr-Newman black hole. The anisotropic Kerr-Newman-AdS and Kerr-Newman-AdS black holes have a single thermodynamic defect with winding number $+1$, which results in $W = +1$. In contrast, the Kerr-Newman black hole has two defects with winding numbers $+1$ and $-1$, which result in a vanishing global topological number, $W = 0$. These findings show that the AdS contribution alters the global topological classification, but the anisotropic matter studied here preserves the topological class of the Kerr-Newman-AdS black hole. As an analogous limiting instance, we further study a Kiselev-type black hole, analyzing the circumstances in which its metric reduces to a charged black-hole geometry and how the thermodynamic topology reflects this reduction. Finally, we use the complex residue approach on the anisotropic Kerr-Newman-AdS black hole.

</details>


### [436] [HWF Analysis of TRN Black Holes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39757)
*Ashfaque Ahmad,Sudhir Kumar Gupta,Abbas Ali*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 本文将视界波函数（HWF）形式推广至 D+1 维球对称带电无自旋量子源，构建 TRN 黑洞内外视界对应的 HWF 并计算黑洞形成概率，分析其对电荷、质量与维数的敏感性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有 HWF 形式多用于简单或中性源，缺乏对高维带电（TRN）黑洞内、外视界量子描述的刻画，且源参数与维度对形成概率的影响尚不清楚。

Method: 将视界波函数（horizon wave-function）形式推广到 D+1 维球对称、带电、无自旋量子源，构建与 Tangherlini–Reissner–Nordström（TRN）黑洞内视界和外视界相关联的 HWF，并据此计算形成概率 P_BH^±。

Result: 当源偏离由参数 α 定义的极端极限（极端情形下 α→1）时，内、外视界概率之比 P_BH^-/P_BH^+ 由等于 1 发生显著变化；在较高 D 值下形成概率被强烈压低，尤其当源质量 m ≲ Λ_D 时，例如 α=0.5 时 P_BH^+(D=5)/P_BH^+(D=10) 约与 D 个空间维数相关。

Conclusion: 结果表明黑洞形成概率对内、外视界、极端性参数 α、电荷、质量及时空维数 D 均敏感，高维情形下量子源的成洞概率明显受抑制。

Abstract: We extend the horizon wave-function (HWF) formalism to a spherically symmetric, charged, spinless quantum source in $\mathcal{D} + 1$ dimensional spacetime geometry and construct the HWFs associated with inner- as well as outer-horizons of the Tangherlini--Reissner--Nordström (TRN) black hole. The corresponding black hole formation probabilities, $P_{\rm BH}^{\pm}$, are also calculated and their sensitivities due to various source parameters including charge, mass, and $\mathcal{D}$ are analysed as well. Our analysis reveals that the ratio of inner- to outer-horizon probabilities, $P_{\rm BH}^{-}/P_{\rm BH}^{+}$, changes drastically from being unity as the source departs away from being in the extremal limit defined by $α$ ($\to 1$ for extremal case). Furthermore, black hole formation probabilities are found to be highly suppressed for higher values of $\mathcal{D}$, particularly for the source mass, $m \lesssim Λ_{\mathcal{D}}$, e.g., for $α= 0.5$, the ratio, $P_{\rm BH}^{+}(\mathcal{D} = 5)/P_{\rm BH}^{+}(\mathcal{D}=10)$ turn out to be approximately associated with $\mathcal{D}$ spatial-dimensions.

</details>


### [437] [Looking for gravitational waves with orbital dynamics: GUEST mission and the $μ$Hz band of Gravitational Waves](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39881)
*Diego Blas*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 该会议论文综述了利用引力束缚系统轨道作为微赫兹（microhertz）引力波与超轻暗物质（ultra-light dark matter）的共振探测器，并介绍新提出的GUEST卫星任务概念。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微赫兹频段位于脉冲星计时阵列（pulsar timing arrays）与LISA之间，尚未被探测覆盖；该频段可能承载脉冲星计时阵列信号的延伸、早期宇宙（early Universe）信号、原初黑洞（primordial black holes）或暗物质信号，拓展观测频段有望揭示新的宇宙现象。

Method: 利用引力束缚系统（gravitationally bound systems）的轨道作为微赫兹引力波与超轻暗物质的共振探测器（resonant detectors）；并描述GUEST（Gravitational Universe Exploration with Satellite Tracking）任务概念：两颗覆盖回反射器（retroreflectors）的密集无源球体置于高偏心地球轨道（highly eccentric Earth orbits），由全球激光测距网络（global laser-ranging network）跟踪。

Result: 摘要未给出定量探测结果；所介绍的是GUEST任务概念已被提交至ESA F级征集（ESA F-class call），其方案由两颗无源球体与全球激光测距网络构成。

Conclusion: 微赫兹频段是引力波天文学（gravitational-wave astronomy）的重要空白区，轨道共振探测与GUEST等空间任务概念为探索该频段及超轻暗物质提供了可行途径。

Abstract: `Adding colour'' to the gravitational-wave sky by probing unexplored frequency bands has the potential to unveil new and unexpected phenomena in the Universe. The microhertz band, between pulsar timing arrays and LISA, is a particularly attractive target: it should host the extension of the signal recently found by pulsar timing arrays (if it is generated by a family of sources of gravitational waves), and it may harbour signals from the early Universe, primordial black holes or dark matter. In these proceedings, we review how the orbits of gravitationally bound systems act as resonant detectors of microhertz gravitational waves and ultra-light dark matter. We then describe GUEST (Gravitational Universe Exploration with Satellite Tracking), a mission concept recently proposed to the ESA F-class call, consisting of two dense passive spheres covered with retroreflectors, placed in highly eccentric Earth orbits and tracked by a global laser-ranging network.

</details>


### [438] [Self-Bound Anisotropic Stars in $\mathcal{R}+α\mathcal{R}^2$ Gravity with a Hayward Exterior: Junction Conditions and NICER Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39916)
*Furqan Nazeer,Tooba Feroze*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 该文在无Birkhoff定理前提下，用Hayward外解与嵌入类一内部解构造 $\mathcal{F}(\mathcal{R})=\mathcal{R}+\alpha\mathcal{R}^2$ 引力下的解析致密星模型，用二阶引力结条件闭合全部常数，并给出可同时拟合四颗脉冲星且预测 $R_{1.4}=11.5$ km、$M_{\rm max}=2.9M_\odot$ 的结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有修正引力（modified gravity）解析致密星模型通常沿用广义相对论（general relativity）的结条件（junction conditions），并以特定星体模型给出的半径来定常数，做法不自洽。本文旨在避免这两处借用，检验在无Birkhoff定理时外解假设与结条件的实际影响。

Method: 采用 $\mathcal{F}(\mathcal{R})=\mathcal{R}+\alpha\mathcal{R}^2$ 引力，内部为满足Karmarkar条件（Karmarkar condition）的嵌入类一（embedding class one）Durgapal-Bannerji解，外部为Hayward度规（以长度 $\ell$ 对Schwarzschild变形）。以二次引力结条件解析定出全部常数（用 $M$、$R$、$\ell$ 表示），并以 extrinsic curvature 迹的连续性替代 $p_r(R)=0$。

Result: Ricci标量在表面发生跳变，形成负表面能密度薄壳（$\alpha>0$）、引力双层（gravitational double layer）及小的径向应力；欲使应力低于中心压强的1%，需 $\alpha\lesssim0.2$ km$^2$、$\ell\lesssim0.3M$。单一表面能密度 $\rho_s=(1.37\pm0.16)\rho_0$ 可同时复现 PSR J0740+6620、J0437-4715、J0030+0451 与 J0614-3329；$\alpha=0.1$ km$^2$ 时给出 $R_{1.4}=11.5$ km 与最大质量 $2.9M_\odot$。由于 $\ell$ 仅以 $(\ell/M)^2(M/R)^3$ 阶进入表面观测量，结果可延续到Schwarzschild外解。若改用食双星X射线脉冲星的奇异星（strange star）半径标定，则得 $R_{1.4}\approx9$ km，为当前数据排除。

Conclusion: 内部呈现自束缚星（self-bound star）行为；模型在较小 $\alpha$ 与 $\ell$ 下自洽且与多颗脉冲星观测相容，并对奇异星半径标定给出可证伪的判别。

Abstract: Analytic compact-star models in modified gravity usually borrow the junction conditions of general relativity and fix their constants with radii derived for a particular stellar model. Here we avoid both. We study $\mathcal{F}(\mathcal{R})=\mathcal{R}+α\mathcal{R}^{2}$ gravity with a Durgapal-Bannerji interior of embedding class one (Karmarkar condition) and a Hayward exterior. Without Birkhoff's theorem, the exterior is an assumption, and we measure its effect with the Hayward metric, which deforms Schwarzschild by a length $\ell$. The junction conditions of quadratic $\mathcal{F}(\mathcal{R})$ gravity fix all constants in closed form in terms of $M$, $R$ and $\ell$. The condition $p_r(R)=0$ is replaced by continuity of the trace of the extrinsic curvature. The Ricci scalar jumps at the surface, so there is a thin shell with negative surface energy density for $α>0$, a gravitational double layer, and a small radial stress. For this stress to be below 1% of the central pressure we need $α\lesssim0.2$ km$^{2}$ and $\ell\lesssim0.3M$. The interior behaves as a self-bound star. A single surface energy density, $ρ_s=(1.37\pm0.16)ρ_0$, reproduces PSR J0740+6620, J0437-4715, J0030+0451 and J0614-3329, and for $α=0.1$ km$^{2}$ the model predicts $R_{1.4}=11.5$ km and a maximum mass of $2.9 M_\odot$. Because $\ell$ enters surface observables only at order $(\ell/M)^{2}(M/R)^{3}$, the results carry over to a Schwarzschild exterior. Calibrating instead with strange-star radii of eclipsing X-ray pulsars gives $R_{1.4}\approx9$ km, which current data rule out.

</details>


### [439] [Diamonds in the sky: the shape of gravitational waves from cosmic string cusps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39983)
*Auclair Pierre,Gharib Chams,Steer Danièle*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 本文重新深入分析宇宙弦尖点（cosmic string cusps）的引力波（gravitational wave, GW）辐射，指出两个此前文献未描述的特征：单频辐射在天空呈菱形而非锥形，且辐射最强方向为两个略微偏离尖点速度方向的方向；随后研究辐射总功率增强的两种极限情形并统计评估其重要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究旨在超越 Damour 与 Vilenkin 的经典工作，对宇宙弦尖点的引力波辐射做更精细的刻画，以修正已有图像中可能被简化或遗漏的辐射几何与方向性特征。

Method: 在解析层面重新分析尖点辐射的方向结构，并用简化示例加以说明；随后以解析方式考察两种使总辐射功率增强的极限情形，再对奇次谐波环（odd-harmonic loops）群体进行统计估计。

Result: 发现两个新特征：任一给定频率下尖点辐射在天空中呈菱形（diamond-like shape）分布而非集中于锥内；辐射在偏离尖点速度方向的两个略微偏移方向上达到最大。总辐射功率在菱形被沿特定方向拉伸、以及尖点处高阶导数消失两种情形下被增强，并在奇次谐波环群体中统计评估了这些效应的重要性。

Conclusion: 宇宙弦尖点的引力波辐射图案比经典锥形图像更复杂，需以菱形几何与双峰方向性描述；相关增强效应在奇次谐波环群体中的统计重要性已作估计，提示这些效应对宇宙弦引力波预测可能有实际影响。

Abstract: We carry an in-depth analysis of the gravitational wave (GW) emission of cosmic string cusps, going beyond the seminal work of Damour and Vilenkin. We identify two features that, to the best of our knowledge, have not been described in the literature: first the GWs emission from a cusp, at any given frequency, is not concentrated inside a cone but instead draws a diamond-like shape in the sky. Second, the emission is not maximal in the direction of the cusp velocity, but in two slightly offset directions. We explain these effects in detail, and illustrate them with simplified examples. Then, we study two limiting cases for which the overall radiated power is enhanced: when the diamond is stretched in a particular direction, and when higher order derivatives vanish at the cusp. We statistically estimate the importance of these effects in a population of odd-harmonic loops.

</details>


### [440] [Inverse Gertsenshteǐn-Zel'dovich Effect in Time-Independent Electromagnetic Field](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40024)
*Rajendra Prasad Bhatt,Rudraksh Verma,R. Prasad,Sudipta Sarkar*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 本文发展了逆盖尔岑施泰因-泽尔多维奇效应（inverse Gertsenshteǐn-Zel'dovich effect）的一般形式化框架，用于计算引力波穿越空间变化的静态背景电磁场时所诱导的电场与磁场分量，并涵盖引力波的全部六种偏振模式（polarization modes）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有关于逆盖尔岑施泰因-泽尔多维奇效应的研究主要局限于恒定背景电磁场（constant background electromagnetic fields），缺乏对空间变化背景场的通用处理方法。

Method: 建立计算引力波通过空间变化、时间无关背景电磁场所诱导电磁场分量的通用形式化方法（general formalism），该框架可容纳引力波的全部六种偏振模式，并以恒定场与空间变化场等算例加以说明。

Result: 通过若干示例展示了该框架的适用性，并进一步研究了引力波穿过天体物理磁场（尤其是中子星（neutron stars）与磁星（magnetars）相关磁场）所产生的电磁信号。

Conclusion: 该效应将引力波与电磁波这两类多信使天文学（multi-messenger astronomy）的核心信使联系起来，为引力波探测与天体物理观测提供有前景的框架，并可能应用于高频引力波探测器（high-frequency gravitational-wave detectors）设计及高能天体物理电磁信号研究。

Abstract: The inverse Gertsenshteǐn-Zel'dovich effect describes the conversion of gravitational waves into electromagnetic waves in the presence of a background electromagnetic field. This effect has primarily been studied for constant background electromagnetic fields. In this work, we develop a general formalism for calculating the components of the electric and magnetic fields induced by the passage of a gravitational wave through a spatially varying, time-independent background electromagnetic field. The formalism accommodates all six possible polarization modes of gravitational waves. We illustrate its applicability through several examples, including gravitational waves propagating through constant and spatially varying electromagnetic fields. We further investigate the electromagnetic signals generated by the passage of gravitational waves through astrophysical magnetic fields, particularly those associated with neutron stars and magnetars. By connecting gravitational waves and electromagnetic waves--two essential messengers of multi-messenger astronomy--the inverse Gertsenshteǐn-Zel'dovich effect offers a promising framework for both gravitational-wave detection and astrophysical observations. The formalism developed here may therefore find applications in the design of high-frequency gravitational-wave detectors and in the investigation of high-energy astrophysical electromagnetic signals.

</details>


### [441] [Curvature scaling and linear area response in charged black-hole interiors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40043)
*Fu-Guo Yang*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 该文阐明带电黑洞内部（charged black-hole interiors）两条标度律（scaling laws）的产生机制与适用范围：质量暴涨（mass inflation）后形成平台，小标量修正与电修正给出 $K\simeq48m^2/r^6$，并受精确下界与半幂律半径关系约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有文献报道了带电黑洞内部的两条标度律，但其物理机制与适用条件尚不明确，本文旨在识别这些机制并确定其有效区间。

Method: 在球对称演化（spherical evolutions）中引入中性无质量标量场，分析质量暴涨后的平台结构，考察小幅标量修正与电修正对 Kretschmann 标量（Kretschmann scalar）$K$ 的贡献；并利用线性响应（linear response）分析初值标量振幅 $A$ 对面积半径平方 $ρ=r^2$ 的影响，结合完整数值演化检验解析预言。

Result: 得到 $K\simeq48m^2/r^6$，当质量与相对曲率修正随半径缓变时局部指数接近六；精确下界 $K\geq28q^4/(5r^8)$ 排除了有限系数的 $r^{-6}$ 渐近行为，大平台质量将电修正推迟至 $r\sim q^2/m$；在简单零点附近给出半幂律半径律，两机制共存时 $K/m^2\propto(A_*-A)^{-3}$。完整演化确认了电修正、在多个观测时刻支持半幂律，并检验了联合反立方律（inverse-cube law）。

Conclusion: 经典区域可在电修正变得显著之前达到普朗克曲率（Planckian curvature），前提是平台质量足够大；所提出的机制与标度律由完整演化数值检验所支持。

Abstract: We identify the mechanisms and range of validity of two scaling laws reported in charged black-hole interiors. In spherical evolutions with a neutral massless scalar, mass inflation produces a large internal mass $m$, followed by a plateau. Small scalar and electric corrections give $K\simeq48m^2/r^6$, where $r$ is the areal radius and $K$ the Kretschmann scalar. The local exponent is near six when the mass and relative curvature correction also vary slowly with radius. The exact bound $K\geq28q^4/(5r^8)$, with $q$ the charge, excludes a finite-coefficient $r^{-6}$ asymptote, while a large plateau mass delays electric corrections to $r\sim q^2/m$. For sufficiently large plateau mass, this classical regime can reach Planckian curvature before electric corrections become significant. At fixed coordinates and initial gauge, a linear response of $ρ=r^2$ to the initial scalar amplitude $A$ gives the half-power radius law near a simple zero. Where both mechanisms apply, $K/m^2\propto(A_*-A)^{-3}$, with $A_*$ the area zero. Full evolutions confirm the electric correction, support the half-power law at several observation times, and test the joint inverse-cube law.

</details>


### [442] [Photon Rings and Mass-Independent Observables of a Five-Dimensional Charged AdS Black Hole](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40069)
*Amrillokhon Mamatkhonov,Javokhir Sharipov,Tursunali Xamidov,Chen Zhou,Sanjar Shaymatov,Chengxun Yuan*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 本文研究五维带电反德西特（anti-de Sitter, AdS）黑洞的光学特征，提出两个与质量无关的几何观测量——次环指数（subring exponent）γ与临界碰撞参数（critical impact parameter）对最内稳定圆轨道（innermost stable circular orbit, ISCO）直接像相应量之比，并用马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（Markov chain Monte Carlo, MCMC）预测其可观测性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在AdS时空中，黑洞阴影的表观尺寸依赖观测者且受质量标度影响，难以作为干净的观测量；因此需要构造不依赖质量标度与观测者的几何量来刻画黑洞光学性质并与四维黑洞对比。

Method: 利用零测地线方程（null geodesic equations）确定事件视界、光子球（photon sphere）半径与临界碰撞参数；解析推导次环指数γ的闭式表达，并以基于无噪声模拟数据（含5%示例性相对不确定度）的MCMC进行参数预测。

Result: 各特征半径与临界碰撞参数均随电荷增大而减小，光子球半径与AdS半径无关；γ与AdS半径无关且满足2π/√3<γ≤π√2，高于四维Schwarzschild与Reissner–Nordström黑洞的取值。MCMC预测显示无量纲AdS半径可被约束到16%–19%的相对不确定度，电荷仅在近极端（near-extremal）基准模型下可与零区分，γ相对四维Schwarzschild黑洞给出3.4–5.9σ的高斯分离度。

Conclusion: 所提出的质量无关观测量（尤其次环指数γ）可用于区分五维带电AdS黑洞与四维黑洞，并对AdS半径提供有效约束；但电荷的可探测性受模型极端程度限制。

Abstract: We investigate the optical properties of a five-dimensional charged anti-de Sitter (AdS) black hole. Using the null geodesic equations, we determine the event horizon and photon sphere radii and the critical impact parameter, showing that all decrease with increasing charge, while the photon sphere radius remains independent of the AdS radius. To avoid dependence on the mass scale and the observer-dependent apparent size of the shadow in an AdS spacetime, we introduce two mass-independent geometric observables: the subring exponent $γ$ and the ratio of the critical impact parameter to that of the direct image of the innermost stable circular orbit (ISCO). We derive $γ$ in closed form and show that it is independent of the AdS radius and satisfies $2π/\sqrt{3}<γ\leqπ\sqrt{2}$, above the values for four-dimensional Schwarzschild and Reissner--Nordström black holes. Using a Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) forecast based on noiseless mock data with illustrative fractional uncertainties of $5\%$, we find that the dimensionless AdS radius can be constrained with a relative uncertainty of $16$--$19\%$, whereas the charge can be distinguished from zero only for the near-extremal fiducial model considered. Under these assumptions, the subring exponent provides a Gaussian separation of $3.4$--$5.9σ$ from the four-dimensional Schwarzschild black hole.

</details>


### [443] [Disentangling Spin-induced Precession vs. Eccentricity in GW190521 and GW231123](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40077)
*Patricia McMillin,Giuseppe Ficarra,Carlos O. Lousto,Richard O'Shaughnessy*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 利用RIT双黑洞波形目录第五版中逾2000个全数值相对论模拟，通过RIFT对GW190521与GW231123做贝叶斯参数估计，确认前者偏心且自旋进动、后者仅偏好自旋进动而偏心率可忽略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GW190521此前被认为在进入探测器频段（20 Hz）时可能具有较大偏心率，需用更大规模数值相对论波形库重新检验；同时希望检验该方法能否在现有引力波信号中区分偏心率（eccentricity）与自旋进动（spin precession）两种效应。

Method: 采用RIT双黑洞波形目录（RIT binary-black-hole waveform catalog）第五版中超过2000个全数值相对论（numerical relativity）模拟，结合快速迭代拟合算法（rapid iterative fitting algorithm, RIFT）对GW190521和GW231123进行贝叶斯参数估计（Bayesian parameter estimation），并与仅含非进动（偏心与准圆）模拟的分析作对比。

Result: GW190521的最高似然来自同时偏心且自旋进动的波形，e20 = 0.207（+0.192/−0.147）、χ1,⊥ = 0.717（+0.194/−0.406）；GW231123偏好自旋进动，χ1,⊥ = 0.678（+0.218/−0.462），但偏心率可忽略，e10 = 0.097（+0.124/−0.073）、e20 = 0.056（+0.059/−0.045）。仅用非进动模拟时两者似然均更低；最高似然模拟给出的最终黑洞反冲速度（recoil velocity）分别为3965 km/s（GW190521）与2059 km/s（GW231123）。

Conclusion: 该方法能够在当前引力波信号中区分偏心率与自旋进动效应，并支持GW190521偏心且进动的解释；最大似然数值相对论模拟还给出了两事件合并后黑洞的较大反冲速度估计。

Abstract: We use the more than 2000 full numerical-relativity simulations included in the fifth release of the RIT binary-black-hole waveform catalog to perform Bayesian parameter estimation, via the rapid iterative fitting algorithm (RIFT), for the gravitational-wave events GW190521 and GW231123. We revisit GW190521, which has previously been identified as potentially possessing large eccentricity upon entering the detector band at $20~\mathrm{Hz}$, and confirm this finding: the highest likelihood is obtained from waveforms that are simultaneously eccentric and spin-precessing, yielding $e_{20} =0.207_{-0.147}^{+0.192}$ and $χ_{1,\perp}=0.717_{-0.406}^{+0.194}$. Applying the same simulation pool to GW231123, we likewise find a preference for spin precession where at 20 Hz $χ_{1,\perp}=0.678_{-0.462}^{+0.218}$, but in this case with negligible eccentricity at both $10~\mathrm{Hz}$ and $20~\mathrm{Hz}$, with $e_{10}=0.097_{-0.073}^{+0.124}$ and $e_{20}=0.056_{-0.045}^{+0.059}$. For comparison, both events are also analyzed using exclusively non-precessing (eccentric and quasi-circular) simulations, which yield lower likelihoods in each case. These results indicate that our approach is capable of discriminating between the effects of eccentricity and spin precession in current gravitational-wave signals. The singled out top peak likelihood NR simulations give estimates of the recoil velocities of the merged final holes of 3965km/s for GW190521, and of 2059km/s for GW231123.

</details>


### [444] [Nonminimal Scalar-curvature Coupling Noncanonical Warm Inflation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40159)
*Zhi-Peng Peng,Shi-Chao Zhang,Xiao-Pei Xu,Ruan-Jing Zhang,Xiao-Min Zhang,Xi-Bin Li*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 该文研究包含暴胀子与标量曲率非最小耦合（nonminimal coupling）的非标准（noncanonical）温暴胀（warm inflation）模型，在 Jordan 框架下导出修正背景方程与慢滚（slow-roll）条件，并借助随机方法（stochastic approach）得到标量谱与张量谱，指出非最小耦合、非标准动力学与热耗散联合压低张标比（tensor-to-scalar ratio）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 常规温暴胀框架在解释观测约束（如张标比）与场域范围方面仍存在局限，作者希望考察非最小耦合与非标准动力学能否作为可行扩展，放宽对势垒陡峭度与场位移的要求。

Method: 在 Jordan 框架（Jordan frame）中推导修正的背景方程，利用线性稳定性分析（linear stability analysis）建立慢滚条件；采用随机方法导出暴胀子涨落的 Langevin 方程，并计算原初标量功率谱与张量功率谱（primordial scalar and tensor power spectra）。

Result: 非最小耦合增强有效阻尼（effective damping）并修正势梯度（potential gradient），使较陡势也能实现慢滚；标量谱近似标度不变（nearly scale-invariant），而非最小耦合、非标准动力学与热耗散的共同效应可进一步压低张标比；模型在弱耗散（weak-dissipation）区域仍可维持温暴胀，并在合适参数区间容许亚普朗克场位移（sub-Planckian field excursions）。

Conclusion: 上述结果表明该框架可作为常规温暴胀的一种可行扩展（viable extension），其显著特征在于通过耦合与耗散机制同时改善慢滚实现条件与谱观测量的符合度。

Abstract: We investigate a noncanonical warm inflationary model with a nonminimal coupling between the inflaton field and scalar curvature. Within the Jordan frame, we derive the modified background equations and establish the slow-roll conditions through a linear stability analysis. We find that the nonminimal coupling enhances the effective damping and modifies the potential gradient, facilitating slow-roll evolution even for relatively steep potentials. Using the stochastic approach, we derive the Langevin equation for inflaton fluctuations and obtain the primordial scalar and tensor power spectra. Our results show that the scalar spectrum is nearly scale-invariant, while the combined effects of nonminimal coupling, noncanonical dynamics, and thermal dissipation can further suppress the tensor-to-scalar ratio. Moreover, the model can sustain warm inflation even in the weak-dissipation regime and accommodate sub-Planckian field excursions in suitable parameter regions. These findings highlight the potential of this framework as a viable extension of conventional warm inflation.

</details>


### [445] [Rotation overcharges vectorized black holes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40179)
*Shengjun Guo,Guangzai Ye,Peng Liu*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 该文构造了 Einstein–Maxwell–Vector（EMV）模型中首个旋转矢量化黑洞解，证明矢量毛（vector hair）不再以牺牲电荷为代价，可在耦合阈值以上突破极值 Kerr–Newman 上限，并在阴影椭率上留下难以模仿的印记。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 带电黑洞存在由极值性（extremality）设定的电荷上限，而此前矢量化只降低该上限（球对称解严格欠带电）。球对称性同时使毛的质量退化（Komar 质量恒为零、$M_V=2\Omega_HJ_V$ 退化为 $0=0$），因此“上限是否为矢量场本身的属性”一直悬而未决。

Method: 在无质量矢量场与电磁不变量非最小耦合的 EMV 模型中构造旋转（轴对称）解，借助转动同时破除质量与电荷两重退化，并利用 $M_V=2\Omega_HJ_V$ 将毛的质量确定为旋转响应的二阶不变量；随后通过阴影椭率（ellipticity）分解量化毛的可观测效应，并讨论鬼自由性（ghost-free）判据的适用性。

Result: 毛的质量并非自由参数，而由 $M_V=2\Omega_HJ_V$ 固定。超过耦合阈值后存在域（domain of existence）越过极值 Kerr–Newman 界，可达 $q=Q/M>1$、$q^2+\chi^2$ 最高约 $1.84$；而 $\alpha=5$ 时最大电荷仍低于该界。在 $(q,\chi)=(0.9947,0.10)$ 处，毛贡献椭率 $8.30\%$，远高于电荷的 $0.44\%$ 与转动的 $0.06\%$（约 19 倍）；在过带电解 $(q,\chi)=(1.2527,0.10)$ 处总椭率达 $25.6\%$。

Conclusion: 电荷上限并非矢量场的固有属性，而是球对称假设造成的假象；转动使毛的质量与阴影效应同时显现。该分支是否鬼自由仍为开放问题，现有 no-go 判据因所设背景与色散关系不适用而无法裁定。

Abstract: A charged black hole has a ceiling: extremality bounds the charge that a given mass and spin can support. Vector hair has so far only lowered it. In the Einstein--Maxwell--Vector (EMV) model, where a massless vector field couples nonminimally to the electromagnetic invariant, the spherically symmetric vectorized Reissner--Nordström black holes are strictly undercharged: vector hair is paid for in charge. Whether this ceiling is a property of the vector field or merely of spherical symmetry has remained open, because spherical symmetry hides the hair's mass as well: its Komar mass vanishes identically and the exact identity $M_V=2Ω_HJ_V$ degenerates to $0=0$. Rotation lifts both degeneracies at once. We construct the rotating solutions of the model, the first in this setting, and find that the hair's mass is not a free parameter but a second-order invariant of the rotational response, fixed by $M_V=2Ω_HJ_V$. Above a coupling threshold the ceiling gives way: the domain of existence crosses the extremal Kerr--Newman bound, reaching $q=Q/M>1$ with $q^2+χ^2$ up to $1.84$, while at $α=5$ the maximum charge stays below it. The shadow is where the hair becomes visible. At $(q,χ)=(0.9947,0.10)$, near the extremal bound, the hair contributes an ellipticity of $8.30\%$, against $0.44\%$ from the charge and $0.06\%$ from rotation --- a factor of $19$ that charging a Kerr black hole cannot mimic; at the overcharged solution $(q,χ)=(1.2527,0.10)$ the total ellipticity reaches $25.6\%$. Whether the branch is ghost-free remains open, but the existing no-go criteria do not settle it: they assume a background and a dispersion relation that do not hold here.

</details>


### [446] [Gravitational waves away from a Schwarzschild black hole: full spectrum analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40181)
*Marco Refuto,Giampiero Esposito*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 该文研究施瓦西零无穷（Schwarzschild null infinity）附近引力波（gravitational waves）的渐近结构，将其视为无质量标量场（massless scalar field）的自旋加权推广（spin-weighted generalisation），并计算其完整频谱（full spectrum），与 LIGO 和 VIRGO 实验观测结果保持一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该工作是作者近期研究的延续，此前在黑洞微扰理论（black hole perturbation theory）中运用了庞加莱渐近展开（Poincaré asymptotic expansion），现希望将其数学形式体系与引力波唯象学（gravitational wave phenomenology）建立紧密联系。

Method: 在施瓦西零无穷附近，将引力波按无质量标量场的自旋加权推广处理，并采用先前发展的庞加莱渐近展开框架计算其完整频谱。

Result: 计算得到引力波的完整频谱，该结果与 LIGO 和 VIRGO 实验的观测数据相符。

Conclusion: 所发展的数学形式体系与引力波唯象学密切相关，可为研究引力波特征提供新的数学工具。

Abstract: Gravitational waves as one approaches Schwarzschild null infinity are the core of our investigation, treated as the spin-weighted generalisation of a massless scalar field. In particular, we compute their full spectrum, consistent with observations coming from LIGO and VIRGO experiments. This paper continues recent work by the authors, where the Poincaré asymptotic expansion was exploited in black hole perturbation theory. The mathematical formalism we developed is now intimately connected with gravitational wave phenomenology, providing new mathematical tools to investigate their features.

</details>


### [447] [Scalar--photon coupling in cosmology: Radiation evolution, recombination, and CMB signatures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40319)
*Y Bisabr*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 该文研究宇宙学标量场（scalar field）与辐射之间的有效标量-光子流体耦合（scalar-photon-fluid coupling），推导耦合背景与线性扰动方程，在CLASS中实现并给出CMB与物质谱的可观测影响；结果未显示观测偏好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标量场与辐射的相互作用可能改变复合前（pre-recombination）膨胀历史，并在宇宙微波背景（cosmic microwave background, CMB）各向异性中留下可观测印记，因此需系统评估此类耦合的观测可行性。

Method: 以指数势（exponential potential）正则标量场为对象，推导耦合背景与线性扰动方程及领头阶绝热初始条件（adiabatic initial conditions）；从辐射期标度解（scaling solution）出发，在CLASS中实现动力学耦合，计算复合历史、CMB各向异性与线性物质功率谱（matter power spectrum），光子热力学与碰撞作唯象处理并假定普朗克谱保持，采用条件化Planck 2018温度、偏振与透镜似然（likelihood），固定六个标准宇宙学参数并剖面化校准参数A_Planck。

Result: 耦合对CMB与物质谱产生标度依赖（scale-dependent）的修正，但弱耦合下条件似然较平坦；最佳采样点(ε_i, σ)=(4×10^-5, 0.10)相对匹配的无相互作用ΛCDM参考略受不利（Δχ²≈+0.30）。

Conclusion: 研究建立了唯象的宇宙学特征，但未证明对该相互作用存在观测偏好；确定性约束仍需对光子热化（photon thermalization）、碰撞动力学与光子密度归一化作进一步验证。

Abstract: Interactions between a cosmological scalar field and radiation can modify the pre-recombination expansion history and leave observable signatures in cosmic microwave background (CMB) anisotropies. We investigate an effective scalar-photon-fluid coupling, deriving the coupled background and linear perturbation equations and leading-order adiabatic initial conditions for a canonical scalar field with an exponential potential. Starting from a radiation-era scaling solution, we implement the dynamical interaction in CLASS and compute the resulting recombination history, CMB anisotropies, and linear matter power spectrum. Photon thermodynamics and collisions are treated phenomenologically, assuming preservation of a Planckian spectrum. We assess observational compatibility using conditional Planck 2018 temperature, polarization, and lensing likelihoods, holding the six standard cosmological parameters fixed while profiling the calibration parameter $A_{\rm Planck}$.
  The interaction produces scale-dependent modifications to CMB and matter spectra, but the conditional likelihood remains shallow at weak coupling. The best sampled interacting point, $(ε_i,σ)=(4\times10^{-5},0.10)$, is slightly disfavored relative to the matched interaction-off $Λ$CDM reference ($Δχ^2\simeq+0.30$). These results establish phenomenological cosmological signatures without demonstrating an observational preference for the interaction. Definitive constraints require further validation of photon thermalization, collision dynamics, and photon-density normalization.

</details>


### [448] [Quasinormal-mode encounters: Pseudospectra near Kerr--Newman exceptional points](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40323)
*Kyriakos Destounis*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 本工作在 Kerr–Newman 时空中借助伪谱（pseudospectra）与条件数（condition numbers），研究近例外点（exceptional points, EPs）处黑洞准正规模（quasinormal modes）的谱不稳定性放大；结果显示近邻模式对的条件数显著高于更阻尼模式，且频率劈裂与条件数分别遵循平方根规律及其倒数标度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 例外点处两个准正规模频率与本征矢合并，可显著增强黑洞准正规模的谱不稳定性；作者意在 Kerr–Newman 时空中定量刻画这一机制，并为其对黑洞铃宕（ringdown）的贡献奠定基础。

Method: 对无质量中性标量场沿 (\ell,m)=(1,1) 椭球分支（spheroidal branch）由能动张量（stress-energy tensor）导出能量范数；对耦合引力电磁（gravitoelectromagnetic, GE）扰动采用具正辐射能量的四场耦合系统，并以伪谱与条件数在选定近 EP 背景上进行分析。

Result: 在所选近 EP 背景上，近邻模式对中两个模式的条件数均超过同一背景下作为对照的两个更阻尼模式；沿匹配的 GE 参数路径，频率劈裂服从平方根律，条件数随至 EP 距离的平方根倒数增长，伪谱等值线（pseudospectral contours）可分辨由单体模式敏感性向模式对集体响应的转变。

Conclusion: 在本文所考虑的离散化问题与能量范数范围内，结果定量给出了 EP 附近谱不稳定性的放大，并为研究其对黑洞铃宕的贡献提供了基础。

Abstract: Exceptional points (EPs), at which two quasinormal frequencies and their eigenvectors coalesce, can strongly enhance the spectral instability of black hole quasinormal modes. We investigate this behavior in Kerr--Newman spacetimes through pseudospectra and condition numbers for neutral massless scalar fields and coupled gravitoelectromagnetic (GE) perturbations. For the scalar field, we follow the $(\ell,m)=(1,1)$ spheroidal branch and derive the energy norm from the stress-energy tensor. For GE perturbations, we use a coupled four-field system equipped with a positive radiative energy. At the selected near-EP backgrounds, the condition numbers of both modes in the close pair exceed those of the two more-damped modes shown for comparison at the same background. Along a matched GE parameter path, the frequency splitting follows a square-root law and the condition numbers grow as the inverse square root of the distance to the EP. The pseudospectral contours resolve the transition from individual-mode sensitivity to the collective response of the pair. Within the discretized problems and energy norms considered here, these results quantify the amplification of spectral instability near EPs and provide a basis for studying their contribution to black-hole ringdown.

</details>


### [449] [Curvature Blindness: Material Inference in Stars and Black Hole Candidates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40501)
*Jacob M. Krebs*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 论文通过“属性层面可辨识性判据（property-level identifiability criterion）”组织广义相对论中的逆问题，区分两类物质属性无法由引力观测确定的情形：不同状态具有相同总源、不同时空历史具有相同留存观测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 引力观测可在两种方式下使物质属性无法确定：一是不同状态可能具有相同总源（equal-source ambiguity），二是不同时空历史可能产生相同的留存观测。论文旨在为恒星与黑洞候选者的相关逆问题提供统一的辨识框架。

Method: 建立属性层面的可辨识性判据，并区分瞬时源相等、历史全域源相等与观测投影三个层次。以两个理想无质量气体（ideal massless gases）说明等源歧义，另以一个因果流体（causal-fluid）示例比较相同源与几何数据但本构响应不同的模型，考察曲率历史与尺度因子（scale factor）的偏离阶数。

Result: 两个理想无质量气体的温度相差因子(8/29)^{1/4}，熵不同而应力-能量张量（stress-energy tensor）一致。因果流体示例中两模型曲率历史在固有时（proper time）线性阶分离，尺度因子在立方阶分离。对黑洞候选者，区分了稳态外部参数、扰动通量与组分历史。

Conclusion: 该框架提供了检验留存数据能否辨识某一物质属性的判据，并将瞬时源相等、历史全域源相等与观测投影加以区分，可应用于恒星与黑洞候选者的引力逆问题分析。

Abstract: Gravitational observations can leave material properties undetermined in two different ways: distinct states can have the same total source, and distinct spacetime histories can have the same retained observations. We organize these inverse problems in general relativity through a property-level identifiability criterion, with applications to stars and black hole candidates. Two ideal massless gases illustrate equal-source ambiguity: their temperatures differ by a factor of $(8/29)^{1/4}$ and their entropies differ while their stress-energy tensors agree. A separate causal-fluid example starts with identical sources and geometric data but different constitutive responses; the two models' curvature histories separate at linear order in proper time and their scale factors at cubic order. For black hole candidates, the relevant distinction is between stationary exterior parameters, perturbing fluxes and constituent history. The framework provides a test for whether retained data identify a material property, separating instantaneous source equality, history-wide source equality and observational projection.

</details>


### [450] [Anisotropic overlap reduction functions for arbitrary equal-arm TDI channels: A fully analytic framework and efficient evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40548)
*Kun Zhou,Jin Li*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 该文建立面向静态互易等臂等边星座中任意有限延迟TDI通道的各向异性重叠约减函数（ORF）统一解析框架，将通道生成与角度积分分离，并实现比天空数值积分快约50–5000倍的稳定高精度评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多通道各向异性引力波背景建模需要任意有限延迟时延干涉（TDI）通道的重叠约减函数（ORF），但缺乏统一解析构造，且直接天空积分（sky quadrature）效率低、精度受限。

Method: 构造结合激光噪声消除的多项式约束、星座对称性与方向投影积分；用容许通道模（channel module）的自由基把通道生成与角度积分解耦，再由两类基本角核生成全部通道对强度ORF。通道代数与偏振无关，强度核约减适用于张量（tensor）、矢量（vector）、呼吸（breathing）与纵向（longitudinal）扇区；保留完整传播效应至任意固定有限角阶，并给出至ℓ=5的显式示例。数值上采用预备频率批次（prepared frequency batches）、共享多精度表达式与可去延迟点局部展开。

Result: 在预备批次基准测试中，同等误差容限下解析实现比优化的天空数值积分快约50至5000倍；独立多精度天空积分验证了预设混合误差目标，测试案例可达10^{-100}量级。

Conclusion: 所得核与生成规则为各向异性多通道背景模型提供可复用输入，验证了通道代数与角核分解的有效性与数值稳定性。

Abstract: We establish a unified analytic framework for anisotropic overlap reduction functions (ORFs) of arbitrary finite-delay time-delay interferometry (TDI) channels in a static, reciprocal, equal-arm equilateral constellation. The construction combines the polynomial constraints for laser-noise cancellation, constellation symmetries, and directional-projection integration. A free basis of the admissible channel module separates channel generation from angular integration; two families of elementary angular kernels then generate all channel-pair intensity ORFs. The channel algebra is independent of gravitational-wave polarization, and the intensity-kernel reduction applies to tensor, vector, breathing, and longitudinal sectors. Tensor multipoles illustrate the framework here. Complete propagation effects are retained at arbitrary fixed finite angular order, with explicit examples through $\ell=5$. Prepared frequency batches, shared multiprecision expressions, and local expansions at removable delay points provide stable evaluation. In the prepared-batch benchmark, the analytic implementation is approximately 50 to 5000 times faster than optimized sky quadrature at matched error tolerances. Independent multiprecision sky integrations also validate prescribed mixed error targets down to $10^{-100}$ in the tested cases. The resulting kernels and generation rules supply reusable inputs for anisotropic multichannel background models.

</details>


### [451] [Gravitational-Wave Echoes and Greybody Cutoff from Logarithmic Throats at a Marginal-Trapping Threshold](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40631)
*Jahed Abedi*

Main category: gr-qc

TL;DR: 静态球对称构型接近边缘捕获阈值（marginal-trapping threshold）时形成长喉（throat）；喉内轴向引力波（axial gravitational waves）被角动量势垒围成腔体，产生间隔为 $T_{\rm echo}\propto\Delta^{-s/2}$ 的回声（echoes），且势垒对反射谱施加与任何视界表面重力无关的灰体截断（greybody cutoff）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探讨无视界（horizonless）微态几何（microstate geometries）中"带帽喉"结构的可观测特征：需要理解喉区如何影响引力波传播，并区分其回声时延与薄壳引力星（thin-shell gravastars）、虫洞（wormholes）等模型的差异。

Method: 构建喉区的有效模型，将时移函数（lapse）参数化为 $N\propto F^{s/2}$，其中 $F=1-2m/r\simeq\Delta+\beta(r-R_M)^2$；在此模型下研究轴向引力波的传播，并以四维、有物质支撑的准黑洞（quasi-black holes，具有正则中心与近-AdS$_2$ 喉）为具体实现，辅以时域演化（time-domain evolutions）验证标度关系。

Result: 当 $s>0$ 时喉充当角动量势垒后的腔体，回声间隔 $T_{\rm echo}\simeq2\Lambda+\delta\propto\Delta^{-s/2}$（$\Lambda$ 为喉的光学长度，$\delta$ 与 $\Delta$ 无关），由喉底附近红移的倒数控制；时域演化在 $\Delta$ 的三个数量级范围内确认该标度，而 $s=0$ 时喉并入势垒、无独立回声。势垒还导致反射谱截断 $1-\Gamma\simeq e^{-(\omega-f)/T}$，$T$ 由势垒曲率决定、不依赖任何背后视界的表面重力。

Conclusion: 在该模型中，无论内部含视界还是反射喉，初始信号（prompt signal）相同；但无视界情形下透射波会以回声形式返回，从而恢复完整反射谱的高频部分。该结果说明带帽喉的回声时延由喉底红移决定，与仅呈对数增长时延的薄壳引力星和虫洞模型不同，为 horizonless microstate geometries 的观测鉴别提供依据。

Abstract: When a static, spherically symmetric configuration is brought close to a marginal-trapping threshold, it develops a long throat. As the nondegenerate minimum of $F=1-2m/r$ approaches zero, $F\simeqΔ+β(r-R_M)^2$, the proper length across the throat grows as $-\lnΔ/\sqrtβ$, even though the local curvature stays finite. We study how axial gravitational waves propagate in an effective model of this throat, in which the lapse is parametrized as $N\propto F^{s/2}$. For $s>0$ the throat acts as a cavity behind the angular-momentum barrier, and waves come back out as echoes spaced by $T_{\rm echo}\simeq2Λ+δ\proptoΔ^{-s/2}$, where $Λ$ is the optical length of the throat and $δ$ does not depend on $Δ$. We study four-dimensional, matter-supported quasi-black holes in which a regular centre caps the near-AdS$_2$ throat. These configurations provide a simplified model for investigating capped throats in horizonless microstate geometries. The echo delay in this model is controlled by the inverse redshift near the bottom of the throat, as in capped microstate geometries. This differs from thin-shell gravastars and wormholes, where the delay grows only logarithmically with the distance to the would-be horizon. Time-domain evolutions confirm the $Δ^{-s/2}$ scaling over three decades in $Δ$; for $s=0$ the throat becomes part of the barrier and no distinct echo appears. The barrier also imposes a greybody cutoff on the reflected spectrum, $1-Γ\simeq e^{-(ω-f)/T}$, where $T$ is fixed by the curvature of the barrier and does not depend on the surface gravity of any horizon behind it. In this model, the prompt signal is the same whether the interior contains a horizon or a reflecting throat. In the horizonless case, however, the transmitted wave returns as echoes, restoring the high-frequency part of the full reflected spectrum.

</details>
